  // a18: one live runner instance owns all model-facing transport and durable writes.
  // A package can be injected repeatedly (or, historically, accidentally concatenated).
  // stop() clears timers, but it cannot cancel an async continuation that already crossed an await.
  // The global instance token therefore fences those stale continuations deterministically.
  const RUNNER_INSTANCE_SLOT_V614 = '__VIBE_GO_RUNNER_INSTANCE_V614__';
  const previousVibeGoRunnerV614 = window.VibeGo || null;
  const runnerInstanceTokenV614 = {
    id: `vibe-runner-a37:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    retired: false,
  };
  globalThis[RUNNER_INSTANCE_SLOT_V614] = runnerInstanceTokenV614;

  function isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614() {
    return runnerInstanceTokenV614.retired !== true &&
      globalThis[RUNNER_INSTANCE_SLOT_V614] === runnerInstanceTokenV614;
  }

  function retireRunnerInstanceV614() {
    runnerInstanceTokenV614.retired = true;
  }

  // a18: legacy closures injected before the durable lease existed cannot be made to
  // voluntarily obey it. Fence the actual ChatGPT send surface as the final authority
  // boundary. Trusted user clicks always pass. Programmatic clicks require a one-shot
  // permit owned by the currently installed runner instance. The capture listener is
  // installed once and reads the global gate dynamically, so re-injection supersedes
  // old permits without stacking competing listeners.
  const PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SLOT_V616 = '__VIBE_GO_PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_V616__';
  const PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SCHEMA_V616 = 'vibe-go-physical-send-gate/v1';

  function physicalSendButtonFromTargetV616(target) {
    const element = target?.closest?.('button,[data-testid="send-button"],[data-testid="composer-submit-button"]') || null;
    if (!element) return null;
    const testId = String(element.getAttribute?.('data-testid') || '');
    if (testId === 'send-button' || testId === 'composer-submit-button') return element;
    if (String(element.tagName || '').toLowerCase() !== 'button') return null;
    const label = String(element.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || element.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (label === 'send' || label.includes('send message') || label === 'отправить' || label.includes('отправить сообщение')) {
      return element;
    }
    return null;
  }

  let physicalSendGateV616 = globalThis[PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SLOT_V616];
  if (!physicalSendGateV616 || physicalSendGateV616.schema !== PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SCHEMA_V616) {
    physicalSendGateV616 = {
      schema: PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SCHEMA_V616,
      generation: 0,
      ownerInstanceId: null,
      permit: null,
      blockedProgrammaticClicks: 0,
      allowedProgrammaticClicks: 0,
      payloadMismatches: 0,
      canonicalizedPayloadAccepts: 0,
      usageGovernorBlocks: 0,
      lastUsageGovernorBlock: null,
      lastBlocked: null,
      lastAllowed: null,
      lastPayloadMismatch: null,
      lastCanonicalizedPayloadAccept: null,
      listenerInstalled: false,
    };
    globalThis[PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SLOT_V616] = physicalSendGateV616;
  }
  physicalSendGateV616.generation = Number(physicalSendGateV616.generation || 0) + 1;
  physicalSendGateV616.ownerInstanceId = runnerInstanceTokenV614.id;
  physicalSendGateV616.permit = null;

  if (!physicalSendGateV616.listenerInstalled) {
    physicalSendGateV616.listenerInstalled = true;
    document.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (event.isTrusted) return;
      const button = physicalSendButtonFromTargetV616(event.target);
      if (!button) return;
      const gate = globalThis[PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SLOT_V616];
      const permit = gate?.permit || null;
      const valid = Boolean(
        gate?.schema === PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SCHEMA_V616 &&
        permit &&
        permit.ownerInstanceId === gate.ownerInstanceId &&
        permit.button === button &&
        Number(permit.expiresAt || 0) >= Date.now()
      );
      if (valid) {
        gate.allowedProgrammaticClicks = Number(gate.allowedProgrammaticClicks || 0) + 1;
        gate.lastAllowed = {
          permitId: permit.id,
          ownerInstanceId: permit.ownerInstanceId,
          context: permit.context || null,
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        gate.permit = null;
        return;
      }
      gate.blockedProgrammaticClicks = Number(gate.blockedProgrammaticClicks || 0) + 1;
      gate.lastBlocked = {
        ownerInstanceId: gate.ownerInstanceId || null,
        attemptedTarget: String(button.getAttribute?.('data-testid') || button.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || button.tagName || 'send'),
        at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      console.warn('[VIBE-GO a18 SEND GATE] blocked unpermitted programmatic ChatGPT send click', gate.lastBlocked);
    }, true);
  }

  function normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(value) {
    return String(value ?? '')
      .replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n')
      .replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ')
      .replace(/[\u200b\u200c\u200d\ufeff]/g, '')
      .normalize('NFC')
      .replace(/[ \t]+$/gm, '')
      .replace(/\n+$/g, '');
  }

  function compactComposerWitnessTextV617(value) {
    return normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(value).replace(/\s+/gu, '');
  }

  function composerPayloadCandidatesV617() {
    const composer = findComposer();
    if (!composer) return [];
    const values = [];
    if (composer instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) {
      values.push({ source: 'value', text: String(composer.value || '') });
    } else {
      if (typeof composer.innerText === 'string') values.push({ source: 'innerText', text: String(composer.innerText || '') });
      values.push({ source: 'textContent', text: String(composer.textContent || '') });
    }
    const seen = new Set();
    return values.filter(item => {
      const key = `${item.source}\u0000${item.text}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) return false;
      seen.add(key);
      return true;
    });
  }

  function expectedCausalEnvelopeV617(expectedText) {
    const text = String(expectedText || '');
    const dispatch = text.match(/\[\[VIBE_DISPATCH\s+id=([^\s\]]+)\s+session=([^\s\]]+)\s+revision=(\d+)\]\]/);
    if (dispatch) {
      return {
        kind: 'dispatch',
        dispatchId: dispatch[1],
        sessionId: dispatch[2],
        revision: Number(dispatch[3]),
      };
    }
    if (text.includes('VIBE-GO · REPAIR IMPULSE')) {
      const dispatchId = text.match(/\bdispatchId\s*=\s*([^\s]+)/)?.[1] || '';
      const sessionId = text.match(/\bsessionId\s*=\s*([^\s]+)/)?.[1] || '';
      const baseRevision = Number(text.match(/\bbaseRevision\s*=\s*(\d+)/)?.[1] || NaN);
      if (dispatchId && sessionId && Number.isFinite(baseRevision)) {
        return { kind: 'repair', dispatchId, sessionId, revision: baseRevision };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function composerCausalEnvelopeMatchesV617(actualText, envelope) {
    if (!envelope) return true;
    const actual = normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(actualText);
    if (envelope.kind === 'dispatch') {
      return actual.includes(`[[VIBE_DISPATCH id=${envelope.dispatchId} session=${envelope.sessionId} revision=${envelope.revision}]]`);
    }
    if (envelope.kind === 'repair') {
      return actual.includes('VIBE-GO · REPAIR IMPULSE') &&
        actual.includes(`sessionId = ${envelope.sessionId}`) &&
        actual.includes(`dispatchId = ${envelope.dispatchId}`) &&
        actual.includes(`baseRevision = ${envelope.revision}`);
    }
    return true;
  }

  function assessComposerPayloadV617(expectedText) {
    const expected = normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(expectedText);
    const expectedCompact = compactComposerWitnessTextV617(expectedText);
    const envelope = expectedCausalEnvelopeV617(expectedText);
    const candidates = composerPayloadCandidatesV617();
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      const normalized = normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(candidate.text);
      if (normalized === expected) {
        return { matches: true, mode: 'exact-normalized', source: candidate.source };
      }
    }
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      const compact = compactComposerWitnessTextV617(candidate.text);
      if (
        compact === expectedCompact &&
        composerCausalEnvelopeMatchesV617(candidate.text, envelope)
      ) {
        return {
          matches: true,
          mode: 'editor-whitespace-canonicalization',
          source: candidate.source,
          actualHash: hashText(normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(candidate.text)),
          expectedHash: hashText(expected),
          compactHash: hashText(expectedCompact),
          actualLength: normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(candidate.text).length,
          expectedLength: expected.length,
          envelope,
        };
      }
    }
    const diagnostic = candidates.map(candidate => {
      const normalized = normalizeComposerWitnessTextV617(candidate.text);
      const compact = compactComposerWitnessTextV617(candidate.text);
      return {
        source: candidate.source,
        actualHash: hashText(normalized),
        compactHash: hashText(compact),
        actualLength: normalized.length,
        causalEnvelopeMatches: composerCausalEnvelopeMatchesV617(candidate.text, envelope),
      };
    });
    return {
      matches: false,
      mode: 'mismatch',
      expectedHash: hashText(expected),
      expectedCompactHash: hashText(expectedCompact),
      expectedLength: expected.length,
      envelope,
      candidates: diagnostic,
    };
  }

  const OPERATOR_EVENT_BRIDGE_SLOT_V626 = '__VIBE_GO_OPERATOR_EVENT_BRIDGE_V626__';

    document.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (!event.isTrusted) return;
      const button = physicalSendButtonFromTargetV616(event.target);
      if (!button) return;
      globalThis[OPERATOR_EVENT_BRIDGE_SLOT_V626]?.handler?.({
        kind: 'trusted-send-click',

      });
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (!event.isTrusted || event.defaultPrevented) return;
      if (event.key !== 'Enter' || event.shiftKey || event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.isComposing) return;
      const composer = event.target?.closest?.('#prompt-textarea,[contenteditable="true"],textarea') || null;
      if (!composer) return;

        kind: 'trusted-composer-enter',

  }

  function clickSendButtonWithPermitV616(button, context = null, expectedText = null) {
    if (!button || !isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return false;
    const gate = globalThis[PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SLOT_V616];
    if (!gate || gate.schema !== PHYSICAL_SEND_GATE_SCHEMA_V616 || gate.ownerInstanceId !== runnerInstanceTokenV614.id) {
      return false;
    }
    const usageDecisionV625 = usageGovernorDecisionV625(String(context || 'programmatic-send-final-gate'));
    if (!usageDecisionV625.allowed) {
      gate.usageGovernorBlocks = Number(gate.usageGovernorBlocks || 0) + 1;
      gate.lastUsageGovernorBlock = {
        context: context ? String(context) : null,
        ...usageDecisionV625,
        at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      console.warn('[VIBE-GO a29 USAGE GOVERNOR] blocked late programmatic send at physical gate', gate.lastUsageGovernorBlock);
      return false;
    }
    if (expectedText != null) {
      const assessment = assessComposerPayloadV617(String(expectedText));
      if (!assessment.matches) {
        gate.payloadMismatches = Number(gate.payloadMismatches || 0) + 1;
        gate.lastPayloadMismatch = {
          context: context ? String(context) : null,
          ...assessment,
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        console.warn('[VIBE-GO a18 SEND GATE] composer payload changed before authorized click', gate.lastPayloadMismatch);
        return false;
      }
      if (assessment.mode === 'editor-whitespace-canonicalization') {
        gate.canonicalizedPayloadAccepts = Number(gate.canonicalizedPayloadAccepts || 0) + 1;
        gate.lastCanonicalizedPayloadAccept = {
          context: context ? String(context) : null,
          ...assessment,
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        console.info('[VIBE-GO a18 SEND GATE] accepted whitespace-only editor canonicalization with identical causal envelope', gate.lastCanonicalizedPayloadAccept);
      }
    }
    const permit = {
      id: `send-permit-v17:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`,
      ownerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id,
      button,
      context: context ? String(context) : null,
      issuedAt: Date.now(),
      expiresAt: Date.now() + 1500,
    };
    gate.permit = permit;
    try {
      // Reserve the usage event before the physical click. An unconfirmed click may
      // still have reached the platform, so under-counting it would be less safe.
      usageGovernorRecordSendV625(String(context || 'programmatic-send'), expectedText == null ? '' : String(expectedText));
      button.click();
      return true;
    } finally {
      if (gate.permit?.id === permit.id) gate.permit = null;
    }
  }

    semanticPauseNoops: 0,
    startedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  // Path-scoped persistence authority must exist before cacheKey or any
  // bootstrap/rebind consumer reads it. Keep this binding in the early
  // runtime state section to avoid temporal-dead-zone failures.
  let persistenceBoundPathname = location.pathname;

  let cacheKey =
    CONFIG.cachePrefix + location.origin + persistenceBoundPathname;

  function sleep(ms) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  function now() {
    return Date.now();
  }

  function randomInt(min, max) {
    const low = Math.ceil(min);
    const high = Math.floor(max);
    return Math.floor(Math.random() * (high - low + 1)) + low;
  }

  function log(...args) {
    console.log(
      '%c[VIBE-GO RESORT WEB v0.1 · MISSION NEUTRAL]',
      'color:#7dd3fc;font-weight:800',
      ...args
    );
  }

  function warn(...args) {
    console.warn('[VIBE-GO RESORT WEB v0.1 · MISSION NEUTRAL]', ...args);
  }

  function fail(...args) {
    console.error('[VIBE-GO RESORT WEB v0.1 · MISSION NEUTRAL]', ...args);
  }

  function normalizeText(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }

  function hashText(text) {
    let hash = 2166136261;

    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) {
      hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
      hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
    }

    return (hash >>> 0).toString(16);
  }

  /*
   * Runtime Persistence v2 — IndexedDB only.
   *
   * The Source Workspace keeps its own existing IndexedDB. Runtime/semantic
   * authority is deliberately separated into a second database so installing
   * this runner cannot be blocked by an already-open Source Workspace v3
   * connection. No production code below reads or writes Web Storage.
   *
   * Synchronous protocol-facing APIs read an already-hydrated RAM projection.
   * Durable writes are serialized into IndexedDB and semantic saves are
   * coalesced. Critical transport boundaries await flushRuntimePersistence().
   */
  const RUNTIME_DB_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-runtime-idb/v1';
  const RUNTIME_DB_VERSION = 1;
  const LEGACY_RUNTIME_DB_PREFIX_V616 = 'vibe-go-runtime:';
  const AUTHORITY_RUNTIME_DB_PREFIX_V616 = 'vibe-go-resort-web-runtime-authority-v1:';
  const LEGACY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616 = 'vibe-go-monolith-source:';
  const AUTHORITY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616 = 'vibe-go-resort-web-source-authority-v1:';

  function persistenceDbSuffixForPathV616(pathname) {
    return hashText(location.origin + String(pathname || '/'));
  }

  function runtimeDatabaseNameForPathV616(pathname) {
    return AUTHORITY_RUNTIME_DB_PREFIX_V616 + persistenceDbSuffixForPathV616(pathname);
  }

  function sourceDatabaseNameForPathV616(pathname) {
    return AUTHORITY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616 + persistenceDbSuffixForPathV616(pathname);
  }

  function runtimeDatabaseSuffixV616(name) {
    const value = String(name || '');
    if (value.startsWith(AUTHORITY_RUNTIME_DB_PREFIX_V616)) return value.slice(AUTHORITY_RUNTIME_DB_PREFIX_V616.length);
    if (value.startsWith(LEGACY_RUNTIME_DB_PREFIX_V616)) return value.slice(LEGACY_RUNTIME_DB_PREFIX_V616.length);
    return null;
  }

  function isVibeRuntimeDatabaseNameV616(name) {
    return runtimeDatabaseSuffixV616(name) !== null;
  }

  function sourceDatabaseSuffixV616(name) {
    const value = String(name || '');
    if (value.startsWith(AUTHORITY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616)) return value.slice(AUTHORITY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616.length);
    if (value.startsWith(LEGACY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616)) return value.slice(LEGACY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616.length);
    return null;
  }

  function isVibeSourceDatabaseNameV616(name) {
    return sourceDatabaseSuffixV616(name) !== null;
  }

  function pairedSourceDatabaseNamesV616(runtimeName) {
    const suffix = runtimeDatabaseSuffixV616(runtimeName);
    if (suffix == null) return [];
    return [
      AUTHORITY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616 + suffix,
      LEGACY_SOURCE_DB_PREFIX_V616 + suffix,
    ];
  }

  let RUNTIME_DB_NAME = runtimeDatabaseNameForPathV616(persistenceBoundPathname);
  const RUNTIME_STATE_STORE = 'runtimeState';
  const RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_STORE_NAMES = Object.freeze([
    'semanticSessions',
    'semanticTransport',
    'semanticCursors',
    'semanticPendingDispatch',
    'semanticDistances',
    'semanticRelatedRanges',
    'semanticNotes',
    'semanticDecisions',
    'semanticWorklog',
  ]);
  const RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES = Object.freeze([
    RUNTIME_STATE_STORE,
    ...RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_STORE_NAMES,
    'recoveryJournal',
  ]);
  const RUNTIME_ALL_STORE_NAMES = Object.freeze([
    ...RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES,
    'legacyMigrationInbox',
  ]);

  let runtimeDatabasePromise = null;
  let vibeBootstrapPromise = null;

  const runtimePersistence = {
    hydrated: false,
    hydratePromise: null,
    runtimeState: new Map(),
    semanticSession: null,
    semanticCommittedIndex: null,
    semanticPendingSession: null,
    semanticWriterScheduled: false,
    semanticCompactionPersistenceDeferredV619: false,
    writeTail: Promise.resolve(),
    failedWrites: new Map(),
  };

  // a16 durable single-writer lease. The new isolated runtime namespace prevents
  // pre-a16 closures from touching this authority database at all. The lease then
  // arbitrates multiple a16 tabs/instances that legitimately share one chat path.
  const SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_KEY_V616 = 'semanticRuntimeLeaseV616';
  const SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_SCHEMA_V616 = 'vibe-go-semantic-runtime-lease/v1';
  let semanticRuntimeLeaseV616 = null;

  function semanticRuntimeLeaseMatchesV616(value) {
    return Boolean(
      value &&
      value.schema === SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_SCHEMA_V616 &&
      value.ownerInstanceId === runnerInstanceTokenV614.id &&
      semanticRuntimeLeaseV616 &&
      Number(value.generation) === Number(semanticRuntimeLeaseV616.generation) &&
      value.leaseId === semanticRuntimeLeaseV616.leaseId
    );
  }

  async function claimSemanticRuntimeLeaseV616(reason = 'runner-claim') {
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return null;
    const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return null;
    const transaction = database.transaction(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE, 'readwrite');
    const done = runtimeTransactionDone(transaction);
    const store = transaction.objectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE);
    const previousRow = await runtimeRequest(store.get(SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_KEY_V616));
    const previous = previousRow?.value || null;
    const lease = {
      schema: SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_SCHEMA_V616,
      leaseId: `semantic-lease-v16:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`,
      ownerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id,
      generation: Math.max(0, Number(previous?.generation || 0)) + 1,
      pathname: persistenceBoundPathname,
      runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      reason: String(reason || 'runner-claim'),
      acquiredAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    store.put({ key: SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_KEY_V616, value: persistenceClone(lease), updatedAt: semanticIsoNow() });
    await done;
    semanticRuntimeLeaseV616 = lease;
    runtimePersistence.runtimeState.set(SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_KEY_V616, persistenceClone(lease));
    return persistenceClone(lease);
  }

  async function verifySemanticRuntimeLeaseV616() {
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614() || !semanticRuntimeLeaseV616) return false;
    const row = await runtimeDbGet(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE, SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_KEY_V616).catch(() => null);
    const value = row?.value || null;
    const matches = semanticRuntimeLeaseMatchesV616(value);
    if (!matches) {
      warn('durable semantic lease lost; this runner becomes transport read-only', {
        expected: semanticRuntimeLeaseV616,
        current: value,
      });
    }
    return matches;
  }

  function requireSemanticRuntimeLeaseInTransactionV616(transaction, writer) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = transaction.objectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE).get(SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_KEY_V616);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Unable to verify semantic runtime lease'));
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const value = request.result?.value || null;
        if (!semanticRuntimeLeaseMatchesV616(value)) {
          try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
          reject(new Error('SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_LOST: durable writer authority belongs to another runner'));
          return;
        }
        try {
          writer();
          resolve(true);
        } catch (error) {
          try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
          reject(error);
        }
      };
    });
  }

  // a15: full SemanticSession snapshots can survive across awaits. A same-instance
  // continuation may therefore try to save transport state captured before a newer
  // queued/submitting/submitted authority transition. Keep a monotonic causal epoch
  // inside transport and reconcile every full-session save against the current RAM
  // authority before it can reach IndexedDB.
  const SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_EPOCH_V615 = 'authorityEpochV615';
  const SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_UPDATED_AT_V615 = 'authorityUpdatedAtV615';
  const semanticTransportFenceStatsV615 = {
    epochAdvances: 0,
    staleTransportSnapshotsMerged: 0,
    staleSemanticSnapshotsRejected: 0,
    lastEvent: null,
  };

  function semanticTransportAuthorityEpochV615(sessionInput = null) {
    const transport = sessionInput?.transport || {};
    const value = Number(transport?.[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_EPOCH_V615] || 0);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
  }

  function semanticTransportComparableV615(transportInput = null) {
    const transport = persistenceClone(transportInput || {});
    delete transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_EPOCH_V615];
    delete transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_UPDATED_AT_V615];
    // Local evidence is factual payload metadata, not causal send authority. It may
    // complete after a newer transport transition and is merged separately below.
    delete transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps;
    delete transport.sourceIntelligenceHistoryV703;
    delete transport.failureHistoryV704;
    delete transport.lastProjectDataOpsV670;
    return transport;
  }

  function semanticTransportAuthorityChangedV615(a, b) {
    return JSON.stringify(semanticTransportComparableV615(a)) !==
      JSON.stringify(semanticTransportComparableV615(b));
  }

  function newerLocalEvidenceV615(currentInput, incomingInput) {
    const current = currentInput || null;
    const incoming = incomingInput || null;
    if (!incoming) return current ? persistenceClone(current) : null;
    if (!current) return persistenceClone(incoming);
    const currentAt = Date.parse(String(current.recordedAt || ''));
    const incomingAt = Date.parse(String(incoming.recordedAt || ''));
    if (Number.isFinite(incomingAt) && (!Number.isFinite(currentAt) || incomingAt >= currentAt)) {
      return persistenceClone(incoming);
    }
    return persistenceClone(current);
  }

  function reconcileSemanticSnapshotAuthorityV615(currentInput, incomingInput) {
    const current = currentInput ? persistenceClone(currentInput) : null;
    const incoming = persistenceClone(incomingInput);
    if (!current || String(current.id || '') !== String(incoming.id || '')) {
      incoming.transport = incoming.transport || {};
      incoming.transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_EPOCH_V615] =
        semanticTransportAuthorityEpochV615(incoming);
      return { session: incoming, mode: 'new-session' };
    }

    const currentRevision = Number(current.revision || 0);
    const incomingRevision = Number(incoming.revision || 0);
    const currentEpoch = semanticTransportAuthorityEpochV615(current);
    const incomingEpoch = semanticTransportAuthorityEpochV615(incoming);

    // A late async continuation must never roll the complete semantic ledger back.
    if (incomingRevision < currentRevision) {
      semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.staleSemanticSnapshotsRejected += 1;
      semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.lastEvent = {
        kind: 'stale-semantic-snapshot-rejected',
        currentRevision,
        incomingRevision,
        currentEpoch,
        incomingEpoch,
        at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      warn('authority fence rejected stale SemanticSession snapshot', semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.lastEvent);
      return { session: current, mode: 'stale-semantic-rejected' };
    }

    incoming.transport = incoming.transport || {};
    const incomingEvidence = incoming.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps || null;
    const incomingProjectEvidenceV670 = incoming.transport.lastProjectDataOpsV670 || null;

    if (incomingRevision === currentRevision && incomingEpoch < currentEpoch) {
      // Accept non-transport factual/semantic additions from the late continuation,
      // but preserve the newer complete causal transport authority.
      incoming.transport = persistenceClone(current.transport || {});
      const evidence = newerLocalEvidenceV615(
        current.transport?.lastSourceIntelligenceOps || null,
        incomingEvidence
      );
      if (evidence) incoming.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps = evidence;
      const projectEvidenceV670 = newerLocalEvidenceV615(
        current.transport?.lastProjectDataOpsV670 || null,
        incomingProjectEvidenceV670
      );
      if (projectEvidenceV670) incoming.transport.lastProjectDataOpsV670 = projectEvidenceV670;
      semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.staleTransportSnapshotsMerged += 1;
      semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.lastEvent = {
        kind: 'stale-transport-snapshot-merged',
        revision: currentRevision,
        currentEpoch,
        incomingEpoch,
        currentDispatchId: current.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        incomingDispatchId: incomingInput?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      log('authority fence preserved newer semantic transport over stale full-session save',
        semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.lastEvent);
      return { session: incoming, mode: 'stale-transport-merged' };
    }

    const authorityChanged = incomingRevision > currentRevision ||
      semanticTransportAuthorityChangedV615(current.transport, incoming.transport);
    if (authorityChanged) {
      const nextEpoch = Math.max(currentEpoch, incomingEpoch) + 1;
      incoming.transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_EPOCH_V615] = nextEpoch;
      incoming.transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_UPDATED_AT_V615] = semanticIsoNow();
      semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.epochAdvances += 1;
      semanticTransportFenceStatsV615.lastEvent = {
        kind: incomingRevision > currentRevision
          ? 'semantic-revision-authority-advance'
          : 'transport-authority-advance',
        currentRevision,
        incomingRevision,
        previousEpoch: currentEpoch,
        nextEpoch,
        previousDispatchId: current.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        nextDispatchId: incoming.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    } else {
      incoming.transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_EPOCH_V615] =
        Math.max(currentEpoch, incomingEpoch);
      if (current.transport?.[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_UPDATED_AT_V615]) {
        incoming.transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_UPDATED_AT_V615] =
          current.transport[SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_UPDATED_AT_V615];
      }
    }
    return { session: incoming, mode: authorityChanged ? 'authority-advanced' : 'no-authority-change' };
  }

  function persistenceClone(value) {
    if (value == null) return value;
    if (typeof structuredClone === 'function') return structuredClone(value);
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  }

  function runtimeRequest(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(
        request.error || new Error('Runtime IndexedDB request failed')
      );
    });
  }

  function runtimeTransactionDone(transaction) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      transaction.onabort = () => reject(
        transaction.error || new Error('Runtime IndexedDB transaction aborted')
      );
      transaction.onerror = () => reject(
        transaction.error || new Error('Runtime IndexedDB transaction failed')
      );
    });
  }

  function ensureRuntimeSessionIndex(store) {
    if (!store.indexNames.contains('sessionId')) {
      store.createIndex('sessionId', 'sessionId', { unique: false });
    }
  }

  function openRuntimeDatabase() {
    if (runtimeDatabasePromise) return runtimeDatabasePromise;
    if (!globalThis.indexedDB) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('IndexedDB is unavailable'));
    }
    runtimeDatabasePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(RUNTIME_DB_NAME, RUNTIME_DB_VERSION);
      request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        const database = request.result;
        const transaction = request.transaction;

        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE)) {
          database.createObjectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE, { keyPath: 'key' });
        }
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('semanticSessions')) {
          database.createObjectStore('semanticSessions', { keyPath: 'id' });
        }
        for (const name of ['semanticTransport', 'semanticCursors', 'semanticPendingDispatch']) {
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(name)) {
            database.createObjectStore(name, { keyPath: 'sessionId' });
          }
        }
        for (const name of [
          'semanticDistances',
          'semanticRelatedRanges',
          'semanticNotes',
          'semanticDecisions',
          'semanticWorklog',
        ]) {
          const store = database.objectStoreNames.contains(name)
            ? transaction.objectStore(name)
            : database.createObjectStore(name, { keyPath: 'key' });
          ensureRuntimeSessionIndex(store);
        }
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('recoveryJournal')) {
          database.createObjectStore('recoveryJournal', { keyPath: 'id' });
        }
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('legacyMigrationInbox')) {
          database.createObjectStore('legacyMigrationInbox', { keyPath: 'key' });
        }
      };
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(
        request.error || new Error('Unable to open VIBE runtime IndexedDB')
      );
      request.onblocked = () => warn('VIBE runtime IndexedDB open/upgrade is blocked');
    });
    return runtimeDatabasePromise;
  }

  async function runtimeDbGet(storeName, key) {
    const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readonly');
    return runtimeRequest(transaction.objectStore(storeName).get(key));
  }

  async function runtimeDbGetAll(storeName) {
    const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readonly');
    const store = transaction.objectStore(storeName);
    if (typeof store.getAll === 'function') return runtimeRequest(store.getAll());
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const rows = [];
      const request = store.openCursor();
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Runtime cursor failed'));
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const cursor = request.result;
        if (!cursor) return resolve(rows);
        rows.push(cursor.value);
        cursor.continue();
      };
    });
  }

  async function runtimeDbGetAllBySession(storeName, sessionId) {
    const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readonly');
    const store = transaction.objectStore(storeName);
    const index = store.index('sessionId');
    if (typeof index.getAll === 'function') {
      return runtimeRequest(index.getAll(IDBKeyRange.only(String(sessionId))));
    }
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const rows = [];
      const request = index.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(String(sessionId)));
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Runtime session cursor failed'));
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const cursor = request.result;
        if (!cursor) return resolve(rows);
        rows.push(cursor.value);
        cursor.continue();
      };
    });
  }

  function enqueueRuntimeWrite(label, writer) {
    const safeLabel = String(label || 'runtime-write');
    const previous = runtimePersistence.writeTail.catch(() => undefined);
    const current = previous.then(async () => {
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
      const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
      await writer(database);
      runtimePersistence.failedWrites.delete(safeLabel);
    });
    current.catch(error => {
      runtimePersistence.failedWrites.set(safeLabel, error);
      fail(`Runtime persistence failed [${safeLabel}]`, error);
    });
    runtimePersistence.writeTail = current;
    return current;
  }

  async function flushRuntimePersistence() {
    await runtimePersistence.writeTail.catch(() => undefined);
    if (runtimePersistence.failedWrites.size) {
      const [label, error] = runtimePersistence.failedWrites.entries().next().value;
      throw new Error(
        `Runtime persistence is not durable (${label}): ${error?.message || String(error)}`
      );
    }
    return true;
  }

  function getRuntimeStateValue(key, fallback = null) {
    if (!runtimePersistence.runtimeState.has(key)) return persistenceClone(fallback);
    return persistenceClone(runtimePersistence.runtimeState.get(key));
  }

  function replaceRuntimeStateValue(key, value) {
    const safeKey = String(key || '').trim();
    if (!safeKey) throw new Error('Runtime state key is required');
    if (value == null) runtimePersistence.runtimeState.delete(safeKey);
    else runtimePersistence.runtimeState.set(safeKey, persistenceClone(value));
    enqueueRuntimeWrite(`runtime-state:${safeKey}`, async database => {
      const transaction = database.transaction(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE, 'readwrite');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE);
      if (value == null) store.delete(safeKey);
      else store.put({ key: safeKey, value: persistenceClone(value), updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
      await runtimeTransactionDone(transaction);
    });
    return getRuntimeStateValue(safeKey, null);
  }

  function patchRuntimeStateValue(key, patch) {
    const current = getRuntimeStateValue(key, {});
    const next = {
      ...(current && typeof current === 'object' ? current : {}),
      ...(patch && typeof patch === 'object' ? persistenceClone(patch) : {}),
    };
    return replaceRuntimeStateValue(key, next);
  }


  // SourceOps durability is intentionally duplicated across Source workingRevisions
  // and the independent Runtime DB. A lost/corrupted Source workspace must not erase
  // the canonical mutation recipe that produced it.
  const SOURCE_MUTATION_JOURNAL_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-source-mutation-journal/v1';
  const SOURCE_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-source-authority-floor/v1';
  const SOURCE_MUTATION_JOURNAL_MAX_ENTRIES = 512;
  const SOURCE_MUTATION_JOURNAL_MAX_CHARS = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

  const SPEC_OPS_ITERATION_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-spec-ops-iteration/v1';
  const SPEC_OPS_RESULT_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-spec-ops-result/v1';
  const SPEC_DETERMINIZATION_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-spec-determinization/v1';
  const SPEC_OPS_MAX_ASSERTIONS = 64;
  const SPEC_OPS_MAX_ASSERTION_CHARS = 32768;

  function specOpsIterationRuntimeKey(sessionId) {
    return `specOpsIteration:${String(sessionId || 'unknown')}`;
  }

  function getSpecOpsIterationRequest(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    if (!session?.id) return null;
    const value = getRuntimeStateValue(specOpsIterationRuntimeKey(session.id), null);
    return value?.schema === SPEC_OPS_ITERATION_SCHEMA ? cloneSemanticValue(value) : null;
  }

  function clearSpecOpsIterationRequest(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    if (!session?.id) return null;
    return replaceRuntimeStateValue(specOpsIterationRuntimeKey(session.id), null);
  }

  function armSpecOpsIteration(options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    if (!session?.id) throw new Error('SPEC_OPS: semantic session is unavailable');
    const request = {
      schema: SPEC_OPS_ITERATION_SCHEMA,
      id: String(options.id || semanticId('spec-iteration')),
      objective: String(options.objective || 'Produce one deterministic Working Source specification.').trim(),
      mode: String(options.mode || 'DRY_RUN').trim().toUpperCase(),
      parent: cloneSemanticValue(options.parent || null),
      targetSequence: Number(options.targetSequence || 0) || null,
      equivalentToHeadRevisionId: options.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || null,
      baselineSha256: options.baselineSha256 || sourceRuntime.baseline?.sha256 || semanticCursorBaselineSha(session.sourceCursor || {}) || null,
      candidateSeed: options.candidateSeed ? cloneSemanticValue(options.candidateSeed) : null,
      notes: String(options.notes || '').trim(),
      armedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(specOpsIterationRuntimeKey(session.id), request);
    flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);
    scheduleProcess(50);
    return cloneSemanticValue(request);
  }

  function sourceMutationJournalRuntimeKey(sessionId) {
    return `sourceMutationJournal:${String(sessionId || 'unknown')}`;
  }

  function sourceAuthorityFloorRuntimeKey(sessionId) {
    return `sourceAuthorityFloor:${String(sessionId || 'unknown')}`;
  }

  function canonicalSourceOpsForJournal(operations = []) {
    return (Array.isArray(operations) ? operations : []).map(operation =>
      cloneSemanticValue(operation)
    );
  }

  function sourceOpsDigest(operations = []) {
    return hashText(JSON.stringify(canonicalSourceOpsForJournal(operations)));
  }

  function appendSourceMutationJournalEntry(revision, sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    const sessionId = session?.id || sourceRuntime.workspace?.sessionId || null;
    if (!sessionId || !revision) return null;
    const key = sourceMutationJournalRuntimeKey(sessionId);
    const previous = getRuntimeStateValue(key, null);
    const entries = Array.isArray(previous?.entries) ? previous.entries.slice() : [];
    const entry = {
      revisionId: revision.id,
      sequence: Number(revision.sequence || 0),
      parentRevisionId: revision.parentRevisionId || null,
      baselineId: revision.baselineId || null,
      sourceOps: canonicalSourceOpsForJournal(revision.sourceOps || []),
      sourceOpsDigest: revision.sourceOpsDigest || sourceOpsDigest(revision.sourceOps || []),
      affectedBaselineRanges: cloneSemanticValue(revision.affectedBaselineRanges || []),
      intent: revision.intent || '',
      summary: revision.summary || '',
      rationale: revision.rationale || '',
      activity: revision.activity || '',
      distanceId: revision.distanceId || null,
      semanticRevision: Number(revision.semanticRevision || 0),
      kind: revision.kind || 'change',
      recovery: cloneSemanticValue(revision.recovery || null),
      createdAt: revision.createdAt || semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    const duplicateIndex = entries.findIndex(item =>
      String(item?.revisionId || '') === String(entry.revisionId || '')
    );
    if (duplicateIndex >= 0) entries.splice(duplicateIndex, 1);
    entries.push(entry);
    while (entries.length > SOURCE_MUTATION_JOURNAL_MAX_ENTRIES) entries.shift();
    while (entries.length > 1 && JSON.stringify(entries).length > SOURCE_MUTATION_JOURNAL_MAX_CHARS) entries.shift();
    return replaceRuntimeStateValue(key, {
      schema: SOURCE_MUTATION_JOURNAL_SCHEMA,
      sessionId,
      baselineId: revision.baselineId || sourceRuntime.workspace?.baselineId || null,
      entries,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
  }

  function parseCertifiedWorkingIdentity(value) {
    const text = String(value || '').trim();
    const match = text.match(/^working:([^:\s]+):r(\d{1,9})(?::(.+))?$/i);
    if (!match) return null;
    const sequence = Number(match[2] || 0);
    if (!Number.isInteger(sequence) || sequence < 0) return null;
    return {
      baselineSha256: String(match[1] || ''),
      workingSequence: sequence,
      headRevisionId: String(match[3] || '').trim() || null,
      identity: text,
    };
  }

  function inferSourceAuthorityFloorFromSemanticHistory(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    if (!session?.id) return null;

    // Only runner-certified structured authority may raise the mutation floor.
    // Free-form notes/decisions/worklog summaries/nextFocus are engineering prose:
    // mentioning "Working r53" there must never manufacture causal source authority.
    const candidates = [];
    const addCandidate = (workingSequence, headRevisionId = null, reason = '') => {
      const sequence = Number(workingSequence || 0);
      if (!Number.isInteger(sequence) || sequence <= 0) return;
      candidates.push({
        workingSequence: sequence,
        headRevisionId: String(headRevisionId || '').trim() || null,
        reason: String(reason || 'structured-authority'),
      });
    };
    const addIdentity = (identityValue, expectedHeadRevisionId = null, reason = '') => {
      const parsed = parseCertifiedWorkingIdentity(identityValue);
      if (!parsed) return;
      if (
        expectedHeadRevisionId &&
        parsed.headRevisionId &&
        String(parsed.headRevisionId) !== String(expectedHeadRevisionId)
      ) return;
      addCandidate(
        parsed.workingSequence,
        expectedHeadRevisionId || parsed.headRevisionId,
        reason || 'working-identity'
      );
    };

    // Worklog authority fields are attached by applySemanticStateWithWorking only
    // after a Working mutation/spec commit has actually been staged/committed.
    for (const row of Array.isArray(session.worklog) ? session.worklog : []) {
      if (row?.workingRevisionId && row?.workingIdentity) {
        addIdentity(row.workingIdentity, row.workingRevisionId, 'committed-worklog-working-identity');
      }
      if (row?.specOps?.committed === true) {
        addCandidate(
          row.specOps.targetSequence,
          row.specOps.newHeadRevisionId || null,
          'committed-spec-determinization'
        );
      }
    }

    // The independent mutation journal is durable evidence of commits and survives
    // semantic-ledger compaction. It outranks descriptive semantic prose.
    const journal = getRuntimeStateValue(sourceMutationJournalRuntimeKey(session.id), null);
    if (journal?.schema === SOURCE_MUTATION_JOURNAL_SCHEMA) {
      for (const entry of Array.isArray(journal.entries) ? journal.entries : []) {
        addCandidate(entry?.sequence, entry?.revisionId || null, 'source-mutation-journal');
      }
    }

    // A currently restored physical workspace is itself certified local authority.
    if (
      sourceRuntime.workspace &&
      String(sourceRuntime.workspace.sessionId || '') === String(session.id)
    ) {
      addCandidate(
        sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.sequence,
        sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || null,
        'physical-working-head'
      );
    }

    if (!candidates.length) return null;
    candidates.sort((a, b) =>
      Number(b.workingSequence || 0) - Number(a.workingSequence || 0) ||
      Number(Boolean(b.headRevisionId)) - Number(Boolean(a.headRevisionId))
    );
    const strongestSequence = Number(candidates[0]?.workingSequence || 0);
    const strongestHeads = [...new Set(
      candidates
        .filter(item => Number(item?.workingSequence || 0) === strongestSequence)
        .map(item => String(item?.headRevisionId || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    )];
    if (strongestHeads.length > 1) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_FORK: certified structured evidence contains multiple heads at ' +
        `r${strongestSequence}: ${strongestHeads.join(', ')}`
      );
    }
    const strongest = candidates.find(item =>
      Number(item?.workingSequence || 0) === strongestSequence &&
      (!strongestHeads.length || String(item?.headRevisionId || '') === strongestHeads[0])
    ) || candidates[0];
    return {
      schema: SOURCE_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_SCHEMA,
      sessionId: session.id,
      baselineId: session.sourceCursor?.baselineId || sourceRuntime.workspace?.baselineId || null,
      workingSequence: Number(strongest.workingSequence || 0),
      headRevisionId: strongest.headRevisionId || null,
      reason: `structured-certified-authority:${strongest.reason}`,
      inferred: true,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  function setSourceAuthorityFloor(floorInput = {}, options = {}) {
    const session = options.semanticSession || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    const sessionId = String(floorInput.sessionId || session?.id || sourceRuntime.workspace?.sessionId || '').trim();
    if (!sessionId) throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR: sessionId is required');
    const key = sourceAuthorityFloorRuntimeKey(sessionId);
    const previous = getRuntimeStateValue(key, null);
    const previousSequence = Number(previous?.workingSequence || 0);
    const requestedSequence = Number(floorInput.workingSequence || 0);
    if (!Number.isInteger(requestedSequence) || requestedSequence < 0) {
      throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR: workingSequence must be a non-negative integer');
    }
    const requestedHeadRevisionId = String(floorInput.headRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    const previousHeadRevisionId = String(previous?.headRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    const lowering = requestedSequence < previousSequence;
    if (lowering && options.allowLower !== true) return previous;
    if (
      requestedSequence === previousSequence &&
      requestedSequence > 0 &&
      requestedHeadRevisionId &&
      previousHeadRevisionId &&
      requestedHeadRevisionId !== previousHeadRevisionId &&
      options.allowReplaceEqual !== true
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_FORK: same Working sequence has conflicting head revisions; ' +
        `r${requestedSequence} persisted=${previousHeadRevisionId}, requested=${requestedHeadRevisionId}`
      );
    }
    const nextSequence = lowering && options.allowLower === true
      ? requestedSequence
      : Math.max(previousSequence, requestedSequence);
    const next = {
      schema: SOURCE_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_SCHEMA,
      sessionId,
      baselineId: floorInput.baselineId || previous?.baselineId || sourceRuntime.workspace?.baselineId || null,
      workingSequence: nextSequence,
      headRevisionId: lowering && options.allowLower === true
        ? requestedHeadRevisionId
        : (requestedSequence > previousSequence
            ? requestedHeadRevisionId
            : requestedSequence === previousSequence
              ? (requestedHeadRevisionId || previousHeadRevisionId)
              : previousHeadRevisionId),
      equivalentToHeadRevisionId: lowering && options.allowLower === true
        ? (String(floorInput.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '').trim() || null)
        : (requestedSequence > previousSequence
            ? (String(floorInput.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '').trim() || null)
            : requestedSequence === previousSequence
              ? (String(floorInput.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || previous?.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '').trim() || null)
              : (String(previous?.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '').trim() || null)),
      reason: floorInput.reason || previous?.reason || 'explicit',
      inferred: floorInput.inferred === true,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    return replaceRuntimeStateValue(key, next);
  }


  function replaceSourceAuthorityFloorWithEquivalentHead(floorInput = {}, equivalentHeadRevisionId = '', options = {}) {
    const session = options.semanticSession || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    const sessionId = String(floorInput.sessionId || session?.id || sourceRuntime.workspace?.sessionId || '').trim();
    if (!sessionId) throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_EQUIVALENT_FLOOR: sessionId is required');
    const sequence = Number(floorInput.workingSequence || 0);
    const replacementHead = String(floorInput.headRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    const equivalentHead = String(equivalentHeadRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    if (!Number.isInteger(sequence) || sequence <= 0 || !replacementHead || !equivalentHead) {
      throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_EQUIVALENT_FLOOR: workingSequence, replacement head and equivalent lost head are required');
    }
    const key = sourceAuthorityFloorRuntimeKey(sessionId);
    const previous = getRuntimeStateValue(key, null);
    const previousSequence = Number(previous?.workingSequence || 0);
    const previousHead = String(previous?.headRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    if (previousSequence > sequence) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_EQUIVALENT_FLOOR_STALE: refusing to replace an authority floor above the deterministic target; ' +
        `persisted r${previousSequence}/${previousHead || 'no-head'}, target r${sequence}/${replacementHead}`
      );
    }
    if (previousSequence === sequence && previousHead && ![equivalentHead, replacementHead].includes(previousHead)) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_EQUIVALENT_FLOOR_FORK: persisted authority head is not the certified equivalent being replaced; ' +
        `r${sequence} persisted=${previousHead}, equivalent=${equivalentHead}, replacement=${replacementHead}`
      );
    }
    return setSourceAuthorityFloor({
      ...cloneSemanticValue(floorInput),
      equivalentToHeadRevisionId: equivalentHead,
    }, {
      semanticSession: session,
      allowReplaceEqual: true,
    });
  }

  function currentWorkingHeadCertifiesEquivalentAuthority(sequenceInput, replacementHeadInput, equivalentHeadInput) {
    const sequence = Number(sequenceInput || 0);
    const replacementHead = String(replacementHeadInput || '').trim();
    const equivalentHead = String(equivalentHeadInput || '').trim();
    const workspaceHead = sourceRuntime.workspace?.working || null;
    const revision = workingRuntime.headRevision || null;
    if (!sequence || !replacementHead || !equivalentHead || !workspaceHead || !revision) return false;
    if (Number(workspaceHead.sequence || 0) !== sequence) return false;
    if (String(workspaceHead.headRevisionId || '') !== replacementHead) return false;
    if (String(revision.id || '') !== replacementHead || Number(revision.sequence || 0) !== sequence) return false;
    const recovery = revision.recovery && typeof revision.recovery === 'object' ? revision.recovery : {};
    const specEquivalent =
      revision.kind === 'spec-determinization' &&
      Number(recovery.targetSequence || 0) === sequence &&
      String(recovery.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '') === equivalentHead;
    const replayEquivalent =
      Number(recovery.recoveryOfSequence || 0) === sequence &&
      String(recovery.lostTargetHeadRevisionId || '') === equivalentHead;
    return specEquivalent || replayEquivalent;
  }

  async function reconcileEquivalentCrossChatRegistryHead(currentInput, sessionInput = null, registryInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    const current = currentInput || (session ? localSemanticSourceAuthority(session) : null);
    let registry = registryInput || await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
    if (
      !session || !current ||
      registry?.schema !== CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA ||
      String(registry.sessionId || '') !== String(session.id) ||
      (registry.baselineSha256 && current.baselineSha256 &&
        String(registry.baselineSha256) !== String(current.baselineSha256))
    ) return registry;
    const registrySequence = Number(registry.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(registry.workingRevision) || 0);
    const registryHead = String(registry.headRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    const currentSequence = Number(current.workingSequence || 0);
    const currentHead = String(current.headRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    if (registrySequence !== currentSequence || !registryHead || !currentHead || registryHead === currentHead) {
      return registry;
    }
    if (!currentWorkingHeadCertifiesEquivalentAuthority(currentSequence, currentHead, registryHead)) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_REGISTRY_FORK: cross-chat registry and physical Working expose different heads ' +
        `at r${currentSequence}; registry=${registryHead}, physical=${currentHead}`
      );
    }
    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(SemanticSessionStore.load() || session);
    registry = await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
    const repairedSequence = Number(registry?.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(registry?.workingRevision) || 0);
    const repairedHead = String(registry?.headRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    if (repairedSequence !== currentSequence || repairedHead !== currentHead) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_REGISTRY_REPAIR_FAILED: equivalent physical Working head could not replace stale registry authority; ' +
        `expected r${currentSequence}/${currentHead}, registry r${repairedSequence}/${repairedHead || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }
    return registry;
  }

  async function repairSourceAuthorityFloorToCurrent(options = {}) {
    const session = options.semanticSession || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    if (!session?.id) throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_REPAIR: semantic session is unavailable');
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline || sourceRuntime.workspace.sessionId !== session.id) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
    }
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const current = localSemanticSourceAuthority(SemanticSessionStore.load() || session);
    let registry = await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
    if (!Number.isInteger(Number(current?.workingSequence)) || Number(current.workingSequence) <= 0) {
      throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_REPAIR: current physical Working head is unavailable');
    }
    registry = await reconcileEquivalentCrossChatRegistryHead(current, session, registry);
    if (
      registry?.schema === CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA &&
      String(registry.sessionId || '') === String(session.id) &&
      (!registry.baselineSha256 || !current.baselineSha256 ||
        String(registry.baselineSha256) === String(current.baselineSha256))
    ) {
      const registrySequence = Number(
        registry.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(registry.workingRevision)
      );
      const registryHead = registry.headRevisionId || null;
      if (
        registrySequence !== Number(current.workingSequence) ||
        String(registryHead || '') !== String(current.headRevisionId || '')
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_REPAIR: registry does not certify the current physical Working head; ' +
          `physical r${current.workingSequence}/${current.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}, ` +
          `registry r${registrySequence}/${registryHead || 'no-head'}`
        );
      }
    }
    const repaired = setSourceAuthorityFloor({
      sessionId: session.id,
      baselineId: sourceRuntime.baseline?.id || session.sourceCursor?.baselineId || null,
      workingSequence: Number(current.workingSequence),
      headRevisionId: current.headRevisionId || null,
      reason: String(options.reason || 'verified-physical-working-head-repair'),
      inferred: false,
    }, {
      semanticSession: session,
      allowLower: true,
      allowReplaceEqual: true,
    });
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    const resolved = resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(SemanticSessionStore.load() || session);
    if (
      Number(resolved?.workingSequence || 0) !== Number(current.workingSequence) ||
      String(resolved?.headRevisionId || '') !== String(current.headRevisionId || '')
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_REPAIR_VERIFY_FAILED: floor was re-inferred above the verified physical head; ' +
        `expected r${current.workingSequence}/${current.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}, ` +
        `resolved r${resolved?.workingSequence || 0}/${resolved?.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }
    return {
      repaired: true,
      previous: options.previous || null,
      current,
      floor: cloneSemanticValue(resolved),
      registry: registry ? {
        workingSequence: Number(registry.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(registry.workingRevision)),
        headRevisionId: registry.headRevisionId || null,
        workspaceRevision: Number(registry.workspaceRevision || 0),
      } : null,
    };
  }

  function resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(sessionInput = null, options = {}) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    if (!session?.id) return null;
    const key = sourceAuthorityFloorRuntimeKey(session.id);
    let persisted = getRuntimeStateValue(key, null);
    const inferred = options.infer === false ? null : inferSourceAuthorityFloorFromSemanticHistory(session);

    // v6.5.12 migration: older builds persisted a monotonic floor inferred from
    // free-form semantic prose. Those rows are explicitly uncertified authority;
    // keeping them would permanently preserve the old poisoning bug even after the
    // inference algorithm is fixed. Replace them with structured evidence, or clear
    // them when no certified evidence exists. Explicit/journal/spec floors are kept.
    if (
      persisted?.inferred === true &&
      String(persisted?.reason || '') === 'semantic-history-max-working-sequence'
    ) {
      if (inferred) {
        persisted = setSourceAuthorityFloor(inferred, {
          semanticSession: session,
          allowLower: true,
          allowReplaceEqual: true,
        });
      } else {
        replaceRuntimeStateValue(key, null);
        persisted = null;
      }
    }

    const inferredSequence = Number(inferred?.workingSequence || 0);
    const persistedSequence = Number(persisted?.workingSequence || 0);
    const shouldPromoteInferred = Boolean(inferred) && (
      inferredSequence > persistedSequence ||
      (
        inferredSequence === persistedSequence &&
        inferredSequence > 0 &&
        !persisted?.headRevisionId &&
        inferred?.headRevisionId
      )
    );
    if (shouldPromoteInferred) {
      return setSourceAuthorityFloor(inferred, { semanticSession: session });
    }
    if (
      inferred && persisted &&
      inferredSequence === persistedSequence &&
      inferredSequence > 0 &&
      inferred.headRevisionId &&
      persisted.headRevisionId &&
      String(inferred.headRevisionId) !== String(persisted.headRevisionId)
    ) {
      if (currentWorkingHeadCertifiesEquivalentAuthority(
        inferredSequence,
        inferred.headRevisionId,
        persisted.headRevisionId
      )) {
        return replaceSourceAuthorityFloorWithEquivalentHead({
          ...cloneSemanticValue(inferred),
          reason: `committed-equivalent-recovery:${inferred.reason || 'physical-working-head'}`,
        }, persisted.headRevisionId, { semanticSession: session });
      }
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_FORK: structured authority conflicts with persisted floor at ' +
        `r${persistedSequence}: persisted=${persisted.headRevisionId}, inferred=${inferred.headRevisionId}`
      );
    }
    return persisted || inferred || null;
  }

  function loadCache() {
    return getRuntimeStateValue('runnerCache', {});
  }

  function saveCache(patch) {
    const current = loadCache();
    const next = { ...current, ...(patch || {}) };
    replaceRuntimeStateValue('runnerCache', next);
    return next;
  }

  const SEMANTIC_LANE_SCHEMA_V6918 = 'vibe-go-semantic-lane/v1';
  const SEMANTIC_LANE_STATE_KEY_V6918 = 'semanticLaneV6918';
  const SEMANTIC_LANE_DEFAULT_V6918 = 'PRIMARY';

  function normalizeSemanticLaneIdV6918(value, fallback = SEMANTIC_LANE_DEFAULT_V6918) {
    const lane = String(value || fallback).trim();
    if (!lane || lane.length > 128 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$/.test(lane)) {
      throw new Error(`SEMANTIC_LANE_INVALID: ${lane || '(empty)'}`);
    }
    return lane;
  }

  function persistedSemanticLaneIdV6918() {
    const value = getRuntimeStateValue(SEMANTIC_LANE_STATE_KEY_V6918, null);
    return normalizeSemanticLaneIdV6918(value?.laneId || SEMANTIC_LANE_DEFAULT_V6918);
  }

  function semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const explicit = session?.transport?.semanticLaneV6918?.laneId || session?.semanticLaneId || null;
    // Legacy persisted sessions predate lanes and are BUILD by definition. This is
    // crucial when inspecting foreign sessions: never infer their lane from THIS chat.
    if (session) return normalizeSemanticLaneIdV6918(explicit || SEMANTIC_LANE_DEFAULT_V6918);
    return persistedSemanticLaneIdV6918();
  }

  function currentSemanticLaneIdV6918() {
    const live = runtimePersistence.semanticSession || null;
    if (live) return semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(live);
    return persistedSemanticLaneIdV6918();
  }

  function ensureSemanticLaneV6918(session) {
    if (!session || typeof session !== 'object') return session;
    session.transport ||= {};
    if (!session.transport.semanticLaneV6918 || typeof session.transport.semanticLaneV6918 !== 'object') {
      session.transport.semanticLaneV6918 = {
        schema: SEMANTIC_LANE_SCHEMA_V6918,
        laneId: persistedSemanticLaneIdV6918(),
        assignedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        source: 'legacy-default-or-runtime-setting',
      };
    } else {
      session.transport.semanticLaneV6918.laneId = normalizeSemanticLaneIdV6918(session.transport.semanticLaneV6918.laneId || SEMANTIC_LANE_DEFAULT_V6918);
      session.transport.semanticLaneV6918.schema = SEMANTIC_LANE_SCHEMA_V6918;
    }
    return session;
  }

  function setSemanticLaneV6918(value, options = {}) {
    const laneId = normalizeSemanticLaneIdV6918(value);
    const currentSession = runtimePersistence.semanticSession || null;
    if (currentSession) {
      const currentLane = semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(currentSession);
      if (currentLane !== laneId && options.allowExistingSession !== true) {
        throw new Error(`SEMANTIC_LANE_SESSION_EXISTS: current session ${currentSession.id} belongs to ${currentLane}; clear/create a separate session before selecting ${laneId}`);
      }
    }
    const stateValue = {
      schema: SEMANTIC_LANE_SCHEMA_V6918,
      laneId,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(SEMANTIC_LANE_STATE_KEY_V6918, stateValue);
    if (currentSession && options.allowExistingSession === true) {
      currentSession.transport ||= {};
      currentSession.transport.semanticLaneV6918 = { ...stateValue, assignedAt: semanticIsoNow(), source: 'explicit-existing-session-update' };
      SemanticSessionStore.save(currentSession);
    }
    return cloneSemanticValue(stateValue);
  }

  /*
   * a25 Usage Governor — proactive, local and fail-closed.
   *
   * ChatGPT does not expose a stable per-account remaining-message quota to page
   * JavaScript. Therefore this layer never pretends to know the platform quota.
   * It only enforces a conservative local sliding-window budget over VIBE-GO's
   * own programmatic model-facing sends. Human trusted clicks remain untouched.
   */
  const USAGE_GOVERNOR_CACHE_KEY_V625 = 'usageGovernorV625';
  const USAGE_GOVERNOR_SCHEMA_V625 = 'vibe-go-usage-governor/v1';
  const USAGE_GOVERNOR_PROFILES_V625 = Object.freeze({
    guarded: Object.freeze({
      id: 'guarded',
      label: 'Guarded',
      minGapMs: 60 * 1000,
      windows: Object.freeze([
        Object.freeze({ id: '10m', windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000, maxSends: 8 }),
        Object.freeze({ id: '1h', windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, maxSends: 36 }),
        Object.freeze({ id: '3h', windowMs: 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000, maxSends: 90 }),
      ]),
    }),
    conservative: Object.freeze({
      id: 'conservative',
      label: 'Conservative',
      minGapMs: 90 * 1000,
      windows: Object.freeze([
        Object.freeze({ id: '10m', windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000, maxSends: 6 }),
        Object.freeze({ id: '1h', windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, maxSends: 24 }),
        Object.freeze({ id: '3h', windowMs: 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000, maxSends: 60 }),
      ]),
    }),
    off: Object.freeze({
      id: 'off',
      label: 'Off',
      minGapMs: 0,
      windows: Object.freeze([]),
    }),
  });

  function normalizeUsageGovernorProfileIdV625(value) {
    const id = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(USAGE_GOVERNOR_PROFILES_V625, id)
      ? id
      : String(CONFIG.usageGovernorDefaultProfile || 'guarded');
  }

  function getUsageGovernorStateV625() {
    const cache = loadCache();
    const raw = cache?.[USAGE_GOVERNOR_CACHE_KEY_V625];
    const fallbackProfile = normalizeUsageGovernorProfileIdV625(CONFIG.usageGovernorDefaultProfile);
    const value = raw && raw.schema === USAGE_GOVERNOR_SCHEMA_V625 ? raw : {};
    return {
      schema: USAGE_GOVERNOR_SCHEMA_V625,
      profileId: normalizeUsageGovernorProfileIdV625(value.profileId || fallbackProfile),
      events: Array.isArray(value.events) ? value.events.filter(item => Number.isFinite(Number(item?.at))) : [],
      cooldownUntil: Number.isFinite(Number(value.cooldownUntil)) ? Number(value.cooldownUntil) : 0,
      cooldownReason: String(value.cooldownReason || ''),
      lastPressure: value.lastPressure ? cloneSemanticValue(value.lastPressure) : null,
      lastDecision: value.lastDecision ? cloneSemanticValue(value.lastDecision) : null,
      updatedAt: value.updatedAt || null,
    };
  }

  function persistUsageGovernorStateV625(stateInput) {
    const retentionMs = Math.max(
      60 * 60 * 1000,
      Number(CONFIG.usageGovernorHistoryRetentionMs || 4 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    );
    const cutoff = now() - retentionMs;
    const stateValue = {
      ...getUsageGovernorStateV625(),
      ...(stateInput && typeof stateInput === 'object' ? cloneSemanticValue(stateInput) : {}),
      schema: USAGE_GOVERNOR_SCHEMA_V625,
    };
    stateValue.profileId = normalizeUsageGovernorProfileIdV625(stateValue.profileId);
    stateValue.events = (Array.isArray(stateValue.events) ? stateValue.events : [])
      .filter(item => Number.isFinite(Number(item?.at)) && Number(item.at) >= cutoff)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a.at) - Number(b.at))
      .slice(-256);
    stateValue.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    saveCache({ [USAGE_GOVERNOR_CACHE_KEY_V625]: stateValue });
    return cloneSemanticValue(stateValue);
  }

  function usageGovernorDecisionV625(context = '', atInput = null) {
    const at = atInput !== null && atInput !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(atInput)) ? Number(atInput) : now();
    const stateValue = getUsageGovernorStateV625();
    const profile = USAGE_GOVERNOR_PROFILES_V625[stateValue.profileId] || USAGE_GOVERNOR_PROFILES_V625.guarded;
    if (CONFIG.usageGovernorEnabled !== true || profile.id === 'off') {
      return {
        allowed: true,
        enabled: CONFIG.usageGovernorEnabled === true,
        profileId: profile.id,
        profileLabel: profile.label,
        context: String(context || ''),
        reason: 'usage governor disabled',
        waitMs: 0,
        nextAllowedAt: at,
      };
    }

    const maxWindowMs = Math.max(
      Number(profile.minGapMs || 0),
      ...profile.windows.map(window => Number(window.windowMs || 0)),
      1
    );
    const events = stateValue.events
      .filter(item => Number(item.at) >= at - maxWindowMs)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a.at) - Number(b.at));

    let nextAllowedAt = at;
    const blockers = [];
    if (Number(stateValue.cooldownUntil || 0) > at) {
      nextAllowedAt = Math.max(nextAllowedAt, Number(stateValue.cooldownUntil));
      blockers.push({
        kind: 'pressure-cooldown',
        until: Number(stateValue.cooldownUntil),
        reason: stateValue.cooldownReason || 'platform pressure cooldown',
      });
    }

    const lastEvent = events.at(-1) || null;
    if (lastEvent && Number(profile.minGapMs || 0) > 0) {
      const minGapUntil = Number(lastEvent.at) + Number(profile.minGapMs);
      if (minGapUntil > at) {
        nextAllowedAt = Math.max(nextAllowedAt, minGapUntil);
        blockers.push({ kind: 'min-gap', until: minGapUntil, minGapMs: Number(profile.minGapMs) });
      }
    }

    const windowStatus = [];
    for (const window of profile.windows) {
      const cutoff = at - Number(window.windowMs);
      const active = events.filter(item => Number(item.at) > cutoff);
      const count = active.length;
      let windowNext = at;
      if (count >= Number(window.maxSends) && active.length) {
        const releaseIndex = Math.max(0, count - Number(window.maxSends));
        windowNext = Number(active[releaseIndex].at) + Number(window.windowMs) + 1;
        nextAllowedAt = Math.max(nextAllowedAt, windowNext);
        blockers.push({
          kind: 'sliding-window',
          id: window.id,
          count,
          maxSends: Number(window.maxSends),
          windowMs: Number(window.windowMs),
          until: windowNext,
        });
      }
      windowStatus.push({
        id: window.id,
        count,
        maxSends: Number(window.maxSends),
        windowMs: Number(window.windowMs),
        nextReleaseAt: windowNext > at ? windowNext : null,
      });
    }

    const waitMs = Math.max(0, nextAllowedAt - at);
    return {
      allowed: waitMs <= 0,
      enabled: true,
      profileId: profile.id,
      profileLabel: profile.label,
      context: String(context || ''),
      reason: waitMs > 0
        ? blockers.map(item => item.kind === 'sliding-window' ? `${item.id}:${item.count}/${item.maxSends}` : item.kind).join(', ')
        : 'within local safety budget',
      waitMs,
      nextAllowedAt,
      nextAllowedAtIso: waitMs > 0 ? new Date(nextAllowedAt).toISOString() : null,
      blockers,
      windows: windowStatus,
      eventCountRetained: events.length,
      lastEventAt: lastEvent ? Number(lastEvent.at) : null,
      cooldownUntil: Number(stateValue.cooldownUntil || 0) || null,
    };
  }

  function usageGovernorRecordSendV625(context = '', textValue = '') {
    if (CONFIG.usageGovernorEnabled !== true) return null;
    const stateValue = getUsageGovernorStateV625();
    const at = now();
    const text = String(textValue || '');
    const event = {
      at,
      atIso: new Date(at).toISOString(),
      context: String(context || 'programmatic-send'),
      chars: text.length,
      approxTokens: text ? Math.ceil(text.length / 4) : 0,
      payloadHash: text ? hashText(text) : null,
    };
    stateValue.events.push(event);
    persistUsageGovernorStateV625({ ...stateValue, events: stateValue.events });
    return cloneSemanticValue(event);
  }

  function usageGovernorLatchPressureV625(signalInput = null) {
    const signal = signalInput && typeof signalInput === 'object' ? signalInput : {};
    const minutes = Number(signal.retryAfterMinutes);
    const cooldownMs = Number.isFinite(minutes) && minutes > 0
      ? minutes * 60 * 1000
      : Math.max(60 * 1000, Number(CONFIG.usageGovernorPressureFallbackCooldownMs || 30 * 60 * 1000));
    const stateValue = getUsageGovernorStateV625();
    const cooldownUntil = Math.max(Number(stateValue.cooldownUntil || 0), now() + cooldownMs);
    return persistUsageGovernorStateV625({
      ...stateValue,
      cooldownUntil,
      cooldownReason: String(signal.kind || 'platform-pressure'),
      lastPressure: {
        kind: signal.kind || 'platform-pressure',
        text: String(signal.text || '').slice(0, 700),
        retryAfterMinutes: Number.isFinite(minutes) ? minutes : null,
        observedAt: signal.observedAt || semanticIsoNow(),
        latchedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      },
    });
  }

  function setUsageGovernorProfileV625(value) {
    const profileId = normalizeUsageGovernorProfileIdV625(value);
    const current = getUsageGovernorStateV625();
    const saved = persistUsageGovernorStateV625({ ...current, profileId });
    log('a25 usage governor profile changed', { profileId, profile: USAGE_GOVERNOR_PROFILES_V625[profileId] });
    return { state: saved, decision: usageGovernorDecisionV625('profile-change') };
  }

  function clearUsageGovernorHistoryV625(options = {}) {
    const current = getUsageGovernorStateV625();
    const saved = persistUsageGovernorStateV625({
      ...current,
      events: [],
      cooldownUntil: options.keepCooldown === true ? current.cooldownUntil : 0,
      cooldownReason: options.keepCooldown === true ? current.cooldownReason : '',
      lastPressure: options.keepCooldown === true ? current.lastPressure : null,
      lastDecision: null,
    });
    return { state: saved, decision: usageGovernorDecisionV625('history-cleared') };
  }

  function isVisible(element) {
    if (!(element instanceof Element)) return false;

    const style = getComputedStyle(element);
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();

    return (
      style.display !== 'none' &&
      style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
      rect.width > 0 &&
      rect.height > 0
    );
  }


  // a73 ChatGPT DOM compatibility. Keep the legacy transport surface valid while
  // accepting the current virtualized transcript DOM. The new UI groups a user+assistant
  // exchange under [data-turn-key]; the actual message bodies are separate descendants.
  // Never classify [data-conversation-role="assistant"] as the body: in the current UI it
  // is the small "ChatGPT said:" heading, not the assistant artifact.
  const CHATGPT_ROLE_NODE_SELECTOR_V730 = [
    '[data-message-author-role="assistant"]',
    '[data-message-author-role="user"]',
    '[data-user-message-bubble="true"]',
    '[data-markdown-text-style="assistant-message"]',
  ].join(',');

  const CHATGPT_CONVERSATION_SURFACE_SELECTOR_V730 = [
    CHATGPT_ROLE_NODE_SELECTOR_V730,
    '[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]',
    '[data-turn-key]',
  ].join(',');

  function chatgptConversationRoleV730(node) {
    if (!(node instanceof Element)) return null;
    const legacy = String(node.getAttribute?.('data-message-author-role') || '');
    if (legacy === 'assistant' || legacy === 'user') return legacy;
    if (node.matches?.('[data-user-message-bubble="true"]')) return 'user';
    if (node.matches?.('[data-markdown-text-style="assistant-message"]')) return 'assistant';
    return null;
  }

  function chatgptModernTurnKeyV730(node) {
    if (!(node instanceof Element)) return null;
    return String(node.closest?.('[data-turn-key]')?.getAttribute?.('data-turn-key') || '').trim() || null;
  }

  function chatgptRoleNodeDomIdV730(roleNode, roleInput = null, turnElementInput = null) {
    if (!(roleNode instanceof Element)) return '';
    const role = roleInput || chatgptConversationRoleV730(roleNode);
    const turnElement = turnElementInput instanceof Element ? turnElementInput : getTurnElement(roleNode);
    const legacyTestId = String(turnElement?.getAttribute?.('data-testid') || '');
    if (/^conversation-turn-/i.test(legacyTestId)) return legacyTestId;

    const modernTurnKey = String(
      turnElement?.getAttribute?.('data-turn-key') ||
      chatgptModernTurnKeyV730(roleNode) ||
      ''
    ).trim();
    if (modernTurnKey && (role === 'assistant' || role === 'user')) {
      // Match the one-shot recovery shim key exactly so an already-created re-anchor
      // remains mounted after this native reader is injected.
      return `chatgpt-turn:${modernTurnKey}:${role}`;
    }

    return String(
      turnElement?.getAttribute?.('data-message-id') ||
      roleNode.getAttribute?.('data-message-id') ||
      ''
    );
  }

  function chatgptRoleNodeScoreV730(node, role) {
    if (!(node instanceof Element)) return -1;
    let score = String(node.innerText || node.textContent || '').length;
    if (String(node.getAttribute?.('data-message-author-role') || '') === role) score += 2_000_000;
    if (role === 'assistant' && node.matches?.('[data-markdown-text-style="assistant-message"]')) score += 1_000_000;
    if (role === 'user' && node.matches?.('[data-user-message-bubble="true"]')) score += 1_000_000;
    return score;
  }

  function chatgptRoleNodesAllV730() {
    const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll(CHATGPT_ROLE_NODE_SELECTOR_V730)];
    const selected = new Map();
    for (const node of candidates) {
      const role = chatgptConversationRoleV730(node);
      if (role !== 'assistant' && role !== 'user') continue;
      const turnElement = getTurnElement(node);
      const domId = chatgptRoleNodeDomIdV730(node, role, turnElement);
      const identity = domId || `${role}:fallback:${hashText(String(node.innerText || node.textContent || ''))}`;
      const key = `${role}\u0000${identity}`;
      const previous = selected.get(key);
      if (!previous || chatgptRoleNodeScoreV730(node, role) > chatgptRoleNodeScoreV730(previous, role)) {
        selected.set(key, node);
      }
    }
    return [...selected.values()].sort((a, b) => {
      if (a === b) return 0;
      const relation = a.compareDocumentPosition(b);
      if (relation & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING) return -1;
      if (relation & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_PRECEDING) return 1;
      return 0;
    });
  }

  function chatgptMountedConversationUnitCountV730() {
    const legacy = new Set(
      [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]')]
        .map(element => String(element.getAttribute('data-testid') || ''))
        .filter(Boolean)
    );
    const modern = new Set();
    for (const node of document.querySelectorAll(
      '[data-user-message-bubble="true"],[data-markdown-text-style="assistant-message"]'
    )) {
      const role = chatgptConversationRoleV730(node);
