      const turnKey = chatgptModernTurnKeyV730(node);
      if (role && turnKey) modern.add(`${turnKey}:${role}`);
    }
    return Math.max(legacy.size, modern.size);
  }


  function normalizePlatformPressureText(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .toLocaleLowerCase('ru-RU');
  }


  function classifyPlatformPressureSnippets(snippetsInput = []) {
    const snippets = (Array.isArray(snippetsInput) ? snippetsInput : [])
      .map(normalizePlatformPressureText)
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (!snippets.length) return null;

    // Known reliability cooldown observed by the user.
    const quickCheckSnippet = snippets.find(text =>
      text.includes('мы проводим быструю проверку') &&
      text.includes('chatgpt') &&
      text.includes('работал надежно')
    ) || null;
    const retrySnippet = snippets.find(text =>
      text.includes('повторите попытку через') &&
      /минут(?:у|ы)?(?:\s|[.!?,;:]|$)/.test(text)
    ) || null;
    if (quickCheckSnippet && retrySnippet) {
      const combined = (quickCheckSnippet === retrySnippet
        ? quickCheckSnippet
        : `${quickCheckSnippet} ${retrySnippet}`
      ).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      const retryMatch = combined.match(/повторите попытку через\s+(\d+)\s+минут(?:у|ы)?(?:\s|[.!?,;:]|$)/);
      const retryAfterMinutes = retryMatch ? Number(retryMatch[1]) : null;
      return {
        kind: 'chatgpt-reliability-cooldown',
        text: combined.slice(0, Number(CONFIG.platformPressureMaxProbeChars || 1200)),
        retryAfterMinutes: Number.isFinite(retryAfterMinutes) ? retryAfterMinutes : null,
      };
    }

    // a25: broader but still action-oriented visible usage/rate-limit signals.
    // Conversation turns are excluded by detectPlatformPressureSignal(), so quoted
    // user/model text cannot trigger this classifier.
    const limitSnippet = snippets.find(text => {
      const english =
        ((text.includes("you've reached") || text.includes('you have reached') || text.includes("you've hit") || text.includes('you have hit')) && text.includes('limit')) ||
        (text.includes('usage limit') && (text.includes('try again') || text.includes('reset') || text.includes('available'))) ||
        (text.includes('message limit') && (text.includes('try again') || text.includes('reset') || text.includes('available'))) ||
        text.includes('too many requests') ||
        (text.includes('rate limit') && (text.includes('reached') || text.includes('exceeded') || text.includes('try again')));
      const russian =
        ((text.includes('вы достигли') || text.includes('достигнут') || text.includes('исчерпан')) && text.includes('лимит')) ||
        text.includes('слишком много запросов') ||
        (text.includes('лимит сообщений') && (text.includes('попроб') || text.includes('сброс') || text.includes('доступ')));
      return english || russian;
    }) || null;
    if (!limitSnippet) return null;

    const retryMinutePatterns = [
      /(?:try again|retry|available again|resets?)\D{0,32}(\d+)\s*(?:minutes?|mins?)\b/i,
      /(?:повторите|попробуйте|доступно|сброс)\D{0,32}(\d+)\s*минут(?:у|ы)?\b/i,
    ];
    let retryAfterMinutes = null;
    for (const pattern of retryMinutePatterns) {
      const match = limitSnippet.match(pattern);
      if (match) {
        retryAfterMinutes = Number(match[1]);
        break;
      }
    }
    return {
      kind: 'chatgpt-usage-or-rate-limit',
      text: limitSnippet.slice(0, Number(CONFIG.platformPressureMaxProbeChars || 1200)),
      retryAfterMinutes: Number.isFinite(retryAfterMinutes) ? retryAfterMinutes : null,
    };
  }

  function detectPlatformPressureSignal() {
    if (CONFIG.platformPressureGateEnabled !== true) return null;

    const conversationSelector = CHATGPT_CONVERSATION_SURFACE_SELECTOR_V730;
    const ownUiSelector = '#vibe-go-panel-v628,#vibe-go-banner-v5';
    const snippets = [];
    const maxChars = Math.max(200, Number(CONFIG.platformPressureMaxProbeChars || 1200));

    // Generic structural scan only: no guessed platform error/cooldown selector.
    // Elements that are/contain conversation turns are excluded, preventing the
    // user's quoted cooldown text from being mistaken for platform UI evidence.
    for (const element of document.querySelectorAll('div,section,aside,p,span')) {
      if (!(element instanceof Element) || !isVisible(element)) continue;
      if (element.closest(ownUiSelector)) continue;
      if (element.closest(conversationSelector)) continue;
      if (element.querySelector?.(conversationSelector)) continue;
      const text = String(element.innerText || element.textContent || '').trim();
      if (!text || text.length > maxChars) continue;
      const normalized = normalizePlatformPressureText(text);
      if (
        normalized.includes('мы проводим быструю проверку') ||
        normalized.includes('повторите попытку через') ||
        normalized.includes('usage limit') ||
        normalized.includes('message limit') ||
        normalized.includes('too many requests') ||
        normalized.includes('rate limit') ||
        normalized.includes('you\'ve reached') ||
        normalized.includes('you have reached') ||
        normalized.includes('you\'ve hit') ||
        normalized.includes('вы достигли') ||
        normalized.includes('достигнут лимит') ||
        normalized.includes('исчерпан лимит') ||
        normalized.includes('слишком много запросов') ||
        normalized.includes('лимит сообщений')
      ) snippets.push(normalized);
    }

    const classified = classifyPlatformPressureSnippets(snippets);
    if (!classified) return null;
    return {
      ...classified,
      source: 'visible-platform-ui-outside-conversation',
      observedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }


  async function pauseForPlatformPressure(signal, context = '') {
    if (!signal) return false;

    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
    document.querySelector('#vibe-go-auto-continue-overlay-v626')?.remove();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    clearTimeout(observerSettleTimer);
    observerSettleTimer = null;
    clearTimeout(generationProbeTimer);
    generationProbeTimer = null;
    clearProjectDataTransportWakeTimerV6915();
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();

    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const persistedSignal = {
      ...cloneSemanticValue(signal),
      status: 'paused',
      context: String(context || 'model-facing-send-preflight'),
      pausedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    if (session) {
      session.transport = session.transport || {};
      const pending = session.transport.pendingDispatch || null;
      if (pending?.transportMetrics) {
        pending.transportMetrics = {
          ...pending.transportMetrics,
          lifecycle: {
            ...(pending.transportMetrics.lifecycle || {}),
            platformPressureAt: persistedSignal.pausedAt,
            responseClass: 'platform-pressure-paused',
            causalAdmission: ['submitting', 'submitted', 'generating', 'submit-unconfirmed'].includes(String(pending.status || ''))
              ? 'uncertain-or-inflight'
              : 'not-sent',
            platformPressureContext: persistedSignal.context,
          },
        };
      }
      session.transport.platformPressure = persistedSignal;
      session.transport.pausedAt = persistedSignal.pausedAt;
      session.transport.pauseReason =
        `Platform reliability/cooldown UI detected; automatic progression stopped (${persistedSignal.context})`;
      session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    }
    saveCache({ lastPlatformPressure: persistedSignal });
    usageGovernorLatchPressureV625(persistedSignal);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    const retrySuffix = Number.isFinite(Number(signal.retryAfterMinutes))
      ? ` · UI requested retry after ${Number(signal.retryAfterMinutes)} min`
      : '';
    setPhase('paused', `platform reliability/cooldown detected; manual resume required${retrySuffix}`);
    warn('Platform-pressure gate paused VIBE-GO before model-facing send', persistedSignal);
    return true;
  }


  async function enforcePlatformPressureGate(context = '') {
    const signal = detectPlatformPressureSignal();
    if (!signal) return null;
    await pauseForPlatformPressure(signal, context);
    return signal;
  }

  const MODEL_CONTINUITY_GUARD_STATE_KEY_V622 = 'model-continuity-guard-v622';
  const MODEL_CONTINUITY_GUARD_SCHEMA_V622 = 'vibe-go-model-continuity-guard/v1';

  function classifyObservedModelModeV622(value) {
    const text = normalizeText(value);
    if (!text) return 'unknown';
    if (/(^|\s|[·|/()_-])instant($|\s|[·|/()_-])/.test(text)) return 'instant';
    if (/(^|\s|[·|/()_-])thinking($|\s|[·|/()_-])/.test(text) || text.includes('reasoning')) return 'thinking';
    if (/(^|\s|[·|/()_-])pro($|\s|[·|/()_-])/.test(text)) return 'pro';
    if (/(^|\s|[·|/()_-])auto($|\s|[·|/()_-])/.test(text)) return 'auto';
    if (/gpt[-\s]?\d/i.test(text)) return 'named-model';
    return 'unknown';
  }

  function modelIdentityTokensV622(value) {
    const text = normalizeText(value).slice(0, Math.max(80, Number(CONFIG.modelContinuityMaxLabelChars || 180)));
    const tokens = [];
    const modelNames = text.match(/gpt[-\s]?\d+(?:\.\d+)*(?:\s+[a-z0-9._-]+)?/gi) || [];
    modelNames.forEach(item => tokens.push(normalizeText(item)));
    for (const word of ['instant', 'thinking', 'pro', 'auto', 'reasoning']) {
      if (new RegExp(`(^|\\W)${word}(?=$|\\W)`, 'i').test(text)) tokens.push(word);
    }
    return [...new Set(tokens)].join('|') || text;
  }

  function modelUiCandidateScoreV622(element, composerRect = null) {
    if (!(element instanceof Element) || !isVisible(element)) return null;
    if (element.closest(CHATGPT_CONVERSATION_SURFACE_SELECTOR_V730)) return null;
    if (element.closest('#vibe-go-panel-v628,#vibe-go-banner-v5')) return null;

    const testId = String(element.getAttribute?.('data-testid') || '');
    const ariaLabel = String(element.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || '');
    const title = String(element.getAttribute?.('title') || '');
    const id = String(element.id || '');
    const text = String(element.innerText || element.textContent || '').trim();
    const attrs = `${testId} ${ariaLabel} ${title} ${id}`.toLowerCase();
    const label = String(ariaLabel || title || text || testId || id).trim();
    const mode = classifyObservedModelModeV622(`${label} ${attrs}`);
    const explicitModelAttr = /model|reasoning|thinking/.test(attrs);
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect?.() || null;
    const nearComposer = Boolean(
      composerRect && rect &&
      Math.abs((rect.top + rect.height / 2) - (composerRect.top + composerRect.height / 2)) <= 260
    );
    const topChrome = Boolean(rect && rect.top >= -20 && rect.top <= 220);

    if (!explicitModelAttr && mode === 'unknown') return null;
    // A generic "Pro" upgrade button is not a model selector unless it is beside the composer
    // or exposes an explicit model/reasoning attribute.
    if (!explicitModelAttr && mode === 'pro' && !nearComposer) return null;
    if (!explicitModelAttr && !nearComposer && !topChrome) return null;

    let score = 0;
    if (explicitModelAttr) score += 100;
    if (nearComposer) score += 45;
    if (topChrome) score += 15;
    if (mode !== 'unknown') score += 25;
    if (/model-selector|model-switcher|model-picker|model_button|model-button/.test(attrs)) score += 80;
    if (element.getAttribute?.('aria-haspopup') === 'menu') score += 10;
    if (label.length > 0 && label.length <= 120) score += 10;

    const identity = modelIdentityTokensV622(`${label} ${attrs}`);
    return {
      source: 'visible-model-ui',
      score,
      reliable: score >= 70 && Boolean(identity),
      label: label.slice(0, Math.max(80, Number(CONFIG.modelContinuityMaxLabelChars || 180))),
      normalizedLabel: normalizeText(label),
      mode,
      identity,
      signature: hashText(`${identity}::${normalizeText(testId)}::${normalizeText(ariaLabel || title)}`),
      testId: testId || null,
      ariaLabel: ariaLabel || null,
      title: title || null,
    };
  }

  function detectVisibleModelUiV622() {
    const composer = findComposer();
    const composerRect = composer?.getBoundingClientRect?.() || null;
    const candidates = [];
    for (const element of document.querySelectorAll('button,[role="button"]')) {
      const candidate = modelUiCandidateScoreV622(element, composerRect);
      if (candidate) candidates.push(candidate);
    }
    candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    return candidates.find(item => item.reliable) || null;
  }

  function detectAssistantModelMetadataV622() {
    const assistantNodes = getRoleNodes().filter(node => chatgptConversationRoleV730(node) === 'assistant');
    const roleNode = assistantNodes.at(-1) || null;
    if (!roleNode) return null;
    const turn = getTurnElement(roleNode);
    const nodes = [roleNode, turn, ...(turn ? [...turn.querySelectorAll('*')].slice(0, 160) : [])].filter(Boolean);
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;
      for (const attr of [...node.attributes]) {
        const name = String(attr.name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (!/model/.test(name)) continue;
        const value = String(attr.value || '').trim();
        if (!value || value.length > 220) continue;
        const identity = modelIdentityTokensV622(value);
        if (!identity) continue;
        return {
          source: 'assistant-dom-model-metadata',
          reliable: true,
          label: value.slice(0, Math.max(80, Number(CONFIG.modelContinuityMaxLabelChars || 180))),
          normalizedLabel: normalizeText(value),
          mode: classifyObservedModelModeV622(value),
          identity,
          signature: hashText(`${name}::${identity}`),
          attribute: name,
          turnKey: String(turn?.getAttribute?.('data-testid') || turn?.getAttribute?.('data-message-id') || ''),
        };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

    };
  }

  function modelBaselineFromObservationV622(observation) {
    const primary = observation?.primary || null;
    if (!primary?.reliable || !primary.identity) return null;
    return {
      source: primary.source,
      identity: String(primary.identity),
      signature: String(primary.signature || ''),

  function armModelContinuityGuardV622(options = {}) {
    const observation = observeModelContinuityV622();
    const baseline = modelBaselineFromObservationV622(observation);
    if (!baseline) {
      const next = saveModelContinuityGuardStateV622({
        ...getModelContinuityGuardStateV622(),
        enabled: options.enabled !== false,
        sessionId: SemanticSessionStore?.peek?.()?.id || null,
        status: 'observability-degraded',
        lastObservation: observation,
        paused: null,
      });
      return { armed: false, reason: 'No reliable client-visible model identity is exposed on the current page', state: next, observation };
    }
    if (
      CONFIG.modelContinuityDisallowInstantBaseline === true &&
      baseline.mode === 'instant' &&
      options.allowInstant !== true
    ) {
      const next = saveModelContinuityGuardStateV622({
        ...getModelContinuityGuardStateV622(),
        enabled: true,
        sessionId: SemanticSessionStore?.peek?.()?.id || null,
        status: 'instant-baseline-refused',
        lastObservation: observation,
        paused: {
          reason: 'Visible model UI reports Instant; automatic guard arming refuses Instant baseline',
          detectedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
          observation,
        },
      });
      return { armed: false, blocked: true, reason: next.paused.reason, state: next, observation };
    }
    const next = saveModelContinuityGuardStateV622({
      ...getModelContinuityGuardStateV622(),
      enabled: options.enabled !== false,
      sessionId: SemanticSessionStore?.peek?.()?.id || null,
      status: 'armed',
      baseline,
      lastObservation: observation,
      behavioralFailureStreak: 0,
      lastBehavioralFailureKey: null,
      lastBehavioralFailure: null,
      paused: null,
    });
    log('a22 model-continuity guard armed from observable client identity', {
      source: baseline.source,
      identity: baseline.identity,
      label: baseline.label,
      mode: baseline.mode,
    });
    return { armed: true, state: next, observation };
  }

  function compareModelContinuityIdentityV622(baseline, current) {
    if (!baseline || !current?.reliable) return { comparable: false, drift: false, reason: 'insufficient-signal' };
    const baselineMode = String(baseline.mode || 'unknown');
    const currentMode = String(current.mode || 'unknown');
    if (baselineMode !== 'instant' && currentMode === 'instant') {
      return { comparable: true, drift: true, kind: 'visible-instant-regression' };
    }
    const sameSource = String(baseline.source || '') === String(current.source || '');
    const baselineIdentity = String(baseline.identity || '');
    const currentIdentity = String(current.identity || '');
    if (sameSource && baselineIdentity && currentIdentity) {
      return {
        comparable: true,
        drift: baselineIdentity !== currentIdentity,
        kind: baselineIdentity !== currentIdentity ? 'observable-model-identity-drift' : 'same-observable-identity',
      };
    }
    const explicitModes = new Set(['instant', 'thinking', 'pro', 'auto']);
    if (explicitModes.has(baselineMode) && explicitModes.has(currentMode)) {
      return {
        comparable: true,
        drift: baselineMode !== currentMode,
        kind: baselineMode !== currentMode ? 'observable-model-mode-drift' : 'same-observable-mode',
      };
    }
    const baselineTokens = new Set(String(baselineIdentity || '').split('|').filter(Boolean));
    const currentTokens = new Set(String(currentIdentity || '').split('|').filter(Boolean));
    const overlap = [...baselineTokens].some(token => currentTokens.has(token));
    if (overlap) return { comparable: true, drift: false, kind: 'cross-source-token-overlap' };
    // UI labels and per-turn DOM metadata are different observational surfaces.
    // If they expose incomparable detail (e.g. "Thinking" vs an internal GPT slug),
    // absence of token overlap is not evidence of a switch. Keep the original baseline
    // and rely on explicit Instant regression / same-surface drift / behavioral sentinel.
    return { comparable: false, drift: false, reason: 'cross-source-incomparable' };
  }

  function evaluateModelContinuityV622(context = '', options = {}) {
    if (CONFIG.modelContinuityGuardEnabled !== true) return { blocked: false, disabled: true };
    let guard = getModelContinuityGuardStateV622();
    const sessionId = SemanticSessionStore?.peek?.()?.id || null;
    if (guard.sessionId && sessionId && String(guard.sessionId) !== String(sessionId)) {
      guard = defaultModelContinuityGuardStateV622();
    }
    const observation = observeModelContinuityV622();
    const current = observation.primary || null;

    if (guard.paused?.kind === 'protocol-behavior-drift') {
      return {
        blocked: true,
        reason: String(guard.paused.reason || 'Protocol-behavior continuity alarm is latched; explicit modelGuard.resetBehavioral() or acceptCurrent() is required'),
        observation,
        guard,
        context: String(context || ''),
        kind: 'protocol-behavior-drift',
      };
    }

    if (!guard.baseline && options.allowArm !== false) {
      const armed = armModelContinuityGuardV622({ allowInstant: options.allowInstant === true });
      if (armed.blocked) return { blocked: true, reason: armed.reason, observation, guard: armed.state };
      guard = armed.state;
    }

    if (!guard.enabled) return { blocked: false, disabled: true, observation, guard };

    if (guard.paused && !current) {
      return {
        blocked: true,
        reason: 'Model continuity guard is paused and the current page exposes no reliable model identity to prove recovery',
        observation,
        guard,
      };
    }

    const baseline = guard.baseline || null;
    if (baseline && current?.reliable) {
      const comparison = compareModelContinuityIdentityV622(baseline, current);
      if (comparison.drift) {
        return {
          blocked: true,
          reason: comparison.kind === 'visible-instant-regression'
            ? `Visible model selection regressed to Instant (baseline: ${baseline.label || baseline.identity}; current: ${current.label || current.identity})`
            : `Observable model identity changed (baseline: ${baseline.label || baseline.identity}; current: ${current.label || current.identity})`,
          observation,
          guard,
          context: String(context || ''),
          kind: comparison.kind || 'observable-model-identity-drift',
          comparison,
        };
      }
    }

    const next = saveModelContinuityGuardStateV622({
      ...guard,
      sessionId,
      status: baseline ? 'armed' : 'observability-degraded',
      lastObservation: observation,
      paused: null,
    });
    return { blocked: false, observation, guard: next };
  }

  async function pauseForModelContinuityV622(signal, context = '') {
    if (!signal?.blocked) return false;
    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    clearTimeout(observerSettleTimer);
    observerSettleTimer = null;
    clearTimeout(generationProbeTimer);
    generationProbeTimer = null;
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();

    const guard = getModelContinuityGuardStateV622();
    const paused = {
      kind: String(signal.kind || 'model-continuity-uncertain'),
      reason: String(signal.reason || 'Model continuity could not be certified'),
      context: String(context || ''),
      observation: cloneSemanticValue(signal.observation || null),
      baseline: cloneSemanticValue(guard.baseline || null),
      detectedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    saveModelContinuityGuardStateV622({ ...guard, status: 'paused', paused, lastObservation: paused.observation });
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (session) {
      session.transport = session.transport || {};
      session.transport.modelContinuityGuardV622 = cloneSemanticValue(paused);
      session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    setPhase('paused', `model continuity guard: ${paused.reason}`);
    warn('a22 MODEL CONTINUITY PAUSE:', paused);
    showBanner(`⏸ MODEL CONTINUITY — ${paused.reason}`, '#7c2d12', 14000);
    return true;
  }

  async function enforceModelContinuityGuardV622(context = '', options = {}) {
    const signal = evaluateModelContinuityV622(context, options);
    if (!signal?.blocked) return null;
    await pauseForModelContinuityV622(signal, context);
    return signal;
  }

  function legacyTransportBehavioralGuardEligibleForMigrationV6910(guardInput = null, sessionInput = null) {
    const guard = guardInput || getModelContinuityGuardStateV622();
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    if (guard?.paused?.kind !== 'protocol-behavior-drift') return false;
    const pausedReason = String(guard?.paused?.reason || '');
    const failureReason = String(guard?.lastBehavioralFailure?.reason || guard?.paused?.failure?.reason || '');
    const legacyPauseShape = /VIBE_STATE transport\/protocol-shape failures occurred without an accepted state/i.test(pausedReason);
    if (!legacyPauseShape) return false;
    const transportReason = /MALFORMED_(?:VG_RESULT|VG_PATCH|VIBE_STATE)_PAYLOAD|Expected (?:one|at most one) VG_(?:RESULT|PATCH)|VG_PATCH .*mismatch|VG_RESULT must not contain patch fields|closing sentinel|JSON is not complete|marker has no JSON payload|INLINE_ANALYZER_SOURCE_FORBIDDEN/i.test(failureReason);
    const lastObservation = session?.transport?.lastFailureObservationV695 || null;
    const matchingTransportObservation = Boolean(
      lastObservation?.kind === 'TRANSPORT_FAILURE' &&
      (!guard?.lastBehavioralFailure?.dispatchId || !lastObservation?.dispatchId || String(lastObservation.dispatchId) === String(guard.lastBehavioralFailure.dispatchId))
    );
    return Boolean(transportReason || matchingTransportObservation);
  }

  function recordModelContinuityBehavioralFailureV622(reasonInput, marker = null) {
    if (CONFIG.modelContinuityGuardEnabled !== true) return { alarm: false, disabled: true };
    const guard = getModelContinuityGuardStateV622();
    if (!guard.enabled) return { alarm: false, disabled: true };
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const reason = String(reasonInput || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    const attemptIdentity = String(marker?.id || marker?.turn?.key || `raw:${hashText(String(marker?.raw || ''))}:${String(marker?.raw || '').length}`);
    const failureKey = `${pending?.id || 'no-dispatch'}::${attemptIdentity}::${hashText(reason)}`;
    if (failureKey === guard.lastBehavioralFailureKey) {
      return { alarm: false, duplicate: true, streak: Number(guard.behavioralFailureStreak || 0), state: guard };
    }
    const streak = Number(guard.behavioralFailureStreak || 0) + 1;
    const failure = {
      key: failureKey,
      dispatchId: pending?.id || null,
      baseRevision: pending?.baseRevision ?? null,
      markerId: marker?.id || null,
      reason: reason.slice(0, 700),
      at: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    const threshold = Math.max(2, Number(CONFIG.modelContinuityBehavioralFailureThreshold || 2));
    const alarm = streak >= threshold;
    const next = saveModelContinuityGuardStateV622({
      ...guard,
      status: alarm ? 'behavioral-alert' : guard.status,
      behavioralFailureStreak: streak,
      lastBehavioralFailureKey: failureKey,
      lastBehavioralFailure: failure,
      paused: alarm ? {
        kind: 'protocol-behavior-drift',
        reason: `${streak} distinct VIBE_STATE transport/protocol-shape failures occurred without an accepted state between them; hidden model/routing change is possible but not proven`,
        detectedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        failure,
      } : guard.paused,
    });
    return { alarm, streak, threshold, failure, state: next };
  }

      ...guard,

    });
  }

  function getRoleNodes() {
    return chatgptRoleNodesAllV730().slice(-CONFIG.tailTurnLimit);
  }

  function getTurnElement(roleNode) {
    return (
      roleNode.closest('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]') ||
      roleNode.closest('[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]') ||
      roleNode.closest('[data-turn-key]') ||
      roleNode.closest('[data-message-id]') ||
      roleNode
    );
  }

  const tailTextCache = new WeakMap();
  const dirtyTailRoleNodes = new WeakSet();
  const TAIL_SKIP_SELECTOR = [
    'button',
    '[role="button"]',
    'svg',
    '[data-testid*="error" i]',
    '[data-testid*="retry" i]',
    '[class~="text-orange-600"]',
    '[class*="text-orange-"]',
  ].join(',');

  function readMessageContent(roleNode, { stripCode = false, stripPre = false, restoreInlineCode = false } = {}) {
    const parts = [];
    const visit = node => {
      if (!node) return;
      if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
        if (node.nodeValue) parts.push(node.nodeValue);
        return;
      }
      if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return;
      const element = node;
      if (element !== roleNode && element.matches?.(TAIL_SKIP_SELECTOR)) return;

      // v6.5.12 transport fidelity: fenced code is a machine envelope and must be
      // handled separately by readSemanticMarkerContent(). The historical
      // stripCode path removed both <pre> and inline <code>, which destroyed
      // Markdown-significant source characters before JSON.parse ever saw them.
      if ((stripPre || stripCode) && element !== roleNode && element.matches?.('pre')) return;
      if (stripCode && !restoreInlineCode && element !== roleNode && element.matches?.('code')) return;
      if (
        restoreInlineCode &&
        element !== roleNode &&
        element.matches?.('code') &&
        !element.closest?.('pre')
      ) {
        parts.push('`');
        for (const child of element.childNodes) visit(child);
        parts.push('`');
        return;
      }
      for (const child of element.childNodes) visit(child);
    };
    visit(roleNode);
    return parts.join('');
  }

  function findCompleteSemanticJsonObjectEndV612(textInput, objectStartInput) {
    const text = String(textInput || '');
    const objectStart = Number(objectStartInput);
    if (!Number.isInteger(objectStart) || objectStart < 0 || text[objectStart] !== '{') return -1;

    // v6.6.0-a14: lexical JSON boundary recovery. Braces inside JSON strings are
    // data, not structure; escaped quotes/backslashes therefore cannot close the
    // root object early. This scanner only identifies a candidate boundary;
    // JSON.parse remains the syntax/semantic authority before any state is accepted.
    let depth = 0;
    let inString = false;
    let escaped = false;
    for (let index = objectStart; index < text.length; index += 1) {
      const char = text[index];
      if (inString) {
        if (escaped) {
          escaped = false;
          continue;
        }
        if (char === '\\') {
          escaped = true;
          continue;
        }
        if (char === '"') inString = false;
        continue;
      }
      if (char === '"') {
        inString = true;
        continue;
      }
      if (char === '{') {
        depth += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (char === '}') {
        depth -= 1;
        if (depth === 0) return index;
        if (depth < 0) return -1;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function isIgnorableSemanticTransportTailV612(textInput) {
    const tail = String(textInput || '').trim();
    if (!tail) return true;
    // Raw-markdown fallback can expose the closing fence itself when the UI has
    // not mounted a native <pre>. Nothing else is silently discarded.
    return /^```(?:text)?\s*$/i.test(tail);
  }

  function recoverClosedFencedSemanticMarkerV610(textInput) {
    const text = String(textInput || '');
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed.startsWith('[[VIBE_STATE')) return text;
    if (trimmed.endsWith(']]')) return text;

    const marker = '[[VIBE_STATE';
    const objectStart = trimmed.indexOf('{', marker.length);
    if (objectStart < 0) return text;
    const objectEnd = findCompleteSemanticJsonObjectEndV612(trimmed, objectStart);
    if (objectEnd < objectStart) return text;
    if (!isIgnorableSemanticTransportTailV612(trimmed.slice(objectEnd + 1))) return text;
    const raw = trimmed.slice(objectStart, objectEnd + 1);
    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || Array.isArray(payload)) return text;
      return `${trimmed.slice(0, objectEnd + 1)}]]`;
    } catch {
      return text;
    }
  }

  function readSemanticMarkerContent(roleNode) {
    // a28 normal transport: VG_RESULT and optional VG_PATCH live in fenced
    // Markdown blocks. Legacy VIBE_STATE remains accepted for recovery/bootstrap.
    // Browser textContent of <pre> preserves literal JSON/source payload bytes.
    const fencedMarkers = [];
    for (const pre of roleNode?.querySelectorAll?.('pre') || []) {
      if (pre !== roleNode && pre.matches?.(TAIL_SKIP_SELECTOR)) continue;
      const text = String(pre.textContent || '');
      const trimmed = text.trimStart();
      if (trimmed.startsWith('[[VIBE_STATE')) {
        fencedMarkers.push(recoverClosedFencedSemanticMarkerV610(text));
      } else if (trimmed.startsWith('[[VG_RESULT') || trimmed.startsWith('[[VG_PATCH')) {
        fencedMarkers.push(recoverClosedFencedThinSemanticMarkerV627(text));
      }
    }
    if (fencedMarkers.length) return fencedMarkers.join('\n');

    // Backward compatibility for pre-v6.5.12/plain markers. Inline <code> is
    // reconstructed with its Markdown delimiters so common template literals do
    // not silently lose backticks. This fallback is intentionally secondary:
    // only the fenced envelope is fully lossless for arbitrary source text.
    return readMessageContent(roleNode, {
      stripPre: true,
      restoreInlineCode: true,
    });
  }

  function getTurnTextProjection(roleNode, role) {
    const cached = tailTextCache.get(roleNode);
    if (cached && !dirtyTailRoleNodes.has(roleNode)) {
      cpuHotPathStats.tailCacheHits += 1;
      return cached;
    }
    cpuHotPathStats.tailCacheMisses += 1;
    const readableText = readMessageContent(roleNode);
    // ChatGPT's 2026 Markdown DOM can render a plain protocol footer as ordinary
    // block content rather than <pre>. The recursive readable projection below
    // intentionally preserves text bytes but historically joins adjacent DOM blocks
    // without separators; that can collapse `...narrative\n[[VG_RESULT...` into
    // `...narrative[[VG_RESULT...` and defeat the line-anchored thin parser.
    // Native innerText preserves rendered block/line boundaries, so keep it as an
    // additional observational projection. It is never accepted on its own: the
    // existing parser/JSON/causal checks must prove it complete before selection.
    const visualText = role === 'assistant'
      ? String(roleNode?.innerText || '')
      : '';
    let markerText = role === 'assistant'
      ? readSemanticMarkerContent(roleNode)
      : readableText;

    // v6.6.0-a14 + 2026 DOM compatibility: ChatGPT can expose the same assistant
    // artifact through multiple DOM projections. Prefer a projection that actually
    // parses as one complete semantic marker; never concatenate fragments or weaken
    // the protocol header/causal parser merely to accommodate presentation markup.
    if (
      role === 'assistant' &&
      (containsSemanticControlMarkerV627(readableText) || containsSemanticControlMarkerV627(visualText))
    ) {
      const projections = [
        String(markerText || ''),
        String(visualText || ''),
        String(readableText || ''),
      ].filter((value, index, list) =>
        containsSemanticControlMarkerV627(value) && list.indexOf(value) === index
      );
      const scored = projections.map(value => {
        const legacy = extractSemanticStatePayloads(value);
        const legacyOne = legacy.length === 1 ? legacy[0] : null;
        const thin = extractThinSemanticTurnPayloadV627(value);
        const rootMarkerCount = (value.match(/\[\[(?:VIBE_STATE|VG_RESULT)\b/g) || []).length;
        return {
          value,
          complete: Boolean(
            (legacyOne?.payload && !legacyOne?.error && !legacyOne?.incomplete) ||
            (thin?.payload && !thin?.error && !thin?.incomplete)
          ),
          singleMarker: rootMarkerCount === 1,
          length: value.length,
        };
      }).sort((a, b) =>
        Number(b.complete) - Number(a.complete)
        || Number(b.singleMarker) - Number(a.singleMarker)
        || b.length - a.length
      );
      if (scored[0]) markerText = scored[0].value;
    }

    const next = { readableText, markerText };
    tailTextCache.set(roleNode, next);
    dirtyTailRoleNodes.delete(roleNode);
    return next;
  }

  function markTailRoleDirtyFromMutation(mutation) {
    const targetElement = mutation.target instanceof Element
      ? mutation.target
      : mutation.target?.parentElement;
    const roleNode = targetElement?.closest?.(CHATGPT_ROLE_NODE_SELECTOR_V730);
    if (roleNode && chatgptConversationRoleV730(roleNode)) dirtyTailRoleNodes.add(roleNode);

    for (const node of mutation.addedNodes || []) {
      if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;
      if (node.matches?.(CHATGPT_ROLE_NODE_SELECTOR_V730) && chatgptConversationRoleV730(node)) {
        dirtyTailRoleNodes.add(node);
      }
      node.querySelectorAll?.(CHATGPT_ROLE_NODE_SELECTOR_V730).forEach(item => {
        if (chatgptConversationRoleV730(item)) dirtyTailRoleNodes.add(item);
      });
    }
  }

  function mutationTouchesConversationTransport(mutation) {
    const targetElement = mutation.target instanceof Element
      ? mutation.target
      : mutation.target?.parentElement;
    if (targetElement?.closest?.(CHATGPT_CONVERSATION_SURFACE_SELECTOR_V730)) return true;
    const relevantSelector = [
      CHATGPT_CONVERSATION_SURFACE_SELECTOR_V730,
      '[data-testid="stop-button"]',
    ].join(',');
    for (const node of [...(mutation.addedNodes || []), ...(mutation.removedNodes || [])]) {
      if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;
      if (node.matches?.(relevantSelector) || node.querySelector?.(relevantSelector)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function parseTurnOrder(domId) {
    const match = String(domId || '')
      .match(/conversation-turn-(\d+)/i);

    return match ? Number(match[1]) : null;
  }

  function getTailTurns() {
    cpuHotPathStats.tailReads += 1;
    const seen = new Set();
    const turns = [];
    const roleNodes = getRoleNodes();

    // Stable-artifact invariant: once native generation is no longer active, the
    // newest assistant artifact is always read directly from the live DOM instead
    // of trusting a cache populated while the response was streaming. This keeps
    // transport correctness independent of MutationObserver characterData policy.
    if (!isGeneratingFast()) {
      for (let index = roleNodes.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
        const node = roleNodes[index];
        if (chatgptConversationRoleV730(node) === 'assistant') {
          dirtyTailRoleNodes.add(node);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    for (const roleNode of roleNodes) {
      const role = chatgptConversationRoleV730(roleNode);

      if (role !== 'assistant' && role !== 'user') continue;

      const turnElement = getTurnElement(roleNode);
      const domId = chatgptRoleNodeDomIdV730(roleNode, role, turnElement);

      const { readableText, markerText } = getTurnTextProjection(roleNode, role);
      const order = parseTurnOrder(domId);

      const key =
        domId ||
        `${role}:${hashText(readableText)}:${readableText.length}`;

      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);

      turns.push({
        role,
        domId,
        order,
        key,
        readableText,
        markerText,
        turnElement,
      });
    }

    return turns.map((turn, index) => ({ ...turn, index }));
  }

  function resolveTurnIndex(turns, key, order) {
    if (key) {
      const byKey = turns.findIndex(turn => turn.key === key);
      if (byKey >= 0) return byKey;
    }

    if (Number.isFinite(order)) {
      const byOrder = turns.findIndex(turn => turn.order === order);
      if (byOrder >= 0) return byOrder;
    }

    return -1;
  }

  function getStopButton() {
    const selectors = [
      '[data-testid="stop-button"]',
      'button[data-testid="stop-button"]',
    ];

    for (const selector of selectors) {
      const element = document.querySelector(selector);
      if (element && isVisible(element)) return element;
    }

    return [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button => {
      if (!isVisible(button)) return false;

      const label = normalizeText(
        button.getAttribute('aria-label') || button.textContent
      );

      return (
        label.includes('stop generating') ||
        label.includes('stop response') ||
        label.includes('остановить создание') ||
        label.includes('остановить ответ') ||
        label === 'stop'
      );
    }) || null;
  }

  function getStopButtonFast() {
    const button = document.querySelector('[data-testid="stop-button"]');
    return button?.isConnected ? button : null;
  }

  function isGeneratingFast() {
    return Boolean(getStopButtonFast());
  }

  function isGenerating() {
    return Boolean(getStopButton());
  }

  function markLatestAssistantTailDirty() {
    const nodes = getRoleNodes().filter(node => chatgptConversationRoleV730(node) === 'assistant');
    const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];
    if (last) dirtyTailRoleNodes.add(last);
  }

  function scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe(delay = CONFIG.generationPollMs) {
    if (!state.running || generationProbeTimer) return;
    generationProbeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      generationProbeTimer = null;
      if (!state.running) return;
      cpuHotPathStats.generationProbeChecks += 1;
      if (isGeneratingFast()) {
        scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe(CONFIG.generationPollMs);
        return;
      }
      if (generationDirty) {
        generationDirty = false;
        markLatestAssistantTailDirty();
      }
      scheduleProcess(80);
    }, Math.max(80, Number(delay || CONFIG.generationPollMs)));
  }
