  function resortBootstrapMissionV022() {
    return {
      schema: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V022,
      revision: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REVISION_V022,
      direction: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_DIRECTION_V022,
      reminder: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REMINDER_V022,
      contract: cloneSemanticValue(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022),
    };
  }

  function resortMissionSessionMatchesExact(sessionInput, schema, revision) {
    const session = sessionInput && typeof sessionInput === 'object' ? sessionInput : null;
    return Boolean(
      session &&
      String(session.mission?.contract?.schema || '') === String(schema || '') &&
      String(session.mission?.contract?.revision || '') === String(revision || '')
    );
  }

  function resortMissionSessionMatchesV02(sessionInput) {
    return resortMissionSessionMatchesExact(sessionInput, RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V02, RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REVISION_V02);
  }
  function resortMissionSessionMatchesV021(sessionInput) {
    return resortMissionSessionMatchesExact(sessionInput, RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V021, RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REVISION_V021);
  }
  function resortMissionSessionMatchesV022(sessionInput) {
    return resortMissionSessionMatchesExact(sessionInput, RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V022, RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REVISION_V022);
  }
  function resortMissionSessionIsGovernedBootstrap(sessionInput) {
    return resortMissionSessionMatchesV02(sessionInput) ||
      resortMissionSessionMatchesV021(sessionInput) ||
      resortMissionSessionMatchesV022(sessionInput);
  }

  function resortMissionClosureEvidenceGoverned(sessionInput, payloadInput) {
    const session = sessionInput && typeof sessionInput === 'object' ? sessionInput : null;
    if (!resortMissionSessionIsGovernedBootstrap(session)) return { applicable: false, ok: true, missing: [] };
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : {};
    const closure = payload.closureEvidence && typeof payload.closureEvidence === 'object' ? payload.closureEvidence : null;
    const expected = Array.isArray(session.mission?.contract?.closure_rule?.required_predicate_ids)
      ? session.mission.contract.closure_rule.required_predicate_ids.map(String) : [];
    const rows = Array.isArray(closure?.predicates) ? closure.predicates : [];
    const byId = new Map(rows.map(row => [String(row?.id || ''), row]));
    const missing = [];
    if (!closure || String(closure.schema || '') !== 'resort-vibe-mission-closure-evidence/v1') missing.push('closureEvidence.schema');
    if (closure?.invariantPreserved !== true) missing.push('invariantPreserved');
    if (closure?.forbiddenStatesAbsent !== true) missing.push('forbiddenStatesAbsent');
    for (const id of expected) {
      const row = byId.get(id);
      const refs = Array.isArray(row?.evidenceRefs) ? row.evidenceRefs.filter(Boolean) : [];
      if (!row || String(row.verdict || '').toUpperCase() !== 'PROVEN' || refs.length < 1) missing.push(id);
    }
    return { applicable: true, ok: missing.length === 0, expected, missing, closure: closure ? cloneSemanticValue(closure) : null };
  }

  function assertResortMissionClosureEvidenceGoverned(sessionInput, payloadInput) {
    const status = resortMissionClosureEvidenceGoverned(sessionInput, payloadInput);
    if (!status.applicable || status.ok) return status;
    const error = new Error(`RESORT_MISSION_CLOSURE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: missing ${status.missing.join(', ')}`);
    error.code = 'RESORT_MISSION_CLOSURE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED';
    error.closureStatus = status;
    throw error;
  }

  function assertResortMissionImmutabilityGoverned(sessionInput, payloadInput) {
    const session = sessionInput && typeof sessionInput === 'object' ? sessionInput : null;
    if (!resortMissionSessionIsGovernedBootstrap(session)) return true;
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : {};
    const expectedDirection = String(session.mission?.direction || '');
    const expectedReminder = String(session.mission?.reminder || '');
    if ('direction' in payload && String(payload.direction || '') !== expectedDirection) {
      const error = new Error('RESORT_MISSION_DIRECTION_IMMUTABLE');
      error.code = 'RESORT_MISSION_DIRECTION_IMMUTABLE';
      throw error;
    }
    if ('reminder' in payload && String(payload.reminder || '') !== expectedReminder) {
      const error = new Error('RESORT_MISSION_REMINDER_IMMUTABLE');
      error.code = 'RESORT_MISSION_REMINDER_IMMUTABLE';
      throw error;
    }
    return true;
  }

  async function activateResortBootstrapMissionV022(environmentEvidence = {}) {
    const preflight = assertResortEnvironmentForMutationV01(environmentEvidence || {});
    const existing = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (existing) {
      if (resortMissionSessionMatchesV022(existing)) {
        return {
          activated: false,
          reason: 'already-active-v2.2',
          preflight,
          sessionId: existing.id,
          status: existing.status,
          mission: cloneSemanticValue(existing.mission),
        };
      }
      if (resortMissionSessionMatchesV02(existing) || resortMissionSessionMatchesV021(existing)) {
        const error = new Error('RESORT_MISSION_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED: active older Resort bootstrap Mission requires explicit amendToV22()');
        error.code = 'RESORT_MISSION_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED';
        throw error;
      }
      const error = new Error(
        `RESORT_MISSION_SESSION_CONFLICT: existing SemanticSession ${existing.id} carries another Mission authority`
      );
      error.code = 'RESORT_MISSION_SESSION_CONFLICT';
      throw error;
    }

    const mission = resortBootstrapMissionV022();
    const initial = cloneSemanticValue(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022.initial_distance || {});
    const created = SemanticSessionStore.create({
      sessionId: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022.installation.session_id,
      direction: mission.direction,
      reminder: mission.reminder,
      missionContract: mission.contract,
      activity: initial.activity || 'RECON',
      tacticalFocus: initial.objective || '',
      activeDistance: {
        id: initial.id,
        objective: initial.objective,
        closureContract: initial.closure_contract,
        reason: 'Rehydrated after explicit physical environment rebind; continue Stage 5 semantic repository routing foundation',
      },
    });
    addSemanticDecision(created, {
      id: 'decision:resort-environment-rebind-rehydration-v2.2',
      text: 'Bootstrap Mission semantics preserved after explicit physical environment rebind; physical coordinates now resolve through .vibe/environment.json instead of duplicated Mission fields.',
      reason: 'The control browser on the new PC had no prior browser-local SemanticSession. Explicit environment preflight authorizes rehydration of the same Mission/session identity.',
      distanceId: initial.id || null,
    }, Number(created.revision || 0));
    const saved = SemanticSessionStore.save(created);
    replaceRuntimeStateValue('resortBootstrapMissionV022', {
      schema: 'resort-vibe-mission-installation/v1',
      installedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      sessionId: saved.id,
      missionSchema: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V022,
      missionRevision: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REVISION_V022,
      projectId: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022.project_id,
      mode: 'explicit-rehydration-after-environment-rebind',
    });
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return {
      activated: true,
      preflight,
      sessionId: saved.id,
      status: saved.status,
      mission: cloneSemanticValue(saved.mission),
      activeDistance: cloneSemanticValue(saved.distances?.[saved.route?.activeDistanceId] || null),
    };
  }

  async function amendResortBootstrapMissionToV022(environmentEvidence = {}) {
    const preflight = assertResortEnvironmentForMutationV01(environmentEvidence || {});
    const existing = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!existing) {
      const error = new Error('RESORT_MISSION_AMENDMENT_NO_ACTIVE_SESSION: use activate() for explicit rehydration');
      error.code = 'RESORT_MISSION_AMENDMENT_NO_ACTIVE_SESSION';
      throw error;
    }
    if (resortMissionSessionMatchesV022(existing)) {
      return {
        amended: false,
        reason: 'already-v2.2',
        preflight,
        sessionId: existing.id,
        status: existing.status,
        mission: cloneSemanticValue(existing.mission),
      };
    }
    if (!(resortMissionSessionMatchesV02(existing) || resortMissionSessionMatchesV021(existing))) {
      const error = new Error(
        `RESORT_MISSION_AMENDMENT_SOURCE_MISMATCH: got ${String(existing.mission?.contract?.schema || 'unknown')} @ ${String(existing.mission?.contract?.revision || 'unknown')}`
      );
      error.code = 'RESORT_MISSION_AMENDMENT_SOURCE_MISMATCH';
      throw error;
    }

    const fromSchema = String(existing.mission?.contract?.schema || '');
    const fromRevision = String(existing.mission?.contract?.revision || '');
    const next = cloneSemanticValue(existing);
    const nextRevision = Number(next.revision || 0) + 1;
    next.revision = nextRevision;
    next.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    next.mission.direction = RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_DIRECTION_V022;
    next.mission.reminder = RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REMINDER_V022;
    next.mission.contract = cloneSemanticValue(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022);
    const activeDistanceId = String(next.route?.activeDistanceId || '');
    const activeDistance = activeDistanceId ? next.distances?.[activeDistanceId] || null : null;
    if (activeDistance && activeDistance.status !== 'sealed') {
      activeDistance.objective = String(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022.initial_distance.objective);
      activeDistance.closureContract = String(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022.initial_distance.closure_contract);
      activeDistance.updatedAt = next.updatedAt;
      activeDistance.revision = nextRevision;
    }
    addSemanticDecision(next, {
      id: 'decision:resort-environment-binding-indirection-v2.2',
      text: 'Mission physical host/repo coordinates are now resolved from .vibe/environment.json; Mission semantics and CP-01..CP-12 are unchanged.',
      reason: 'Explicit PC environment rebind exposed stale duplicated physical coordinates in v2.1.',
      distanceId: activeDistanceId || null,
    }, nextRevision);

    const saved = SemanticSessionStore.save(next);
    replaceRuntimeStateValue('resortBootstrapMissionV022', {
      schema: 'resort-vibe-mission-amendment/v1',
      amendedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      sessionId: saved.id,
      fromSchema,
      fromRevision,
      toSchema: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V022,
      toRevision: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_REVISION_V022,
      projectId: RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022.project_id,
    });
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return {
      amended: true,
      preflight,
      sessionId: saved.id,
      status: saved.status,
      revision: saved.revision,
      mission: cloneSemanticValue(saved.mission),
      activeDistance: cloneSemanticValue(saved.distances?.[saved.route?.activeDistanceId] || null),
    };
  }

  function resortMissionStatusV022() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    return {
      schema: 'resort-vibe-bootstrap-mission-status/v1',
      approvedContract: resortBootstrapMissionV022(),
      active: resortMissionSessionMatchesV022(session),
      installRequired: !session,
      amendmentRequired: Boolean(session) && (
        resortMissionSessionMatchesV02(session) || resortMissionSessionMatchesV021(session)
      ),
      sessionId: session?.id || null,
      sessionStatus: session?.status || null,
      activeMission: session?.mission ? cloneSemanticValue(session.mission) : null,
      closurePredicateIds: cloneSemanticValue(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_CONTRACT_V022.closure_rule.required_predicate_ids),
    };
  }

  const SEMANTIC_DEFAULT_DIRECTION = configuredMissionProfileV670().direction;
  const SEMANTIC_DEFAULT_REMINDER = configuredMissionProfileV670().reminder;

  function semanticMissionProfileIdV678(sessionInput) {
    const session = sessionInput && typeof sessionInput === 'object' ? sessionInput : null;
    if (!session) return 'unknown';
    const schema = String(session.mission?.contract?.schema || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const direction = String(session.mission?.direction || '').trim();
    const reminder = String(session.mission?.reminder || '').trim();

    if (schema === String(MISSION_NEUTRAL_SCHEMA_CC01).toLowerCase()) return 'mission-neutral';
    if (schema === String(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V022).toLowerCase()) return 'resort-bootstrap-v2.2';
    if (schema === String(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V021).toLowerCase()) return 'resort-bootstrap-v2.1';
    if (schema === String(RESORT_BOOTSTRAP_MISSION_SCHEMA_V02).toLowerCase()) return 'resort-bootstrap-v2';
    if (REJECTED_LEGACY_MISSION_SCHEMAS_RESORT_V01.has(schema)) return 'legacy-rejected';
    if (schema || direction || reminder) return 'custom';
    return 'unknown';
  }

  function configuredMissionCompatibilityV678(sessionInput, options = {}) {
    const desired = 'mission-neutral';
    const actual = semanticMissionProfileIdV678(sessionInput);
    const allowUnknown = options.allowUnknown === true;
    const legacyRejected = actual === 'legacy-rejected';
    return {
      desired,
      actual,
      compatible: !legacyRejected && (actual !== 'unknown' || allowUnknown),
      preservesExplicitMission: actual === 'custom' || actual === 'mission-neutral' || actual === 'resort-bootstrap-v2' || actual === 'resort-bootstrap-v2.1' || actual === 'resort-bootstrap-v2.2',
      legacyRejected,
    };
  }

  async function applyConfiguredMissionProfileV670(options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    if (!session?.id) return { migrated: false, reason: 'no-semantic-session' };
    const profile = configuredMissionProfileV670();
    const missionCompatibilityV678 = configuredMissionCompatibilityV678(session, { allowUnknown: true });

    if (missionCompatibilityV678.legacyRejected && options.force !== true) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue('configuredMissionProfileV670', {
        schema: 'vibe-go-configured-mission-profile/v1',
        profile: profile.id,
        missionSchema: session.mission?.contract?.schema || null,
        sessionId: session.id,
        semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        appliedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        mode: 'legacy-mission-rejected',
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      return {
        migrated: false,
        rejected: true,
        reason: 'legacy-mission-authority-rejected',
        profile: profile.id,
        detectedProfile: missionCompatibilityV678.actual,
        missionSchema: session.mission?.contract?.schema || null,
        sessionId: session.id,
      };
    }

    if (profile.id === 'mission-neutral' && options.force !== true) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue('configuredMissionProfileV670', {
        schema: 'vibe-go-configured-mission-profile/v1',
        profile: profile.id,
        missionSchema: session.mission?.contract?.schema || null,
        missionRevision: session.mission?.contract?.revision || null,
        sessionId: session.id,
        semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        appliedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        mode: 'preserve-explicit-mission-authority',
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      return {
        migrated: false,
        reason: 'mission-neutral-preserves-explicit-authority',
        profile: profile.id,
        detectedProfile: missionCompatibilityV678.actual,
        sessionId: session.id,
      };
    }
    if (
      missionCompatibilityV678.actual !== 'unknown' &&
      missionCompatibilityV678.actual !== profile.id &&
      options.force !== true
    ) {
      return {
        migrated: false,
        reason: 'different-mission-authority',
        profile: profile.id,
        detectedProfile: missionCompatibilityV678.actual,
        sessionId: session.id,
      };
    }
    const alreadyCurrent =
      String(session.mission?.direction || '') === profile.direction &&
      String(session.mission?.reminder || '') === profile.reminder &&
      session.mission?.contract?.schema === profile.contract.schema &&
      session.mission?.contract?.revision === profile.contract.revision;
    if (alreadyCurrent) return { migrated: false, reason: 'already-current', profile: profile.id, sessionId: session.id };

    session.mission = {
      ...(session.mission || {}),
      direction: profile.direction,
      reminder: profile.reminder,
      contract: {
        ...cloneSemanticValue(profile.contract),
        appliedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      },
    };
    sourceInvalidateUnsentDispatch(session);
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    const saved = SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    replaceRuntimeStateValue('configuredMissionProfileV670', {
      schema: 'vibe-go-configured-mission-profile/v1',
      profile: profile.id,
      missionSchema: profile.schema,
      missionRevision: profile.revision,
      sessionId: saved.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(saved.revision || 0),
      appliedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return { migrated: true, profile: profile.id, sessionId: saved.id, semanticRevision: Number(saved.revision || 0) };
  }



  function cloneSemanticValue(value) {
    if (typeof structuredClone === 'function') {
      return structuredClone(value);
    }
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  }


  function semanticIsoNow() {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  }

  function semanticId(prefix) {
    return (
      `${prefix}:` +
      `${now().toString(36)}:` +
      `${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`
    );
  }

  function normalizeSemanticActivity(value, fallback = 'RECON') {
    const safeFallback = SEMANTIC_ACTIVITIES.includes(String(fallback || '').trim().toUpperCase())
      ? String(fallback).trim().toUpperCase()
      : 'RECON';
    const activity = String(value || safeFallback).trim().toUpperCase();
    // Activity is semantic context, not integrity-critical transport. Preserve
    // the existing/fallback activity when the model emits an unknown label.
    return SEMANTIC_ACTIVITIES.includes(activity) ? activity : safeFallback;
  }

  function normalizeSemanticAction(value) {
    const raw = String(value || 'CONTINUE').trim().toUpperCase();
    const action = raw.startsWith('VIBE_') ? raw.slice(5) : raw;
    if (!SEMANTIC_ACTIONS.includes(action)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown VIBE_STATE action: ${raw}`);
    }
    return action;
  }

  function normalizeSemanticRange(value) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return null;
    const start = Number(value.start ?? value.startOffset ?? value.startLine);
    const end = Number(value.end ?? value.endOffset ?? value.endLine);
    if (!Number.isFinite(start) || !Number.isFinite(end)) return null;
    return {
      start: Math.min(start, end),
      end: Math.max(start, end),
      label: String(value.label || '').trim(),
    };
  }

  function semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(cursorInput = {}) {
    const cursor = cursorInput && typeof cursorInput === 'object' ? cursorInput : {};
    return {
      workspaceId: cursor.workspaceId ?? null,
      baselineId: cursor.baselineId ?? null,
      baseline: cursor.baseline && typeof cursor.baseline === 'object'
        ? {
            id: cursor.baseline.id ?? null,
            name: cursor.baseline.name ?? null,
            sha256: cursor.baseline.sha256 ?? null,
            sizeChars: cursor.baseline.sizeChars ?? null,
            sizeBytes: cursor.baseline.sizeBytes ?? null,
          }
        : cursor.baseline ?? null,
      nextOffset: Number.isFinite(Number(cursor.nextOffset)) ? Number(cursor.nextOffset) : 0,
      activeRange: normalizeSemanticRange(cursor.activeRange),
      coveredThrough: cursor.coveredThrough ?? null,
      coveredRangeCount: Array.isArray(cursor.coveredRanges) ? cursor.coveredRanges.length : Number(cursor.coveredRangeCount || 0),
      relatedRangeCount: Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges) ? cursor.relatedRanges.length : Number(cursor.relatedRangeCount || 0),
      workingRevision: cursor.workingRevision ?? null,
      workspaceRevision: Number.isFinite(Number(cursor.workspaceRevision)) ? Number(cursor.workspaceRevision) : 0,
    };
  }

  const SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS = Object.freeze({
    notes: 240,
    decisions: 160,
    worklog: 120,
  });

  function semanticMemoryText(value, maxChars = 1800) {
    const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    const max = Math.max(240, Number(maxChars || 1800));
    return text.length <= max ? text : `${text.slice(0, max - 32)} … [clipped]`;
  }

  function semanticMemoryKey(value) {
    return semanticMemoryText(value, 4096).toLowerCase();
  }

  function semanticNoteMemoryKey(note) {
    return [
      String(note?.kind || 'finding').toLowerCase(),
      String(note?.distanceId || ''),
      semanticMemoryKey(note?.text || ''),
    ].join('::');
  }

  function semanticDecisionMemoryKey(decision) {
    return [
      String(decision?.distanceId || ''),
      semanticMemoryKey(decision?.text || ''),
    ].join('::');
  }

  function semanticWorklogHasEffects(item) {
    return Boolean(
      item?.workingRevisionId ||
      item?.workingIdentity ||
      item?.specOps ||
      (Array.isArray(item?.sourceNativeOps) && item.sourceNativeOps.length) ||
      (Array.isArray(item?.workspaceOps) && item.workspaceOps.length) ||
      (Array.isArray(item?.sourceIntelligenceOps) && item.sourceIntelligenceOps.length)
    );
  }

  function semanticWorklogMemoryKey(item) {
    return [
      String(item?.action || 'CONTINUE'),
      String(item?.activity || ''),
      String(item?.distanceId || ''),
      semanticMemoryKey(item?.summary || ''),
    ].join('::');
  }

  function semanticLedgerChronology(a, b) {
    const revisionDelta = Number(a?.revision || 0) - Number(b?.revision || 0);
    if (revisionDelta) return revisionDelta;
    return String(a?.createdAt || a?.at || '').localeCompare(String(b?.createdAt || b?.at || ''));
  }

  function compactSemanticNotes(session) {
    if (!session || !Array.isArray(session.notes)) return false;
    const before = JSON.stringify(session.notes);
    const byKey = new Map();
    for (const input of session.notes) {
      if (!input) continue;
      const item = cloneSemanticValue(input);
      item.text = semanticMemoryText(item.text, 1800);
      if (!item.text) continue;
      const key = semanticNoteMemoryKey(item);
      const previous = byKey.get(key);
      if (!previous) {
        byKey.set(key, item);
        continue;
      }
      // A repeated note refreshes the same promise/finding instead of creating a report row.
      previous.updatedAt = item.updatedAt || previous.updatedAt;
      previous.revision = Math.max(Number(previous.revision || 0), Number(item.revision || 0));
      if (item.status) previous.status = item.status;
      if (item.sourceRange) previous.sourceRange = cloneSemanticValue(item.sourceRange);
    }
    let items = [...byKey.values()].sort(semanticLedgerChronology);
    const max = SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.notes;
    if (items.length > max) {
      const open = items.filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved').slice(-max);
      const openIds = new Set(open.map(item => item.id));
      const room = Math.max(0, max - open.length);
      // Array.prototype.slice(-0) is slice(0), i.e. the whole array. When open notes
      // already consume the complete budget, resolved history must contribute zero rows.
      const resolvedPool = items.filter(item => item.status === 'resolved' && !openIds.has(item.id));
      const resolved = room > 0 ? resolvedPool.slice(-room) : [];
      items = [...resolved, ...open].sort(semanticLedgerChronology);
    }
    session.notes = items;
    return before !== JSON.stringify(items);
  }

  function compactSemanticDecisions(session) {
    if (!session || !Array.isArray(session.decisions)) return false;
    const before = JSON.stringify(session.decisions);
    const byKey = new Map();
    for (const input of session.decisions) {
      if (!input) continue;
      const item = cloneSemanticValue(input);
      item.text = semanticMemoryText(item.text, 1800);
      item.reason = semanticMemoryText(item.reason, 900);
      if (!item.text) continue;
      const key = semanticDecisionMemoryKey(item);
      const previous = byKey.get(key);
      if (!previous) {
        byKey.set(key, item);
        continue;
      }
      // Keep one durable decision; a later repetition may enrich its reason.
      previous.revision = Math.max(Number(previous.revision || 0), Number(item.revision || 0));
      if (item.reason) previous.reason = item.reason;
      if (item.createdAt && (!previous.createdAt || item.createdAt > previous.createdAt)) {
        previous.createdAt = item.createdAt;
      }
    }
    let items = [...byKey.values()].sort(semanticLedgerChronology);
    if (items.length > SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.decisions) {
      items = items.slice(-SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.decisions);
    }
    session.decisions = items;
    return before !== JSON.stringify(items);
  }

  function compactSemanticWorklog(session) {
    if (!session || !Array.isArray(session.worklog)) return false;
    const before = JSON.stringify(session.worklog);
    const items = [];
    for (const input of session.worklog) {
      if (!input) continue;
      const item = cloneSemanticValue(input);
      item.summary = semanticMemoryText(item.summary, 1600);
      if (item.sourceCursor && typeof item.sourceCursor === 'object') {
        item.sourceCursor = semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(item.sourceCursor);
      }
      // nextFocus is advisory route memory. Keeping it in every history row only duplicates state.
      delete item.nextFocus;
      if (Array.isArray(item.workspaceOps)) {
        item.workspaceOps = item.workspaceOps.map(result => ({
          op: String(result?.op || ''),
          ok: result?.ok !== false,
        }));
      }
      if (Array.isArray(item.sourceIntelligenceOps)) {
        item.sourceIntelligenceOps = item.sourceIntelligenceOps.map(result => ({
          op: String(result?.op || ''),
          ok: result?.ok !== false,
          ...(result?.error ? { error: semanticMemoryText(result.error, 500) } : {}),
          ...(result?.resultId ? { resultId: String(result.resultId) } : {}),
          ...(Number.isFinite(Number(result?.candidateCount)) ? { candidateCount: Number(result.candidateCount) } : {}),
          ...(result?.space ? { space: String(result.space) } : {}),
          ...(Number.isFinite(Number(result?.start)) ? { start: Number(result.start) } : {}),
          ...(Number.isFinite(Number(result?.end)) ? { end: Number(result.end) } : {}),
          ...(Number.isFinite(Number(result?.workingStart)) ? { workingStart: Number(result.workingStart) } : {}),
          ...(Number.isFinite(Number(result?.workingEnd)) ? { workingEnd: Number(result.workingEnd) } : {}),
        }));
      }
      if (item.sourceAuthorityPreflight && typeof item.sourceAuthorityPreflight === 'object') {
        const value = item.sourceAuthorityPreflight;
        item.sourceAuthorityPreflight = {
          beforeWorkingSequence: Number(value.before?.workingSequence || value.beforeWorkingSequence || 0),
          currentWorkingSequence: Number(value.current?.workingSequence || value.currentWorkingSequence || 0),
          localPromoted: Boolean(value.localPromoted),
          reconciled: Boolean(value.reconciled),
        };
      }

      const effects = semanticWorklogHasEffects(item);
      const isStructuralAction = !['CONTINUE', 'NOTE_ADDED'].includes(String(item.action || 'CONTINUE'));
      const hasSummary = Boolean(item.summary);
      const previous = items.at(-1) || null;

      // A pure transport turn with no semantic/source effect is not an engineering worklog event.
      if (!effects && !isStructuralAction && !hasSummary) continue;

      const duplicate = previous && !effects && !semanticWorklogHasEffects(previous) &&
        semanticWorklogMemoryKey(previous) === semanticWorklogMemoryKey(item);
      if (duplicate) {
        previous.revision = Math.max(Number(previous.revision || 0), Number(item.revision || 0));
        previous.at = item.at || previous.at;
        previous.sourceCursor = item.sourceCursor || previous.sourceCursor;
        previous.repeatCount = Number(previous.repeatCount || 1) + 1;
        continue;
      }
      items.push(item);
    }
    if (items.length > SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.worklog) {
      items.splice(0, items.length - SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.worklog);
    }
    session.worklog = items;
    return before !== JSON.stringify(items);
  }

  function compactSemanticLedger(session) {
    if (!session) return false;
    const notes = compactSemanticNotes(session);
    const decisions = compactSemanticDecisions(session);
    const worklog = compactSemanticWorklog(session);
    return notes || decisions || worklog;
  }

  function compactSemanticWorklogHistory(session) {
    // Compatibility name retained for persisted v6.3/v6.4 sessions. Hydration now
    // compacts the complete semantic ledger, not only large cursor snapshots.
    return compactSemanticLedger(session);
  }

  const STRATEGIC_FRONTIER_SCHEMA_V690 = 'vibe-go-strategic-frontier/v1';
  const SEMANTIC_AGENCY_SCHEMA_V690 = 'vibe-go-semantic-agency/v1';
  const STRATEGIC_FRONTIER_MAX_FRONTS_V690 = 12;
  const STRATEGIC_POSTURES_V690 = new Set(['EXPLORE', 'CONSOLIDATE', 'EXECUTE', 'VALIDATE', 'ARCHITECT']);

  function normalizeStrategicPostureV690(value, fallback = 'EXPLORE') {
    const normalized = String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    return STRATEGIC_POSTURES_V690.has(normalized) ? normalized : fallback;
  }

  function normalizeStrategicFrontV690(input = {}, ordinal = 0) {
    const frontId = String(input.frontId || input.front_id || input.id || `front-${ordinal + 1}`).trim();
    const status = String(input.status || 'OPEN').trim().toUpperCase();
    const coarse = value => {
      const v = String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      return ['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH'].includes(v) ? v : null;
    };
    return {
      frontId,
      title: semanticMemoryText(input.title || input.name || frontId, 220),
      objective: semanticMemoryText(input.objective || '', 700),
      status,
      informationGain: coarse(input.informationGain || input.expected_information_gain),
      leverage: coarse(input.leverage || input.expected_leverage),
      mechanicality: coarse(input.mechanicality),
      blockingValue: coarse(input.blockingValue || input.blocking_value),
      cost: coarse(input.cost || input.estimated_cost),
      relatedDistanceIds: [...new Set((Array.isArray(input.relatedDistanceIds)
        ? input.relatedDistanceIds
        : Array.isArray(input.related_distance_ids) ? input.related_distance_ids : [])
        .map(value => String(value || '').trim()).filter(Boolean))].slice(0, 12),
      rationale: semanticMemoryText(input.rationale || '', 700),
      provenance: String(input.provenance || 'AI_ASSESSMENT').trim().toUpperCase(),
      updatedAt: input.updatedAt || null,
    };
  }

  function ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session) {
    if (!session || typeof session !== 'object') return session;
    session.route ||= {};
    const legacyFocus = String(session.route.tacticalFocus ?? session.route.nextFocus ?? '').trim();
    session.route.tacticalFocus = legacyFocus;
    // nextFocus remains a compatibility alias during A09 CUT 1 because evidence
    // relevance and scheduler snapshots still consume it throughout the runner.
    session.route.nextFocus = legacyFocus;

    const existing = session.strategicFrontier && typeof session.strategicFrontier === 'object'
      ? session.strategicFrontier
      : {};
    const normalizedFronts = (Array.isArray(existing.fronts) ? existing.fronts : [])
      .slice(0, STRATEGIC_FRONTIER_MAX_FRONTS_V690)
      .map((front, index) => normalizeStrategicFrontV690(front, index));
    session.strategicFrontier = {
      schema: STRATEGIC_FRONTIER_SCHEMA_V690,
      activeTheory: semanticMemoryText(existing.activeTheory || '', 1200),
      posture: normalizeStrategicPostureV690(existing.posture || 'EXPLORE'),
      strategyReminder: semanticMemoryText(
        existing.strategyReminder ||
        'Tactical focus is advisory. Optimize Mission progress; prefer batch/tooling or abstraction shifts when they have higher leverage.',
        900
      ),
      fronts: normalizedFronts,
      provenance: String(existing.provenance || 'AI_ASSESSMENT').trim().toUpperCase(),
      reviewRationale: semanticMemoryText(existing.reviewRationale || '', 700),
      reviewRevision: Math.max(0, Number(existing.reviewRevision || 0)),
      reviewAcceptanceSequenceV704: Math.max(0, Number(existing.reviewAcceptanceSequenceV704 || 0)),
      reviewWorkingIdentityV705: existing.reviewWorkingIdentityV705 || null,
      reviewWorkingCharsV705: Math.max(0, Number(existing.reviewWorkingCharsV705 || 0)),
      reviewedAt: existing.reviewedAt || null,
      updatedAt: existing.updatedAt || null,
    };
    return session;
  }

  function applyStrategicFrontierPatchV690(session, patchInput = {}, revision = 0, timestamp = semanticIsoNow()) {
    ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session);
    const patch = patchInput && typeof patchInput === 'object' ? patchInput : {};
    const frontier = session.strategicFrontier;
    let changed = false;

    if ('activeTheory' in patch) {
      const value = semanticMemoryText(patch.activeTheory || '', 1200);
      if (value !== frontier.activeTheory) { frontier.activeTheory = value; changed = true; }
    }
    if ('posture' in patch) {
      const value = normalizeStrategicPostureV690(patch.posture, frontier.posture);
      if (value !== frontier.posture) { frontier.posture = value; changed = true; }
    }
    if ('strategyReminder' in patch) {
      const value = semanticMemoryText(patch.strategyReminder || '', 900);
      if (value !== frontier.strategyReminder) { frontier.strategyReminder = value; changed = true; }
    }
    if ('provenance' in patch) {
      const value = String(patch.provenance || 'AI_ASSESSMENT').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (value !== frontier.provenance) { frontier.provenance = value; changed = true; }
    }
    if ('reviewRationale' in patch || 'rationale' in patch) {
      const value = semanticMemoryText(patch.reviewRationale ?? patch.rationale ?? '', 700);
      if (value !== frontier.reviewRationale) { frontier.reviewRationale = value; changed = true; }
    }
    const frontComparableV690 = front => ({ ...front, updatedAt: null });
    if (Array.isArray(patch.fronts)) {
      const value = patch.fronts.slice(0, STRATEGIC_FRONTIER_MAX_FRONTS_V690)
        .map((front, index) => normalizeStrategicFrontV690(front, index));
      const comparableNext = value.map(frontComparableV690);
      const comparablePrevious = frontier.fronts.map(frontComparableV690);
      if (JSON.stringify(comparableNext) !== JSON.stringify(comparablePrevious)) {
        frontier.fronts = value.map(front => ({ ...front, updatedAt: front.updatedAt || timestamp }));
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (Array.isArray(patch.upsertFronts)) {
      const byId = new Map(frontier.fronts.map(front => [front.frontId, front]));
      patch.upsertFronts.forEach((raw, index) => {
        const next = normalizeStrategicFrontV690(raw, index);
        const previous = byId.get(next.frontId) || null;
        if (!previous) {
          byId.set(next.frontId, { ...next, updatedAt: next.updatedAt || timestamp });
          changed = true;
          return;
        }
        if (JSON.stringify(frontComparableV690(previous)) !== JSON.stringify(frontComparableV690(next))) {
          byId.set(next.frontId, { ...next, updatedAt: timestamp });
          changed = true;
        }
      });
      frontier.fronts = [...byId.values()].slice(-STRATEGIC_FRONTIER_MAX_FRONTS_V690);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(patch.closeFrontIds)) {
      const closeSet = new Set(patch.closeFrontIds.map(value => String(value || '').trim()).filter(Boolean));
      frontier.fronts = frontier.fronts.map(front => {
        if (!closeSet.has(front.frontId) || front.status === 'CLOSED') return front;
        changed = true;
        return { ...front, status: 'CLOSED', updatedAt: timestamp };
      });
    }

    if (changed || patch.reviewed === true) {
      frontier.reviewRevision = Math.max(0, Number(revision || session.revision || 0));
      frontier.reviewAcceptanceSequenceV704 = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
      try {
        const materializedV705 = sourceRuntime.workspace ? WorkingSource.materialize() : null;
        frontier.reviewWorkingIdentityV705 = sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || materializedV705?.identity || null;
        frontier.reviewWorkingCharsV705 = Math.max(0, Number(materializedV705?.text?.length || 0));
      } catch {
        frontier.reviewWorkingIdentityV705 ||= null;
        frontier.reviewWorkingCharsV705 = Math.max(0, Number(frontier.reviewWorkingCharsV705 || 0));
      }
      frontier.reviewedAt = timestamp;
      frontier.updatedAt = timestamp;
    }
    return changed || patch.reviewed === true;
  }

  function primaryDonorNumberFromTextV690(value) {
    const match = String(value || '').match(/\bD0*(\d{1,6})\b/i);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : null;
  }

  function detectSemanticAntiTunnelV690(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.peek?.() || null;
    if (!session) return { schema: SEMANTIC_AGENCY_SCHEMA_V690, active: false, reviewDue: false, reasons: [] };
    ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session);
    const rows = (Array.isArray(session.worklog) ? session.worklog : []).slice(-8);
    let capsuleOps = 0;
    let writeMetaOps = 0;
    let projectRows = 0;
    let residualMentions = 0;
    let sourceIntelOps = 0;
    let sourceZeroResultOps = 0;
    let sourceSurfaceOps = 0;
    let sourceMutationRows = 0;
    const sourceHistoryV703 = (Array.isArray(session.transport?.sourceIntelligenceHistoryV703)
      ? session.transport.sourceIntelligenceHistoryV703
      : []).slice(-8);
    const sourceHistoryHasEvidenceV703 = sourceHistoryV703.length > 0;
    const primaryDonors = [];
    for (const row of rows) {
      const ops = Array.isArray(row?.projectDataOpsV670) ? row.projectDataOpsV670 : [];
      if (ops.length) projectRows += 1;
      capsuleOps += ops.filter(item => String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase() === 'GET_CAPSULE').length;
      writeMetaOps += ops.filter(item => String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase() === 'WRITE_DONOR_META').length;
      if (!sourceHistoryHasEvidenceV703) {
        const sourceOps = Array.isArray(row?.sourceIntelligenceOps) ? row.sourceIntelligenceOps : [];
        sourceIntelOps += sourceOps.length;
        sourceZeroResultOps += sourceOps.filter(item => ['SEARCH','QUERY','PROBE'].includes(String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase()) && Number(item?.candidateCount || 0) === 0).length;
        sourceSurfaceOps += sourceOps.filter(item => ['SURFACE_CANDIDATE','READ_RANGE','SURFACE_RANGE'].includes(String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase())).length;
      }
      if (row?.workingRevisionId || row?.artifactEffect === 'SOURCE_MUTATION') sourceMutationRows += 1;
      const summary = String(row?.summary || '');
      if (/residual[- ]authority|residual pocket|residual-authority pocket/i.test(summary)) residualMentions += 1;
      const donor = primaryDonorNumberFromTextV690(summary);
      if (Number.isFinite(donor)) primaryDonors.push(donor);
    }

    if (sourceHistoryHasEvidenceV703) {
      for (const batch of sourceHistoryV703) {
        const sourceOps = Array.isArray(batch?.results) ? batch.results : [];
        sourceIntelOps += sourceOps.length;
        sourceZeroResultOps += sourceOps.filter(item => ['SEARCH','QUERY','PROBE'].includes(String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase()) && Number(item?.candidateCount || 0) === 0).length;
        sourceSurfaceOps += sourceOps.filter(item => ['SURFACE_CANDIDATE','READ_RANGE','SURFACE_RANGE'].includes(String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase())).length;
      }
    }

    let sequentialSteps = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < primaryDonors.length; i += 1) {
      const delta = primaryDonors[i] - primaryDonors[i - 1];
      if (delta >= 0 && delta <= 6) sequentialSteps += 1;
    }
    const sequentialRatio = primaryDonors.length > 1 ? sequentialSteps / (primaryDonors.length - 1) : 0;
    const reasons = [];
    const reviewedAtMsV705 = Date.parse(String(session.strategicFrontier?.reviewedAt || ''));
    const sealedSinceReviewV705 = Object.values(session.distances || {}).filter(distance => {
      if (String(distance?.status || '') !== 'sealed') return false;
      const sealedAtMs = Date.parse(String(distance?.sealedAt || ''));
      return !Number.isFinite(reviewedAtMsV705) || (Number.isFinite(sealedAtMs) && sealedAtMs > reviewedAtMsV705);
    }).length;
    let currentWorkingCharsV705 = 0;
    let currentWorkingIdentityV705 = null;
    try {
      const materializedV705 = sourceRuntime.workspace ? WorkingSource.materialize() : null;
      currentWorkingCharsV705 = Math.max(0, Number(materializedV705?.text?.length || 0));
      currentWorkingIdentityV705 = sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || materializedV705?.identity || null;
    } catch {}
    const reviewedWorkingCharsV705 = Math.max(0, Number(session.strategicFrontier?.reviewWorkingCharsV705 || 0));
    const reviewedWorkingIdentityV705 = session.strategicFrontier?.reviewWorkingIdentityV705 || null;
    const materialGrowthV705 = reviewedWorkingCharsV705 > 0
      ? currentWorkingCharsV705 - reviewedWorkingCharsV705
      : currentWorkingCharsV705;
    if (projectRows >= 3 && capsuleOps >= 7) reasons.push(`repeated GET_CAPSULE loop (${capsuleOps} capsule requests across ${projectRows} recent project-data turns)`);
    if (primaryDonors.length >= 4 && sequentialRatio >= 0.66) reasons.push(`repeated sequential donor traversal (${primaryDonors.slice(-6).map(value => `D${String(value).padStart(6, '0')}`).join(' → ')})`);
    if (residualMentions >= 3) reasons.push(`repeated residual-authority deferral (${residualMentions} recent turns)`);
    if (writeMetaOps >= 3 && capsuleOps >= 4) reasons.push(`repeated capsule-to-semantic-closure pattern (${writeMetaOps} WRITE_DONOR_META ops)`);
    if (sourceIntelOps >= 8 && sourceMutationRows === 0) reasons.push(`source-navigation loop without source mutation (${sourceIntelOps} source-intelligence ops across ${rows.length} recent semantic rows)`);
    if (sourceZeroResultOps >= 4) reasons.push(`repeated zero-result source search (${sourceZeroResultOps} SEARCH/QUERY/PROBE misses; search/index absence is non-authoritative)`);
    if (sourceSurfaceOps >= 4 && sourceMutationRows === 0) reasons.push(`repeated source surfacing without engineering mutation (${sourceSurfaceOps} surface/read ops)`);
    if (sealedSinceReviewV705 >= 5) reasons.push(`strategic review debt (${sealedSinceReviewV705} Distances sealed since the last recorded review)`);
    if (
      currentWorkingCharsV705 >= 250000 &&
      (
        !reviewedWorkingIdentityV705 ||
        (currentWorkingIdentityV705 !== reviewedWorkingIdentityV705 && materialGrowthV705 >= Math.max(100000, Math.floor(reviewedWorkingCharsV705 * 0.25)))
      )
    ) {
      reasons.push(`material Working growth requires architecture review (${currentWorkingCharsV705} chars; last reviewed ${reviewedWorkingCharsV705 || 0})`);
    }

    const active = reasons.length > 0;
    const reviewRevision = Number(session.strategicFrontier?.reviewRevision || 0);
    const reviewAcceptanceSequenceV704 = Number(session.strategicFrontier?.reviewAcceptanceSequenceV704 || 0);
    const currentAcceptanceSequenceV704 = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const reviewDue = active && currentAcceptanceSequenceV704 - reviewAcceptanceSequenceV704 >= 3;
    return {
      schema: SEMANTIC_AGENCY_SCHEMA_V690,
      active,
      reviewDue,
      reasons,
      observedTurns: rows.length,
      capsuleOps,
      writeMetaOps,
      residualMentions,
      sourceIntelOps,
      sourceZeroResultOps,
      sourceSurfaceOps,
      sourceMutationRows,
      sealedSinceReviewV705,
      currentWorkingCharsV705,
      reviewedWorkingCharsV705,
      currentWorkingIdentityV705,
      reviewedWorkingIdentityV705,
      primaryDonors: primaryDonors.slice(-8),
      reviewRevision,
      reviewAcceptanceSequenceV704,
      currentAcceptanceSequenceV704,
      currentRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
    };
  }

  function buildSemanticAgencyDispatchLinesV690(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.peek?.() || null;
    if (!session) return [];
    ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session);
    const frontier = session.strategicFrontier;
    const openFronts = frontier.fronts.filter(front => !['CLOSED', 'SEALED', 'SUPERSEDED'].includes(String(front.status || '').toUpperCase()));
    const antiTunnel = detectSemanticAntiTunnelV690(session);
    const lines = [
      'AGENCY · SEMANTIC FREEDOM',
      'TACTICAL FOCUS is advisory, not route authority. Optimize Mission progress rather than cursor progress.',
      'You may DEEPEN, REDIRECT, branch, batch, author/reuse analyzers, or change abstraction level when expected leverage is higher.',
      'Repeated mechanically decidable work should become tooling/batch analysis; preserve unresolved branches and explicit return contracts.',
      'Choose qualitatively by INFORMATION_GAIN / LEVERAGE / MECHANICALITY / BLOCKING_VALUE / COST; no numeric optimizer is required and source adjacency is not strategy authority.',
      `STRATEGIC FRONTIER · ${frontier.posture}`,
    ];
    if (frontier.activeTheory) lines.push(`THEORY: ${semanticClipText(frontier.activeTheory, 700)}`);
    if (frontier.strategyReminder) lines.push(`REMINDER: ${semanticClipText(frontier.strategyReminder, 650)}`);
    if (openFronts.length) {
      lines.push(`FRONTS: ${openFronts.slice(0, 5).map(front => `${front.frontId}=${front.title}${front.status && front.status !== 'OPEN' ? `(${front.status})` : ''}`).join(' · ')}`);
    }
    if (antiTunnel.reviewDue) {
      lines.push(
        'STRATEGY CHECK · repeated low-leverage local pattern detected.',
        ...antiTunnel.reasons.slice(0, 3).map(reason => `- ${reason}`),
        'Before continuing manually, assess whether semantic proof is already closed. If proof is closed but acceptance/integration housekeeping remains, seal the current Distance and emit nextDistance for that dependent engineering/validation debt instead of keeping semantic uncertainty open. Otherwise prefer tooling/batch/structural source navigation/another semantic plane when it has higher information gain. Sequential continuation remains allowed only when it still adds evidence.'
      );
    }
    return lines;
  }

  function validateSemanticSession(session) {
    if (!session || session.schema !== SEMANTIC_SESSION_SCHEMA) {
      throw new Error('Unsupported or missing semantic session');
    }
    if (!session.id || !Number.isInteger(Number(session.revision))) {
      throw new Error('Semantic session identity is damaged');
    }
    if (!session.distances || typeof session.distances !== 'object') {
      throw new Error('Semantic distance map is missing');
    }
    if (!session.route || !Array.isArray(session.route.deepeningStack)) {
      throw new Error('Semantic route is damaged');
    }
    normalizeSemanticActivity(session.route.activity);
    if (!Array.isArray(session.notes) || !Array.isArray(session.worklog)) {
      throw new Error('Semantic notes/worklog are missing');
    }
    return true;
  }

  function semanticPersistenceEntityKey(sessionId, kind, value, ordinal = 0) {
    const explicitId = String(value?.id || value?.distanceId || '').trim();
    if (explicitId) return `${sessionId}::${kind}::${explicitId}`;
    const fallback = hashText(JSON.stringify(value ?? null));
    return `${sessionId}::${kind}::legacy-${ordinal}-${fallback}`;
  }

  function semanticRecordFingerprint(value) {
    return hashText(JSON.stringify(value ?? null));
  }

  function semanticSessionToPersistenceRecords(sessionInput) {
    const session = persistenceClone(sessionInput);
    validateSemanticSession(session);
    const sessionId = String(session.id);

    const head = persistenceClone(session);
    delete head.distances;
    delete head.sourceCursor;
    delete head.notes;
    delete head.decisions;
    delete head.worklog;
    delete head.transport;

    const transport = persistenceClone(session.transport || {});
    const pendingDispatch = transport.pendingDispatch || null;
    delete transport.pendingDispatch;

    const cursor = persistenceClone(session.sourceCursor || {});
    const relatedRanges = Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges)
      ? cursor.relatedRanges
      : [];
    delete cursor.relatedRanges;

    const mapItems = (items, kind) => (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).map((value, ordinal) => ({
      key: semanticPersistenceEntityKey(sessionId, kind, value, ordinal),
      sessionId,
      ordinal,
      value: persistenceClone(value),
    }));

    return {
      semanticSessions: [{ id: sessionId, value: head }],
      semanticTransport: [{ sessionId, value: transport }],
      semanticCursors: [{ sessionId, value: cursor }],
      semanticPendingDispatch: pendingDispatch
        ? [{ sessionId, value: persistenceClone(pendingDispatch) }]
        : [],
      semanticDistances: Object.values(session.distances || {}).map((value, ordinal) => ({
        key: semanticPersistenceEntityKey(sessionId, 'distance', value, ordinal),
        sessionId,
        ordinal,
        value: persistenceClone(value),
      })),
      semanticRelatedRanges: mapItems(relatedRanges, 'related-range'),
      semanticNotes: mapItems(session.notes, 'note'),
      semanticDecisions: mapItems(session.decisions, 'decision'),
      semanticWorklog: mapItems(session.worklog, 'worklog'),
    };
  }

  function semanticPersistenceIndexFromRecords(records) {
    const record = records.semanticSessions?.[0] || null;
    const sessionId = String(record?.id || '');
    const fingerprints = name => new Map(
      (records[name] || []).map(item => [item.key, semanticRecordFingerprint(item.value)])
    );
    const keys = name => new Set((records[name] || []).map(item => item.key));
    return {
      sessionId,
      distances: fingerprints('semanticDistances'),
      relatedRanges: fingerprints('semanticRelatedRanges'),
      notes: fingerprints('semanticNotes'),
      decisions: fingerprints('semanticDecisions'),
      worklog: fingerprints('semanticWorklog'),
    };
  }

  function sortSemanticRecords(records) {
    return [...(records || [])].sort((a, b) => Number(a.ordinal || 0) - Number(b.ordinal || 0));
  }

  function normalizeProtocolCargoV649(sessionInput) {
    const session = persistenceClone(sessionInput);
    if (!session || typeof session !== 'object') return session;
    session.transport ||= {};
    const operatorControl = session.transport.operatorControl;
    if (operatorControl && typeof operatorControl === 'object') {
      // a49: supersededDispatch was historical write-only telemetry. It never
      // participated in resend/admission authority; in-flight/pending authority
      // is represented by pendingDispatch + operatorControl.inFlightDispatch.
      delete operatorControl.supersededDispatch;
    }
    return session;
  }

  function reconstructSemanticSessionFromRecords(records, sessionId = null) {
    const headRecord = sessionId
      ? (records.semanticSessions || []).find(item => String(item.id) === String(sessionId))
      : (records.semanticSessions || [])[0];
    if (!headRecord?.value) return null;
    const id = String(headRecord.id);
    const transportRecord = (records.semanticTransport || []).find(item => String(item.sessionId) === id);
    const cursorRecord = (records.semanticCursors || []).find(item => String(item.sessionId) === id);
    const pendingRecord = (records.semanticPendingDispatch || []).find(item => String(item.sessionId) === id);
    const forSession = name => sortSemanticRecords(
      (records[name] || []).filter(item => String(item.sessionId) === id)
    );
    const distances = {};
    for (const record of forSession('semanticDistances')) {
      if (record.value?.id) distances[String(record.value.id)] = persistenceClone(record.value);
    }
    const session = {
      ...persistenceClone(headRecord.value),
      distances,
      sourceCursor: {
        ...(persistenceClone(cursorRecord?.value) || {}),
        relatedRanges: forSession('semanticRelatedRanges').map(item => persistenceClone(item.value)),
      },
      notes: forSession('semanticNotes').map(item => persistenceClone(item.value)),
      decisions: forSession('semanticDecisions').map(item => persistenceClone(item.value)),
      worklog: forSession('semanticWorklog').map(item => persistenceClone(item.value)),
      transport: {
        ...(persistenceClone(transportRecord?.value) || {}),
        pendingDispatch: pendingRecord?.value ? persistenceClone(pendingRecord.value) : null,
      },
    };
    // a48: make the a45 transport-sequence axis explicit after persistence restore.
    // Legacy sessions may have neither transport.acceptanceSequence nor a sequence
    // on lastControl; semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645() intentionally falls
    // back to the monotonic semantic head in that case. Persisting the normalized
    // value on the reconstructed object prevents repeated legacy ambiguity while
    // preserving historical controls verbatim.
    session.transport ||= {};
    session.transport.acceptanceSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const normalizedV649 = normalizeProtocolCargoV649(session);
    ensureSemanticAgencyV690(normalizedV649);
    validateSemanticSession(normalizedV649);
    return normalizedV649;
  }

  async function readSemanticSessionRecordsFromRuntimeDb(sessionId) {
    const id = String(sessionId || '');
    if (!id) return { session: null, records: null, index: null };
    const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
    const stores = [...RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_STORE_NAMES];
    const transaction = database.transaction(stores, 'readonly');
    const getOne = (name, key) => runtimeRequest(transaction.objectStore(name).get(key));
    const getMany = name => {
      const index = transaction.objectStore(name).index('sessionId');
      return typeof index.getAll === 'function'
        ? runtimeRequest(index.getAll(IDBKeyRange.only(id)))
        : runtimeDbGetAllBySession(name, id);
    };
    const [head, transport, cursor, pending, distances, ranges, notes, decisions, worklog] = await Promise.all([
      getOne('semanticSessions', id),
      getOne('semanticTransport', id),
      getOne('semanticCursors', id),
      getOne('semanticPendingDispatch', id),
      getMany('semanticDistances'),
      getMany('semanticRelatedRanges'),
      getMany('semanticNotes'),
      getMany('semanticDecisions'),
      getMany('semanticWorklog'),
    ]);
    const records = {
      semanticSessions: head ? [head] : [],
      semanticTransport: transport ? [transport] : [],
      semanticCursors: cursor ? [cursor] : [],
      semanticPendingDispatch: pending ? [pending] : [],
      semanticDistances: distances || [],
      semanticRelatedRanges: ranges || [],
      semanticNotes: notes || [],
      semanticDecisions: decisions || [],
      semanticWorklog: worklog || [],
    };
    const session = reconstructSemanticSessionFromRecords(records, id);
    return {
      session,
      records,
      index: session ? semanticPersistenceIndexFromRecords(records) : null,
    };
  }

  function semanticChangedRecordPlan(name, nextRows, committedMap, { immutable = false } = {}) {
    const nextMap = new Map((nextRows || []).map(item => [item.key, item]));
    const puts = [];
    const deletes = [];
    for (const [key, item] of nextMap) {
      if (!committedMap?.has(key)) {
        puts.push(item);
        continue;
      }
      if (!immutable) {
        const fingerprint = semanticRecordFingerprint(item.value);
        if (committedMap.get(key) !== fingerprint) puts.push(item);
      }
    }
    if (committedMap) {
      for (const key of committedMap.keys()) {
        if (!nextMap.has(key)) deletes.push(key);
      }
    }
    return { name, puts, deletes };
  }

  async function persistSemanticSessionSnapshot(database, session) {
    const records = semanticSessionToPersistenceRecords(session);
    const committed = runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex;
    const sameSession = committed?.sessionId === String(session.id);
    const plans = [
      semanticChangedRecordPlan(
        'semanticDistances', records.semanticDistances, sameSession ? committed.distances : null
      ),
      semanticChangedRecordPlan(
        'semanticRelatedRanges', records.semanticRelatedRanges, sameSession ? committed.relatedRanges : null
      ),
      semanticChangedRecordPlan(
        'semanticNotes', records.semanticNotes, sameSession ? committed.notes : null
      ),
      semanticChangedRecordPlan(
        'semanticDecisions', records.semanticDecisions, sameSession ? committed.decisions : null
      ),
      semanticChangedRecordPlan(
        'semanticWorklog', records.semanticWorklog, sameSession ? committed.worklog : null
      ),
    ];
    const transaction = database.transaction(
      [RUNTIME_STATE_STORE, ...RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_STORE_NAMES],
      'readwrite'
    );
    const doneV616 = runtimeTransactionDone(transaction);
    try {
      await requireSemanticRuntimeLeaseInTransactionV616(transaction, () => {
      transaction.objectStore('semanticSessions').put(records.semanticSessions[0]);
      transaction.objectStore('semanticTransport').put(records.semanticTransport[0]);
      transaction.objectStore('semanticCursors').put(records.semanticCursors[0]);
      const pendingStore = transaction.objectStore('semanticPendingDispatch');
      if (records.semanticPendingDispatch[0]) pendingStore.put(records.semanticPendingDispatch[0]);
      else pendingStore.delete(String(session.id));
      for (const plan of plans) {
        const store = transaction.objectStore(plan.name);
        for (const key of plan.deletes) store.delete(key);
        for (const item of plan.puts) store.put(item);
      }
      transaction.objectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE).put({
        key: 'semanticActiveSessionId',
        value: String(session.id),
        updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
      });
    } catch (error) {
      // a19: requireSemanticRuntimeLeaseInTransactionV616 aborts the transaction
      // on lease loss. Drain the transaction completion promise before rethrowing
      // so the abort cannot surface as an unrelated unhandled rejection.
      await doneV616.catch(() => undefined);
      throw error;
    }
    await doneV616;
    runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex = semanticPersistenceIndexFromRecords(records);
    runtimePersistence.runtimeState.set('semanticActiveSessionId', String(session.id));
  }

  function scheduleSemanticSessionPersistence() {
    if (runtimePersistence.semanticWriterScheduled) return;
    runtimePersistence.semanticWriterScheduled = true;
    enqueueRuntimeWrite('semantic-session', async database => {
      try {
        while (runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession) {
          const snapshot = runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession;
          runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession = null;
          await persistSemanticSessionSnapshot(database, snapshot);
        }
      } finally {
        runtimePersistence.semanticWriterScheduled = false;
        if (runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession) {
          scheduleSemanticSessionPersistence();
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function queueSemanticSessionDelete(sessionId, committedIndex = runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex) {
    const id = String(sessionId || '');
    if (!id) return;
    runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession = null;
    enqueueRuntimeWrite('semantic-session', async database => {
      const transaction = database.transaction(
        [RUNTIME_STATE_STORE, ...RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_STORE_NAMES],
        'readwrite'
      );
      const doneV616 = runtimeTransactionDone(transaction);
      try {
        await requireSemanticRuntimeLeaseInTransactionV616(transaction, () => {
      transaction.objectStore('semanticSessions').delete(id);
      transaction.objectStore('semanticTransport').delete(id);
      transaction.objectStore('semanticCursors').delete(id);
      transaction.objectStore('semanticPendingDispatch').delete(id);
      const keyed = [
        ['semanticDistances', committedIndex?.distances],
        ['semanticRelatedRanges', committedIndex?.relatedRanges],
        ['semanticNotes', committedIndex?.notes],
        ['semanticDecisions', committedIndex?.decisions],
        ['semanticWorklog', committedIndex?.worklog],
      ];
      for (const [name, keys] of keyed) {
        const store = transaction.objectStore(name);
        for (const key of keys?.keys?.() || []) store.delete(key);
      }
      const activeNow = runtimePersistence.semanticSession?.id || null;
      if (activeNow && String(activeNow) !== id) {
        transaction.objectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE).put({
          key: 'semanticActiveSessionId',
          value: String(activeNow),
          updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        });
      } else {
        transaction.objectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE).delete('semanticActiveSessionId');
      }
        });
      } catch (error) {
        await doneV616.catch(() => undefined);
        throw error;
      }
      await doneV616;
      if (runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex?.sessionId === id) {
        runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex = null;
      }
      if (activeNow && String(activeNow) !== id) {
        runtimePersistence.runtimeState.set('semanticActiveSessionId', String(activeNow));
      } else {
        runtimePersistence.runtimeState.delete('semanticActiveSessionId');
      }
    });
  }

  async function consumeLegacyMigrationInbox() {
    const inbox = await runtimeDbGet('legacyMigrationInbox', 'legacy-v1-current-path');
    if (!inbox?.localState) return false;
    const localState = persistenceClone(inbox.localState || {});
    const session = localState.semanticCache?.session || null;
    if (session) validateSemanticSession(session);
    const records = session ? semanticSessionToPersistenceRecords(session) : null;
    const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction([...RUNTIME_ALL_STORE_NAMES], 'readwrite');
    for (const name of RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES) transaction.objectStore(name).clear();

    const stateStore = transaction.objectStore(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE);
    const runtimeValues = [
      ['runnerCache', localState.runnerCache],
      ['manifestBootstrap', localState.manifestBootstrap],
      ['alphaLaunch', localState.alphaLaunch],
    ];
    for (const [key, value] of runtimeValues) {
      if (value != null) stateStore.put({ key, value: persistenceClone(value), updatedAt: semanticIsoNow() });
    }
    if (session) {
      stateStore.put({ key: 'semanticActiveSessionId', value: String(session.id), updatedAt: semanticIsoNow() });
      for (const name of RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_STORE_NAMES) {
        const store = transaction.objectStore(name);
        for (const record of records[name] || []) store.put(record);
      }
    }
    transaction.objectStore('recoveryJournal').put({
      id: semanticId('legacy-idb-migration'),
      kind: 'web-storage-to-full-idb',
      sessionId: session?.id || null,
      semanticRevision: session?.revision ?? null,
      stagedAt: inbox.stagedAt || null,
      normalizedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      sourceKeys: persistenceClone(inbox.sourceKeys || []),
    });
    transaction.objectStore('legacyMigrationInbox').delete(inbox.key);
    await runtimeTransactionDone(transaction);
    log('Legacy VIBE persistence normalized into full IndexedDB', {
      sessionId: session?.id || null,
      revision: session?.revision ?? null,
    });
    return true;
  }

  async function hydrateRuntimePersistence(options = {}) {
    if (runtimePersistence.hydrated && options.force !== true) {
      return {
        hydrated: true,
        sessionId: runtimePersistence.semanticSession?.id || null,
      };
    }
    if (runtimePersistence.hydratePromise && options.force !== true) {
      return runtimePersistence.hydratePromise;
    }
    runtimePersistence.hydratePromise = (async () => {
      await consumeLegacyMigrationInbox();
      const stateRows = await runtimeDbGetAll(RUNTIME_STATE_STORE);
      runtimePersistence.runtimeState = new Map(
        stateRows.map(row => [String(row.key), persistenceClone(row.value)])
      );
      // Clear stale pending RAM before hydration. If historical compaction below
      // schedules a write, do not erase that newly queued snapshot afterwards.
      runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession = null;
      const activeSessionId = runtimePersistence.runtimeState.get('semanticActiveSessionId') || null;
      if (activeSessionId) {
        const loaded = await readSemanticSessionRecordsFromRuntimeDb(activeSessionId);
        const historyCompacted = compactSemanticWorklogHistory(loaded.session);
        runtimePersistence.semanticSession = loaded.session;
        runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex = loaded.index;
        if (historyCompacted) {
          // a19: hydration is read-only until this runner has successfully claimed
          // the durable single-writer lease. Scheduling a guarded semantic write
          // here races the lease claim on package replacement and produces a false
          // SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LEASE_LOST against the previous runner's valid lease.
          runtimePersistence.semanticCompactionPersistenceDeferredV619 = true;
          log('Compacted historical Semantic ledger memory', {
            sessionId: loaded.session?.id || null,
            revision: loaded.session?.revision ?? null,
            worklogEntries: loaded.session?.worklog?.length || 0,
            persistenceDeferredUntilLeaseV619: true,
          });
        }
      } else {
        runtimePersistence.semanticSession = null;
        runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex = null;
      }
      runtimePersistence.hydrated = true;
      return {
        hydrated: true,
        runtimeDb: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        sessionId: runtimePersistence.semanticSession?.id || null,
        revision: runtimePersistence.semanticSession?.revision ?? null,
      };
    })();
    try {
      return await runtimePersistence.hydratePromise;
    } finally {
      runtimePersistence.hydratePromise = null;
    }
  }

  function persistDeferredSemanticCompactionAfterLeaseV619() {
    if (!runtimePersistence.semanticCompactionPersistenceDeferredV619) return false;
    if (!semanticRuntimeLeaseV616 || !isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return false;
    const session = runtimePersistence.semanticSession;
    if (!session) {
      runtimePersistence.semanticCompactionPersistenceDeferredV619 = false;
      return false;
    }
    runtimePersistence.semanticCompactionPersistenceDeferredV619 = false;
    runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession = persistenceClone(session);
    scheduleSemanticSessionPersistence();
    return true;
  }

  const SemanticSessionStore = Object.freeze({
    peek() {
      const value = runtimePersistence.semanticSession;
      if (!value) return null;
      ensureSemanticLaneV6918(value);
      ensureSemanticAgencyV690(value);
      validateSemanticSession(value);
      return value;
    },

    load() {
      const value = this.peek();
      return value ? persistenceClone(value) : null;
    },

    save(session) {
      session = normalizeProtocolCargoV649(session);
      ensureSemanticLaneV6918(session);
      ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session);
      validateSemanticSession(session);
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) {
        // Stale async continuations may finish after a newer package instance took ownership.
        // They are read-only from this point forward and must never overwrite transport authority.
        return runtimePersistence.semanticSession
          ? persistenceClone(runtimePersistence.semanticSession)
          : persistenceClone(session);
      }
      const reconciledV615 = reconcileSemanticSnapshotAuthorityV615(
        runtimePersistence.semanticSession,
        session
      );
      const next = reconciledV615.session;
      const previousId = runtimePersistence.semanticSession?.id || null;
      if (previousId && String(previousId) !== String(next.id)) {
        queueSemanticSessionDelete(previousId, runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex);
        runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex = null;
      }
      runtimePersistence.semanticSession = next;
      runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession = next;
      runtimePersistence.runtimeState.set('semanticActiveSessionId', String(next.id));
      scheduleSemanticSessionPersistence();
      scheduleGlobalCrossChatPublish(next);
      return persistenceClone(next);
    },

    create(options = {}) {
      const session = createSemanticSession(options);
      return this.save(session);
    },

    clear() {
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return false;
      const id = runtimePersistence.semanticSession?.id ||
        runtimePersistence.runtimeState.get('semanticActiveSessionId') || null;
      const committed = runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex;
      runtimePersistence.semanticSession = null;
      runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession = null;
      runtimePersistence.runtimeState.delete('semanticActiveSessionId');
      if (id) queueSemanticSessionDelete(id, committed);
      return true;
    },

    export() {
      const session = this.load();
      return session ? JSON.stringify(session, null, 2) : null;
    },
  });


  async function ensureSemanticSessionReady(options = {}) {
    const targetPathname = String(options.pathname || location.pathname || '/');
    let rebind = null;
    if (
      targetPathname !== persistenceBoundPathname ||
      RUNTIME_DB_NAME !== runtimeDatabaseNameForPathV616(targetPathname) ||
      SOURCE_DB_NAME !== sourceDatabaseNameForPathV616(targetPathname)
    ) {
      rebind = await rebindPathScopedPersistenceToCurrentLocation({
        pathname: targetPathname,
        hydrate: true,
      });
    } else if (!runtimePersistence.hydrated || runtimePersistence.hydratePromise) {
      await hydrateRuntimePersistence();
    }

    if (!semanticRuntimeLeaseV616 || !(await verifySemanticRuntimeLeaseV616())) {
      await claimSemanticRuntimeLeaseV616('semantic-session-ready');
    }

    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    let recovery = null;
    if (!session && options.recoverFromTail !== false) {
      try {
        recovery = await recoverSemanticAuthorityFromTail({
          reason: String(options.reason || 'semantic session readiness recovery'),
        });
      } catch (error) {
        if (options.requireRecoverySuccess === true) throw error;
        warn('Semantic session readiness tail recovery failed', error);
        recovery = { recovered: false, error: error?.message || String(error) };
      }
      session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    }

    if (!session && options.required !== false) {
      throw new Error(
        'Semantic session is unavailable after current-path persistence hydration' +
        (options.recoverFromTail === false ? '' : '/tail recovery')
      );
    }

    return {
      ready: Boolean(session),
      session,
      recovery,
      rebind,
      pathname: persistenceBoundPathname,
      runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
    };
  }



  /*
   * Source Workspace v1
   *
   * IndexedDB is authoritative for immutable baseline text and the physical
   * traversal cursor. Runtime/Semantic authority lives in the separate
   * IndexedDB runtime database above. The workspace proposes context; it
   * does not decide whether engineering work is sufficient.
   */
  const SOURCE_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-source-workspace/v1';
  const SOURCE_BASELINE_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-source-baseline/v1';
  const SOURCE_DB_VERSION = 3;
  let SOURCE_DB_NAME = sourceDatabaseNameForPathV616(persistenceBoundPathname);
  const SOURCE_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({
    targetChars: 18000,
    minChars: 6500,
    maxChars: 36000,
    surfacedDispatchLimit: 8,
    surfacedDispatchChars: 24000,
    // a51: evidence surfaces are a cache/navigation aid, not semantic memory.
    // Keep enough retained evidence for nonlinear investigation while bounding
    // long-run persistence. Older evidence is summarized in surfaceArchive.
    surfacedActiveRetention: 384,
    surfacedResolvedRetention: 96,
    surfacedArchiveBucketLimit: 48,
    surfacedArchiveLabelSamples: 6,
    intelligenceSliceChars: 262144,
    intelligenceSliceOverlap: 768,
    intelligenceCandidateLimit: 320,
    intelligenceBatchDispatchChars: 18000,
    intelligenceBatchQueryLimit: 8,
    intelligenceBatchCandidatesPerQuery: 12,
  });

  let sourceDatabasePromise = null;
  const sourceRuntime = {
    sessionId: null,
    workspace: null,
    baseline: null,
    restorePromise: null,
  };


  async function rebindPathScopedPersistenceToCurrentLocation(options = {}) {
    const targetPathname = String(options.pathname || location.pathname || '/');
    // A delayed cross-chat publish must never carry a pointer captured from the
    // pathname that is about to be detached. Re-publish from live authority after
    // rebind/recovery instead.
    if (typeof crossChatPublishTimer !== 'undefined' && crossChatPublishTimer) {
      clearTimeout(crossChatPublishTimer);
      crossChatPublishTimer = null;
    }
    if (
      targetPathname === persistenceBoundPathname &&
      RUNTIME_DB_NAME === runtimeDatabaseNameForPathV616(targetPathname) &&
      SOURCE_DB_NAME === sourceDatabaseNameForPathV616(targetPathname)
    ) {
      const hydration = options.hydrate === false || runtimePersistence.hydrated
        ? null
        : await hydrateRuntimePersistence();
      return {
        rebound: false,
        pathname: persistenceBoundPathname,
        runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
        hydration,
        semanticSessionId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.id || null,
      };
    }

    // A hydration already reading the previous pathname must finish before the
    // database identity changes. Otherwise its late RAM assignments can repopulate
    // the new namespace with the previous chat's SemanticSession.
    const previousHydration = runtimePersistence.hydratePromise;
    if (previousHydration) {
      await previousHydration.catch(error => {
        warn('Previous-path runtime hydration failed before rebind', error);
      });
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);

    const old = {
      pathname: persistenceBoundPathname,
      runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
    };
    const oldRuntimePromise = runtimeDatabasePromise;
    const oldSourcePromise = sourceDatabasePromise;
    try { (await oldRuntimePromise)?.close?.(); } catch {}
    try { (await oldSourcePromise)?.close?.(); } catch {}

    persistenceBoundPathname = targetPathname;
    RUNTIME_DB_NAME = runtimeDatabaseNameForPathV616(persistenceBoundPathname);
    SOURCE_DB_NAME = sourceDatabaseNameForPathV616(persistenceBoundPathname);
    cacheKey = CONFIG.cachePrefix + location.origin + persistenceBoundPathname;
    runtimeDatabasePromise = null;
    sourceDatabasePromise = null;

    runtimePersistence.hydrated = false;
    runtimePersistence.hydratePromise = null;
    runtimePersistence.runtimeState = new Map();
    runtimePersistence.semanticSession = null;
    runtimePersistence.semanticCommittedIndex = null;
    runtimePersistence.semanticPendingSession = null;
    runtimePersistence.semanticWriterScheduled = false;
    runtimePersistence.writeTail = Promise.resolve();
    runtimePersistence.failedWrites = new Map();
    semanticRuntimeLeaseV616 = null;

    sourceRuntime.sessionId = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = null;
    sourceRuntime.baseline = null;
    sourceRuntime.restorePromise = null;
    if (typeof workingRuntime !== 'undefined') {
      workingRuntime.sessionId = null;
      workingRuntime.spans = new Map();
      workingRuntime.headRevision = null;
      workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
      workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    }
    if (typeof intelligenceRuntime !== 'undefined') {
      intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = null;
      intelligenceRuntime.localLens = null;
      intelligenceRuntime.queries.clear();
      intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
      intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;
    }

    const hydration = options.hydrate === false
      ? null
      : await hydrateRuntimePersistence({ force: true });

    return {
      rebound: true,
      from: old,
      pathname: persistenceBoundPathname,
      runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
      hydration,
      semanticSessionId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.id || null,
    };
  }

  function sourceRequest(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(
        request.error || new Error('IndexedDB request failed')
      );
    });
  }

  function sourceTransactionDone(transaction) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      transaction.onabort = () => reject(
        transaction.error || new Error('IndexedDB transaction aborted')
      );
      transaction.onerror = () => reject(
        transaction.error || new Error('IndexedDB transaction failed')
      );
    });
  }

  function openSourceDatabase() {
    if (sourceDatabasePromise) return sourceDatabasePromise;
    if (!globalThis.indexedDB) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('IndexedDB is unavailable'));
    }
    sourceDatabasePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(SOURCE_DB_NAME, SOURCE_DB_VERSION);
      request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        const database = request.result;
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('baselines')) {
          database.createObjectStore('baselines', { keyPath: 'id' });
        }
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('workspaces')) {
          database.createObjectStore('workspaces', { keyPath: 'sessionId' });
        }
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('intelligenceQueries')) {
          database.createObjectStore('intelligenceQueries', { keyPath: 'id' });
        }
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('workingSpans')) {
          database.createObjectStore('workingSpans', { keyPath: 'id' });
        }
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('workingRevisions')) {
          database.createObjectStore('workingRevisions', { keyPath: 'id' });
        }
      };
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(
        request.error || new Error('Unable to open Source Workspace database')
      );
      request.onblocked = () => warn('Source Workspace IndexedDB upgrade is blocked');
    });
    return sourceDatabasePromise;
  }
