  async function sourceDbGet(storeName, key) {
    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readonly');
    return sourceRequest(transaction.objectStore(storeName).get(key));
  }

  async function sourceDbPut(storeName, value) {
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return value;
    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return value;
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readwrite');
    transaction.objectStore(storeName).put(value);
    await sourceTransactionDone(transaction);
    return value;
  }

  async function sourceDbDelete(storeName, key) {
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readwrite');
    transaction.objectStore(storeName).delete(key);
    await sourceTransactionDone(transaction);
  }

  async function sourceDbGetAll(storeName) {
    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readonly');
    const store = transaction.objectStore(storeName);
    if (typeof store.getAll === 'function') {
      return sourceRequest(store.getAll());
    }
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const result = [];
      const request = store.openCursor();
      request.onerror = () => reject(
        request.error || new Error('IndexedDB cursor failed')
      );
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const cursor = request.result;
        if (!cursor) {
          resolve(result);
          return;
        }
        result.push(cursor.value);
        cursor.continue();
      };
    });
  }

  function sourceClampOffset(value, length) {
    const number = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return 0;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(length, Math.floor(number)));
  }

  async function sourceSha256(buffer) {
    if (!globalThis.crypto?.subtle) {
      throw new Error('Web Crypto SHA-256 is unavailable');
    }
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer);
    return [...new Uint8Array(digest)]
      .map(byte => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
      .join('');
  }

  function sourceNormalizeRange(range, length = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) {
    if (!range || typeof range !== 'object') return null;
    const rawStart = range.start ?? range.startOffset ?? range.startLine;
    const rawEnd = range.end ?? range.endOffset ?? range.endLine;
    if (!Number.isFinite(Number(rawStart)) || !Number.isFinite(Number(rawEnd))) {
      return null;
    }
    const start = sourceClampOffset(Math.min(Number(rawStart), Number(rawEnd)), length);
    const end = sourceClampOffset(Math.max(Number(rawStart), Number(rawEnd)), length);
    if (end <= start) return null;
    return {
      start,
      end,
      label: String(range.label || '').trim(),
    };
  }

  function mergeSourceRanges(ranges, length = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) {
    const normalized = (Array.isArray(ranges) ? ranges : [])
      .map(range => sourceNormalizeRange(range, length))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.end - b.end);
    const result = [];
    for (const range of normalized) {
      const current = result.at(-1);
      if (!current || range.start > current.end) {
        result.push({ ...range });
      } else {
        current.end = Math.max(current.end, range.end);
        if (!current.label && range.label) current.label = range.label;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  function sourceCoveredThrough(ranges) {
    let through = 0;
    for (const range of mergeSourceRanges(ranges)) {
      if (range.start > through) break;
      through = Math.max(through, range.end);
    }
    return through;
  }

  function sourceLooksLikeJavaScriptV703(text, metadata = {}) {
    const source = String(text || '');
    const name = String(metadata?.name || '').toLowerCase();
    const type = String(metadata?.type || '').toLowerCase();
    if (/\.(?:mjs|cjs|js|jsx|ts|tsx)$/i.test(name)) return true;
    if (/(?:java|type)script/.test(type)) return true;
    if (/<!doctype\s+html|<html\b|<script\b|<style\b/i.test(source)) return false;
    const signals = [
      /['\"]use strict['\"]/,
      /\b(?:async\s+)?function\s+[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*\(/,
      /\bclass\s+[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*/,
      /\b(?:const|let|var)\s+[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=/,
      /\b(?:globalThis|window|self)\.[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*/,
      /=>/,
      /\b(?:await|new)\s+[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*/,
    ];
    return signals.reduce((score, regex) => score + (regex.test(source) ? 1 : 0), 0) >= 2;
  }

  function buildSourceSegmentMap(text, metadata = {}) {
    const source = String(text || '');
    const name = String(metadata?.name || '').toLowerCase();
    const type = String(metadata?.type || '').toLowerCase();
    if (/\.css$/i.test(name) || /text\/css/.test(type)) {
      return source.length ? [{ mode: 'css', start: 0, end: source.length }] : [];
    }
    if (sourceLooksLikeJavaScriptV703(source, metadata)) {
      return source.length ? [{ mode: 'javascript', start: 0, end: source.length }] : [];
    }
    const htmlLikeV703 = /\.html?$/i.test(name) || /text\/html/.test(type) || /<!doctype\s+html|<html\b/i.test(source);
    const fallbackModeV703 = htmlLikeV703 ? 'html' : 'text';
    const segments = [];
    const openPattern = /<(script|style)\b[^>]*>/gi;
    let cursor = 0;
    let match;
    while ((match = openPattern.exec(source)) !== null) {
      const mode = match[1].toLowerCase() === 'script' ? 'javascript' : 'css';
      const openStart = match.index;
      const openEnd = openPattern.lastIndex;
      if (openStart > cursor) {
        segments.push({ mode: 'html', start: cursor, end: openStart });
      }
      const closePattern = new RegExp(`</${match[1]}\\s*>`, 'ig');
      closePattern.lastIndex = openEnd;
      const close = closePattern.exec(source);
      const end = close ? closePattern.lastIndex : source.length;
      segments.push({
        mode,
        start: openStart,
        contentStart: openEnd,
        contentEnd: close ? close.index : source.length,
        end,
      });
      cursor = end;
      openPattern.lastIndex = end;
      if (!close) break;
    }
    if (cursor < source.length) {
      segments.push({ mode: segments.length ? 'html' : fallbackModeV703, start: cursor, end: source.length });
    }
    if (!segments.length && source.length) {
      segments.push({ mode: fallbackModeV703, start: 0, end: source.length });
    }
    return segments;
  }

  function sourceRegionAt(text, offset, segmentMap = null) {
    const length = String(text || '').length;
    const point = sourceClampOffset(offset, length);
    const segments = Array.isArray(segmentMap) && segmentMap.length
      ? segmentMap
      : buildSourceSegmentMap(text);
    let low = 0;
    let high = segments.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const middle = (low + high) >> 1;
      const segment = segments[middle];
      if (point < segment.start) high = middle - 1;
      else if (point >= segment.end) low = middle + 1;
      else {
        return {
          mode: segment.mode,
          regionStart: segment.start,
          regionEnd: segment.end,
          contentStart: segment.contentStart ?? segment.start,
          contentEnd: segment.contentEnd ?? segment.end,
        };
      }
    }
    const fallback = segments[Math.max(0, Math.min(segments.length - 1, low))];
    return fallback
      ? {
          mode: fallback.mode,
          regionStart: fallback.start,
          regionEnd: fallback.end,
          contentStart: fallback.contentStart ?? fallback.start,
          contentEnd: fallback.contentEnd ?? fallback.end,
        }
      : { mode: sourceLooksLikeJavaScriptV703(text) ? 'javascript' : 'text', regionStart: 0, regionEnd: length };
  }

  function sourceBoundaryCandidates(text, start, limit, mode) {
    const candidates = [];
    let quote = null;
    let escaped = false;
    let lineComment = false;
    let blockComment = false;
    let brace = 0;
    let paren = 0;
    let bracket = 0;
    let previousNonSpace = '';

    for (let index = start; index < limit; index += 1) {
      const char = text[index];
      const next = text[index + 1] || '';

      if (lineComment) {
        if (char === '\n') {
          lineComment = false;
          if (brace === 0 && paren === 0 && bracket === 0) {
            candidates.push(index + 1);
          }
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (blockComment) {
        if (char === '*' && next === '/') {
          blockComment = false;
          index += 1;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (quote) {
        if (escaped) escaped = false;
        else if (char === '\\') escaped = true;
        else if (char === quote) quote = null;
        continue;
      }

      if ((mode === 'javascript' || mode === 'css') && char === '/' && next === '*') {
        blockComment = true;
        index += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (mode === 'javascript' && char === '/' && next === '/') {
        lineComment = true;
        index += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (char === '"' || char === "'" || char === '`') {
        quote = char;
        continue;
      }

      if (char === '{') brace += 1;
      else if (char === '}') brace = Math.max(0, brace - 1);
      else if (char === '(') paren += 1;
      else if (char === ')') paren = Math.max(0, paren - 1);
      else if (char === '[') bracket += 1;
      else if (char === ']') bracket = Math.max(0, bracket - 1);

      if (mode === 'javascript') {
        if (
          brace === 0 && paren === 0 && bracket === 0 &&
          (char === ';' || char === '}')
        ) {
          candidates.push(index + 1);
        } else if (
          char === '\n' && brace === 0 && paren === 0 && bracket === 0 &&
          (previousNonSpace === ';' || previousNonSpace === '}')
        ) {
          candidates.push(index + 1);
        }
      } else if (mode === 'css') {
        if (char === '}' && brace === 0) candidates.push(index + 1);
      } else if (mode === 'html') {
        if (char === '>' && (next === '\n' || next === '\r')) {
          candidates.push(index + 1);
        }
      }

      if (!/\s/.test(char)) previousNonSpace = char;
    }
    return candidates;
  }

  function sourceLineBoundary(text, target, start, limit) {
    const after = text.indexOf('\n', target);
    if (after >= 0 && after + 1 <= limit) return after + 1;
    const before = text.lastIndexOf('\n', target);
    if (before >= start) return before + 1;
    return limit;
  }

  function proposeSourceChunk(text, offset, options = {}) {
    const length = text.length;
    const start = sourceClampOffset(offset, length);
    if (start >= length) return null;
    const targetChars = Math.max(1000, Number(options.targetChars || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.targetChars));
    const minChars = Math.max(200, Math.min(targetChars, Number(options.minChars || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.minChars)));
    const maxChars = Math.max(targetChars, Number(options.maxChars || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.maxChars));
    const region = sourceRegionAt(text, start, options.segmentMap);
    const hardEnd = Math.min(length, start + maxChars, Math.max(start + 1, region.regionEnd));
    const minEnd = Math.min(hardEnd, start + minChars);
    const targetEnd = Math.min(hardEnd, start + targetChars);
    const candidates = sourceBoundaryCandidates(text, start, hardEnd, region.mode)
      .filter(end => end >= minEnd && end <= hardEnd);
    let end = null;
    const after = candidates.find(candidate => candidate >= targetEnd);
    const before = [...candidates].reverse().find(candidate => candidate < targetEnd);
    if (after != null && before != null) {
      end = (after - targetEnd) <= (targetEnd - before) * 1.35 ? after : before;
    } else {
      end = after ?? before ?? sourceLineBoundary(text, targetEnd, start, hardEnd);
    }
    end = Math.max(start + 1, Math.min(length, end || hardEnd));
    return {
      start,
      end,
      label: `${region.mode} · ${start}…${end}`,
      mode: region.mode,
      proposedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  function sourceBaselineMeta(baseline) {
    if (!baseline) return null;
    return {
      id: baseline.id,
      name: baseline.name,
      type: baseline.type,
      sha256: baseline.sha256,
      sizeChars: baseline.sizeChars,
      sizeBytes: baseline.sizeBytes,
      importedAt: baseline.importedAt,
    };
  }

  function sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(itemInput = {}) {
    const raw = String(itemInput?.lifecycle || itemInput?.retention || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (raw === 'ephemeral' || raw === 'pinned' || raw === 'retained') return raw;
    return 'ephemeral';
  }

  function sourceSurfaceChronologyV651(item, fallback = 0) {
    const parsed = Date.parse(String(item?.createdAt || item?.resolvedAt || item?.updatedAt || ''));
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : Number(fallback || 0);
  }

  function sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(item, reasonCode, settings) {
    const labelLimit = Math.max(1, Number(settings?.surfacedArchiveLabelSamples || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.surfacedArchiveLabelSamples));
    const space = item?.space === 'working' ? 'working' : 'baseline';
    const lifecycle = sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(item);
    const distanceId = String(item?.distanceId || 'unscoped');
    const reason = String(reasonCode || 'retention');
    const start = Number(item?.start ?? item?.baselineStart ?? item?.workingStart ?? 0);
    const end = Number(item?.end ?? item?.baselineEnd ?? item?.workingEnd ?? start);
    const at = String(item?.resolvedAt || item?.createdAt || semanticIsoNow());
    const label = semanticMemoryText(item?.label || item?.reason || '', 240);
    return {
      key: `${distanceId}|${space}|${lifecycle}|${reason}`,
      distanceId,
      space,
      lifecycle,
      reason,
      count: 1,
      minStart: Math.min(start, end),
      maxEnd: Math.max(start, end),
      firstAt: at,
      lastAt: at,
      labels: label ? [label].slice(-labelLimit) : [],
    };
  }

  function mergeSourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(target, incoming, settings) {
    const labelLimit = Math.max(1, Number(settings?.surfacedArchiveLabelSamples || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.surfacedArchiveLabelSamples));
    target.count = Number(target.count || 0) + Number(incoming.count || 0);
    target.minStart = Math.min(Number(target.minStart ?? incoming.minStart ?? 0), Number(incoming.minStart ?? target.minStart ?? 0));
    target.maxEnd = Math.max(Number(target.maxEnd ?? incoming.maxEnd ?? 0), Number(incoming.maxEnd ?? target.maxEnd ?? 0));
    if (!target.firstAt || String(incoming.firstAt || '') < String(target.firstAt)) target.firstAt = incoming.firstAt || target.firstAt;
    if (!target.lastAt || String(incoming.lastAt || '') > String(target.lastAt)) target.lastAt = incoming.lastAt || target.lastAt;
    target.labels = [...new Set([...(target.labels || []), ...(incoming.labels || [])].filter(Boolean))].slice(-labelLimit);
    return target;
  }

  function compactSourceSurfaceArchiveV651(existingInput, additions, settings) {
    const buckets = new Map();
    const add = recordInput => {
      if (!recordInput) return;
      const record = cloneSemanticValue(recordInput);
      record.key ||= `${record.distanceId || 'unscoped'}|${record.space || 'baseline'}|${record.lifecycle || 'retained'}|${record.reason || 'retention'}`;
      const current = buckets.get(record.key);
      if (current) mergeSourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(current, record, settings);
      else buckets.set(record.key, record);
    };
    for (const item of Array.isArray(existingInput) ? existingInput : []) add(item);
    for (const item of Array.isArray(additions) ? additions : []) add(item);

    const limit = Math.max(4, Number(settings?.surfacedArchiveBucketLimit || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.surfacedArchiveBucketLimit));
    let rows = [...buckets.values()].sort((a, b) => String(b.lastAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.lastAt || '')));
    if (rows.length > limit) {
      const keep = rows.slice(0, Math.max(1, limit - 1));
      const overflow = rows.slice(Math.max(1, limit - 1));
      let other = null;
      for (const row of overflow) {
        const normalized = {
          ...row,
          key: 'archive:other',
          distanceId: 'multiple',
          space: 'mixed',
          lifecycle: 'mixed',
          reason: 'bucket-compaction',
        };
        if (!other) other = normalized;
        else mergeSourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(other, normalized, settings);
      }
      rows = other ? [...keep, other] : keep;
    }
    return rows;
  }

  function compactSourceSurfaceLedgerV651(workspaceInput, sessionInput = null) {
    const workspace = workspaceInput;
    const cursor = workspace?.cursor;
    if (!workspace || !cursor) return { changed: false, stats: null };
    cursor.surfacedRanges = Array.isArray(cursor.surfacedRanges) ? cursor.surfacedRanges : [];
    cursor.surfaceArchive = Array.isArray(cursor.surfaceArchive) ? cursor.surfaceArchive : [];
    const settings = workspace.settings || SOURCE_DEFAULTS;
    const activeLimit = Math.max(32, Number(settings.surfacedActiveRetention || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.surfacedActiveRetention));
    const resolvedLimit = Math.max(0, Number(settings.surfacedResolvedRetention ?? SOURCE_DEFAULTS.surfacedResolvedRetention));
    const currentSequence = sessionInput ? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(sessionInput) : null;
    const beforeJson = JSON.stringify({ surfacedRanges: cursor.surfacedRanges, surfaceArchive: cursor.surfaceArchive });
    const beforeCount = cursor.surfacedRanges.length;
    const archiveAdditions = [];
    let normalizedLifecycle = 0;
    let normalizedLegacyExplicit = 0;
    let duplicateCount = 0;
    let expiredEphemeral = 0;

    // Keep the newest exact semantic duplicate. Old repeated SURFACE_RANGE rows are cache cargo.
    const seen = new Set();
    const dedupedReverse = [];
    for (let index = cursor.surfacedRanges.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const item = cloneSemanticValue(cursor.surfacedRanges[index] || {});
      const lifecycle = sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(item);
      if (item.lifecycle !== lifecycle) {
        item.lifecycle = lifecycle;
        normalizedLifecycle += 1;
      }
      // Repair-3 migration: pre-forensic surfaces had no causal acceptance sequence and
      // sourceCursor import defaulted them to explicitAddressed=true. That historical
      // flag cannot mean "the active Unit explicitly requested these bytes now".
      // Demote it before relevance/GC so baseline-tail ancestry cannot bypass budgets.
      if (
        item.explicitAddressed === true &&
        !Number.isInteger(Number(item.createdAcceptanceSequence))
      ) {
        item.explicitAddressed = false;
        normalizedLegacyExplicit += 1;
      }
      const signature = [
        String(item.status || 'active'), lifecycle, String(item.space || 'baseline'),
        Number(item.start), Number(item.end), String(item.distanceId || ''),
        String(item.label || ''), String(item.reason || ''),
      ].join('|');
      if (seen.has(signature)) {
        duplicateCount += 1;
        archiveAdditions.push(sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(item, 'duplicate', settings));
        continue;
      }
      seen.add(signature);
      dedupedReverse.push({ item, index });
    }
    const rows = dedupedReverse.reverse();
    const active = [];
    const resolved = [];
    for (const row of rows) {
      const item = row.item;
      if (item.status === 'resolved') {
        resolved.push(row);
        continue;
      }
      const lifecycle = sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(item);
      const currentWorkingIdentity = String(workspace?.working?.identity || '');
      const itemWorkingIdentity = String(item?.workingIdentity || '');
      if (lifecycle !== 'pinned' && itemWorkingIdentity && currentWorkingIdentity && itemWorkingIdentity !== currentWorkingIdentity) {
        archiveAdditions.push(sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(item, 'working-identity-changed', settings));
        continue;
      }
      const distanceStatus = item?.distanceId ? String(sessionInput?.distances?.[item.distanceId]?.status || '').toLowerCase() : '';
      if (lifecycle !== 'pinned' && ['sealed', 'superseded'].includes(distanceStatus)) {
        archiveAdditions.push(sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(item, 'distance-closed', settings));
        continue;
      }
      const createdSequence = Number(item.createdAcceptanceSequence);
      const createdAt = Date.parse(String(item.createdAt || ''));
      const lastControlAt = Date.parse(String(sessionInput?.transport?.lastControl?.acceptedAt || ''));
      const legacyEphemeralExpired = lifecycle === 'ephemeral' && !Number.isInteger(createdSequence) &&
        Number.isFinite(createdAt) && Number.isFinite(lastControlAt) && createdAt < lastControlAt;
      const legacyRetainedPreForensicV703 = lifecycle === 'retained' && !Number.isInteger(createdSequence) &&
        Number.isFinite(createdAt) && Number.isFinite(lastControlAt) && createdAt < lastControlAt;
      if (legacyRetainedPreForensicV703) {
        archiveAdditions.push(sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(item, 'legacy-retained-pre-forensic', settings));
        continue;
      }
      if (
        lifecycle === 'ephemeral' &&
        ((Number.isInteger(currentSequence) && Number.isInteger(createdSequence) && createdSequence < currentSequence) || legacyEphemeralExpired)
      ) {
        expiredEphemeral += 1;
        archiveAdditions.push(sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(item, 'ephemeral-expired', settings));
        continue;
      }
      active.push(row);
    }

    const byRecent = (a, b) =>
      sourceSurfaceChronologyV651(b.item, b.index) - sourceSurfaceChronologyV651(a.item, a.index) || b.index - a.index;
    const pinned = active.filter(row => sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(row.item) === 'pinned').sort(byRecent);
    const ordinary = active.filter(row => sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(row.item) !== 'pinned').sort(byRecent);
    const keepActive = [];
    for (const row of [...pinned, ...ordinary]) {
      if (keepActive.length < activeLimit) keepActive.push(row);
      else archiveAdditions.push(sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(row.item, 'active-retention', settings));
    }
    const keepResolved = resolved.sort(byRecent).slice(0, resolvedLimit);
    for (const row of resolved.sort(byRecent).slice(resolvedLimit)) {
      archiveAdditions.push(sourceSurfaceArchiveRecordV651(row.item, 'resolved-retention', settings));
    }

    const keptRows = [...keepActive, ...keepResolved]
      .sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index)
      .map(row => row.item);
    cursor.surfacedRanges = keptRows;
    cursor.surfaceArchive = compactSourceSurfaceArchiveV651(cursor.surfaceArchive, archiveAdditions, settings);
    const archivedThisRun = archiveAdditions.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item?.count || 0), 0);
    const archivedTotal = cursor.surfaceArchive.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item?.count || 0), 0);
    const afterJson = JSON.stringify({ surfacedRanges: cursor.surfacedRanges, surfaceArchive: cursor.surfaceArchive });
    const changed = beforeJson !== afterJson;
    if (changed) {
      cursor.surfaceGc = {
        schema: 'vibe-go-source-surface-gc/v1',
        at: semanticIsoNow(),
        before: beforeCount,
        after: cursor.surfacedRanges.length,
        active: cursor.surfacedRanges.filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved').length,
        resolved: cursor.surfacedRanges.filter(item => item.status === 'resolved').length,
        archivedThisRun,
        archivedTotal,
        duplicateCount,
        expiredEphemeral,
        normalizedLifecycle,
        normalizedLegacyExplicit,
        archiveBuckets: cursor.surfaceArchive.length,
        activeLimit,
        resolvedLimit,
      };
    }
    return { changed, stats: cloneSemanticValue(cursor.surfaceGc || null) };
  }

  function sourceWorkspaceMeta(workspace) {
    if (!workspace) return null;
    return {
      schema: workspace.schema,
      sessionId: workspace.sessionId,
      baselineId: workspace.baselineId,
      revision: workspace.revision,
      updatedAt: workspace.updatedAt,
      cursor: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor),
      settings: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.settings),
      segmentCount: Array.isArray(workspace.segmentMap) ? workspace.segmentMap.length : 0,
    };
  }

  function requireSourceSession(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    const session = sessionInput;
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error('Source Workspace requires a SemanticSession');
    }
    validateSemanticSession(session);
    return session;
  }

  function requireSourceRuntime(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    const session = requireSourceSession(sessionInput);
    if (
      sourceRuntime.sessionId !== session.id ||
      !sourceRuntime.workspace ||
      !sourceRuntime.baseline
    ) {
      throw new Error('Source Workspace is not restored for the active SemanticSession');
    }
    return {
      session,
      workspace: sourceRuntime.workspace,
      baseline: sourceRuntime.baseline,
    };
  }

  function sourceInvalidateUnsentDispatch(session) {
    const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch;
    if (pending && (pending.status === 'ready' || pending.status === 'queued')) {
      // a14: invalidate both durable authority and the corresponding in-memory queue.
      // Otherwise executeQueuedSend() can retain the old dispatch object after the
      // durable pending envelope has already been rebuilt under a new id.
      if (pendingSend?.dispatch?.id === pending.id) clearPendingSend();
      session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    }
  }

  function projectSurfacedRangeForSemanticCursor(itemInput = {}) {
    const item = itemInput && typeof itemInput === 'object' ? itemInput : {};
    const space = item.space === 'working' ? 'working' : 'baseline';
    const projected = {
      id: item.id,
      space,
      start: item.start,
      end: item.end,
      label: item.label,
      reason: item.reason,
      distanceId: item.distanceId,
      status: item.status,
      lifecycle: sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(item),
      explicitAddressed: item.explicitAddressed === true,
      workingIdentity: item.workingIdentity || null,
      ...(Number.isInteger(Number(item.createdAcceptanceSequence)) ? { createdAcceptanceSequence: Number(item.createdAcceptanceSequence) } : {}),
    };
    if (space === 'working') {
      projected.workingStart = Number.isFinite(Number(item.workingStart))
        ? Number(item.workingStart)
        : Number(item.start);
      projected.workingEnd = Number.isFinite(Number(item.workingEnd))
        ? Number(item.workingEnd)
        : Number(item.end);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(item.baselineStart))) projected.baselineStart = Number(item.baselineStart);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(item.baselineEnd))) projected.baselineEnd = Number(item.baselineEnd);
    } else {
      projected.baselineStart = Number.isFinite(Number(item.baselineStart))
        ? Number(item.baselineStart)
        : Number(item.start);
      projected.baselineEnd = Number.isFinite(Number(item.baselineEnd))
        ? Number(item.baselineEnd)
        : Number(item.end);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(item.workingStart))) projected.workingStart = Number(item.workingStart);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(item.workingEnd))) projected.workingEnd = Number(item.workingEnd);
    }
    return projected;
  }

  function syncSourceProjectionIntoSession(workspace, baseline) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || session.id !== workspace.sessionId) return null;
    const surfaced = workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges
      .filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved')
      .map(projectSurfacedRangeForSemanticCursor);
    session.sourceCursor = {
      ...session.sourceCursor,
      workspaceId: workspace.sessionId,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      baseline: sourceBaselineMeta(baseline),
      nextOffset: workspace.cursor.nextOffset,
      activeRange: workspace.cursor.activeRange
        ? cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor.activeRange)
        : null,
      coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges),
      coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges),
      workingRevision: workspace.working?.identity || session.sourceCursor.workingRevision || 'baseline',
      relatedRanges: surfaced,
      workspaceRevision: workspace.revision,
    };
    sourceInvalidateUnsentDispatch(session);
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    return SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
  }

  function projectSourceWorkspaceIntoSession(sessionInput, workspace, baseline) {
    const session = sessionInput;
    const surfaced = workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges
      .filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved')
      .map(projectSurfacedRangeForSemanticCursor);
    session.sourceCursor = {
      ...session.sourceCursor,
      workspaceId: workspace.sessionId,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      baseline: sourceBaselineMeta(baseline),
      nextOffset: workspace.cursor.nextOffset,
      activeRange: workspace.cursor.activeRange
        ? cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor.activeRange)
        : null,
      coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges),
      coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges),
      workingRevision: workspace.working?.identity || session.sourceCursor.workingRevision || 'baseline',
      relatedRanges: surfaced,
      workspaceRevision: workspace.revision,
    };
    return session;
  }

  function normalizeWorkspaceOperationName(value) {
    return String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_');
  }

  function stageWorkspaceOperations(workspaceInput, operationsInput, baseline, session) {
    const operations = Array.isArray(operationsInput) ? operationsInput : [];
    const workspace = cloneSemanticValue(workspaceInput);
    const results = [];
    let changed = false;

    function currentRange() {
      const range = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
      if (!range) throw new Error('Workspace operation requires an active source chunk');
      return range;
    }

    function setRange(start, end, options = {}) {
      const range = sourceNormalizeRange({ start, end, label: options.label }, baseline.text.length);
      if (!range) throw new Error('Workspace operation produced an invalid chunk range');
      workspace.cursor.nextOffset = range.start;
      workspace.cursor.activeRange = {
        ...range,
        mode: options.mode || sourceRegionAt(baseline.text, range.start, workspace.segmentMap).mode,
        proposedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        manual: options.manual !== false,
      };
      changed = true;
      return cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor.activeRange);
    }

    function cover({ advance = false, label = '' } = {}) {
      const range = currentRange();
      workspace.cursor.coveredRanges = mergeSourceRanges([
        ...workspace.cursor.coveredRanges,
        { ...range, label: label || range.label },
      ], baseline.text.length);
      workspace.cursor.nextOffset = range.end;
      if (advance && range.end < baseline.text.length) {
        workspace.cursor.activeRange = proposeSourceChunk(
          baseline.text,
          range.end,
          { ...workspace.settings, segmentMap: workspace.segmentMap }
        );
      } else if (range.end >= baseline.text.length) {
        workspace.cursor.activeRange = null;
      }
      changed = true;
      return {
        coveredRange: range,
        nextOffset: workspace.cursor.nextOffset,
        activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor.activeRange),
        eof: range.end >= baseline.text.length,
      };
    }

    for (const input of operations) {
      const operation = input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {};
      const op = normalizeWorkspaceOperationName(operation.op || operation.action);
      let result;

      switch (op) {
        case 'SET_CHUNK': {
          const target = operation.range || operation.target || operation;
          result = setRange(target.start, target.end, {
            label: operation.label || target.label,
            mode: operation.mode || target.mode,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 'PROPOSE_CHUNK': {
          const offset = Number.isFinite(Number(operation.offset))
            ? Number(operation.offset)
            : workspace.cursor.nextOffset;
          const range = proposeSourceChunk(
            baseline.text,
            offset,
            { ...workspace.settings, ...(operation.options || {}), segmentMap: workspace.segmentMap }
          );
          workspace.cursor.nextOffset = range ? range.start : baseline.text.length;
          workspace.cursor.activeRange = range;
          changed = true;
          result = cloneSemanticValue(range);
          break;
        }

        case 'EXPAND_CHUNK': {
          const range = currentRange();
          const before = Number(operation.before ?? operation.startBy ?? 0);
          const after = Number(operation.after ?? operation.endBy ?? operation.value ?? 0);
          result = setRange(range.start - before, range.end + after, {
            label: operation.label || range.label,
            mode: range.mode,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 'SHRINK_CHUNK': {
          const range = currentRange();
          const before = Number(operation.before ?? operation.startBy ?? 0);
          const after = Number(operation.after ?? operation.endBy ?? operation.value ?? 0);
          result = setRange(range.start + before, range.end - after, {
            label: operation.label || range.label,
            mode: range.mode,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 'COVER_ACTIVE':
          result = cover({ advance: operation.advance === true, label: operation.label });
          break;

        case 'NEXT_CHUNK':
          result = cover({ advance: true, label: operation.label });
          break;

        case 'SURFACE_RANGE': {
          const target = operation.range || operation.target || operation;
          const range = sourceNormalizeRange(target, baseline.text.length);
          if (!range) throw new Error('SURFACE_RANGE requires a valid baseline range');
          const item = {
            id: String(operation.id || semanticId('surface')),
            ...range,
            space: 'baseline',
            baselineStart: range.start,
            baselineEnd: range.end,
            label: String(operation.label || range.label || 'surfaced context'),
            reason: String(operation.reason || '').trim(),
            distanceId: operation.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
            workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline',
            explicitAddressed: operation.explicitAddressed === true,
            status: 'active',
            lifecycle: sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(operation),
            createdAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
            createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
          };
          if (workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.some(entry => entry.id === item.id)) {
            throw new Error(`SURFACE_RANGE id already exists: ${item.id}`);
          }
          workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.push(item);
          changed = true;
          result = cloneSemanticValue(item);
          break;
        }

        case 'RESOLVE_SURFACE': {
          const id = String(operation.id || operation.surfaceId || '');
          const item = workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.find(entry => entry.id === id);
          if (!item) throw new Error(`RESOLVE_SURFACE target not found: ${id}`);
          item.status = 'resolved';
          item.resolvedAt = semanticIsoNow();
          changed = true;
          result = { id, resolved: true };
          break;
        }

        case 'CLEAR_SURFACES':
          workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges = [];
          changed = true;
          result = { cleared: true };
          break;

        default:
          throw new Error(`Unsupported workspace operation: ${op || '(empty)'}`);
      }

      results.push({ op, ok: true, result });
    }

    return { workspace, results, changed };
  }

  function semanticBaselinePointerMatches(cursorInput, baseline) {
    const cursor = cursorInput && typeof cursorInput === 'object' ? cursorInput : {};
    const pointers = [];
    if (cursor.baselineId != null) pointers.push(cursor.baselineId);
    if (cursor.baseline != null) {
      if (typeof cursor.baseline === 'string') pointers.push(cursor.baseline);
      else if (typeof cursor.baseline === 'object') {
        if (cursor.baseline.id != null) pointers.push(cursor.baseline.id);
        if (cursor.baseline.sha256 != null) pointers.push(cursor.baseline.sha256);
      }
    }
    if (!pointers.length) return true;
    const accepted = new Set([
      String(baseline.id),
      String(baseline.sha256),
      `sha256:${baseline.sha256}`,
      `baseline:${baseline.sha256}`,
    ]);
    return pointers.every(pointer => accepted.has(String(pointer)));
  }

  function semanticCursorRequestsWorkspaceProjection(cursorInput) {
    const cursor = cursorInput && typeof cursorInput === 'object' ? cursorInput : null;
    if (!cursor) return false;
    return (
      'activeRange' in cursor ||
      'nextOffset' in cursor ||
      Array.isArray(cursor.coveredRanges) ||
      Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges) ||
      Array.isArray(cursor.surfacedRanges)
    );
  }

  function stageDeclarativeWorkspaceCursor(workspaceInput, cursorInput, baseline, session) {
    const workspace = cloneSemanticValue(workspaceInput);
    const cursor = cursorInput && typeof cursorInput === 'object' ? cursorInput : {};
    const result = {
      activeRange: false,
      nextOffset: false,
      coveredRanges: 0,
      surfacedRanges: 0,
    };
    let changed = false;

    if (!semanticBaselinePointerMatches(cursor, baseline)) {
      throw new Error(
        `VIBE_STATE sourceCursor baseline mismatch: expected ${baseline.sha256}`
      );
    }

    if ('activeRange' in cursor) {
      if (cursor.activeRange == null) {
        if (workspace.cursor.activeRange != null) changed = true;
        workspace.cursor.activeRange = null;
      } else {
        const range = sourceNormalizeRange(cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
        if (!range) throw new Error('VIBE_STATE sourceCursor.activeRange is invalid');
        const previous = workspace.cursor.activeRange;
        const next = {
          ...range,
          label: String(cursor.activeRange.label || range.label || previous?.label || ''),
          mode:
            cursor.activeRange.mode ||
            previous?.mode ||
            sourceRegionAt(baseline.text, range.start, workspace.segmentMap).mode,
          proposedAt: previous?.proposedAt || semanticIsoNow(),
          manual: true,
        };
        if (
          !previous ||
          Number(previous.start) !== Number(next.start) ||
          Number(previous.end) !== Number(next.end) ||
          String(previous.label || '') !== String(next.label || '')
        ) {
          changed = true;
        }
        workspace.cursor.activeRange = next;
      }
      result.activeRange = true;
    }

    if ('nextOffset' in cursor) {
      const nextOffset = Number(cursor.nextOffset);
      if (!Number.isFinite(nextOffset)) {
        throw new Error('VIBE_STATE sourceCursor.nextOffset is invalid');
      }
      const normalized = sourceClampOffset(nextOffset, baseline.text.length);
      if (Number(workspace.cursor.nextOffset) !== normalized) changed = true;
      workspace.cursor.nextOffset = normalized;
      result.nextOffset = true;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(cursor.coveredRanges)) {
      const incoming = cursor.coveredRanges.map(item => {
        const range = sourceNormalizeRange(item, baseline.text.length);
        if (!range) throw new Error('VIBE_STATE sourceCursor.coveredRanges contains an invalid range');
        return {
          ...range,
          label: String(item?.label || range.label || ''),
        };
      });
      const merged = mergeSourceRanges([
        ...(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges || []),
        ...incoming,
      ], baseline.text.length);
      const before = JSON.stringify(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges || []);
      const after = JSON.stringify(merged);
      if (before !== after) changed = true;
      workspace.cursor.coveredRanges = merged;
      result.coveredRanges = incoming.length;
    }

    const related = Array.isArray(cursor.surfacedRanges)
      ? cursor.surfacedRanges
      : Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges)
        ? cursor.relatedRanges
        : [];
    for (const input of related) {
      const explicitId = input?.id != null ? String(input.id) : null;
      const space = input?.space === 'working' ? 'working' : 'baseline';
      let nextSurface;
      if (space === 'working') {
        const rawStart = Number(input?.workingStart ?? input?.start);
        const rawEnd = Number(input?.workingEnd ?? input?.end);
        if (!Number.isFinite(rawStart) || !Number.isFinite(rawEnd) || rawEnd <= rawStart) {
          throw new Error('VIBE_STATE sourceCursor working related range is invalid');
        }
        const workingStart = Math.min(rawStart, rawEnd);
        const workingEnd = Math.max(rawStart, rawEnd);
        const label = String(input?.label || 'working surfaced context');
        nextSurface = {
          id: explicitId || semanticId('surface-working'),
          space: 'working',
          start: workingStart,
          end: workingEnd,
          workingStart,
          workingEnd,
          label,
          reason: String(input?.reason || 'Declared by semantic result sourceCursor'),
          distanceId: input?.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
          workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline',
          explicitAddressed: input?.explicitAddressed !== false,
          status: 'active',
          lifecycle: sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(input),
          createdAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
          createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        if (Number.isFinite(Number(input?.baselineStart))) nextSurface.baselineStart = Number(input.baselineStart);
        if (Number.isFinite(Number(input?.baselineEnd))) nextSurface.baselineEnd = Number(input.baselineEnd);
      } else {
        const range = sourceNormalizeRange(input, baseline.text.length);
        if (!range) throw new Error('VIBE_STATE sourceCursor related range is invalid');
        const label = String(input?.label || range.label || 'surfaced context');
        nextSurface = {
          id: explicitId || semanticId('surface'),
          ...range,
          space: 'baseline',
          baselineStart: range.start,
          baselineEnd: range.end,
          label,
          reason: String(input?.reason || 'Declared by semantic result sourceCursor'),
          distanceId: input?.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
          workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline',
          explicitAddressed: input?.explicitAddressed !== false,
          status: 'active',
          lifecycle: sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(input),
          createdAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
          createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        if (Number.isFinite(Number(input?.workingStart))) nextSurface.workingStart = Number(input.workingStart);
        if (Number.isFinite(Number(input?.workingEnd))) nextSurface.workingEnd = Number(input.workingEnd);
      }
      const already = (workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges || []).find(item =>
        item.status !== 'resolved' && (
          (explicitId && item.id === explicitId) ||
          (
            String(item.space || 'baseline') === space &&
            Number(item.start) === Number(nextSurface.start) &&
            Number(item.end) === Number(nextSurface.end) &&
            String(item.label || '') === String(nextSurface.label || '')
          )
        )
      );
      if (already) continue;
      workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.push(nextSurface);
      changed = true;
      result.surfacedRanges += 1;
    }

    return { workspace, changed, result };
  }

  async function saveSourceWorkspace(workspace, { syncSession = true } = {}) {
    // a51: compact evidence-cache lifecycle before every durable workspace write.
    // Semantic conclusions live in Notes/Decisions/Worklog; SURFACE_RANGE is bounded navigation evidence.
    compactSourceSurfaceLedgerV651(workspace, SemanticSessionStore.load());
    workspace.revision = Number(workspace.revision || 0) + 1;
    workspace.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    await sourceDbPut('workspaces', workspace);
    sourceRuntime.sessionId = workspace.sessionId;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = workspace;
    if (syncSession && sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      syncSourceProjectionIntoSession(workspace, sourceRuntime.baseline);
    }
    renderPanel();
    return sourceWorkspaceMeta(workspace);
  }

  async function restoreSourceWorkspaceForSession(sessionId) {
    const id = String(sessionId || '');
    if (!id) return null;
    if (
      sourceRuntime.sessionId === id &&
      sourceRuntime.workspace &&
      sourceRuntime.baseline
    ) {
      return sourceWorkspaceMeta(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    }
    if (sourceRuntime.restorePromise && sourceRuntime.sessionId === id) {
      return sourceRuntime.restorePromise;
    }
    sourceRuntime.sessionId = id;
    sourceRuntime.restorePromise = (async () => {
      const workspace = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', id);
      if (!workspace) {
        sourceRuntime.workspace = null;
        sourceRuntime.baseline = null;
        return null;
      }
      if (workspace.schema !== SOURCE_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA) {
        throw new Error('Unsupported Source Workspace schema');
      }
      const baseline = await sourceDbGet('baselines', workspace.baselineId);
      if (!baseline || baseline.schema !== SOURCE_BASELINE_SCHEMA) {
        throw new Error('Source baseline is missing or damaged');
      }
      if (`baseline:${baseline.sha256}` !== baseline.id) {
        throw new Error('Source baseline identity is damaged');
      }
      let workspaceMigrated = false;
      // Segment maps are derived parser state, not source authority. Recompute them on
      // restore so a runner upgrade can repair stale language classification (notably
      // legacy text/plain JavaScript workspaces persisted as mode=html).
      const canonicalSegmentMapV703 = buildSourceSegmentMap(baseline.text, baseline);
      if (JSON.stringify(workspace.segmentMap || []) !== JSON.stringify(canonicalSegmentMapV703)) {
        workspace.segmentMap = canonicalSegmentMapV703;
        workspaceMigrated = true;
      }
      if (!workspace.working || typeof workspace.working !== 'object') {
        workspace.working = {
          schema: 'vibe-go-working-head/v1',
          sequence: 0,
          headRevisionId: null,
          activeSpanIds: [],
          identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r0`,
          structureDirty: false,
          updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        workspaceMigrated = true;
      }
      const surfaceGcV651 = compactSourceSurfaceLedgerV651(workspace, SemanticSessionStore.load());
      if (surfaceGcV651.changed) {
        workspace.revision = Number(workspace.revision || 0) + 1;
        workspace.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        workspaceMigrated = true;
      }
      if (workspaceMigrated) await sourceDbPut('workspaces', workspace);
      sourceRuntime.workspace = workspace;
      sourceRuntime.baseline = baseline;
      syncSourceProjectionIntoSession(workspace, baseline);
      await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
      return sourceWorkspaceMeta(workspace);
    })();
    try {
      return await sourceRuntime.restorePromise;
    } finally {
      sourceRuntime.restorePromise = null;
    }
  }

  async function createSourceBaselineFromBuffer(buffer, metadata = {}) {
    let bytes;
    if (buffer && typeof buffer.byteLength === 'number' && typeof buffer.slice === 'function') {
      bytes = buffer.slice(0);
    } else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(buffer)) {
      bytes = buffer.buffer.slice(buffer.byteOffset, buffer.byteOffset + buffer.byteLength);
    } else {
      throw new Error('Source baseline requires an ArrayBuffer or typed array');
    }
    const sha256 = await sourceSha256(bytes);
    const text = metadata.text != null
      ? String(metadata.text)
      : new TextDecoder(metadata.encoding || 'utf-8').decode(bytes);
    return {
      schema: SOURCE_BASELINE_SCHEMA,
      id: `baseline:${sha256}`,
      sha256,
      name: String(metadata.name || 'monolith.html'),
      type: String(metadata.type || 'text/html'),
      encoding: String(metadata.encoding || 'utf-8'),
      sizeChars: text.length,
      sizeBytes: bytes.byteLength,
      importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      text,
    };
  }

  function baselineEquivalentWorkingRevision(value, baselineSha256) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!raw || raw === 'baseline') return true;
    const sha = String(baselineSha256 || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!sha) return false;
    const accepted = new Set([
      sha,
      `sha256:${sha}`,
      `baseline:${sha}`,
      `working:${sha}:r0`,
    ]);
    return accepted.has(raw.toLowerCase());
  }

  function shouldRehydrateWorkspaceFromSemanticCursor(session, baseline) {
    const cursor = session?.sourceCursor;
    if (!cursor || typeof cursor !== 'object') return false;
    if (!semanticCursorRequestsWorkspaceProjection(cursor)) return false;
    const desiredSha = semanticCursorBaselineSha(cursor);
    if (!desiredSha) return false;
    if (desiredSha !== String(baseline.sha256).toLowerCase()) {
      throw new Error(
        `Reattached source SHA-256 mismatch: semantic authority expects ${desiredSha}, selected file is ${baseline.sha256}`
      );
    }
    if (!baselineEquivalentWorkingRevision(cursor.workingRevision, baseline.sha256)) {
      throw new Error(
        'Recovered semantic state references a non-baseline Working Source revision, but its persisted working spans are absent. Refusing to reconstruct edited source from baseline alone.'
      );
    }
    return true;
  }

  async function openSourceBuffer(buffer, metadata = {}) {
    const session = requireSourceSession();
    await SourceIntelligence.clear({ persistent: false });
    const baseline = await createSourceBaselineFromBuffer(buffer, metadata);
    await sourceDbPut('baselines', baseline);
    const segmentMap = buildSourceSegmentMap(baseline.text, baseline);
    const firstRange = proposeSourceChunk(baseline.text, 0, {
      ...(metadata.chunk || {}),
      segmentMap,
    });
    let workspace = {
      schema: SOURCE_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA,
      sessionId: session.id,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      revision: 0,
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      settings: {
        ...SOURCE_DEFAULTS,
        ...(metadata.chunk || {}),
      },
      segmentMap,
      cursor: {
        nextOffset: 0,
        activeRange: firstRange,
        coveredRanges: [],
        surfacedRanges: [],
      },
      working: {
        schema: 'vibe-go-working-head/v1',
        sequence: 0,
        headRevisionId: null,
        activeSpanIds: [],
        identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r0`,
        structureDirty: false,
        updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      },
    };

    const rehydrateCursor =
      metadata.rehydrateSemanticCursor !== false &&
      shouldRehydrateWorkspaceFromSemanticCursor(session, baseline);

    if (rehydrateCursor) {
      const staged = stageDeclarativeWorkspaceCursor(
        workspace,
        session.sourceCursor,
        baseline,
        session
      );
      workspace = staged.workspace;
      workspace.recovery = {
        kind: 'semantic-cursor-reattach',
        semanticRevision: session.revision,
        baselineSha256: baseline.sha256,
        rehydratedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }

    sourceRuntime.sessionId = session.id;
    sourceRuntime.baseline = baseline;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = workspace;
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();

    if (rehydrateCursor) {
      const resumed = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (resumed?.status === 'hold' && String(resumed.hold?.reason || '').includes('Source Workspace is absent')) {
        resumed.status = 'active';
        resumed.hold = null;
        resumed.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        SemanticSessionStore.save(resumed);
      }
      log('Authoritative Source Workspace reattached from recovered semantic cursor', {
        sessionId: session.id,
        baselineSha256: baseline.sha256,
        semanticRevision: session.revision,
        nextOffset: workspace.cursor.nextOffset,
        activeRange: workspace.cursor.activeRange,
        coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges),
        surfacedRanges: workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.length,
        surfaceActive: workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved').length,
        surfaceResolved: workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.filter(item => item.status === 'resolved').length,
        surfaceArchiveBuckets: Array.isArray(workspace.cursor.surfaceArchive) ? workspace.cursor.surfaceArchive.length : 0,
        surfaceArchivedTotal: Array.isArray(workspace.cursor.surfaceArchive) ? workspace.cursor.surfaceArchive.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item?.count || 0), 0) : 0,
        surfaceGc: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor.surfaceGc || null),
      });
    }

    scheduleProcess(100);
    return SourceWorkspace.status();
  }

  async function openSourceText(textValue, metadata = {}) {
    const text = String(textValue ?? '');
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(text);
    return openSourceBuffer(bytes.buffer, { ...metadata, text });
  }

  function chooseSourceFile() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'file';
      input.accept = '.html,.htm,.js,.css,.txt,text/html,text/javascript,text/css,text/plain';
      input.style.display = 'none';
      input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const file = input.files?.[0] || null;
        input.remove();
        if (file) resolve(file);
        else reject(new Error('Source file selection was cancelled'));
      }, { once: true });
      document.body.appendChild(input);
      input.click();
    });
  }

  async function openSourceFile(fileInput = null, metadata = {}) {
    const file = fileInput || await chooseSourceFile();
    if (!file || typeof file.arrayBuffer !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('openFile expects a File or a user-selected file');
    }
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    return openSourceBuffer(buffer, {
      ...metadata,
      name: metadata.name || file.name,
      type: metadata.type || file.type || 'text/html',
    });
  }

  function sourceActiveChunkSync() {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const range = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    if (!range) return null;
    const projection = typeof WorkingSource !== 'undefined' && workspace.working
      ? WorkingSource.projectBaselineRange(range.start, range.end)
      : {
          text: baseline.text.slice(range.start, range.end),
          workingRange: { start: range.start, end: range.end },
          touchingSpanIds: [],
        };
    return {
      ...range,
      mode: workspace.cursor.activeRange?.mode || sourceRegionAt(baseline.text, range.start, workspace.segmentMap).mode,
      text: projection.text,
      workingRange: projection.workingRange,
      touchingSpanIds: projection.touchingSpanIds || [],
      baseline: sourceBaselineMeta(baseline),
      workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline',
      workspaceRevision: workspace.revision,
    };
  }

  async function setSourceChunk(start, end, options = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const range = sourceNormalizeRange({ start, end, label: options.label }, baseline.text.length);
    if (!range) throw new Error('Invalid source chunk range');
    workspace.cursor.nextOffset = range.start;
    workspace.cursor.activeRange = {
      ...range,
      mode: options.mode || sourceRegionAt(baseline.text, range.start, workspace.segmentMap).mode,
      proposedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      manual: true,
    };
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return sourceActiveChunkSync();
  }

  async function proposeSourceChunkAt(offset = null, options = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const start = offset == null ? workspace.cursor.nextOffset : offset;
    const range = proposeSourceChunk(
      baseline.text,
      start,
      { ...workspace.settings, ...options, segmentMap: workspace.segmentMap }
    );
    workspace.cursor.nextOffset = range ? range.start : baseline.text.length;
    workspace.cursor.activeRange = range;
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return range ? sourceActiveChunkSync() : null;
  }

  async function resizeSourceChunk({ startBy = 0, endBy = 0, label = '' } = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const current = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    if (!current) throw new Error('No active source chunk');
    return setSourceChunk(
      current.start - Number(startBy || 0),
      current.end + Number(endBy || 0),
      { label: label || current.label }
    );
  }

  async function expandSourceChunk(value = 8000) {
    const options = typeof value === 'object'
      ? value
      : { endBy: Number(value) };
    return resizeSourceChunk({
      startBy: Number(options.before ?? options.startBy ?? 0),
      endBy: Number(options.after ?? options.endBy ?? 0),
      label: options.label || '',
    });
  }

  async function shrinkSourceChunk(value = 4000) {
    const options = typeof value === 'object'
      ? value
      : { endBy: Number(value) };
    return resizeSourceChunk({
      startBy: -Number(options.before ?? options.startBy ?? 0),
      endBy: -Number(options.after ?? options.endBy ?? 0),
      label: options.label || '',
    });
  }

  async function coverActiveSource(options = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const range = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    if (!range) throw new Error('No active source chunk to cover');
    workspace.cursor.coveredRanges = mergeSourceRanges([
      ...workspace.cursor.coveredRanges,
      { ...range, label: options.label || range.label },
    ], baseline.text.length);
    workspace.cursor.nextOffset = range.end;
    if (options.advance === false || range.end >= baseline.text.length) {
      workspace.cursor.activeRange = range.end >= baseline.text.length
        ? null
        : workspace.cursor.activeRange;
    } else {
      workspace.cursor.activeRange = proposeSourceChunk(
        baseline.text,
        range.end,
        { ...workspace.settings, segmentMap: workspace.segmentMap }
      );
    }
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return SourceWorkspace.status();
  }

  async function nextSourceChunk(options = {}) {
    return coverActiveSource({ ...options, advance: true });
  }

  async function surfaceSourceRange(start, end, options = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline, session } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const range = sourceNormalizeRange({ start, end, label: options.label }, baseline.text.length);
    if (!range) throw new Error('Invalid surfaced source range');
    const item = {
      id: String(options.id || semanticId('surface')),
      ...range,
      space: 'baseline',
      baselineStart: range.start,
      baselineEnd: range.end,
      label: String(options.label || range.label || 'surfaced context'),
      reason: String(options.reason || '').trim(),
      distanceId: options.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
      workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline',
      explicitAddressed: options.explicitAddressed === true,
      status: 'active',
      lifecycle: sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(options),
      createdAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.push(item);
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return cloneSemanticValue(item);
  }

  async function resolveSurfacedSource(id) {
    const { workspace } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const item = workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.find(entry => entry.id === id);
    if (!item) return false;
    item.status = 'resolved';
    item.resolvedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return true;
  }

  async function clearSurfacedSource() {
    const { workspace } = requireSourceRuntime();
    workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges = [];
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return true;
  }

  function sourceCommentProjection(range, session, baseline, kind = 'ACTIVE CHUNK') {
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    const returnPoint = session.route.returnPoint
      ? JSON.stringify(session.route.returnPoint)
      : '(none)';
    return [
      `/* ═══ VIBE SOURCE · ${kind} START ═══`,
      ` * Direction: ${session.mission.direction}`,
      ` * Distance: ${active?.objective || '(none)'}`,
      ` * Activity: ${session.route.activity}`,
      ` * Baseline: ${baseline.sha256}`,
      ` * Working: ${sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || 'baseline'}`,
      ` * Source cursor: ${range.start}…${range.end}`,
      ` * Return point: ${returnPoint}`,
      ' * ═══════════════════════════════════════ */',
    ].join('\n');
  }

  function sourceRelevanceTermsV630(value) {
    const stop = new Set([
      'this','that','with','from','into','only','when','then','than','current','continue','after','before','source','working','active','distance','semantic','model','runner',
      'этот','эта','это','этом','когда','после','перед','только','текущий','текущего','дальше','продолжить','источник','модель','работа','рабочий'
    ]);
    const terms = String(value || '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .match(/[a-z_$][a-z0-9_$.-]{3,}|[а-яё][а-яё0-9_-]{3,}/gi) || [];
    return [...new Set(terms.filter(term => !stop.has(term)))].slice(0, 48);
  }

  function semanticFindMatchingDelimiterV631(masked, openIndex, openChar, closeChar) {
    if (masked[openIndex] !== openChar) return -1;
    let depth = 0;
    for (let index = openIndex; index < masked.length; index += 1) {
      if (masked[index] === openChar) depth += 1;
      else if (masked[index] === closeChar) {
        depth -= 1;
        if (depth === 0) return index;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function semanticOwnerDefinitionRangeV631(text, masked, match, spec) {
    const localStart = match.index;
    let bodyBrace = -1;
    if (spec.kind === 'function' || spec.kind === 'assigned-function') {
      const openParen = masked.indexOf('(', localStart);
      const closeParen = openParen >= 0
        ? semanticFindMatchingDelimiterV631(masked, openParen, '(', ')')
        : -1;
      if (closeParen >= 0) bodyBrace = masked.indexOf('{', closeParen + 1);
    } else if (spec.kind === 'class') {
      bodyBrace = masked.indexOf('{', spec.regex.lastIndex);
    } else if (spec.kind === 'assigned-arrow') {
      bodyBrace = masked.lastIndexOf('{', spec.regex.lastIndex);
      if (bodyBrace < localStart) bodyBrace = masked.indexOf('{', spec.regex.lastIndex - 1);
    }
    if (bodyBrace >= 0 && bodyBrace <= localStart + 3200) {
      const closeBrace = intelligenceFindMatchingBrace(masked, bodyBrace);
      if (closeBrace >= 0) return { start: localStart, end: closeBrace + 1 };
    }
    return intelligenceDefinitionRange(text, masked, localStart, spec.regex.lastIndex, 0);
  }

  function semanticEvidenceBoundaryProjectionV631(rawText, item, session) {
    const text = String(rawText || '');
    const base = {
      text,
      strategy: 'raw-surface-fallback',
      reason: 'no-semantic-boundary',
      owner: null,
      originalChars: text.length,
      projectedChars: text.length,
      trimmedChars: 0,
      candidates: 0,
      usable: true,
    };
    if (!text || text.length < 1200) return { ...base, reason: 'surface-already-small' };

    const rawMode = String(item?.mode || '').toLowerCase();
    const likelyJavascript = rawMode === 'javascript' || rawMode === 'js' || /\b(?:function|const|let|var|async|await)\b/.test(text);
    if (!likelyJavascript) return { ...base, reason: 'non-javascript-surface' };

    const masked = intelligenceMaskJavaScript(text);
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    const recentWork = Array.isArray(session?.worklog) ? session.worklog.at(-1) : null;
    const terms = sourceRelevanceTermsV630([
      active?.objective || '',
      session?.route?.nextFocus || '',
      item?.label || '',
      item?.reason || '',
    ].join('\n'));
    const labelHay = `${item?.label || ''} ${item?.reason || ''}`.toLowerCase();
    const candidates = [];
    const specs = [
      { kind: 'function', regex: /\b(?:async\s+)?function\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(/g, nameGroup: 1 },
      { kind: 'class', regex: /\bclass\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\b/g, nameGroup: 1 },
      { kind: 'assigned-function', regex: /\b([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=\s*(?:async\s+)?function\s*\(/g, nameGroup: 1 },
      { kind: 'assigned-arrow', regex: /\b(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\([^)]*\)|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=>\s*\{/g, nameGroup: 1 },
    ];
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const spec of specs) {
      let match;
      while ((match = spec.regex.exec(masked)) !== null) {
        const name = String(match[spec.nameGroup] || '');
        if (!name) continue;
        const range = semanticOwnerDefinitionRangeV631(text, masked, match, spec);
        if (!range || range.end <= range.start) continue;
        const key = `${range.start}:${range.end}`;
        if (seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);
        const body = text.slice(range.start, range.end);
        const hay = `${name} ${body}`.toLowerCase();
        let score = 0;
        for (const term of terms) {
          if (name.toLowerCase().includes(term)) score += term.length >= 8 ? 24 : 14;
          else if (hay.includes(term)) score += term.length >= 10 ? 6 : 3;
          if (labelHay.includes(term) && hay.includes(term)) score += 2;
        }
        if (labelHay.includes(name.toLowerCase())) score += 18;
        if (spec.kind === 'function' || spec.kind === 'assigned-function') score += 3;
        candidates.push({ name, kind: spec.kind, start: range.start, end: range.end, score, chars: range.end - range.start });
      }
    }
    if (!candidates.length) return { ...base, reason: 'no-named-owner-boundary' };

    candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.chars - b.chars || a.start - b.start);
    const best = candidates[0];
    const maxChars = Math.max(1200, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalEvidenceOwnerMaxCharsV631 || 9000));
    if (best.score <= 0) return { ...base, reason: 'no-relevant-owner-boundary', candidates: candidates.length };
    if (best.chars > maxChars) return { ...base, reason: 'owner-boundary-too-large', owner: best.name, candidates: candidates.length };

    // A persisted surface may begin in the middle of the relevant owner and only contain the
    // declaration of the *next* adjacent function. Never "trim" such a fragment into the wrong
    // neighbour merely because that neighbour is the only syntactically complete definition.
    // If the surface label does not name the candidate and the leading fragment itself carries
    // current-focus terms, fail back to the lossless raw surface.
    const labelNamesBest = labelHay.includes(best.name.toLowerCase());
    if (best.start > 240 && !labelNamesBest) {
      const prefixHay = text.slice(0, best.start).toLowerCase();
      const relevantPrefixTerms = terms.filter(term => prefixHay.includes(term));
      if (relevantPrefixTerms.length) {
        return {
          ...base,
          reason: `leading-fragment-relevant-before-${best.name}`,
          owner: best.name,
          candidates: candidates.length,
        };
      }
    }

    // Keep a short immediately preceding comment when it is physically adjacent to the owner.
    let start = best.start;
    const preceding = text.slice(Math.max(0, best.start - 420), best.start);
    const commentMatch = preceding.match(/(?:\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|\/\/[^\n]*\n?)\s*$/);
    if (commentMatch) start = best.start - commentMatch[0].length;
    const projected = text.slice(start, best.end).trimEnd();
    const trimmed = Math.max(0, text.length - projected.length);
    const ownerMinCharsV634 = Math.max(120, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalEvidenceOwnerMinCharsV634 || 220));
    if (projected && projected.length < ownerMinCharsV634 && text.length >= ownerMinCharsV634 * 2) {
      return {
        text: '',
        strategy: 'boundary-insufficient',
        reason: `owner-projection-too-small:${best.name}:${projected.length}<${ownerMinCharsV634}`,
        owner: best.name,
        originalChars: text.length,
        projectedChars: 0,
        trimmedChars: text.length,
        candidates: candidates.length,
        usable: false,
      };
    }
    if (!projected || trimmed < Math.max(240, Math.floor(text.length * 0.08))) {
      return { ...base, reason: 'semantic-boundary-no-material-trim', owner: best.name, candidates: candidates.length };
    }
    return {
      text: projected,
      strategy: 'semantic-owner-definition',
      reason: `best-owner:${best.kind}:${best.name}:score=${best.score}`,
      owner: best.name,
      originalChars: text.length,
      projectedChars: projected.length,
      trimmedChars: trimmed,
      candidates: candidates.length,
      usable: true,
    };
  }

  function semanticMetadataCodeIdentifiersV632(value) {
    const tokens = String(value || '').match(/\b[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]{5,}\b/g) || [];
    return [...new Set(tokens.filter(token => {
      if (/^v\d+$/i.test(token)) return false;
      if (/^[A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(token)) return false;
      return /[a-z][A-Z]/.test(token) || /_[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(token) || token.includes('$');
    }))].slice(0, 12);
  }

  function semanticSurfaceProjectedTextV632(item, workspace, baseline) {
    if (!item || !workspace || !baseline) return '';
    try {
      if (item.space === 'working') {
        const start = Number(item.workingStart);
        const end = Number(item.workingEnd);
        if (!Number.isFinite(start) || !Number.isFinite(end) || end <= start) return '';
        return String(WorkingSource.projectWorkingRange(start, end)?.text || '');
      }
      const range = sourceNormalizeRange(item, baseline.text.length);
      if (!range) return '';
      return String(WorkingSource.projectBaselineRange(range.start, range.end)?.text || '');
    } catch (_) {
      return '';
    }
  }

  function semanticSurfaceIdentityV632(rawText, item, session, focusTermsInput = null) {
    const text = String(rawText || '');
    const metadata = `${item?.label || ''} ${item?.reason || ''}`.trim();
    const identifiers = semanticMetadataCodeIdentifiersV632(metadata);
    const presentIdentifiers = identifiers.filter(identifier => text.includes(identifier));
    const missingIdentifiers = identifiers.filter(identifier => !text.includes(identifier));
    const focusTerms = Array.isArray(focusTermsInput)
      ? focusTermsInput
      : sourceRelevanceTermsV630([
          semanticActiveDistance(session)?.objective || '',
          session?.route?.nextFocus || '',
        ].join('\n'));
    const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
    const factualFocusHits = focusTerms.filter(term => lowerText.includes(term));
    const valid = identifiers.length === 0 || presentIdentifiers.length > 0;
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-evidence-identity/v1',
      valid,
      reason: valid
        ? (identifiers.length ? 'metadata-identifier-confirmed' : 'no-concrete-metadata-identifier')
        : `metadata-identifier-missing:${identifiers.join(',')}`,
      identifiers,
      presentIdentifiers,
      missingIdentifiers,
      factualFocusHits: factualFocusHits.slice(0, 16),
      factualFocusHitCount: factualFocusHits.length,
      rawChars: text.length,
    };
  }

  function semanticMetadataClaimTermsV635(item) {
    const metadata = `${item?.label || ''} ${item?.reason || ''}`.trim();
    const concrete = new Set(semanticMetadataCodeIdentifiersV632(metadata).map(value => semanticFocusCompactV633(value)));
    const generic = new Set([
      'full','current','body','lifecycle','contract','exact','source','surface','working','definition','definitions','consumer','consumers',
      'late','legacy','normalized','modal','loader','terminal','owner','owners','async','function','path','code','vibe','current','local',
      'repair','repaired','continuation','post','pre','read','write','writer','reader','runtime','generation'
    ]);
    return sourceRelevanceTermsV630(metadata)
      .filter(term => {
        const compact = semanticFocusCompactV633(term);
        if (!compact || compact.length < 5) return false;
        if (generic.has(term) || generic.has(compact)) return false;
        if (/^v\d+$/i.test(compact)) return false;
        if (concrete.has(compact)) return false;
        return true;
      })
      .slice(0, 18);
  }

  function semanticEvidenceTermPresentV635(text, term) {
    const source = String(text || '');
    const lower = source.toLowerCase();
    const lowerTerm = String(term || '').toLowerCase();
    const compactText = semanticFocusCompactV633(source);
    const compactTerm = semanticFocusCompactV633(term);
    if (!compactTerm || compactTerm.length < 5) return false;
    return lower.includes(lowerTerm) || compactText.includes(compactTerm);
  }

  function semanticFinalEvidenceAdmissionV635(boundary, item, session, focusProfile) {
    const text = String(boundary?.text || '');
    const metadata = `${item?.label || ''} ${item?.reason || ''}`.trim();
    const identifiers = semanticMetadataCodeIdentifiersV632(metadata);
    const presentIdentifiers = identifiers.filter(identifier => text.includes(identifier));
    const missingIdentifiers = identifiers.filter(identifier => !text.includes(identifier));
    const claimTerms = semanticMetadataClaimTermsV635(item);
    const claimHits = claimTerms.filter(term => semanticEvidenceTermPresentV635(text, term));
    const claimRatio = claimTerms.length ? claimHits.length / claimTerms.length : 1;
    const minClaimTerms = Math.max(1, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalFinalClaimMinTermsV635 || 3));
    const minClaimRatio = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(0.9, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalFinalClaimMinRatioV635 || 0.5)));
    const coherence = semanticSurfaceFocusCoherenceV633(text, focusProfile);
    let accepted = boundary?.usable !== false && Boolean(text.trim());
    let reason = 'accepted';
    if (accepted && identifiers.length && !presentIdentifiers.length) {
      accepted = false;
      reason = `final-metadata-identifier-missing:${identifiers.join(',')}`;
    }
    if (accepted && !identifiers.length && claimTerms.length >= minClaimTerms && claimRatio < minClaimRatio) {
      accepted = false;
      reason = `final-claim-fidelity:${claimHits.length}/${claimTerms.length}<${minClaimRatio.toFixed(2)}`;
    }
    if (accepted && !coherence.coherent) {
      accepted = false;
      reason = `final-focus-tier:${coherence.tier}<2`;
    }
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-final-evidence-admission/v1',
      accepted,
      reason,
      chars: text.length,
      identifiers,
      presentIdentifiers,
      missingIdentifiers,
      claimTerms,
      claimHits,
      claimRatio,
      focusTier: coherence.tier,
      strongAnchorHits: coherence.strongAnchorHits,
      supportingHits: coherence.supportingHits,
      identifierHits: coherence.identifierHits,
      coherence,
    };
  }

  function semanticFocusCompactV633(value) {
    return String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-zа-яё0-9_$]+/gi, '');
  }

  function semanticFocusProfileV633(session) {
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    const nextFocus = String(session?.route?.nextFocus || '').trim();
    const fallbackFocus = String(active?.objective || '').trim();
    const primaryFocusText = nextFocus || fallbackFocus;
    const primaryText = nextFocus || fallbackFocus;
    const generic = new Set([
      'audit','auditing','remaining','remain','same','distinction','effects','effect','continue','continued','continuation','applied','apply','async','owner','owners','current','existing','without','across','after','before','through','between','against','using','used','result','results','actual','factual','engineering','problem','question','path','code','function','functions','surface','surfaces',
      'runtime','generation','generations','recovered','recover','identifier','identifiers','captures','capture','reacquires','reacquire','validating','validate','cannot','finally','ordinary','local','exact','remaining','stale','same','distinction','effects','effect',
      'проверить','проверка','продолжить','оставшийся','оставшиеся','текущий','текущая','результат','фактический','инженерный'
    ]);
    const distanceTerms = new Set(sourceRelevanceTermsV630(String(active?.objective || ''))
      .map(term => semanticFocusCompactV633(term)));
    const strongAnchorTerms = sourceRelevanceTermsV630(primaryFocusText)
      .filter(term => {
        const compact = semanticFocusCompactV633(term);
        if (generic.has(term) || generic.has(compact)) return false;
        if (distanceTerms.has(compact)) return false;
        return compact.length >= 6;
      })
      .slice(0, Math.max(8, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalFocusAnchorLimitV633 || 24)));
    // Model-authored prior summaries are intentionally excluded from source-evidence
    // relevance. Tactical focus remains advisory; only current Distance/focus metadata
    // and factual source metadata participate in bounded ranking.
    const supportingTerms = [];
    const identifiers = semanticMetadataCodeIdentifiersV632(primaryText).slice(0, 12);
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-focus-profile/v2',
      primaryText,
      primaryFocusText,
      anchorTerms: strongAnchorTerms,
      strongAnchorTerms,
      supportingTerms,
      identifiers,
    };
  }

  function semanticSurfaceFocusCoherenceV633(rawText, profile) {
    const text = String(rawText || '');
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    const compactText = semanticFocusCompactV633(text);
    const identifierHits = (profile?.identifiers || []).filter(identifier => text.includes(identifier));
    const hitTerms = terms => (terms || []).filter(term => {
      const lowerTerm = String(term || '').toLowerCase();
      const compactTerm = semanticFocusCompactV633(term);
      if (!compactTerm || compactTerm.length < 6) return false;
      return lower.includes(lowerTerm) || compactText.includes(compactTerm);
    });
    const strongAnchorHits = hitTerms(profile?.strongAnchorTerms || profile?.anchorTerms || []);
    const supportingHits = hitTerms(profile?.supportingTerms || []);
