    const minHits = Math.max(2, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalFocusCoherentMinHitsV633 || 2));
    const tier = identifierHits.length
      ? 3
      : strongAnchorHits.length >= minHits
        ? 2
        : strongAnchorHits.length
          ? 1
          : 0;
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-focus-coherence/v2',
      tier,
      coherent: tier >= 2,
      marginal: tier === 1,
      identifierHits: identifierHits.slice(0, 8),
      anchorHits: strongAnchorHits.slice(0, 12),
      strongAnchorHits: strongAnchorHits.slice(0, 12),
      supportingHits: supportingHits.slice(0, 12),
      anchorHitCount: strongAnchorHits.length,
      supportingHitCount: supportingHits.length,
    };
  }

  function semanticEvidenceEnvelopeV634(item) {
    if (!item) return null;
    if (item.space === 'working') {
      const start = Number(item.workingStart);
      const end = Number(item.workingEnd);
      if (Number.isFinite(start) && Number.isFinite(end) && end > start) return { space: 'working', start, end };
      const baselineStart = Number(item.baselineStart);
      const baselineEnd = Number(item.baselineEnd);
      if (Number.isFinite(baselineStart) && Number.isFinite(baselineEnd) && baselineEnd > baselineStart) return { space: 'baseline', start: baselineStart, end: baselineEnd };
      return null;
    }
    const start = Number(item.baselineStart ?? item.start);
    const end = Number(item.baselineEnd ?? item.end);
    if (!Number.isFinite(start) || !Number.isFinite(end) || end <= start) return null;
    return { space: 'baseline', start, end };
  }

  function semanticEvidenceOverlapRatioV634(left, right) {
    const a = semanticEvidenceEnvelopeV634(left);
    const b = semanticEvidenceEnvelopeV634(right);
    if (!a || !b || a.space !== b.space) return 0;
    const intersection = Math.max(0, Math.min(a.end, b.end) - Math.max(a.start, b.start));
    const shorter = Math.max(1, Math.min(a.end - a.start, b.end - b.start));
    return intersection / shorter;
  }

  function semanticEvidenceContentContainsV634(leftText, rightText) {
    const a = normalizeText(leftText);
    const b = normalizeText(rightText);
    if (Math.min(a.length, b.length) < 180) return false;
    const short = a.length <= b.length ? a : b;
    const long = a.length <= b.length ? b : a;
    return long.includes(short);
  }

  function semanticEvidenceDuplicateReasonV634(candidate, selected) {
    const candidateOwner = String(candidate?.boundaryV631?.owner || '').trim();
    const selectedOwner = String(selected?.boundaryV631?.owner || '').trim();
    if (candidateOwner && selectedOwner && candidateOwner === selectedOwner) return `same-owner:${candidateOwner}`;
    const overlap = semanticEvidenceOverlapRatioV634(candidate?.item, selected?.item);
    const threshold = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(0.95, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalEvidenceOverlapThresholdV634 || 0.65)));
    if (overlap >= threshold) return `source-overlap:${overlap.toFixed(3)}`;
    if (semanticEvidenceContentContainsV634(candidate?.boundaryV631?.text || candidate?.rawText, selected?.boundaryV631?.text || selected?.rawText)) {
      return 'content-contained';
    }
    return '';
  }

  function relevantSourceSurfacesV630(session, workspace, options = {}) {
    const activeId = String(session?.route?.activeDistanceId || '');
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    const terms = sourceRelevanceTermsV630([
      active?.objective || '',
      session?.route?.nextFocus || '',
    ].join('\n'));
    const identityMetrics = options?.identityMetricsV632 && typeof options.identityMetricsV632 === 'object'
      ? options.identityMetricsV632
      : null;
    const focusMetrics = options?.focusMetricsV633 && typeof options.focusMetricsV633 === 'object'
      ? options.focusMetricsV633
      : null;
    const diversityMetrics = options?.diversityMetricsV634 && typeof options.diversityMetricsV634 === 'object'
      ? options.diversityMetricsV634
      : null;
    const finalAdmissionMetricsV635 = options?.finalAdmissionMetricsV635 && typeof options.finalAdmissionMetricsV635 === 'object'
      ? options.finalAdmissionMetricsV635
      : null;
    const focusProfileV633 = semanticFocusProfileV633(session);
    const finalLimit = Math.max(1, Number(options.limit || CONFIG.semanticNormalSurfaceLimitV630 || 4));
    const multiplier = Math.max(2, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalSurfaceCandidateMultiplierV632 || 6));
    const poolLimit = Math.max(finalLimit, finalLimit * multiplier);
    // Never materialize thousands of persisted surfaces just to rank a normal turn.
    // Metadata ranking is cheap; factual source identity is checked only for a bounded
    // shortlist large enough to backfill rejected/stale candidates.
    const factualProbeLimit = Math.max(poolLimit, finalLimit * 12, 32);
    if (identityMetrics) {
      identityMetrics.schema = 'vibe-go-evidence-identity/v1';
      identityMetrics.totalUnresolvedCandidates = 0;
      identityMetrics.factualProbeLimit = factualProbeLimit;
      identityMetrics.candidatesEvaluated = 0;
      identityMetrics.rejectedMetadataMismatch = 0;
      identityMetrics.validCandidates = 0;
      identityMetrics.deferredUninspected = 0;
      identityMetrics.rejected = [];
      identityMetrics.selected = [];
    }
    if (focusMetrics) {
      focusMetrics.schema = 'vibe-go-focus-coherence/v2';
      focusMetrics.primaryText = semanticClipText(focusProfileV633.primaryText, 1200);
      focusMetrics.anchorTerms = [...focusProfileV633.strongAnchorTerms];
      focusMetrics.strongAnchorTerms = [...focusProfileV633.strongAnchorTerms];
      focusMetrics.supportingTerms = [...focusProfileV633.supportingTerms];
      focusMetrics.identifiers = [...focusProfileV633.identifiers];
      focusMetrics.candidatesEvaluated = 0;
      focusMetrics.coherentCandidates = 0;
      focusMetrics.marginalCandidates = 0;
      focusMetrics.incoherentCandidates = 0;
      focusMetrics.selectedCoherent = 0;
      focusMetrics.selectedMarginal = 0;
      focusMetrics.backfillIncoherent = 0;
      focusMetrics.selected = [];
    }
    if (diversityMetrics) {
      diversityMetrics.schema = 'vibe-go-evidence-diversity/v1';
      diversityMetrics.overlapThreshold = Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalEvidenceOverlapThresholdV634 || 0.65);
      diversityMetrics.candidatesConsidered = 0;
      diversityMetrics.boundaryInsufficientRejected = 0;
      diversityMetrics.duplicateRejected = 0;
      diversityMetrics.backfilled = 0;
      diversityMetrics.rejected = [];
      diversityMetrics.selected = [];
    }
    if (finalAdmissionMetricsV635) {
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.schema = 'vibe-go-final-evidence-admission/v1';
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.candidatesEvaluated = 0;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.acceptedCandidates = 0;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedCandidates = 0;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedClaimFidelity = 0;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedFinalIdentity = 0;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedFinalFocus = 0;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejected = [];
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.selected = [];
    }
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline;
    const now = Date.now();
    const metadataCandidates = (Array.isArray(workspace?.cursor?.surfacedRanges) ? workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges : [])
      .filter(item => item?.status !== 'resolved')
      .map((item, index) => {
        const hay = `${item?.label || ''} ${item?.reason || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        let metadataScore = String(item?.distanceId || '') === activeId && activeId ? 16 : 0;
        for (const term of terms) {
          if (hay.includes(term)) metadataScore += term.length >= 10 ? 8 : 4;
        }
        const created = Date.parse(String(item?.createdAt || ''));
        if (Number.isFinite(created)) {
          const ageHours = Math.max(0, (now - created) / 3600000);
          metadataScore += ageHours < 1 ? 8 : ageHours < 12 ? 5 : ageHours < 48 ? 3 : 0;
        }
        return { item, metadataScore, index };
      });
    metadataCandidates.sort((a, b) => b.metadataScore - a.metadataScore || b.index - a.index);
    if (identityMetrics) {
      identityMetrics.totalUnresolvedCandidates = metadataCandidates.length;
      identityMetrics.deferredUninspected = Math.max(0, metadataCandidates.length - factualProbeLimit);
    }

    const inspected = metadataCandidates.slice(0, factualProbeLimit).map(entry => {
      const rawText = semanticSurfaceProjectedTextV632(entry.item, workspace, baseline);
      const identity = semanticSurfaceIdentityV632(rawText, entry.item, session, terms);
      const rawCoherenceV633 = semanticSurfaceFocusCoherenceV633(rawText, focusProfileV633);
      const boundaryV631 = semanticEvidenceBoundaryProjectionV631(rawText, entry.item, session);
      const finalAdmissionV635 = semanticFinalEvidenceAdmissionV635(boundaryV631, entry.item, session, focusProfileV633);
      const coherenceV633 = finalAdmissionV635.coherence;
      let score = entry.metadataScore;
      // Factual content must participate in relevance. Metadata can nominate a candidate,
      // but it cannot make an unrelated coordinate slab authoritative.
      score += Math.min(24, identity.factualFocusHitCount * 3);
      if (identity.presentIdentifiers.length) score += 18 + Math.min(12, identity.presentIdentifiers.length * 4);
      // a33: current-focus coherence outranks broad same-Distance/cache/page relevance.
      // Exact current-focus identifiers form the strongest tier; two or more strong
      // compound/domain anchors form the next tier. A single anchor is only marginal.
      score += coherenceV633.tier * 24;
      score += Math.min(24, coherenceV633.anchorHitCount * 5);
      // Supporting narrative terms may refine order inside an already coherent tier,
      // but they cannot create that tier.
      score += Math.min(8, coherenceV633.supportingHitCount * 2);
      score += Math.min(30, coherenceV633.identifierHits.length * 15);
      if (!identity.valid || boundaryV631.usable === false || !finalAdmissionV635.accepted) score = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;

      if (focusMetrics) {
        focusMetrics.candidatesEvaluated += 1;
        if (coherenceV633.coherent) focusMetrics.coherentCandidates += 1;
        else if (coherenceV633.marginal) focusMetrics.marginalCandidates += 1;
        else focusMetrics.incoherentCandidates += 1;
      }

      if (identityMetrics) {
        identityMetrics.candidatesEvaluated += 1;
        if (identity.valid) identityMetrics.validCandidates += 1;
        else {
          identityMetrics.rejectedMetadataMismatch += 1;
          if (identityMetrics.rejected.length < 12) identityMetrics.rejected.push({
            id: entry.item?.id || null,
            label: entry.item?.label || '',
            reason: identity.reason,
            identifiers: identity.identifiers,
            rawChars: identity.rawChars,
          });
        }
      }
      if (diversityMetrics && boundaryV631.usable === false) {
        diversityMetrics.boundaryInsufficientRejected += 1;
        if (diversityMetrics.rejected.length < 16) diversityMetrics.rejected.push({
          id: entry.item?.id || null,
          label: entry.item?.label || '',
          reason: boundaryV631.reason,
          kind: 'boundary-insufficient',
          originalChars: boundaryV631.originalChars,
          projectedChars: boundaryV631.projectedChars,
        });
      }
      if (finalAdmissionMetricsV635) {
        finalAdmissionMetricsV635.candidatesEvaluated += 1;
        if (finalAdmissionV635.accepted) finalAdmissionMetricsV635.acceptedCandidates += 1;
        else {
          finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedCandidates += 1;
          if (finalAdmissionV635.reason.startsWith('final-claim-fidelity:')) finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedClaimFidelity += 1;
          else if (finalAdmissionV635.reason.startsWith('final-metadata-identifier-missing:')) finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedFinalIdentity += 1;
          else if (finalAdmissionV635.reason.startsWith('final-focus-tier:')) finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedFinalFocus += 1;
          if (finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejected.length < 16) finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejected.push({
            id: entry.item?.id || null,
            label: entry.item?.label || '',
            reason: finalAdmissionV635.reason,
            focusTier: finalAdmissionV635.focusTier,
            claimHits: finalAdmissionV635.claimHits,
            claimTerms: finalAdmissionV635.claimTerms,
            claimRatio: finalAdmissionV635.claimRatio,
            presentIdentifiers: finalAdmissionV635.presentIdentifiers,
            chars: finalAdmissionV635.chars,
          });
        }
      }
      return {
        item: { ...entry.item, __evidenceIdentityV632: identity, __evidenceBoundaryV631: boundaryV631 },
        score,
        metadataScore: entry.metadataScore,
        index: entry.index,
        identity,
        rawCoherenceV633,
        coherenceV633,
        boundaryV631,
        finalAdmissionV635,
        rawText,
      };
    }).filter(entry => entry.identity.valid && entry.boundaryV631.usable !== false && entry.finalAdmissionV635.accepted);

    // a34: current-focus tier remains the primary ordering key, but only strong
    // anchors can create tier 2. Supporting/generic narrative words merely refine score.
    inspected.sort((a, b) =>
      b.coherenceV633.tier - a.coherenceV633.tier ||
      b.coherenceV633.anchorHitCount - a.coherenceV633.anchorHitCount ||
      b.score - a.score ||
      b.metadataScore - a.metadataScore ||
      b.index - a.index
    );
    const coherent = inspected.filter(entry => entry.coherenceV633.coherent && entry.score > 0);
    const marginal = inspected.filter(entry => entry.coherenceV633.marginal && entry.score > 0);
    const incoherent = inspected.filter(entry => entry.coherenceV633.tier === 0 && entry.score > 0);
    // a35: model-facing evidence is an admission set, not a quota. Marginal/incoherent
    // candidates remain local telemetry and can be inspected through QUERY/READ_RANGE,
    // but they never fill empty slots in an ordinary thin dispatch.
    const ordered = coherent;
    const orderedPool = ordered.slice(0, Math.max(poolLimit * 3, poolLimit));

    // Final evidence slots must add information, not repeat the same owner/range.
    // Diversity is enforced only on this bounded factual pool; no full-surface scan.
    const diverse = [];
    const duplicateDeferred = [];
    for (const candidate of orderedPool) {
      if (diversityMetrics) diversityMetrics.candidatesConsidered += 1;
      const duplicate = diverse.find(chosen => semanticEvidenceDuplicateReasonV634(candidate, chosen));
      if (duplicate) {
        const reason = semanticEvidenceDuplicateReasonV634(candidate, duplicate);
        duplicateDeferred.push(candidate);
        if (diversityMetrics) {
          diversityMetrics.duplicateRejected += 1;
          if (diversityMetrics.rejected.length < 16) diversityMetrics.rejected.push({
            id: candidate.item?.id || null,
            label: candidate.item?.label || '',
            kind: 'duplicate',
            reason,
            duplicateOf: duplicate.item?.id || null,
          });
        }
        continue;
      }
      diverse.push(candidate);
      if (diverse.length >= poolLimit) break;
    }
    // Do not refill a model-facing slot with known duplicate evidence merely to hit
    // the nominal quota. Fewer independent blocks are better than redundant context.
    const selected = diverse.slice(0, poolLimit);
    const finalSelected = selected.slice(0, finalLimit);
    if (diversityMetrics) {
      const nominalTopV634 = orderedPool.slice(0, finalLimit);
      diversityMetrics.backfilled = finalSelected.filter(entry => !nominalTopV634.includes(entry)).length;
      diversityMetrics.independentSelected = finalSelected.length;
      diversityMetrics.selected = finalSelected.map(entry => ({
        id: entry.item?.id || null,
        label: entry.item?.label || '',
        owner: entry.boundaryV631?.owner || null,
        strategy: entry.boundaryV631?.strategy || null,
        tier: entry.coherenceV633.tier,
        strongAnchorHits: entry.coherenceV633.strongAnchorHits,
        identifierHits: entry.coherenceV633.identifierHits,
      }));
    }
    if (focusMetrics) {
      focusMetrics.selectedCoherent = finalSelected.filter(entry => entry.coherenceV633.coherent).length;
      focusMetrics.selectedMarginal = finalSelected.filter(entry => entry.coherenceV633.marginal).length;
      focusMetrics.backfillIncoherent = finalSelected.filter(entry => entry.coherenceV633.tier === 0).length;
      focusMetrics.selected = finalSelected.map(entry => ({
        id: entry.item?.id || null,
        label: entry.item?.label || '',
        tier: entry.coherenceV633.tier,
        coherent: entry.coherenceV633.coherent,
        anchorHits: entry.coherenceV633.anchorHits,
        strongAnchorHits: entry.coherenceV633.strongAnchorHits,
        supportingHits: entry.coherenceV633.supportingHits,
        identifierHits: entry.coherenceV633.identifierHits,
        score: Number.isFinite(entry.score) ? entry.score : null,
      }));
    }
    if (identityMetrics) {
      identityMetrics.candidatePoolLimit = poolLimit;
      identityMetrics.selected = finalSelected.map(entry => ({
        id: entry.item?.id || null,
        label: entry.item?.label || '',
        score: Number.isFinite(entry.score) ? entry.score : null,
        metadataScore: Number.isFinite(entry.metadataScore) ? entry.metadataScore : null,
        identityReason: entry.identity.reason,
        presentIdentifiers: entry.identity.presentIdentifiers,
        factualFocusHitCount: entry.identity.factualFocusHitCount,
      }));
    }
    if (finalAdmissionMetricsV635) {
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.selected = finalSelected.map(entry => ({
        id: entry.item?.id || null,
        label: entry.item?.label || '',
        reason: entry.finalAdmissionV635.reason,
        focusTier: entry.finalAdmissionV635.focusTier,
        claimRatio: entry.finalAdmissionV635.claimRatio,
        claimHits: entry.finalAdmissionV635.claimHits,
        claimTerms: entry.finalAdmissionV635.claimTerms,
        presentIdentifiers: entry.finalAdmissionV635.presentIdentifiers,
      }));
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.independentSelected = finalSelected.length;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.marginalAvailableButNotAdmitted = marginal.length;
      finalAdmissionMetricsV635.incoherentAvailableButNotAdmitted = incoherent.length;
    }
    return selected.map(entry => entry.item);
  }

  function buildSourceDispatchContextSync(sessionInput, options = {}) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return 'SOURCE WORKSPACE\n(no semantic session)';
    if (
      sourceRuntime.sessionId !== session.id ||
      !sourceRuntime.workspace ||
      !sourceRuntime.baseline
    ) {
      const pointer = session.sourceCursor?.baselineId || session.sourceCursor?.baseline || null;
      return [
        'SOURCE WORKSPACE',
        pointer
          ? `Baseline pointer exists but workspace is not restored: ${JSON.stringify(pointer)}`
          : '(no baseline loaded)',
      ].join('\n');
    }
    const workspace = sourceRuntime.workspace;
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline;
    const thinNormalV630 = options?.thinNormal === true;
    const surfaceLimitV643 = thinNormalV630
      ? Math.max(1, Number(options?.surfaceLimitV643 || CONFIG.semanticNormalSurfaceLimitV630 || 4))
      : null;
    const sourceEvidenceCharsV643 = thinNormalV630
      ? Math.max(2000, Number(options?.sourceEvidenceCharsV643 || CONFIG.semanticNormalSourceEvidenceCharsV630 || 16000))
      : null;
    const relevanceMetricsV631 = options?.relevanceMetricsV631 && typeof options.relevanceMetricsV631 === 'object'
      ? options.relevanceMetricsV631
      : null;
    const identityMetricsV632 = options?.identityMetricsV632 && typeof options.identityMetricsV632 === 'object'
      ? options.identityMetricsV632
      : null;
    const focusMetricsV633 = options?.focusMetricsV633 && typeof options.focusMetricsV633 === 'object'
      ? options.focusMetricsV633
      : null;
    const diversityMetricsV634 = options?.diversityMetricsV634 && typeof options.diversityMetricsV634 === 'object'
      ? options.diversityMetricsV634
      : null;
    const finalAdmissionMetricsV635 = options?.finalAdmissionMetricsV635 && typeof options.finalAdmissionMetricsV635 === 'object'
      ? options.finalAdmissionMetricsV635
      : null;
    if (relevanceMetricsV631) {
      relevanceMetricsV631.schema = 'vibe-go-relevance-boundary/v1';
      relevanceMetricsV631.selectedSurfaceChars = 0;
      relevanceMetricsV631.projectedEvidenceChars = 0;
      relevanceMetricsV631.trimmedIrrelevantChars = 0;
      relevanceMetricsV631.surfaces = [];
    }
    const activeRange = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    const allUnresolvedSurfaced = workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges
      .filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved');
    const currentAcceptanceSequenceV703 = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const explicitSurfacedV703 = thinNormalV630
      ? allUnresolvedSurfaced
          .filter(item =>
            item?.explicitAddressed === true &&
            Number.isInteger(Number(item?.createdAcceptanceSequence)) &&
            Number(item.createdAcceptanceSequence) === Number(currentAcceptanceSequenceV703)
          )
          .sort((a, b) => sourceSurfaceChronologyV651(b) - sourceSurfaceChronologyV651(a))
          .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(CONFIG.semanticExplicitReadMaxPerBatchV703 || 2)))
      : [];
    const scoredSurfacedV630 = thinNormalV630
      ? relevantSourceSurfacesV630(session, workspace, { limit: surfaceLimitV643, identityMetricsV632, focusMetricsV633, diversityMetricsV634, finalAdmissionMetricsV635 })
      : null;
    const relevantSurfacedV630 = thinNormalV630
      ? [...explicitSurfacedV703, ...(scoredSurfacedV630 || []).filter(item => !explicitSurfacedV703.some(explicit => explicit.id === item.id))]
          .slice(0, Math.max(surfaceLimitV643, explicitSurfacedV703.length))
      : null;
    const includeActiveChunkV630 = !thinNormalV630 || !relevantSurfacedV630?.length;
    const lines = thinNormalV630
      ? [
          'SOURCE WORKSPACE · RELEVANCE PROJECTION',
          `Working r${Number(workspace.working?.sequence || 0)} · workspace r${Number(workspace.revision || 0)} · ` +
            `physical cursor ${activeRange ? `${activeRange.start}…${activeRange.end}` : 'EOF'} · ` +
            `covered ${sourceCoveredThrough(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges)} contiguous · ` +
            `${allUnresolvedSurfaced.length} unresolved surface(s) persisted`,
        ]
      : [
          'SOURCE WORKSPACE · WORKING SOURCE',
          JSON.stringify({
            baseline: sourceBaselineMeta(baseline),
            workspaceRevision: workspace.revision,
            working: workspace.working ? {
              schema: workspace.working.schema || 'vibe-go-working-head/v1',
              sequence: Number(workspace.working.sequence || 0),
              headRevisionId: workspace.working.headRevisionId || null,
              activeSpanCount: Array.isArray(workspace.working.activeSpanIds)
                ? workspace.working.activeSpanIds.length
                : 0,
              identity: workspace.working.identity || null,
              structureDirty: Boolean(workspace.working.structureDirty),
              updatedAt: workspace.working.updatedAt || null,
            } : null,
            nextOffset: workspace.cursor.nextOffset,
            coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(workspace.cursor.coveredRanges),
            activeRange,
          }, null, 2),
        ];
    if (activeRange && includeActiveChunkV630) {
      const activeProjectionV703 = WorkingSource.projectBaselineRange(activeRange.start, activeRange.end);
      if (thinNormalV630 && activeProjectionV703.text.length > sourceEvidenceCharsV643) {
        const materializedV703 = WorkingSource.materialize();
        const focusAnchorV703 = String(session.sourceCursor?.focusAnchor || '').trim();
        const focusMatchV703 = focusAnchorV703
          ? materializedV703.text.indexOf(focusAnchorV703)
          : -1;
        const preferredWorkingStartV703 = Number.isFinite(Number(session.sourceCursor?.anchorResolution?.workingStart))
          ? Number(session.sourceCursor.anchorResolution.workingStart)
          : Number.isFinite(Number(session.sourceCursor?.anchorResolution?.start)) &&
              String(session.sourceCursor?.anchorResolution?.space || '') === 'working'
            ? Number(session.sourceCursor.anchorResolution.start)
            : focusMatchV703 >= 0
              ? Math.max(0, focusMatchV703 - Math.floor(sourceEvidenceCharsV643 / 3))
              : Number(activeProjectionV703?.pieces?.[0]?.workingStart || 0);
        const workingStartV703 = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            Number(materializedV703.text.length || 0),
            Number.isFinite(preferredWorkingStartV703) ? preferredWorkingStartV703 : 0
          )
        );
        const workingEndV703 = Math.min(
          Number(materializedV703.text.length || 0),
          workingStartV703 + sourceEvidenceCharsV643
        );
        const fallbackV703 = WorkingSource.projectWorkingRange(workingStartV703, workingEndV703);
        lines.push(
          '',
          `/* VIBE ACTIVE EVIDENCE BUDGET · baseline ${activeRange.start}…${activeRange.end} expands to ${activeProjectionV703.text.length} Working chars, above ${sourceEvidenceCharsV643} char normal-source budget. Emitting bounded Working-native ${workingStartV703}…${workingEndV703}; ancestral baseline coordinates remain local authority only. */`,
          `/* VIBE EVIDENCE · bounded Working fallback · ${workingStartV703}…${workingEndV703} · ${workspace.cursor.activeRange?.label || ''} */`,
          fallbackV703.text,
          '/* /VIBE EVIDENCE */'
        );
      } else {
        lines.push(
          '',
          thinNormalV630
            ? `/* VIBE EVIDENCE · physical active chunk · ${activeRange.start}…${activeRange.end} · ${workspace.cursor.activeRange?.label || ''} */`
            : sourceCommentProjection(activeRange, session, baseline, 'ACTIVE CHUNK'),
          activeProjectionV703.text,
          thinNormalV630 ? '/* /VIBE EVIDENCE */' : '/* ═══ VIBE SOURCE · ACTIVE CHUNK END ═══ */'
        );
      }
    } else if (thinNormalV630 && activeRange) {
      lines.push('', `Physical active chunk ${activeRange.start}…${activeRange.end} is persisted but omitted from this turn because more relevant surfaced evidence was selected.`);
    } else if (!activeRange) {
      lines.push('', '(source cursor reached EOF or no active chunk)');
    }
    const lastAcceptedAt = Date.parse(String(session.transport?.lastControl?.acceptedAt || ''));
    const fullSurfaceRefeed = Boolean(
      !session.transport?.lastControl ||
      !Number.isFinite(lastAcceptedAt) ||
      session.transport?.reanchorBoundary ||
      session.transport?.forceFullSourceRefeed === true
    );
    const deltaSurfaced = thinNormalV630
      ? relevantSurfacedV630
      : fullSurfaceRefeed
        ? allUnresolvedSurfaced
        : allUnresolvedSurfaced.filter(item => {
            const createdAt = Date.parse(String(item?.createdAt || ''));
            return Number.isFinite(createdAt) &&
              Number.isFinite(lastAcceptedAt) &&
              createdAt >= lastAcceptedAt;
          });
    const surfacedLimitV630 = thinNormalV630
      ? surfaceLimitV643
      : Number(workspace.settings.surfacedDispatchLimit || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.surfacedDispatchLimit);
    const surfaced = thinNormalV630
      ? deltaSurfaced.slice(0, Math.max(
          surfacedLimitV630,
          surfacedLimitV630 * Math.max(2, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalSurfaceCandidateMultiplierV632 || 6))
        ))
      : deltaSurfaced.slice(-surfacedLimitV630);
    const omittedPersistedSurfaceCount = Math.max(0, allUnresolvedSurfaced.length - surfaced.length);
    const surfacedBudget = thinNormalV630
      ? sourceEvidenceCharsV643
      : Math.max(0, Number(workspace.settings.surfacedDispatchChars || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.surfacedDispatchChars));
    let surfacedUsed = 0;
    let surfacedIncluded = 0;
    let surfacedSkipped = 0;
    for (const item of surfaced) {
      if (thinNormalV630 && surfacedIncluded >= surfacedLimitV630) break;
      let block = null;
      if (item.space === 'working') {
        const projection = WorkingSource.projectWorkingRange(item.workingStart, item.workingEnd);
        const pseudoRange = {
          start: projection.baselineEnvelope.start,
          end: projection.baselineEnvelope.end,
        };
        const boundaryV631 = item.explicitAddressed === true
          ? { text: projection.text, strategy: 'explicit-address', reason: 'explicit address bypasses relevance projection', owner: null, originalChars: projection.text.length, projectedChars: projection.text.length, trimmedChars: 0, candidates: 0, usable: true }
          : thinNormalV630
            ? (item.__evidenceBoundaryV631 || semanticEvidenceBoundaryProjectionV631(projection.text, item, session))
            : { text: projection.text, strategy: 'full-protocol', reason: 'full-protocol', owner: null, originalChars: projection.text.length, projectedChars: projection.text.length, trimmedChars: 0, candidates: 0 };
        if (relevanceMetricsV631 && thinNormalV630) {
          relevanceMetricsV631.selectedSurfaceChars += boundaryV631.originalChars;
          relevanceMetricsV631.projectedEvidenceChars += boundaryV631.projectedChars;
          relevanceMetricsV631.trimmedIrrelevantChars += boundaryV631.trimmedChars;
          relevanceMetricsV631.surfaces.push({ id: item.id, label: item.label || '', space: 'working', strategy: boundaryV631.strategy, reason: boundaryV631.reason, owner: boundaryV631.owner, originalChars: boundaryV631.originalChars, projectedChars: boundaryV631.projectedChars, trimmedChars: boundaryV631.trimmedChars, candidates: boundaryV631.candidates });
        }
        block = thinNormalV630
          ? [
              '',
              `/* VIBE EVIDENCE · ${item.id} · working ${item.workingStart}…${item.workingEnd} · ${item.label || '(none)'}${boundaryV631.owner ? ` · owner ${boundaryV631.owner}` : ''} */`,
              boundaryV631.text,
              '/* /VIBE EVIDENCE */'
            ]
          : [
              '',
              sourceCommentProjection(pseudoRange, session, baseline, `RELATED WORKING · ${item.id}`),
              `/* working range: ${item.workingStart}…${item.workingEnd} · label: ${item.label || '(none)'} · reason: ${item.reason || '(not specified)'} */`,
              projection.text,
              `/* ═══ VIBE RELATED WORKING · ${item.id} END ═══ */`
            ];
      } else {
        const range = sourceNormalizeRange(item, baseline.text.length);
        if (!range) continue;
        const rawProjectionV631 = WorkingSource.projectBaselineRange(range.start, range.end).text;
        const boundaryV631 = item.explicitAddressed === true
          ? { text: rawProjectionV631, strategy: 'explicit-address', reason: 'explicit address bypasses relevance projection', owner: null, originalChars: rawProjectionV631.length, projectedChars: rawProjectionV631.length, trimmedChars: 0, candidates: 0, usable: true }
          : thinNormalV630
            ? (item.__evidenceBoundaryV631 || semanticEvidenceBoundaryProjectionV631(rawProjectionV631, item, session))
            : { text: rawProjectionV631, strategy: 'full-protocol', reason: 'full-protocol', owner: null, originalChars: rawProjectionV631.length, projectedChars: rawProjectionV631.length, trimmedChars: 0, candidates: 0 };
        if (relevanceMetricsV631 && thinNormalV630) {
          relevanceMetricsV631.selectedSurfaceChars += boundaryV631.originalChars;
          relevanceMetricsV631.projectedEvidenceChars += boundaryV631.projectedChars;
          relevanceMetricsV631.trimmedIrrelevantChars += boundaryV631.trimmedChars;
          relevanceMetricsV631.surfaces.push({ id: item.id, label: item.label || '', space: 'baseline', strategy: boundaryV631.strategy, reason: boundaryV631.reason, owner: boundaryV631.owner, originalChars: boundaryV631.originalChars, projectedChars: boundaryV631.projectedChars, trimmedChars: boundaryV631.trimmedChars, candidates: boundaryV631.candidates });
        }
        if (
          thinNormalV630 &&
          item.explicitAddressed === true &&
          boundaryV631.text.length > Math.max(
            Number(CONFIG.semanticExplicitReadMaxCharsV703 || 12000),
            sourceEvidenceCharsV643
          )
        ) {
          block = [
            '',
            `/* VIBE EXPLICIT READ REJECTED · baseline ${range.start}…${range.end} expands to ${boundaryV631.text.length} Working chars. Historical baseline ancestry cannot bypass explicit-read/source-evidence limits. Re-address the desired bytes in Working coordinates with READ_RANGE. */`
          ];
        } else {
          block = thinNormalV630
            ? [
                '',
                `/* VIBE EVIDENCE · ${item.id} · baseline ${range.start}…${range.end} · ${item.label || '(none)'}${boundaryV631.owner ? ` · owner ${boundaryV631.owner}` : ''} */`,
                boundaryV631.text,
                '/* /VIBE EVIDENCE */'
              ]
            : [
                '',
                sourceCommentProjection(range, session, baseline, `RELATED · ${item.id}`),
                `/* label: ${item.label || '(none)'} · reason: ${item.reason || '(not specified)'} */`,
                WorkingSource.projectBaselineRange(range.start, range.end).text,
                `/* ═══ VIBE RELATED · ${item.id} END ═══ */`
              ];
        }

      }
      const blockText = block.join('\n');
      if (surfacedUsed + blockText.length > surfacedBudget) {
        // Explicit reads are themselves bounded at creation time. If imported/corrupt
        // historical state would exceed the current evidence budget, fail closed here
        // rather than recreating an oversized model-facing dispatch.
        surfacedSkipped += 1;
        if (item.explicitAddressed === true) {
          lines.push(
            '',
            `/* VIBE EXPLICIT EVIDENCE OMITTED · ${item.id} would exceed the current ${surfacedBudget} char source-evidence budget. Reissue a bounded Working READ_RANGE. */`
          );
        }
        continue;
      }
      lines.push(...block);
      surfacedUsed += blockText.length;
      surfacedIncluded += 1;
    }
    if (surfacedSkipped) {
      lines.push(
        '',
        `/* VIBE RELATED CONTEXT BUDGET · included ${surfacedIncluded}/${surfaced.length} · ${surfacedUsed}/${surfacedBudget} chars · ${surfacedSkipped} omitted; persisted in Source Workspace and available through explicit READ_RANGE */`
      );
    }
    if (thinNormalV630 && focusMetricsV633 && focusMetricsV633.backfillIncoherent > 0) {
      lines.push(
        '',
        `/* VIBE FOCUS COHERENCE · ${focusMetricsV633.selectedCoherent} coherent + ${focusMetricsV633.selectedMarginal} marginal evidence block(s); ${focusMetricsV633.backfillIncoherent} generic fallback block(s) retained because stronger bounded evidence was insufficient. */`
      );
    }
    if (thinNormalV630 && finalAdmissionMetricsV635 && finalAdmissionMetricsV635.rejectedCandidates > 0) {
      lines.push(
        '',
        `/* VIBE FINAL EVIDENCE ADMISSION · ${finalAdmissionMetricsV635.acceptedCandidates}/${finalAdmissionMetricsV635.candidatesEvaluated} factual candidate(s) survived exact-fragment identity/claim/focus validation; rejected candidates remain local authority. */`
      );
    }
    if (thinNormalV630 && diversityMetricsV634 && (diversityMetricsV634.duplicateRejected > 0 || diversityMetricsV634.boundaryInsufficientRejected > 0)) {
      lines.push(
        '',
        `/* VIBE EVIDENCE DIVERSITY · ${diversityMetricsV634.duplicateRejected} overlapping/duplicate candidate(s) deferred · ${diversityMetricsV634.boundaryInsufficientRejected} boundary-insufficient candidate(s) excluded before model dispatch. */`
      );
    }
    if (thinNormalV630 && identityMetricsV632 && identityMetricsV632.rejectedMetadataMismatch > 0) {
      lines.push(
        '',
        `/* VIBE EVIDENCE IDENTITY · ${identityMetricsV632.rejectedMetadataMismatch} metadata-mismatched historical surface(s) rejected locally before model dispatch. */`
      );
    }
    if (thinNormalV630 && relevanceMetricsV631 && relevanceMetricsV631.trimmedIrrelevantChars > 0) {
      lines.push(
        '',
        `/* VIBE SEMANTIC EVIDENCE BOUNDARY · ${relevanceMetricsV631.projectedEvidenceChars}/${relevanceMetricsV631.selectedSurfaceChars} selected source chars retained · ${relevanceMetricsV631.trimmedIrrelevantChars} adjacent chars omitted by owner-boundary projection. */`
      );
    }
    if ((thinNormalV630 || !fullSurfaceRefeed) && omittedPersistedSurfaceCount) {
      lines.push(
        '',
        thinNormalV630
          ? `/* VIBE RELEVANCE PROJECTION · ${surfacedIncluded}/${allUnresolvedSurfaced.length} unresolved surface(s) selected; all others remain local authority and are not echoed. */`
          : `/* VIBE SOURCE DELTA · ${omittedPersistedSurfaceCount} older unresolved surface(s) intentionally not echoed in this normal dispatch; authority remains persisted in Source Workspace/IndexedDB. Request READ_RANGE/SURFACE_CANDIDATE or explicit full refeed only when the active engineering question actually needs them. */`
      );
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  function sourceCursorCommentSync() {
    const { session, workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const range = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    return range
      ? sourceCommentProjection(range, session, baseline, 'ACTIVE CHUNK')
      : '/* VIBE SOURCE · no active source chunk */';
  }

  async function clearSourceWorkspace(options = {}) {
    const session = requireSourceSession();
    if (options.deleteIntelligence !== false) {
      await SourceIntelligence.clear({ persistent: true });
    } else {
      await SourceIntelligence.clear({ persistent: false });
    }
    const workspace = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', session.id);
    if (workspace) {
      if (options.deleteWorking !== false) {
        for (const span of await sourceDbGetAll('workingSpans')) {
          if (span.baselineId === workspace.baselineId) {
            await sourceDbDelete('workingSpans', span.id);
          }
        }
        for (const revision of await sourceDbGetAll('workingRevisions')) {
          if (revision.baselineId === workspace.baselineId) {
            await sourceDbDelete('workingRevisions', revision.id);
          }
        }
      }
      await sourceDbDelete('workspaces', session.id);
      if (options.deleteBaseline) {
        await sourceDbDelete('baselines', workspace.baselineId);
      }
    }
    sourceRuntime.sessionId = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = null;
    sourceRuntime.baseline = null;
    workingRuntime.sessionId = null;
    workingRuntime.spans = new Map();
    workingRuntime.headRevision = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    const next = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (next) {
      next.sourceCursor = {
        workspaceId: null,
        baselineId: null,
        baseline: null,
        nextOffset: 0,
        activeRange: null,
        coveredRanges: [],
        coveredThrough: null,
        workingRevision: null,
        relatedRanges: [],
        workspaceRevision: 0,
      };
      sourceInvalidateUnsentDispatch(next);
      SemanticSessionStore.save(next);
    }
    renderPanel();
    return true;
  }

  const SourceWorkspace = Object.freeze({
    schema: SOURCE_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA,
    openFile: openSourceFile,
    openText: openSourceText,
    restore(sessionId = SemanticSessionStore.load()?.id) {
      return restoreSourceWorkspaceForSession(sessionId);
    },
    status() {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      return {
        ready: Boolean(
          session && sourceRuntime.sessionId === session.id &&
          sourceRuntime.workspace && sourceRuntime.baseline
        ),
        sessionId: sourceRuntime.sessionId,
        baseline: sourceBaselineMeta(sourceRuntime.baseline),
        workspace: sourceWorkspaceMeta(sourceRuntime.workspace),
        working: typeof WorkingSource !== 'undefined' ? WorkingSource.status() : null,
      };
    },
    getActiveChunk: sourceActiveChunkSync,
    setChunk: setSourceChunk,
    proposeChunk: proposeSourceChunkAt,
    expandChunk: expandSourceChunk,
    shrinkChunk: shrinkSourceChunk,
    coverActive: coverActiveSource,
    nextChunk: nextSourceChunk,
    surface: surfaceSourceRange,
    resolveSurface: resolveSurfacedSource,
    clearSurfaces: clearSurfacedSource,
    cursorComment: sourceCursorCommentSync,
    buildDispatchContext: buildSourceDispatchContextSync,
    clear: clearSourceWorkspace,
    internals: Object.freeze({
      proposeSourceChunk,
      mergeSourceRanges,
      sourceCoveredThrough,
      sourceRegionAt,
      buildSourceSegmentMap,
      stageWorkspaceOperations,
      projectSourceWorkspaceIntoSession,
    }),
    selfTest() {
      const sample = [
        '<!doctype html>',
        '<style>',
        '.a { color: red; }',
        '.b { color: blue; }',
        '</style>',
        '<script>',
        'function alpha() { return 1; }',
        'function beta() { return alpha(); }',
        '</script>',
      ].join('\n');
      const first = proposeSourceChunk(sample, 0, {
        targetChars: 55,
        minChars: 20,
        maxChars: 90,
      });
      const merged = mergeSourceRanges([
        { start: 0, end: 20 },
        { start: 18, end: 40 },
        { start: 60, end: 70 },
      ], sample.length);
      return {
        ok:
          first?.start === 0 && first.end > first.start &&
          merged.length === 2 && sourceCoveredThrough(merged) === 40,
        first,
        merged,
        coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(merged),
      };
    },
  });

  /*
   * Autonomous Cursor Loop
   *
   * Mutable, normalized overlay over the immutable baseline. Active spans are
   * expressed in baseline coordinates; overlapping edits are folded into a
   * new canonical span instead of being rejected as an engineering action.
   * IndexedDB stores immutable spans and append-only revisions. The full
   * working source is materialized only for explicit operations such as export
   * or a targeted query.
   */
  const WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-working-span/v1';
  const WORKING_REVISION_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-working-revision/v1';
  const WORKING_HEAD_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-working-head/v1';
  const workingRuntime = {
    sessionId: null,
    spans: new Map(),
    headRevision: null,
    workingSegmentMap: null,
    workingSegmentIdentity: null,
  };

  function workingHeadFor(workspace, baseline) {
    if (!workspace.working || typeof workspace.working !== 'object') {
      workspace.working = {
        schema: WORKING_HEAD_SCHEMA,
        sequence: 0,
        headRevisionId: null,
        activeSpanIds: [],
        identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r0`,
        structureDirty: false,
        updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
    workspace.working.schema = WORKING_HEAD_SCHEMA;
    workspace.working.sequence = Number(workspace.working.sequence || 0);
    workspace.working.activeSpanIds = Array.isArray(workspace.working.activeSpanIds)
      ? [...new Set(workspace.working.activeSpanIds.map(String))]
      : [];
    workspace.working.identity = workspace.working.identity ||
      `working:${baseline.sha256}:r${workspace.working.sequence}`;
    return workspace.working;
  }

  function workingSortedSpans(spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const values = spansInput instanceof Map
      ? [...spansInput.values()]
      : Array.isArray(spansInput) ? spansInput : [];
    return values
      .map(item => cloneSemanticValue(item))
      .sort((a, b) =>
        a.baselineStart - b.baselineStart ||
        a.baselineEnd - b.baselineEnd ||
        String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))
      );
  }

  function validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baselineLength) {
    let previous = null;
    for (const span of workingSortedSpans(spans)) {
      if (span.schema !== WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA) {
        throw new Error(`Unsupported Working Source span ${span.id || '(unknown)'}`);
      }
      if (
        !Number.isInteger(Number(span.baselineStart)) ||
        !Number.isInteger(Number(span.baselineEnd)) ||
        span.baselineStart < 0 ||
        span.baselineEnd < span.baselineStart ||
        span.baselineEnd > baselineLength ||
        typeof span.replacementText !== 'string'
      ) {
        throw new Error(`Damaged Working Source span ${span.id || '(unknown)'}`);
      }
      if (previous) {
        const overlaps = span.baselineStart < previous.baselineEnd ||
          (
            span.baselineStart === previous.baselineStart &&
            span.baselineEnd === span.baselineStart &&
            previous.baselineEnd === previous.baselineStart
          );
        if (overlaps) {
          throw new Error(
            `Working Source active spans overlap: ${previous.id} and ${span.id}`
          );
        }
      }
      previous = span;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function buildWorkingPieces(baselineText, spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const spans = workingSortedSpans(spansInput);
    validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baselineText.length);
    const pieces = [];
    let baselineCursor = 0;
    let workingCursor = 0;
    for (const span of spans) {
      if (span.baselineStart > baselineCursor) {
        const length = span.baselineStart - baselineCursor;
        pieces.push({
          kind: 'baseline',
          baselineStart: baselineCursor,
          baselineEnd: span.baselineStart,
          workingStart: workingCursor,
          workingEnd: workingCursor + length,
        });
        workingCursor += length;
      }
      pieces.push({
        kind: 'replacement',
        spanId: span.id,
        baselineStart: span.baselineStart,
        baselineEnd: span.baselineEnd,
        localStart: 0,
        localEnd: span.replacementText.length,
        workingStart: workingCursor,
        workingEnd: workingCursor + span.replacementText.length,
      });
      workingCursor += span.replacementText.length;
      baselineCursor = span.baselineEnd;
    }
    if (baselineCursor < baselineText.length) {
      const length = baselineText.length - baselineCursor;
      pieces.push({
        kind: 'baseline',
        baselineStart: baselineCursor,
        baselineEnd: baselineText.length,
        workingStart: workingCursor,
        workingEnd: workingCursor + length,
      });
      workingCursor += length;
    }
    return { pieces, workingLength: workingCursor, spans };
  }

  function materializeWorkingSourceSync(spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const spans = workingSortedSpans(spansInput);
    let cursor = 0;
    const parts = [];
    for (const span of spans) {
      parts.push(baseline.text.slice(cursor, span.baselineStart));
      parts.push(span.replacementText);
      cursor = span.baselineEnd;
    }
    parts.push(baseline.text.slice(cursor));
    return {
      text: parts.join(''),
      spans,
      identity: sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity ||
        `working:${baseline.sha256}:r0`,
    };
  }

  function baselineToWorkingOffset(offsetInput, bias = 'before', spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const offset = sourceClampOffset(offsetInput, baseline.text.length);
    let delta = 0;
    for (const span of workingSortedSpans(spansInput)) {
      if (offset < span.baselineStart) break;
      if (offset === span.baselineStart) {
        return offset + delta + (bias === 'after' ? span.replacementText.length : 0);
      }
      if (offset < span.baselineEnd) {
        return span.baselineStart + delta +
          (bias === 'after' || bias === 'end' ? span.replacementText.length : 0);
      }
      delta += span.replacementText.length - (span.baselineEnd - span.baselineStart);
      if (offset === span.baselineEnd && bias === 'before') {
        return offset + delta;
      }
    }
    return offset + delta;
  }

  function workingBoundaryToBaseline(offsetInput, bias = 'before', spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const projection = buildWorkingPieces(baseline.text, spansInput);
    const offset = sourceClampOffset(offsetInput, projection.workingLength);
    for (const piece of projection.pieces) {
      if (offset < piece.workingStart || offset > piece.workingEnd) continue;
      if (piece.kind === 'baseline') {
        return sourceClampOffset(
          piece.baselineStart + Math.max(0, Math.min(
            piece.baselineEnd - piece.baselineStart,
            offset - piece.workingStart
          )),
          baseline.text.length
        );
      }
      if (offset === piece.workingStart) {
        return bias === 'after' ? piece.baselineEnd : piece.baselineStart;
      }
      if (offset === piece.workingEnd) {
        return bias === 'before' ? piece.baselineStart : piece.baselineEnd;
      }
      return bias === 'after' || bias === 'end'
        ? piece.baselineEnd
        : piece.baselineStart;
    }
    return baseline.text.length;
  }

  function projectBaselineRangeSync(startInput, endInput, spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const start = sourceClampOffset(Math.min(Number(startInput), Number(endInput)), baseline.text.length);
    const end = sourceClampOffset(Math.max(Number(startInput), Number(endInput)), baseline.text.length);
    const spans = workingSortedSpans(spansInput);
    const parts = [];
    const pieces = [];
    let cursor = start;
    let workingCursor = baselineToWorkingOffset(start, 'before', spans);
    for (const span of spans) {
      if (span.baselineEnd < start || span.baselineStart > end) continue;
      if (span.baselineStart > cursor) {
        const sliceEnd = Math.min(end, span.baselineStart);
        if (sliceEnd > cursor) {
          const text = baseline.text.slice(cursor, sliceEnd);
          parts.push(text);
          pieces.push({
            kind: 'baseline',
            baselineStart: cursor,
            baselineEnd: sliceEnd,
            workingStart: workingCursor,
            workingEnd: workingCursor + text.length,
          });
          workingCursor += text.length;
        }
      }
      const includeInsertion = span.baselineStart === span.baselineEnd &&
        span.baselineStart >= start && span.baselineStart <= end;
      const overlaps = span.baselineStart < end && span.baselineEnd > start;
      if (includeInsertion || overlaps) {
        parts.push(span.replacementText);
        pieces.push({
          kind: 'replacement',
          spanId: span.id,
          baselineStart: span.baselineStart,
          baselineEnd: span.baselineEnd,
          localStart: 0,
          localEnd: span.replacementText.length,
          workingStart: workingCursor,
          workingEnd: workingCursor + span.replacementText.length,
        });
        workingCursor += span.replacementText.length;
        cursor = Math.max(cursor, span.baselineEnd);
      }
    }
    if (cursor < end) {
      const text = baseline.text.slice(cursor, end);
      parts.push(text);
      pieces.push({
        kind: 'baseline',
        baselineStart: cursor,
        baselineEnd: end,
        workingStart: workingCursor,
        workingEnd: workingCursor + text.length,
      });
      workingCursor += text.length;
    }
    const workingStart = baselineToWorkingOffset(start, 'before', spans);
    return {
      baselineRange: { start, end },
      workingRange: { start: workingStart, end: workingCursor },
      text: parts.join(''),
      pieces,
      touchingSpanIds: [...new Set(
        pieces.filter(item => item.kind === 'replacement').map(item => item.spanId)
      )],
    };
  }

  function projectWorkingRangeSync(startInput, endInput, spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync(spansInput);
    const start = sourceClampOffset(Math.min(Number(startInput), Number(endInput)), materialized.text.length);
    const end = sourceClampOffset(Math.max(Number(startInput), Number(endInput)), materialized.text.length);
    return {
      workingRange: { start, end },
      text: materialized.text.slice(start, end),
      baselineEnvelope: {
        start: workingBoundaryToBaseline(start, 'before', spansInput),
        end: workingBoundaryToBaseline(end, 'after', spansInput),
      },
      identity: materialized.identity,
    };
  }

  async function restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace() {
    const { workspace, baseline, session } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const head = workingHeadFor(workspace, baseline);
    const spans = new Map();
    for (const id of head.activeSpanIds) {
      const span = await sourceDbGet('workingSpans', id);
      if (!span) throw new Error(`Working Source span is missing: ${id}`);
      spans.set(id, span);
    }
    validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baseline.text.length);
    workingRuntime.sessionId = session.id;
    workingRuntime.spans = spans;
    workingRuntime.headRevision = head.headRevisionId
      ? await sourceDbGet('workingRevisions', head.headRevisionId)
      : null;
    if (head.headRevisionId && !workingRuntime.headRevision) {
      throw new Error('Working Source head revision is missing');
    }
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    return WorkingSource.status();
  }


  function workingRevisionDescendsFrom(revision, ancestorRevisionId, revisionMap) {
    if (!revision) return false;
    const ancestorId = String(ancestorRevisionId || '');
    const seen = new Set();
    let current = revision;
    while (current && !seen.has(current.id)) {
      seen.add(current.id);
      const parentId = String(current.parentRevisionId || '');
      if (parentId === ancestorId) return true;
      if (!parentId) return false;
      const parent = revisionMap.get(parentId) || null;
      if (!parent) return false; // orphan lineage is never recoverable authority
      current = parent;
    }
    return false;
  }

  async function findStrongestLocalWorkingDescendant(workspaceInput = sourceRuntime.workspace) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const workspace = workspaceInput || sourceRuntime.workspace;
    const currentSequence = Number(workspace?.working?.sequence || 0);
    const currentHead = workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || null;
    const revisions = (await sourceDbGetAll('workingRevisions'))
      .filter(item => item?.schema === WORKING_REVISION_SCHEMA)
      .filter(item => String(item?.baselineId || '') === String(baseline.id || ''));
    const revisionMap = new Map(revisions.map(item => [item.id, item]));
    const candidates = revisions
      .filter(item => Number(item?.sequence || 0) > currentSequence)
      .filter(item => workingRevisionDescendsFrom(item, currentHead, revisionMap))
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b.sequence || 0) - Number(a.sequence || 0));
    if (!candidates.length) return null;

    const allSpans = await sourceDbGetAll('workingSpans');
    const spanMap = new Map(allSpans.map(item => [item.id, item]));
    const valid = [];
    for (const revision of candidates) {
      const ids = Array.isArray(revision.afterActiveSpanIds) ? revision.afterActiveSpanIds : [];
      const missing = ids.filter(id => !spanMap.has(id));
      if (missing.length) continue;
      const spans = new Map(ids.map(id => [id, spanMap.get(id)]));
      try {
        validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baseline.text.length);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      valid.push({ revision, spans });
    }
    if (!valid.length) return null;
    const strongest = valid[0];
    const divergent = valid.find(item =>
      String(item.revision.id || '') !== String(strongest.revision.id || '') &&
      !workingRevisionDescendsFrom(strongest.revision, item.revision.id, revisionMap)
    );
    if (divergent) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_LOCAL_FORK: multiple valid append-only Working descendants diverge from the current head; ' +
        `strongest r${strongest.revision.sequence}/${strongest.revision.id}, ` +
        `divergent r${divergent.revision.sequence}/${divergent.revision.id}`
      );
    }
    return strongest;
  }

  async function promoteLocalWorkingDescendant(candidate, options = {}) {
    if (!candidate?.revision || !candidate?.spans) return null;
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const workspace = cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    const expectedParentAuthority = workingAuthorityToken(workspace);
    const revision = candidate.revision;
    const targetSequence = Number(revision.sequence || 0);
    if (targetSequence <= expectedParentAuthority.workingSequence) return null;

    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction('workspaces', 'readwrite');
    const store = transaction.objectStore('workspaces');
    const persistedWorkspace = await sourceRequest(store.get(workspace.sessionId));
    const persistedAuthority = workingAuthorityToken(persistedWorkspace);
    if (!sameWorkingCommitAuthority(persistedAuthority, expectedParentAuthority)) {
      try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_AUTHORITY_LOCAL_PROMOTE_RACE: workspace changed while promoting local Working descendant; ' +
        `expected r${expectedParentAuthority.workingSequence}/${expectedParentAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}, ` +
        `persisted r${persistedAuthority.workingSequence}/${persistedAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }
    const promoted = cloneSemanticValue(persistedWorkspace);
    promoted.working = {
      ...(promoted.working || {}),
      schema: WORKING_HEAD_SCHEMA,
      sequence: targetSequence,
      headRevisionId: revision.id,
      activeSpanIds: [...revision.afterActiveSpanIds],
      identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r${targetSequence}:${revision.id}`,
      // Segment/source-intelligence caches must be rebuilt after authority repair.
      structureDirty: true,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    promoted.revision = Number(promoted.revision || 0) + 1;
    promoted.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    store.put(promoted);
    await sourceTransactionDone(transaction);

    sourceRuntime.workspace = promoted;
    workingRuntime.sessionId = promoted.sessionId;
    workingRuntime.spans = candidate.spans;
    workingRuntime.headRevision = revision;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    await invalidateIntelligenceForWorkingChange();
    if (options.syncSession !== false) syncSourceProjectionIntoSession(promoted, baseline);
    log('Promoted stale local Working head from append-only revision lineage', {
      from: expectedParentAuthority,
      to: workingAuthorityToken(promoted),
    });
    return {
      promoted: true,
      from: expectedParentAuthority,
      to: workingAuthorityToken(promoted),
      revision: cloneSemanticValue(revision),
    };
  }

  function collectWorkingRevisionLineage(revisionInput, ancestorRevisionId, revisionMap) {
    const revision = revisionInput || null;
    if (!revision) return null;
    const ancestorId = String(ancestorRevisionId || '');
    const lineage = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    let current = revision;
    while (current && !seen.has(current.id)) {
      seen.add(current.id);
      lineage.push(current);
      const parentId = String(current.parentRevisionId || '');
      if (parentId === ancestorId) {
        lineage.reverse();
        return lineage;
      }
      if (!parentId) return null;
      const parent = revisionMap.get(parentId) || null;
      if (!parent) return null;
      current = parent;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function validateWorkingRevisionLineage(lineageInput, ancestorAuthority) {
    const lineage = Array.isArray(lineageInput) ? lineageInput : [];
    if (!lineage.length) throw new Error('Foreign Working revision lineage is empty');
    let expectedParent = String(ancestorAuthority?.headRevisionId || '');
    let expectedSequence = Number(ancestorAuthority?.workingSequence || 0) + 1;
    for (const revision of lineage) {
      if (String(revision?.parentRevisionId || '') !== expectedParent) {
        throw new Error(
          `Foreign Working revision lineage parent mismatch at ${revision?.id || 'unknown'}: ` +
          `expected ${expectedParent || 'no-head'}, got ${revision?.parentRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
        );
      }
      const actualSequence = Number(revision?.sequence || 0);
      const specJump = revision?.kind === 'spec-determinization' &&
        revision?.recovery?.schema === SPEC_DETERMINIZATION_SCHEMA &&
        Number(revision?.recovery?.fromSequence || 0) === expectedSequence - 1 &&
        Number(revision?.recovery?.targetSequence || 0) === actualSequence &&
        actualSequence >= expectedSequence;
      if (actualSequence !== expectedSequence && !specJump) {
        throw new Error(
          `Foreign Working revision lineage sequence gap at ${revision?.id || 'unknown'}: ` +
          `expected r${expectedSequence}, got r${actualSequence}`
        );
      }
      expectedParent = String(revision.id || '');
      expectedSequence = actualSequence + 1;
    }
    return true;
  }

  async function readForeignWorkingRecoveryStores(sourceDatabaseName) {
    const database = await openForeignDatabase(sourceDatabaseName);
    try {
      const required = ['workspaces', 'workingRevisions', 'workingSpans'];
      for (const name of required) {
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(name)) {
          return { workspaces: [], workingRevisions: [], workingSpans: [] };
        }
      }
      return {
        workspaces: await foreignDbGetAll(database, 'workspaces'),
        workingRevisions: await foreignDbGetAll(database, 'workingRevisions'),
        workingSpans: await foreignDbGetAll(database, 'workingSpans'),
      };
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
  }

  function strongestWorkingRevisionDescendantFromStores(stores, sourceDatabaseName, session, ancestorAuthority) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const workspace = (stores?.workspaces || []).find(
      item => String(item?.sessionId || '') === String(session?.id || '')
    ) || null;
    if (!workspace) return null;
    if (String(workspace.baselineId || '') !== String(baseline.id || '')) return null;

    const revisions = (stores?.workingRevisions || [])
      .filter(item => item?.schema === WORKING_REVISION_SCHEMA)
      .filter(item => String(item?.baselineId || '') === String(baseline.id || ''));
    const revisionMap = new Map(revisions.map(item => [item.id, item]));
    const spanMap = new Map((stores?.workingSpans || []).map(item => [item.id, item]));
    const candidates = revisions
      .filter(item => Number(item?.sequence || 0) > Number(ancestorAuthority?.workingSequence || 0))
      .filter(item => workingRevisionDescendsFrom(item, ancestorAuthority?.headRevisionId, revisionMap))
      .sort((a, b) =>
        Number(b?.sequence || 0) - Number(a?.sequence || 0) ||
        Number(b?.semanticRevision || 0) - Number(a?.semanticRevision || 0)
      );

    for (const revision of candidates) {
      const lineage = collectWorkingRevisionLineage(
        revision,
        ancestorAuthority?.headRevisionId,
        revisionMap
      );
      if (!lineage) continue;
      try {
        validateWorkingRevisionLineage(lineage, ancestorAuthority);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      const finalIds = Array.isArray(revision.afterActiveSpanIds) ? revision.afterActiveSpanIds : [];
      if (finalIds.some(id => !spanMap.has(id))) continue;
      const finalSpans = new Map(finalIds.map(id => [id, spanMap.get(id)]));
      try {
        validateWorkingSpanSet(finalSpans, baseline.text.length);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }

      const referencedSpanIds = new Set(finalIds);
      for (const item of lineage) {
        for (const key of ['beforeActiveSpanIds', 'afterActiveSpanIds', 'addedSpanIds', 'removedSpanIds']) {
          for (const id of Array.isArray(item?.[key]) ? item[key] : []) referencedSpanIds.add(id);
        }
      }
      const recoverySpans = new Map();
      let complete = true;
      for (const id of referencedSpanIds) {
        const span = spanMap.get(id);
        if (!span) {
          complete = false;
          break;
        }
        recoverySpans.set(id, span);
      }
      if (!complete) continue;

      return {
        sourceDatabaseName,
        workspace,
        revision,
        lineage,
        finalSpans,
        recoverySpans,
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function findStrongestForeignWorkingRevisionDescendant(sessionInput, ancestorAuthorityInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return null;
    const ancestorAuthority = ancestorAuthorityInput || workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    const databaseNames = await listCrossChatDatabaseNames();
    const sourceNames = databaseNames.filter(name =>
      isVibeSourceDatabaseNameV616(name) && name !== SOURCE_DB_NAME
    );
    const candidates = [];
    for (const sourceDatabaseName of sourceNames) {
      try {
        const stores = await readForeignWorkingRecoveryStores(sourceDatabaseName);
        const candidate = strongestWorkingRevisionDescendantFromStores(
          stores,
          sourceDatabaseName,
          session,
          ancestorAuthority
        );
        if (candidate) candidates.push(candidate);
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Unable to inspect foreign Working revision lineage', sourceDatabaseName, error);
      }
    }
    candidates.sort((a, b) =>
      Number(b?.revision?.sequence || 0) - Number(a?.revision?.sequence || 0) ||
      Number(b?.revision?.semanticRevision || 0) - Number(a?.revision?.semanticRevision || 0)
    );
    if (!candidates.length) return null;
    const strongest = candidates[0];
    const strongestLineageIds = new Set((strongest.lineage || []).map(item => String(item?.id || '')));
    const divergent = candidates.find(item =>
      String(item?.revision?.id || '') !== String(strongest?.revision?.id || '') &&
      !strongestLineageIds.has(String(item?.revision?.id || ''))
    );
    if (divergent) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FOREIGN_FORK: compatible foreign Source DBs expose divergent Working descendants; ' +
        `strongest ${strongest.sourceDatabaseName} r${strongest.revision.sequence}/${strongest.revision.id}, ` +
        `divergent ${divergent.sourceDatabaseName} r${divergent.revision.sequence}/${divergent.revision.id}`
      );
    }
    return strongest;
  }

  async function promoteForeignWorkingRevisionDescendant(candidate, options = {}) {
    if (!candidate?.revision || !candidate?.lineage || !candidate?.finalSpans) return null;
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const expectedParentAuthority = workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    validateWorkingRevisionLineage(candidate.lineage, expectedParentAuthority);
    const targetSequence = Number(candidate.revision.sequence || 0);
    if (targetSequence <= Number(expectedParentAuthority.workingSequence || 0)) return null;

    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction(
      ['workingSpans', 'workingRevisions', 'workspaces'],
      'readwrite'
    );
    const workspaceStore = transaction.objectStore('workspaces');
    const persistedWorkspace = await sourceRequest(
      workspaceStore.get(expectedParentAuthority.sessionId || sourceRuntime.workspace?.sessionId)
    );
    const persistedAuthority = workingAuthorityToken(persistedWorkspace);
    if (!sameWorkingCommitAuthority(persistedAuthority, expectedParentAuthority)) {
      try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_AUTHORITY_FOREIGN_PROMOTE_RACE: workspace changed while importing foreign Working lineage; ' +
        `expected r${expectedParentAuthority.workingSequence}/${expectedParentAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}, ` +
        `persisted r${persistedAuthority.workingSequence}/${persistedAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }

    const spanStore = transaction.objectStore('workingSpans');
    for (const span of candidate.recoverySpans.values()) spanStore.put(span);
    const revisionStore = transaction.objectStore('workingRevisions');
    for (const revision of candidate.lineage) revisionStore.put(revision);

    const promoted = cloneSemanticValue(persistedWorkspace);
    promoted.working = {
      ...(promoted.working || {}),
      schema: WORKING_HEAD_SCHEMA,
      sequence: targetSequence,
      headRevisionId: candidate.revision.id,
      activeSpanIds: [...candidate.revision.afterActiveSpanIds],
      identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r${targetSequence}:${candidate.revision.id}`,
      structureDirty: true,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    // Cursor is intentionally preserved. workingRevisions are authoritative for
    // source materialization but do not carry cursor snapshots; fabricating a
    // nextOffset here would mix Source recovery with workspace traversal state.
    promoted.revision = Number(promoted.revision || 0) + 1;
    promoted.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    workspaceStore.put(promoted);
    await sourceTransactionDone(transaction);

    const verifiedWorkspace = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', promoted.sessionId);
    const verifiedRevision = await sourceDbGet('workingRevisions', candidate.revision.id);
    if (
      Number(verifiedWorkspace?.working?.sequence || 0) !== targetSequence ||
      String(verifiedWorkspace?.working?.headRevisionId || '') !== String(candidate.revision.id) ||
      !verifiedRevision
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_AUTHORITY_FOREIGN_PROMOTE_VERIFY_FAILED: imported lineage did not become persisted Working head; ' +
        `expected r${targetSequence}/${candidate.revision.id}, ` +
        `persisted r${verifiedWorkspace?.working?.sequence || 0}/${verifiedWorkspace?.working?.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }

    sourceRuntime.workspace = verifiedWorkspace;
    workingRuntime.sessionId = verifiedWorkspace.sessionId;
    workingRuntime.spans = candidate.finalSpans;
    workingRuntime.headRevision = candidate.revision;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    await invalidateIntelligenceForWorkingChange();
    if (options.syncSession !== false) syncSourceProjectionIntoSession(verifiedWorkspace, baseline);
    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(SemanticSessionStore.load()).catch(() => null);
    log('Recovered Working head from foreign append-only revision lineage', {
      sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
      from: expectedParentAuthority,
      to: workingAuthorityToken(verifiedWorkspace),
      lineageLength: candidate.lineage.length,
      cursorPreservedAt: verifiedWorkspace?.cursor?.nextOffset ?? null,
    });
    return {
      promoted: true,
      mode: 'foreign-revision-lineage',
      sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
      from: expectedParentAuthority,
      to: workingAuthorityToken(verifiedWorkspace),
      revision: cloneSemanticValue(candidate.revision),
      lineageLength: candidate.lineage.length,
      cursorPreserved: true,
      nextOffset: verifiedWorkspace?.cursor?.nextOffset ?? null,
    };
  }

  async function sourceMutationAuthorityPreflight(options = {}) {
    const semanticSession = options.semanticSession || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!semanticSession) throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY: semantic session is unavailable');
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(semanticSession.id);
    }
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();

    const before = localSemanticSourceAuthority(semanticSession);
    let localPromotion = null;
    const localDescendant = await findStrongestLocalWorkingDescendant(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    if (localDescendant) {
      localPromotion = await promoteLocalWorkingDescendant(localDescendant, { syncSession: true });
    }

    let foreignPromotion = null;
    if (!localPromotion) {
      const authorityAfterLocal = workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace);
      const foreignDescendant = await findStrongestForeignWorkingRevisionDescendant(
        semanticSession,
        authorityAfterLocal
      );
      if (foreignDescendant) {
        foreignPromotion = await promoteForeignWorkingRevisionDescendant(
          foreignDescendant,
          { syncSession: true }
        );
      }
    }

    let reconciliation = null;
    // sourceOps are infrequent and destructive by design. Before mutation, pay the
    // bounded authority check cost rather than silently forking a stale Working head.
    try {
      reconciliation = await reconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority({
        automatic: false,
        reanchor: false,
        sourceOpsGuard: true,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY: reconciliation failed before mutation: ${error?.message || error}`);
    }

    await SourceWorkspace.restore(semanticSession.id);
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const current = localSemanticSourceAuthority(SemanticSessionStore.load() || semanticSession);
    let registry = await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
    registry = await reconcileEquivalentCrossChatRegistryHead(
      current,
      SemanticSessionStore.load() || semanticSession,
      registry
    );
    if (
      registry?.schema === CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA &&
      String(registry.sessionId || '') === String(semanticSession.id) &&
      (!registry.baselineSha256 || !current.baselineSha256 ||
        String(registry.baselineSha256) === String(current.baselineSha256))
    ) {
      const registrySequence = Number(
        registry.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(registry.workingRevision)
      );
      if (registrySequence > Number(current.workingSequence || 0)) {
        throw new Error(
          'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_STALE: refusing mutation on a Working head below monotonic registry floor; ' +
          `local r${current.workingSequence}/${current.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}, ` +
          `registry r${registrySequence}/${registry.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
        );
      }
    }

    const authorityFloor = resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(semanticSession);
    const floorSequence = Number(authorityFloor?.workingSequence || 0);
    if (floorSequence > Number(current.workingSequence || 0)) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_STALE: refusing mutation below causal semantic authority floor; ' +
        `physical Working r${current.workingSequence}/${current.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}, ` +
        `required floor r${floorSequence}/${authorityFloor?.headRevisionId || 'unknown-head'} ` +
        `(${authorityFloor?.reason || 'unknown reason'})`
      );
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      before,
      current,
      localPromotion,
      foreignPromotion,
      reconciliation,
      authorityFloor,
      commitAuthority: workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace),
    };
  }

  const BASELINE_NATIVE_SOURCE_OPS = new Set([
    'RESTORE_CHANGE_SPAN',
    'RESTORE_BASELINE_RANGE',
    'DELETE_BASELINE_RANGE',
  ]);

  function baselineNativeExpectedSpanIds(operation = {}) {
    const target = operation?.target && typeof operation.target === 'object'
      ? operation.target
      : {};
    const value = operation.expectedSpanIds ?? operation.spanIds ?? target.expectedSpanIds ?? target.spanIds;
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
      throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_SPAN_OWNERSHIP: expectedSpanIds must be an array when supplied');
    }
    return [...new Set(value.map(String).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  }

  function baselineNativeSpanRelation(span, range) {
    const start = Number(span.baselineStart);
    const end = Number(span.baselineEnd);
    const insertion = start === end;
    if (insertion) {
      if (start > range.start && start < range.end) return 'contained';
      if (start === range.start || start === range.end) return 'boundary';
      return 'outside';
    }
    if (end <= range.start || start >= range.end) return 'outside';
    if (start >= range.start && end <= range.end) return 'contained';
    return 'partial';
  }

  function assertBaselineNativeSpanOwnership(operation, containedSpans, partialSpans, opName) {
    if (partialSpans.length) {
      throw new Error(
        `${opName} refuses partial overlap with active Working spans: ` +
        partialSpans.map(span => `${span.id}[${span.baselineStart}…${span.baselineEnd}]`).join(', ') +
        '. Use an exact/source-native mutation or restore the owning change span instead of widening the baseline envelope.'
      );
    }
    if (!containedSpans.length) return;
    const actualIds = containedSpans.map(span => String(span.id)).sort();
    const expectedIds = baselineNativeExpectedSpanIds(operation);
    if (expectedIds == null) {
      throw new Error(
        `${opName} intersects active Working spans and requires explicit expectedSpanIds ownership: ` +
        actualIds.join(', ') +
        '. This guard prevents baseline-range restore/delete from silently consuming neighboring accepted changes.'
      );
    }
    if (
      expectedIds.length !== actualIds.length ||
      expectedIds.some((id, index) => id !== actualIds[index])
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `${opName} expectedSpanIds mismatch; expected current affected set [${actualIds.join(', ')}], ` +
        `received [${expectedIds.join(', ')}]. Refusing stale or over-broad baseline mutation.`
      );
    }
  }

  function stageBaselineNativeOperation(spansInput, operationInput = {}) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const operation = operationInput && typeof operationInput === 'object' ? operationInput : {};
    const op = String(operation.op || operation.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!BASELINE_NATIVE_SOURCE_OPS.has(op)) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported baseline-native source operation: ${op || '(empty)'}`);
    }
    const spans = new Map(
      workingSortedSpans(spansInput).map(span => [span.id, cloneSemanticValue(span)])
    );

    if (op === 'RESTORE_CHANGE_SPAN') {
      const spanId = String(
        operation?.target?.spanId || operation?.target?.id || operation.spanId || ''
      );
      const span = spans.get(spanId);
      if (!span) throw new Error(`RESTORE_CHANGE_SPAN unknown active span ${spanId || '(missing)'}`);
      spans.delete(spanId);
      validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baseline.text.length);
      return {
        spans,
        addedSpan: null,
        removedSpanIds: [spanId],
        affectedBaselineRange: {
          start: Number(span.baselineStart),
          end: Number(span.baselineEnd),
        },
        workingRange: {
          start: baselineToWorkingOffset(span.baselineStart, 'before', spansInput),
          end: baselineToWorkingOffset(span.baselineEnd, 'after', spansInput),
        },
        baselineNative: true,
      };
    }
