    const rawTarget = operation.target || {
      kind: 'baseline-range',
      start: operation.start,
      end: operation.end,
    };
    const range = sourceNormalizeRange(rawTarget, baseline.text.length);
    if (!range) throw new Error(`${op} requires a valid non-empty baseline range`);

    const containedSpans = [];
    const partialSpans = [];
    const boundarySpans = [];
    for (const span of workingSortedSpans(spans)) {
      const relation = baselineNativeSpanRelation(span, range);
      if (relation === 'contained') containedSpans.push(span);
      else if (relation === 'partial') partialSpans.push(span);
      else if (relation === 'boundary') boundarySpans.push(span);
    }
    assertBaselineNativeSpanOwnership(operation, containedSpans, partialSpans, op);

    const workingStart = baselineToWorkingOffset(range.start, 'before', spansInput);
    const workingEnd = baselineToWorkingOffset(range.end, 'after', spansInput);
    const removedSpanIds = [];
    for (const span of containedSpans) {
      spans.delete(span.id);
      removedSpanIds.push(span.id);
    }

    let addedSpan = null;
    if (op === 'DELETE_BASELINE_RANGE') {
      const alreadyDeleted = containedSpans.length === 1 &&
        Number(containedSpans[0].baselineStart) === range.start &&
        Number(containedSpans[0].baselineEnd) === range.end &&
        String(containedSpans[0].replacementText || '') === '';
      if (alreadyDeleted && removedSpanIds.length === 1) {
        // Preserve the existing exact deletion span rather than replacing it with a
        // new identity just to create a no-op revision.
        spans.set(containedSpans[0].id, cloneSemanticValue(containedSpans[0]));
        return {
          spans,
          addedSpan: null,
          removedSpanIds: [],
          affectedBaselineRange: range,
          workingRange: { start: workingStart, end: workingEnd },
          baselineNative: true,
          noop: true,
          boundarySpanIds: boundarySpans.map(span => span.id),
        };
      }
      addedSpan = {
        schema: WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA,
        id: semanticId('working-span'),
        baselineId: baseline.id,
        baselineStart: range.start,
        baselineEnd: range.end,
        replacementText: '',
        replacementSha256: null,
        createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      spans.set(addedSpan.id, addedSpan);
    }

    validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baseline.text.length);
    return {
      spans,
      addedSpan,
      removedSpanIds,
      affectedBaselineRange: range,
      workingRange: { start: workingStart, end: workingEnd },
      baselineNative: true,
      noop: op === 'RESTORE_BASELINE_RANGE' && removedSpanIds.length === 0,
      boundarySpanIds: boundarySpans.map(span => span.id),
    };
  }

  function workingAffectedSpanIds(spans, workingStart, workingEnd) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const projection = buildWorkingPieces(baseline.text, spans);
    const ids = new Set();
    for (const piece of projection.pieces) {
      if (piece.kind !== 'replacement') continue;
      const overlaps = workingStart < piece.workingEnd && workingEnd > piece.workingStart;
      const insertionInside = workingStart === workingEnd &&
        workingStart >= piece.workingStart && workingStart <= piece.workingEnd;
      if (overlaps || insertionInside) ids.add(piece.spanId);
    }
    return ids;
  }

  function stageWorkingEdit(spansInput, editInput) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const spans = new Map(
      workingSortedSpans(spansInput).map(span => [span.id, cloneSemanticValue(span)])
    );
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync(spans);
    const workingStart = sourceClampOffset(editInput.workingStart, materialized.text.length);
    const workingEnd = sourceClampOffset(editInput.workingEnd, materialized.text.length);
    if (workingEnd < workingStart) throw new Error('Working edit range is reversed');
    const replacementText = String(editInput.replacementText ?? '');
    const affectedIds = workingAffectedSpanIds(spans, workingStart, workingEnd);
    let baselineStart = workingBoundaryToBaseline(workingStart, 'before', spans);
    let baselineEnd = workingBoundaryToBaseline(workingEnd, 'after', spans);
    for (const id of affectedIds) {
      const span = spans.get(id);
      baselineStart = Math.min(baselineStart, span.baselineStart);
      baselineEnd = Math.max(baselineEnd, span.baselineEnd);
    }
    const envelopeWorkingStart = baselineToWorkingOffset(baselineStart, 'before', spans);
    const envelopeWorkingEnd = baselineToWorkingOffset(baselineEnd, 'after', spans);
    const envelopeText = materialized.text.slice(envelopeWorkingStart, envelopeWorkingEnd);
    const relativeStart = workingStart - envelopeWorkingStart;
    const relativeEnd = workingEnd - envelopeWorkingStart;
    if (relativeStart < 0 || relativeEnd > envelopeText.length) {
      throw new Error('Unable to normalize working edit into baseline envelope');
    }
    const nextText =
      envelopeText.slice(0, relativeStart) +
      replacementText +
      envelopeText.slice(relativeEnd);
    const removedSpanIds = [];
    for (const span of workingSortedSpans(spans)) {
      const overlaps = span.baselineStart < baselineEnd && span.baselineEnd > baselineStart;
      const insertionInside = span.baselineStart === span.baselineEnd &&
        span.baselineStart >= baselineStart && span.baselineStart <= baselineEnd;
      if (overlaps || insertionInside || affectedIds.has(span.id)) {
        spans.delete(span.id);
        removedSpanIds.push(span.id);
      }
    }
    let addedSpan = null;
    const baselineText = baseline.text.slice(baselineStart, baselineEnd);
    if (nextText !== baselineText) {
      addedSpan = {
        schema: WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA,
        id: semanticId('working-span'),
        baselineId: baseline.id,
        baselineStart,
        baselineEnd,
        replacementText: nextText,
        replacementSha256: null,
        createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      spans.set(addedSpan.id, addedSpan);
    }
    validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baseline.text.length);
    return {
      spans,
      addedSpan,
      removedSpanIds,
      affectedBaselineRange: { start: baselineStart, end: baselineEnd },
      workingRange: { start: workingStart, end: workingEnd },
    };
  }

  function resolveWorkingTarget(targetInput = {}, spansInput = workingRuntime.spans, workspaceInput = null) {
    const runtime = requireSourceRuntime();
    const baseline = runtime.baseline;
    const workspace = workspaceInput || runtime.workspace;
    const target = typeof targetInput === 'string'
      ? { kind: targetInput }
      : { ...(targetInput || {}) };
    const kind = String(target.kind || 'active').toLowerCase();
    if (kind === 'working-range') {
      const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync(spansInput);
      return {
        kind,
        workingStart: sourceClampOffset(target.start, materialized.text.length),
        workingEnd: sourceClampOffset(target.end, materialized.text.length),
      };
    }
    // Deterministic recovery may need to resolve exact historical source tokens
    // outside the currently mounted traversal chunk. The whole Working Source is
    // a search envelope only: exact-match ambiguity/context checks still apply,
    // and the resulting edit is normalized back into the baseline/span model.
    if (kind === 'working-source' || kind === 'whole-working-source') {
      const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync(spansInput);
      return {
        kind: 'working-source',
        workingStart: 0,
        workingEnd: materialized.text.length,
      };
    }
    if (kind === 'change-span') {
      const span = spansInput instanceof Map
        ? spansInput.get(target.spanId || target.id)
        : workingSortedSpans(spansInput).find(item => item.id === (target.spanId || target.id));
      if (!span) throw new Error(`Unknown Working Source span ${target.spanId || target.id}`);
      const start = baselineToWorkingOffset(span.baselineStart, 'before', spansInput);
      return {
        kind,
        spanId: span.id,
        workingStart: start,
        workingEnd: start + span.replacementText.length,
      };
    }
    let baselineRange = null;
    if (kind === 'active') {
      baselineRange = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    } else if (kind === 'surface') {
      const item = workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.find(entry =>
        entry.id === (target.surfaceId || target.id)
      );
      if (!item) throw new Error(`Unknown surfaced range ${target.surfaceId || target.id}`);
      if (item.space === 'working') {
        return {
          kind,
          workingStart: sourceClampOffset(item.workingStart, materializeWorkingSourceSync(spansInput).text.length),
          workingEnd: sourceClampOffset(item.workingEnd, materializeWorkingSourceSync(spansInput).text.length),
        };
      }
      baselineRange = sourceNormalizeRange(item, baseline.text.length);
    } else if (kind === 'baseline-range') {
      baselineRange = sourceNormalizeRange(target, baseline.text.length);
    } else {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported Working Source target: ${kind}`);
    }
    if (!baselineRange) throw new Error(`Working Source target ${kind} has no valid range`);
    return {
      kind,
      baselineRange,
      workingStart: baselineToWorkingOffset(baselineRange.start, 'before', spansInput),
      workingEnd: baselineToWorkingOffset(baselineRange.end, 'after', spansInput),
    };
  }

  function resolveExactWorkingOperation(spans, operation, workspaceInput = null) {
    const op = String(operation.op || operation.action || 'REPLACE_EXACT').toUpperCase();
    if (op === 'APPLY_EDIT' || op === 'REPLACE_RANGE') {
      return {
        workingStart: Number(operation.workingStart ?? operation.start),
        workingEnd: Number(operation.workingEnd ?? operation.end),
        replacementText: String(operation.replacementText ?? operation.text ?? ''),
      };
    }

    // Baseline-native restore/delete operations are staged outside this generic
    // Working-coordinate editor. Routing them through stageWorkingEdit() used to
    // widen edits to a merged baseline envelope and could consume neighboring
    // accepted spans (the v313/v314 collateral regression class).
    if (BASELINE_NATIVE_SOURCE_OPS.has(op)) {
      throw new Error(`${op} must be staged through stageBaselineNativeOperation`);
    }

    // Exact source mutations are content-addressed. The active traversal chunk is
    // a cheap first search envelope, not an authority boundary. If the model did
    // not provide an explicit target and the exact token/context is absent locally,
    // widen deterministically to the complete Working Source. Explicit targets
    // remain strict and never escape their declared envelope.
    const expectedInput = operation.expectedText ?? operation.anchorText ?? operation.oldText ??
      (op === 'DELETE_EXACT' ? operation.text : '');
    const expected = String(expectedInput ?? '');
    if (!expected && !['INSERT_BEFORE', 'INSERT_AFTER'].includes(op)) {
      throw new Error(`${op} requires expectedText (anchorText/oldText are accepted aliases)`);
    }

    const explicitTarget = operation.target != null;
    const targetInputs = explicitTarget || !expected
      ? [operation.target || { kind: 'active' }]
      : [{ kind: 'active' }, { kind: 'working-source' }];
    const explicitIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(operation.matchIndex))
      ? Number(operation.matchIndex)
      : null;
    const eolVariants = value => {
      const text = String(value ?? '');
      const variants = [text];
      if (text.includes('\r\n')) variants.push(text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n'));
      else if (text.includes('\n')) variants.push(text.replace(/\n/g, '\r\n'));
      return [...new Set(variants)];
    };
    let lastMiss = null;

    for (let targetIndex = 0; targetIndex < targetInputs.length; targetIndex += 1) {
      const targetInput = targetInputs[targetIndex];
      let target;
      try {
        target = resolveWorkingTarget(targetInput, spans, workspaceInput);
      } catch (error) {
        const canWiden = !explicitTarget && targetIndex + 1 < targetInputs.length;
        if (canWiden) {
          lastMiss = error;
          continue;
        }
        throw error;
      }

      const projection = projectWorkingRangeSync(target.workingStart, target.workingEnd, spans);
      const targetDescription = target.baselineRange
        ? `${target.kind} baseline ${target.baselineRange.start}…${target.baselineRange.end}`
        : `${target.kind} working ${target.workingStart}…${target.workingEnd}`;
      const contextMatchesBefore = (index, context) =>
        context == null || eolVariants(context).some(candidate =>
          projection.text.slice(Math.max(0, index - candidate.length), index) === candidate
        );
      const contextMatchesAfter = (index, expectedLength, context) =>
        context == null || eolVariants(context).some(candidate => {
          const start = index + expectedLength;
          return projection.text.slice(start, start + candidate.length) === candidate;
        });

      const rawMatches = [];
      const matches = [];
      if (expected) {
        for (const candidateExpected of eolVariants(expected)) {
          let index = projection.text.indexOf(candidateExpected);
          while (index >= 0) {
            const identity = `${index}:${candidateExpected.length}`;
            if (!rawMatches.some(item => item.identity === identity)) {
              const match = {
                identity,
                index,
                length: candidateExpected.length,
                expectedText: candidateExpected,
              };
              rawMatches.push(match);
              const beforeOk = contextMatchesBefore(index, operation.contextBefore);
              const afterOk = contextMatchesAfter(index, candidateExpected.length, operation.contextAfter);
              if (beforeOk && afterOk) matches.push(match);
            }
            index = projection.text.indexOf(
              candidateExpected,
              index + Math.max(1, candidateExpected.length)
            );
          }
        }
      }

      if ((op === 'INSERT_BEFORE' || op === 'INSERT_AFTER') && !expected) {
        const localStart = op === 'INSERT_BEFORE' ? 0 : projection.text.length;
        return {
          workingStart: target.workingStart + localStart,
          workingEnd: target.workingStart + localStart,
          replacementText: String(operation.replacementText ?? operation.text ?? ''),
        };
      }

      if (!matches.length) {
        const canWiden = !explicitTarget && targetIndex + 1 < targetInputs.length;
        if (canWiden) {
          lastMiss = rawMatches.length
            ? new Error(
                `${op} exact token exists in ${targetDescription}, but contextBefore/contextAfter rejected every local match`
              )
            : new Error(`${op} exact token was not found in ${targetDescription}`);
          continue;
        }
        if (rawMatches.length) {
          throw new Error(
            `${op} ${op.startsWith('INSERT_') ? 'anchor' : 'expectedText'} exists in target (${rawMatches.length} raw match${rawMatches.length === 1 ? '' : 'es'}), but contextBefore/contextAfter rejected every match`
          );
        }
        throw new Error(
          `${op} ${op.startsWith('INSERT_') ? 'anchor' : 'expectedText'} was not found in target [${targetDescription}]` +
          (lastMiss ? ` after implicit source resolution: ${lastMiss.message}` : '')
        );
      }

      if (matches.length > 1 && explicitIndex == null) {
        throw new Error(
          `${op} ${op.startsWith('INSERT_') ? 'anchor' : 'expectedText'} is ambiguous in target (${matches.length} matches)`
        );
      }
      const selected = matches[explicitIndex ?? 0];
      if (selected == null) throw new Error(`${op} matchIndex is out of range`);
      const localStart = selected.index + (op === 'INSERT_AFTER' ? selected.length : 0);
      const localEnd = op === 'INSERT_BEFORE' || op === 'INSERT_AFTER'
        ? localStart
        : selected.index + selected.length;
      const replacementText = op === 'DELETE_EXACT'
        ? ''
        : String(operation.replacementText ?? operation.text ?? '');
      return {
        workingStart: target.workingStart + localStart,
        workingEnd: target.workingStart + localEnd,
        replacementText,
      };
    }

    throw lastMiss || new Error(`${op} implicit exact-source resolution produced no target`);
  }

  function rangesIntersect(a, b) {
    return a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end;
  }

  function workingAuthorityToken(workspaceInput = sourceRuntime.workspace) {
    const workspace = workspaceInput || null;
    return {
      sessionId: workspace?.sessionId || null,
      baselineId: workspace?.baselineId || null,
      workingSequence: Number(workspace?.working?.sequence || 0),
      headRevisionId: workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || null,
      workingIdentity: workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number(workspace?.revision || 0),
    };
  }

  function sameWorkingCommitAuthority(actualInput, expectedInput) {
    const actual = actualInput || {};
    const expected = expectedInput || {};
    return String(actual.sessionId || '') === String(expected.sessionId || '') &&
      String(actual.baselineId || '') === String(expected.baselineId || '') &&
      Number(actual.workingSequence || 0) === Number(expected.workingSequence || 0) &&
      String(actual.headRevisionId || '') === String(expected.headRevisionId || '') &&
      Number(actual.workspaceRevision || 0) === Number(expected.workspaceRevision || 0);
  }

  async function workingAtomicCommit({
    nextSpans,
    beforeSpanIds,
    revision,
    workspace,
    expectedParentAuthority = null,
  }) {
    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction(
      ['workingSpans', 'workingRevisions', 'workspaces'],
      'readwrite'
    );
    const workspaceStore = transaction.objectStore('workspaces');
    if (expectedParentAuthority) {
      const persistedWorkspace = await sourceRequest(
        workspaceStore.get(expectedParentAuthority.sessionId || workspace.sessionId)
      );
      const persistedAuthority = workingAuthorityToken(persistedWorkspace);
      if (!sameWorkingCommitAuthority(persistedAuthority, expectedParentAuthority)) {
        try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
        throw new Error(
          'SOURCE_OP_STALE_HEAD: atomic commit authority changed before write; ' +
          `expected Working r${expectedParentAuthority.workingSequence}/${expectedParentAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'} ` +
          `workspaceRevision ${expectedParentAuthority.workspaceRevision}, ` +
          `persisted Working r${persistedAuthority.workingSequence}/${persistedAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'} ` +
          `workspaceRevision ${persistedAuthority.workspaceRevision}`
        );
      }
    }
    const spanStore = transaction.objectStore('workingSpans');
    for (const span of nextSpans.values()) {
      if (!beforeSpanIds.includes(span.id)) spanStore.put(span);
    }
    transaction.objectStore('workingRevisions').put(revision);
    workspaceStore.put(workspace);
    await sourceTransactionDone(transaction);
  }

  async function invalidateIntelligenceForWorkingChange() {
    intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLens = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.queries.clear();
    intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
    intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;
    for (const controller of intelligenceRuntime.controllers.values()) controller.abort();
    intelligenceRuntime.controllers.clear();
  }

  function stageWorkingChangeSet(changeInput = {}, options = {}, workspaceInput = null) {
    const { session, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const semanticSession = options.semanticSession || session;
    const workspace = cloneSemanticValue(workspaceInput || sourceRuntime.workspace);
    const operations = Array.isArray(changeInput.operations)
      ? changeInput.operations
      : Array.isArray(changeInput.workingOps)
        ? changeInput.workingOps
        : [];
    if (!operations.length) throw new Error('Working Source change set has no operations');
    let stagedSpans = new Map(
      workingSortedSpans(workingRuntime.spans).map(span => [span.id, span])
    );
    const beforeSpanIds = [...stagedSpans.keys()];
    const affectedBaselineRanges = [];
    let effectiveOperationCount = 0;
    for (let operationIndex = 0; operationIndex < operations.length; operationIndex += 1) {
      const operation = operations[operationIndex];
      try {
        const opName = String(operation?.op || operation?.action || 'REPLACE_EXACT').toUpperCase();
        const staged = BASELINE_NATIVE_SOURCE_OPS.has(opName)
          ? stageBaselineNativeOperation(stagedSpans, operation)
          : stageWorkingEdit(
              stagedSpans,
              resolveExactWorkingOperation(stagedSpans, operation, options.targetWorkspace || workspace)
            );
        stagedSpans = staged.spans;
        if (!staged.noop) {
          affectedBaselineRanges.push(staged.affectedBaselineRange);
          effectiveOperationCount += 1;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        const opName = String(operation?.op || operation?.action || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();
        throw new Error(
          `source operation ${operationIndex + 1}/${operations.length} ${opName}: ${error?.message || error}`
        );
      }
    }
    if (!effectiveOperationCount) {
      throw new Error('SOURCE_OP_NO_EFFECT: all requested source operations already match current Working Source');
    }
    const afterSpanIds = workingSortedSpans(stagedSpans).map(span => span.id);
    const sequence = Number(workspace.working?.sequence || 0) + 1;
    const revisionId = semanticId('working-revision');
    const coveredRanges = workspace.cursor.coveredRanges || [];
    const affectedCoveredRanges = mergeSourceRanges(
      affectedBaselineRanges.filter(range =>
        coveredRanges.some(covered => rangesIntersect(range, covered))
      ),
      baseline.text.length
    );
    const revision = {
      schema: WORKING_REVISION_SCHEMA,
      id: revisionId,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      parentRevisionId: workspace.working?.headRevisionId || null,
      sequence,
      beforeActiveSpanIds: beforeSpanIds,
      afterActiveSpanIds: afterSpanIds,
      addedSpanIds: afterSpanIds.filter(id => !beforeSpanIds.includes(id)),
      removedSpanIds: beforeSpanIds.filter(id => !afterSpanIds.includes(id)),
      affectedBaselineRanges: mergeSourceRanges(affectedBaselineRanges, baseline.text.length),
      affectedCoveredRanges,
      intent: String(changeInput.intent || changeInput.workingChange?.intent || `source-mutation:${semanticSession.route.activity || 'UNSPECIFIED'}`),
      summary: String(changeInput.summary || changeInput.workingChange?.summary || `${operations.map(operation => String(operation?.op || operation?.action || 'SOURCE_OP').toUpperCase()).join(' + ')} · ${effectiveOperationCount} effective operation(s)`).trim(),
      rationale: String(changeInput.rationale || changeInput.workingChange?.rationale || (semanticActiveDistance(semanticSession)?.objective ? `Distance ${semanticSession.route.activeDistanceId || '(none)'}: ${semanticActiveDistance(semanticSession).objective}` : 'Committed source mutation under the accepted semantic control.')).trim(),
      activity: semanticSession.route.activity,
      distanceId: semanticSession.route.activeDistanceId,
      semanticRevision: Number(options.semanticRevision ?? semanticSession.revision),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(semanticSession),
      controlId: semanticSession.transport?.lastControl?.id || null,
      kind: String(options.kind || 'change'),
      sourceOps: canonicalSourceOpsForJournal(operations),
      sourceOpsDigest: sourceOpsDigest(operations),
      recovery: options.recovery ? cloneSemanticValue(options.recovery) : null,
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    const structureDirty = Boolean(workspace.working?.structureDirty) ||
      revision.affectedBaselineRanges.some(range => {
        const before = baseline.text.slice(
          Math.max(0, range.start - 24),
          Math.min(baseline.text.length, range.end + 24)
        );
        const projected = projectBaselineRangeSync(range.start, range.end, stagedSpans).text;
        return /<\/?(?:script|style)\b/i.test(before + projected);
      });
    workspace.working = {
      schema: WORKING_HEAD_SCHEMA,
      sequence,
      headRevisionId: revisionId,
      activeSpanIds: afterSpanIds,
      identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r${sequence}:${revisionId}`,
      structureDirty,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    return {
      workspace,
      nextSpans: stagedSpans,
      beforeSpanIds,
      revision,
      expectedParentAuthority: workingAuthorityToken(workspaceInput || sourceRuntime.workspace),
    };
  }

  async function commitStagedWorkingChange(stage, options = {}) {
    const { session, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const workspace = options.workspace || stage.workspace;
    workspace.revision = Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision || workspace.revision || 0) + 1;
    workspace.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    await workingAtomicCommit({
      nextSpans: stage.nextSpans,
      beforeSpanIds: stage.beforeSpanIds,
      revision: stage.revision,
      workspace,
      expectedParentAuthority: stage.expectedParentAuthority || null,
    });
    const persistedWorkspace = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', workspace.sessionId);
    const persistedRevision = await sourceDbGet('workingRevisions', stage.revision.id);
    if (
      String(persistedWorkspace?.working?.headRevisionId || '') !== String(stage.revision.id) ||
      Number(persistedWorkspace?.working?.sequence || 0) !== Number(stage.revision.sequence || 0) ||
      !persistedRevision
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_OP_COMMIT_VERIFY_FAILED: Working mutation transaction completed but read-back authority does not match committed revision; ' +
        `expected r${stage.revision.sequence}/${stage.revision.id}, ` +
        `persisted r${persistedWorkspace?.working?.sequence || 0}/${persistedWorkspace?.working?.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }
    workingRuntime.sessionId = session.id;
    workingRuntime.spans = stage.nextSpans;
    workingRuntime.headRevision = stage.revision;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = workspace;
    await invalidateIntelligenceForWorkingChange();
    if (options.syncSession !== false) {
      syncSourceProjectionIntoSession(workspace, baseline);
    }
    // Commit is already durable in Source DB at this point. Persist an independent
    // canonical sourceOps journal in Runtime DB; journal failure must never pretend
    // the already-committed source transaction rolled back.
    try {
      appendSourceMutationJournalEntry(stage.revision, SemanticSessionStore.load() || session);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    } catch (journalError) {
      warn('Source mutation committed but Runtime mutation journal persistence failed', journalError);
    }
    renderPanel();
    if (options.schedule !== false) scheduleProcess(100);
    return cloneSemanticValue(stage.revision);
  }

  async function applyWorkingChangeSet(changeInput = {}, options = {}) {
    if (options.skipAuthorityPreflight !== true) {
      await sourceMutationAuthorityPreflight({ semanticSession: options.semanticSession });
    } else {
      await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    }
    const stage = stageWorkingChangeSet(changeInput, options);
    return commitStagedWorkingChange(stage, options);
  }

  async function applyWorkingEdit(editInput = {}, options = {}) {
    return applyWorkingChangeSet({
      operations: [{
        op: 'APPLY_EDIT',
        workingStart: editInput.workingStart ?? editInput.start,
        workingEnd: editInput.workingEnd ?? editInput.end,
        replacementText: editInput.replacementText ?? editInput.text ?? '',
      }],
      intent: editInput.intent || options.intent,
      summary: editInput.summary || options.summary,
      rationale: editInput.rationale || options.rationale,
    }, options);
  }

  async function revertWorkingHead(options = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline, session } = requireSourceRuntime();
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const headRevision = workingRuntime.headRevision;
    if (!headRevision) return null;
    const beforeSpanIds = [...workspace.working.activeSpanIds];
    const targetIds = Array.isArray(headRevision.beforeActiveSpanIds)
      ? headRevision.beforeActiveSpanIds
      : [];
    const targetSpans = new Map();
    for (const id of targetIds) {
      const span = await sourceDbGet('workingSpans', id);
      if (!span) throw new Error(`Cannot revert: span ${id} is missing`);
      targetSpans.set(id, span);
    }
    validateWorkingSpanSet(targetSpans, baseline.text.length);
    const sequence = Number(workspace.working.sequence || 0) + 1;
    const revisionId = semanticId('working-revision');
    const revision = {
      schema: WORKING_REVISION_SCHEMA,
      id: revisionId,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      parentRevisionId: workspace.working.headRevisionId,
      sequence,
      beforeActiveSpanIds: beforeSpanIds,
      afterActiveSpanIds: targetIds,
      addedSpanIds: targetIds.filter(id => !beforeSpanIds.includes(id)),
      removedSpanIds: beforeSpanIds.filter(id => !targetIds.includes(id)),
      affectedBaselineRanges: cloneSemanticValue(headRevision.affectedBaselineRanges || []),
      affectedCoveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(headRevision.affectedCoveredRanges || []),
      intent: 'revert',
      summary: String(options.summary || `Revert ${headRevision.id}`),
      rationale: String(options.rationale || '').trim(),
      activity: session.route.activity,
      distanceId: session.route.activeDistanceId,
      semanticRevision: session.revision,
      kind: 'revert',
      revertsRevisionId: headRevision.id,
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    workspace.working = {
      ...workspace.working,
      sequence,
      headRevisionId: revisionId,
      activeSpanIds: targetIds,
      identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r${sequence}:${revisionId}`,
      structureDirty: true,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    workspace.revision = Number(workspace.revision || 0) + 1;
    workspace.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    await workingAtomicCommit({ nextSpans: targetSpans, beforeSpanIds, revision, workspace });
    workingRuntime.spans = targetSpans;
    workingRuntime.headRevision = revision;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = workspace;
    await invalidateIntelligenceForWorkingChange();
    syncSourceProjectionIntoSession(workspace, baseline);
    renderPanel();
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return cloneSemanticValue(revision);
  }

  async function workingExport(options = {}) {
    const { baseline, workspace } = requireSourceRuntime();
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync();
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(materialized.text);
    const sha256 = await sourceSha256(bytes.buffer);
    const manifest = {
      baselineSha256: baseline.sha256,
      workingIdentity: workspace.working.identity,
      workingSha256: sha256,
      revision: workspace.working.sequence,
      headRevisionId: workspace.working.headRevisionId,
      workingSizeChars: materialized.text.length,
      baselineSizeChars: Number(baseline.sizeChars || baseline.text.length),
      ...workingSpanStatsSync(materialized.spans),
      exportedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    if (options.download !== false && typeof Blob === 'function' && globalThis.URL?.createObjectURL) {
      const blob = new Blob([materialized.text], { type: baseline.type || 'text/plain' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const anchor = document.createElement('a');
      const suffix = workspace.working.sequence ? `.working-r${workspace.working.sequence}` : '.working';
      const name = baseline.name || 'monolith.html';
      const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
      anchor.download = dot > 0
        ? `${name.slice(0, dot)}${suffix}${name.slice(dot)}`
        : `${name}${suffix}`;
      anchor.href = url;
      anchor.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.appendChild(anchor);
      anchor.click();
      anchor.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    }
    return { text: materialized.text, manifest };
  }

  const WORKING_PATCH_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-working-patch/v1';

  function workingSpanStatsSync(spansInput = workingRuntime.spans) {
    const spans = workingSortedSpans(spansInput);
    let baselineChars = 0;
    let replacementChars = 0;
    let deletions = 0;
    let replacements = 0;
    let insertions = 0;
    for (const span of spans) {
      const removed = Math.max(0, Number(span.baselineEnd || 0) - Number(span.baselineStart || 0));
      const added = String(span.replacementText || '').length;
      baselineChars += removed;
      replacementChars += added;
      if (removed === 0 && added > 0) insertions += 1;
      else if (removed > 0 && added === 0) deletions += 1;
      else replacements += 1;
    }
    return {
      activeSpanCount: spans.length,
      baselineChars,
      replacementChars,
      netDeltaChars: replacementChars - baselineChars,
      deletions,
      replacements,
      insertions,
    };
  }

  function workingAuthorityProjectionSync() {
    const workspace = sourceRuntime.workspace;
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline;
    if (!workspace || !baseline) return { ready: false };
    const stats = workingSpanStatsSync();
    const audit = currentWorkingRefactorAudit();
    const auditFresh = Boolean(
      audit?.working?.identity &&
      workspace.working?.identity &&
      String(audit.working.identity) === String(workspace.working.identity)
    );
    return {
      ready: true,
      baselineName: baseline.name || null,
      baselineSha256: baseline.sha256 || null,
      baselineSizeChars: Number(baseline.sizeChars || baseline.text?.length || 0),
      workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || null,
      workingSequence: Number(workspace.working?.sequence || 0),
      headRevisionId: workspace.working?.headRevisionId || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number(workspace.revision || 0),
      structureDirty: Boolean(workspace.working?.structureDirty),
      workingSha256: auditFresh ? audit.working.sha256 || null : null,
      workingSizeChars: auditFresh
        ? Number(audit.working.sizeChars || 0)
        : Number(baseline.sizeChars || baseline.text?.length || 0) + stats.netDeltaChars,
      auditFresh,
      ...stats,
    };
  }

  function workingSpanDiffTextSync(options = {}) {
    const { baseline, workspace } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const spans = workingSortedSpans();
    const stats = workingSpanStatsSync(spans);
    const lines = [
      '# VIBE-GO WORKING SPAN DIFF v1',
      `# baseline: ${baseline.name || 'monolith'} · sha256 ${baseline.sha256}`,
      `# working: ${workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline'}`,
      `# head: ${workspace.working?.headRevisionId || '—'} · r${Number(workspace.working?.sequence || 0)}`,
      `# spans: ${stats.activeSpanCount} · delta ${stats.netDeltaChars >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${stats.netDeltaChars} chars`,
      '# Coordinates below are immutable baseline coordinates. This is a span diff, not a task-progress metric.',
      '',
    ];
    for (const span of spans) {
      const oldText = baseline.text.slice(span.baselineStart, span.baselineEnd);
      const newText = String(span.replacementText || '');
      const kind = span.baselineStart === span.baselineEnd
        ? 'INSERT'
        : newText.length === 0 ? 'DELETE' : 'REPLACE';
      lines.push(
        `@@ ${kind} baseline ${span.baselineStart}…${span.baselineEnd} · span ${span.id} @@`,
        `--- baseline (${oldText.length} chars)`,
        oldText,
        `+++ working (${newText.length} chars)`,
        newText,
        ''
      );
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  async function buildWorkingPatchBundle(options = {}) {
    const { baseline, workspace } = requireSourceRuntime();
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync();
    const workingBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(materialized.text);
    const workingSha256 = await sourceSha256(workingBytes.buffer);
    const stats = workingSpanStatsSync(materialized.spans);
    return {
      schema: WORKING_PATCH_SCHEMA,
      exportedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      baseline: {
        id: baseline.id,
        name: baseline.name,
        sha256: baseline.sha256,
        sizeChars: Number(baseline.sizeChars || baseline.text.length),
        sizeBytes: Number(baseline.sizeBytes || 0),
      },
      working: {
        identity: workspace.working?.identity || null,
        sequence: Number(workspace.working?.sequence || 0),
        headRevisionId: workspace.working?.headRevisionId || null,
        sha256: workingSha256,
        sizeChars: materialized.text.length,
        structureDirty: Boolean(workspace.working?.structureDirty),
        ...stats,
      },
      // Exact baseline SHA + normalized active spans are sufficient to reproduce
      // the Working Source without embedding the full immutable baseline again.
      spans: materialized.spans.map(span => ({
        id: span.id,
        baselineStart: Number(span.baselineStart),
        baselineEnd: Number(span.baselineEnd),
        replacementText: String(span.replacementText || ''),
        createdAt: span.createdAt || null,
      })),
    };
  }

  function downloadTextArtifact(filename, textValue, type = 'text/plain;charset=utf-8') {
    if (typeof Blob !== 'function' || !globalThis.URL?.createObjectURL) {
      throw new Error('Browser download APIs are unavailable');
    }
    const blob = new Blob([String(textValue ?? '')], { type });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');
    anchor.download = filename;
    anchor.href = url;
    anchor.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(anchor);
    anchor.click();
    anchor.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    return { filename, bytes: blob.size };
  }

  async function downloadWorkingPatch(options = {}) {
    const patch = await buildWorkingPatchBundle(options);
    const filename = options.filename || `vibe-go-working-r${patch.working.sequence}.patch.json`;
    const download = downloadTextArtifact(filename, JSON.stringify(patch, null, 2), 'application/json;charset=utf-8');
    return { patch, download };
  }

  function downloadWorkingDiff(options = {}) {
    const authority = workingAuthorityProjectionSync();
    if (!authority.ready) throw new Error('Working Source is not attached');
    const text = workingSpanDiffTextSync(options);
    const filename = options.filename || `vibe-go-working-r${authority.workingSequence}.span-diff.txt`;
    return { text, download: downloadTextArtifact(filename, text) };
  }

  async function surfaceWorkingRange(start, end, options = {}) {
    const { workspace, session } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync();
    const workingStart = sourceClampOffset(start, materialized.text.length);
    const workingEnd = sourceClampOffset(end, materialized.text.length);
    if (workingEnd <= workingStart) throw new Error('Invalid working surfaced range');
    const projected = projectWorkingRangeSync(workingStart, workingEnd);
    const baselineStart = Number.isFinite(Number(options.baselineStart))
      ? Number(options.baselineStart)
      : Number(projected.baselineEnvelope.start);
    const baselineEnd = Number.isFinite(Number(options.baselineEnd))
      ? Number(options.baselineEnd)
      : Number(projected.baselineEnvelope.end);
    const item = {
      id: String(options.id || semanticId('surface-working')),
      space: 'working',
      start: workingStart,
      end: workingEnd,
      workingStart,
      workingEnd,
      baselineStart,
      baselineEnd,
      label: String(options.label || 'working surfaced context'),
      reason: String(options.reason || '').trim(),
      distanceId: options.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
      workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || materialized.identity || 'baseline',
      explicitAddressed: options.explicitAddressed === true,
      status: 'active',
      lifecycle: sourceSurfaceLifecycleV651(options),
      createdAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    workspace.cursor.surfacedRanges.push(item);
    await saveSourceWorkspace(workspace);
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return cloneSemanticValue(item);
  }

  function workingSegmentMapSync() {
    const { workspace } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const identity = workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline';
    if (
      workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap &&
      workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity === identity &&
      !workspace.working?.structureDirty
    ) {
      return workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap;
    }
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync();
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = buildSourceSegmentMap(materialized.text, sourceRuntime.baseline || {});
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = identity;
    workspace.working.structureDirty = false;
    return workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap;
  }

  const WorkingSource = Object.freeze({
    schema: WORKING_HEAD_SCHEMA,
    async restore() {
      return restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    },
    status() {
      const workspace = sourceRuntime.workspace;
      return {
        ready: Boolean(workspace && sourceRuntime.baseline),
        identity: workspace?.working?.identity || null,
        sequence: workspace?.working?.sequence || 0,
        headRevisionId: workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || null,
        activeSpanCount: workingRuntime.spans.size,
        structureDirty: Boolean(workspace?.working?.structureDirty),
      };
    },
    materialize: materializeWorkingSourceSync,
    projectBaselineRange: projectBaselineRangeSync,
    projectWorkingRange: projectWorkingRangeSync,
    baselineToWorking: baselineToWorkingOffset,
    workingToBaseline: workingBoundaryToBaseline,
    resolveTarget: resolveWorkingTarget,
    applyEdit: applyWorkingEdit,
    applyChangeSet: applyWorkingChangeSet,
    revertHead: revertWorkingHead,
    export: workingExport,
    surface: surfaceWorkingRange,
    segmentMap: workingSegmentMapSync,
    activeProjection() {
      const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
      const range = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
      return range ? projectBaselineRangeSync(range.start, range.end) : null;
    },
    selfTest() {
      const baseline = 'AAA BBB CCC DDD';
      const span = {
        schema: WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA,
        id: 'span:test',
        baselineId: 'baseline:test',
        baselineStart: 4,
        baselineEnd: 7,
        replacementText: 'XX',
      };
      const pieces = buildWorkingPieces(baseline, new Map([[span.id, span]]));
      return {
        ok: pieces.workingLength === baseline.length - 1,
        pieces,
      };
    },
    internals: Object.freeze({
      buildWorkingPieces,
      stageWorkingEdit,
      stageBaselineNativeOperation,
      baselineNativeSpanRelation,
      validateWorkingSpanSet,
      stageWorkingChangeSet,
      commitStagedWorkingChange,
    }),
  });


  /*
   * Source Intelligence v2
   *
   * Local Lens analyzes only the active chunk. Targeted probes scan only the
   * relevant source segments for explicitly selected anchors. Results retain
   * compact ranges and reasons, never copies of the baseline source.
   */
  const SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-source-intelligence-query/v1';
  const SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION = 2;
  const INTELLIGENCE_RELATIONS = Object.freeze([
    'definitions', 'writers', 'consumers', 'selectors',
  ]);
  const intelligenceRuntime = {
    localLensKey: null,
    localLens: null,
    queries: new Map(),
    queryBytes: 0,
    controllers: new Map(),
    lastQueryId: null,
  };

  function intelligenceEscapeRegExp(value) {
    return String(value).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  }

  function intelligenceApproximateBytes(value) {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value).length * 2;
    } catch {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  function intelligenceBudgets(baseline) {
    const sourceBytes = Math.max(1, Number(baseline?.sizeBytes || baseline?.text?.length || 1));
    return {
      runtimeBytes: Math.min(4 * 1024 * 1024, Math.max(512 * 1024, Math.ceil(sourceBytes * 0.005))),
      storedBytes: Math.min(24 * 1024 * 1024, Math.max(2 * 1024 * 1024, Math.ceil(sourceBytes * 0.02))),
    };
  }

  function intelligenceQueryCompatibleV703(record, baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline, workingIdentity = null) {
    if (!record || record.schema !== SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_SCHEMA) return false;
    if (Number(record.version || 0) !== Number(SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION)) return false;
    if (baseline?.id && String(record.baselineId || '') !== String(baseline.id)) return false;
    if (workingIdentity != null && String(record.workingIdentity || '') !== String(workingIdentity || '')) return false;
    return true;
  }

  function intelligenceRememberQuery(record, baseline) {
    if (!intelligenceQueryCompatibleV703(record, baseline)) return null;
    const copy = cloneSemanticValue(record);
    const bytes = Number(copy.approximateBytes || intelligenceApproximateBytes(copy));
    copy.approximateBytes = bytes;
    if (intelligenceRuntime.queries.has(copy.id)) {
      intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes -= Number(
        intelligenceRuntime.queries.get(copy.id).approximateBytes || 0
      );
      intelligenceRuntime.queries.delete(copy.id);
    }
    intelligenceRuntime.queries.set(copy.id, copy);
    intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes += bytes;
    intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = copy.id;
    const budget = intelligenceBudgets(baseline).runtimeBytes;
    while (intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes > budget && intelligenceRuntime.queries.size > 1) {
      const [oldestId, oldest] = intelligenceRuntime.queries.entries().next().value;
      intelligenceRuntime.queries.delete(oldestId);
      intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes -= Number(oldest.approximateBytes || 0);
    }
    return copy;
  }

  async function intelligencePruneStoredQueries(baseline) {
    const rows = (await sourceDbGetAll('intelligenceQueries'))
      .filter(item => item?.baselineId === baseline.id);
    const compatible = [];
    for (const item of rows) {
      if (!intelligenceQueryCompatibleV703(item, baseline)) {
        await sourceDbDelete('intelligenceQueries', item.id);
        continue;
      }
      compatible.push(item);
    }
    compatible.sort((a, b) => String(b.lastUsedAt || b.createdAt).localeCompare(String(a.lastUsedAt || a.createdAt)));
    const budget = intelligenceBudgets(baseline).storedBytes;
    let bytes = 0;
    for (const item of compatible) {
      bytes += Number(item.approximateBytes || intelligenceApproximateBytes(item));
      if (bytes > budget) await sourceDbDelete('intelligenceQueries', item.id);
    }
  }

  function intelligenceMaskJavaScript(value) {
    const source = String(value || '');
    const chars = source.split('');
    let mode = 'code';
    let quote = '';
    let escaped = false;
    let regexClass = false;
    const regexCanStart = index => {
      let cursor = index - 1;
      while (cursor >= 0 && /\s/.test(source[cursor])) cursor -= 1;
      if (cursor < 0) return true;
      return /[({[=,:;!?&|+\-*%^~<>]/.test(source[cursor]);
    };
    for (let index = 0; index < chars.length; index += 1) {
      const char = source[index];
      const next = source[index + 1] || '';
      if (mode === 'line-comment') {
        if (char === '\n') mode = 'code';
        else chars[index] = ' ';
        continue;
      }
      if (mode === 'block-comment') {
        chars[index] = char === '\n' ? '\n' : ' ';
        if (char === '*' && next === '/') {
          chars[index + 1] = ' ';
          index += 1;
          mode = 'code';
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (mode === 'string') {
        chars[index] = char === '\n' ? '\n' : ' ';
        if (escaped) escaped = false;
        else if (char === '\\') escaped = true;
        else if (char === quote) mode = 'code';
        continue;
      }
      if (mode === 'regex') {
        chars[index] = char === '\n' ? '\n' : ' ';
        if (escaped) escaped = false;
        else if (char === '\\') escaped = true;
        else if (char === '[') regexClass = true;
        else if (char === ']') regexClass = false;
        else if (char === '/' && !regexClass) mode = 'regex-flags';
        else if (char === '\n') mode = 'code';
        continue;
      }
      if (mode === 'regex-flags') {
        if (/[A-Za-z]/.test(char)) {
          chars[index] = ' ';
          continue;
        }
        mode = 'code';
      }
      if (char === '/' && next === '/') {
        chars[index] = chars[index + 1] = ' ';
        index += 1;
        mode = 'line-comment';
      } else if (char === '/' && next === '*') {
        chars[index] = chars[index + 1] = ' ';
        index += 1;
        mode = 'block-comment';
      } else if (char === '/' && regexCanStart(index)) {
        chars[index] = ' ';
        mode = 'regex';
        regexClass = false;
      } else if (char === '"' || char === "'" || char === '`') {
        chars[index] = ' ';
        quote = char;
        mode = 'string';
      }
    }
    return chars.join('');
  }

  function intelligenceFindMatchingBrace(masked, openIndex) {
    if (masked[openIndex] !== '{') return -1;
    let depth = 0;
    for (let index = openIndex; index < masked.length; index += 1) {
      if (masked[index] === '{') depth += 1;
      else if (masked[index] === '}') {
        depth -= 1;
        if (depth === 0) return index;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function intelligenceDefinitionRange(text, masked, localStart, searchFrom, globalStart) {
    const brace = masked.indexOf('{', searchFrom);
    const semicolon = masked.indexOf(';', searchFrom);
    const lineEnd = masked.indexOf('\n', searchFrom);
    if (brace >= 0 && brace <= localStart + 2800 && (semicolon < 0 || brace < semicolon)) {
      const close = intelligenceFindMatchingBrace(masked, brace);
      if (close >= 0) return { start: globalStart + localStart, end: globalStart + close + 1 };
    }
    const ends = [semicolon >= 0 ? semicolon + 1 : -1, lineEnd >= 0 ? lineEnd : -1]
      .filter(value => value > localStart);
    const localEnd = ends.length ? Math.min(...ends) : Math.min(text.length, localStart + 600);
    return { start: globalStart + localStart, end: globalStart + localEnd };
  }

  function intelligenceContextRange(text, offset, preferredEnd = null) {
    const startLine = Math.max(0, text.lastIndexOf('\n', Math.max(0, offset - 1)) + 1);
    if (preferredEnd != null && preferredEnd > offset) {
      return { start: startLine, end: Math.min(text.length, preferredEnd) };
    }
    let end = offset;
    for (let count = 0; count < 3; count += 1) {
      const next = text.indexOf('\n', end + 1);
      if (next < 0) return { start: startLine, end: text.length };
      end = next;
    }
    return { start: startLine, end: Math.min(text.length, end + 1) };
  }

  function intelligenceCandidate({ baseline, anchor, relation, kind, start, end, reason, confidence }) {
    const range = intelligenceContextRange(baseline.text, start, end);
    const baselineEnvelope = typeof WorkingSource !== 'undefined'
      ? {
          start: WorkingSource.workingToBaseline(range.start, 'before'),
          end: WorkingSource.workingToBaseline(range.end, 'after'),
        }
      : { start: range.start, end: range.end };
    return {
      id: `candidate:${hashText(`${baseline.id}:${anchor}:${relation}:${start}:${kind}`)}`,
      anchor,
      relation,
      kind,
      space: 'working',
      start: range.start,
      end: range.end,
      workingStart: range.start,
      workingEnd: range.end,
      baselineStart: baselineEnvelope.start,
      baselineEnd: baselineEnvelope.end,
      matchStart: start,
      confidence,
      reason,
    };
  }

  function intelligenceExtractSelectors(text, baseOffset = 0) {
    const selectors = [];
    const specs = [
      { regex: /\bgetElementById\s*\(\s*(["'])(.*?)\1/g, prefix: '#' },
      { regex: /\bgetElementsByClassName\s*\(\s*(["'])(.*?)\1/g, prefix: '.' },
      { regex: /\b(?:querySelector|querySelectorAll|closest|matches)\s*\(\s*(["'])(.*?)\1/g, prefix: '' },
    ];
    for (const spec of specs) {
      let match;
      while ((match = spec.regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
        const raw = match[2];
        const values = spec.prefix
          ? [spec.prefix + raw.trim()]
          : [...raw.matchAll(/[#.][A-Za-z_][\w-]*/g)].map(item => item[0]);
        for (const value of values.filter(Boolean)) {
          selectors.push({
            value,
            kind: 'selector-reference',
            start: baseOffset + match.index,
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return selectors;
  }

  function buildSourceLocalLens() {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const range = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    if (!range) return null;
    const mode = workspace.cursor.activeRange?.mode ||
      sourceRegionAt(baseline.text, range.start, workspace.segmentMap).mode;
    const projection = WorkingSource.projectBaselineRange(range.start, range.end);
    const workingBase = projection.workingRange.start;
    const workingIdentity = workspace.working?.identity || 'baseline';
    const key = `${baseline.id}:${workingIdentity}:${range.start}:${range.end}:${mode}`;
    if (intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey === key) {
      return cloneSemanticValue(intelligenceRuntime.localLens);
    }
    const source = projection.text;
    const definitions = [];
    const anchors = new Map();
    const addAnchor = (kind, value, start, relation = null) => {
      if (!value) return;
      const keyValue = `${kind}:${value}`;
      if (!anchors.has(keyValue)) anchors.set(keyValue, { kind, value, occurrences: 0, relations: [] });
      const item = anchors.get(keyValue);
      item.occurrences += 1;
      if (relation && !item.relations.includes(relation)) item.relations.push(relation);
      if (item.firstOffset == null) item.firstOffset = start;
    };
    if (mode === 'javascript') {
      const masked = intelligenceMaskJavaScript(source);
      const definitionSpecs = [
        { kind: 'function', regex: /\b(?:async\s+)?function\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(/g },
        { kind: 'class', regex: /\bclass\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\b/g },
        { kind: 'variable', regex: /\b(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=/g },
        { kind: 'global-owner', regex: /\b(?:window|globalThis|self)\.([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=/g },
      ];
      for (const spec of definitionSpecs) {
        let match;
        while ((match = spec.regex.exec(masked)) !== null) {
          const name = match[1];
          const nameOffset = match.index + match[0].indexOf(name);
          const definitionRange = intelligenceDefinitionRange(
            source, masked, match.index, spec.regex.lastIndex, workingBase
          );
          definitions.push({
            kind: spec.kind,
            name,
            start: definitionRange.start,
            end: definitionRange.end,
          });
          addAnchor('identifier', name, workingBase + nameOffset, 'definitions');
        }
      }
      const callPattern = /\b([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(/g;
      const ignoredCalls = new Set(['if', 'for', 'while', 'switch', 'catch', 'function']);
      let match;
      while ((match = callPattern.exec(masked)) !== null) {
        if (!ignoredCalls.has(match[1])) addAnchor('identifier', match[1], workingBase + match.index, 'consumers');
      }
      const writerPattern = /\b((?:window|globalThis|self)\.)?([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)*)\s*(?:=|\+=|-=|\*=|\/=|\+\+|--)/g;
      while ((match = writerPattern.exec(masked)) !== null) {
        addAnchor('member-path', match[2], workingBase + match.index, 'writers');
        addAnchor('identifier', match[2].split('.')[0], workingBase + match.index, 'writers');
      }
      const memberPattern = /\b([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)+)/g;
      while ((match = memberPattern.exec(masked)) !== null) {
        addAnchor('member-path', match[1], workingBase + match.index, null);
      }
      for (const selector of intelligenceExtractSelectors(source, workingBase)) {
        addAnchor('selector', selector.value, selector.start, 'selectors');
      }
    } else if (mode === 'css') {
      let match;
      const selectorPattern = /([#.][A-Za-z_][\w-]*)/g;
      while ((match = selectorPattern.exec(source)) !== null) {
        addAnchor('selector', match[1], workingBase + match.index, 'selectors');
      }
      const customPropertyPattern = /(--[A-Za-z_][\w-]*)\s*:/g;
      while ((match = customPropertyPattern.exec(source)) !== null) {
        definitions.push({ kind: 'css-custom-property', name: match[1], start: workingBase + match.index, end: workingBase + match.index + match[1].length });
        addAnchor('css-property', match[1], workingBase + match.index, 'definitions');
      }
    } else {
      let match;
      const attributePattern = /\b(id|class)\s*=\s*(["'])(.*?)\2/gi;
      while ((match = attributePattern.exec(source)) !== null) {
        const values = match[1].toLowerCase() === 'id'
          ? [`#${match[3].trim()}`]
          : match[3].split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(value => `.${value}`);
        for (const value of values.filter(value => value.length > 1)) {
          definitions.push({ kind: 'html-selector', name: value, start: workingBase + match.index, end: workingBase + attributePattern.lastIndex });
          addAnchor('selector', value, workingBase + match.index, 'selectors');
        }
      }
      const handlerPattern = /\bon[a-z]+\s*=\s*(["'])(.*?)\1/gi;
      while ((match = handlerPattern.exec(source)) !== null) {
        for (const call of match[2].matchAll(/\b([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(/g)) {
          addAnchor('identifier', call[1], workingBase + match.index, 'consumers');
        }
      }
    }
    const lens = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-source-local-lens/v1',
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      workingIdentity,
      workspaceRevision: workspace.revision,
      range: { ...range, mode, workingStart: projection.workingRange.start, workingEnd: projection.workingRange.end },
      definitions: definitions.slice(0, 160),
      anchors: [...anchors.values()]
        .sort((a, b) => b.occurrences - a.occurrences || a.value.localeCompare(b.value))
        .slice(0, 240),
      builtAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = key;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLens = lens;
    return cloneSemanticValue(lens);
  }

  function normalizeIntelligenceQuery(input) {
    const value = typeof input === 'string' ? { anchor: input } : { ...(input || {}) };
    const anchor = String(value.anchor?.value ?? value.anchor ?? '').trim();
    if (!anchor) throw new Error('Source Intelligence query requires an anchor');
    const kind = String(value.kind || value.anchor?.kind || (
      /^[#.]/.test(anchor) ? 'selector' : anchor.startsWith('--') ? 'css-property' : anchor.includes('.') ? 'member-path' : 'identifier'
    ));
    const relations = [...new Set(
      (Array.isArray(value.relations) ? value.relations : INTELLIGENCE_RELATIONS)
        .map(item => String(item).toLowerCase())
        .filter(item => INTELLIGENCE_RELATIONS.includes(item))
    )];
    if (!relations.length) throw new Error('Source Intelligence query has no supported relations');
    return { anchor, kind, relations, force: Boolean(value.force) };
  }

  function intelligenceRelevantSegments(workspace, query) {
    const modes = query.kind === 'selector'
      ? new Set(['html', 'css', 'javascript'])
      : query.kind === 'css-property'
        ? new Set(['css', 'javascript'])
        : new Set(['javascript', 'text', 'html']);
    return workspace.segmentMap.filter(segment => modes.has(segment.mode));
  }

  function intelligenceClassifyIdentifierMatch({ source, masked, localIndex, anchor, relation }) {
    const before = masked.slice(Math.max(0, localIndex - 120), localIndex);
    const after = masked.slice(localIndex + anchor.length, Math.min(masked.length, localIndex + anchor.length + 160));
    const linePrefix = before.slice(before.lastIndexOf('\n') + 1);
    const methodLikeDeclaration = /^\s*(?:(?:async|static|get|set)\s+)*$/.test(linePrefix) &&
      /^\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{/.test(after);
    const definition = /(?:function|class|const|let|var)\s+$/.test(before) ||
      (/(?:window|globalThis|self)\.\s*$/.test(before) && /^\s*=/.test(after)) ||
      methodLikeDeclaration;
    const writer = /^\s*(?:\.[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)*\s*(?:=|\+=|-=|\*=|\/=|\+\+|--)/.test(after);
    const call = /^\s*\(/.test(after);
    if (relation === 'definitions' && definition) return { kind: 'definition', confidence: 'strong', reason: 'exact declaration or global owner assignment' };
    if (relation === 'writers' && writer) return { kind: 'writer', confidence: 'strong', reason: 'exact assignment or mutation target' };
    if (relation === 'consumers' && !definition && !writer) {
      return { kind: call ? 'call' : 'read', confidence: call ? 'strong' : 'probable', reason: call ? 'exact function call' : 'exact identifier read' };
    }
    return null;
  }

  function intelligenceSelectorCandidates({ baseline, segment, slice, sliceStart, query, coreStart, coreEnd }) {
    const candidates = [];
    const occurrences = [];
    if (segment.mode === 'html' && /^[#.]/.test(query.anchor)) {
      const token = query.anchor.slice(1);
      const attribute = query.anchor.startsWith('#') ? 'id' : 'class';
      const attributePattern = new RegExp(`\\b${attribute}\\s*=\\s*(["'])(.*?)\\1`, 'gi');
      let attributeMatch;
      while ((attributeMatch = attributePattern.exec(slice)) !== null) {
        const raw = attributeMatch[2];
        const tokens = attribute === 'id' ? [raw.trim()] : raw.split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        if (!tokens.includes(token)) continue;
        const rawOffset = attributeMatch.index + attributeMatch[0].indexOf(raw);
        const tokenOffset = raw.indexOf(token);
        occurrences.push(rawOffset + Math.max(0, tokenOffset));
      }
    } else {
      const pattern = new RegExp(intelligenceEscapeRegExp(query.anchor), 'g');
      let match;
      while ((match = pattern.exec(slice)) !== null) occurrences.push(match.index);
    }
    for (const localIndex of occurrences) {
      const globalStart = sliceStart + localIndex;
      if (globalStart < coreStart || globalStart >= coreEnd) continue;
      const classifications = [];
      if (segment.mode === 'html') {
        if (query.relations.includes('definitions')) {
          classifications.push({ relation: 'definitions', kind: 'html-selector', confidence: 'strong', reason: 'exact HTML id/class declaration' });
        }
        if (query.relations.includes('selectors')) {
          classifications.push({ relation: 'selectors', kind: 'html-selector', confidence: 'strong', reason: 'exact selector occurrence in HTML' });
        }
      } else if (segment.mode === 'css') {
        if (query.relations.includes('definitions')) {
          classifications.push({ relation: 'definitions', kind: 'css-selector', confidence: 'strong', reason: 'exact CSS selector declaration' });
        }
        if (query.relations.includes('selectors')) {
          classifications.push({ relation: 'selectors', kind: 'css-selector', confidence: 'strong', reason: 'exact selector occurrence in CSS' });
        }
      } else {
        if (query.relations.includes('consumers')) {
          classifications.push({ relation: 'consumers', kind: 'dom-selector-reference', confidence: 'probable', reason: 'exact selector string in JavaScript' });
        }
        if (query.relations.includes('selectors')) {
          classifications.push({ relation: 'selectors', kind: 'dom-selector-reference', confidence: 'probable', reason: 'exact selector occurrence in JavaScript' });
        }
      }
      for (const classification of classifications) {
        candidates.push(intelligenceCandidate({
          baseline,
          anchor: query.anchor,
          relation: classification.relation,
          kind: classification.kind,
          start: globalStart,
          reason: classification.reason,
          confidence: classification.confidence,
        }));
      }
    }
    return candidates;
  }

  async function runSourceIntelligenceQuery(input) {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const query = normalizeIntelligenceQuery(input);
    const materialized = WorkingSource.materialize();
    const workingIdentity = workspace.working?.identity || materialized.identity || 'baseline';
    const scanSource = { id: workingIdentity, text: materialized.text };
    const scanWorkspace = { ...workspace, segmentMap: WorkingSource.segmentMap() };
    const fingerprint = hashText(JSON.stringify({
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      workingIdentity,
      version: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION,
      anchor: query.anchor,
      kind: query.kind,
      relations: query.relations.slice().sort(),
    }));
    const id = `query:${fingerprint}`;
    if (!query.force) {
      const memory = intelligenceRuntime.queries.get(id);
      if (intelligenceQueryCompatibleV703(memory, baseline, workingIdentity)) {
        memory.lastUsedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        intelligenceRememberQuery(memory, baseline);
        return cloneSemanticValue(memory);
      } else if (memory) {
        intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes -= Number(memory.approximateBytes || 0);
        intelligenceRuntime.queries.delete(id);
      }
      const stored = await sourceDbGet('intelligenceQueries', id);
      if (intelligenceQueryCompatibleV703(stored, baseline, workingIdentity)) {
        stored.lastUsedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        await sourceDbPut('intelligenceQueries', stored);
        intelligenceRememberQuery(stored, baseline);
        return cloneSemanticValue(stored);
      } else if (stored) {
        await sourceDbDelete('intelligenceQueries', id);
      }
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    intelligenceRuntime.controllers.set(id, controller);
    const settings = workspace.settings || SOURCE_DEFAULTS;
    const sliceChars = Math.max(32768, Number(settings.intelligenceSliceChars || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.intelligenceSliceChars));
    const overlap = Math.max(128, Number(settings.intelligenceSliceOverlap || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.intelligenceSliceOverlap));
    const limit = Math.max(20, Number(settings.intelligenceCandidateLimit || SOURCE_DEFAULTS.intelligenceCandidateLimit));
    const candidates = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const segments = intelligenceRelevantSegments(scanWorkspace, query);
    const exactIdentifier = new RegExp(`\\b${intelligenceEscapeRegExp(query.anchor)}\\b`, 'g');
    try {
      for (const segment of segments) {
        const segmentStart = segment.contentStart ?? segment.start;
        const segmentEnd = segment.contentEnd ?? segment.end;
        for (let coreStart = segmentStart; coreStart < segmentEnd; coreStart += sliceChars) {
          if (controller.signal.aborted) {
            const error = new Error('Source Intelligence query aborted');
            error.name = 'AbortError';
            throw error;
          }
          const coreEnd = Math.min(segmentEnd, coreStart + sliceChars);
          const sliceStart = Math.max(segmentStart, coreStart - overlap);
          const sliceEnd = Math.min(segmentEnd, coreEnd + overlap);
          const slice = scanSource.text.slice(sliceStart, sliceEnd);
          if (query.kind === 'selector' || query.kind === 'css-property') {
            if (query.relations.includes('selectors') || query.relations.includes('definitions') || query.relations.includes('consumers')) {
              for (const candidate of intelligenceSelectorCandidates({ baseline: scanSource, segment, slice, sliceStart, query, coreStart, coreEnd })) {
                const key = `${candidate.relation}:${candidate.matchStart}:${candidate.kind}`;
                if (!seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); candidates.push(candidate); }
              }
            }
          } else if (segment.mode === 'javascript') {
            const masked = intelligenceMaskJavaScript(slice);
            exactIdentifier.lastIndex = 0;
            let match;
            while ((match = exactIdentifier.exec(masked)) !== null) {
              const globalStart = sliceStart + match.index;
              if (globalStart < coreStart || globalStart >= coreEnd) continue;
              for (const relation of query.relations) {
                if (relation === 'selectors') continue;
                const classification = intelligenceClassifyIdentifierMatch({
                  source: slice,
                  masked,
                  localIndex: match.index,
                  anchor: query.anchor,
                  relation,
                });
                if (!classification) continue;
                let preferredEnd = null;
                if (relation === 'definitions') {
                  preferredEnd = intelligenceDefinitionRange(slice, masked, match.index, match.index + query.anchor.length, sliceStart).end;
                }
                const candidate = intelligenceCandidate({
                  baseline: scanSource,
                  anchor: query.anchor,
                  relation,
                  kind: classification.kind,
                  start: globalStart,
                  end: preferredEnd,
                  reason: classification.reason,
                  confidence: classification.confidence,
                });
                const key = `${candidate.relation}:${candidate.matchStart}:${candidate.kind}`;
                if (!seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); candidates.push(candidate); }
              }
              if (candidates.length >= limit) break;
            }
          } else if (segment.mode === 'text') {
            const pattern = new RegExp(intelligenceEscapeRegExp(query.anchor), 'g');
            let match;
            while ((match = pattern.exec(slice)) !== null) {
              const globalStart = sliceStart + match.index;
              if (globalStart < coreStart || globalStart >= coreEnd) continue;
              const relation = query.relations.includes('consumers') ? 'consumers' : query.relations[0];
              const candidate = intelligenceCandidate({
                baseline: scanSource,
                anchor: query.anchor,
                relation,
                kind: 'text-match',
                start: globalStart,
                reason: 'exact plain-text occurrence; no structural completeness guarantee',
                confidence: 'probable',
              });
              const key = `${candidate.relation}:${candidate.matchStart}:${candidate.kind}`;
              if (!seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); candidates.push(candidate); }
              if (candidates.length >= limit) break;
            }
          } else if (segment.mode === 'html' && query.relations.includes('consumers')) {
            const handlerPattern = new RegExp(`\\b${intelligenceEscapeRegExp(query.anchor)}\\s*\\(`, 'g');
            let match;
            while ((match = handlerPattern.exec(slice)) !== null) {
              const globalStart = sliceStart + match.index;
              if (globalStart < coreStart || globalStart >= coreEnd) continue;
              const candidate = intelligenceCandidate({
                baseline: scanSource,
                anchor: query.anchor,
                relation: 'consumers',
                kind: 'html-handler',
                start: globalStart,
                reason: 'exact inline handler call',
                confidence: 'strong',
              });
              const key = `${candidate.relation}:${candidate.matchStart}:${candidate.kind}`;
              if (!seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); candidates.push(candidate); }
            }
          }
          if (candidates.length >= limit) break;
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
        }
        if (candidates.length >= limit) break;
      }
      candidates.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.relation.localeCompare(b.relation));
      const record = {
        schema: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_SCHEMA,
        id,
        baselineId: baseline.id,
        workingIdentity,
        version: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION,
        anchor: query.anchor,
        kind: query.kind,
        relations: query.relations,
        parser: [...new Set(segments.map(segment => segment.mode))].join('+') || 'unknown',
        completeness: 'unknown',
        scope: { space: 'working', workingIdentity, start: 0, end: scanSource.text.length },
        status: 'ready',
        candidateCount: candidates.length,
        truncated: candidates.length >= limit,
        candidates: candidates.slice(0, limit),
        createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        lastUsedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      record.approximateBytes = intelligenceApproximateBytes(record);
      await sourceDbPut('intelligenceQueries', record);
      await intelligencePruneStoredQueries(baseline);
      intelligenceRememberQuery(record, baseline);
      const semantic = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (semantic) {
        sourceInvalidateUnsentDispatch(semantic);
        SemanticSessionStore.save(semantic);
      }
      return cloneSemanticValue(record);
    } finally {
      intelligenceRuntime.controllers.delete(id);
    }
  }

  function cancelSourceIntelligenceQuery(queryId = intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId) {
    const controller = intelligenceRuntime.controllers.get(queryId);
    if (!controller) return false;
    controller.abort();
    intelligenceRuntime.controllers.delete(queryId);
    return true;
  }

  async function findSourceIntelligenceCandidate(candidateId) {
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline;
    const workingIdentity = sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || WorkingSource.materialize()?.identity || null;
    for (const [queryId, query] of [...intelligenceRuntime.queries.entries()]) {
      if (!intelligenceQueryCompatibleV703(query, baseline, workingIdentity)) {
        intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes -= Number(query?.approximateBytes || 0);
        intelligenceRuntime.queries.delete(queryId);
        continue;
      }
      const candidate = query.candidates?.find(item => item.id === candidateId);
      if (candidate) return { query, candidate };
    }
    const records = await sourceDbGetAll('intelligenceQueries');
    for (const query of records) {
      if (!intelligenceQueryCompatibleV703(query, baseline, workingIdentity)) {
        if (query?.baselineId === baseline?.id) await sourceDbDelete('intelligenceQueries', query.id);
        continue;
      }
      const candidate = query.candidates?.find(item => item.id === candidateId);
      if (candidate) {
        intelligenceRememberQuery(query, baseline);
        return { query, candidate };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function surfaceSourceIntelligenceCandidate(candidateId, options = {}) {
    const found = await findSourceIntelligenceCandidate(candidateId);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`Unknown Source Intelligence candidate ${candidateId}`);
    if (found.candidate.space === 'working') {
      return WorkingSource.surface(found.candidate.workingStart, found.candidate.workingEnd, {
        id: options.id,
        baselineStart: found.candidate.baselineStart,
        baselineEnd: found.candidate.baselineEnd,
        label: options.label || `${found.candidate.relation}: ${found.query.anchor}`,
        reason: options.reason || `${found.candidate.confidence} · ${found.candidate.reason}`,
        distanceId: options.distanceId,
        lifecycle: options.lifecycle || 'ephemeral',
        explicitAddressed: true,
      });
    }
    return SourceWorkspace.surface(found.candidate.start, found.candidate.end, {
      id: options.id,
      label: options.label || `${found.candidate.relation}: ${found.query.anchor}`,
      reason: options.reason || `${found.candidate.confidence} · ${found.candidate.reason}`,
      distanceId: options.distanceId,
      lifecycle: options.lifecycle || 'ephemeral',
      explicitAddressed: true,
    });
  }

  async function searchExactWorkingTextV705(input = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const materialized = WorkingSource.materialize();
    const queryText = String(input.query ?? input.text ?? input.anchor ?? '').trim();
    if (!queryText) {
      const error = new Error('SEARCH requires non-empty query/text/anchor');
      error.code = 'SOURCE_SEARCH_QUERY_REQUIRED';
      throw error;
    }
    const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Number(input.limit || 32)));
    const caseSensitive = input.caseSensitive !== false;
    const haystack = caseSensitive ? materialized.text : materialized.text.toLowerCase();
    const needle = caseSensitive ? queryText : queryText.toLowerCase();
    const candidates = [];
    let from = 0;
    while (from <= haystack.length - needle.length && candidates.length < limit) {
      const matchStart = haystack.indexOf(needle, from);
      if (matchStart < 0) break;
      const range = intelligenceContextRange(materialized.text, matchStart);
      candidates.push({
        id: `candidate:${hashText(`${materialized.identity || workspace.working?.identity || 'working'}:search:${queryText}:${matchStart}`)}`,
        anchor: queryText,
        relation: 'match',
        kind: 'literal-working-match',
        space: 'working',
        start: range.start,
        end: range.end,
        workingStart: range.start,
        workingEnd: range.end,
        baselineStart: null,
        baselineEnd: null,
        matchStart,
        confidence: 'exact',
        reason: 'exact literal occurrence in current Working; search is discovery evidence, not a completeness/semantic-role claim',
      });
      from = matchStart + Math.max(1, needle.length);
    }
    const workingIdentity = workspace.working?.identity || materialized.identity || 'baseline';
    const fingerprint = hashText(JSON.stringify({
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      workingIdentity,
      version: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION,
      op: 'SEARCH',
      queryText,
      caseSensitive,
      limit,
    }));
    const record = {
      schema: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_SCHEMA,
      id: `query:${fingerprint}`,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      workingIdentity,
      version: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION,
      anchor: queryText,
      kind: 'literal',
      relations: ['match'],
      parser: 'literal-working',
      completeness: candidates.length < limit ? 'complete-for-exact-literal-scan' : 'truncated-at-limit',
      scope: { space: 'working', workingIdentity, start: 0, end: materialized.text.length },
      status: 'ready',
      candidateCount: candidates.length,
