      truncated: candidates.length >= limit,
      candidates,
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      lastUsedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    record.approximateBytes = intelligenceApproximateBytes(record);
    await sourceDbPut('intelligenceQueries', record);
    await intelligencePruneStoredQueries(baseline);
    intelligenceRememberQuery(record, baseline);
    return cloneSemanticValue(record);
  }

  async function readExactSourceRangeV703(input = {}) {
    const { workspace, baseline, session } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const space = String(input.space || (input.workingStart != null || input.workingEnd != null ? 'working' : 'working')).toLowerCase() === 'baseline'
      ? 'baseline'
      : 'working';
    const materialized = WorkingSource.materialize();
    const sourceLength = space === 'working' ? materialized.text.length : baseline.text.length;
    const rawStart = Number(input.workingStart ?? input.start);
    const rawEnd = Number(input.workingEnd ?? input.end);
    if (!Number.isFinite(rawStart) || !Number.isFinite(rawEnd)) {
      const error = new Error('READ_RANGE requires numeric start/end (or workingStart/workingEnd)');
      error.code = 'SOURCE_READ_RANGE_INVALID';
      throw error;
    }
    const start = sourceClampOffset(Math.min(rawStart, rawEnd), sourceLength);
    const end = sourceClampOffset(Math.max(rawStart, rawEnd), sourceLength);
    if (end <= start) {
      const error = new Error(`READ_RANGE produced an empty ${space} range ${start}…${end}`);
      error.code = 'SOURCE_READ_RANGE_INVALID';
      throw error;
    }
    const maxChars = Math.max(1000, Number(CONFIG.semanticExplicitReadMaxCharsV703 || 18000));
    const addressedProjectionV703 = space === 'baseline'
      ? WorkingSource.projectBaselineRange(start, end)
      : WorkingSource.projectWorkingRange(start, end);
    const addressedCharsV703 = String(addressedProjectionV703?.text || '').length;
    if ((end - start) > maxChars || addressedCharsV703 > maxChars) {
      const error = new Error(
        `READ_RANGE ${space} range ${start}…${end} addresses ${end - start} coordinate chars but projects to ${addressedCharsV703} Working chars; explicit-read limit is ${maxChars}. ` +
        (space === 'baseline'
          ? 'The baseline range crosses expanded Working ancestry; re-address the desired bytes in Working coordinates.'
          : 'Split the request into bounded Working ranges.')
      );
      error.code = 'SOURCE_READ_RANGE_TOO_LARGE';
      throw error;
    }
    const options = {
      id: input.id || semanticId('explicit-read'),
      label: String(input.label || `explicit ${space} read ${start}…${end}`),
      reason: String(input.reason || 'Explicit address requested by the active Unit; bypass relevance projection.'),
      distanceId: input.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
      lifecycle: 'ephemeral',
      explicitAddressed: true,
    };
    if (space === 'working') return WorkingSource.surface(start, end, options);
    return SourceWorkspace.surface(start, end, options);
  }

  async function applySourceIntelligenceOps(ops) {
    const results = [];
    let explicitReadCountV703 = 0;
    let explicitReadCharsV703 = 0;
    for (const raw of Array.isArray(ops) ? ops : []) {
      const op = String(raw?.op || raw?.action || '').toUpperCase();
      try {
        if (op === 'SEARCH') {
          results.push({ ok: true, op, value: await searchExactWorkingTextV705(raw) });
        } else if (op === 'QUERY' || op === 'PROBE') {
          results.push({ ok: true, op, value: await runSourceIntelligenceQuery(raw) });
        } else if (op === 'READ_RANGE' || op === 'SURFACE_RANGE') {
          explicitReadCountV703 += 1;
          const maxReads = Math.max(1, Number(CONFIG.semanticExplicitReadMaxPerBatchV703 || 2));
          if (explicitReadCountV703 > maxReads) {
            const error = new Error(`Too many explicit reads in one sourceOps batch (${explicitReadCountV703} > ${maxReads})`);
            error.code = 'SOURCE_READ_RANGE_BATCH_LIMIT';
            throw error;
          }
          const requestedStartV703 = Number(raw?.workingStart ?? raw?.start);
          const requestedEndV703 = Number(raw?.workingEnd ?? raw?.end);
          const requestedCharsV703 = Number.isFinite(requestedStartV703) && Number.isFinite(requestedEndV703)
            ? Math.abs(requestedEndV703 - requestedStartV703)
            : 0;
          const batchMaxCharsV703 = Math.max(2000, Number(CONFIG.semanticExplicitReadBatchMaxCharsV703 || 18000));
          if (explicitReadCharsV703 + requestedCharsV703 > batchMaxCharsV703) {
            const error = new Error(`Explicit-read batch would exceed ${batchMaxCharsV703} chars; split reads across turns.`);
            error.code = 'SOURCE_READ_RANGE_BATCH_CHAR_LIMIT';
            throw error;
          }
          const valueV703 = await readExactSourceRangeV703(raw);
          explicitReadCharsV703 += Math.max(0, Number(valueV703?.end ?? valueV703?.workingEnd ?? 0) - Number(valueV703?.start ?? valueV703?.workingStart ?? 0));
          results.push({ ok: true, op, value: valueV703 });
        } else if (op === 'SURFACE_CANDIDATE') {
          results.push({
            ok: true,
            op,
            value: await surfaceSourceIntelligenceCandidate(raw.candidateId || raw.id, raw),
          });
        } else if (op === 'CANCEL_QUERY') {
          results.push({ ok: true, op, value: cancelSourceIntelligenceQuery(raw.queryId || raw.id) });
        } else {
          results.push({
            ok: false,
            op: op || '(missing)',
            error: 'Unsupported source operation',
            message: 'Unsupported source operation',
            error_code: 'SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION',
            failure_domain: 'TOOL_REQUEST_FAILURE',
            recoverable: true,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({
          ok: false,
          op: op || '(missing)',
          error: error?.message || String(error),
          message: error?.message || String(error),
          error_code: error?.code || 'SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILURE',
          failure_domain: 'TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILURE',
          recoverable: true,
          ...(error?.stack ? { traceback: semanticMemoryText(error.stack, 5000) } : {}),
        });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  function sourceIntelligenceBatchForDispatch(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput && typeof sessionInput === 'object' ? sessionInput : null;
    const batch = session?.transport?.lastSourceIntelligenceOps || null;
    if (!batch || Number(batch.revision) !== Number(session?.revision)) return null;
    const currentSequenceV645 = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const batchSequenceV645 = Number(batch.acceptanceSequence);
    if (Number.isInteger(batchSequenceV645) && batchSequenceV645 >= 0) {
      return batchSequenceV645 === currentSequenceV645 ? batch : null;
    }
    // Legacy batches had no transport sequence. Admit only when they were recorded
    // no earlier than the current accepted control; otherwise a same-r no-op turn
    // would incorrectly re-echo stale local evidence.
    const batchAtV645 = Date.parse(String(batch.recordedAt || ''));
    const controlAtV645 = Date.parse(String(session?.transport?.lastControl?.acceptedAt || ''));
    if (Number.isFinite(batchAtV645) && Number.isFinite(controlAtV645) && batchAtV645 >= controlAtV645) return batch;
    return null;
  }

  function appendSourceIntelligenceQueryProjection(lines, query, budgetState, options = {}) {
    if (!query || budgetState.exhausted) return false;
    const perQueryLimit = Math.max(1, Number(
      sourceRuntime.workspace?.settings?.intelligenceBatchCandidatesPerQuery ||
      SOURCE_DEFAULTS.intelligenceBatchCandidatesPerQuery
    ));
    const header = [
      `QUERY ${query.id}`,
      `Anchor: ${query.anchor} · relations: ${(query.relations || []).join(', ') || '(none)'}`,
      `Parser: ${query.parser || 'unknown'} · completeness: ${query.completeness || 'unknown'} · scope: ${query.scope?.space || 'working'} ${query.scope?.start ?? 0}…${query.scope?.end ?? '?'}`,
      `Absence contract: ${query.completeness === 'complete' ? 'zero candidates may support scoped absence' : 'zero candidates DO NOT prove source absence'}`,
      `Candidates: ${Number(query.candidateCount || query.candidates?.length || 0)}${query.truncated ? ' · truncated' : ''}`,
    ];
    const rows = [];
    const candidates = Array.isArray(query.candidates) ? query.candidates.slice(0, perQueryLimit) : [];
    if (!candidates.length) rows.push('- (none)');
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      const coordinates = candidate.space === 'working'
        ? `working ${candidate.workingStart}…${candidate.workingEnd}`
        : `${candidate.start}…${candidate.end}`;
      rows.push(
        `- ${candidate.id} · ${candidate.relation}/${candidate.kind} · ${candidate.confidence}`,
        `  ${candidate.reason} · ${coordinates}`
      );
    }
    const block = [...header, ...rows].join('\n');
    if (budgetState.used + block.length > budgetState.limit) {
      budgetState.exhausted = true;
      return false;
    }
    lines.push(...header, ...rows);
    budgetState.used += block.length;
    return true;
  }

  function buildSourceIntelligenceDispatchContext(sessionInput = null, options = {}) {
    const thinNormalV630 = options?.thinNormal === true;
    const batch = sourceIntelligenceBatchForDispatch(sessionInput);
    if (thinNormalV630 && !batch) {
      return 'SOURCE INTELLIGENCE · no fresh local evidence in this semantic revision; older query/lens state remains persisted and is not echoed.';
    }
    let lens = null;
    try {
      lens = buildSourceLocalLens();
    } catch {
      return 'SOURCE INTELLIGENCE\n(no active Source Workspace)';
    }
    const lines = [thinNormalV630 ? 'SOURCE INTELLIGENCE · FRESH EVIDENCE' : 'SOURCE INTELLIGENCE · LOCAL LENS'];
    if (!lens) return lines.concat('(no active chunk)').join('\n');
    if (!thinNormalV630) lines.push(
      `Range: ${lens.range.start}…${lens.range.end} · ${lens.range.mode}`,
      '',
      'Definitions:'
    );
    if (!thinNormalV630) {
      if (lens.definitions.length) {
        for (const item of lens.definitions.slice(0, 24)) {
          lines.push(`- ${item.kind} ${item.name} · ${item.start}…${item.end}`);
        }
      } else lines.push('- (none detected)');
      lines.push('', 'Available anchors:');
      for (const item of lens.anchors.slice(0, 32)) {
        const relations = item.relations.length ? ` · probes: ${item.relations.join(', ')}` : '';
        lines.push(`- ${item.kind} ${item.value} · occurrences ${item.occurrences}${relations}`);
      }
    }

    const fullHistory = options.fullHistory === true;
    const batchBudget = {
      used: 0,
      limit: Math.max(2000, Number(
        sourceRuntime.workspace?.settings?.intelligenceBatchDispatchChars ||
        SOURCE_DEFAULTS.intelligenceBatchDispatchChars
      )),
      exhausted: false,
    };
    let includedQueries = 0;
    let omittedQueries = 0;

    if (batch) {
      const results = Array.isArray(batch.results) ? batch.results : [];
      lines.push(
        '',
        `FRESH LOCAL EVIDENCE BATCH · semantic r${Number(batch.revision || 0)}`,
        `Operations: ${results.length} · ok ${results.filter(item => item.ok !== false).length} · failed ${results.filter(item => item.ok === false).length}`
      );
      const queryIds = [...new Set(results
        .filter(item => item.ok !== false && ['SEARCH', 'QUERY', 'PROBE'].includes(String(item.op || '').toUpperCase()))
        .map(item => String(item.resultId || ''))
        .filter(Boolean)
      )].slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(
        sourceRuntime.workspace?.settings?.intelligenceBatchQueryLimit ||
        SOURCE_DEFAULTS.intelligenceBatchQueryLimit
      )));
      for (const queryId of queryIds) {
        const query = intelligenceRuntime.queries.get(queryId) || null;
        if (!query || !appendSourceIntelligenceQueryProjection(lines, query, batchBudget)) {
          omittedQueries += 1;
          continue;
        }
        includedQueries += 1;
      }
      const nonQuery = results.filter(item => !['SEARCH', 'QUERY', 'PROBE'].includes(String(item.op || '').toUpperCase()));
      if (nonQuery.length) {
        lines.push('', 'LOCAL OP OUTCOMES:');
        for (const item of nonQuery) {
          const coordinates = item.space === 'working' && Number.isFinite(Number(item.workingStart))
            ? ` · working ${item.workingStart}…${item.workingEnd}`
            : Number.isFinite(Number(item.start)) ? ` · ${item.start}…${item.end}` : '';
          lines.push(`- ${item.op}: ${item.ok === false ? `FAIL · ${item.error || 'unknown error'}` : 'ok'}${coordinates}`);
        }
      }
      if (omittedQueries || batchBudget.exhausted) {
        lines.push(
          '',
          `FRESH BATCH BUDGET · query projections included ${includedQueries}; omitted ${omittedQueries}${batchBudget.exhausted ? ' · context budget reached' : ''}. Full query records remain persisted in Source Intelligence storage.`
        );
      }
    } else if (fullHistory) {
      const latest = intelligenceRuntime.queries.get(intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId) || null;
      if (latest) {
        lines.push('', `RECOVERY QUERY · ${latest.id}`);
        appendSourceIntelligenceQueryProjection(lines, latest, batchBudget, options);
      }
    } else {
      lines.push('', 'No fresh targeted Source Intelligence batch in this semantic revision; older query records remain persisted and are not re-echoed in normal delta transport.');
    }

    lines.push(
      '',
      thinNormalV630
        ? 'Fresh local evidence only. Request any further independent QUERY/PROBE operations together in one VG_PATCH.'
        : 'This lens and fresh batch are factual context only. When several independent local facts are already known to be necessary, request their QUERY/PROBE operations together in one VG_PATCH; runner executes the local batch before the next model-facing dispatch. Do not split independent probes into extra model turns merely to serialize tool use.'
    );
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  async function clearSourceIntelligence(options = {}) {
    intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLens = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.queries.clear();
    intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
    intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;
    for (const controller of intelligenceRuntime.controllers.values()) controller.abort();
    intelligenceRuntime.controllers.clear();
    if (options.persistent !== false && sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      const records = await sourceDbGetAll('intelligenceQueries');
      for (const record of records) {
        if (record.baselineId === sourceRuntime.baseline.id) {
          await sourceDbDelete('intelligenceQueries', record.id);
        }
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  const SourceIntelligence = Object.freeze({
    version: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION,
    localLens: buildSourceLocalLens,
    query: runSourceIntelligenceQuery,
    cancel: cancelSourceIntelligenceQuery,
    surfaceCandidate: surfaceSourceIntelligenceCandidate,
    applyOps: applySourceIntelligenceOps,
    buildDispatchContext: buildSourceIntelligenceDispatchContext,
    clear: clearSourceIntelligence,
    status() {
      return {
        ready: Boolean(sourceRuntime.baseline && sourceRuntime.workspace),
        baselineId: sourceRuntime.baseline?.id || null,
        localLens: intelligenceRuntime.localLens
          ? {
              range: cloneSemanticValue(intelligenceRuntime.localLens.range),
              definitions: intelligenceRuntime.localLens.definitions.length,
              anchors: intelligenceRuntime.localLens.anchors.length,
            }
          : null,
        cachedQueries: intelligenceRuntime.queries.size,
        cachedBytes: intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes,
        runningQueries: [...intelligenceRuntime.controllers.keys()],
        lastQueryId: intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId,
        budgets: intelligenceBudgets(sourceRuntime.baseline),
      };
    },
    internals: Object.freeze({
      maskJavaScript: intelligenceMaskJavaScript,
      normalizeQuery: normalizeIntelligenceQuery,
      approximateBytes: intelligenceApproximateBytes,
    }),
  });

  const PROJECT_DATA_PROVIDER_SCHEMA_V670 = 'vibe-go-project-data-provider/v2';
  const PROJECT_DATA_BATCH_SCHEMA_V670 = 'vibe-go-project-data-evidence-batch/v1';

  async function runProjectDataUnknownOutcomeRecoveryV6917(reason = 'relay-ready') {

    const pending = hydrateProjectDataUnknownOutcomeFromSessionV6917();

    projectDataUnknownOutcomeRecoveryRuntimeV6917.lastRequestId = requestId;
    try {

      projectDataUnknownOutcomeRecoveryRuntimeV6917.lastResult = cloneSemanticValue(recovered);
      if (recovered?.resolved === true && String(recovered?.outcome || '').toUpperCase() === 'COMMITTED') {

  function projectDataTransportBackoffV6915(indexInput = 0) {

      : [2000, 5000, 10000, 30000, 60000];

  }

  function normalizeTransportStackSignatureV6915(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .split('\n')
      .slice(0, 5)
      .map(line => line.replace(/:\d+:\d+/g, ':#:#').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join('|')
      .slice(0, 1200);
  }

  function projectDataTransportFailureFingerprintV6915(itemInput = {}) {
    const item = itemInput && typeof itemInput === 'object' ? itemInput : {};
    const domain = String(item.failure_domain || item.failureDomain || '').toUpperCase();
    const code = String(item.error_code || item.code || 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE').toUpperCase();
    const stack = normalizeTransportStackSignatureV6915(item.traceback || item.stack || item?.details?.traceback || item?.details?.stack || '');
    return [domain || 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE', code, stack].join('::');
  }

  function ensureProjectDataTransportWakeStateV6915(session) {
    session.transport ||= {};
    const current = session.transport.transportWakeV6915;
    if (!current || current.schema !== PROJECT_DATA_TRANSPORT_WAKE_SCHEMA_V6915) {
      session.transport.transportWakeV6915 = {
        schema: PROJECT_DATA_TRANSPORT_WAKE_SCHEMA_V6915,
        status: 'idle',
        resource: 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY',
        distanceIds: [],
        backoffIndex: 0,
        probeCount: 0,
        lastFailureFingerprint: null,
        lastProbeAt: null,
        nextProbeAt: null,
        lastSuccessAt: null,
        lastWakeAt: null,
        pendingWake: null,
        updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
    const wake = session.transport.transportWakeV6915;
    wake.distanceIds = [...new Set((Array.isArray(wake.distanceIds) ? wake.distanceIds : []).map(String).filter(Boolean))];
    wake.backoffIndex = Math.max(0, Number(wake.backoffIndex || 0));
    wake.probeCount = Math.max(0, Number(wake.probeCount || 0));
    return wake;
  }

  function projectDataTransportWaitingDistancesV6915(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.peek?.() || null;
    if (!session) return [];
    return Object.values(session.distances || {}).filter(item =>
      item?.status === 'waiting_on_transport' &&
      String(item?.waitingOnTransport?.resource || '').toUpperCase() === 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY'
    );
  }

  function recordProjectDataTransportWakeBatchV6915(session, rawResults, requested = [{ op: 'PING' }]) {
    const acceptanceSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const results = (Array.isArray(rawResults) ? rawResults : []).map((item, index) =>
      boundedProjectDataResultV670(normalizeProjectDataToolResultV6914(item, requested[index] || requested[0] || { op: 'PING' }))
    );
    session.transport ||= {};
    session.transport.lastProjectDataOpsV670 = {
      schema: PROJECT_DATA_BATCH_SCHEMA_V670,
      revision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence,
      recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requested: requested.length,
      succeeded: results.filter(item => item.ok !== false).length,
      failed: results.filter(item => item.ok === false).length,
      results,
      transportWakeProbeV6915: true,

  }

  function applyProjectDataTransportProbeOutcomeV6915(session, outcomeInput = {}) {
    const waiting = projectDataTransportWaitingDistancesV6915(session);
    const wake = ensureProjectDataTransportWakeStateV6915(session);
    if (!waiting.length) {
      wake.status = 'idle';
      wake.distanceIds = [];
      wake.pendingWake = null;
      return { wake: false, kind: 'no-waiters', activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null };
    }
    const at = semanticIsoNow();
    wake.distanceIds = waiting.map(item => item.id);
    wake.lastProbeAt = at;
    wake.probeCount += 1;
    if (outcomeInput.ok === true) {
      const rawResults = Array.isArray(outcomeInput.results) ? outcomeInput.results : [{ ok: true, op: 'PING', value: { ok: true } }];
      recordProjectDataTransportWakeBatchV6915(session, rawResults);
      for (const distance of waiting) {
        distance.status = 'resumable';
        distance.resumableAt = at;
        distance.updatedAt = at;
        if (distance.waitingOnTransport) {
          distance.waitingOnTransport.recoveredAt = at;
          distance.waitingOnTransport.updatedAt = at;
          distance.waitingOnTransport.wakeReason = 'PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_RECOVERED';
        }
        recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'TRANSPORT_RESUMABLE', {
          distanceId: distance.id,
          resource: 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY',
          reason: 'relay recovered',
        });
      }
      wake.status = 'recovered';
      wake.backoffIndex = 0;
      wake.lastSuccessAt = at;
      wake.lastWakeAt = at;
      wake.pendingWake = { kind: 'PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_RECOVERED', at };
      wake.updatedAt = at;
      scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'project-data-relay-recovered');
      return { wake: true, kind: 'recovered', activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null };
    }

    const failure = outcomeInput.failure || projectDataFailureObservationV696(outcomeInput.error || new Error('PROJECT_DATA_TRANSPORT_WAKE_PROBE_FAILED'));
    const normalized = normalizeProjectDataToolResultV6914(failure, { op: 'PING' });
    const fingerprint = projectDataTransportFailureFingerprintV6915(normalized);
    const previous = String(wake.lastFailureFingerprint || waiting[0]?.waitingOnTransport?.failureFingerprint || '');
    const materiallyNew = Boolean(previous && fingerprint && previous !== fingerprint);
    wake.lastFailureFingerprint = fingerprint;
    wake.updatedAt = at;
    if (materiallyNew) {
      recordProjectDataTransportWakeBatchV6915(session, [normalized]);
      for (const distance of waiting) {
        distance.status = 'resumable';
        distance.resumableAt = at;
        distance.updatedAt = at;
        if (distance.waitingOnTransport) {
          distance.waitingOnTransport.updatedAt = at;
          distance.waitingOnTransport.wakeReason = 'MATERIALLY_NEW_TRANSPORT_FAILURE';
          distance.waitingOnTransport.failureFingerprint = fingerprint;
          distance.waitingOnTransport.failureEnvelope = boundedProjectDataResultV670(normalized);
        }
      }
      wake.status = 'repair-wake';
      wake.lastWakeAt = at;
      wake.pendingWake = { kind: 'MATERIALLY_NEW_TRANSPORT_FAILURE', fingerprint, at };
      scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'materially-new-project-data-transport-failure');
      return { wake: true, kind: 'materially-new-failure', fingerprint, activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null };
    }

    wake.status = 'watching';
    wake.pendingWake = null;
    wake.backoffIndex = Math.min(
      Math.max(0, (Array.isArray(CONFIG.projectDataTransportWakeBackoffMsV6915) ? CONFIG.projectDataTransportWakeBackoffMsV6915.length : 5) - 1),
      Number(wake.backoffIndex || 0) + 1
    );
    return { wake: false, kind: 'same-failure', fingerprint, activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null };
  }

  function clearProjectDataTransportWakeTimerV6915() {

  function scheduleProjectDataTransportWakeProbeV6915(delayMs = null, reason = 'transport-watch') {
    if (!state.running) return false;
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const waiting = projectDataTransportWaitingDistancesV6915(session);
    if (!session || !waiting.length) {
      clearProjectDataTransportWakeTimerV6915();
      return false;
    }
    const wake = ensureProjectDataTransportWakeStateV6915(session);
    if (projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.inFlight) return true;
    if (projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.timer) return true;
    const delay = delayMs == null ? projectDataTransportBackoffV6915(wake.backoffIndex) : Math.max(50, Number(delayMs || 0));
    wake.status = 'watching';
    wake.distanceIds = waiting.map(item => item.id);
    wake.nextProbeAt = new Date(Date.now() + delay).toISOString();
    wake.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    session.transport.transportWakeV6915 = wake;
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.timer = null;
      runProjectDataTransportWakeProbeV6915(reason).catch(error => warn('a09.15 transport wake probe failed unexpectedly', error));
    }, delay);
    return true;
  }

  function nudgeProjectDataTransportWakeControllerV6915(reason = 'relay-ready-event') {
    if (!state.running) return false;
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    if (!projectDataTransportWaitingDistancesV6915(session).length) return false;

  async function runProjectDataTransportWakeProbeV6915(reason = 'transport-watch') {
    if (!state.running || projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.inFlight) return { handled: false, reason: 'not-runnable' };
    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || !projectDataTransportWaitingDistancesV6915(session).length) return { handled: false, reason: 'no-waiters' };
    projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.inFlight = true;
    projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.generation += 1;
    let outcome = null;
    try {
      const results = await applyProjectDataOpsV670([{ op: 'PING' }], session, {
        timeoutMs: Number(CONFIG.projectDataTransportWakeProbeTimeoutMsV6915 || 8000),
      });
      const ping = Array.isArray(results) ? results[0] : null;
      if (!ping || ping.ok === false) {
        outcome = { ok: false, failure: normalizeProjectDataToolResultV6914(ping || { ok: false, op: 'PING', error: 'PING returned no success result' }, { op: 'PING' }) };
      } else {
        outcome = { ok: true, results };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      outcome = { ok: false, failure: projectDataFailureObservationV696(error) };
    } finally {
      projectDataTransportWakeRuntimeV6915.inFlight = false;
    }

    session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return { handled: false, reason: 'session-lost' };
    const result = applyProjectDataTransportProbeOutcomeV6915(session, outcome || {});
    const wake = ensureProjectDataTransportWakeStateV6915(session);
    wake.lastProbeReason = String(reason || 'transport-watch');
    wake.nextProbeAt = null;
    wake.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);

    if (result.wake) {
      clearProjectDataTransportWakeTimerV6915();
      scheduleProcess(80);
      return { handled: true, ...result };
    }
    scheduleProjectDataTransportWakeProbeV6915(null, 'backoff-retry');
    return { handled: true, ...result };
  }

        error_code: 'PROJECT_DATA_HTTP_403',
        failure_domain: 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE',
        recoverable: true,
        traceback: 'Error: forbidden at relay (snippet:///vibe-go-project-data:10684:16)',
      },
    });
    const changedWake = newFailure.wake === true && newFailure.kind === 'materially-new-failure' && changedEntered.route.activeDistanceId === changedRootId;
    const changedRevisionStable = changedEntered.revision === changedRevision;

    const sections = {
      waitTransportCreatesTransportSchedulerState: blockedStateCreated,
      waitTransportRemovesBlockedDistanceFromActiveSlotBeforeWake: sameFailure.activeDistanceId == null,
      identicalFailureDoesNotWake: sameFailure.wake === false && sameFailure.kind === 'same-failure',

      identicalFailureDoesNotChangeSemanticMeaning: sameFailureNoSemanticMutation,

      recoveryDoesNotAdvanceSemanticCounters: recoveryRevisionStable,
      materiallyNewFailureProducesRepairWake: changedWake,
      materiallyNewFailureDoesNotAdvanceSemanticRevision: changedRevisionStable,
    };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-transport-wake-controller-acceptance/v1',
      ok: Object.values(sections).every(Boolean),
      sections,
      counters: {
        blockedRevision,
        blockedAcceptanceSequence: blockedSequence,
        finalRevision: entered.revision,
        finalAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(entered),
      },
      states: {
        sameFailure,
        recovered,
        newFailure,
      },
    };
  }

  function projectDataToolFailureDomainV6914(itemInput = {}, requestInput = {}) {
    const item = itemInput && typeof itemInput === 'object' ? itemInput : {};
    const request = requestInput && typeof requestInput === 'object' ? requestInput : {};
    const existing = String(item.failure_domain || item.failureDomain || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (existing) return existing;
    const message = String(
      item.error || item.message || item?.details?.error || item?.value?.error || ''
    );
    const code = String(item.error_code || item.code || item?.details?.error_code || '');
    const combined = `${code} ${message}`;
    const requestFailure = /unknown analyzer|save_analyzer first|unknown (?:op|operation)|unsupported (?:op|operation|projectops)|invalid (?:argument|args|schema|id)|missing (?:argument|field|id)|(?:argument|field|id) .* required|valueerror|keyerror|typeerror|must (?:provide|include|be)|expected .*?(?:argument|field|id)|not found|does not exist/i.test(combined);
    const executionFailure = /traceback|syntaxerror|parsererror|operationalerror|exit[_ -]?code|worker .* failed|analyzer .* failed|process .* failed|spawn|executable|stderr|runtimeerror/i.test(combined);
    if (requestFailure) return 'TOOL_REQUEST_FAILURE';
    if (executionFailure) return 'TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILURE';
    // A bridge operation returned ok:false after transport itself succeeded. That is a
    // tool-domain failure by construction; default to execution when request-shape
    // evidence is insufficient rather than escalating it into semantic authority.
    return item.ok === false || request.op ? 'TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILURE' : 'TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILURE';
  }

  function normalizeProjectDataToolResultV6914(itemInput = {}, requestInput = {}) {
    const item = cloneSemanticValue(itemInput || {});
    if (item.ok !== false) return item;
    const request = requestInput && typeof requestInput === 'object' ? requestInput : {};
    const domain = projectDataToolFailureDomainV6914(item, request);
    if (['EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE', 'MUTATION_DELIVERY_UNKNOWN'].includes(domain)) return item;
    const op = String(item.op || request.op || request.action || '(unknown)').trim() || '(unknown)';
    const message = String(item.error || item.message || item?.details?.error || item?.value?.error || 'Project Data operation failed');
    const trace = item.traceback || item.stack || item?.details?.traceback || item?.details?.stack || item?.value?.traceback || item?.value?.stack || null;
    const errorCode = String(item.error_code || item.code || item?.details?.error_code || '').trim() ||
      (domain === 'TOOL_REQUEST_FAILURE' ? 'PROJECT_DATA_TOOL_REQUEST_FAILURE' : 'PROJECT_DATA_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILURE');
    return {
      ...item,
      ok: false,
      op,
      kind: domain,
      surface: item.surface || 'PROJECT_DATA_BRIDGE',
      operation: item.operation || op,
      error: message,
      message,
      error_code: errorCode,
      failure_domain: domain,
      recoverable: item.recoverable !== false,
      ...(trace ? { traceback: semanticMemoryText(trace, 8000) } : {}),
      request: item.request || { op, ...cloneSemanticValue(request) },
    };
  }

  const PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_SCHEMA_V671 = 'vibe-go-project-data-extension-relay/v1';

  const PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_RESPONSE_SOURCE_V671 = 'VIBE_GO_PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION';

  function ensureProjectDataRelayListenerV671() {
    if (projectDataRelayListenerInstalledV671) return;
    projectDataRelayListenerInstalledV671 = true;
    window.addEventListener('message', event => {
      if (event.source !== window) return;
      const data = event.data;
      if (!data || data.schema !== PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_SCHEMA_V671 || data.source !== PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_RESPONSE_SOURCE_V671) return;
      if (data.kind === 'ready') {
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.generation = data.generation ? String(data.generation) : null;
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.readyAt = String(data.at || new Date().toISOString());
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastErrorCode = null;
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastError = null;
        nudgeProjectDataTransportWakeControllerV6915('extension-relay-ready-event');
        scheduleProjectDataUnknownOutcomeRecoveryV6917(120, 'extension-relay-ready-event');
        return;
      }
      if (data.kind !== 'response') return;
      const requestId = String(data.requestId || '');
      const pending = projectDataRelayPendingV671.get(requestId);
      if (!pending) return;
      projectDataRelayPendingV671.delete(requestId);
      clearTimeout(pending.timeout);
      projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastResponseAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (data.ok === false) {
        const code = String(data.error_code || data.code || 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY_FAILED');
        const message = String(data.error || code);
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastErrorCode = code;
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastError = message;
        pending.reject(projectDataExternalTransportErrorV696(code, message, { requestId }));
        return;
      }
      projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastErrorCode = null;
      projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastError = null;
      pending.resolve(cloneSemanticValue(data.response ?? null));
    }, false);
  }

  function projectDataRelayRequestV671(pathname, options = {}) {
    ensureProjectDataRelayListenerV671();
    const requestId = String(options.transportRequestId || '') ||
      `project-data-v671:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
    const timeoutMs = Math.max(1000, Number(options.timeoutMs ?? CONFIG.projectDataRequestTimeoutMs ?? 45000));
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        projectDataRelayPendingV671.delete(requestId);
        const code = 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY_TIMEOUT';
        const message = 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY_TIMEOUT: no extension-relay response before timeout';
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastErrorCode = code;
        projectDataRuntimeV670.relay.lastError = message;
        reject(projectDataExternalTransportErrorV696(code, message, { requestId }));
      }, timeoutMs);
      projectDataRelayPendingV671.set(requestId, { resolve, reject, timeout });
      window.postMessage({
        schema: PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_SCHEMA_V671,
        source: PROJECT_DATA_RELAY_REQUEST_SOURCE_V671,
        kind: 'request',
        requestId,
        request: {
          path: String(pathname || ''),
          method: String(options.method || 'GET').toUpperCase(),
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            ...(options.headers || {}),
          },
          body: options.body == null ? null : String(options.body),
        },
      }, location.origin);
    });
  }

  async function projectDataFetchV670(pathname, options = {}) {

  function boundedProjectDataResultV670(itemInput) {
    const item = cloneSemanticValue(itemInput || {});
    const limit = Math.max(2000, Number(CONFIG.projectDataResultMaxChars || 14000));
    const raw = JSON.stringify(item);
    if (raw.length <= limit) return item;
    // a72: failed operations are debugging evidence. Preserve the causal error and
    // traceback/stack ahead of arbitrary success-payload preview text so the model
    // can repair its own request on the next turn instead of parking the workflow.
    if (item.ok === false) {
      const trace = item.traceback || item.stack || item?.details?.traceback || item?.details?.stack || null;
      return {
        ok: false,
        op: item.op || '(unknown)',
        truncated: true,
        originalChars: raw.length,
        ...(item.error ? { error: semanticMemoryText(item.error, 5000) } : {}),
        ...(item.error_code ? { error_code: item.error_code } : {}),
        ...(item.failure_domain ? { failure_domain: item.failure_domain } : {}),
        ...(item.recoverable != null ? { recoverable: item.recoverable } : {}),
        ...(trace ? { traceback: semanticMemoryText(trace, Math.max(1200, limit - 6500)) } : {}),
      };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      op: item.op || '(unknown)',
      truncated: true,
      originalChars: raw.length,
      preview: raw.slice(0, Math.max(512, limit - 220)),
    };
  }

      error_code: item.error_code || null,
      failure_domain: item.failure_domain || item.kind || null,
      error: semanticMemoryText(item.error || item.message || 'tool operation failed', 1200),
      ...(item.traceback ? { traceback: semanticMemoryText(item.traceback, 1800) } : {}),
    }));
    const error = new Error(
      `RECOVERABLE_TOOL_FAILURE_PARK_FORBIDDEN: action ${action} cannot park the runner while fresh recoverable tool failures are available for model repair. ` +
      `Return CONTINUE with corrected VIBE operations or change the engineering route. Fresh failure evidence: ${JSON.stringify(compact)}`
    );
    error.code = 'RECOVERABLE_TOOL_FAILURE_PARK_FORBIDDEN';
    error.failureDomain = String(compact[0]?.failure_domain || 'TOOL_REQUEST_FAILURE');
    error.recoverable = true;
    error.toolFailures = compact;
    throw error;
  }

  function projectDataPromiseItemsForSessionV673(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const inbox = projectDataRuntimeV670.lastStatus?.async_jobs?.promise_inbox || null;
    if (!inbox) return { fulfilled: [], waiting: [] };
    const sessionId = String(session?.id || '');
    const accept = item => !item?.semantic_session_id || !sessionId || String(item.semantic_session_id) === sessionId;
    return {
      fulfilled: (Array.isArray(inbox.fulfilled_unconsumed) ? inbox.fulfilled_unconsumed : []).filter(accept),
      waiting: (Array.isArray(inbox.waiting) ? inbox.waiting : []).filter(accept),
    };
  }

  function buildProjectDataPromiseDispatchLinesV673(sessionInput = null) {
    const items = projectDataPromiseItemsForSessionV673(sessionInput);
    const lines = [];
    if (items.fulfilled.length) {
      lines.push('', 'RESOLVED EXTERNAL PROMISE(S) · DURABLE LOCAL AUTHORITY');
      for (const item of items.fulfilled.slice(0, 4)) {
        lines.push(
          `${item.promise_id} · ${item.status}${item.resume_priority ? ` · priority ${item.resume_priority}` : ''}`,
          `Previously blocked: ${item.distance_id || '(distance not recorded)'}`,
          `Question: ${String(item.subject || '').slice(0, 700)}`,
          item.reason ? `Reason: ${String(item.reason).slice(0, 500)}` : null,
          `Job: ${item.job_id || '(none)'} · result ${item.result_ref || '(available via GET_JOB_RESULT)'}`,
          `Resume contract: ${String(item.resume_contract || '').slice(0, 900)}`,
          `Action: use GET_JOB_RESULT for factual evidence; after semantic review use CONSUME_PROMISE. If current focus should continue elsewhere, DEFER_PROMISE and leave it fulfilled.`
        );
      }
      if (items.fulfilled.length > 4) lines.push(`(+${items.fulfilled.length - 4} more fulfilled unconsumed promise(s); use GET_PROMISE_INBOX)`);
    }
    if (items.waiting.length) {
      const compact = items.waiting.slice(0, 4).map(item =>
        `${item.promise_id}:${item.job_id || '?'}:${item.resume_priority || 'NORMAL'}:${String(item.subject || '').slice(0, 160)}`
      );
      lines.push('', `EXTERNAL PROMISES WAITING · ${items.waiting.length}`, ...compact.map(value => `- ${value}`));
    }
    return lines.filter(value => value != null);
  }

  function projectDataHumanItemsForSessionV675(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();

  function compactHumanOptionsV675(item) {
    const options = Array.isArray(item?.options) ? item.options : [];
    return options.slice(0, 8).map(option => {
      const value = String(option?.value ?? '').slice(0, 40);
      const label = String(option?.label ?? '').slice(0, 180);
      return `${value}=${label}`;
    }).filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
  }

  function buildProjectDataHumanDispatchLinesV675(sessionInput = null) {
    const items = projectDataHumanItemsForSessionV675(sessionInput);
    const lines = [];
    if (items.answered.length) {
      lines.push('', 'RESOLVED HUMAN DECISION(S) · DURABLE USER AUTHORITY');
      for (const item of items.answered.slice(0, 4)) {
        lines.push(
          `${item.request_id} · ANSWERED · ${item.blocking_class || 'DEFERRED'}`,
          `Previously blocked: ${item.distance_id || '(distance not recorded)'}`,
          `Question: ${String(item.question || item.subject || '').slice(0, 700)}`,
          `Human answer: ${String(item.answer_value ?? '').slice(0, 300)}${item.answer_note ? ` · ${String(item.answer_note).slice(0, 500)}` : ''}`,
          item.related_donor_ids?.length ? `Related donors: ${item.related_donor_ids.slice(0, 12).join(', ')}` : null,
          `Action: treat answer as HUMAN_DECISION authority, apply the exact affected engineering decision with provenance, then CONSUME_HUMAN_REQUEST. If follow-up mechanics are required, a new analysis job/promise may be launched before consumption.`
        );
      }
      if (items.answered.length > 4) lines.push(`(+${items.answered.length - 4} more answered request(s); use GET_HUMAN_INBOX)`);
    }
    if (items.open.length || items.deferred.length) {
      lines.push('', `HUMAN DECISION INBOX · ${items.open.length} OPEN · ${items.deferred.length} DEFERRED`);
      for (const item of items.open.slice(0, 5)) {
        const opts = compactHumanOptionsV675(item);
        lines.push(
          `- ${item.request_id} · ${item.blocking_class || 'DEFERRED'} · ${String(item.subject || '').slice(0, 180)}${opts ? ` · options ${opts}` : ''}`
        );
      }
      if (items.open.length > 5) lines.push(`(+${items.open.length - 5} more open request(s); use GET_HUMAN_INBOX)`);
      lines.push('Open human requests are durable. Do not repeatedly ask the same unresolved question in chat; continue other READY work and surface/batch the inbox when user review is useful.');
    }
    return lines.filter(value => value != null);
  }

  // a06 operator projection: durable machine promises + Human Decision Inbox are
  // visible in the VIBE panel. vibe_jobs.db remains the only authority; this UI
  // holds only ephemeral presentation caches and never owns queue/request state.
  const operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676 = {
    promiseInbox: null,
    humanInbox: null,
    jobStatusById: new Map(),
    resultPreviewByPromiseId: new Map(),
    lastRefreshAt: null,
    lastStatusSignature: null,
    refreshing: false,
    error: null,
  };

  function operatorAsyncInboxStatusSignatureV676(statusInput = null) {
    const asyncJobs = statusInput?.async_jobs || null;
    if (!asyncJobs) return 'async:none';
    const p = asyncJobs.promise_inbox || {};
    const h = asyncJobs.human_inbox || {};
    const compact = values => (Array.isArray(values) ? values : []).map(item => [
      item?.promise_id || item?.request_id || '',
      item?.status || '',
      item?.updated_at || item?.resolved_at || item?.answered_at || '',
      item?.answer_value ?? '',
    ]);
    return hashText(JSON.stringify({
      pc: asyncJobs.promise_counts || {},
      hc: asyncJobs.human_request_counts || {},
      pf: compact(p.fulfilled_unconsumed),
      pw: compact(p.waiting),
      ha: compact(h.answered_unconsumed),
      ho: compact(h.open),
      hd: compact(h.deferred),
    }));
  }

  function operatorAsyncInboxSnapshotV676(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const asyncJobs = projectDataRuntimeV670.lastStatus?.async_jobs || null;
    const promiseInbox = operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.promiseInbox || asyncJobs?.promise_inbox || {};
    const humanInbox = operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.humanInbox || asyncJobs?.human_inbox || {};
    const sessionId = String(session?.id || '');
    const accept = item => !item?.semantic_session_id || !sessionId || String(item.semantic_session_id) === sessionId;
    return {
      bridgeReady: Boolean(projectDataRuntimeV670.lastStatus),
      asyncSchema: asyncJobs?.schema || null,
      jobsDb: asyncJobs?.jobs_db || null,
      promises: {
        fulfilled: (Array.isArray(promiseInbox.fulfilled_unconsumed) ? promiseInbox.fulfilled_unconsumed : []).filter(accept),
        waiting: (Array.isArray(promiseInbox.waiting) ? promiseInbox.waiting : []).filter(accept),
      },
      humans: {
        answered: (Array.isArray(humanInbox.answered_unconsumed) ? humanInbox.answered_unconsumed : []).filter(accept),
        open: (Array.isArray(humanInbox.open) ? humanInbox.open : []).filter(accept),
        deferred: (Array.isArray(humanInbox.deferred) ? humanInbox.deferred : []).filter(accept),
      },
      refreshedAt: operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.lastRefreshAt,
      refreshing: operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.refreshing,
      error: operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.error,
    };
  }

  async function refreshOperatorAsyncInboxV676(options = {}) {
    if (operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.refreshing) return operatorAsyncInboxSnapshotV676();
    operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.refreshing = true;
    operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.error = null;
    renderPanel();
    try {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      const sessionId = String(session?.id || '').trim();
      const limit = Math.max(6, Math.min(50, Number(options.limit || 24)));
      const common = sessionId ? { semantic_session_id: sessionId, limit } : { limit };
      const results = await applyProjectDataOpsV670([
        { op: 'GET_PROMISE_INBOX', ...common },
        { op: 'GET_HUMAN_INBOX', ...common },
      ], session);
      const promiseResult = results.find(item => String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase() === 'GET_PROMISE_INBOX');
      const humanResult = results.find(item => String(item?.op || '').toUpperCase() === 'GET_HUMAN_INBOX');
      if (promiseResult?.ok === false) throw new Error(promiseResult.error || 'GET_PROMISE_INBOX failed');
      if (humanResult?.ok === false) throw new Error(humanResult.error || 'GET_HUMAN_INBOX failed');
      operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.promiseInbox = cloneSemanticValue(promiseResult?.value || { fulfilled_unconsumed: [], waiting: [] });
      operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.humanInbox = cloneSemanticValue(humanResult?.value || { answered_unconsumed: [], open: [], deferred: [] });
      const schedulerSessionV677 = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (schedulerSessionV677) {
        const schedulerResultV677 = reconcileSemanticDistanceSchedulerV677(
          schedulerSessionV677,
          operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.promiseInbox,
          operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.humanInbox,
          'operator-inbox-refresh'
        );
        if (schedulerResultV677.changed) {
          schedulerSessionV677.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
          SemanticSessionStore.save(schedulerSessionV677);
          await flushRuntimePersistence();
        }
      }

      const promiseItems = [
        ...(operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.promiseInbox?.waiting || []),
        ...(operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.promiseInbox?.fulfilled_unconsumed || []),
      ];
      const jobIds = [...new Set(promiseItems.map(item => String(item?.job_id || '').trim()).filter(Boolean))].slice(0, 24);
      if (jobIds.length) {
        const jobResults = await applyProjectDataOpsV670(jobIds.map(job_id => ({ op: 'GET_JOB_STATUS', job_id })), session);
        for (const result of jobResults) {
          if (result?.ok === false || !result?.value?.job_id) continue;
          operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.jobStatusById.set(String(result.value.job_id), cloneSemanticValue(result.value));
        }
      }
      operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.lastRefreshAt = semanticIsoNow();
      operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.lastStatusSignature = operatorAsyncInboxStatusSignatureV676(projectDataRuntimeV670.lastStatus);
      return operatorAsyncInboxSnapshotV676(session);
    } catch (error) {
      operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.error = String(error?.message || error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.refreshing = false;
      renderPanel();
    }
  }

  async function applyOperatorInboxActionV676(op, successMessage) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    try {
      const results = await applyProjectDataOpsV670([op], session);
      const result = results[0] || null;
      if (!result || result.ok === false) throw new Error(result?.error || `${op.op} failed`);
      persistenceUiMessage = successMessage || `${op.op} accepted`;
      await refreshOperatorAsyncInboxV676();
      return result.value;
    } catch (error) {
      const code = String(error?.code || error?.error_code || '').toUpperCase();
      if (code === 'PROJECT_DATA_MUTATION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN') {
        const pending = hydrateProjectDataUnknownOutcomeFromSessionV6917(session) || projectDataRuntimeV670.lastOutcomeUnknownV696;
        persistenceUiMessage = `Submitted; durable outcome unknown · ${pending?.requestId || op.op} · waiting for relay reconciliation`;
        renderPanel();
        // Do not ask the operator to click again. The same durable request_id is
        // reconciled after relay recovery; blind mutation replay remains forbidden.
        scheduleProjectDataUnknownOutcomeRecoveryV6917(250, 'operator-inbox-mutation-outcome-unknown');
        return null;
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async function inspectOperatorPromiseResultV676(item) {
    const promiseId = String(item?.promise_id || '');
    const jobId = String(item?.job_id || '');
    if (!promiseId || !jobId) return;
    try {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      const results = await applyProjectDataOpsV670([{ op: 'GET_JOB_RESULT', job_id: jobId }], session);
      const result = results[0] || null;
      if (!result || result.ok === false) throw new Error(result?.error || 'GET_JOB_RESULT failed');
      const text = JSON.stringify(result.value ?? null, null, 2);
      operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.resultPreviewByPromiseId.set(promiseId, ledgerTruncate(text, 4200));
      persistenceUiMessage = `Loaded result preview for ${promiseId}`;
      renderPanel();
    } catch (error) {
      persistenceUiMessage = `Result preview failed · ${error?.message || error}`;
      renderPanel();
    }
  }

  function operatorInboxButtonV676(label, title, handler, tone = 'neutral') {
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.textContent = label;
    button.title = title || label;
    const palette = tone === 'primary'
      ? ['rgba(30,64,175,.34)', 'rgba(96,165,250,.55)', '#dbeafe']
      : tone === 'warn'
        ? ['rgba(120,53,15,.30)', 'rgba(251,191,36,.48)', '#fef3c7']
        : ['rgba(30,41,59,.74)', 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)', '#cbd5e1'];
    Object.assign(button.style, {
      padding: '4px 6px',
      border: `1px solid ${palette[1]}`,
      borderRadius: '6px',
      background: palette[0],
      color: palette[2],
      font: '800 9px/1.15 system-ui, sans-serif',
      cursor: 'pointer',
    });
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      Promise.resolve(handler?.()).catch(error => {
        persistenceUiMessage = `Inbox action failed · ${error?.message || error}`;
        renderPanel();
      });
    });
    return button;
  }

  function renderOperatorAsyncInboxSectionV676(root, sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const snapshot = operatorAsyncInboxSnapshotV676(session);
    const p = snapshot.promises;
    const h = snapshot.humans;
    const actionable = p.waiting.length + p.fulfilled.length + h.open.length + h.deferred.length + h.answered.length;
    const details = ensureOperatorAsyncInboxSectionV676(root, actionable > 0);
    const summary = details.querySelector('[data-role="summary"]');
    const body = details.querySelector('[data-role="async-body"]');
    if (!body || !summary) return;
    summary.textContent = `ASYNC INBOX · machine ${p.waiting.length} waiting / ${p.fulfilled.length} ready · human ${h.open.length} open / ${h.deferred.length} deferred / ${h.answered.length} answered`;
    body.replaceChildren();

    const toolbar = document.createElement('div');
    Object.assign(toolbar.style, { display: 'flex', gap: '6px', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap' });
    const statusText = snapshot.refreshing
      ? 'refreshing…'
      : snapshot.error
        ? `error: ${snapshot.error}`
        : snapshot.bridgeReady
          ? `${snapshot.asyncSchema || 'async authority'}${snapshot.refreshedAt ? ` · refreshed ${snapshot.refreshedAt}` : ' · live status projection'}`
          : 'bridge status not observed yet';
    toolbar.append(
      operatorInboxTextV676(statusText, { color: snapshot.error ? '#fecaca' : '#94a3b8' }),
      operatorInboxButtonV676(snapshot.refreshing ? '↻ …' : '↻ Refresh', 'Read current-session Promise + Human Inbox authority and job progress', () => refreshOperatorAsyncInboxV676(), 'primary')
    );
    body.appendChild(toolbar);

    if (!snapshot.bridgeReady && !operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.promiseInbox && !operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.humanInbox) {
      body.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676('No Project Data status yet. The panel remains a projection only; Refresh requests live authority without creating records.'));
      return;
    }

    const machineTitle = operatorInboxTextV676(`MACHINE PROMISES · ${p.waiting.length} WAITING · ${p.fulfilled.length} FULFILLED/FAILED/CANCELLED UNCONSUMED`, { color: '#93c5fd', font: '900 9px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif' });
    body.appendChild(machineTitle);
    if (!p.waiting.length && !p.fulfilled.length) {
      body.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676('— empty —', { color: '#64748b' }));
    }
    for (const item of [...p.fulfilled, ...p.waiting]) {
      const card = operatorInboxCardV676('machine', item);
      const jobStatus = item?.job_id ? operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.jobStatusById.get(String(item.job_id)) : null;
      card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`${item.promise_id || 'PRM-?'} · ${item.status || 'UNKNOWN'}${item.resume_priority ? ` · ${item.resume_priority}` : ''}`, { color: item.status === 'WAITING' ? '#fde68a' : '#a7f3d0', font: '900 9px/1.3 ui-monospace, monospace' }));
      card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(ledgerTruncate(item.subject || '(no subject)', 500)));
      if (item.distance_id) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Distance: ${item.distance_id}`, { color: '#94a3b8' }));
      if (item.job_id) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Job: ${item.job_id}${jobStatus?.status ? ` · ${jobStatus.status}` : ''}`, { color: '#94a3b8' }));
      if (jobStatus?.progress) {
        const progress = jobStatus.progress;
        const pct = Number.isFinite(Number(progress.percent)) ? `${Number(progress.percent).toFixed(1)}%` : '—';
        card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Progress: ${pct} · ${progress.phase || 'phase ?'} · ${progress.processed ?? '—'}/${progress.total ?? '—'}${progress.message ? `\n${ledgerTruncate(progress.message, 360)}` : ''}`, { color: '#bae6fd' }));
      }
      if (item.reason) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Reason: ${ledgerTruncate(item.reason, 500)}`, { color: '#94a3b8' }));
      if (item.resume_contract) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Resume: ${ledgerTruncate(item.resume_contract, 700)}`, { color: '#c4b5fd' }));
      const preview = operatorAsyncInboxRuntimeV676.resultPreviewByPromiseId.get(String(item.promise_id || ''));
      if (preview) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`RESULT PREVIEW\n${preview}`, { color: '#d1fae5' }));
      if (String(item.status || '') !== 'WAITING' && item.job_id) {
        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        Object.assign(actions.style, { display: 'flex', gap: '5px', flexWrap: 'wrap' });
        actions.appendChild(operatorInboxButtonV676('Inspect result', 'Read bounded GET_JOB_RESULT evidence; does not consume the promise', () => inspectOperatorPromiseResultV676(item), 'primary'));
        card.appendChild(actions);
      }
      body.appendChild(card);
    }

    const humanTitle = operatorInboxTextV676(`HUMAN DECISIONS · ${h.open.length} OPEN · ${h.deferred.length} DEFERRED · ${h.answered.length} ANSWERED/UNCONSUMED`, { color: '#c4b5fd', font: '900 9px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif' });
    body.appendChild(humanTitle);
    if (!h.open.length && !h.deferred.length && !h.answered.length) {
      body.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676('— empty —', { color: '#64748b' }));
    }
    for (const item of [...h.answered, ...h.open, ...h.deferred]) {
      const card = operatorInboxCardV676('human', item);
      const stateColor = item.status === 'ANSWERED' ? '#a7f3d0' : item.status === 'DEFERRED' ? '#cbd5e1' : '#fde68a';
      card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`${item.request_id || 'HRQ-?'} · ${item.status || 'UNKNOWN'} · ${item.blocking_class || 'DEFERRED'}`, { color: stateColor, font: '900 9px/1.3 ui-monospace, monospace' }));
      card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(ledgerTruncate(item.question || item.subject || '(no question)', 700), { color: '#e2e8f0' }));
      if (item.context_summary) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Facts: ${ledgerTruncate(item.context_summary, 700)}`, { color: '#94a3b8' }));
      if (item.engineering_note) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Engineering: ${ledgerTruncate(item.engineering_note, 700)}`, { color: '#c4b5fd' }));
      if (Array.isArray(item.related_donor_ids) && item.related_donor_ids.length) card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`Donors: ${item.related_donor_ids.slice(0, 16).join(', ')}`, { color: '#94a3b8' }));
      if (item.status === 'ANSWERED') {
        card.appendChild(operatorInboxTextV676(`HUMAN_DECISION: ${item.answer_value ?? '—'}${item.answer_note ? ` · ${item.answer_note}` : ''}\nAwaiting model application + explicit CONSUME_HUMAN_REQUEST.`, { color: '#d1fae5' }));
      } else {
        const options = Array.isArray(item.options) ? item.options : [];
        if (options.length) {
          const optionWrap = document.createElement('div');
          Object.assign(optionWrap.style, { display: 'flex', gap: '5px', flexWrap: 'wrap' });
          for (const option of options.slice(0, 20)) {
            const value = String(option?.value ?? '');
            const label = String(option?.label ?? value);
            const recommended = String(item.recommended_option ?? '') === value;
            optionWrap.appendChild(operatorInboxButtonV676(
              `${recommended ? '★ ' : ''}${value} · ${ledgerTruncate(label, 80)}`,
              option?.description || `Answer ${item.request_id} = ${value}`,
              async () => {
                const ok = typeof confirm !== 'function' || confirm(`Persist HUMAN_DECISION?\n\n${item.request_id}\n${value} · ${label}`);
                if (!ok) return;
                await applyOperatorInboxActionV676(

            ));

        } else {

      );

        break;

      lines.push('', block);
      used += block.length + 2;
    }
    lines.push(...buildProjectDataPromiseDispatchLinesV673(session));
    lines.push(...buildProjectDataHumanDispatchLinesV675(session));
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  function summarizeSemanticSourceIntelligenceResult(result) {
    const value = result?.value;
    const summary = {
      op: String(result?.op || ''),
      ok: result?.ok !== false,
    };
    if (result?.error) summary.error = semanticClipText(result.error, 1200);
    if (result?.message) summary.message = semanticClipText(result.message, 1200);
    if (result?.error_code) summary.error_code = String(result.error_code);
    if (result?.failure_domain) summary.failure_domain = String(result.failure_domain);
    if (result?.recoverable != null) summary.recoverable = result.recoverable !== false;
    if (result?.traceback || result?.stack) summary.traceback = semanticClipText(result.traceback || result.stack, 3500);
    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
      if (value.id) summary.resultId = String(value.id);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(value.candidateCount))) summary.candidateCount = Number(value.candidateCount);
      if (value.space) summary.space = String(value.space);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(value.start))) summary.start = Number(value.start);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(value.end))) summary.end = Number(value.end);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(value.workingStart))) summary.workingStart = Number(value.workingStart);
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(value.workingEnd))) summary.workingEnd = Number(value.workingEnd);
    } else if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
      summary.value = value;
    }
    return summary;
  }

  async function applyAndRecordSemanticSourceIntelligenceOps(ops, semanticRevision, acceptanceSequenceInput = null) {
    const requested = Array.isArray(ops) ? ops : [];
    let rawResults = [];
    try {
      // One accepted semantic state owns one local evidence transaction. Execute
      // every independent intelligence op in this batch before the runner is
      // allowed to build/send the next model-facing dispatch.
      rawResults = await SourceIntelligence.applyOps(requested);
    } catch (error) {
      rawResults = [{
        ok: false,
        op: 'SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_INTERNAL',
        error: error?.message || String(error),
        message: error?.message || String(error),
        error_code: error?.code || 'SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_INTERNAL_FAILURE',
        failure_domain: 'TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILURE',
        recoverable: true,
        ...(error?.stack ? { traceback: semanticMemoryText(error.stack, 5000) } : {}),
      }];
    }
    const results = rawResults.map(summarizeSemanticSourceIntelligenceResult);
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (session) {
      const revision = Number(semanticRevision);
      const acceptanceSequenceV645ForWorklog = Number.isInteger(Number(acceptanceSequenceInput))
        ? Number(acceptanceSequenceInput)
        : semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
      const currentControlV645 = session.transport?.lastControl || null;
      const worklog = currentControlV645?.semanticChanged === true &&
        Number(currentControlV645?.acceptanceSequence) === acceptanceSequenceV645ForWorklog
        ? [...(session.worklog || [])].reverse().find(item => Number(item?.revision) === revision) || null
        : null;
      if (worklog) worklog.sourceIntelligenceOps = cloneSemanticValue(results);
      session.transport = session.transport || {};
      const acceptanceSequenceV645 = Number.isInteger(Number(acceptanceSequenceInput))
        ? Number(acceptanceSequenceInput)
        : semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
      session.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps = {
        schema: 'vibe-go-local-evidence-batch/v1',
        revision: Number.isFinite(revision) ? revision : Number(session.revision || 0),
        acceptanceSequence: acceptanceSequenceV645,
        recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        requested: requested.length,
        succeeded: results.filter(item => item.ok !== false).length,
        failed: results.filter(item => item.ok === false).length,
        queryCount: results.filter(item => ['SEARCH', 'QUERY', 'PROBE'].includes(String(item.op || '').toUpperCase())).length,
        surfacedCount: results.filter(item => ['SURFACE_CANDIDATE','READ_RANGE','SURFACE_RANGE'].includes(String(item.op || '').toUpperCase()) && item.ok !== false).length,
        results: cloneSemanticValue(results),
      };
      session.transport.sourceIntelligenceHistoryV703 = [
        ...(Array.isArray(session.transport.sourceIntelligenceHistoryV703) ? session.transport.sourceIntelligenceHistoryV703 : [])
          .filter(item => Number(item?.acceptanceSequence) !== Number(acceptanceSequenceV645)),
        {
          acceptanceSequence: acceptanceSequenceV645,
          revision: Number.isFinite(revision) ? revision : Number(session.revision || 0),
          recordedAt: session.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps.recordedAt,
          results: cloneSemanticValue(results),
        },
      ].slice(-12);
      session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      compactSemanticLedger(session);
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }
    return results;
  }


  function extractSemanticStatePayloads(textValue) {
    const value = String(textValue || '');
    const marker = '[[VIBE_STATE';
    const result = [];
    const markerIndexes = [];
    let cursor = 0;
    while (cursor < value.length) {
      const index = value.indexOf(marker, cursor);
      if (index < 0) break;
      markerIndexes.push(index);
      cursor = index + marker.length;
    }
    if (!markerIndexes.length) return result;

    // One assistant turn is contractually allowed to carry one control marker.
    // The explicit sentinel remains canonical. The a12 fallback may lexically locate
    // one root JSON object only when the sentinel is absent; string/escape state keeps
    // arbitrary source punctuation inert, and JSON.parse remains final authority.
    if (markerIndexes.length !== 1) {
      return [{
        error: `Expected one VIBE_STATE marker, found ${markerIndexes.length}`,
        raw: value,
        markerIndex: markerIndexes[0],
        endIndex: value.length,
      }];
    }

    const markerIndex = markerIndexes[0];
    const objectStart = value.indexOf('{', markerIndex + marker.length);
    if (objectStart < 0) {
      return [{
        incomplete: true,
        error: 'VIBE_STATE marker has no JSON payload yet',
        raw: value.slice(markerIndex),
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: value.length,
      }];
    }

    // The final sentinel, not brace balancing, proves that the assistant artifact
    // is framed. lastIndexOf is deliberate: source text inside a JSON string may
    // itself contain `]]`; the contract requires the marker terminator to be the
    // final sentinel in the fenced machine envelope.
    let markerEnd = value.lastIndexOf(']]');
    let recoveredObjectEnd = -1;
    if (markerEnd < objectStart) {
      // v6.6.0-a14: transport recovery belongs at the parser boundary, not only at
      // a particular DOM renderer (<pre>). If ChatGPT exposes a complete root JSON
      // object but drops the two lexical sentinel bytes, accept it only when a
      // string-aware lexical scan finds the root close, no non-transport tail is
      // discarded, and JSON.parse validates the exact recovered object. Partial or
      // malformed JSON remains INCOMPLETE/INVALID and therefore fail-closed.
      recoveredObjectEnd = findCompleteSemanticJsonObjectEndV612(value, objectStart);
      if (recoveredObjectEnd >= objectStart
          && isIgnorableSemanticTransportTailV612(value.slice(recoveredObjectEnd + 1))) {
        const recoveredRaw = value.slice(objectStart, recoveredObjectEnd + 1).trim();
        try {
          const recoveredPayload = JSON.parse(recoveredRaw);
          if (recoveredPayload && typeof recoveredPayload === 'object' && !Array.isArray(recoveredPayload)) {
            return [{
              payload: recoveredPayload,
              raw: recoveredRaw,
              markerIndex,
              endIndex: recoveredObjectEnd + 1,
              recoveredTransportSentinel: true,
            }];
          }
        } catch {
          // Fall through to bounded incomplete-state settling below.
        }
      }
      return [{
        incomplete: true,
        error: `VIBE_STATE transport sentinel is not mounted yet (observedChars=${Math.max(0, value.length - markerIndex)}; rootJsonClosed=${recoveredObjectEnd >= objectStart})`,
        raw: value.slice(objectStart),
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: value.length,
      }];
    }

    const raw = value.slice(objectStart, markerEnd).trim();
    if (!raw) {
      return [{
        error: 'VIBE_STATE payload is empty',
        raw,
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: markerEnd + 2,
      }];
    }
    try {
      result.push({
        payload: JSON.parse(raw),
        raw,
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: markerEnd + 2,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      result.push({
        error: `MALFORMED_VIBE_STATE_PAYLOAD: ${error?.message || String(error)}`,
        raw,
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: markerEnd + 2,
      });
    }
    return result;
  }

  const THIN_RESULT_FORBIDDEN_PATCH_FIELDS_V627 = new Set([
    'sessionId', 'dispatchId', 'baseRevision',
    'sourceOps', 'workingOps', 'workspaceOps', 'sourceCursor', 'cursor', 'workingChange', 'specOps', 'projectOps', 'workbenchOps', 'hostOps',
  ]);
  const THIN_PATCH_ALLOWED_FIELDS_V627 = new Set([
    'sourceOps', 'workingOps', 'workspaceOps', 'sourceCursor', 'cursor', 'workingChange', 'specOps', 'projectOps', 'workbenchOps', 'hostOps',
  ]);

  function containsSemanticControlMarkerV627(textInput) {
    const text = String(textInput || '');
    return text.includes('[[VG_RESULT') || text.includes('[[VG_PATCH') || text.includes('[[VIBE_STATE');
  }

  function thinSemanticMarkerSpecV627(kindInput) {
    const kind = String(kindInput || '').toUpperCase();
    if (kind === 'VG_RESULT') {
      return {
        kind,
        opening: '[[VG_RESULT',
        closing: '[[/VG_RESULT]]',
        header: /^[ \t]*\[\[VG_RESULT\s+d=([^\s\]]+)\s+r=(\d+)\s*\]\]/gm,
      };
    }
    if (kind === 'VG_PATCH') {
      return {
        kind,
        opening: '[[VG_PATCH',
        closing: '[[/VG_PATCH]]',
        header: /^[ \t]*\[\[VG_PATCH\s+d=([^\s\]]+)\s+r=(\d+)\s*\]\]/gm,
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  function extractThinSemanticMarkerV627(textInput, kindInput) {
    const value = String(textInput || '');
    const spec = thinSemanticMarkerSpecV627(kindInput);
    if (!spec) return [];
    const matches = [...value.matchAll(spec.header)];
    if (!matches.length) return [];
    if (matches.length !== 1) {
      return [{
        error: `Expected one ${spec.kind} marker, found ${matches.length}`,
        raw: value,
        markerIndex: matches[0]?.index ?? -1,
        endIndex: value.length,
      }];
    }
    const match = matches[0];
    const markerIndex = Number(match.index || 0);
    const headerEnd = markerIndex + match[0].length;
    const dispatchId = String(match[1] || '');
    const baseRevision = Number(match[2]);
    const objectStart = value.indexOf('{', headerEnd);
    if (objectStart < 0) {
      return [{
        incomplete: true,
        error: `${spec.kind} marker has no JSON payload yet`,
        raw: value.slice(markerIndex),
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: value.length,
        dispatchId,
        baseRevision,
      }];
    }

    let objectEnd = findCompleteSemanticJsonObjectEndV612(value, objectStart);
    if (objectEnd < objectStart) {
      return [{
        incomplete: true,
        error: `${spec.kind} JSON is not complete yet`,
        raw: value.slice(markerIndex),
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: value.length,
        dispatchId,
        baseRevision,
      }];
    }
    const closingIndex = value.indexOf(spec.closing, objectEnd + 1);
    if (closingIndex >= 0) {
      if (objectEnd < objectStart || objectEnd > closingIndex) {
        return [{
          incomplete: true,
          error: `${spec.kind} JSON is not complete before closing sentinel`,
          raw: value.slice(markerIndex, closingIndex + spec.closing.length),
          markerIndex,
          endIndex: closingIndex + spec.closing.length,
          dispatchId,
          baseRevision,
        }];
      }
      const between = value.slice(objectEnd + 1, closingIndex).trim();
      if (between) {
        return [{
          error: `${spec.kind} contains non-transport text between JSON and closing sentinel`,
          raw: value.slice(markerIndex, closingIndex + spec.closing.length),
          markerIndex,
          endIndex: closingIndex + spec.closing.length,
          dispatchId,
          baseRevision,
        }];
      }
    } else {
      const tail = value.slice(objectEnd + 1).trim();
      const otherThinMarker = tail.search(/\[\[(?:VG_RESULT|VG_PATCH)\b/);
      const candidateTail = otherThinMarker >= 0 ? tail.slice(0, otherThinMarker).trim() : tail;
      if (candidateTail && !isIgnorableSemanticTransportTailV612(candidateTail)) {
        return [{
          incomplete: true,
          error: `${spec.kind} closing sentinel is not mounted yet`,
          raw: value.slice(markerIndex, objectEnd + 1),
          markerIndex,
          endIndex: objectEnd + 1,
          dispatchId,
          baseRevision,
        }];
      }
    }

    const rawJson = value.slice(objectStart, objectEnd + 1).trim();
    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(rawJson);
      if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || Array.isArray(payload)) {
        throw new Error(`${spec.kind} payload must be a JSON object`);
      }
      return [{
        payload,
        raw: value.slice(markerIndex, closingIndex >= 0 ? closingIndex + spec.closing.length : objectEnd + 1),
        rawJson,
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: closingIndex >= 0 ? closingIndex + spec.closing.length : objectEnd + 1,
        dispatchId,
        baseRevision,
        recoveredTransportSentinel: closingIndex < 0,
      }];
    } catch (error) {
      return [{
        error: `MALFORMED_${spec.kind}_PAYLOAD: ${error?.message || String(error)}`,
        raw: rawJson,
        markerIndex,
        endIndex: objectEnd + 1,
        dispatchId,
        baseRevision,
      }];
    }
  }

  function validateThinPatchPayloadV627(payloadInput) {
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : {};
    const unknown = Object.keys(payload).filter(key => !THIN_PATCH_ALLOWED_FIELDS_V627.has(key));
    if (unknown.length) {
      throw new Error(`VG_PATCH contains unsupported fields: ${unknown.join(', ')}`);
    }

    const inlineAnalyzerLimit = Math.max(256, Number(CONFIG.semanticInlineAnalyzerSourceMaxCharsV695 || 2048));
    for (const [index, op] of (Array.isArray(payload.projectOps) ? payload.projectOps : []).entries()) {
      if (String(op?.op || '').toUpperCase() !== 'SAVE_ANALYZER') continue;
      const source = typeof op?.source === 'string' ? op.source : '';
      if (source.length <= inlineAnalyzerLimit) continue;
      throw new Error(
        `INLINE_ANALYZER_SOURCE_FORBIDDEN: projectOps[${index}] SAVE_ANALYZER source is ${source.length} chars; ` +
        `semantic transport limit is ${inlineAnalyzerLimit}. Register analyzer from a local/file artifact and carry only analyzer identity/args through VG_PATCH.`
      );
    }
    return payload;
  }

  function extractThinSemanticTurnPayloadV627(textInput) {
    const value = String(textInput || '');
    const results = extractThinSemanticMarkerV627(value, 'VG_RESULT');
    const patches = extractThinSemanticMarkerV627(value, 'VG_PATCH');
    if (!results.length) {
      if (patches.length) {
        return { error: 'VG_PATCH is present without a VG_RESULT commit marker', raw: value };
      }
      return null;
    }
    if (results.length !== 1) return { error: `Expected one VG_RESULT marker, found ${results.length}`, raw: value };
    const result = results[0];
    if (result.incomplete || result.error) return { ...result, kind: 'thin-result' };
    if (patches.length > 1) return { error: `Expected at most one VG_PATCH marker, found ${patches.length}`, raw: value };
    const patch = patches[0] || null;
    if (patch?.incomplete || patch?.error) return { ...patch, kind: 'thin-patch' };
    if (patch) {
      if (String(patch.dispatchId) !== String(result.dispatchId)) {
        return { error: `VG_PATCH dispatch id mismatch: expected ${result.dispatchId}`, raw: value };
      }
      if (Number(patch.baseRevision) !== Number(result.baseRevision)) {
        return { error: `VG_PATCH base revision mismatch: expected ${result.baseRevision}`, raw: value };
      }
    }

    const resultPayload = cloneSemanticValue(result.payload || {});
    const forbidden = Object.keys(resultPayload).filter(key => THIN_RESULT_FORBIDDEN_PATCH_FIELDS_V627.has(key));
    if (forbidden.length) {
      return { error: `VG_RESULT must not contain patch fields: ${forbidden.join(', ')}`, raw: value };
    }
    if (!('action' in resultPayload)) resultPayload.action = 'CONTINUE';
    const payload = {
      ...resultPayload,
      dispatchId: result.dispatchId,
      baseRevision: result.baseRevision,
    };
    if (patch) {
      try {
        Object.assign(payload, cloneSemanticValue(validateThinPatchPayloadV627(patch.payload)));
      } catch (error) {
        return { error: error?.message || String(error), raw: value };
      }
    }
    return {
      payload,
      raw: [result.raw, patch?.raw].filter(Boolean).join('\n'),
      result,
      patch,
      dispatchId: result.dispatchId,
      baseRevision: result.baseRevision,
      recoveredTransportSentinel: Boolean(result.recoveredTransportSentinel || patch?.recoveredTransportSentinel),
    };
  }

  function recoverClosedFencedThinSemanticMarkerV627(textInput) {
    const text = String(textInput || '');
    const thin = extractThinSemanticTurnPayloadV627(text);
    if (!thin || thin.error || thin.incomplete) return text;
    // Parser-level recovery is already safe and JSON-validated. Preserve the
    // original DOM projection rather than rewriting bytes/source payload.
    return text;
  }

  function semanticTurnAfterBoundary(turn, boundary, turns) {
    if (!boundary) return true;
    if (Number.isFinite(turn.order) && Number.isFinite(boundary.turnOrder)) {
      return turn.order > boundary.turnOrder;
    }
    if (boundary.turnKey) {
      const boundaryIndex = turns.findIndex(item => item.key === boundary.turnKey);
      if (boundaryIndex >= 0) return turn.index > boundaryIndex;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function parseSemanticTurn(turn) {
    if (!turn || turn.role !== 'assistant') return null;
    const thin = extractThinSemanticTurnPayloadV627(turn.markerText);
    if (thin) {
      if (thin.incomplete) {
        const raw = String(thin.raw || '');
        return {
          incomplete: true,
          reason: thin.error || 'Unclosed thin semantic result',
          raw,
          turn,
          protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
          id: `${turn.key}:vg-result-incomplete:${hashText(raw)}:${raw.length}`,
        };
      }
