      if (thin.error) {
        return {
          invalid: true,
          reason: thin.error,
          raw: String(thin.raw || ''),
          turn,
          protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
        };
      }
      return {
        payload: thin.payload,
        raw: thin.raw,
        turn,
        protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
        resultMarker: thin.result || null,
        patchMarker: thin.patch || null,
        id: `${turn.key}:vg-result:${hashText(thin.raw)}`,
      };
    }
    const candidates = extractSemanticStatePayloads(turn.markerText);
    if (!candidates.length) return null;
    if (candidates.length !== 1) {
      return {
        invalid: true,
        reason: `Expected one VIBE_STATE marker, found ${candidates.length}`,
        turn,
      };
    }
    const candidate = candidates[0];
    if (candidate.incomplete) {
      const raw = String(candidate.raw || '');
      return {
        incomplete: true,
        reason: candidate.error || 'Unclosed VIBE_STATE JSON',
        raw,
        turn,
        id: `${turn.key}:vibe-state-incomplete:${hashText(raw)}:${raw.length}`,
      };
    }
    if (candidate.error) {
      return {
        invalid: true,
        reason: candidate.error,
        turn,
      };
    }
    return {
      payload: candidate.payload,
      raw: candidate.raw,
      turn,
      protocol: 'vibe-state/v1-fallback',
      id: `${turn.key}:vibe-state:${hashText(candidate.raw)}`,
    };
  }

  function semanticTurnIndex(turns, turn) {
    if (!turn) return -1;
    return resolveTurnIndex(
      turns,
      turn.key || null,
      Number.isFinite(turn.order) ? turn.order : null
    );
  }

  function semanticDispatchMatchesExpected(parsed, session, expected) {
    return Boolean(
      parsed &&
      !parsed.invalid &&
      parsed.id === expected.id &&
      parsed.sessionId === session.id &&
      Number(parsed.revision) === Number(expected.baseRevision)
    );
  }

  function semanticExplicitEnvelopeMatchesExpected(payload, session, expected, protocolInput = '') {
    const protocol = String(protocolInput || '');
    const dispatchAndRevisionMatch = Boolean(
      payload &&
      payload.dispatchId != null &&
      payload.baseRevision != null &&
      String(payload.dispatchId) === String(expected.id) &&
      Number(payload.baseRevision) === Number(expected.baseRevision)
    );
    if (!dispatchAndRevisionMatch) return false;

    // a28: thin-result/v1 deliberately does not echo sessionId. The currently
    // loaded durable SemanticSession owns the pendingDispatch, while the exact
    // high-entropy dispatchId + baseRevision pair is the model-facing causal
    // identity. Requiring a field that the thin protocol intentionally removed
    // deadlocks when ChatGPT virtualizes the giant mounted VIBE_DISPATCH.
    if (protocol === 'thin-result/v1') {
      return payload.sessionId == null || String(payload.sessionId) === String(session.id);
    }

    // Legacy VIBE_STATE detached recovery remains conservative: its explicit
    // envelope historically includes sessionId and must continue to match it.
    return Boolean(
      payload.sessionId != null &&
      String(payload.sessionId) === String(session.id)
    );
  }

  function semanticFailedAttemptBefore(turns, dispatchIndex, beforeIndex, session, expected) {
    for (let index = dispatchIndex + 1; index < beforeIndex; index += 1) {
      const turn = turns[index];
      if (turn.role !== 'assistant') continue;
      const attempt = parseSemanticTurn(turn);
      if (!attempt) continue;
      if (attempt.invalid) return true;
      if (session.transport.lastControl?.id === attempt.id) continue;
      const payload = attempt.payload || {};
      const sessionMatches = payload.sessionId == null || String(payload.sessionId) === String(session.id);
      const dispatchMatches = payload.dispatchId == null || String(payload.dispatchId) === String(expected.id);
      const revisionMatches = payload.baseRevision == null || Number(payload.baseRevision) === Number(expected.baseRevision);
      if (sessionMatches && dispatchMatches && revisionMatches) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function hydrateAutomaticSemanticEnvelope(session, marker, turns) {
    const expected = session.transport?.pendingDispatch;
    if (!expected) {
      throw new Error('Unexpected automatic VIBE_STATE without pending dispatch');
    }

    const payload = cloneSemanticValue(marker?.payload || {});

    // Explicit transport metadata is authoritative when the model echoed it.
    // Missing metadata is recoverable from the unique mounted dispatch turn;
    // conflicting metadata remains a hard technical-integrity failure.
    if (payload.sessionId != null && String(payload.sessionId) !== session.id) {
      throw new Error('VIBE_STATE sessionId mismatch');
    }
    if (payload.dispatchId != null && String(payload.dispatchId) !== expected.id) {
      throw new Error(`VIBE_STATE dispatchId mismatch: expected ${expected.id}`);
    }
    if (
      payload.baseRevision != null &&
      Number(payload.baseRevision) !== Number(expected.baseRevision)
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `VIBE_STATE baseRevision mismatch: expected ${expected.baseRevision}`
      );
    }

    const markerIndex = semanticTurnIndex(turns, marker?.turn);
    if (markerIndex < 0) {
      throw new Error('VIBE_STATE turn is no longer mounted; causal envelope cannot be recovered');
    }

    // A causally complete explicit envelope is authoritative against the persisted pending
    // dispatch. The mounted user turn is useful corroborating evidence, but it is
    // not durable: ChatGPT may virtualize/unmount a very large dispatch while the
    // assistant correction turns remain mounted. markDispatchMounted() already
    // persists mountedTurnKey/mountedTurnOrder, so we can preserve causality
    // without requiring that giant DOM turn to remain resident forever.
    const explicitCorrectionEnvelope = semanticExplicitEnvelopeMatchesExpected(
      payload,
      session,
      expected,
      marker?.protocol || ''
    );

    let dispatchIndex = -1;
    for (let index = markerIndex - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const turn = turns[index];
      if (turn.role !== 'user') continue;
      const parsed = parseSemanticDispatchTurn(turn);
      if (semanticDispatchMatchesExpected(parsed, session, expected)) {
        dispatchIndex = index;
        break;
      }
    }

    const persistedMountedTurnOrder = expected.mountedTurnOrder != null && Number.isFinite(Number(expected.mountedTurnOrder))
      ? Number(expected.mountedTurnOrder)
      : null;
    // a28: an exact protocol-valid explicit envelope is durable causal identity by itself
    // once it matches the persisted pending dispatch. For thin-result/v1 this means exact dispatchId + baseRevision against the current session's durable pending; legacy VIBE_STATE additionally requires sessionId. The giant user dispatch
    // may be virtualized out of ChatGPT's mounted DOM and older builds may have
    // persisted status='submitting'/'submit-unconfirmed' before mount-confirm
    // bookkeeping completed. Requiring mountedTurnKey/order here creates a
    // false-negative deadlock even though the assistant marker carries the
    // exact high-entropy dispatchId and baseRevision. Omitted/inferred envelopes
    // still require the mounted dispatch and keep the stricter causal checks.
    const detachedDispatchFallback = dispatchIndex < 0 && explicitCorrectionEnvelope;

    if (dispatchIndex < 0 && !detachedDispatchFallback) {
      throw new Error(
        'Matching mounted VIBE_DISPATCH is unavailable and semantic-result transport metadata is insufficient for detached causal binding'
      );
    }

    // User-intervention inference is required only when the dispatch is still
    // mounted and we are reasoning from turn order. For a detached *explicit*
    // envelope there is no transport inference: sessionId + dispatchId +
    // baseRevision already match the persisted pending object exactly. A later
    // user turn cannot retroactively make that assistant envelope ambiguous.
    let correctionRetry = false;
    if (dispatchIndex >= 0) {
      for (let index = dispatchIndex + 1; index < markerIndex; index += 1) {
        const turn = turns[index];
        if (turn.role !== 'user') continue;
        const parsed = parseSemanticDispatchTurn(turn);
        if (semanticDispatchMatchesExpected(parsed, session, expected)) continue;
        const failedAttemptExists = semanticFailedAttemptBefore(
          turns,
          dispatchIndex,
          index,
          session,
          expected
        );
        if (explicitCorrectionEnvelope && failedAttemptExists) {
          correctionRetry = true;
          continue;
        }
        throw new Error(
          'User intervention detected between VIBE_DISPATCH and VIBE_STATE; refusing causal inference'
        );
      }
    }

    const inferred = [];
    if (payload.sessionId == null) {
      payload.sessionId = session.id;
      inferred.push('sessionId');
    }
    if (payload.dispatchId == null) {
      payload.dispatchId = expected.id;
      inferred.push('dispatchId');
    }
    if (payload.baseRevision == null) {
      payload.baseRevision = expected.baseRevision;
      inferred.push('baseRevision');
    }

    return {
      payload,
      inferred,
      dispatchIndex,
      markerIndex,
      correctionRetry,
      detachedDispatchFallback,
    };
  }

  function semanticActiveDistance(session) {
    return session.route.activeDistanceId
      ? session.distances[session.route.activeDistanceId] || null
      : null;
  }

  function addSemanticNote(session, noteInput, revision) {
    if (!noteInput) return null;
    const value = typeof noteInput === 'string' ? { text: noteInput } : noteInput;
    const text = semanticMemoryText(value.text, 1800);
    if (!text) return null;
    const candidate = {
      id: String(value.id || semanticId('note')),
      kind: String(value.kind || 'finding'),
      text,
      status: String(value.status || 'open'),
      sourceRange: normalizeSemanticRange(value.sourceRange),
      distanceId: value.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
      meta: value.meta && typeof value.meta === 'object'
        ? cloneSemanticValue(value.meta)
        : null,
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      revision,
    };
    const key = semanticNoteMemoryKey(candidate);
    const existing = [...session.notes].reverse().find(item =>
      (candidate.id && String(item?.id || '') === candidate.id) ||
      semanticNoteMemoryKey(item) === key
    ) || null;
    if (existing) {
      existing.updatedAt = candidate.updatedAt;
      existing.revision = revision;
      existing.status = candidate.status || existing.status;
      if (candidate.sourceRange) existing.sourceRange = candidate.sourceRange;
      if (candidate.meta) existing.meta = cloneSemanticValue(candidate.meta);
      return existing;
    }
    session.notes.push(candidate);
    return candidate;
  }

  function addSemanticDecision(session, decisionInput, revision) {
    if (!decisionInput) return null;
    const value = typeof decisionInput === 'string' ? { text: decisionInput } : decisionInput;
    const text = semanticMemoryText(value.text, 1800);
    if (!text) return null;
    const candidate = {
      id: String(value.id || semanticId('decision')),
      text,
      reason: semanticMemoryText(value.reason, 900),
      distanceId: value.distanceId || session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      revision,
    };
    const key = semanticDecisionMemoryKey(candidate);
    const existing = [...session.decisions].reverse().find(item => semanticDecisionMemoryKey(item) === key) || null;
    if (existing) {
      existing.revision = revision;
      if (candidate.reason) existing.reason = candidate.reason;
      return existing;
    }
    session.decisions.push(candidate);
    return candidate;
  }

  function mergeSemanticCursor(session, payload) {
    const incoming = payload.sourceCursor || payload.cursor || null;
    if (!incoming || typeof incoming !== 'object') return;
    if ('workspaceId' in incoming) session.sourceCursor.workspaceId = incoming.workspaceId;
    if ('baselineId' in incoming) session.sourceCursor.baselineId = incoming.baselineId;
    if ('baseline' in incoming) session.sourceCursor.baseline = incoming.baseline;
    if (Number.isFinite(Number(incoming.nextOffset))) {
      session.sourceCursor.nextOffset = Number(incoming.nextOffset);
    }
    const range = normalizeSemanticRange(incoming.activeRange || incoming.target);
    if (range) session.sourceCursor.activeRange = range;
    if ('coveredThrough' in incoming) {
      session.sourceCursor.coveredThrough = incoming.coveredThrough;
    }
    if ('workingRevision' in incoming) {
      session.sourceCursor.workingRevision = incoming.workingRevision;
    }
    if ('focusAnchor' in incoming) {
      session.sourceCursor.focusAnchor = String(incoming.focusAnchor || '');
    }
    if ('anchorResolution' in incoming) {
      session.sourceCursor.anchorResolution = cloneSemanticValue(incoming.anchorResolution || null);
    }
    if (Number.isFinite(Number(incoming.workspaceRevision))) {
      session.sourceCursor.workspaceRevision = Number(incoming.workspaceRevision);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(incoming.coveredRanges)) {
      session.sourceCursor.coveredRanges = cloneSemanticValue(incoming.coveredRanges);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(incoming.relatedRanges)) {
      session.sourceCursor.relatedRanges = cloneSemanticValue(incoming.relatedRanges);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(incoming.surfacedRanges)) {
      session.sourceCursor.relatedRanges = cloneSemanticValue(incoming.surfacedRanges);
    }
  }

  function upsertSemanticDistance(session, input, parentId = null) {
    const value = input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {};
    const id = value.id || null;
    if (id && session.distances[id]) {
      const current = session.distances[id];
      if (value.objective != null) current.objective = String(value.objective);
      if (value.closureContract != null) {
        current.closureContract = String(value.closureContract);
      }
      if (value.reason != null) current.reason = String(value.reason);
      if (value.sourceTarget != null) {
        current.sourceTarget = cloneSemanticValue(value.sourceTarget);
      }
      if (value.resumePriority != null || value.priority != null) current.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(value.resumePriority || value.priority);
      if (value.dependencyBlocking != null) current.dependencyBlocking = Boolean(value.dependencyBlocking);
      if (value.strategicFrontId != null || value.strategic_front_id != null) current.strategicFrontId = String(value.strategicFrontId || value.strategic_front_id || '').trim() || null;
      if (value.resumeContract != null || value.resume_contract != null) current.resumeContract = semanticMemoryText(value.resumeContract ?? value.resume_contract ?? '', 900);
      current.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      return current;
    }
    const distance = createSemanticDistance(value, parentId);
    session.distances[distance.id] = distance;
    return distance;
  }

  // a07 persisted Distance scheduler. External blockers remain authoritative in
  // vibe_jobs.db; the SemanticSession stores only causal scheduling state and
  // return-point metadata required to leave/resume a reasoning branch safely.
  const SEMANTIC_DISTANCE_SCHEDULER_STATES_V677 = Object.freeze([
    'active', 'ready', 'waiting_on_promise', 'waiting_on_human', 'waiting_on_transport', 'resumable', 'suspended', 'sealed',
  ]);
  const SEMANTIC_RESUME_PRIORITY_RANK_V677 = Object.freeze({ BLOCKING: 0, HIGH: 1, NORMAL: 2, LOW: 3 });
  const SEMANTIC_SCHEDULER_EVENT_LIMIT_V677 = 96;

  function normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(value, fallback = 'NORMAL') {
    const raw = String(value || fallback || 'NORMAL').trim().toUpperCase();
    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SEMANTIC_RESUME_PRIORITY_RANK_V677, raw) ? raw : 'NORMAL';
  }

  function ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session) {
    if (!session || typeof session !== 'object') return null;
    session.route ||= {};
    session.route.scheduler ||= {
      schema: 'vibe-go-distance-scheduler/v1',
      events: [],
      lastDecisionAt: null,
      lastReason: null,
      lastActivatedDistanceId: null,
    };
    if (!Array.isArray(session.route.scheduler.events)) session.route.scheduler.events = [];
    for (const distance of Object.values(session.distances || {})) {
      if (!distance || typeof distance !== 'object') continue;
      const status = String(distance.status || 'active').toLowerCase();
      if (!SEMANTIC_DISTANCE_SCHEDULER_STATES_V677.includes(status)) {
        distance.status = status === 'complete' ? 'sealed' : 'suspended';
      } else {
        distance.status = status;
      }
      if (distance.waitingOn && typeof distance.waitingOn === 'object') {
        distance.waitingOn.promiseIds = [...new Set((Array.isArray(distance.waitingOn.promiseIds) ? distance.waitingOn.promiseIds : []).map(String).filter(Boolean))];
        distance.waitingOn.humanRequestIds = [...new Set((Array.isArray(distance.waitingOn.humanRequestIds) ? distance.waitingOn.humanRequestIds : []).map(String).filter(Boolean))];
        distance.waitingOn.promiseStates ||= {};
        distance.waitingOn.humanStates ||= {};
        distance.waitingOn.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(distance.waitingOn.resumePriority || distance.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
      }
      distance.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(distance.resumePriority || distance.waitingOn?.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
      distance.dependencyBlocking = Boolean(distance.dependencyBlocking);
    }
    return session.route.scheduler;
  }

  function recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, type, payload = {}) {
    const scheduler = ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    if (!scheduler) return null;
    const event = {
      id: semanticId('scheduler-event'),
      type: String(type || 'EVENT'),
      at: semanticIsoNow(),
      ...cloneSemanticValue(payload || {}),
    };
    scheduler.events.push(event);
    if (scheduler.events.length > SEMANTIC_SCHEDULER_EVENT_LIMIT_V677) {
      scheduler.events.splice(0, scheduler.events.length - SEMANTIC_SCHEDULER_EVENT_LIMIT_V677);
    }
    scheduler.lastDecisionAt = event.at;
    scheduler.lastReason = String(payload?.reason || type || '');
    return event;
  }

  function semanticStrategicFrontByIdV691(session, frontIdInput) {
    const frontId = String(frontIdInput || '').trim();
    if (!frontId) return null;
    ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session);
    return session.strategicFrontier.fronts.find(front => front.frontId === frontId) || null;
  }

  function linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, distance, frontIdInput, timestamp = semanticIsoNow()) {
    if (!session || !distance) return false;
    const frontId = String(frontIdInput || distance.strategicFrontId || '').trim();
    if (!frontId) return false;
    const front = semanticStrategicFrontByIdV691(session, frontId);
    if (!front) return false;
    let changed = false;
    if (distance.strategicFrontId !== frontId) { distance.strategicFrontId = frontId; changed = true; }
    const ids = [...new Set([...(front.relatedDistanceIds || []), distance.id])].slice(-12);
    if (JSON.stringify(ids) !== JSON.stringify(front.relatedDistanceIds || [])) {
      front.relatedDistanceIds = ids;
      front.updatedAt = timestamp;
      changed = true;
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function applySemanticResumeDistancesV691(session, payloadInput = {}) {
    const values = Array.isArray(payloadInput?.resumeDistances) ? payloadInput.resumeDistances : [];
    const resumed = [];
    for (const input of values) {
      if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') continue;
      const id = String(input.id || input.distanceId || '').trim();
      const distance = id ? session.distances?.[id] || null : null;
      if (!distance || distance.status === 'sealed') continue;
      captureSemanticSchedulerReturnV677(session, distance);
      if (input.tacticalFocus != null || input.nextFocus != null) {
        const focus = String(input.tacticalFocus ?? input.nextFocus ?? '').trim();
        distance.schedulerReturn.tacticalFocus = focus;
        distance.schedulerReturn.nextFocus = focus;
      }
      if (input.resumeContract != null || input.resume_contract != null) {
        distance.resumeContract = semanticMemoryText(input.resumeContract ?? input.resume_contract ?? '', 900);
        distance.schedulerReturn.resumeContract = distance.resumeContract;
      }
      if (input.strategicFrontId != null || input.strategic_front_id != null) {
        linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, distance, input.strategicFrontId || input.strategic_front_id);
      }
      distance.status = String(input.status || 'ready').toLowerCase() === 'resumable' ? 'resumable' : 'ready';
      distance.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(input.resumePriority || input.priority || distance.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
      distance.dependencyBlocking = Boolean(input.dependencyBlocking ?? distance.dependencyBlocking);
      if (distance.status === 'ready') distance.readyAt = semanticIsoNow();
      else distance.resumableAt = semanticIsoNow();
      distance.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      resumed.push(distance.id);
    }
    if (resumed.length) recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'STRATEGIC_RESUME_QUEUED', { distanceIds: resumed, reason: 'model-declared resumeDistances' });
    return resumed;
  }

  function restoreSemanticTacticalReturnV691(session, returnPointInput = null) {
    const returnPoint = returnPointInput && typeof returnPointInput === 'object' ? returnPointInput : null;
    if (!session || !returnPoint) return false;
    const focus = String(returnPoint.tacticalFocus ?? returnPoint.nextFocus ?? '').trim();
    if (!focus) return false;
    session.route.tacticalFocus = focus;
    session.route.nextFocus = focus;
    return true;
  }

  function queueSemanticReadyDistancesV677(session, payloadInput = {}) {
    const values = Array.isArray(payloadInput?.readyDistances) ? payloadInput.readyDistances : [];
    const queued = [];
    for (const input of values) {
      if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') continue;
      const distance = upsertSemanticDistance(session, input, input.parentId || null);
      if (!distance || distance.id === session.route.activeDistanceId || distance.status === 'sealed') continue;
      distance.status = 'ready';
      distance.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(input.resumePriority || input.priority || distance.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
      distance.dependencyBlocking = Boolean(input.dependencyBlocking ?? distance.dependencyBlocking);
      linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, distance, input.strategicFrontId || input.strategic_front_id || distance.strategicFrontId);
      distance.readyAt ||= semanticIsoNow();
      distance.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      queued.push(distance.id);
    }
    if (queued.length) recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'READY_QUEUED', { distanceIds: queued, reason: 'model-declared readyDistances' });
    return queued;
  }

  function captureSemanticSchedulerReturnV677(session, distance) {
    if (!session || !distance) return null;
    if (distance.schedulerReturn && typeof distance.schedulerReturn === 'object') return distance.schedulerReturn;
    distance.schedulerReturn = {
      capturedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      deepeningStack: cloneSemanticValue(session.route?.deepeningStack || []),
      returnPoint: cloneSemanticValue(session.route?.returnPoint || null),
      nextFocus: String(session.route?.nextFocus || ''),
      tacticalFocus: String(session.route?.tacticalFocus || session.route?.nextFocus || ''),
      strategicFrontier: {
        posture: session.strategicFrontier?.posture || 'EXPLORE',
        activeTheory: semanticMemoryText(session.strategicFrontier?.activeTheory || '', 700),
        strategyReminder: semanticMemoryText(session.strategicFrontier?.strategyReminder || '', 500),
      },
      strategicFrontId: distance.strategicFrontId || null,
      resumeContract: semanticMemoryText(distance.resumeContract || '', 900),
      sourceCursor: semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(session.sourceCursor || {}),
      objective: String(distance.objective || ''),
      closureContract: String(distance.closureContract || ''),
    };
    return distance.schedulerReturn;
  }

  function ensureDistanceWaitingOnV677(distance) {
    if (!distance.waitingOn || typeof distance.waitingOn !== 'object') {
      distance.waitingOn = {
        promiseIds: [],
        humanRequestIds: [],
        promiseStates: {},
        humanStates: {},
        reason: '',
        resumeContract: '',
        resumePriority: normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(distance.resumePriority || 'NORMAL'),
        sinceAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
    distance.waitingOn.promiseIds ||= [];
    distance.waitingOn.humanRequestIds ||= [];
    distance.waitingOn.promiseStates ||= {};
    distance.waitingOn.humanStates ||= {};
    return distance.waitingOn;
  }

  function markSemanticDistancePromiseBlockedV677(session, distanceId, promiseInput = {}) {
    const distance = distanceId ? session?.distances?.[distanceId] || null : null;
    const promiseId = String(promiseInput?.promise_id || promiseInput?.promiseId || '').trim();
    if (!distance || !promiseId) return false;
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    if (session.route.activeDistanceId === distance.id) captureSemanticSchedulerReturnV677(session, distance);
    const waiting = ensureDistanceWaitingOnV677(distance);
    if (!waiting.promiseIds.includes(promiseId)) waiting.promiseIds.push(promiseId);
    waiting.promiseStates[promiseId] = String(promiseInput?.status || 'WAITING').toUpperCase();
    waiting.reason = String(promiseInput?.reason || waiting.reason || 'mechanical evidence required');
    waiting.resumeContract = String(promiseInput?.resume_contract || promiseInput?.resumeContract || waiting.resumeContract || 'inspect fulfilled evidence and resume this Distance');
    waiting.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(promiseInput?.resume_priority || waiting.resumePriority || distance.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
    waiting.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    distance.resumePriority = waiting.resumePriority;
    distance.status = 'waiting_on_promise';
    distance.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'WAITING_ON_PROMISE', { distanceId: distance.id, promiseId, reason: waiting.reason });
    return true;
  }

  function markSemanticDistanceHumanBlockedV677(session, distanceId, requestInput = {}) {
    const distance = distanceId ? session?.distances?.[distanceId] || null : null;
    const requestId = String(requestInput?.request_id || requestInput?.requestId || '').trim();
    const blockingClass = String(requestInput?.blocking_class || requestInput?.blockingClass || 'DEFERRED').toUpperCase();
    if (!distance || !requestId || blockingClass !== 'BLOCKING') return false;
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    if (session.route.activeDistanceId === distance.id) captureSemanticSchedulerReturnV677(session, distance);
    const waiting = ensureDistanceWaitingOnV677(distance);
    if (!waiting.humanRequestIds.includes(requestId)) waiting.humanRequestIds.push(requestId);
    waiting.humanStates[requestId] = String(requestInput?.status || 'OPEN').toUpperCase();
    waiting.reason = String(requestInput?.question || requestInput?.subject || waiting.reason || 'human decision required');
    waiting.resumeContract = String(requestInput?.resume_contract || waiting.resumeContract || 'apply HUMAN_DECISION authority and resume this Distance');
    waiting.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(requestInput?.resume_priority || waiting.resumePriority || distance.resumePriority || 'BLOCKING');
    waiting.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    distance.resumePriority = waiting.resumePriority;
    distance.status = 'waiting_on_human';
    distance.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'WAITING_ON_HUMAN', { distanceId: distance.id, requestId, reason: waiting.reason });
    return true;
  }

  // a09.15: external transport blocking is scheduler state, not Semantic HOLD.
  // It preserves the active Distance return envelope, removes it from the active
  // slot, and lets unrelated READY/RESUMABLE work continue. A runner-level relay
  // watcher owns health probes and later marks the branch resumable.
  function markSemanticDistanceTransportBlockedV6915(session, distanceId, waitInput = {}) {
    const distance = distanceId ? session?.distances?.[distanceId] || null : null;
    if (!session || !distance) return false;
    const resource = String(waitInput.resource || waitInput.blockedResource || 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (resource !== 'PROJECT_DATA_EXTENSION_RELAY') {
      throw new Error(`WAIT_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED_RESOURCE: ${resource || '(empty)'}`);
    }
    const evidence = waitInput.failureEnvelope || latestProjectDataExternalTransportFailureV6915(session);
    if (!evidence || String(evidence.failure_domain || evidence.failureDomain || '').toUpperCase() !== 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE') {
      throw new Error('WAIT_TRANSPORT_REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE_EVIDENCE');
    }
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    if (session.route.activeDistanceId === distance.id) captureSemanticSchedulerReturnV677(session, distance);
    const at = semanticIsoNow();
    const previousStatusV6917 = String(distance.status || 'active');
    const failureFingerprint = String(waitInput.failureFingerprint || projectDataTransportFailureFingerprintV6915(evidence) || 'external-transport-failure');
    distance.status = 'waiting_on_transport';
    distance.waitingOnTransport = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-distance-transport-wait/v1',
      resource,
      previousStatus: distance.waitingOnTransport?.previousStatus || previousStatusV6917,
      reason: semanticMemoryText(waitInput.reason || evidence.error || evidence.message || 'Project Data relay unavailable', 1200),
      resumeContract: semanticMemoryText(waitInput.resumeContract || waitInput.resume_contract || distance.resumeContract || 'Resume preserved Distance when the relay recovers.', 1200),
      failureFingerprint,
      failureEnvelope: boundedProjectDataResultV670(evidence),
      sinceAt: distance.waitingOnTransport?.sinceAt || at,
      updatedAt: at,
      recoveredAt: null,
      wakeReason: null,
    };
    distance.updatedAt = at;
    if (session.route.activeDistanceId === distance.id) session.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    const wake = ensureProjectDataTransportWakeStateV6915(session);
    wake.status = 'watching';
    wake.resource = resource;
    wake.lastFailureFingerprint = failureFingerprint;
    wake.distanceIds = [...new Set([...(wake.distanceIds || []), distance.id])];
    wake.updatedAt = at;
    recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'WAITING_ON_TRANSPORT', {
      distanceId: distance.id,
      resource,
      failureFingerprint,
      reason: distance.waitingOnTransport.reason,
    });
    scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'transport-blocked');
    return true;
  }

  function semanticSchedulerCandidateRankV677(distance) {
    const stateRank = distance?.status === 'resumable' ? 0 : distance?.status === 'ready' ? 1 : 9;
    const priority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(distance?.resumePriority || distance?.waitingOn?.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
    const blockingRank = distance?.dependencyBlocking ? 0 : 1;
    const age = Date.parse(distance?.resumableAt || distance?.readyAt || distance?.createdAt || '') || Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    return [stateRank, blockingRank, SEMANTIC_RESUME_PRIORITY_RANK_V677[priority], age, String(distance?.id || '')];
  }

  function compareSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677(a, b) {
    const ar = semanticSchedulerCandidateRankV677(a);
    const br = semanticSchedulerCandidateRankV677(b);
    for (let i = 0; i < ar.length; i += 1) {
      if (ar[i] < br[i]) return -1;
      if (ar[i] > br[i]) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  function selectSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677(session) {
    return Object.values(session?.distances || {})
      .filter(item => item && (item.status === 'ready' || item.status === 'resumable'))
      .sort(compareSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677)[0] || null;
  }

  const OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_REASON_V704 = 'SYSTEM_OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY';
  const OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_SCHEMA_V704 = 'vibe-go-open-mission-continuity/v1';

  function isOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(distance) {
    return Boolean(
      distance &&
      String(distance.reason || '') === OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_REASON_V704
    );
  }

  function openMissionContinuityHardBlockedV704(session) {
    if (!session || session.status !== 'active') return true;
    const operatorPrerequisite = session.transport?.operatorPrerequisiteV6912 || null;
    if (operatorPrerequisite?.status === 'waiting') return true;
    return false;
  }

  function ensureOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(session, reason = 'open-mission-continuity') {
    if (!session || session.status !== 'active') return null;
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);

    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    if (active?.status === 'active') return active;

    const candidate = selectSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677(session);
    if (candidate) return candidate;

    const pendingStatus = String(session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status || '');
    if (['submitting', 'submitted', 'generating', 'submit-unconfirmed'].includes(pendingStatus)) return null;
    if (openMissionContinuityHardBlockedV704(session)) return null;

    // If a previous system continuity probe itself is waiting on an external
    // dependency, that is an explicit bounded wait. Do not manufacture another
    // probe and spin while its blocker is unresolved.
    const blockedContinuity = Object.values(session.distances || {}).find(distance =>
      isOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(distance) &&
      ['waiting_on_promise', 'waiting_on_human', 'waiting_on_transport'].includes(String(distance.status || ''))
    );
    if (blockedContinuity) return null;

    const existing = Object.values(session.distances || {}).find(distance =>
      isOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(distance) &&
      ['ready', 'resumable', 'active'].includes(String(distance.status || ''))
    );
    if (existing) return existing;

    const timestamp = semanticIsoNow();
    const distance = createSemanticDistance({
      id: semanticId('mission-continuity'),
      objective:
        'Reconcile the still-open Mission after local Distance completion. Use durable Mission authority, accepted evidence, scheduler blockers and Strategic Frontier to activate, resume or create the next highest-leverage executable Distance. Do not redo sealed work and do not treat advisory focus as work authority.',
      closureContract:
        'Leave this continuity Distance only by establishing successor executable Distance authority, sealing the Mission, or entering an explicit genuine external-prerequisite wait. It may not be sealed into an open Mission with no successor.',
      status: 'ready',
      reason: OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_REASON_V704,
      resumePriority: 'BLOCKING',
      dependencyBlocking: true,
    });
    distance.readyAt = timestamp;
    distance.updatedAt = timestamp;
    session.distances[distance.id] = distance;
    recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_QUEUED', {
      distanceId: distance.id,
      schema: OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_SCHEMA_V704,
      reason: String(reason || 'open-mission-continuity'),
    });
    return distance;
  }

  function activateSemanticScheduledDistanceV677(session, distance, reason = 'scheduler-select') {
    if (!session || !distance) return null;
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    const previousId = session.route.activeDistanceId || null;
    distance.status = 'active';
    distance.resumedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    distance.updatedAt = distance.resumedAt;
    session.route.activeDistanceId = distance.id;
    linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, distance, distance.strategicFrontId);
    if (distance.schedulerReturn && typeof distance.schedulerReturn === 'object') {
      session.route.deepeningStack = cloneSemanticValue(distance.schedulerReturn.deepeningStack || []);
      session.route.returnPoint = cloneSemanticValue(distance.schedulerReturn.returnPoint || null);
      if (distance.schedulerReturn.tacticalFocus || distance.schedulerReturn.nextFocus) {
        const restoredFocusV690 = String(distance.schedulerReturn.tacticalFocus || distance.schedulerReturn.nextFocus || '');
        session.route.tacticalFocus = restoredFocusV690;
        session.route.nextFocus = restoredFocusV690;
      }
    } else {
      session.route.deepeningStack = [];
      session.route.returnPoint = null;
    }
    session.route.scheduler.lastActivatedDistanceId = distance.id;
    recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'ACTIVATED', { distanceId: distance.id, previousDistanceId: previousId, reason });
    return distance;
  }

  function scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, reason = 'scheduler') {
    if (!session) return null;
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    // A coherent ACTIVE Distance is never preempted merely because another branch
    // became resumable. This is the P14.G06 anti-preemption invariant.
    if (active?.status === 'active') return active;
    let candidate = selectSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677(session);
    if (!candidate) {
      candidate = ensureOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(session, reason);
    }
    if (!candidate) {
      session.route.activeDistanceId = null;
      session.route.deepeningStack = [];
      session.route.returnPoint = null;
      recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'IDLE_NO_READY', { reason });
      return null;
    }
    return activateSemanticScheduledDistanceV677(session, candidate, reason);
  }

  const SEMANTIC_MODEL_FACING_PENDING_STATUSES_V696 = Object.freeze(new Set([
    'submitting',
    'submitted',
    'generating',
    'submit-unconfirmed',
  ]));

  function semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    if (!session) {
      return { eligible: false, reason: 'NO_SESSION', activeDistanceId: null, schedulerCandidateId: null, pendingStatus: null };
    }

    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    if (active?.status === 'active') {
      return {
        eligible: true,
        reason: 'ACTIVE_DISTANCE',
        activeDistanceId: active.id,
        schedulerCandidateId: null,
        pendingStatus: session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status || null,
      };
    }

    const candidate = selectSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677(session);
    if (candidate) {
      return {
        eligible: true,
        reason: 'SCHEDULER_CANDIDATE',
        activeDistanceId: null,
        schedulerCandidateId: candidate.id,
        pendingStatus: session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status || null,
      };
    }

    const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const pendingStatus = String(pending?.status || '');
    if (pending && SEMANTIC_MODEL_FACING_PENDING_STATUSES_V696.has(pendingStatus)) {
      return {
        eligible: true,
        reason: 'IN_FLIGHT_RECONCILIATION',
        activeDistanceId: null,
        schedulerCandidateId: null,
        pendingStatus,
        pendingDispatchId: pending.id || null,
      };
    }

    return {
      eligible: false,
      reason: 'SEMANTIC_IDLE_NO_ACTIVE_DISTANCE',
      activeDistanceId: null,
      schedulerCandidateId: null,
      pendingStatus: pendingStatus || null,
      pendingDispatchId: pending?.id || null,
      staleProvenUnsentPending: Boolean(pending && ['ready', 'queued'].includes(pendingStatus)),
    };
  }

  function enforceSemanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(context = 'runtime') {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return { allowed: false, changed: false, reason: 'NO_SESSION' };

    let eligibility = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(session);
    if (eligibility.schedulerCandidateId) {
      const candidate = session.distances?.[eligibility.schedulerCandidateId] || null;
      if (candidate) {
        activateSemanticScheduledDistanceV677(session, candidate, `v696-${context}`);
        session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
        eligibility = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(SemanticSessionStore.load());
        return {
          allowed: eligibility.eligible === true,
          changed: true,
          activatedDistanceId: candidate.id,
          reason: eligibility.reason,
          eligibility,
        };
      }
    }

    if (!eligibility.eligible && !eligibility.staleProvenUnsentPending) {
      const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      const recovered = scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(
        live,
        `v704-${context}-open-mission-watchdog`
      );
      if (recovered?.status === 'active') {
        live.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        SemanticSessionStore.save(live);
        eligibility = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(SemanticSessionStore.load());
        return {
          allowed: eligibility.eligible === true,
          changed: true,
          continuityRecovered: true,
          activatedDistanceId: recovered.id,
          reason: eligibility.reason,
          eligibility,
        };
      }
    }

    if (!eligibility.eligible && eligibility.staleProvenUnsentPending) {
      const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (live?.transport?.pendingDispatch &&
          ['ready', 'queued'].includes(String(live.transport.pendingDispatch.status || ''))) {
        const cancelled = cloneSemanticValue(live.transport.pendingDispatch);
        live.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
        live.transport.lastIdleSuppressedDispatchV696 = {
          schema: 'vibe-go-idle-suppressed-dispatch/v1',
          dispatchId: cancelled.id || null,
          baseRevision: cancelled.baseRevision ?? null,
          previousStatus: cancelled.status || null,
          context: String(context || 'runtime'),
          suppressedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        live.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        SemanticSessionStore.save(live);
        clearPendingSend();
        const repaired = SemanticSessionStore.load();
        const recovered = scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(
          repaired,
          `v704-${context}-post-stale-cancel-watchdog`
        );
        if (recovered?.status === 'active') {
          repaired.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
          SemanticSessionStore.save(repaired);
        }
        eligibility = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(SemanticSessionStore.load());
        return {
          allowed: eligibility.eligible === true,
          changed: true,
          cancelledDispatchId: cancelled.id || null,
          continuityRecovered: Boolean(recovered?.status === 'active'),
          activatedDistanceId: recovered?.status === 'active' ? recovered.id : null,
          reason: eligibility.reason,
          eligibility,
        };
      }
    }

    return {
      allowed: eligibility.eligible === true,
      changed: false,
      reason: eligibility.reason,
      eligibility,
    };
  }

  function semanticIdleBoundaryAcceptanceV696() {
    const open = createSemanticSession({
      sessionId: 'semantic-open-mission-continuity-v704',
      objective: 'Close local root while Mission remains open.',
      closureContract: 'Local root closes and Mission continues.',
      nextFocus: 'Advisory future direction only.',
    });
    const rootId = open.route.activeDistanceId;
    open.distances[rootId].status = 'sealed';
    open.distances[rootId].summary = 'sealed local Distance';
    open.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    open.route.deepeningStack = [];
    open.route.returnPoint = null;
    open.transport.pendingDispatch = null;

    const beforeRecovery = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(open);
    const recovered = scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(open, 'selftest-open-mission-continuity');
    const afterRecovery = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(open);

    const sealedMission = cloneSemanticValue(open);
    sealedMission.status = 'sealed';
    sealedMission.completedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    for (const distance of Object.values(sealedMission.distances || {})) distance.status = 'sealed';
    sealedMission.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    sealedMission.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    const sealedRecovery = scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(sealedMission, 'selftest-mission-sealed');
    const sealedEligibility = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(sealedMission);

    const ready = createSemanticSession({
      sessionId: 'semantic-ready-v704',
      objective: 'Explicit schedulable root.',
      closureContract: 'Ready work completes.',
    });
    const readyRoot = semanticActiveDistance(ready);
    readyRoot.status = 'sealed';
    ready.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    const readyDistance = createSemanticDistance({
      id: 'distance-ready-v704',
      objective: 'Explicit schedulable work.',
      closureContract: 'Ready work completes.',
      status: 'ready',
    });
    readyDistance.status = 'ready';
    ready.distances[readyDistance.id] = readyDistance;
    const schedulableEligibility = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(ready);

    const inflight = createSemanticSession({
      sessionId: 'semantic-inflight-v704',
      objective: 'In-flight reconciliation.',
      closureContract: 'Pending model result reconciles.',
    });
    const inflightRoot = semanticActiveDistance(inflight);
    inflightRoot.status = 'sealed';
    inflight.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    inflight.transport.pendingDispatch = {
      id: 'dispatch-inflight-v704',
      baseRevision: inflight.revision,
      status: 'generating',
      text: 'x',
      controlId: 'control-v704',
    };
    const inflightEligibility = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(inflight);

    const operatorBlocked = createSemanticSession({
      sessionId: 'semantic-operator-block-v704',
      objective: 'External prerequisite.',
      closureContract: 'Wait only for genuine operator prerequisite.',
    });
    const operatorRoot = semanticActiveDistance(operatorBlocked);
    operatorRoot.status = 'sealed';
    operatorBlocked.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    operatorBlocked.transport.operatorPrerequisiteV6912 = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-operator-prerequisite/v1',
      status: 'waiting',
      reason: 'external prerequisite',
    };
    const operatorRecovery = scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(operatorBlocked, 'selftest-operator-hard-block');

    const dependencyBlocked = createSemanticSession({
      sessionId: 'semantic-continuity-dependency-block-v704',
      objective: 'Continuity probe waits on dependency.',
      closureContract: 'Do not spin while the probe is durably blocked.',
    });
    const dependencyRoot = semanticActiveDistance(dependencyBlocked);
    dependencyRoot.status = 'sealed';
    dependencyBlocked.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    const blockedProbe = createSemanticDistance({
      id: 'mission-continuity-blocked-v704',
      objective: 'Continuity probe.',
      closureContract: 'Resume after dependency.',
      reason: OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_REASON_V704,
    });
    blockedProbe.status = 'waiting_on_human';
    dependencyBlocked.distances[blockedProbe.id] = blockedProbe;
    const duplicateRecovery = scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(dependencyBlocked, 'selftest-blocked-continuity-no-spin');

    const ok =
      beforeRecovery.eligible === false &&
      Boolean(recovered) &&
      isOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(recovered) &&
      recovered.status === 'active' &&
      afterRecovery.eligible === true &&
      afterRecovery.reason === 'ACTIVE_DISTANCE' &&
      sealedRecovery === null &&
      sealedEligibility.eligible === false &&
      schedulableEligibility.eligible === true &&
      schedulableEligibility.schedulerCandidateId === readyDistance.id &&
      inflightEligibility.eligible === true &&
      inflightEligibility.reason === 'IN_FLIGHT_RECONCILIATION' &&
      operatorRecovery === null &&
      duplicateRecovery === null;

    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-open-mission-continuity-acceptance/v1',
      ok,
      beforeRecovery,
      recoveredDistanceId: recovered?.id || null,
      afterRecovery,
      sealedEligibility,
      schedulableEligibility,
      inflightEligibility,
      operatorHardBlockPreserved: operatorRecovery === null,
      blockedContinuityDoesNotSpin: duplicateRecovery === null,
    };
  }

  function openMissionContinuityAcceptanceV704() {
    return semanticIdleBoundaryAcceptanceV696();
  }

  function schedulerInboxMapsV677(promiseInbox = {}, humanInbox = {}) {
    const promises = new Map();
    for (const item of Array.isArray(promiseInbox?.waiting) ? promiseInbox.waiting : []) promises.set(String(item.promise_id || ''), item);
    for (const item of Array.isArray(promiseInbox?.fulfilled_unconsumed) ? promiseInbox.fulfilled_unconsumed : []) promises.set(String(item.promise_id || ''), item);
    const humans = new Map();
    for (const item of Array.isArray(humanInbox?.open) ? humanInbox.open : []) humans.set(String(item.request_id || ''), item);
    for (const item of Array.isArray(humanInbox?.deferred) ? humanInbox.deferred : []) humans.set(String(item.request_id || ''), item);
    for (const item of Array.isArray(humanInbox?.answered_unconsumed) ? humanInbox.answered_unconsumed : []) humans.set(String(item.request_id || ''), item);
    return { promises, humans };
  }

  function reconcileSemanticDistanceSchedulerV677(session, promiseInbox = {}, humanInbox = {}, reason = 'inbox-reconcile') {
    if (!session) return { changed: false, activeDistanceId: null };
    // A07.1 acceptance repair: capture the persisted envelope BEFORE migration.
    // A07 created route.scheduler in a detached clone and then took its `before`
    // snapshot, so an empty-inbox migration looked like a no-op and was never
    // saved to IndexedDB. Scheduler schema/normalization are durable state and
    // therefore must participate in change detection without incrementing the
    // semantic revision.
    const before = JSON.stringify({
      active: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
      distances: session.distances || {},
      stack: session.route?.deepeningStack || [],
      returnPoint: session.route?.returnPoint || null,
      scheduler: session.route?.scheduler || null,
    });
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    const maps = schedulerInboxMapsV677(promiseInbox, humanInbox);
    for (const distance of Object.values(session.distances || {})) {
      const waiting = distance?.waitingOn;
      if (!waiting || typeof waiting !== 'object') continue;
      const blockerCoreBefore = JSON.stringify({
        status: distance.status || null,
        resumePriority: distance.resumePriority || null,
        promiseStates: waiting.promiseStates || {},
        humanStates: waiting.humanStates || {},
        reason: waiting.reason || '',
        resumeContract: waiting.resumeContract || '',
        waitingResumePriority: waiting.resumePriority || null,
      });
      let promiseOutstanding = false;
      let humanOutstanding = false;
      let hasKnownBlocker = false;
      for (const promiseId of waiting.promiseIds || []) {
        const item = maps.promises.get(String(promiseId));
        const status = String(item?.status || waiting.promiseStates?.[promiseId] || 'WAITING').toUpperCase();
        waiting.promiseStates[promiseId] = status;
        if (item) {
          hasKnownBlocker = true;
          waiting.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(item.resume_priority || waiting.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
          if (item.resume_contract) waiting.resumeContract = String(item.resume_contract);
          if (item.reason) waiting.reason = String(item.reason);
        }
        if (status === 'WAITING' || !['FULFILLED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'CONSUMED'].includes(status)) promiseOutstanding = true;
      }
      for (const requestId of waiting.humanRequestIds || []) {
        const item = maps.humans.get(String(requestId));
        const status = String(item?.status || waiting.humanStates?.[requestId] || 'OPEN').toUpperCase();
        waiting.humanStates[requestId] = status;
        if (item) hasKnownBlocker = true;
        if (status === 'OPEN' || status === 'DEFERRED' || !['ANSWERED', 'CONSUMED', 'CANCELLED'].includes(status)) humanOutstanding = true;
      }
      distance.resumePriority = normalizeSemanticResumePriorityV677(waiting.resumePriority || distance.resumePriority || 'NORMAL');
      if (promiseOutstanding) distance.status = 'waiting_on_promise';
      else if (humanOutstanding) distance.status = 'waiting_on_human';
      else if ((waiting.promiseIds?.length || waiting.humanRequestIds?.length) && hasKnownBlocker) {
        if (distance.status !== 'active' && distance.status !== 'sealed') {
          if (distance.status !== 'resumable') {
            distance.status = 'resumable';
            distance.resumableAt = semanticIsoNow();
            recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'RESUMABLE', { distanceId: distance.id, reason: waiting.resumeContract || reason });
          }
        }
      }
      const blockerCoreAfter = JSON.stringify({
        status: distance.status || null,
        resumePriority: distance.resumePriority || null,
        promiseStates: waiting.promiseStates || {},
        humanStates: waiting.humanStates || {},
        reason: waiting.reason || '',
        resumeContract: waiting.resumeContract || '',
        waitingResumePriority: waiting.resumePriority || null,
      });
      // Do not dirty persisted rows on every status poll. Timestamps move only
      // when blocker-derived scheduling state actually changes.
      if (blockerCoreBefore !== blockerCoreAfter) {
        const changedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        waiting.updatedAt = changedAt;
        distance.updatedAt = changedAt;
      }
    }
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    if (!active || active.status !== 'active') scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, reason);
    const after = JSON.stringify({
      active: session.route.activeDistanceId || null,
      distances: session.distances,
      stack: session.route.deepeningStack,
      returnPoint: session.route.returnPoint,
      scheduler: session.route.scheduler || null,
    });
    return { changed: before !== after, activeDistanceId: session.route.activeDistanceId || null };
  }

  function applySemanticSchedulerCreationResultsV677(session, requestedOps = [], rawResults = [], fallbackDistanceId = null) {
    if (!session) return { changed: false, blockers: [] };
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    const before = JSON.stringify(session.distances || {});
    const blockers = [];
    requestedOps.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const result = rawResults[index];
      if (!result || result.ok === false) return;
      const op = normalizeProjectDataOpV670(raw);
      const value = result.value || {};
      if (op === 'CREATE_PROMISE') {
        const promise = value;
        const distanceId = String(promise.distance_id || raw?.distance_id || fallbackDistanceId || '');
        if (markSemanticDistancePromiseBlockedV677(session, distanceId, { ...raw, ...promise })) blockers.push({ kind: 'promise', id: promise.promise_id, distanceId });
      } else if (op === 'SUBMIT_ANALYSIS_JOB' && value?.promise?.promise_id) {
        const promise = value.promise;
        const distanceId = String(promise.distance_id || raw?.distance_id || fallbackDistanceId || '');
        if (markSemanticDistancePromiseBlockedV677(session, distanceId, { ...(raw?.promise || {}), ...promise })) blockers.push({ kind: 'promise', id: promise.promise_id, distanceId });
      } else if (op === 'CREATE_HUMAN_REQUEST' && value?.request?.request_id) {
        const request = value.request;
        const distanceId = String(request.distance_id || raw?.distance_id || fallbackDistanceId || '');
        if (markSemanticDistanceHumanBlockedV677(session, distanceId, request)) blockers.push({ kind: 'human', id: request.request_id, distanceId });
      }
    });
    if (blockers.length) {
      const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
      if (!active || active.status !== 'active') scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'active-distance-blocked');
    }
    return { changed: before !== JSON.stringify(session.distances || {}), blockers };
  }

  function semanticSchedulerProjectionV677(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return { active: null, ready: [], resumable: [], waitingPromise: [], waitingHuman: [], waitingTransport: [], sealed: [] };
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    const values = Object.values(session.distances || {});
    const pick = status => values.filter(item => item?.status === status).sort(compareSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677);
    return {
      active: semanticActiveDistance(session),
      ready: pick('ready'),
      resumable: pick('resumable'),
      waitingPromise: pick('waiting_on_promise'),
      waitingHuman: pick('waiting_on_human'),
      waitingTransport: pick('waiting_on_transport'),
      sealed: pick('sealed'),
      scheduler: cloneSemanticValue(session.route.scheduler || null),
    };
  }

  function buildSemanticSchedulerDispatchLinesV677(sessionInput = null) {
    const p = semanticSchedulerProjectionV677(sessionInput);
    const lines = [
      `DISTANCE SCHEDULER · active ${p.active?.id || 'none'} · ready ${p.ready.length} · resumable ${p.resumable.length} · waiting promise ${p.waitingPromise.length} · waiting human ${p.waitingHuman.length} · waiting transport ${p.waitingTransport.length}`,
    ];
    if (p.waitingTransport.length) {
      lines.push('TRANSPORT-GATED DISTANCES');
      for (const item of p.waitingTransport.slice(0, 5)) {
        lines.push(`- ${item.id} · ${item.waitingOnTransport?.resource || 'transport'} · ${String(item.objective || '').slice(0, 220)} · wake: ${String(item.waitingOnTransport?.resumeContract || '').slice(0, 320)}`);
      }
    }
    if (p.resumable.length) {
      lines.push('RESUMABLE DISTANCES');
      for (const item of p.resumable.slice(0, 5)) {
        lines.push(`- ${item.id} · ${item.resumePriority || 'NORMAL'} · ${String(item.objective || '').slice(0, 220)} · resume: ${String(item.waitingOn?.resumeContract || '').slice(0, 320)}`);
      }
    }
    if (!p.active && (p.ready.length || p.resumable.length)) lines.push('Scheduler invariant warning: selectable work exists without an ACTIVE Distance; call scheduler reconciliation before dispatch.');
    return lines;
  }

  function semanticSchedulerSelfTestV677() {
    let session = createSemanticSession({ sessionId: 'scheduler-self-test', objective: 'Root', closureContract: 'Root closure' });
    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    const ready = upsertSemanticDistance(session, { id: 'distance-ready', objective: 'Unrelated READY work', closureContract: 'Ready closure', resumePriority: 'NORMAL' }, null);
    ready.status = 'ready'; ready.readyAt = semanticIsoNow();
    markSemanticDistancePromiseBlockedV677(session, session.route.activeDistanceId, { promise_id: 'PRM-A', status: 'WAITING', resume_priority: 'HIGH', resume_contract: 'Inspect A' });
    scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'selftest-root-blocked');
    const step1 = { active: session.route.activeDistanceId, root: session.distances[Object.keys(session.distances).find(id => id !== 'distance-ready')].status };
    reconcileSemanticDistanceSchedulerV677(session, { waiting: [], fulfilled_unconsumed: [{ promise_id: 'PRM-A', status: 'FULFILLED', resume_priority: 'HIGH', resume_contract: 'Inspect A' }] }, {}, 'selftest-fulfilled');
    const root = Object.values(session.distances).find(item => item.id !== 'distance-ready');
    const step2 = { active: session.route.activeDistanceId, root: root.status };
    markSemanticDistanceHumanBlockedV677(session, 'distance-ready', { request_id: 'HRQ-A', status: 'OPEN', blocking_class: 'BLOCKING', question: 'Choose authority' });
    scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'selftest-human-block');
    const step3 = { active: session.route.activeDistanceId, ready: session.distances['distance-ready'].status };
    reconcileSemanticDistanceSchedulerV677(session, { waiting: [], fulfilled_unconsumed: [{ promise_id: 'PRM-A', status: 'FULFILLED' }] }, { open: [], deferred: [], answered_unconsumed: [{ request_id: 'HRQ-A', status: 'ANSWERED', blocking_class: 'BLOCKING' }] }, 'selftest-human-answered');
    const step4 = { active: session.route.activeDistanceId, ready: session.distances['distance-ready'].status };
    root.status = 'sealed'; session.route.activeDistanceId = null;
    scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'selftest-sealed-root');
    const step5 = { active: session.route.activeDistanceId, ready: session.distances['distance-ready'].status };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-distance-scheduler-selftest/v1',
      ok: step1.active === 'distance-ready' && step1.root === 'waiting_on_promise' && step2.active === 'distance-ready' && step2.root === 'resumable' && step3.active === root.id && step3.ready === 'waiting_on_human' && step4.active === root.id && step4.ready === 'resumable' && step5.active === 'distance-ready' && step5.ready === 'active',
      steps: { step1, step2, step3, step4, step5 },
      events: session.route.scheduler.events.length,
    };
  }

  function semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(sessionInput) {
    const session = sessionInput && typeof sessionInput === 'object' ? sessionInput : {};
    const explicit = Number(session.transport?.acceptanceSequence);
    if (Number.isInteger(explicit) && explicit >= 0) return explicit;
    const controlSequence = Number(session.transport?.lastControl?.acceptanceSequence);
    if (Number.isInteger(controlSequence) && controlSequence >= 0) return controlSequence;
    // Legacy sessions predate a45. Seed the lightweight transport sequence from
    // the existing monotonic semantic head so the first a45 acceptance is still
    // monotonic without rewriting historical controls.
    return Math.max(0, Number(session.revision || 0));
  }

  function semanticPayloadDeclaresDurableEffectsV645(payloadInput) {
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : {};
    const routedSourceOps = splitSemanticSourceOps(payload.sourceOps);
    const routedSpecOps = splitSemanticSpecOps(payload.specOps);
    const directWorkingOps = Array.isArray(payload.workingOps) ? payload.workingOps : [];
    // Forensic repair 2: Source Workspace navigation has its own durable revision/
    // acceptance receipt. Moving a cursor, surfacing/reading evidence, or clearing
    // navigation cache is not a semantic-world mutation and must not advance the
    // SemanticSession head. Actual Working/spec mutations still do.
    return Boolean(
      routedSourceOps.workingOps.length ||
      routedSpecOps.specOps.length ||
      directWorkingOps.length
    );
  }

  function resolveSemanticTransportWaitTargetV6917(session, waitInput = {}) {
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    if (active) return active;
    const explicitId = String(waitInput.distanceId || waitInput.distance_id || '').trim();
    if (explicitId) {
      const explicit = session?.distances?.[explicitId] || null;
      if (!explicit) throw new Error(`WAIT_TRANSPORT_DISTANCE_NOT_FOUND: ${explicitId}`);
      if (explicit.status === 'sealed') throw new Error(`WAIT_TRANSPORT_DISTANCE_SEALED: ${explicitId}`);
      return explicit;
    }
    const values = Object.values(session?.distances || {});
    const selectable = values.filter(item => ['active', 'ready', 'resumable'].includes(String(item?.status || '')));
    const blocked = values.filter(item => ['waiting_on_human', 'waiting_on_promise'].includes(String(item?.status || '')));
    if (!selectable.length && blocked.length === 1) return blocked[0];
    return null;
  }

  function applySemanticState(sessionInput, payloadInput, markerMeta = {}) {
    const session = cloneSemanticValue(sessionInput);
    ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session);
    validateSemanticSession(session);
    const payload = cloneSemanticValue(payloadInput || {});
    const action = normalizeSemanticAction(payload.action);
    assertResortMissionImmutabilityGoverned(session, payload);
    if (action === 'MISSION_SEALED') assertResortMissionClosureEvidenceGoverned(session, payload);
    const previousRevisionV645 = Number(session.revision || 0);
    const revision = previousRevisionV645 + 1;
    const previousMeaningV645 = semanticMeaningProjectionV644(session);
    const previousAcceptanceSequenceV645 = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const nextAcceptanceSequenceV645 = markerMeta.id
      ? previousAcceptanceSequenceV645 + 1
      : previousAcceptanceSequenceV645;
    const timestamp = semanticIsoNow();

    if (payload.sessionId && payload.sessionId !== session.id) {
      throw new Error('VIBE_STATE sessionId mismatch');
    }
    if (
      Number.isInteger(Number(payload.baseRevision)) &&
      Number(payload.baseRevision) !== Number(session.revision)
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `VIBE_STATE baseRevision mismatch: expected ${session.revision}`
      );
    }

    if (markerMeta.automatic) {
      const expected = session.transport.pendingDispatch;
      if (!expected) {
        throw new Error('Unexpected automatic VIBE_STATE without pending dispatch');
      }
      if (!payload.dispatchId || payload.dispatchId !== expected.id) {
        throw new Error(
          `VIBE_STATE dispatchId mismatch: expected ${expected.id}`
        );
      }
      if (
        Number(payload.baseRevision) !== Number(expected.baseRevision)
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          `VIBE_STATE pending baseRevision mismatch: expected ${expected.baseRevision}`
        );
      }
    }

    // a09.14: a model/tool mistake is not a workflow blocker. A fresh recoverable
    // Project Data/Source Intelligence failure must flow back into another model repair turn; the model
    // cannot convert its own failed request into HOLD/WAIT_OPERATOR. Genuine external
    // prerequisites still use WAIT_OPERATOR when no fresh recoverable tool failure exists.
    assertRecoverableToolFailureDoesNotParkV6914(session, action);

    const transportOnlyOperatorWaitV6912 = action === 'WAIT_OPERATOR';
    if (!transportOnlyOperatorWaitV6912) {
    if (payload.direction) session.mission.direction = String(payload.direction);
    if (payload.reminder) session.mission.reminder = String(payload.reminder);
    if (payload.activity) {
      session.route.activity = normalizeSemanticActivity(payload.activity, session.route.activity);
    }
    if ('nextFocus' in payload || 'tacticalFocus' in payload) {
      const tacticalFocusV690 = String(payload.tacticalFocus ?? payload.nextFocus ?? '').trim();
      session.route.tacticalFocus = tacticalFocusV690;
      session.route.nextFocus = tacticalFocusV690;
    }
    if ('strategyReminder' in payload) {
      applyStrategicFrontierPatchV690(session, { strategyReminder: payload.strategyReminder }, revision, timestamp);
    }
    if (payload.strategicFrontier || payload.strategy) {
      applyStrategicFrontierPatchV690(session, payload.strategicFrontier || payload.strategy, revision, timestamp);
    }
    mergeSemanticCursor(session, payload);

    const notes = [
      ...(Array.isArray(payload.notes) ? payload.notes : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(payload.promises) ? payload.promises : []),
    ];
    for (const note of notes) addSemanticNote(session, note, revision);
    for (const decision of Array.isArray(payload.decisions) ? payload.decisions : []) {
      addSemanticDecision(session, decision, revision);
    }

    ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
    queueSemanticReadyDistancesV677(session, payload);
    applySemanticResumeDistancesV691(session, payload);

    const activeBefore = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    if (payload.activeDistance && action !== 'DEEPEN') {
      // a09.17 / FM-16: activeDistance is descriptive/activation intent, not
      // authority to erase a durable external blocker. Scheduler transitions out
      // of waiting_* only after Promise/Human/Transport authority says so. A model
      // that accidentally names a blocked Distance here must receive a repair turn
      // rather than silently reactivating it and causing semantic spin.
      const requestedDistanceIdV6916 = String(payload.activeDistance.id || '').trim();
      const existingDistanceV6916 = requestedDistanceIdV6916
        ? session.distances?.[requestedDistanceIdV6916] || null
        : null;
      const existingStatusV6916 = String(existingDistanceV6916?.status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const requestedStatusV6916 = String(payload.activeDistance.status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const protectedStatusesV6916 = new Set([
        'waiting_on_promise',
        'waiting_on_human',
        'waiting_on_transport',
        'sealed',
      ]);
      if (
        protectedStatusesV6916.has(existingStatusV6916) ||
        requestedStatusV6916.startsWith('waiting_on_') ||
        requestedStatusV6916 === 'sealed'
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'ACTIVE_DISTANCE_BLOCKER_REACTIVATION_FORBIDDEN: activeDistance cannot reactivate or manufacture a durable waiting/sealed Distance. ' +
          `distance=${requestedDistanceIdV6916 || '(new)'} existingStatus=${existingStatusV6916 || '(none)'} requestedStatus=${requestedStatusV6916 || '(unspecified)'}. ` +
          'Keep the blocker intact; seal/continue the current branch and let the Distance scheduler resume blocked work only after authoritative blocker resolution.'
        );
      }
      const distance = upsertSemanticDistance(
        session,
        payload.activeDistance,
        payload.activeDistance.parentId || activeBefore?.parentId || null
      );
      distance.status = 'active';
      session.route.activeDistanceId = distance.id;
    }
    }

    switch (action) {
      case 'WAIT_OPERATOR': {
        openOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(session, payload, markerMeta, timestamp);
        break;
      }

      case 'WAIT_TRANSPORT': {
        const waitInput = payload.transportWait || payload.transport_wait || {};
        const current = resolveSemanticTransportWaitTargetV6917(session, waitInput);
        if (!current) throw new Error('WAIT_TRANSPORT_REQUIRES_ACTIVE_OR_UNAMBIGUOUS_BLOCKED_DISTANCE');
        markSemanticDistanceTransportBlockedV6915(session, current.id, {
          ...waitInput,
          reason: waitInput.reason || payload.reason || payload.summary || 'Project Data relay unavailable',
          resumeContract: waitInput.resumeContract || waitInput.resume_contract || payload.resumeContract || payload.resume_contract || current.resumeContract || current.closureContract,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 'CONTINUE':
      case 'NOTE_ADDED': {
        // payload.summary is model-authored continuity text, not Distance authority.
        // Durable Distance.summary changes only through explicit Distance mutation /
        // RETURN / DISTANCE_SEALED, not every tactical continuation turn.
        break;
      }

      case 'DEEPEN': {
        const parent = semanticActiveDistance(session);
        if (parent) {
          parent.status = 'suspended';
          parent.suspendedAt = timestamp;
          parent.updatedAt = timestamp;
        }
        const distanceInput = payload.activeDistance || payload.distance || {
          objective: payload.objective,
          closureContract: payload.closureContract,
          reason: payload.reason,
          sourceTarget: payload.target,
        };
        const child = upsertSemanticDistance(
          session,
          distanceInput,
          parent?.id || null
        );
        child.status = 'active';
        linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, child, distanceInput.strategicFrontId || distanceInput.strategic_front_id || child.strategicFrontId);
        session.route.deepeningStack.push({
          distanceId: parent?.id || null,
          childDistanceId: child.id,
          returnPoint:
            payload.returnPoint || {
              sourceCursor: semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(session.sourceCursor),
              nextFocus: session.route.nextFocus,
              tacticalFocus: session.route.tacticalFocus || session.route.nextFocus || '',
              strategicFrontier: {
                posture: session.strategicFrontier?.posture || 'EXPLORE',
                activeTheory: semanticMemoryText(session.strategicFrontier?.activeTheory || '', 700),
              },
            },
          openedAt: timestamp,
        });
        session.route.returnPoint =
          session.route.deepeningStack.at(-1)?.returnPoint || null;
        session.route.activeDistanceId = child.id;
        break;
      }

      case 'RETURN': {
        const current = semanticActiveDistance(session);
        if (
          current &&
          payload.seal === true &&
          isOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(current) &&
          !session.route.deepeningStack.length &&
          !selectSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677(session)
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            'OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_RETURN_REQUIRES_SUCCESSOR: a root system continuity Distance cannot RETURN sealed into an open Mission with no successor. REDIRECT/create READY work, establish a durable blocker, WAIT_OPERATOR for a genuine external prerequisite, or MISSION_SEALED.'
          );
        }
        if (current) {
          current.status = payload.seal === true ? 'sealed' : 'suspended';
          current.summary = String(payload.summary || current.summary || '');
          current.updatedAt = timestamp;
          current.suspendedAt = current.status === 'suspended' ? timestamp : null;
          current.sealedAt = current.status === 'sealed' ? timestamp : null;
        }
        const frame = session.route.deepeningStack.pop() || null;
        const parent = frame?.distanceId
          ? session.distances[frame.distanceId] || null
          : null;
        if (parent) {
          parent.status = 'active';
          parent.updatedAt = timestamp;
          session.route.activeDistanceId = parent.id;
          restoreSemanticTacticalReturnV691(session, frame?.returnPoint || null);
          linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, parent, parent.strategicFrontId);
        }
        session.route.returnPoint =
          session.route.deepeningStack.at(-1)?.returnPoint || null;
        if (payload.promise) addSemanticNote(session, payload.promise, revision);
        break;
      }

      case 'REDIRECT': {
        const current = semanticActiveDistance(session);
        const redirectInput = payload.activeDistance || payload.nextDistance || null;
        const strategicFrontIdV691 = String(payload.strategicFrontId || payload.strategic_front_id || redirectInput?.strategicFrontId || redirectInput?.strategic_front_id || '').trim() || null;
        if (redirectInput) {
          if (current) {
            captureSemanticSchedulerReturnV677(session, current);
            if (payload.resumeContract != null || payload.resume_contract != null) {
              current.resumeContract = semanticMemoryText(payload.resumeContract ?? payload.resume_contract ?? '', 900);
              current.schedulerReturn.resumeContract = current.resumeContract;
            }
            current.status = 'suspended';
            current.suspendedAt = timestamp;
            current.updatedAt = timestamp;
          }
          const redirected = upsertSemanticDistance(
            session,
            { ...redirectInput, strategicFrontId: strategicFrontIdV691 || redirectInput.strategicFrontId || redirectInput.strategic_front_id || null },
            redirectInput.parentId ?? current?.parentId ?? null
          );
          redirected.status = 'active';
          linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, redirected, strategicFrontIdV691 || redirected.strategicFrontId);
          session.route.activeDistanceId = redirected.id;
          recordSemanticSchedulerEventV677(session, 'STRATEGIC_REDIRECT', {
            previousDistanceId: current?.id || null,
            distanceId: redirected.id,
            strategicFrontId: redirected.strategicFrontId || null,
            reason: String(payload.reason || 'model strategic redirect'),
          });
        } else if (current) {
          if (payload.objective) current.objective = String(payload.objective);
          if (payload.closureContract) {
            current.closureContract = String(payload.closureContract);
          }
          if (strategicFrontIdV691) linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, current, strategicFrontIdV691);
          current.reason = String(payload.reason || current.reason || '');
          current.updatedAt = timestamp;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'DISTANCE_SEALED': {
        const current = semanticActiveDistance(session);
        if (
          current &&
          isOpenMissionContinuityDistanceV704(current) &&
          !session.route.deepeningStack.length &&
          !payload.nextDistance &&
          !selectSemanticSchedulerCandidateV677(session)
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            'OPEN_MISSION_CONTINUITY_REQUIRES_SUCCESSOR: a system continuity Distance cannot be sealed while the Mission remains open without nextDistance/READY/RESUMABLE work. Use REDIRECT/nextDistance, establish a durable blocker, WAIT_OPERATOR for a genuine external prerequisite, or MISSION_SEALED if the Mission is actually complete.'
          );
        }
        if (current) {
          current.status = 'sealed';
          current.summary = String(payload.summary || current.summary || '');
          current.sealedAt = timestamp;
          current.updatedAt = timestamp;
        }
        const frame = session.route.deepeningStack.pop() || null;
        const parent = frame?.distanceId
          ? session.distances[frame.distanceId] || null
          : null;
        if (parent) {
          parent.status = 'active';
          parent.updatedAt = timestamp;
          session.route.activeDistanceId = parent.id;
          restoreSemanticTacticalReturnV691(session, frame?.returnPoint || null);
          linkDistanceToStrategicFrontV691(session, parent, parent.strategicFrontId);
        } else if (payload.nextDistance) {
          const next = upsertSemanticDistance(session, payload.nextDistance, null);
          next.status = 'active';
          session.route.activeDistanceId = next.id;
        } else {
          session.route.activeDistanceId = null;
          scheduleNextSemanticDistanceV677(session, 'distance-sealed');
        }
        session.route.returnPoint =
          session.route.deepeningStack.at(-1)?.returnPoint || session.route.returnPoint || null;
        break;
      }

      case 'HOLD':
        session.status = 'hold';
        session.hold = {
          reason: String(payload.reason || payload.summary || 'Semantic HOLD'),
          at: timestamp,
