          revision,
        };
        break;

      case 'MISSION_SEALED':
        session.status = 'sealed';
        session.completedAt = timestamp;
        break;
    }

    if (action !== 'WAIT_OPERATOR') {
      clearResolvedOperatorPrerequisiteAfterAcceptedControlV6912(session, {
        ...markerMeta,
        dispatchId: payload.dispatchId || markerMeta.dispatchId || null,
      });
    }

    const semanticMeaningChangedV645 =
      JSON.stringify(previousMeaningV645) !== JSON.stringify(semanticMeaningProjectionV644(session));
    const declaredDurableEffectsV645 = semanticPayloadDeclaresDurableEffectsV645(payload);
    const semanticChangedV645 = semanticMeaningChangedV645 || declaredDurableEffectsV645;
    const committedRevisionV645 = semanticChangedV645 ? revision : previousRevisionV645;

    // Source/workspace operations need one provisional engineering event so their
    // staged effects can attach transactionally. Pure transport/no-op controls do
    // not create worklog entries and do not advance the semantic head.
    if (semanticChangedV645) {
      session.worklog.push({
        id: semanticId('worklog'),
        revision: committedRevisionV645,
        at: timestamp,
        action,
        activity: session.route.activity,
        reasoningActivity: session.route.activity,
        artifactEffect: 'NONE',
        runtimeEffect: 'NONE',
        transportEffect: 'NONE',
        distanceId: session.route.activeDistanceId,
        summary: semanticMemoryText(payload.summary, 1600),
        sourceCursor: semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(session.sourceCursor),
      });
    }

    session.revision = committedRevisionV645;
    session.updatedAt = timestamp;
    session.transport.acceptanceSequence = nextAcceptanceSequenceV645;
    session.transport.lastControl = markerMeta.id
      ? {
          id: markerMeta.id,
          turnKey: markerMeta.turnKey || null,
          turnOrder: Number.isFinite(markerMeta.turnOrder)
            ? markerMeta.turnOrder
            : null,
          markerHash: markerMeta.markerHash || null,
          protocol: markerMeta.protocol || null,
          machineChars: Number.isFinite(Number(markerMeta.machineChars)) ? Number(markerMeta.machineChars) : null,
          acceptedAt: timestamp,
          revision: committedRevisionV645,
          baseRevision: Number.isFinite(Number(payload.baseRevision)) ? Number(payload.baseRevision) : previousRevisionV645,
          acceptanceSequence: nextAcceptanceSequenceV645,
          semanticChanged: semanticChangedV645,
          modelSummary: semanticMemoryText(payload.summary || '', 1600),
          reasoningActivity: session.route.activity || null,
          tacticalFocus: semanticMemoryText(session.route.tacticalFocus || session.route.nextFocus || '', 1200),
        }
      : session.transport.lastControl;
    session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    session.transport.reanchorBoundary = null;
    session.transport.pausedByUser = false;
    return session;
  }

  const SEMANTIC_SOURCE_NATIVE_WORKING_OPS = new Set([
    'APPLY_EDIT',
    'REPLACE_RANGE',
    'RESTORE_CHANGE_SPAN',
    'RESTORE_BASELINE_RANGE',
    'DELETE_BASELINE_RANGE',
    'REPLACE_EXACT',
    'DELETE_EXACT',
    'INSERT_BEFORE',
    'INSERT_AFTER',
  ]);
  const SEMANTIC_SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_OPS = new Set([
    'SEARCH',
    'QUERY',
    'PROBE',
    'READ_RANGE',
    // Backward-compatible alias: historical prompts advertised SURFACE_RANGE under sourceOps.
    // It is now interpreted as an exact bounded read instead of failing the model turn.
    'SURFACE_RANGE',
    'SURFACE_CANDIDATE',
    'CANCEL_QUERY',
  ]);
  const SEMANTIC_WORKSPACE_OPS_V703 = Object.freeze([
    'SET_CHUNK', 'PROPOSE_CHUNK', 'EXPAND_CHUNK', 'SHRINK_CHUNK',
    'COVER_ACTIVE', 'NEXT_CHUNK', 'SURFACE_RANGE', 'RESOLVE_SURFACE', 'CLEAR_SURFACES',
  ]);

  function semanticSourceOperationName(value) {
    return String(value?.op || value?.action || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase()
      .replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_');
  }

  function splitSemanticSourceOps(opsInput) {
    const workingOps = [];
    const intelligenceOps = [];
    const unknownOps = [];
    for (const raw of Array.isArray(opsInput) ? opsInput : []) {
      const op = semanticSourceOperationName(raw);
      if (SEMANTIC_SOURCE_NATIVE_WORKING_OPS.has(op)) {
        workingOps.push(cloneSemanticValue(raw));
      } else if (SEMANTIC_SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_OPS.has(op)) {
        intelligenceOps.push(cloneSemanticValue(raw));
      } else {
        unknownOps.push({ op: op || '(missing)', value: cloneSemanticValue(raw) });
      }
    }
    return { workingOps, intelligenceOps, unknownOps };
  }

  const SEMANTIC_SPEC_OPS = new Set(['DETERMINIZE_WORKING']);

  function splitSemanticSpecOps(opsInput) {
    const specOps = [];
    const unknownOps = [];
    for (const raw of Array.isArray(opsInput) ? opsInput : []) {
      const op = semanticSourceOperationName(raw);
      if (SEMANTIC_SPEC_OPS.has(op)) specOps.push(cloneSemanticValue(raw));
      else unknownOps.push({ op: op || '(missing)', value: cloneSemanticValue(raw) });
    }
    return { specOps, unknownOps };
  }

  function boundedSpecAssertions(value) {
    const rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (rows.length > SPEC_OPS_MAX_ASSERTIONS) {
      throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS: too many assertions (${rows.length} > ${SPEC_OPS_MAX_ASSERTIONS})`);
    }
    return rows.map((item, index) => {
      const text = String(item ?? '');
      if (!text) throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS: assertion ${index + 1} is empty`);
      if (text.length > SPEC_OPS_MAX_ASSERTION_CHARS) {
        throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS: assertion ${index + 1} exceeds ${SPEC_OPS_MAX_ASSERTION_CHARS} chars`);
      }
      return text;
    });
  }

  async function sourceDeterminizationAuthorityPreflight(specInput = {}, semanticSessionInput = null, options = {}) {
    const semanticSession = semanticSessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!semanticSession) throw new Error('SPEC_OPS_AUTHORITY: semantic session is unavailable');
    const mode = String(options.mode || specInput?.mode || 'DRY_RUN').trim().toUpperCase();
    const commitMode = mode === 'COMMIT';
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(semanticSession.id);
    }
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();

    const before = localSemanticSourceAuthority(semanticSession);
    let localPromotion = null;
    const localDescendant = await findStrongestLocalWorkingDescendant(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    if (localDescendant) {
      if (!commitMode) {
        throw new Error(
          'SPEC_OPS_AUTHORITY_STALE_PREVIEW: a stronger local Working descendant already exists; ' +
          `preview remains read-only at r${before.workingSequence || 0}/${before.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}, ` +
          `descendant r${localDescendant.revision.sequence}/${localDescendant.revision.id}`
        );
      }
      localPromotion = await promoteLocalWorkingDescendant(localDescendant, { syncSession: true });
    }

    let foreignPromotion = null;
    if (!localPromotion) {
      const foreignDescendant = await findStrongestForeignWorkingRevisionDescendant(
        semanticSession,
        workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace)
      );
      if (foreignDescendant) {
        if (!commitMode) {
          throw new Error(
            'SPEC_OPS_AUTHORITY_STALE_PREVIEW: a stronger foreign append-only Working descendant exists; ' +
            `preview remains read-only, descendant ${foreignDescendant.sourceDatabaseName} ` +
            `r${foreignDescendant.revision.sequence}/${foreignDescendant.revision.id}`
          );
        }
        foreignPromotion = await promoteForeignWorkingRevisionDescendant(foreignDescendant, { syncSession: true });
      }
    }

    let reconciliation = { recovered: false, previewReadOnly: !commitMode };
    if (commitMode) {
      try {
        reconciliation = await reconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority({
          automatic: false,
          reanchor: false,
          sourceOpsGuard: true,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS_AUTHORITY: reconciliation failed before determinization: ${error?.message || error}`);
      }
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(semanticSession.id);
      await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    }

    const currentSession = SemanticSessionStore.load() || semanticSession;
    const current = localSemanticSourceAuthority(currentSession);
    const targetSequence = Number(specInput?.targetSequence || 0);
    const equivalentHeadRevisionId = String(specInput?.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '').trim() || null;
    if (!Number.isInteger(targetSequence) || targetSequence <= Number(current.workingSequence || 0)) {
      throw new Error(
        'SPEC_OPS_TARGET_INVALID: deterministic target must be above the current physical Working head; ' +
        `current r${current.workingSequence || 0}, target r${targetSequence || 0}`
      );
    }

    const floor = resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(currentSession);
    let registry = await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
    registry = await reconcileEquivalentCrossChatRegistryHead(current, currentSession, registry);
    const futureAuthorities = [];
    const addFutureAuthority = (kind, sequenceInput, headRevisionIdInput) => {
      const sequence = Number(sequenceInput || 0);
      const headRevisionId = String(headRevisionIdInput || '').trim() || null;
      if (!Number.isInteger(sequence) || sequence <= Number(current.workingSequence || 0)) return;
      futureAuthorities.push({ kind, sequence, headRevisionId });
    };
    addFutureAuthority('authority-floor', floor?.workingSequence, floor?.headRevisionId);
    if (
      registry?.schema === CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA &&
      String(registry.sessionId || '') === String(currentSession.id) &&
      (!registry.baselineSha256 || !current.baselineSha256 ||
        String(registry.baselineSha256) === String(current.baselineSha256))
    ) {
      addFutureAuthority(
        'cross-chat-registry',
        registry.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(registry.workingRevision),
        registry.headRevisionId || null
      );
    }

    if (futureAuthorities.length) {
      const strongestSequence = Math.max(...futureAuthorities.map(item => item.sequence));
      const strongest = futureAuthorities.filter(item => item.sequence === strongestSequence);
      const knownHeads = [...new Set(strongest.map(item => item.headRevisionId).filter(Boolean))];
      if (knownHeads.length > 1) {
        throw new Error(
          'SOURCE_OP_AUTHORITY_FLOOR_FORK: determinization guards expose multiple future heads at ' +
          `r${strongestSequence}: ${knownHeads.join(', ')}`
        );
      }
      const knownHead = knownHeads[0] || null;
      if (targetSequence !== strongestSequence) {
        throw new Error(
          'SPEC_OPS_AUTHORITY_TARGET_MISMATCH: physical Working is below certified future authority; ' +
          `determinization must land exactly on r${strongestSequence}, requested r${targetSequence}`
        );
      }
      if (knownHead && equivalentHeadRevisionId !== knownHead) {
        throw new Error(
          'SPEC_OPS_EQUIVALENT_HEAD_REQUIRED: deterministic recovery of certified future authority requires ' +
          `equivalentToHeadRevisionId=${knownHead}, got ${equivalentHeadRevisionId || 'none'}`
        );
      }
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      mode,
      before,
      current,
      localPromotion,
      foreignPromotion,
      reconciliation,
      authorityFloor: floor,
      registry: registry ? {
        workingSequence: Number(registry.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(registry.workingRevision) || 0),
        headRevisionId: registry.headRevisionId || null,
      } : null,
      equivalentReplacementAllowed: Boolean(
        equivalentHeadRevisionId &&
        futureAuthorities.some(item =>
          item.sequence === targetSequence &&
          String(item.headRevisionId || '') === equivalentHeadRevisionId
        )
      ),
    };
  }

  async function stageDeterminizeWorkingSpec(specInput, semanticSession, options = {}) {
    const spec = cloneSemanticValue(specInput || {});
    const opName = semanticSourceOperationName(spec);
    if (opName !== 'DETERMINIZE_WORKING') throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS: unsupported operation ${opName || '(missing)'}`);
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(semanticSession.id);
    }
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const current = workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    const parent = spec.parent && typeof spec.parent === 'object' ? spec.parent : {};
    const requiredParentSequence = Number(parent.sequence ?? parent.workingSequence);
    const requiredParentHead = String(parent.headRevisionId || '');
    const requiredBaselineSha = String(spec.baselineSha256 || baseline.sha256 || '').toLowerCase();
    if (requiredBaselineSha && requiredBaselineSha !== String(baseline.sha256 || '').toLowerCase()) {
      throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS_BASELINE_MISMATCH: expected ${requiredBaselineSha}, got ${baseline.sha256 || 'none'}`);
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(requiredParentSequence) || requiredParentSequence < 0 || (requiredParentSequence > 0 && !requiredParentHead)) {
      throw new Error('SPEC_OPS_PARENT_REQUIRED: DETERMINIZE_WORKING requires parent.sequence >= 0 and parent.headRevisionId for non-root parents');
    }
    if (Number(current.workingSequence || 0) !== requiredParentSequence || String(current.headRevisionId || '') !== requiredParentHead) {
      throw new Error(
        'SPEC_OPS_PARENT_MISMATCH: refusing deterministic Working specification on a different Working parent; ' +
        `expected r${requiredParentSequence}/${requiredParentHead}, ` +
        `got r${current.workingSequence}/${current.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }
    const targetSequence = Number(spec.targetSequence || 0);
    if (!Number.isInteger(targetSequence) || targetSequence <= requiredParentSequence) {
      throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS_TARGET_INVALID: targetSequence must be an integer > r${requiredParentSequence}`);
    }
    const floor = resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(semanticSession);
    const floorSequence = Number(floor?.workingSequence || 0);
    if (floorSequence && targetSequence < floorSequence) {
      throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS_TARGET_BELOW_FLOOR: target r${targetSequence} is below causal floor r${floorSequence}`);
    }
    const routed = splitSemanticSourceOps(spec.sourceOps);
    if (routed.unknownOps.length || routed.intelligenceOps.length || !routed.workingOps.length) {
      throw new Error(
        'SPEC_OPS_SOURCE_OPS_INVALID: deterministic Working specification requires one or more source-native mutating sourceOps only; ' +
        `unknown=${routed.unknownOps.map(item => item.op).join(',') || 'none'}, intelligence=${routed.intelligenceOps.length}`
      );
    }
    const workingChange = spec.workingChange && typeof spec.workingChange === 'object'
      ? spec.workingChange
      : {};
    const stage = stageWorkingChangeSet({
      operations: routed.workingOps,
      workingChange,
      intent: workingChange.intent || 'spec-determinization',
      summary: workingChange.summary || `Determinize Working r${targetSequence}`,
      rationale: workingChange.rationale || 'Materialize a deterministic Working specification from an exact certified parent and canonical source specification.',
    }, {
      semanticSession,
      semanticRevision: semanticSession.revision,
      kind: 'spec-determinization',
    }, sourceRuntime.workspace);

    const specCanonical = {
      op: 'DETERMINIZE_WORKING',
      id: String(spec.id || ''),
      baselineSha256: baseline.sha256,
      parent: { sequence: requiredParentSequence, headRevisionId: requiredParentHead },
      targetSequence,
      equivalentToHeadRevisionId: spec.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || null,
      sourceOps: canonicalSourceOpsForJournal(routed.workingOps),
      assertions: cloneSemanticValue(spec.assertions || {}),
    };
    const specDigest = hashText(JSON.stringify(specCanonical));
    stage.revision.sequence = targetSequence;
    stage.revision.kind = 'spec-determinization';
    stage.revision.specOps = [specCanonical];
    stage.revision.specDigest = specDigest;
    stage.revision.recovery = {
      schema: SPEC_DETERMINIZATION_SCHEMA,
      specId: specCanonical.id || null,
      specDigest,
      fromSequence: requiredParentSequence,
      targetSequence,
      equivalentToHeadRevisionId: spec.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || null,
      sequenceJump: targetSequence - requiredParentSequence,
    };
    stage.workspace.working = {
      ...stage.workspace.working,
      sequence: targetSequence,
      headRevisionId: stage.revision.id,
      identity: `working:${baseline.sha256}:r${targetSequence}:${stage.revision.id}`,
      structureDirty: true,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };

    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync(stage.nextSpans).text;
    const workingSha256 = await sourceSha256(new TextEncoder().encode(materialized).buffer);
    const assertions = spec.assertions && typeof spec.assertions === 'object' ? spec.assertions : {};
    const mustContain = boundedSpecAssertions(assertions.mustContain || assertions.contains);
    const mustNotContain = boundedSpecAssertions(assertions.mustNotContain || assertions.absent);
    const missing = mustContain.filter(text => !materialized.includes(text));
    const forbiddenPresent = mustNotContain.filter(text => materialized.includes(text));
    const expectedWorkingSha256 = String(spec.expectedWorkingSha256 || assertions.workingSha256 || '').toLowerCase();
    if (missing.length || forbiddenPresent.length) {
      throw new Error(
        'SPEC_OPS_ASSERTION_FAILED: deterministic materialization violates assertions; ' +
        JSON.stringify({ missingCount: missing.length, forbiddenPresentCount: forbiddenPresent.length, missing, forbiddenPresent })
      );
    }
    if (expectedWorkingSha256 && expectedWorkingSha256 !== workingSha256) {
      throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS_SHA_MISMATCH: expected ${expectedWorkingSha256}, got ${workingSha256}`);
    }
    stage.revision.resultWorkingSha256 = workingSha256;
    stage.revision.specAssertions = {
      mustContainCount: mustContain.length,
      mustNotContainCount: mustNotContain.length,
      expectedWorkingSha256: expectedWorkingSha256 || null,
    };
    return {
      stage,
      preview: {
        schema: SPEC_OPS_RESULT_SCHEMA,
        op: 'DETERMINIZE_WORKING',
        specId: specCanonical.id || null,
        specDigest,
        mode: String(spec.mode || options.mode || 'DRY_RUN').toUpperCase(),
        parent: cloneSemanticValue(current),
        targetSequence,
        equivalentToHeadRevisionId: spec.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || null,
        operationCount: routed.workingOps.length,
        beforeActiveSpanCount: stage.beforeSpanIds.length,
        afterActiveSpanCount: stage.nextSpans.size,
        workingSha256,
        assertions: cloneSemanticValue(stage.revision.specAssertions),
      },
    };
  }

  async function applySemanticSpecOps(specOpsInput, semanticSession, options = {}) {
    const routed = splitSemanticSpecOps(specOpsInput);
    if (routed.unknownOps.length) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported specOps: ${routed.unknownOps.map(item => item.op).join(', ')}`);
    }
    if (routed.specOps.length !== 1) {
      throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS_ONE_SHOT: exactly one specOp is allowed per iteration, got ${routed.specOps.length}`);
    }
    const spec = routed.specOps[0];
    const mode = String(spec.mode || options.mode || 'DRY_RUN').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!['DRY_RUN', 'COMMIT'].includes(mode)) throw new Error(`SPEC_OPS_MODE_INVALID: ${mode}`);
    const authorityPreflight = await sourceDeterminizationAuthorityPreflight(spec, semanticSession, { mode });
    const staged = await stageDeterminizeWorkingSpec(spec, semanticSession, { mode });
    staged.authorityPreflight = authorityPreflight;
    if (mode === 'DRY_RUN') return { ...staged.preview, committed: false };
    if (options.sourceAcceptance) {
      staged.stage.workspace.lastSemanticAcceptance = cloneSemanticValue(options.sourceAcceptance);
    }
    const revision = await commitStagedWorkingChange(staged.stage, {
      workspace: staged.stage.workspace,
      syncSession: false,
      schedule: false,
    });
    const committedFloor = {
      sessionId: semanticSession.id,
      baselineId: sourceRuntime.baseline?.id || null,
      workingSequence: staged.preview.targetSequence,
      headRevisionId: revision.id,
      reason: `spec-determinization:${staged.preview.specId || staged.preview.specDigest}`,
    };
    if (staged.authorityPreflight?.equivalentReplacementAllowed && staged.preview.equivalentToHeadRevisionId) {
      replaceSourceAuthorityFloorWithEquivalentHead(
        committedFloor,
        staged.preview.equivalentToHeadRevisionId,
        { semanticSession }
      );
    } else {
      setSourceAuthorityFloor(committedFloor, { semanticSession });
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);
    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(SemanticSessionStore.load() || semanticSession).catch(() => null);
    return {
      ...staged.preview,
      committed: true,
      newHeadRevisionId: revision.id,
      workingIdentity: sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      authorityPreflight: {
        beforeWorkingSequence: Number(staged.authorityPreflight?.before?.workingSequence || 0),
        currentWorkingSequence: Number(staged.authorityPreflight?.current?.workingSequence || 0),
        localPromoted: Boolean(staged.authorityPreflight?.localPromotion?.promoted),
        foreignPromoted: Boolean(staged.authorityPreflight?.foreignPromotion?.promoted),
        equivalentReplacementAllowed: Boolean(staged.authorityPreflight?.equivalentReplacementAllowed),
      },
    };
  }

  function semanticSourceAcceptanceReceipt(sessionInput, payloadInput, markerMeta = {}, acceptedRevisionInput = null) {
    const markerId = String(markerMeta?.id || '').trim();
    if (!markerId) return null;
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : {};
    const baseRevision = Number(sessionInput?.revision || 0);
    const acceptedRevision = Number.isInteger(Number(acceptedRevisionInput))
      ? Number(acceptedRevisionInput)
      : baseRevision;
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-source-semantic-acceptance/v2',
      sessionId: String(sessionInput?.id || ''),
      markerId,
      markerHash: String(markerMeta?.markerHash || ''),
      baseRevision,
      acceptedRevision,
      dispatchId: String(payload?.dispatchId || ''),
      sourceOpsDigest: sourceOpsDigest(Array.isArray(payload?.sourceOps) ? payload.sourceOps : []),
      workingOpsDigest: sourceOpsDigest(Array.isArray(payload?.workingOps) ? payload.workingOps : []),
      specOpsDigest: hashText(JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(payload?.specOps) ? payload.specOps : [])),
      workspaceOpsDigest: hashText(JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(payload?.workspaceOps) ? payload.workspaceOps : [])),
      committedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  function semanticSourceAcceptanceMatches(workspace, receipt, sessionInput, acceptedRevisionInput = null) {
    const committed = workspace?.lastSemanticAcceptance || null;
    if (!committed || !receipt) return false;
    if (String(committed.schema || '') !== String(receipt.schema || '')) return false;
    if (String(committed.sessionId || '') !== String(receipt.sessionId || '')) return false;
    if (String(committed.markerId || '') !== String(receipt.markerId || '')) return false;
    if (String(committed.markerHash || '') !== String(receipt.markerHash || '')) return false;
    const baseRevision = Number(sessionInput?.revision || 0);
    const acceptedRevision = Number.isInteger(Number(acceptedRevisionInput))
      ? Number(acceptedRevisionInput)
      : baseRevision;
    if (Number(committed.baseRevision) !== baseRevision) return false;
    if (Number(committed.acceptedRevision) !== acceptedRevision) return false;
    if (String(committed.sourceOpsDigest || '') !== String(receipt.sourceOpsDigest || '')) return false;
    if (String(committed.workingOpsDigest || '') !== String(receipt.workingOpsDigest || '')) return false;
    if (String(committed.specOpsDigest || '') !== String(receipt.specOpsDigest || '')) return false;
    if (String(committed.workspaceOpsDigest || '') !== String(receipt.workspaceOpsDigest || '')) return false;
    return true;
  }

  function finalizeSemanticAcceptanceFromCommittedSource(stagedSession, workspace, baseline, payload) {
    projectSourceWorkspaceIntoSession(stagedSession, workspace, baseline);
    const worklogCandidateV703 = stagedSession.worklog.at(-1) || null;
    const worklog = worklogCandidateV703 && Number(worklogCandidateV703.revision) === Number(stagedSession.revision)
      ? worklogCandidateV703
      : null;
    if (worklog) {
      const routedSourceOps = splitSemanticSourceOps(payload?.sourceOps);
      if (routedSourceOps.workingOps.length) {
        worklog.artifactEffect = 'SOURCE_MUTATION';
        worklog.workingRevisionId = workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || null;
        worklog.workingIdentity = workspace?.working?.identity || null;
        worklog.sourceNativeOps = routedSourceOps.workingOps.map(semanticSourceOperationName);
      }
      if (Array.isArray(payload?.workspaceOps) && payload.workspaceOps.length) {
        if (worklog.artifactEffect === 'NONE') worklog.artifactEffect = 'SOURCE_NAVIGATION';
        worklog.workspaceOps = payload.workspaceOps.map(item => ({
          op: String(item?.op || item?.action || ''),
          ok: true,
        }));
      }
      if (Array.isArray(payload?.specOps) && payload.specOps.length) {
        const headRevision = workingRuntime.headRevision || null;
        worklog.specOps = {
          recoveredCommittedSourceAcceptance: true,
          specDigest: headRevision?.specDigest || null,
          targetSequence: Number(headRevision?.sequence || workspace?.working?.sequence || 0),
          newHeadRevisionId: workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || null,
          workingSha256: headRevision?.resultWorkingSha256 || null,
          committed: true,
        };
      }
      worklog.sourceCursor = semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(stagedSession.sourceCursor);
      worklog.recoveredCommittedSourceAcceptance = true;
    }
    compactSemanticLedger(stagedSession);
    return stagedSession;
  }


  function chooseSourceCursorAnchorCandidateV626(query) {
    const candidates = Array.isArray(query?.candidates) ? query.candidates : [];
    return candidates
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const score = item =>
          (item.relation === 'definitions' ? 100 : 0) +
          (item.confidence === 'strong' ? 30 : item.confidence === 'probable' ? 10 : 0) +
          (item.kind === 'definition' ? 20 : 0);
        return score(b) - score(a) || Number(a.start || 0) - Number(b.start || 0);
      })[0] || null;
  }

  async function resolveDeclarativeSourceCursorAnchorV626(payloadInput, sessionInput) {
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : null;
    const cursor = payload?.sourceCursor || payload?.cursor || null;
    const anchor = String(cursor?.anchor?.value ?? cursor?.anchor ?? '').trim();
    if (!payload || !cursor || !anchor) return { resolved: false, reason: 'no-anchor' };

    // An explicit physical cursor mutation wins. Anchor then remains advisory focus metadata.
    const alreadyPhysical =
      'activeRange' in cursor ||
      'nextOffset' in cursor ||
      Array.isArray(cursor.coveredRanges) ||
      Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges) ||
      Array.isArray(cursor.surfacedRanges);
    cursor.focusAnchor = anchor;
    if (alreadyPhysical) return { resolved: false, advisory: true, anchor };

    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(sessionInput.id);
    }
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      throw new Error(`SOURCE_CURSOR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED: Source Workspace unavailable for "${anchor}"`);
    }

    let query = [...intelligenceRuntime.queries.values()].find(item =>
      String(item?.anchor || '') === anchor &&
      String(item?.workingIdentity || '') === String(sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || '')
    ) || null;
    if (!query) {
      query = await SourceIntelligence.query({
        anchor,
        relations: ['definitions', 'consumers'],
      });
    }
    const candidate = chooseSourceCursorAnchorCandidateV626(query);
    if (!candidate) {
      throw new Error(
        `SOURCE_CURSOR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED: "${anchor}" produced no factual Source Intelligence candidate; ` +
        'anchor-only cursor mutation is not silently accepted'
      );
    }

    if (candidate.space === 'working') {
      const start = Number(candidate.workingStart ?? candidate.start);
      const end = Number(candidate.workingEnd ?? candidate.end);
      if (!Number.isFinite(start) || !Number.isFinite(end) || end <= start) {
        throw new Error(`SOURCE_CURSOR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED: "${anchor}" candidate has invalid Working coordinates`);
      }
      cursor.surfacedRanges = Array.isArray(cursor.surfacedRanges) ? cursor.surfacedRanges : [];
      cursor.surfacedRanges.push({
        id: `anchor-read:${hashText(`${query.id || 'query'}:${candidate.id || anchor}`)}`,
        space: 'working',
        start,
        end,
        workingStart: start,
        workingEnd: end,
        baselineStart: Number.isFinite(Number(candidate.baselineStart)) ? Number(candidate.baselineStart) : undefined,
        baselineEnd: Number.isFinite(Number(candidate.baselineEnd)) ? Number(candidate.baselineEnd) : undefined,
        label: `anchor:${anchor}`,
        reason: 'Explicit anchor resolution; Working-native address must not collapse to baseline ancestry.',
        lifecycle: 'ephemeral',
        explicitAddressed: true,
        workingIdentity: sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
        createdAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(sessionInput),
        createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
      cursor.anchorResolution = {
        queryId: query.id || null,
        candidateId: candidate.id || null,
        relation: candidate.relation || null,
        confidence: candidate.confidence || null,
        space: 'working',
        start,
        end,
      };
      return { resolved: true, anchor, space: 'working', start, end, queryId: query.id || null, candidateId: candidate.id || null };
    }

    const start = Number(candidate.start);
    const end = Number(candidate.end);
    if (!Number.isFinite(start) || !Number.isFinite(end) || end <= start) {
      throw new Error(`SOURCE_CURSOR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED: "${anchor}" candidate has invalid baseline coordinates`);
    }
    cursor.activeRange = {
      start,
      end,
      label: `anchor:${anchor}`,
      mode: sourceRegionAt(sourceRuntime.baseline.text, start, sourceRuntime.workspace.segmentMap).mode,
    };
    cursor.anchorResolution = {
      queryId: query.id || null,
      candidateId: candidate.id || null,
      relation: candidate.relation || null,
      confidence: candidate.confidence || null,
      space: 'baseline',
      start,
      end,
    };
    return { resolved: true, anchor, space: 'baseline', start, end, queryId: query.id || null, candidateId: candidate.id || null };
  }

  async function sourceCursorAcceptanceV638(options = {}) {
    const { session, workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const original = {
      sessionRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      workspaceRevision: Number(workspace.revision || 0),
      workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(workspace.cursor?.nextOffset || 0),
      coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor?.coveredRanges || []),
      relatedRanges: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor?.relatedRanges || []),
    };

    const stagedWorkspace = cloneSemanticValue(workspace);
    const stagedSession = cloneSemanticValue(session);
    const length = baseline.text.length;
    const seedStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(
      Number(options.seedStart ?? workspace.cursor?.activeRange?.start ?? workspace.cursor?.nextOffset ?? 0),
      Math.max(0, length - 1)
    ));
    const seedChars = Math.max(64, Math.min(Number(options.seedChars || 1024), 8192));
    const seedEnd = Math.min(length, Math.max(seedStart + 1, seedStart + seedChars));

    const staged = stageWorkspaceOperations(stagedWorkspace, [
      { op: 'SET_CHUNK', start: seedStart, end: seedEnd, label: 'v638 acceptance seed' },
      { op: 'COVER_ACTIVE', advance: false, label: 'v638 acceptance cover' },
      { op: 'PROPOSE_CHUNK', offset: seedEnd },
      { op: 'NEXT_CHUNK', label: 'v638 acceptance next' },
    ], baseline, stagedSession);

    const results = Array.isArray(staged.results) ? staged.results : [];
    const setEntry = results[0] || null;
    const coverEntry = results[1] || null;
    const proposeEntry = results[2] || null;
    const nextEntry = results[3] || null;
    const setResult = setEntry?.result ?? setEntry?.value ?? null;
    const coverResult = coverEntry?.result ?? coverEntry?.value ?? null;
    const proposeResult = proposeEntry?.result ?? proposeEntry?.value ?? null;
    const nextResult = nextEntry?.result ?? nextEntry?.value ?? null;
    const stagedCursor = staged.workspace?.cursor || stagedWorkspace.cursor || {};
    const cursorOps = {
      ok: Boolean(
        staged.changed === true &&
        setEntry?.ok !== false && setResult && Number(setResult.start) === seedStart && Number(setResult.end) === seedEnd &&
        coverEntry?.ok !== false && coverResult?.coveredRange && Number(coverResult.coveredRange.start) === seedStart && Number(coverResult.coveredRange.end) === seedEnd &&
        proposeEntry?.ok !== false && proposeResult && Number(proposeResult.start) >= seedEnd && Number(proposeResult.end) > Number(proposeResult.start) &&
        nextEntry?.ok !== false && nextResult?.coveredRange && Number(nextResult.coveredRange.start) === Number(proposeResult.start) &&
        Number(nextResult.coveredRange.end) === Number(proposeResult.end)
      ),
      seed: { start: seedStart, end: seedEnd },
      results: cloneSemanticValue(results),
      finalCursor: cloneSemanticValue(stagedCursor),
    };

    const liveAfterStaging = {
      sessionRevision: Number(SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.revision || 0),
      workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision || 0),
      workingIdentity: sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.nextOffset || 0),
      coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.coveredRanges || []),
      relatedRanges: cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.relatedRanges || []),
    };
    const sourceAuthorityUnchanged = JSON.stringify(original) === JSON.stringify(liveAfterStaging);

    const anchors = {
      exercised: options.anchorChecks === true,
      known: null,
      unknown: null,
    };

    if (options.anchorChecks === true) {
      const knownAnchor = String(options.knownAnchor || 'ensureConflictBackendDetailsRuntimeV686');
      const unknownAnchor = String(options.unknownAnchor || '__VIBE_V638_UNKNOWN_ANCHOR_7d6f2a__');
      const knownPayload = { sourceCursor: { anchor: knownAnchor } };
      try {
        const resolution = await resolveDeclarativeSourceCursorAnchorV626(knownPayload, session);
        anchors.known = {
          ok: resolution?.resolved === true && Boolean(knownPayload.sourceCursor?.activeRange),
          anchor: knownAnchor,
          resolution: cloneSemanticValue(resolution),
          activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(knownPayload.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
          anchorResolution: cloneSemanticValue(knownPayload.sourceCursor?.anchorResolution || null),
        };
      } catch (error) {
        anchors.known = {
          ok: false,
          anchor: knownAnchor,
          error: error?.message || String(error),
        };
      }

      const unknownPayload = { sourceCursor: { anchor: unknownAnchor } };
      try {
        const resolution = await resolveDeclarativeSourceCursorAnchorV626(unknownPayload, session);
        anchors.unknown = {
          ok: false,
          anchor: unknownAnchor,
          unexpectedResolution: cloneSemanticValue(resolution),
          activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(unknownPayload.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
        };
      } catch (error) {
        const message = error?.message || String(error);
        anchors.unknown = {
          ok: message.includes('SOURCE_CURSOR_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED'),
          anchor: unknownAnchor,
          error: message,
        };
      }
    }

    const liveAfterAnchors = {
      sessionRevision: Number(SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.revision || 0),
      workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision || 0),
      workingIdentity: sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.nextOffset || 0),
      coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.coveredRanges || []),
      relatedRanges: cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.relatedRanges || []),
    };
    const sourceAuthorityStillUnchanged = JSON.stringify(original) === JSON.stringify(liveAfterAnchors);

    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-source-cursor-acceptance/v1',
      ok: cursorOps.ok && sourceAuthorityUnchanged && sourceAuthorityStillUnchanged &&
        (options.anchorChecks !== true || (anchors.known?.ok === true && anchors.unknown?.ok === true)),
      nonMutating: sourceAuthorityUnchanged && sourceAuthorityStillUnchanged,
      cursorOps,
      anchors,
      original,
      liveAfter: liveAfterAnchors,
    };
  }

  async function sourceIntelligenceTransportAcceptanceV640(options = {}) {
    const { session, workspace } = requireSourceRuntime();
    const original = {
      sessionRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      workspaceRevision: Number(workspace.revision || 0),
      workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(workspace.cursor?.nextOffset || 0),
      coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor?.coveredRanges || []),
      relatedRanges: cloneSemanticValue(workspace.cursor?.relatedRanges || []),
    };

    const anchor = String(options.anchor || 'ensureConflictBackendDetailsRuntimeV686');
    const dispatchId = `v640-source-intel-acceptance:${semanticId('dispatch')}`;
    const queryOp = {
      op: 'QUERY',
      anchor,
      kind: String(options.kind || 'identifier'),
      relations: Array.isArray(options.relations) && options.relations.length
        ? options.relations.map(String)

    const thinText = [

      `[[VG_PATCH d=${dispatchId} r=${Number(session.revision || 0)}]]`,
      JSON.stringify({ sourceOps: [queryOp] }),
      '[[/VG_PATCH]]',
    ].join('\n');

    const parsed = extractThinSemanticTurnPayloadV627(thinText);
    const routed = parsed?.payload ? splitSemanticSourceOps(parsed.payload.sourceOps || []) : {
      intelligenceOps: [],
      workingOps: [],
      unknownOps: [],
    };
    const rawResults = parsed && !parsed.error && !parsed.incomplete && !routed.unknownOps.length
      ? await SourceIntelligence.applyOps(routed.intelligenceOps)
      : [];
    const summarized = rawResults.map(summarizeSemanticSourceIntelligenceResult);
    const stagedSession = cloneSemanticValue(session);
    stagedSession.transport = stagedSession.transport || {};
    stagedSession.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-local-evidence-batch/v1',

      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(stagedSession),
      recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requested: routed.intelligenceOps.length,
      succeeded: summarized.filter(item => item.ok !== false).length,
      failed: summarized.filter(item => item.ok === false).length,
      queryCount: summarized.filter(item => ['SEARCH', 'QUERY', 'PROBE'].includes(String(item.op || '').toUpperCase())).length,
      surfacedCount: summarized.filter(item => String(item.op || '').toUpperCase() === 'SURFACE_CANDIDATE' && item.ok !== false).length,
      results: cloneSemanticValue(summarized),
    };
    const dispatchContext = buildSourceIntelligenceDispatchContext(stagedSession, { thinNormal: true });
    const first = summarized[0] || null;
    const resultId = String(first?.resultId || '');
    const contextHasFreshEvidence = dispatchContext.includes('SOURCE INTELLIGENCE · FRESH EVIDENCE');
    const contextHasQuery = Boolean(resultId) && dispatchContext.includes(resultId);
    const contextHasCandidate = /Candidates:\s*[1-9]/.test(dispatchContext);

    const liveAfter = {
      sessionRevision: Number(SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.revision || 0),
      workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision || 0),
      workingIdentity: sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,

      relatedRanges: cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.relatedRanges || []),
    };
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(original) === JSON.stringify(liveAfter);
    const ok = Boolean(

      parsed.dispatchId === dispatchId &&
      routed.intelligenceOps.length === 1 && routed.unknownOps.length === 0 &&

  function mergedRangeCoverageCharsV626(rangesInput, limit) {
    const ranges = (Array.isArray(rangesInput) ? rangesInput : [])
      .map(item => ({
        start: Math.max(0, Number(item?.start || 0)),
        end: Math.min(Number(limit || Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), Number(item?.end || 0)),
      }))
      .filter(item => Number.isFinite(item.start) && Number.isFinite(item.end) && item.end > item.start)
      .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.end - b.end);
    if (!ranges.length) return 0;
    let total = 0;
    let start = ranges[0].start;
    let end = ranges[0].end;
    for (const range of ranges.slice(1)) {
      if (range.start <= end) end = Math.max(end, range.end);
      else {
        total += end - start;
        start = range.start;
        end = range.end;
      }
    }
    return total + (end - start);
  }

  function sourceCursorDiagnosticsV626(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const workspace = sourceRuntime.workspace || null;
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline || null;
    const cursor = workspace?.cursor || null;
    if (!session || !workspace || !baseline || !cursor) {
      return { ready: false, warning: false, reason: 'source-workspace-detached' };
    }
    const active = cursor.activeRange || null;
    const currentKey = `${active?.start ?? 'none'}:${active?.end ?? 'none'}:${cursor.nextOffset ?? 'none'}`;
    let stagnantTurns = 0;
    for (const item of [...(session.worklog || [])].reverse()) {
      const c = item?.sourceCursor || null;
      const key = `${c?.activeRange?.start ?? 'none'}:${c?.activeRange?.end ?? 'none'}:${c?.nextOffset ?? 'none'}`;
      if (key !== currentKey) break;
      stagnantTurns += Math.max(1, Number(item?.repeatCount || 1));
    }
    const surfaces = Array.isArray(cursor.surfacedRanges) ? cursor.surfacedRanges : [];
    const activeSurfaces = surfaces.filter(item => item?.status !== 'resolved').length;
    const resolvedSurfaces = surfaces.length - activeSurfaces;
    const coveredChars = mergedRangeCoverageCharsV626(cursor.coveredRanges, baseline.text.length);
    const coveredThroughV629 = sourceCoveredThrough(cursor.coveredRanges);
    const activeAgeMs = active?.proposedAt ? Math.max(0, Date.now() - Date.parse(active.proposedAt)) : null;
    const warning =
      stagnantTurns >= Number(CONFIG.operatorCursorStagnationWarnTurns || 12) ||
      activeSurfaces >= Number(CONFIG.operatorSurfaceGrowthWarnCount || 512);
    return {
      ready: true,
      warning,
      baselineChars: baseline.text.length,
      activeRange: active ? cloneSemanticValue(active) : null,
      nextOffset: Number(cursor.nextOffset || 0),
      coveredThrough: Number(coveredThroughV629 || 0),
      coveredChars,
      coveredPercent: baseline.text.length ? (coveredChars / baseline.text.length) * 100 : 0,
      contiguousPercent: baseline.text.length ? (Number(coveredThroughV629 || 0) / baseline.text.length) * 100 : 0,
      surfacedTotal: surfaces.length,
      activeSurfaces,
      resolvedSurfaces,
      stagnantTurns,
      activeAgeMs,
      workspaceRevision: Number(workspace.revision || 0),
      workingRevision: workspace.working?.identity || null,
    };
  }

  async function applySemanticStateWithWorking(sessionInput, payloadInput, markerMeta = {}) {
    const payload = cloneSemanticValue(payloadInput || {});
    const cursorAnchorResolutionV626 = await resolveDeclarativeSourceCursorAnchorV626(payload, sessionInput);
    const stagedSession = applySemanticState(sessionInput, payload, markerMeta);
    if (cursorAnchorResolutionV626?.resolved) {
      const worklogCandidateV626 = stagedSession.worklog?.at?.(-1) || null;
      if (worklogCandidateV626) worklogCandidateV626.sourceCursorAnchorResolution = cloneSemanticValue(cursorAnchorResolutionV626);
    }
    const routedSourceOps = splitSemanticSourceOps(payload.sourceOps);
    if (routedSourceOps.unknownOps.length) {
      throw new Error(
        `Unsupported sourceOps: ${routedSourceOps.unknownOps.map(item => item.op).join(', ')}`
      );
    }
    const routedSpecOps = splitSemanticSpecOps(payload.specOps);
    if (routedSpecOps.unknownOps.length) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported specOps: ${routedSpecOps.unknownOps.map(item => item.op).join(', ')}`);
    }
    const directWorkingOps = Array.isArray(payload.workingOps) ? payload.workingOps : [];
    const allWorkingOps = [...directWorkingOps, ...routedSourceOps.workingOps];
    const hasWorkingOps = allWorkingOps.length > 0;
    const hasSpecOps = routedSpecOps.specOps.length > 0;
    const hasWorkspaceOps = Array.isArray(payload.workspaceOps) && payload.workspaceOps.length;
    const hasDeclarativeWorkspaceCursor =
      !hasWorkspaceOps && semanticCursorRequestsWorkspaceProjection(payload.sourceCursor || payload.cursor);

    if (hasSpecOps && (hasWorkingOps || hasWorkspaceOps || hasDeclarativeWorkspaceCursor)) {
      throw new Error('SPEC_OPS_ONE_SHOT: specOps iteration cannot mix with workingOps/sourceOps/workspaceOps/sourceCursor mutations');
    }
    if (!hasWorkingOps && !hasSpecOps && !hasWorkspaceOps && !hasDeclarativeWorkspaceCursor) {
      compactSemanticLedger(stagedSession);
      return stagedSession;
    }
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(sessionInput.id);
      if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
        throw new Error('VIBE_STATE source operations/cursor projection require a restorable Source Workspace');
      }
    }

    const sourceAcceptance = semanticSourceAcceptanceReceipt(
      sessionInput,
      payload,
      markerMeta,
      stagedSession.revision
    );
    if (semanticSourceAcceptanceMatches(
      sourceRuntime.workspace,
      sourceAcceptance,
      sessionInput,
      stagedSession.revision
    )) {
      return finalizeSemanticAcceptanceFromCommittedSource(
        stagedSession,
        cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace),
        sourceRuntime.baseline,
        payload
      );
    }

    let sourceOpsPreflight = null;
    if (hasWorkingOps) {
      sourceOpsPreflight = await sourceMutationAuthorityPreflight({ semanticSession: stagedSession });
    } else {
      await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    }
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline;
    let finalWorkspace = cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    let workingStage = null;
    let workspaceResults = [];
    let specOpsResult = null;

    if (hasSpecOps) {
      specOpsResult = await applySemanticSpecOps(routedSpecOps.specOps, stagedSession, { sourceAcceptance });
      finalWorkspace = cloneSemanticValue(sourceRuntime.workspace);
      projectSourceWorkspaceIntoSession(stagedSession, finalWorkspace, baseline);
      const worklog = stagedSession.worklog.at(-1);
      if (worklog) {
        worklog.specOps = cloneSemanticValue(specOpsResult);
        worklog.sourceCursor = semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(stagedSession.sourceCursor);
      }
      clearSpecOpsIterationRequest(stagedSession);
      await flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);
      compactSemanticLedger(stagedSession);
      return stagedSession;
    }

    // One accepted semantic result (VG_RESULT + optional VG_PATCH, or legacy VIBE_STATE fallback) is one transactional source-addressing envelope. Workspace/cursor
    // projection establishes the address space for sourceOps in that same state;
    // source edits must therefore resolve against the projected active/surfaced ranges,
    // not the stale pre-state cursor. The projected workspace is still committed only
    // once, together with the resulting Working head.
    let targetWorkspace = finalWorkspace;
    if (hasWorkspaceOps) {
      const stagedWorkspace = stageWorkspaceOperations(
        finalWorkspace,
        payload.workspaceOps,
        baseline,
        stagedSession
      );
      targetWorkspace = stagedWorkspace.workspace;
      workspaceResults = stagedWorkspace.results;
    } else if (hasDeclarativeWorkspaceCursor) {
      const stagedCursor = stageDeclarativeWorkspaceCursor(
        finalWorkspace,
        payload.sourceCursor || payload.cursor,
        baseline,
        stagedSession
      );
      targetWorkspace = stagedCursor.workspace;
      workspaceResults = [{
        op: 'PROJECT_STATE_CURSOR',
        ok: true,
        result: stagedCursor.result,
      }];
    }

    finalWorkspace = targetWorkspace;
    if (hasWorkingOps) {
      workingStage = stageWorkingChangeSet({
        operations: allWorkingOps,
        workingChange: payload.workingChange || {},
        intent: payload.workingChange?.intent,
        summary: payload.workingChange?.summary,
        rationale: payload.workingChange?.rationale,
      }, {
        semanticSession: stagedSession,
        semanticRevision: stagedSession.revision,
        targetWorkspace,
      }, targetWorkspace);
      finalWorkspace = workingStage.workspace;
    }

    if (sourceAcceptance) {
      finalWorkspace.lastSemanticAcceptance = cloneSemanticValue(sourceAcceptance);
      if (workingStage?.workspace) {
        workingStage.workspace.lastSemanticAcceptance = cloneSemanticValue(sourceAcceptance);
      }
    }

    if (workingStage) {
      await commitStagedWorkingChange(workingStage, {
        workspace: finalWorkspace,
        syncSession: false,
        schedule: false,
      });
    } else {
      finalWorkspace.revision = Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision || 0) + 1;
      finalWorkspace.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      await sourceDbPut('workspaces', finalWorkspace);
      sourceRuntime.workspace = finalWorkspace;
      renderPanel();
    }

    projectSourceWorkspaceIntoSession(stagedSession, finalWorkspace, baseline);
    const worklogCandidateV703 = stagedSession.worklog.at(-1) || null;
    const worklog = worklogCandidateV703 && Number(worklogCandidateV703.revision) === Number(stagedSession.revision)
      ? worklogCandidateV703
      : null;
    if (worklog) {
      if (workingStage) {
        worklog.artifactEffect = 'SOURCE_MUTATION';
        worklog.workingRevisionId = workingStage.revision.id;
        worklog.workingIdentity = finalWorkspace.working.identity;
        if (routedSourceOps.workingOps.length) {
          worklog.sourceNativeOps = routedSourceOps.workingOps.map(semanticSourceOperationName);
        }
        if (sourceOpsPreflight) {
          worklog.sourceAuthorityPreflight = {
            beforeWorkingSequence: Number(sourceOpsPreflight.before?.workingSequence || 0),
            currentWorkingSequence: Number(sourceOpsPreflight.current?.workingSequence || 0),
            localPromoted: Boolean(sourceOpsPreflight.localPromotion?.promoted),
            reconciled: Boolean(sourceOpsPreflight.reconciliation?.recovered),
          };
        }
      }
      if (workspaceResults.length) {
        if (worklog.artifactEffect === 'NONE') worklog.artifactEffect = 'SOURCE_NAVIGATION';
        worklog.workspaceOps = workspaceResults.map(item => ({ op: String(item?.op || ''), ok: item?.ok !== false }));
      }
      worklog.sourceCursor = semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(stagedSession.sourceCursor);
    }
    if (workspaceResults.length && stagedSession.transport?.lastControl) {
      stagedSession.transport.lastControl.artifactEffect = workingStage ? 'SOURCE_MUTATION' : 'SOURCE_NAVIGATION';
      stagedSession.transport.lastControl.sourceWorkspaceRevision = Number(finalWorkspace.revision || 0);
      stagedSession.transport.lastControl.sourceCursor = semanticCursorHistorySnapshot(stagedSession.sourceCursor);
      stagedSession.transport.lastControl.workspaceOps = workspaceResults.map(item => ({
        op: String(item?.op || ''),
        ok: item?.ok !== false,
      }));
    }
    compactSemanticLedger(stagedSession);
    return stagedSession;
  }

  function formatSemanticDistanceStack(session) {
    const activeId = session.route.activeDistanceId;
    const ids = [
      ...session.route.deepeningStack
        .map(frame => frame.distanceId)
        .filter(Boolean),
      activeId,
    ].filter((id, index, values) => id && values.indexOf(id) === index);
    if (!ids.length) return '(no active Distance)';
    return ids.map((id, index) => {
      const distance = session.distances[id];
      return distance
        ? `${'  '.repeat(index)}- ${distance.id} [${distance.status}] ${distance.objective}`
        : `${'  '.repeat(index)}- ${id} [missing]`;
    }).join('\n');
  }

  function compactSemanticSourceCursorForDispatch(cursorInput, options = {}) {
    const cursor = cursorInput && typeof cursorInput === 'object' ? cursorInput : {};
    const fullHistory = options.fullHistory === true;
    const related = Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges)
      ? cursor.relatedRanges
      : Array.isArray(cursor.surfacedRanges)
        ? cursor.surfacedRanges
        : [];
    const covered = Array.isArray(cursor.coveredRanges) ? cursor.coveredRanges : [];
    const recentRelated = fullHistory ? related.slice(-8).map(item => ({
      id: item?.id || null,
      space: item?.space === 'working' ? 'working' : 'baseline',
      start: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.start)) ? Number(item.start) : null,
      end: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.end)) ? Number(item.end) : null,
      workingStart: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.workingStart)) ? Number(item.workingStart) : null,
      workingEnd: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.workingEnd)) ? Number(item.workingEnd) : null,
      baselineStart: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.baselineStart)) ? Number(item.baselineStart) : null,
      baselineEnd: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.baselineEnd)) ? Number(item.baselineEnd) : null,
      label: item?.label || '',
      distanceId: item?.distanceId || null,
      status: item?.status || null,
    })) : [];
    const baseline = cursor.baseline && typeof cursor.baseline === 'object'
      ? (fullHistory
          ? cursor.baseline
          : { id: cursor.baseline.id || cursor.baselineId || null, name: cursor.baseline.name || null, sha256: cursor.baseline.sha256 || null })
      : cursor.baseline || null;
    return {
      historyMode: fullHistory ? 'full' : 'delta',
      workspaceId: cursor.workspaceId || null,
      baselineId: cursor.baselineId || null,
      baseline,
      nextOffset: Number.isFinite(Number(cursor.nextOffset)) ? Number(cursor.nextOffset) : null,
      activeRange: cursor.activeRange || null,
      coveredThrough: cursor.coveredThrough ?? null,
      coveredRanges: fullHistory ? covered.slice(-16) : [],
      coveredRangesSummary: {
        total: covered.length,
        authority: fullHistory
          ? 'Recent covered range history included for recovery/bootstrap.'
          : 'Covered range history remains persisted; normal delta transport carries current position/counts only.',
      },
      workingRevision: cursor.workingRevision || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number.isFinite(Number(cursor.workspaceRevision)) ? Number(cursor.workspaceRevision) : null,
      relatedRangesSummary: {
        total: related.length,
        recent: recentRelated,
        authority: fullHistory
          ? 'Recent related/surfaced range metadata included for recovery/bootstrap; full history remains persisted in Source Workspace/IndexedDB.'
          : 'Related/surfaced range history remains persisted; fresh source evidence is carried by ACTIVE SOURCE CONTEXT delta and concrete Working ranges can be read exactly with sourceOps READ_RANGE (legacy sourceOps SURFACE_RANGE remains an alias).',
      },
    };
  }

  function semanticClipText(value, maxChars = 900) {
    const text = String(value || '');
    const max = Math.max(120, Number(maxChars || 900));
    if (text.length <= max) return text;
    return `${text.slice(0, max - 48)} … [clipped ${text.length - max + 48} chars]`;
  }

  function semanticDispatchSize(text) {
    const value = String(text || '');
    return {
      chars: value.length,
      bytes: typeof TextEncoder === 'function'
        ? new TextEncoder().encode(value).byteLength
        : value.length,
      approxTokens: Math.ceil(value.length / 4),
    };
  }

  // a42 Dynamic Cognitive Dispatch planner core.
  // Pure classification only in this cut: no dispatch payload composition is changed yet.
  const DISPATCH_INTENTS_V642 = Object.freeze([
    'CONTINUATION',
    'QUESTION',
    'INVESTIGATION',
    'CHANGE',
    'VALIDATION',
    'ARCHITECTURE',
    'RECOVERY',
    'REPAIR',
    'BOOTSTRAP',
  ]);

  const DISPATCH_PROFILES_V642 = Object.freeze({
    CONTINUATION: Object.freeze({ profile: 'continuation/minimal', softChars: 8000, evidenceSlots: 2 }),
    QUESTION: Object.freeze({ profile: 'question/focused', softChars: 9000, evidenceSlots: 2 }),
    INVESTIGATION: Object.freeze({ profile: 'investigation/multi-evidence', softChars: 16000, evidenceSlots: 4 }),
    CHANGE: Object.freeze({ profile: 'change/targeted', softChars: 12000, evidenceSlots: 3 }),
    VALIDATION: Object.freeze({ profile: 'validation/claim-evidence', softChars: 10000, evidenceSlots: 3 }),
    ARCHITECTURE: Object.freeze({ profile: 'architecture/wide-context', softChars: 24000, evidenceSlots: 6 }),
    RECOVERY: Object.freeze({ profile: 'recovery/full-authority', softChars: 52000, evidenceSlots: 8 }),
    REPAIR: Object.freeze({ profile: 'repair/minimal-causal', softChars: 7000, evidenceSlots: 2 }),
    BOOTSTRAP: Object.freeze({ profile: 'bootstrap/full-authority', softChars: 52000, evidenceSlots: 8 }),
  });

  function normalizeDispatchIntentV642(value) {
    const intent = String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    return DISPATCH_INTENTS_V642.includes(intent) ? intent : null;
  }

  function unresolvedEvidenceCountV642(session) {
    const ranges = Array.isArray(session?.sourceCursor?.relatedRanges)
      ? session.sourceCursor.relatedRanges
      : Array.isArray(session?.sourceCursor?.surfacedRanges)
        ? session.sourceCursor.surfacedRanges
        : [];
    return ranges.filter(item => item && item.status !== 'resolved').length;
  }

  function latestWorklogV642(session) {
    const items = Array.isArray(session?.worklog) ? session.worklog : [];
    return items.length ? items[items.length - 1] : null;
  }

  function planSemanticDispatchV642(sessionInput, options = {}) {
    const session = cloneSemanticValue(sessionInput);
    validateSemanticSession(session);

    const explicitOverride = normalizeDispatchIntentV642(
      options.intentOverride ?? session.transport?.dispatchIntentOverrideV642
    );
    const reasons = [];
    const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const reanchor = session.transport?.reanchorBoundary || null;
    const focus = String(session.route?.nextFocus || '').trim();
    const activity = normalizeSemanticActivity(session.route?.activity || 'RECON');
    const unresolvedEvidence = unresolvedEvidenceCountV642(session);
    const latest = latestWorklogV642(session);
    const fullRecoverySignal = Boolean(
      reanchor?.forceFullProtocolRefeed === true ||
      session.transport?.forceFullProtocolRefeed === true
    );
    const bootstrapSignal = !session.transport?.lastControl;
    const repairSignal = Boolean(
      session.transport?.repairRequestV642 ||
      Number(pending?.repairAttempts || 0) > 0 ||
      /^repair(?:-|$)/i.test(String(pending?.status || '')) ||
      /repair/i.test(String(session.transport?.repairMode || ''))
    );
    const questionSignal = Boolean(
      session.transport?.pendingFactualQuestionV642 ||
      /\?\s*$/.test(focus) ||
      /^(?:question|q:|вопрос\b)/i.test(focus)
    );
    const architectureSignal = Boolean(
      session.transport?.architectureRequestV642 ||
      /\b(?:architecture|architectural|redesign|cutover|responsibilit(?:y|ies)|ownership redesign|архитектур|перестро(?:й|ить)|границ[аы] ответственности)\b/i.test(focus)
    );
    const validationSignal = Boolean(
      session.transport?.validationRequirementV642 ||
      activity === 'VALIDATION'
    );
    const changeSignal = Boolean(
      activity === 'CHANGE' ||
      session.transport?.mutationReadyV642 === true ||
      (latest && Array.isArray(latest.workingOps) && latest.workingOps.some(item => item?.ok !== false))
    );
    const investigationSignal = Boolean(
      session.transport?.investigationRequestV642 ||
      ((activity === 'ANALYSIS' || activity === 'RECON') && unresolvedEvidence > 0)
    );

    let intent = null;
    if (explicitOverride) {
      intent = explicitOverride;
      reasons.push('explicit debug/testing override');
    } else if (fullRecoverySignal) {
      intent = 'RECOVERY';
      reasons.push('full-protocol recovery/reanchor signal');
    } else if (bootstrapSignal) {
      intent = 'BOOTSTRAP';
      reasons.push('no accepted control boundary');
    } else if (repairSignal) {
      intent = 'REPAIR';
      reasons.push('pending dispatch repair state');
    } else if (questionSignal) {
      intent = 'QUESTION';
      reasons.push('explicit factual question signal');
    } else if (architectureSignal) {
      intent = 'ARCHITECTURE';
      reasons.push('architecture/ownership redesign focus');
    } else if (validationSignal) {
      intent = 'VALIDATION';
      reasons.push('explicit validation requirement/activity');
    } else if (changeSignal) {
      intent = 'CHANGE';
      reasons.push('change/mutation-ready engineering state');
    } else if (investigationSignal) {
      intent = 'INVESTIGATION';
      reasons.push('analysis/recon with unresolved factual evidence');
    } else {
      intent = 'CONTINUATION';
      reasons.push('no stronger cognitive intent signal');
    }

    const profile = DISPATCH_PROFILES_V642[intent];
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-dispatch-plan/v1',
      intent,
      profile: profile.profile,
      budget: {
        softChars: profile.softChars,
        evidenceSlots: profile.evidenceSlots,
      },
      reasons,
      signals: {
        activity,
        unresolvedEvidence,
        hasLastControl: Boolean(session.transport?.lastControl),
        fullRecoverySignal,
        repairSignal,
        questionSignal,
        architectureSignal,
        validationSignal,
        changeSignal,
        investigationSignal,
      },
    };
  }

  function dispatchPlannerAcceptanceV642() {
    const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!live) throw new Error('Semantic session is not initialized');
    const before = {
      revision: live.revision,
      workspaceRevision: live.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision ?? null,
      workingIdentity: live.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      pendingDispatchId: live.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
    };

    function baseClone() {
      const s = cloneSemanticValue(live);
      s.transport ||= {};
      s.transport.lastControl ||= {
        id: 'v642-acceptance-control',
        revision: s.revision,
        turnKey: 'v642-acceptance-turn',
        turnOrder: 1,
        acceptedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      s.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
      if (s.transport.reanchorBoundary) s.transport.reanchorBoundary.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
      s.transport.dispatchIntentOverrideV642 = null;
      s.transport.repairRequestV642 = false;
      s.transport.pendingFactualQuestionV642 = null;
      s.transport.architectureRequestV642 = false;
      s.transport.validationRequirementV642 = false;
      s.transport.mutationReadyV642 = false;
      s.transport.investigationRequestV642 = false;
      if (s.transport.pendingDispatch) {
        s.transport.pendingDispatch.repairAttempts = 0;
        if (/^repair/i.test(String(s.transport.pendingDispatch.status || ''))) s.transport.pendingDispatch.status = 'ready';
      }
      s.route.nextFocus = '';
      s.route.activity = 'RECON';
      s.sourceCursor.relatedRanges = [];
      return s;
    }

    const cases = [
      ['CONTINUATION', s => {}],
      ['QUESTION', s => { s.route.nextFocus = 'Which authority owns this result?'; }],
      ['INVESTIGATION', s => {
        s.route.activity = 'ANALYSIS';
        s.sourceCursor.relatedRanges = [{ id: 'v642-evidence', status: 'active', start: 10, end: 20 }];
      }],
      ['CHANGE', s => { s.route.activity = 'CHANGE'; }],
      ['VALIDATION', s => { s.transport.validationRequirementV642 = true; }],
      ['ARCHITECTURE', s => { s.transport.architectureRequestV642 = true; }],
      ['RECOVERY', s => { s.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = true; }],
      ['REPAIR', s => {
        s.transport.pendingDispatch ||= { id: 'v642-repair', status: 'repair-ready', repairAttempts: 1 };
        s.transport.pendingDispatch.status = 'repair-ready';
        s.transport.pendingDispatch.repairAttempts = 1;
      }],
      ['BOOTSTRAP', s => { s.transport.lastControl = null; }],
    ];

    const results = cases.map(([expected, mutate]) => {
      const s = baseClone();
      mutate(s);
      const plan = planSemanticDispatchV642(s);
      return {
        expected,
        ok: plan.intent === expected,
        actual: plan.intent,
        profile: plan.profile,
        budget: plan.budget,
        reasons: plan.reasons,
        signals: plan.signals,
      };
    });

    const overrideSession = baseClone();
    overrideSession.route.activity = 'CHANGE';
    const override = planSemanticDispatchV642(overrideSession, { intentOverride: 'QUESTION' });
    const afterLive = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const after = {
      revision: afterLive?.revision ?? null,
      workspaceRevision: afterLive?.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision ?? null,
      workingIdentity: afterLive?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      pendingDispatchId: afterLive?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
    };
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(after);
    const overrideOk = override.intent === 'QUESTION' && override.reasons.includes('explicit debug/testing override');
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-dispatch-planner-acceptance/v1',
      ok: authorityNonMutating && overrideOk && results.every(item => item.ok),
      authorityNonMutating,
      override: { ok: overrideOk, actual: override.intent, reasons: override.reasons },
      cases: results,
      before,
      after,
      integration: {
        selectorCoreImplemented: true,
        payloadCompositionChanged: false,
        note: 'a42 classifies intent and profiles only; buildSemanticDispatch payload selection remains unchanged until the next cut.',
      },
    };
  }

  const DispatchPlannerV642 = Object.freeze({
    intents: DISPATCH_INTENTS_V642,
    profiles: DISPATCH_PROFILES_V642,
    plan: planSemanticDispatchV642,
    acceptance: dispatchPlannerAcceptanceV642,
  });

  const ADAPTIVE_ENVELOPE_PROFILES_V643 = Object.freeze({
    CONTINUATION: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'continuation/thin', ledgerItems: 1, focusChars: 900, sourceEvidenceRatio: 0.62, guidance: 'Continue from factual current authority, but treat tactical focus as advisory. Prefer the smallest evidence set only when the current route remains the highest-leverage move; otherwise change abstraction level, branch, batch, or author tooling.' }),
    QUESTION: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'question/focused', ledgerItems: 1, focusChars: 1200, sourceEvidenceRatio: 0.60, guidance: 'Answer the concrete factual question. Request local evidence only for facts that are not already established.' }),
    INVESTIGATION: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'investigation/multi-evidence', ledgerItems: 2, focusChars: 1500, sourceEvidenceRatio: 0.74, guidance: 'Investigate the active uncertainty using independent factual evidence; batch independent QUERY/PROBE requests in one VG_PATCH.' }),
    CHANGE: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'change/targeted', ledgerItems: 2, focusChars: 1500, sourceEvidenceRatio: 0.68, guidance: 'Make the smallest source-native mutation that resolves the proven defect; preserve authority/CAS fences and validate detached-result admission.' }),
    VALIDATION: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'validation/claim-evidence', ledgerItems: 2, focusChars: 1300, sourceEvidenceRatio: 0.66, guidance: 'Validate only the stated claim with evidence capable of changing the decision; do not reopen unrelated surfaces.' }),
    ARCHITECTURE: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'architecture/wide-context', ledgerItems: 3, focusChars: 1800, sourceEvidenceRatio: 0.78, guidance: 'Reason across ownership and boundary responsibilities; prefer canonical authority and scalable hot-path architecture over historical layering.' }),
    REPAIR: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'repair/minimal-causal', ledgerItems: 1, focusChars: 800, sourceEvidenceRatio: 0.55, guidance: 'Repair only the causal protocol/tool failure. Do not advance unrelated engineering work or mutate product source unless the repair itself requires it.' }),
    RECOVERY: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'bootstrap-recovery/full', ledgerItems: 4, focusChars: 1800, sourceEvidenceRatio: 1.0, guidance: 'Restore full durable authority before continuing engineering work.' }),
    BOOTSTRAP: Object.freeze({ envelope: 'bootstrap-recovery/full', ledgerItems: 4, focusChars: 1800, sourceEvidenceRatio: 1.0, guidance: 'Establish full durable authority before normal delta continuation.' }),
  });

  function adaptiveDispatchEnvelopeV643(planInput, fullProtocolRefeed) {
    const plan = planInput || { intent: 'CONTINUATION', budget: DISPATCH_PROFILES_V642.CONTINUATION };
    const base = ADAPTIVE_ENVELOPE_PROFILES_V643[plan.intent] || ADAPTIVE_ENVELOPE_PROFILES_V643.CONTINUATION;
    if (fullProtocolRefeed) {
      return {
        schema: 'vibe-go-adaptive-dispatch-envelope/v1',
        intent: plan.intent,
        envelope: 'bootstrap-recovery/full',
        fullProtocolRefeed: true,
        evidenceSlots: Math.max(1, Number(plan?.budget?.evidenceSlots || 8)),
        sourceEvidenceChars: Math.max(16000, Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalSourceEvidenceCharsV630 || 16000)),
        softChars: Math.max(Number(plan?.budget?.softChars || 52000), 52000),
        ledgerItems: 4,
        focusChars: 1800,
        guidance: base.guidance,
      };
    }
    const softChars = Math.max(5000, Number(plan?.budget?.softChars || 8000));
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-adaptive-dispatch-envelope/v1',
      intent: plan.intent,
      envelope: base.envelope,
      fullProtocolRefeed: false,
      evidenceSlots: Math.max(1, Number(plan?.budget?.evidenceSlots || 2)),
      sourceEvidenceChars: Math.max(2400, Math.min(Number(CONFIG.semanticNormalSourceEvidenceCharsV630 || 16000), Math.floor(softChars * base.sourceEvidenceRatio))),
      softChars,
      ledgerItems: Math.max(0, Number(base.ledgerItems || 0)),
      focusChars: Math.max(600, Number(base.focusChars || 1200)),
      guidance: base.guidance,
    };
  }

  const STAGE_H_LIVE_SCHEMA_V653 = 'vibe-go-stage-h-live-integration/v1';

  function stageHLiveStateV653(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const stage = sessionInput?.transport?.stageHLiveV653 || null;
    return stage?.schema === STAGE_H_LIVE_SCHEMA_V653 ? stage : null;
  }

  function stageHLivePhaseV653(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const stage = stageHLiveStateV653(session);
    if (!session || !stage) return null;
    if (stage.status === 'complete') return 'complete';
    if (stage.status === 'failed') return 'failed';
    const revision = Number(session.revision || 0);
    const sequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const startRevision = Number(stage.startRevision || 0);
    const startSequence = Number(stage.startAcceptanceSequence || 0);
    if (revision === startRevision && sequence === startSequence) return 'query';
    if (revision === startRevision && sequence === startSequence + 1) return 'echo';
    if (revision === startRevision && sequence === startSequence + 2) return 'meaningful';
    if (revision === startRevision + 1 && sequence === startSequence + 3) return 'complete';
    return 'drift';
  }

  const STAGE_I_LIVE_SCHEMA_V655 = 'vibe-go-stage-i-cross-chat-recovery/v1';
  // v656: Stage-I role selection must be project/origin-wide, not local-chat scoped.
  // The generic `latest` registry ranks normal Source authority and can legitimately move
  // while an acceptance handoff is in flight.  Stage I therefore owns a dedicated lease
  // naming the exact source Runtime+Source pair and semantic fingerprint being tested.
  const STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_SCHEMA_V656 = 'vibe-go-stage-i-acceptance-lease/v1';
  const STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_KEY_V656 = 'stage-i-v655-active';

  function stageIAcceptanceRankTupleV656(stageInput = null) {
    const stage = stageInput || {};
    const authority = stage.sourceAuthority || {};
    return [
      Number(authority.semanticRevision ?? stage.startRevision ?? 0),
      Number(authority.acceptanceSequence ?? stage.startAcceptanceSequence ?? 0),
      Number(authority.workingSequence || 0),
      Number(authority.workspaceRevision || 0),
      Date.parse(stage.armedAt || '') || 0,
    ];
  }

  function compareStageIAcceptanceSourcesV656(aInput, bInput) {
    const a = stageIAcceptanceRankTupleV656(aInput?.stage || aInput);
    const b = stageIAcceptanceRankTupleV656(bInput?.stage || bInput);
    for (let index = 0; index < Math.max(a.length, b.length); index += 1) {
      const delta = Number(b[index] || 0) - Number(a[index] || 0);
      if (delta) return delta;
    }
    return String(aInput?.runtimeDatabaseName || '').localeCompare(String(bInput?.runtimeDatabaseName || ''));
  }

  function stageIAcceptanceLeaseFromSourceV656(stageInput, runtimeDatabaseName, sourceDatabaseName) {
    const stage = stageInput || null;
    if (!stage || stage.schema !== STAGE_I_LIVE_SCHEMA_V655 || !stage.runId) return null;
    const authority = stage.sourceAuthority || {};
    return {
      schema: STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_SCHEMA_V656,
      key: STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_KEY_V656,
      status: 'ready',
      runId: String(stage.runId),
      sessionId: String(authority.sessionId || ''),
      sourcePathname: String(stage.sourcePathname || ''),
      sourceRuntimeDatabaseName: String(runtimeDatabaseName || stage.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName || ''),
      sourceSourceDatabaseName: String(sourceDatabaseName || stage.sourceSourceDatabaseName || ''),
      semanticRevision: Number(authority.semanticRevision ?? stage.startRevision ?? 0),
      acceptanceSequence: Number(authority.acceptanceSequence ?? stage.startAcceptanceSequence ?? 0),
      workingIdentity: authority.workingIdentity || null,
      workingSequence: Number(authority.workingSequence || 0),
      headRevisionId: authority.headRevisionId || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number(authority.workspaceRevision || 0),
      baselineId: authority.baselineId || null,
      armedAt: stage.armedAt || null,
      publishedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  function stageIAcceptanceLeaseMatchesStageV656(leaseInput, stageInput) {
    const lease = leaseInput || null;
    const stage = stageInput || null;
    const authority = stage?.sourceAuthority || {};
    return Boolean(
      lease?.schema === STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_SCHEMA_V656 &&
      stage?.schema === STAGE_I_LIVE_SCHEMA_V655 &&
      String(lease.runId || '') === String(stage.runId || '') &&
      String(lease.sessionId || '') === String(authority.sessionId || '') &&
      Number(lease.semanticRevision) === Number(authority.semanticRevision ?? stage.startRevision ?? 0) &&
      Number(lease.acceptanceSequence) === Number(authority.acceptanceSequence ?? stage.startAcceptanceSequence ?? 0) &&
      String(lease.workingIdentity || '') === String(authority.workingIdentity || '') &&
      Number(lease.workingSequence) === Number(authority.workingSequence || 0) &&
      String(lease.headRevisionId || '') === String(authority.headRevisionId || '') &&
      Number(lease.workspaceRevision) === Number(authority.workspaceRevision || 0) &&
      String(lease.sourcePathname || '') === String(stage.sourcePathname || '')
    );
  }

  async function getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656() {
    const lease = await crossChatRegistryGet(STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_KEY_V656).catch(() => null);
    return lease?.schema === STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_SCHEMA_V656 ? cloneSemanticValue(lease) : null;
  }

  async function putStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656(valueInput) {
    if (!valueInput) return null;
    const value = {
      ...cloneSemanticValue(valueInput),
      schema: STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_SCHEMA_V656,
      key: STAGE_I_ACCEPTANCE_LEASE_KEY_V656,
      updatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    return crossChatRegistryPut(value);
  }

  async function discoverStageIArmedSourcesV656() {
    const here = String(location.pathname || '');
    const rows = [];
    const localSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const localStage = stageILiveStateV655(localSession);
    if (localStage?.status === 'armed-source') {
      rows.push({
        stage: cloneSemanticValue(localStage),
        runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
        pathname: here,
        local: true,
        candidate: null,
      });
    }

    const databaseNames = await listCrossChatDatabaseNames();
    const sourceNames = new Set(databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeSourceDatabaseNameV616(name)));
    for (const runtimeName of databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeRuntimeDatabaseNameV616(name))) {
      if (runtimeName === RUNTIME_DB_NAME) continue;
      const sourceName = pairedSourceDatabaseNamesV616(runtimeName).find(name => sourceNames.has(name)) || null;
      let candidate = null;
      try {
        candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(runtimeName, sourceName, { quiet: true, loadSource: false });
      } catch {
        candidate = null;
      }
      const foreignStage = candidate?.session?.transport?.stageICrossChatV655 || null;
      if (
