        foreignStage?.schema !== STAGE_I_LIVE_SCHEMA_V655 ||
        foreignStage.status !== 'armed-source' ||
        !foreignStage.runId ||
        !foreignStage.sourcePathname
      ) continue;
      rows.push({
        stage: cloneSemanticValue(foreignStage),
        runtimeDatabaseName: runtimeName,
        sourceDatabaseName: sourceName || candidate?.sourceDatabaseName || foreignStage.sourceSourceDatabaseName || null,
        pathname: String(foreignStage.sourcePathname || ''),
        local: false,
        candidate,
      });
    }
    rows.sort(compareStageIAcceptanceSourcesV656);
    return rows;
  }

  async function hydrateStageIAcceptanceSourceV656(rowInput) {
    const row = rowInput || null;
    if (!row || row.local) return row;
    const candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(
      row.runtimeDatabaseName,
      row.sourceDatabaseName,
      { quiet: true, sessionId: row.stage?.sourceAuthority?.sessionId || null, loadSource: true }
    );
    if (!candidate?.sourceAttached) throw new Error('V656_STAGE_I_SOURCE_WITHOUT_PAIRED_SOURCE_DB');
    const stage = candidate.session?.transport?.stageICrossChatV655 || null;
    if (!stageIAcceptanceLeaseMatchesStageV656(
      stageIAcceptanceLeaseFromSourceV656(stage, row.runtimeDatabaseName, row.sourceDatabaseName),
      row.stage
    )) {
      throw new Error('V656_STAGE_I_SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_DISCOVERY');
    }
    return { ...row, stage: cloneSemanticValue(stage), candidate };
  }

  async function resolveStageIAcceptanceRoleV656() {
    const here = String(location.pathname || '');
    let lease = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656();

    if (lease && ['ready', 'imported'].includes(String(lease.status || ''))) {
      if (String(lease.sourcePathname || '') === here) {
        return { role: 'source', lease, migratedLease: false, source: null };
      }
      try {
        const candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(
          lease.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName,
          lease.sourceSourceDatabaseName,
          { quiet: true, sessionId: lease.sessionId || null, loadSource: true }
        );
        const foreignStage = candidate?.session?.transport?.stageICrossChatV655 || null;
        if (candidate?.sourceAttached && stageIAcceptanceLeaseMatchesStageV656(lease, foreignStage)) {
          return {
            role: 'destination',
            lease,
            migratedLease: false,
            source: {
              stage: cloneSemanticValue(foreignStage),
              runtimeDatabaseName: lease.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName,
              sourceDatabaseName: lease.sourceSourceDatabaseName,
              pathname: lease.sourcePathname,
              local: false,
              candidate,
            },
          };
        }
      } catch {
        // Fall through to migration discovery. A stale/broken lease must not silently arm a new source.
      }
    }

    // Migration path for pre-a56 Stage-I arms: search every origin-visible Runtime DB,
    // rank by semantic acceptance authority (not generic Source `latest` ordering), and
    // publish one exact lease before any destination clone occurs.
    const sources = await discoverStageIArmedSourcesV656();
    const best = sources[0] || null;
    if (!best) return { role: 'none', lease: null, migratedLease: false, source: null };
    const hydrated = await hydrateStageIAcceptanceSourceV656(best);
    lease = stageIAcceptanceLeaseFromSourceV656(
      hydrated.stage,
      hydrated.runtimeDatabaseName,
      hydrated.sourceDatabaseName
    );
    await putStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656(lease);
    return {
      role: String(lease.sourcePathname || '') === here ? 'source' : 'destination',
      lease,
      migratedLease: true,
      source: hydrated,
    };
  }

  async function markStageIAcceptanceLeaseImportedV656(stageInput = null) {
    const stage = stageInput || stageILiveStateV655(SemanticSessionStore.load());
    const lease = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656();
    if (!stage || !stageIAcceptanceLeaseMatchesStageV656(lease, stage)) return false;
    await putStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656({
      ...lease,
      status: 'imported',
      destinationPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
      destinationRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      destinationSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
      importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
    return true;
  }

  async function markStageIAcceptanceLeaseConsumedV656(stageInput = null) {
    const stage = stageInput || stageILiveStateV655(SemanticSessionStore.load());
    const lease = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656();
    if (!stage || !stageIAcceptanceLeaseMatchesStageV656(lease, stage)) return false;
    await putStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656({
      ...lease,
      status: 'consumed',
      consumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      consumedPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
    });
    return true;
  }

  function stageIRecoveryOriginMatchesV657(autoInput, stageInput) {
    const auto = autoInput || null;
    const stage = stageInput || null;
    if (!auto || !stage) return false;
    return Boolean(
      ['pending-reanchor', 'ready'].includes(String(auto.status || '')) &&
      String(auto.sessionId || '') === String(stage.sourceAuthority?.sessionId || '') &&
      String(auto.fromRuntimeDatabase || '') === String(stage.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName || '') &&
      String(auto.fromSourceDatabase || '') === String(stage.sourceSourceDatabaseName || '') &&
      String(auto.fromPathname || '') === String(stage.sourcePathname || '')
    );
  }

  function stageIDestinationAuthorityStillCompatibleV657(sessionInput, stageInput) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const stage = stageInput || null;
    if (!session || !stage) return false;
    const current = stageIAuthoritySnapshotV655(session);
    const source = stage.sourceAuthority || {};
    return Boolean(
      Number(current.semanticRevision) === Number(source.semanticRevision) &&
      String(current.sessionId || '') === String(source.sessionId || '') &&
      String(current.workingIdentity || '') === String(source.workingIdentity || '') &&
      Number(current.workingSequence) === Number(source.workingSequence) &&
      String(current.headRevisionId || '') === String(source.headRevisionId || '') &&
      Number(current.workspaceRevision) === Number(source.workspaceRevision) &&
      String(current.baselineId || '') === String(source.baselineId || '') &&
      Number(current.nextOffset) === Number(source.nextOffset) &&
      Number(current.coveredThrough) === Number(source.coveredThrough)
    );
  }

  function stageILiveStateV655(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const stage = sessionInput?.transport?.stageICrossChatV655 || null;
    return stage?.schema === STAGE_I_LIVE_SCHEMA_V655 ? stage : null;
  }

  function stageILivePhaseV655(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
    if (!session || !stage) return null;
    if (stage.status === 'complete') return 'complete';
    if (stage.status === 'failed') return 'failed';
    const currentPath = String(location.pathname || '');
    const sourcePath = String(stage.sourcePathname || '');
    if (currentPath === sourcePath) return 'source-armed';
    const revision = Number(session.revision || 0);
    const sequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const startRevision = Number(stage.startRevision || 0);
    const startSequence = Number(stage.startAcceptanceSequence || 0);
    if (revision === startRevision && sequence === startSequence) return 'recovery';
    if (revision === startRevision && sequence === startSequence + 1) return 'normal';
    if (revision === startRevision && sequence === startSequence + 2) return 'complete';
    return 'drift';
  }

  function stageILiveInstructionLinesV655(session, dispatchId) {
    const stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
    const phase = stageILivePhaseV655(session);
    if (!stage || !['recovery', 'normal'].includes(phase)) return [];
    const revision = Number(session.revision || 0);
    const runId = String(stage.runId || 'unknown');
    const base = [
      '',
      `STAGE I CROSS-CHAT RECOVERY ACCEPTANCE · ${runId} · ${phase.toUpperCase()}`,
      'Это acceptance traffic, НЕ продолжение замороженного monolith repair. Source/semantic mutation запрещена.',
    ];
    if (phase === 'recovery') {
      return [
        ...base,
        'PHASE 1/2: этот dispatch должен быть первым model-facing envelope после восстановления foreign Runtime+Source authority в новом чате.',
        'Он обязан быть bootstrap/recovery full-refeed ровно один раз. Верни только {"action":"CONTINUE"}; без summary/nextFocus/notes/decisions/VG_PATCH.',
        `Causal marker использует d=${dispatchId} r=${revision}.`,
      ];
    }
    return [
      ...base,
      'PHASE 2/2: recovery envelope уже принят. Этот dispatch должен быть обычным adaptive thin envelope, без повторного full-state refeed.',
      'Верни только {"action":"CONTINUE"}; без summary/nextFocus/notes/decisions/VG_PATCH.',
      `Causal marker использует d=${dispatchId} r=${revision}.`,
    ];
  }

  function recordStageILiveDispatchObservationV655(session, built) {
    const stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
    const phase = stageILivePhaseV655(session);
    if (!stage || !['recovery', 'normal'].includes(phase) || !built?.id) return false;
    stage.dispatchObservations = Array.isArray(stage.dispatchObservations) ? stage.dispatchObservations : [];
    if (stage.dispatchObservations.some(item => String(item?.dispatchId || '') === String(built.id))) return false;
    const metrics = built.transportMetrics || {};
    stage.dispatchObservations.push({
      phase,
      dispatchId: built.id,
      baseRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequenceBefore: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      builtAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      envelope: metrics.adaptiveEnvelopeV643 || metrics.dispatchEnvelopeV630 || null,
      fullProtocolRefeed: metrics.fullProtocolRefeed === true,
      chars: Number(built.size?.chars || 0),
      lifecycle: 'built-candidate',
    });
    stage.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
    return true;
  }

  function recordStageISubmissionWitnessV655(dispatch, witness, turn = null) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
    if (!session || !stage || !dispatch?.id) return false;
    const phase = stageILivePhaseV655(session);
    if (!['recovery', 'normal'].includes(phase)) return false;
    stage.submissionWitnesses = Array.isArray(stage.submissionWitnesses) ? stage.submissionWitnesses : [];
    const dispatchId = String(dispatch.id || '');
    const observation = (stage.dispatchObservations || []).find(item => String(item?.dispatchId || '') === dispatchId) || null;
    const row = {
      dispatchId,
      phase: observation?.phase || phase,
      baseRevision: Number(dispatch.baseRevision ?? observation?.baseRevision ?? session.revision ?? 0),
      acceptanceSequenceBefore: Number(observation?.acceptanceSequenceBefore ?? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session)),
      witness: String(witness || 'unknown'),
      witnessedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      mountedTurnKey: turn?.key || null,
      mountedTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(turn?.order) ? turn.order : null,
    };
    const existing = stage.submissionWitnesses.find(item => String(item?.dispatchId || '') === dispatchId);
    if (existing) Object.assign(existing, row);
    else stage.submissionWitnesses.push(row);
    if (observation) {
      observation.lifecycle = 'physically-submitted';
      observation.submissionWitness = row.witness;
      observation.submittedAt = row.witnessedAt;
    }
    stage.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    return true;
  }

  function stageIAuthoritySnapshotV655(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const source = SourceWorkspace.status();
    const working = WorkingSource.status();
    return {
      semanticRevision: Number(session?.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence: session ? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session) : null,
      sessionId: session?.id || null,
      workingIdentity: session?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || working?.identity || null,
      workingSequence: Number(working?.sequence || 0),
      headRevisionId: working?.headRevisionId || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number(session?.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision ?? source?.workspace?.revision ?? 0),
      baselineId: session?.sourceCursor?.baselineId || source?.baseline?.id || null,
      nextOffset: session?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? null,
      coveredThrough: session?.sourceCursor?.coveredThrough ?? null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(session?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
      runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
      pathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
    };
  }

  function stageILiveReportV655(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
    if (!session || !stage) return { schema: 'vibe-go-stage-i-cross-chat-recovery-acceptance/v1', armed: false, ok: false, reason: 'not-armed' };
    const phase = stageILivePhaseV655(session);
    const current = stageIAuthoritySnapshotV655(session);
    const expected = stage.sourceAuthority || {};
    const observations = Array.isArray(stage.dispatchObservations) ? stage.dispatchObservations : [];
    const witnesses = Array.isArray(stage.submissionWitnesses) ? stage.submissionWitnesses : [];
    const latestFor = name => [...observations].reverse().find(item => item?.phase === name) || null;
    const witnessFor = name => [...witnesses].reverse().find(item => item?.phase === name) || null;
    const recovery = latestFor('recovery');
    const normal = latestFor('normal');
    const auto = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null);
    const handoff = loadCrossChatHandoff();
    const same = (a,b) => String(a ?? '') === String(b ?? '');
    const authorityRecovered = Boolean(
      String(location.pathname || '') !== String(stage.sourcePathname || '') &&
      Number(current.semanticRevision) === Number(expected.semanticRevision) &&
      Number(current.acceptanceSequence) >= Number(expected.acceptanceSequence) &&
      same(current.sessionId, expected.sessionId) &&
      same(current.workingIdentity, expected.workingIdentity) &&
      Number(current.workingSequence) === Number(expected.workingSequence) &&
      same(current.headRevisionId, expected.headRevisionId) &&
      Number(current.workspaceRevision) === Number(expected.workspaceRevision) &&
      same(current.baselineId, expected.baselineId) &&
      Number(current.nextOffset) === Number(expected.nextOffset) &&
      Number(current.coveredThrough) === Number(expected.coveredThrough)
    );
    const foreignOriginProven = Boolean(
      auto &&
      same(auto.sessionId, expected.sessionId) &&
      same(auto.fromRuntimeDatabase, stage.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName) &&
      same(auto.fromSourceDatabase, stage.sourceSourceDatabaseName) &&
      String(auto.fromPathname || '') === String(stage.sourcePathname || '')
    );
    const recoveryEnvelope = Boolean(
      recovery && recovery.fullProtocolRefeed === true && recovery.envelope === 'bootstrap-recovery/full'
    );
    const normalCutover = Boolean(
      normal && normal.fullProtocolRefeed === false && normal.envelope !== 'bootstrap-recovery/full'
    );
    const physical = Boolean(witnessFor('recovery') && witnessFor('normal') && witnessFor('recovery').dispatchId !== witnessFor('normal').dispatchId);
    const sequenceDelta = Number(current.acceptanceSequence) - Number(stage.startAcceptanceSequence || 0);
    const revisionDelta = Number(current.semanticRevision) - Number(stage.startRevision || 0);
    const handoffConsumed = Boolean(handoff?.consumedAt && handoff?.consumedIn?.pathname === location.pathname);
    const acceptanceLease = stage.acceptanceLeaseV656 || null;
    const leaseConsumed = Boolean(
      acceptanceLease?.status === 'consumed' &&
      String(acceptanceLease?.runId || '') === String(stage.runId || '') &&
      String(acceptanceLease?.consumedPathname || '') === String(location.pathname || '')
    );
    const sourceIsolation = Boolean(
      String(current.runtimeDatabaseName) !== String(stage.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName) &&
      String(current.sourceDatabaseName) !== String(stage.sourceSourceDatabaseName) &&
      String(current.pathname) !== String(stage.sourcePathname)
    );
    const complete = phase === 'complete' || stage.status === 'complete';
    const sections = {
      foreignAuthorityRecovered: authorityRecovered && foreignOriginProven,
      recoveryEnvelopeOnce: recoveryEnvelope,
      normalThinCutover: normalCutover,
      semanticHeadStable: complete && revisionDelta === 0 && sequenceDelta === 2,
      physicalMountedDispatches: physical,
      handoffLifecycle: handoffConsumed && sourceIsolation && leaseConsumed,
    };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-stage-i-cross-chat-recovery-acceptance/v1',
      armed: true,
      runId: stage.runId,
      status: stage.status,
      phase,
      role: String(location.pathname || '') === String(stage.sourcePathname || '') ? 'source' : 'destination',
      ok: complete && Object.values(sections).every(Boolean),
      sections,
      sourceAuthority: cloneSemanticValue(expected),
      destinationAuthority: current,
      recovery: recovery ? cloneSemanticValue(recovery) : null,
      normal: normal ? cloneSemanticValue(normal) : null,
      submissionWitnesses: cloneSemanticValue(witnesses),
      crossChatAutoRecovery: cloneSemanticValue(auto),
      handoff: handoff ? {
        status: handoff.status || null,
        sourcePathname: handoff.sourceContext?.pathname || null,
        importedPathname: handoff.importedInto?.pathname || null,
        consumedAt: handoff.consumedAt || null,
        consumedPathname: handoff.consumedIn?.pathname || null,
      } : null,
      acceptanceLease: acceptanceLease ? cloneSemanticValue(acceptanceLease) : null,
      revisionDelta,
      sequenceDelta,
      runnerPausedAfterComplete: Boolean(session.transport?.pausedByUser && complete),
    };
  }

  async function stageILiveGateAfterReconciliationV655() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
    if (!session || !stage) return { handled: false };
    const phase = stageILivePhaseV655(session);
    if (!['complete', 'drift', 'failed'].includes(phase)) return { handled: false };
    const next = cloneSemanticValue(session);
    const nextStage = cloneSemanticValue(stage);
    if (phase === 'complete') {
      nextStage.status = 'complete';
      nextStage.completedAt ||= semanticIsoNow();
    } else {
      nextStage.status = 'failed';
      nextStage.failedAt ||= semanticIsoNow();
      nextStage.failureReason ||= `Stage I causal drift: revision=${session.revision}, sequence=${semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session)}`;
    }
    nextStage.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    next.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = nextStage;
    next.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    next.transport.pausedByUser = true;
    next.transport.pauseReason = phase === 'complete'
      ? 'Stage I cross-chat recovery acceptance complete; monolith repair remains frozen'
      : nextStage.failureReason;
    next.transport.pausedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    next.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(next);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    if (phase === 'complete') {
      await markStageIAcceptanceLeaseConsumedV656(nextStage).catch(() => false);
      const consumedLease = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656().catch(() => null);
      const refreshed = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      const refreshedStage = stageILiveStateV655(refreshed);
      if (refreshed && refreshedStage && consumedLease) {
        refreshedStage.acceptanceLeaseV656 = cloneSemanticValue(consumedLease);
        refreshed.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = refreshedStage;
        SemanticSessionStore.save(refreshed);
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
      }
    }
    return { handled: true, phase: phase === 'complete' ? 'paused' : 'hold', reason: next.transport.pauseReason };
  }

  async function semanticStageICrossChatRecoveryAcceptanceV655(options = {}) {
    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) {
      // v657: package injection/bootstrap is asynchronous. A Stage-I operator call made
      // immediately after load must wait for local hydration and may still recover directly
      // from the dedicated acceptance lease instead of throwing V655_STAGE_I_NO_SESSION.
      await hydrateRuntimePersistence({ force: true }).catch(() => null);
      session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (!session && options.restart !== true) {
        const earlyRole = await resolveStageIAcceptanceRoleV656().catch(() => ({ role: 'none' }));
        if (earlyRole.role === 'destination' && earlyRole.source?.candidate) {
          await cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(earlyRole.source.candidate, {
            automatic: false,
            reason: 'Stage I v657 early exact acceptance lease import',
          });
          session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
        }
      }
    }
    if (!session) throw new Error('V657_STAGE_I_NO_SESSION_AFTER_HYDRATION');
    let stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
    const here = String(location.pathname || '');

    if (options.restart !== true) {
      const roleResolution = await resolveStageIAcceptanceRoleV656();
      if (roleResolution.role === 'destination' && roleResolution.source?.candidate) {
        const currentRunId = String(stage?.runId || '');
        const targetRunId = String(roleResolution.source.stage?.runId || '');
        const alreadyExactDestination = Boolean(
          stage &&
          stage.status !== 'failed' &&
          currentRunId === targetRunId &&
          String(stage.sourcePathname || '') !== here
        );
        if (!alreadyExactDestination) {
          await cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(roleResolution.source.candidate, {
            automatic: false,
            reason: 'Stage I exact acceptance lease import',
          });
          session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
          stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);
          if (!stage || String(stage.runId || '') !== targetRunId) {
            throw new Error('V656_STAGE_I_EXACT_LEASE_CLONE_MISMATCH');
          }
          await markStageIAcceptanceLeaseImportedV656(stage);
          const importedLease = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656().catch(() => null);
          if (importedLease) {
            stage.acceptanceLeaseV656 = cloneSemanticValue(importedLease);
            session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
            SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
            await flushRuntimePersistence();
          }
        }
      } else if (roleResolution.role === 'source' && stage?.status === 'armed-source') {
        const lease = roleResolution.lease || stageIAcceptanceLeaseFromSourceV656(stage, RUNTIME_DB_NAME, SOURCE_DB_NAME);
        if (lease) {
          await putStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656(lease);
          stage.acceptanceLeaseV656 = cloneSemanticValue(lease);
          session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
          SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
          await flushRuntimePersistence();
        }
      }
    }

    session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    stage = stageILiveStateV655(session);

    if (!stage || options.restart === true) {
      if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) throw new Error('V655_STAGE_I_GENERATING');
      if (state.running) stop({ reason: 'Stage I cross-chat acceptance arm', source: 'stage-i-v655' });
      clearPendingSend();
      session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      session.transport ||= {};
      session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
      session.transport.pausedByUser = true;
      session.transport.pauseReason = 'Stage I source handoff armed; open a new chat in the same project';
      session.transport.pausedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      const runId = semanticId('stage-i-v655');
      const snapshot = stageIAuthoritySnapshotV655(session);
      stage = {
        schema: STAGE_I_LIVE_SCHEMA_V655,
        runId,
        status: 'armed-source',
        armedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        sourcePathname: here,
        sourceOrigin: String(location.origin || ''),
        sourceRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        sourceSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
        startRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        startAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
        sourceAuthority: cloneSemanticValue(snapshot),
        dispatchObservations: [],
        submissionWitnesses: [],
      };
      const lease = stageIAcceptanceLeaseFromSourceV656(stage, RUNTIME_DB_NAME, SOURCE_DB_NAME);
      if (lease) stage.acceptanceLeaseV656 = cloneSemanticValue(lease);
      session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
      session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      const handoff = await saveCrossChatHandoff({ reason: `Stage I actual cross-chat recovery ${runId}` });
      const registry = await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(SemanticSessionStore.load()).catch(() => null);
      const acceptanceLease = lease ? await putStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656(lease).catch(() => null) : null;
      return {
        ...stageILiveReportV655(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
        justArmed: true,
        handoffPublished: Boolean(handoff),
        registryPublished: Boolean(registry),
        acceptanceLeasePublished: Boolean(acceptanceLease),
        next: 'Open a NEW ChatGPT chat inside the same project, inject this same a57 package there, then run await VibeGo.transport.stageICrossChatRecoveryAcceptanceV655(). Do not load VIBE-GO in any other new chat meanwhile.',
      };
    }

    if (here === String(stage.sourcePathname || '')) {
      const lease = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656().catch(() => null);
      if (lease && stageIAcceptanceLeaseMatchesStageV656(lease, stage)) {
        stage.acceptanceLeaseV656 = cloneSemanticValue(lease);
        session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
        SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
      }
      return {
        ...stageILiveReportV655(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
        sourceStillArmed: true,
        next: 'Use a NEW chat in the same project for the destination half; this source chat must remain paused.',
      };
    }

    if (stage.status === 'complete') return stageILiveReportV655(session);
    if (stage.status === 'failed') return stageILiveReportV655(session);

    const auto = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null);
    const source = stage.sourceAuthority || {};
    const current = stageIAuthoritySnapshotV655(session);
    const originMatchesV657 = stageIRecoveryOriginMatchesV657(auto, stage);
    const currentFingerprintMatchesV657 = stageIDestinationAuthorityStillCompatibleV657(session, stage);

    if (stage.status === 'destination-live') {
      // v657: after finalizeCrossChatTransportReanchor(), auto.status correctly becomes
      // `ready`. Re-entering the acceptance API while PHASE 1/2 is still in progress must
      // resume/report that live run, not retroactively fail it for no longer being
      // `pending-reanchor`.
      const livePhase = stageILivePhaseV655(session);
      if (!originMatchesV657 || !currentFingerprintMatchesV657 || !['recovery', 'normal', 'complete'].includes(livePhase)) {
        stage.status = 'failed';
        stage.failureReason = `Stage I destination authority drift after re-anchor: phase=${livePhase}, auto=${auto?.status || 'none'}`;
        session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
        SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
        return stageILiveReportV655(session);
      }
      if (livePhase === 'complete') {
        await stageILiveGateAfterReconciliationV655();
        return stageILiveReportV655(SemanticSessionStore.load());
      }
      if (!state.running && !isGeneratingFast() && !isGenerating()) {
        session.transport.pausedByUser = false;
        session.transport.pauseReason = '';
        session.transport.pausedAt = null;
        SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
        await start({ explicit: true, reason: `Stage I v657 resume ${livePhase}` });
      }
      return {
        ...stageILiveReportV655(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
        destinationResumed: true,
        resumePhase: livePhase,
        instruction: 'Stage I destination run resumed from durable authority. No further console action until completion/pause.',
      };
    }

    const exactRecovered = Boolean(
      originMatchesV657 &&
      auto?.status === 'pending-reanchor' &&
      Number(current.semanticRevision) === Number(source.semanticRevision) &&
      Number(current.acceptanceSequence) === Number(source.acceptanceSequence) &&
      currentFingerprintMatchesV657
    );
    if (!exactRecovered) {
      stage.status = 'failed';
      stage.failureReason = 'Destination did not recover the exact Stage I foreign authority before first re-anchor';
      session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      return stageILiveReportV655(session);
    }

    stage.status = 'destination-live';
    stage.destinationPathname = here;
    stage.destinationRuntimeDatabaseName = RUNTIME_DB_NAME;
    stage.destinationSourceDatabaseName = SOURCE_DB_NAME;
    stage.destinationRecoveredAt = semanticIsoNow();
    await markStageIAcceptanceLeaseImportedV656(stage).catch(() => false);
    const importedLease = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656().catch(() => null);
    if (importedLease) stage.acceptanceLeaseV656 = cloneSemanticValue(importedLease);
    session.transport.stageICrossChatV655 = stage;
    session.transport.pausedByUser = false;
    session.transport.pauseReason = '';
    session.transport.pausedAt = null;
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    await start({ explicit: true, reason: 'Stage I actual cross-chat recovery acceptance' });
    return {
      ...stageILiveReportV655(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
      destinationStarted: true,
      leaseMigratedFromPreA56Arm: Boolean((await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656().catch(() => null))?.runId === stage.runId),
      instruction: 'No console action until the two Stage I VIBE dispatches complete and the rail pauses; then call this same function once for the final report.',
    };
  }

  function stageHLiveInstructionLinesV653(session, dispatchId) {
    const stage = stageHLiveStateV653(session);
    const phase = stageHLivePhaseV653(session);
    if (!stage || !['query', 'echo', 'meaningful'].includes(phase)) return [];
    const runId = String(stage.runId || 'unknown');
    const revision = Number(session.revision || 0);
    const header = [
      '',
      `STAGE H LIVE INTEGRATION ACCEPTANCE · ${runId} · ${phase.toUpperCase()}`,
      'Это acceptance traffic, НЕ продолжение замороженного monolith repair. Не повторяй и не меняй инженерное решение legacyGroupByKeyAsync.',
    ];
    if (phase === 'query') {
      return [
        ...header,
        'PHASE 1/3: докажи реальный same-r accepted native turn и Source Intelligence VG_PATCH persistence.',
        'Верни только no-op semantic control: {"action":"CONTINUE"}; НЕ добавляй summary/nextFocus/notes/decisions.',
        'Добавь ровно один VG_PATCH sourceOps QUERY для ensureConflictBackendDetailsRuntimeV686, kind identifier, relations ["definitions"], force true. Других mutation/tool ops не добавляй.',
        `Causal marker должен использовать текущие d=${dispatchId} r=${revision}.`,
      ];
    }
    if (phase === 'echo') {
      return [
        ...header,
        'PHASE 2/3: предыдущий QUERY уже должен быть показан выше как SOURCE INTELLIGENCE · FRESH EVIDENCE.',
        'Не делай новый QUERY и не добавляй VG_PATCH. Верни только {"action":"CONTINUE"} без summary/nextFocus/notes/decisions.',
        'Это второй accepted turn на том же semantic revision; его задача — сделать предыдущий evidence batch stale после acceptance.',
        `Causal marker должен использовать текущие d=${dispatchId} r=${revision}.`,
      ];
    }
    return [
      ...header,
      'PHASE 3/3: fresh evidence из PHASE 1 теперь не должен повторяться в dispatch.',
      'Верни meaningful semantic delta без source mutation: action NOTE_ADDED и ровно одну open finding-note с указанным ниже точным текстом.',
      `NOTE TEXT: ${stage.noteText}`,
      'Не добавляй summary/nextFocus/decisions/VG_PATCH.',
      `Causal marker должен использовать текущие d=${dispatchId} r=${revision}.`,
    ];
  }

  function recordStageHLiveDispatchObservationV653(session, built) {
    const stage = stageHLiveStateV653(session);
    const phase = stageHLivePhaseV653(session);
    if (!stage || !['query', 'echo', 'meaningful'].includes(phase) || !built?.id) return false;
    stage.dispatchObservations = Array.isArray(stage.dispatchObservations) ? stage.dispatchObservations : [];
    if (stage.dispatchObservations.some(item => String(item?.dispatchId || '') === String(built.id))) return false;
    const queryIds = [...String(built.text || '').matchAll(/\bQUERY\s+(query:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/g)].map(match => match[1]);
    stage.dispatchObservations.push({
      phase,
      dispatchId: built.id,
      baseRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequenceBefore: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      builtAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      hasFreshEvidenceHeader: String(built.text || '').includes('SOURCE INTELLIGENCE · FRESH EVIDENCE'),
      localEvidenceBatch: cloneSemanticValue(built.transportMetrics?.localEvidenceBatch || null),
      queryIds,
      chars: Number(built.size?.chars || 0),
      lifecycle: 'built-candidate',
    });
    stage.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    session.transport.stageHLiveV653 = stage;
    return true;
  }

  function recordStageHSubmissionWitnessV654(dispatch, witness, turn = null) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const stage = stageHLiveStateV653(session);
    if (!session || !stage || !dispatch?.id) return false;
    stage.submissionWitnesses = Array.isArray(stage.submissionWitnesses) ? stage.submissionWitnesses : [];
    const dispatchId = String(dispatch.id || '');
    const existing = stage.submissionWitnesses.find(item => String(item?.dispatchId || '') === dispatchId);
    const observation = (stage.dispatchObservations || []).find(item => String(item?.dispatchId || '') === dispatchId) || null;
    const row = {
      dispatchId,
      phase: observation?.phase || stageHLivePhaseV653(session) || null,
      baseRevision: Number(dispatch.baseRevision ?? observation?.baseRevision ?? session.revision ?? 0),
      acceptanceSequenceBefore: Number(observation?.acceptanceSequenceBefore ?? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session)),
      witness: String(witness || 'unknown'),
      witnessedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      mountedTurnKey: turn?.key || null,
      mountedTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(turn?.order) ? turn.order : null,
    };
    if (existing) Object.assign(existing, row);
    else stage.submissionWitnesses.push(row);
    if (observation) {
      observation.lifecycle = 'physically-submitted';
      observation.submissionWitness = row.witness;
      observation.submittedAt = row.witnessedAt;
      observation.mountedTurnKey = row.mountedTurnKey;
      observation.mountedTurnOrder = row.mountedTurnOrder;
    }
    stage.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    session.transport.stageHLiveV653 = stage;
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    return true;
  }

  function stageHLiveReportV653(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const stage = stageHLiveStateV653(session);
    if (!session || !stage) return { schema: 'vibe-go-stage-h-live-integration-acceptance/v1', armed: false, ok: false, reason: 'not-armed' };
    const phase = stageHLivePhaseV653(session);
    const observations = Array.isArray(stage.dispatchObservations) ? stage.dispatchObservations : [];
    const submissionWitnesses = Array.isArray(stage.submissionWitnesses) ? stage.submissionWitnesses : [];
    // Build observations are candidates, not send authority. A proven-unsent candidate may be
    // rebuilt/re-anchored before physical submission, so select the latest candidate for each
    // causal phase unless a durable submission witness names the authoritative dispatch.
    const byPhaseCandidates = name => observations.filter(item => item?.phase === name);
    const witnessForPhase = name => [...submissionWitnesses].reverse().find(item => item?.phase === name) || null;
    const byPhase = name => {
      const witness = witnessForPhase(name);
      if (witness?.dispatchId) {
        const witnessed = observations.find(item => String(item?.dispatchId || '') === String(witness.dispatchId));
        if (witnessed) return witnessed;
      }
      const candidates = byPhaseCandidates(name);
      return candidates.length ? candidates[candidates.length - 1] : null;
    };
    const queryDispatch = byPhase('query');
    const echoDispatch = byPhase('echo');
    const meaningfulDispatch = byPhase('meaningful');
    const selectedDispatches = [queryDispatch, echoDispatch, meaningfulDispatch].filter(Boolean);
    const selectedDispatchIds = new Set(selectedDispatches.map(item => item.dispatchId).filter(Boolean));
    const candidateDispatchIds = new Set(observations.map(item => item.dispatchId).filter(Boolean));
    const durableSubmissionIds = new Set(submissionWitnesses.map(item => item?.dispatchId).filter(Boolean));
    const evidence = session.transport?.lastSourceIntelligenceOps || null;
    const mountedIdsNow = new Set(getTailTurns()
      .filter(turn => turn?.role === 'user')
      .map(turn => String(turn.readableText || turn.markerText || ''))
      .flatMap(value => selectedDispatches.filter(item => value.includes(`[[VIBE_DISPATCH id=${item.dispatchId} `)).map(item => item.dispatchId)));
    const noteMatches = (session.notes || []).filter(item => String(item?.text || '') === String(stage.noteText || ''));
    const causalThreeTurnProof = Boolean(
      phase === 'complete' &&
      Number(session.revision || 0) === Number(stage.startRevision || 0) + 1 &&
      semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session) === Number(stage.startAcceptanceSequence || 0) + 3 &&
      selectedDispatches.length === 3 &&
      selectedDispatchIds.size === 3 &&
      selectedDispatches.every(item => Number(item.baseRevision) === Number(stage.startRevision)) &&
      Number(evidence?.acceptanceSequence) === Number(stage.startAcceptanceSequence || 0) + 1 &&
      Number(evidence?.succeeded || 0) >= 1 &&
      Number(evidence?.queryCount || 0) >= 1 &&
      noteMatches.length === 1
    );
    const physicalSubmissionProof = durableSubmissionIds.size >= 3
      ? { ok: true, mode: 'durable-submission-witnesses', ids: [...durableSubmissionIds] }
      : causalThreeTurnProof
        ? {
            ok: true,
            mode: 'historical-causal-fallback',
            ids: [...selectedDispatchIds],
            note: 'Pre-a54 Stage H did not persist per-dispatch mount witnesses; three accepted stage-specific causal controls prove all three selected dispatches were model-facing. Current DOM mount count is diagnostic only.',
          }
        : { ok: false, mode: 'insufficient-proof', ids: [...durableSubmissionIds] };
    const transportComplete = Boolean(
      causalThreeTurnProof &&
      queryDispatch && echoDispatch && meaningfulDispatch &&
      queryDispatch.hasFreshEvidenceHeader === false &&
      echoDispatch.hasFreshEvidenceHeader === true &&
      meaningfulDispatch.hasFreshEvidenceHeader === false
    );
    const workingRoundTrip = cloneSemanticValue(stage.workingRoundTrip || null);
    const sections = {
      workingPersistence: workingRoundTrip?.ok === true,
      sameRevisionNativeTransport: Boolean(transportComplete && Number(queryDispatch?.baseRevision) === Number(echoDispatch?.baseRevision)),
      sourceIntelligenceAcceptedPatch: Boolean(transportComplete && Number(evidence?.succeeded || 0) >= 1),
      exactlyOnceEvidenceEcho: Boolean(transportComplete && !queryDispatch?.hasFreshEvidenceHeader && echoDispatch?.hasFreshEvidenceHeader && !meaningfulDispatch?.hasFreshEvidenceHeader),
      meaningfulRevisionAdvance: Boolean(transportComplete && noteMatches.length === 1),
      physicalMountedDispatches: physicalSubmissionProof.ok === true,
    };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-stage-h-live-integration-acceptance/v1',
      armed: true,
      runId: stage.runId,
      status: stage.status,
      phase,
      ok: stage.status === 'complete' && Object.values(sections).every(Boolean),
      sections,
      workingRoundTrip,
      transport: {
        startRevision: Number(stage.startRevision),
        currentRevision: Number(session.revision),
        revisionDelta: Number(session.revision) - Number(stage.startRevision),
        startAcceptanceSequence: Number(stage.startAcceptanceSequence),
        currentAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
        sequenceDelta: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session) - Number(stage.startAcceptanceSequence),
        observations: cloneSemanticValue(observations),
        candidateDispatchIds: candidateDispatchIds.size,
        uniqueDispatchIds: selectedDispatchIds.size,
        selectedDispatchIds: [...selectedDispatchIds],
        submissionWitnesses: cloneSemanticValue(submissionWitnesses),
        physicalSubmissionProof: cloneSemanticValue(physicalSubmissionProof),
        mountedDispatchIds: [...mountedIdsNow],
        mountedDispatchIdsDiagnosticOnly: true,
        evidence: evidence ? {
          revision: Number(evidence.revision || 0),
          acceptanceSequence: Number(evidence.acceptanceSequence || 0),
          requested: Number(evidence.requested || 0),
          succeeded: Number(evidence.succeeded || 0),
          failed: Number(evidence.failed || 0),
          queryCount: Number(evidence.queryCount || 0),
          resultIds: (evidence.results || []).map(item => item?.resultId || null).filter(Boolean),
        } : null,
        noteMatches: noteMatches.length,
      },
      runnerPausedAfterComplete: Boolean(session.transport?.pausedByUser && phase === 'complete'),
      remainingLiveGates: [
        'actual cross-chat/rollover recovery round-trip',
        'full long-run refactor run / comparison against a25 baseline',
        'previously deferred operator/auto-continue lifecycle cases',
      ],
    };
  }

  async function stageHLiveGateAfterReconciliationV653() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const stage = stageHLiveStateV653(session);
    if (!session || !stage) return { handled: false };
    const phase = stageHLivePhaseV653(session);
    if (!['complete', 'drift', 'failed'].includes(phase)) return { handled: false };
    const next = cloneSemanticValue(session);
    const nextStage = cloneSemanticValue(stage);
    if (phase === 'complete') {
      nextStage.status = 'complete';
      nextStage.completedAt ||= semanticIsoNow();
    } else {
      nextStage.status = 'failed';
      nextStage.failedAt ||= semanticIsoNow();
      nextStage.failureReason ||= `Stage H causal phase drift: revision=${session.revision}, sequence=${semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session)}`;
    }
    nextStage.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    next.transport.stageHLiveV653 = nextStage;
    next.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    next.transport.pausedByUser = true;
    next.transport.pauseReason = phase === 'complete'
      ? 'Stage H live integration acceptance complete; monolith repair remains frozen'
      : nextStage.failureReason;
    next.transport.pausedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    next.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(next);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return { handled: true, phase: phase === 'complete' ? 'paused' : 'hold', reason: next.transport.pauseReason };
  }

  function buildSemanticDispatch(sessionInput) {

    const dispatchCursor = compactSemanticSourceCursorForDispatch(session.sourceCursor, { fullHistory: fullProtocolRefeed });

    });
    const crossChatHandoffContext = fullProtocolRefeed ? crossChatHandoffDispatchContext(session) : '(local authority; omitted from normal dispatch)';
    const specIteration = getSpecOpsIterationRequest(session);
    const operatingSemanticsLines = fullProtocolRefeed
      ? [
          'MODEL-OPERATING SEMANTICS · RUNTIME CONTRACT',
          'VIBE-GO сохраняет semantic continuity, causal position и durable obligations; конкретная project Mission приходит только из текущей session authority.',

  function adaptiveIntentEnvelopeAcceptanceV643() {
    const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!live) throw new Error('Semantic session is not initialized');
    const before = {
      revision: live.revision,
      workspaceRevision: live.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision ?? null,
      workingIdentity: live.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      pendingDispatchId: live.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(live.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: live.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? null,
    };

    function baseClone() {
      const s = cloneSemanticValue(live);
      s.transport ||= {};
      s.transport.lastControl ||= {
        id: 'v643-acceptance-control',
        revision: s.revision,
        turnKey: 'v643-acceptance-turn',
        turnOrder: 1,
        acceptedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      s.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
      if (s.transport.reanchorBoundary) s.transport.reanchorBoundary.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
      s.transport.repairRequestV642 = false;
      if (s.transport.pendingDispatch) {
        s.transport.pendingDispatch.repairAttempts = 0;
        if (/^repair/i.test(String(s.transport.pendingDispatch.status || ''))) s.transport.pendingDispatch.status = 'ready';
      }
      return s;
    }

    const intents = ['CONTINUATION', 'QUESTION', 'INVESTIGATION', 'CHANGE', 'VALIDATION', 'ARCHITECTURE', 'REPAIR'];
    const cases = intents.map(intent => {
      const s = baseClone();
      s.transport.dispatchIntentOverrideV642 = intent;
      const built = buildSemanticDispatch(s);
      const metrics = built.transportMetrics || {};
      const envelope = metrics.dispatchEnvelopeV643 || {};
      const evidenceBlocks = (built.text.match(/\/\* VIBE EVIDENCE ·/g) || []).length;
      const expected = DISPATCH_PROFILES_V642[intent];
      const expectedEnvelope = ADAPTIVE_ENVELOPE_PROFILES_V643[intent]?.envelope;
      const hasIntentHeader = built.text.includes(`INTENT: ${intent} · ${expected.profile}`);
      const evidenceBounded = evidenceBlocks <= expected.evidenceSlots;
      const budgetWired = Number(envelope.evidenceSlots) === Number(expected.evidenceSlots) &&
        Number(envelope.softChars) === Number(expected.softChars) &&
        Number(envelope.sourceEvidenceChars) >= 2400;
      const ok = metrics.fullProtocolRefeed === false &&
        metrics.dispatchIntentV642 === intent &&
        metrics.adaptiveEnvelopeV643 === expectedEnvelope &&
        hasIntentHeader && evidenceBounded && budgetWired;
      return {
        intent,
        ok,
        envelope: metrics.adaptiveEnvelopeV643,
        profile: expected.profile,
        chars: built.size?.chars ?? null,
        softChars: envelope.softChars ?? null,
        evidenceSlots: envelope.evidenceSlots ?? null,
        evidenceBlocks,
        sourceEvidenceChars: envelope.sourceEvidenceChars ?? null,
        hasIntentHeader,
        evidenceBounded,
        budgetWired,
      };
    });

    const fullCases = ['RECOVERY', 'BOOTSTRAP'].map(intent => {
      const s = baseClone();
      s.transport.dispatchIntentOverrideV642 = intent;
      if (intent === 'RECOVERY') s.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = true;
      if (intent === 'BOOTSTRAP') s.transport.lastControl = null;
      const built = buildSemanticDispatch(s);
      const metrics = built.transportMetrics || {};
      const envelope = metrics.dispatchEnvelopeV643 || {};
      const ok = metrics.fullProtocolRefeed === true &&
        metrics.adaptiveEnvelopeV643 === 'bootstrap-recovery/full' &&
        envelope.fullProtocolRefeed === true &&
        built.text.includes('MODEL-OPERATING SEMANTICS · MANIFEST AUTHORITY') &&
        !built.text.includes(`INTENT: ${intent} ·`);
      return {
        intent,
        ok,
        envelope: metrics.adaptiveEnvelopeV643,
        chars: built.size?.chars ?? null,
        fullProtocolRefeed: metrics.fullProtocolRefeed === true,
        fullSemantics: built.text.includes('MODEL-OPERATING SEMANTICS · MANIFEST AUTHORITY'),
      };
    });

    const afterLive = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const after = {
      revision: afterLive?.revision ?? null,
      workspaceRevision: afterLive?.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision ?? null,
      workingIdentity: afterLive?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      pendingDispatchId: afterLive?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(afterLive?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: afterLive?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? null,
    };
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(after);
    const thinEnvelopeKinds = new Set(cases.map(item => item.envelope));
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-adaptive-intent-envelope-acceptance/v1',
      ok: authorityNonMutating && cases.every(item => item.ok) && fullCases.every(item => item.ok) && thinEnvelopeKinds.size === intents.length,
      authorityNonMutating,
      cases,
      fullCases,
      envelopeDiversity: {
        ok: thinEnvelopeKinds.size === intents.length,
        uniqueThinEnvelopes: thinEnvelopeKinds.size,
        expected: intents.length,
      },
      before,
      after,
      integration: {
        selectorCoreImplemented: true,
        payloadCompositionChanged: true,
        sourceProjectionBudgetWired: true,
        recoveryBootstrapRemainFull: true,
      },
    };
  }

  function parseSemanticDispatchTurn(turn) {
    if (!turn || turn.role !== 'user') return null;
    const text = String(turn.readableText || turn.markerText || '');
    const pattern = /\[\[VIBE_DISPATCH\s+id=([^\s\]]+)\s+session=([^\s\]]+)\s+revision=(\d+)\s*\]\]/g;
    const matches = [...text.matchAll(pattern)];
    if (!matches.length) return null;
    if (matches.length !== 1) {
      return {
        invalid: true,
        reason: `Expected one VIBE_DISPATCH marker, found ${matches.length}`,
        turn,
      };
    }
    const match = matches[0];
    return {
      id: match[1],
      sessionId: match[2],
      revision: Number(match[3]),
      raw: match[0],
      turn,
    };
  }

  function semanticStateAcceptanceBoundary(session) {
    const reanchor = session.transport?.reanchorBoundary || null;
    if (reanchor && Number(reanchor.revision) === Number(session.revision)) {
      return {
        turnKey: reanchor.turnKey || null,
        turnOrder: Number.isFinite(reanchor.turnOrder) ? reanchor.turnOrder : null,
        capturedAt: reanchor.capturedAt || null,
        kind: 'semantic-transport-reanchor',
      };
    }

    // a18: lastControl is the durable acceptance boundary for mounted assistant
    // transport. Once a VIBE_STATE has advanced the semantic revision, that turn
    // is historical evidence, not an unaccepted attempt. ChatGPT may later remount
    // the same turn with a truncated marker projection; filtering from bootstrap
    // allowed that degraded projection to re-enter the incomplete/repair path after
    // pendingDispatch had already been cleared. Prefer stable turnOrder so DOM-key
    // churn cannot resurrect an accepted assistant turn.
    const last = session.transport?.lastControl || null;
    if (last) {
      return {
        turnKey: last.turnKey || null,
        turnOrder: Number.isFinite(last.turnOrder) ? last.turnOrder : null,
        capturedAt: last.acceptedAt || null,
        kind: 'semantic-state-accepted',
      };
    }

    return session.transport?.bootstrapBoundary || null;
  }

  function semanticTransportControlBoundary(session) {
    const reanchor = session.transport?.reanchorBoundary || null;
    const last = session.transport?.lastControl || null;
    const bootstrap = session.transport?.bootstrapBoundary || {};
    if (reanchor && Number(reanchor.revision) === Number(session.revision)) {
      return {
        id: reanchor.id,
        type: 'semantic-transport-reanchor',
        synthetic: true,
        turnKey: reanchor.turnKey || null,
        turnOrder: Number.isFinite(reanchor.turnOrder) ? reanchor.turnOrder : null,
      };
    }
    if (last) {
      return {
        id: last.id,
        type: 'semantic-state',
        synthetic: false,
        turnKey: last.turnKey || null,
        turnOrder: Number.isFinite(last.turnOrder) ? last.turnOrder : null,
      };
    }
    return {
      id: `semantic-bootstrap:${session.id}:r${session.revision}`,
      type: 'semantic-bootstrap',
      synthetic: true,
      turnKey: bootstrap.turnKey || null,
      turnOrder: Number.isFinite(bootstrap.turnOrder) ? bootstrap.turnOrder : null,
    };
  }

  function semanticControlFromSession(session) {
    const boundary = semanticTransportControlBoundary(session);
    return {
      id: boundary.id,
      eventKey: boundary.id,
      type: boundary.type,
      synthetic: boundary.synthetic,

        key: boundary.turnKey,

      },
    };
  }

  function semanticTailAfterControl(turns, control) {
    const index = resolveTurnIndex(
      turns,
      control?.turn?.key || null,
      Number.isFinite(control?.turn?.order) ? control.turn.order : null
    );
    if (index < 0) return null;
    return turns.slice(index + 1);
  }


  function ensureSemanticPendingDispatch(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    if (!sessionInput) throw new Error('Semantic session is not initialized');
    const session = cloneSemanticValue(sessionInput);
    validateSemanticSession(session);
    const controlId = semanticTransportControlBoundary(session).id;
    const current = session.transport.pendingDispatch;
    const currentMatchesCausalBoundary = Boolean(
      current &&
      current.controlId === controlId &&
      Number(current.baseRevision) === Number(session.revision) &&
      current.id &&
      current.text
    );
    if (currentMatchesCausalBoundary) {
      const currentProfile = String(current.transportProfile || 'legacy-unprofiled');
      const requiredProfile = String(CONFIG.semanticTransportProfile || '');
      if (currentProfile === requiredProfile) return cloneSemanticValue(current);

      const currentStatus = String(current.status || 'ready');
      const provenUnsent = currentStatus === 'ready' || currentStatus === 'queued';
      if (!provenUnsent) {
        // Never rewrite a model-facing or uncertain dispatch during package upgrade.
        // Its original text is part of the durable causal evidence needed for mount/
        // response reconciliation, even if a newer runner would serialize differently.
        log('Preserving pending dispatch from older transport profile because it may already be model-facing', {
          dispatchId: current.id,
          status: currentStatus,
          currentProfile,
          requiredProfile,
        });
        return cloneSemanticValue(current);
      }

      // ready/queued are pre-click states. Runtime timers do not survive package reload,
      // so rebuilding the same causal dispatch here cannot duplicate a physical send.
      log('Rebuilding proven-unsent pending dispatch for current transport profile', {
        dispatchId: current.id,
        status: currentStatus,
        currentProfile,
        requiredProfile,
      });
      session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    }
    const built = buildSemanticDispatch(session);
    recordStageHLiveDispatchObservationV653(session, built);
    recordStageILiveDispatchObservationV655(session, built);
    const pending = {
      ...built,
      transportProfile: String(built.transportProfile || CONFIG.semanticTransportProfile || ''),
      baseRevision: session.revision,
      status: 'ready',
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      queuedAt: null,
      sentAt: null,
      generatingAt: null,
      retries: 0,
      repairAttempts: 0,
      repairFailureAttempts: {},
    };
    session.transport.pendingDispatch = pending;
    session.transport.pausedByUser = false;
    const savedV615 = SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    const effectivePendingV615 = savedV615?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (!effectivePendingV615) {
      throw new Error('SEMANTIC_PENDING_AUTHORITY_LOST: pending dispatch build was superseded before commit');
    }
    if (String(effectivePendingV615.id || '') !== String(pending.id || '')) {
      log('a18 pending build superseded; returning current authoritative dispatch instead of phantom build', {
        builtDispatchId: pending.id,
        effectiveDispatchId: effectivePendingV615.id,
        baseRevision: effectivePendingV615.baseRevision,
      });
    }
    return cloneSemanticValue(effectivePendingV615);
  }

  function updateSemanticPendingDispatch(dispatch, patch) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || !dispatch?.id) return null;
    const pending = session.transport.pendingDispatch;
    if (!pending || pending.id !== dispatch.id) return session;
    session.transport.pendingDispatch = {
      ...pending,
      ...cloneSemanticValue(patch || {}),
    };
    const operatorControlV704 = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    if (operatorControlV704?.status === 'active') {
      const statusV704 = String(session.transport.pendingDispatch?.status || '');
      const inFlightV704 = ['submitting', 'submitted', 'generating', 'submit-unconfirmed'].includes(statusV704);
      session.transport.operatorControl = {
        ...operatorControlV704,
        inFlightDispatch: inFlightV704 ? operatorPendingSummaryV626(session.transport.pendingDispatch) : null,
      };
    }
    return SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
  }

  function semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(dispatch, allowedStatuses = null) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const statuses = Array.isArray(allowedStatuses) ? new Set(allowedStatuses.map(String)) : null;
    const matches = Boolean(
      session && pending && dispatch?.id &&
      String(pending.id || '') === String(dispatch.id || '') &&
      String(pending.controlId || '') === String(dispatch.controlId || '') &&
      Number(pending.baseRevision) === Number(dispatch.baseRevision) &&
      (!statuses || statuses.has(String(pending.status || 'ready')))
    );
    return { session, pending, matches };
  }

  function abandonSupersededQueuedDispatchV614(task, stage, details = null) {

      queuedBaseRevision: task?.dispatch?.baseRevision ?? null,
      currentDispatchId: details?.pending?.id || null,
      currentStatus: details?.pending?.status || null,
      currentBaseRevision: details?.pending?.baseRevision ?? null,
      runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id,
    });

    return false;
  }

  function setSemanticUserPause(paused, reason = '') {
    const current = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    if (!current) return null;
    const nextPaused = Boolean(paused);
    const nextReason = nextPaused ? String(reason || '') : '';
    if (
      Boolean(current.transport?.pausedByUser) === nextPaused &&
      String(current.transport?.pauseReason || '') === nextReason
    ) {
      cpuHotPathStats.semanticPauseNoops += 1;
      return current;
    }
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    session.transport.pausedByUser = nextPaused;
    session.transport.pauseReason = nextReason;
    session.transport.pausedAt = nextPaused ? semanticIsoNow() : null;
    return SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
  }

  function enterOperatorControlV626(reason = 'trusted user preemption', meta = {}) {
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return null;
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return null;

    clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
    operatorAssistantStableKeyV626 = null;
    operatorAssistantStableSinceV626 = 0;
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();

    const runtimePending = pendingSend?.dispatch || null;
    if (pendingSend?.protocolName === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name) {
      const owner = ProtocolRuntime.getByName(pendingSend.protocolName);
      owner?.markDispatchCancelled?.(
        pendingSend.dispatch,
        'superseded by trusted operator preemption before physical VIBE send'
      );
      clearPendingSend();
    }

    const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const pendingStatus = String(pending?.status || '');
    const preemptionTailV626 = getTailTurns().at(-1) || null;
    const provenUnsent = pending && ['ready', 'queued'].includes(pendingStatus);
    const inFlight = pending && ['submitting', 'submitted', 'generating', 'submit-unconfirmed'].includes(pendingStatus);

    session.transport = session.transport || {};
    const previous = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    session.transport.operatorControl = {
      ...(previous || {}),
      schema: OPERATOR_CONTROL_SCHEMA_V626,
      status: 'active',
      reason: String(reason || 'trusted user preemption'),
      source: String(meta.source || meta.kind || 'native-user'),
      enteredAt: previous?.status === 'active' ? previous.enteredAt : semanticIsoNow(),
      lastUserActivityAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      lastDomSignalAt: Date.now(),
      autoContinue: getOperatorUiSettingsV626().autoContinue,
      manualHold: Boolean(meta.manualHold),
      preemptionBoundary: meta.turnKey
        ? (previous?.preemptionBoundary || null)
        : {
            turnKey: preemptionTailV626?.key || null,
            turnOrder: Number.isFinite(preemptionTailV626?.order) ? preemptionTailV626.order : null,
          },
      firstOperatorTurnKey: meta.turnKey || previous?.firstOperatorTurnKey || null,
      firstOperatorTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(Number(meta.turnOrder))
        ? Number(meta.turnOrder)
        : (previous?.firstOperatorTurnOrder ?? null),
      countdownStartedAt: null,
      countdownDeadlineAt: null,
      inFlightDispatch: inFlight ? operatorPendingSummaryV626(pending) : null,
      lastMountedUserTurnKey: meta.turnKey || previous?.lastMountedUserTurnKey || null,
      lastMountedUserTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(Number(meta.turnOrder))
        ? Number(meta.turnOrder)
        : (previous?.lastMountedUserTurnOrder ?? null),
      resumedAt: null,
      resumeMode: null,
    };
    if (provenUnsent) session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    session.transport.pausedByUser = true;
    session.transport.pauseReason = 'Operator control: native user conversation owns the chat until resume/replan';
    session.transport.pausedAt = session.transport.pausedAt || semanticIsoNow();
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);

    state.tailWatchKey = null;
    state.tailWatchSince = 0;
    setPhase('paused', '👤 Operator control · VIBE safely parked');
    renderPanel();
    return cloneSemanticValue(session.transport.operatorControl);
  }

  function touchOperatorActivityV626(source = 'composer-input') {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const control = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    if (!session || !control || control.status !== 'active') return false;
    const hadCountdown = Boolean(operatorAutoContinueDeadlineV626 || operatorAutoContinueTimerV626);
    clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
    operatorAssistantStableKeyV626 = null;
    operatorAssistantStableSinceV626 = 0;
    operatorLastDomSignalAtV626 = Date.now();

    // Trusted input can fire for every keystroke. Cancellation is immediate in
    // runtime, but durable activity bookkeeping is throttled unless a live countdown
    // was actually cancelled.
    if (!hadCountdown && Date.now() - operatorLastActivityPersistAtV626 < 900) {
      return true;
    }
    operatorLastActivityPersistAtV626 = Date.now();
    session.transport.operatorControl = {
      ...control,
      lastUserActivityAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      lastDomSignalAt: operatorLastDomSignalAtV626,
      source: String(source || control.source || 'operator'),
      countdownStartedAt: null,
      countdownDeadlineAt: null,
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    if (hadCountdown) renderPanel();
    return true;
  }

  function handleOperatorDomEventV626(payload = {}) {
    operatorLastDomSignalAtV626 = Date.now();
    const kind = String(payload.kind || '');
    if (kind === 'trusted-composer-input') {
      return touchOperatorActivityV626(kind);
    }
    if (!['trusted-send-click', 'trusted-composer-enter'].includes(kind)) return false;
    if (!composerDraftTextV626()) return false;

    // a72: a genuine external prerequisite waits for the operator's next normal
    // message, not for a second manual Resume gesture. The user turn itself releases
    // only the transport wait; the next tool result still proves whether the action
    // actually succeeded. Do not enter generic OPERATOR_CONTROL for this special case.
    const prerequisiteSessionV6913 = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    const prerequisiteV6913 = currentOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(prerequisiteSessionV6913);
    if (prerequisiteV6913?.status === 'waiting') {
      resolveOperatorPrerequisiteFromTrustedUserTurnV6913(kind);
      return true;
    }

    if (!state.running && !pendingSend) return false;
    const session = prerequisiteSessionV6913;
    if (!session) return false;
    enterOperatorControlV626('trusted native user send preempted VIBE automation', {
      source: kind,
    });
    // The native event is deliberately not prevented. The human message remains
    // the highest-priority control-plane event.
    return true;
  }

  function latestUserAssistantBoundaryV626(turnsInput = getTailTurns(), controlInput = currentOperatorControlV626()) {
    const turns = Array.isArray(turnsInput) ? turnsInput : [];
    const control = controlInput || null;
    let operatorTurns = turns;

    if (control?.preemptionBoundary?.turnKey || Number.isFinite(control?.preemptionBoundary?.turnOrder)) {
      operatorTurns = turns.filter(turn =>
        semanticTurnAfterBoundary(turn, control.preemptionBoundary, turns)
      );
    }

    let lastUser = null;
    let lastAssistant = null;

    // Mounted-fallback may enter OPERATOR_CONTROL only after the first user turn
    // already exists. Preserve that exact turn even if no pre-send boundary exists.
    if (control?.firstOperatorTurnKey) {
      lastUser = turns.find(turn => turn.key === control.firstOperatorTurnKey && turn.role === 'user') || null;
    }
    for (const turn of operatorTurns) {
      if (turn.role === 'user') lastUser = turn;
      else if (turn.role === 'assistant') lastAssistant = turn;
    }
    if (lastUser) {
      for (const turn of turns) {
        if (turn.role !== 'assistant') continue;
        if (semanticTurnAfterBoundary(turn, {
          turnKey: lastUser.key || null,
          turnOrder: Number.isFinite(lastUser.order) ? lastUser.order : null,
        }, turns)) {
          lastAssistant = turn;
        }
      }
    }

    const assistantAfterUser = Boolean(
      lastUser && lastAssistant &&
      semanticTurnAfterBoundary(lastAssistant, {
        turnKey: lastUser.key || null,
        turnOrder: Number.isFinite(lastUser.order) ? lastUser.order : null,
      }, turns)
    );
    return { lastUser, lastAssistant, assistantAfterUser, operatorTurns };
  }

  function armOperatorAutoContinueV626(turnsInput = getTailTurns()) {
    const settings = getOperatorUiSettingsV626();
    if (!settings.autoContinue) return false;
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const control = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    if (!session || !control || control.status !== 'active') return false;
    if (operatorAutoContinueTimerV626) return true;
    if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating() || operatorHasComposerDraftV626()) return false;

    const boundary = latestUserAssistantBoundaryV626(turnsInput);
    if (!boundary.assistantAfterUser) return false;

    const assistant = boundary.lastAssistant;
    const assistantStableKey = assistant
      ? `${assistant.key || 'assistant'}:${hashText(assistant.readableText || '')}:${String(assistant.readableText || '').length}`
      : null;
    if (!assistantStableKey) return false;
    if (operatorAssistantStableKeyV626 !== assistantStableKey) {
      operatorAssistantStableKeyV626 = assistantStableKey;
      operatorAssistantStableSinceV626 = Date.now();
      scheduleOperatorControlProcessV626(Number(CONFIG.operatorAutoContinueMinAssistantQuietMs || 1200));
      return false;
    }
    const quietFor = Date.now() - operatorAssistantStableSinceV626;
    if (quietFor < Number(CONFIG.operatorAutoContinueMinAssistantQuietMs || 0)) {
      scheduleOperatorControlProcessV626(
        Math.max(150, Number(CONFIG.operatorAutoContinueMinAssistantQuietMs || 0) - quietFor)
      );
      return false;
    }

    operatorAutoContinueDeadlineV626 = Date.now() + settings.autoContinueDelayMs;
    session.transport.operatorControl = {
      ...control,
      autoContinue: true,
      countdownStartedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      countdownDeadlineAt: new Date(operatorAutoContinueDeadlineV626).toISOString(),
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);

    operatorAutoContinueTimerV626 = setTimeout(() => {
      operatorAutoContinueTimerV626 = null;
      void resumeOperatorControlV626({ mode: 'auto', requireAutoEnabled: true });
    }, settings.autoContinueDelayMs);
    operatorAutoContinueTickV626 = setInterval(() => {
      renderOperatorCountdownOverlayV626();
      renderPanel();
    }, 500);
    renderOperatorCountdownOverlayV626();
    renderPanel();
    return true;
  }

  function resumeLifecycleDecisionV699(input = {}) {
    const running = input.running === true;
    const operatorStatus = String(input.operatorStatus || 'none');
    if (!running && operatorStatus === 'active') return { action: 'START_THEN_RESUME_OPERATOR', running, operatorStatus };
    if (!running) return { action: 'START', running, operatorStatus };
    if (operatorStatus === 'active') return { action: 'RESUME_OPERATOR', running, operatorStatus };
    return { action: 'ALREADY_RUNNABLE', running, operatorStatus };
  }

  function canonicalResumeLifecycleAcceptanceV699() {
    const cases = {
      stoppedActive: resumeLifecycleDecisionV699({ running: false, operatorStatus: 'active' }).action === 'START_THEN_RESUME_OPERATOR',
      stoppedNoControl: resumeLifecycleDecisionV699({ running: false, operatorStatus: 'none' }).action === 'START',
      runningActive: resumeLifecycleDecisionV699({ running: true, operatorStatus: 'active' }).action === 'RESUME_OPERATOR',
      runningResumed: resumeLifecycleDecisionV699({ running: true, operatorStatus: 'resumed' }).action === 'ALREADY_RUNNABLE',
    };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-canonical-resume-lifecycle-acceptance/v1',
      ok: Object.values(cases).every(Boolean),
      sections: cases,
      contract: {
        manualResumeStartsStoppedRunner: true,
        alphaResumeCanFinishStopped: false,
        operatorPauseIsExplicitBlocker: true,
        canonicalResumePath: 'START_IF_NEEDED -> OPERATOR_RESUME_IF_ACTIVE -> RUNNABLE_OR_EXPLICIT_BLOCKER',
      },
    };
  }

  function externalTransportHoldRecoveryEligibilityV6911(sessionInput = null) {
