  async function recoverExternalTransportHoldV6911(options = {}) {
    const before = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const eligibility = externalTransportHoldRecoveryEligibilityV6911(before);
    if (!eligibility.eligible) {
      return { schema: 'vibe-go-external-hold-recovery/v1', attempted: false, recovered: false, eligibility };
    }

    const token = externalTransportHoldTokenV6911(before);
    await recordExternalHoldRecoveryAttemptV6911({
      status: 'PROBING',
      holdToken: token,
      holdRevision: eligibility.revision,
      holdReason: eligibility.reason,
      route: 'POST /v1/ops',
      operation: 'PING',
      authority: String(options.authority || 'explicit-resume'),
    });

    let probeResults;
    try {
      // Same-route-or-stronger recovery: the HOLD was caused by the Project Data
      // operation route, so GET /v1/status alone is insufficient proof. PING must
      // traverse the normal POST /v1/ops provider path before the HOLD can clear.
      probeResults = await applyProjectDataOpsV670([{ op: 'PING' }], before);
    } catch (error) {
      await recordExternalHoldRecoveryAttemptV6911({
        status: 'BLOCKED',
        holdToken: token,
        holdRevision: eligibility.revision,
        holdReason: eligibility.reason,
        route: 'POST /v1/ops',
        operation: 'PING',
        error: error?.message || String(error),
        errorCode: error?.code || null,
        failureDomain: error?.failureDomain || null,
      });
      const held = SemanticSessionStore.load() || before;
      state.running = false;
      setPhase('hold', held?.hold?.reason || eligibility.reason);
      renderPanel();
      return {
        schema: 'vibe-go-external-hold-recovery/v1',
        attempted: true,
        recovered: false,
        reason: 'same-route-project-data-probe-failed',
        error: error?.message || String(error),
        eligibility,
      };
    }

    const ping = (Array.isArray(probeResults) ? probeResults : []).find(item =>
      normalizeProjectDataOpV670(item) === 'PING'
    ) || (Array.isArray(probeResults) ? probeResults[0] : null);
    if (!ping || ping.ok !== true) {
      await recordExternalHoldRecoveryAttemptV6911({
        status: 'BLOCKED',
        holdToken: token,
        holdRevision: eligibility.revision,
        holdReason: eligibility.reason,
        route: 'POST /v1/ops',
        operation: 'PING',
        error: String(ping?.error || 'POST /v1/ops PING did not return ok:true'),
      });
      const held = SemanticSessionStore.load() || before;
      state.running = false;
      setPhase('hold', held?.hold?.reason || eligibility.reason);
      renderPanel();
      return {
        schema: 'vibe-go-external-hold-recovery/v1',
        attempted: true,
        recovered: false,
        reason: 'same-route-project-data-probe-not-ok',
        ping: cloneSemanticValue(ping),
        eligibility,
      };
    }

    // Refresh durable async/promise authority only after the exact operation route
    // is proven healthy. This allows the first post-HOLD dispatch to see fulfilled
    // promises/jobs created or resolved while the runner was parked.
    await pollProjectDataStatusV673().catch(() => null);

    const current = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const currentEligibility = externalTransportHoldRecoveryEligibilityV6911(current);
    const currentToken = externalTransportHoldTokenV6911(current);
    if (!currentEligibility.eligible || currentToken !== token) {
      await recordExternalHoldRecoveryAttemptV6911({
        status: 'STALE_PROBE_IGNORED',
        holdToken: token,
        observedHoldToken: currentToken,
        route: 'POST /v1/ops',
        operation: 'PING',
      });
      return {
        schema: 'vibe-go-external-hold-recovery/v1',
        attempted: true,
        recovered: false,
        reason: 'hold-authority-changed-during-probe',
        eligibility: currentEligibility,
      };
    }

    current.status = 'active';
    current.hold = null;
    current.transport ||= {};
    current.transport.externalHoldRecoveryV6911 = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-external-hold-recovery-witness/v1',
      recoveredAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      recoveredRevision: Number(current.revision || 0),
      previousHoldRevision: eligibility.revision,
      previousHoldAt: eligibility.holdAt,
      previousHoldReason: eligibility.reason,
      route: 'POST /v1/ops',
      operation: 'PING',
      ping: cloneSemanticValue(ping),
      authority: String(options.authority || 'explicit-resume'),
      instruction: 'External transport blocker is resolved. Replan from current durable Project Data/promise authority; stale pre-HOLD focus is advisory only.',
    };
    current.transport.lastExternalHoldRecoveryAttemptV6911 = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-external-hold-recovery-attempt/v1',
      at: semanticIsoNow(),
      status: 'RECOVERED',
      holdToken: token,
      route: 'POST /v1/ops',
      operation: 'PING',
    };
    current.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(current);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    // Re-anchor while the runner is still stopped. This deliberately rebuilds the
    // next causal dispatch from the current mounted tail + refreshed Project Data
    // authority before start() is allowed to process/send anything.
    const reanchor = await reanchorSemanticTransport({
      reason: 'A09.11 external transport HOLD recovered; abandon stale pre-HOLD plan and replan from current durable authority',
      recoverFromTail: false,
      forceFullProtocolRefeed: false,
    });
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-external-hold-recovery/v1',
      attempted: true,
      recovered: true,
      eligibility,
      ping: cloneSemanticValue(ping),
      reanchor: cloneSemanticValue(reanchor),
    };
  }


  const OPERATOR_PREREQUISITE_SCHEMA_V6912 = 'vibe-go-operator-prerequisite/v1';

  function currentOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const gate = session?.transport?.operatorPrerequisiteV6912 || null;
    if (!gate || gate.schema !== OPERATOR_PREREQUISITE_SCHEMA_V6912) return null;
    return gate;
  }

  function operatorPrerequisitePayloadV6912(payloadInput = {}, markerMeta = {}, timestamp = semanticIsoNow()) {
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : {};
    const raw = payload.operatorPrerequisite || payload.operator_prerequisite || {};
    const reason = String(raw.reason || payload.reason || payload.summary || '').trim();
    if (!reason) throw new Error('WAIT_OPERATOR requires operatorPrerequisite.reason or summary');
    return {
      schema: OPERATOR_PREREQUISITE_SCHEMA_V6912,
      id: String(raw.id || semanticId('operator-prerequisite')),
      status: 'waiting',
      kind: String(raw.kind || 'LOCAL_TOOLING_PREREQUISITE'),
      reason,
      instruction: String(raw.instruction || raw.action || 'Complete the external prerequisite and send the result in a normal user message.').trim(),
      completion: 'EXPLICIT_FULFILLMENT_OR_OVERRIDE; TRUSTED_USER_TURN_ONLY_RELEASES_TRANSPORT_WAIT',
      openedAt: timestamp,
      semanticRevision: Number(payload.baseRevision ?? SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.revision ?? 0),
      sourceDispatchId: String(payload.dispatchId || markerMeta.dispatchId || ''),
      sourceControlId: String(markerMeta.id || ''),
      provenance: 'MODEL_DECLARED_OPERATOR_PREREQUISITE',
    };
  }

  function waitOperatorPayloadHasForbiddenMutationV6912(payloadInput = {}) {
    const payload = payloadInput && typeof payloadInput === 'object' ? payloadInput : {};
    const mutationKeys = [
      'sourceOps', 'workingOps', 'workspaceOps', 'specOps', 'projectOps',
      'sourceCursor', 'cursor', 'workingChange', 'readyDistances', 'resumeDistances',
      'activeDistance', 'nextDistance', 'strategicFrontier', 'strategy', 'notes',
      'promises', 'decisions', 'direction', 'reminder', 'strategyReminder',
    ];
    return mutationKeys.filter(key => {
      if (!(key in payload)) return false;
      const value = payload[key];
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length > 0;
      if (value && typeof value === 'object') return Object.keys(value).length > 0;
      return value != null && value !== '';
    });
  }

  function openOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(session, payload, markerMeta, timestamp) {
    const forbidden = waitOperatorPayloadHasForbiddenMutationV6912(payload);
    if (forbidden.length) {
      throw new Error(`WAIT_OPERATOR is transport-only and cannot carry semantic/mutation fields: ${forbidden.join(', ')}`);
    }
    session.transport ||= {};
    session.transport.operatorPrerequisiteV6912 = operatorPrerequisitePayloadV6912(payload, markerMeta, timestamp);
    return session.transport.operatorPrerequisiteV6912;
  }

  function legacyOperatorPrerequisiteHoldEligibilityV6912(sessionInput = null) {

      normalized.includes('missing local analyzer registration') ||
      normalized.includes('unknown analyzer') ||
      normalized.includes('save_analyzer first') ||

    );
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-legacy-operator-prerequisite-hold-eligibility/v1',
      eligible: Boolean(session && session.status === 'hold' && missingAnalyzer),
      sessionId: session?.id || null,
      revision: Number(session?.revision || 0),
      reason,
      reasonClass: missingAnalyzer ? 'LOCAL_ANALYZER_REGISTRATION' : 'NON_OPERATOR_PREREQUISITE_HOLD',
    };
  }

  function resolveOperatorPrerequisiteFromTrustedUserTurnV6913(source = 'trusted-user-turn') {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();

  async function resolveOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(options = {}) {
    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const gate = currentOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(session);
    if (!session || !gate || gate.status !== 'waiting') {
      return { resumed: false, reason: 'no-waiting-operator-prerequisite' };
    }
    const mode = String(options.mode || 'manual');
    if (mode !== 'manual') {
      return { resumed: false, reason: 'operator-prerequisite-requires-explicit-manual-resume', gate: cloneSemanticValue(gate) };
    }
    session.transport.operatorPrerequisiteV6912 = {
      ...gate,
      status: 'released',
      releasedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      releaseAuthority: String(options.authority || 'explicit-manual-resume'),
      fulfillmentStatus: options.fulfilled === true ? 'asserted-by-operator' : 'unknown',
      resolutionNote: String(options.note || 'Operator explicitly released/overrode the wait; factual success remains subject to verification unless fulfillment was explicitly asserted.'),
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    const result = await reanchorSemanticTransport({
      reason: `A09.13 operator prerequisite transport wait released by manual Resume fallback; replan from semantic r${Number(session.revision || 0)} without treating the prerequisite as semantic meaning`,
      forceFullProtocolRefeed: false,
    });
    session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (session?.transport?.operatorPrerequisiteV6912?.id === gate.id) {
      session.transport.operatorPrerequisiteV6912 = {
        ...session.transport.operatorPrerequisiteV6912,
        resumeBoundary: cloneSemanticValue(result?.boundary || null),
        resumeDispatchId: result?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      };
      session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }
    setPhase('active', 'Operator prerequisite wait released · replanned from unchanged semantic revision');
    scheduleProcess(80);
    renderPanel();
    return {
      resumed: true,
      mode,
      operatorPrerequisite: true,
      semanticRevision: Number(session?.revision || gate.semanticRevision || 0),
      gate: cloneSemanticValue(session?.transport?.operatorPrerequisiteV6912 || gate),
      result,
    };
  }

  function operatorPrerequisiteAcceptanceV6912() {
    const seed = SemanticSessionStore.peek();

    const base = cloneSemanticValue(seed);

  async function resumeOperatorControlV626(options = {}) {
    const mode = String(options.mode || 'manual');
    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    let control = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    const initialDecisionV699 = resumeLifecycleDecisionV699({ running: state.running, operatorStatus: control?.status || 'none' });

    let operatorPrerequisiteV6912 = currentOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(session);
    if (operatorPrerequisiteV6912?.status === 'waiting') {
      if (mode !== 'manual') {
        return { resumed: false, reason: 'operator-prerequisite-awaits-trusted-user-turn-or-manual-resume', gate: cloneSemanticValue(operatorPrerequisiteV6912) };
      }
      // A stopped runner is lifecycle state, not prerequisite completion. Start it
      // first; processTail will remain parked on the waiting operator gate until
      // this same explicit Resume resolves the gate below.
      if (!state.running) {
        const startResultV6912 = await start({ explicit: true, reason: 'A09.13 operator prerequisite manual-resume fallback preflight' });
        if (!state.running) {
          return { resumed: false, reason: 'runner-start-blocked-before-operator-prerequisite-release', gate: cloneSemanticValue(operatorPrerequisiteV6912), startResult: startResultV6912 };
        }
        session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
        control = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
        operatorPrerequisiteV6912 = currentOperatorPrerequisiteV6912(session);
      }
      return resolveOperatorPrerequisiteV6912({ mode, authority: String(options.source || 'operator-resume') });
    }

    if (mode === 'manual' && !state.running) {
      const startResultV699 = await start({ explicit: true, reason: 'canonical manual resume start preflight' });
      if (!state.running) {
        recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('blocked-runner-start', {
          mode,
          decision: initialDecisionV699.action,
          phase: state.phase,
          detail: state.detail,
        });
        return { resumed: false, reason: 'runner-start-blocked', decision: initialDecisionV699, startResult: startResultV699, status: status() };
      }
      session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      control = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
      if (!session || !control || control.status !== 'active') {
        setPhase('active', 'Manual resume started runner; no operator blocker remains');
        renderPanel();
        return { resumed: true, mode, startedRunner: true, operatorControl: false, decision: initialDecisionV699, result: startResultV699 };
      }
    }

    if (!session || !control || control.status !== 'active') {
      return { resumed: false, reason: state.running ? 'operator-control-not-active-runner-already-running' : 'operator-control-not-active', decision: initialDecisionV699 };
    }
    recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('requested', { mode, decision: initialDecisionV699.action, runnerWasRunning: initialDecisionV699.running });
    const settings = getOperatorUiSettingsV626();
    if (options.requireAutoEnabled === true && !settings.autoContinue) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      return { resumed: false, reason: 'auto-continue-disabled' };
    }
    if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating() || operatorHasComposerDraftV626()) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      scheduleOperatorControlProcessV626(700);
      recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('blocked-unstable', {
        mode,
        generating: Boolean(isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()),
        composerHasDraft: operatorHasComposerDraftV626(),
      });
      return { resumed: false, reason: 'operator-boundary-not-stable' };
    }
    const turns = getTailTurns();
    const boundary = latestUserAssistantBoundaryV626(turns);
    // a36: explicit manual Resume is operator authority. A mounted user→assistant
    // conversational boundary is required for automatic continuation only; manual
    // resume must remain usable when ChatGPT virtualization has unmounted the user
    // turn, provided generation is stopped and the native composer is empty.
    if (mode !== 'manual' && !control.manualHold && !boundary.assistantAfterUser) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      scheduleOperatorControlProcessV626(700);
      recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('blocked-conversation-boundary', { mode });
      return { resumed: false, reason: 'assistant-has-not-completed-operator-turn' };
    }

    clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
    session.transport.operatorControl = {
      ...control,
      status: 'resuming',
      resumeMode: mode,
      resumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      countdownStartedAt: null,
      countdownDeadlineAt: null,
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('reanchoring', { mode, assistantAfterUser: Boolean(boundary.assistantAfterUser) });
    let result;
    try {
      result = await reanchorSemanticTransport({
        reason: `${mode} operator resume; abandon stale pre-interruption plan and replan from factual current tail`,
        forceFullProtocolRefeed: false,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('failed', { mode, error: error?.message || String(error) });
      throw error;
    }

    const resumed = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (resumed) {
      const latest = currentOperatorControlV626(resumed) || control;
      resumed.transport.operatorControl = {
        ...latest,
        status: 'resumed',
        resumeMode: mode,
        resumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        resumeBoundary: cloneSemanticValue(result?.boundary || null),
        countdownStartedAt: null,
        countdownDeadlineAt: null,
      };
      resumed.transport.pausedByUser = false;
      resumed.transport.pauseReason = '';
      resumed.transport.pausedAt = null;
      resumed.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(resumed);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }
    recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('resumed', {
      mode,
      pendingDispatchId: result?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      forceFullProtocolRefeed: false,
    });
    if (!state.running) {
      recordOperatorResumeAttemptV636('failed-runner-not-running', { mode });
      setPhase('paused', 'Operator resume re-anchored semantic state but runner is not running');
      renderPanel();
      return { resumed: false, reason: 'runner-not-running-after-resume', mode, result, status: status() };
    }
    setPhase('active', `Operator ${mode} resume · replanned from current tail`);
    scheduleProcess(80);
    renderPanel();
    return { resumed: true, mode, startedRunner: initialDecisionV699.running !== true, operatorControl: true, decision: initialDecisionV699, result };
  }

  function cancelOperatorAutoContinueV626(reason = 'operator chose to remain paused') {

  function handleOperatorControlCycleV626(turnsInput = getTailTurns()) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const control = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    if (!session || !control || control.status !== 'active') return { handled: false };

    if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      return {
        handled: true,
        phase: 'waiting',
        reason: '👤 Operator control · жду завершения assistant ответа',
        retryAfterMs: 700,
      };
    }
    if (operatorHasComposerDraftV626()) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      return {
        handled: true,
        phase: 'paused',
        reason: '👤 Operator control · пользователь печатает',
        retryAfterMs: 700,
      };
    }

    const boundary = latestUserAssistantBoundaryV626(turnsInput);
    if (!boundary.assistantAfterUser) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      return {
        handled: true,
        phase: 'paused',
        reason: '👤 Operator control · ожидаю conversational boundary',
        retryAfterMs: 700,
      };
    }

    const settings = getOperatorUiSettingsV626();
    if (control.manualHold) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      return {
        handled: true,
        phase: 'paused',
        reason: '👤 Operator control · explicit manual pause',
      };
    }
    if (!settings.autoContinue) {
      clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
      return {
        handled: true,
        phase: 'paused',
        reason: '👤 Operator control · Resume вручную',
      };
    }
    armOperatorAutoContinueV626(turnsInput);
    const leftMs = operatorAutoContinueDeadlineV626
      ? Math.max(0, operatorAutoContinueDeadlineV626 - Date.now())
      : settings.autoContinueDelayMs;
    return {
      handled: true,
      phase: 'paused',
      reason: `👤 Auto-continue через ${Math.ceil(leftMs / 1000)}с`,
      retryAfterMs: Math.min(700, Math.max(200, leftMs)),
    };
  }

  const USER_INTERRUPTION_PROMISE_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-user-interruption-promise/v1';
  const USER_INTERRUPTION_ACTIVE_STATUSES = new Set([
    'armed',
    'waiting-safe-point',
    'sending',
    'paused',
  ]);

  function currentUserInterruptionPromise(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const promise = sessionInput?.transport?.interruptionPromise || null;
    if (!promise || promise.schema !== USER_INTERRUPTION_PROMISE_SCHEMA) return null;
    return promise;
  }

  function semanticContinuationAnchor(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session) return null;
    const control = semanticTransportControlBoundary(session);
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-semantic-continuation-anchor/v1',
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      controlId: control?.id || null,
      controlType: control?.type || null,
      controlTurnKey: control?.turnKey || null,
      controlTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(control?.turnOrder) ? control.turnOrder : null,
      // Generic boundary aliases keep mounted-turn confirmation compatible with
      // semanticTurnAfterBoundary without inventing a second coordinate model.
      turnKey: control?.turnKey || null,
      turnOrder: Number.isFinite(control?.turnOrder) ? control.turnOrder : null,
      activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
      activity: session.route?.activity || null,
      workingRevision: session.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number(session.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision || 0),
      nextOffset: Number(session.sourceCursor?.nextOffset || 0),
      capturedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  function saveUserInterruptionPromise(patch, { requireExisting = true } = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('User interruption requires an active SemanticSession');
    const current = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
    if (requireExisting && !current) return null;
    session.transport.interruptionPromise = {
      ...(current ? cloneSemanticValue(current) : {}),
      ...(patch ? cloneSemanticValue(patch) : {}),
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    return SemanticSessionStore.save(session).transport.interruptionPromise;
  }

  function armUserInterruption(messageInput) {
    const message = String(messageInput || '').trim();
    if (!message) throw new Error('Сообщение для вмешательства пустое');
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('User interruption requires an active SemanticSession');
    const existing = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
    if (existing && USER_INTERRUPTION_ACTIVE_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
      throw new Error(`Interruption ${existing.id} уже активна (${existing.status})`);
    }

    if (pendingSend?.protocolName === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name) {
      const owner = ProtocolRuntime.getByName(pendingSend.protocolName);
      owner?.markDispatchCancelled?.(
        pendingSend.dispatch,
        'user interruption promise armed before physical send'
      );
      clearPendingSend();
    }

    const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const promise = {
      schema: USER_INTERRUPTION_PROMISE_SCHEMA,
      id: semanticId('user-interruption'),
      message,
      status: 'armed',
      requestedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requestedRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      requestedPendingDispatchId: pending?.id || null,
      requestedPendingStatus: pending?.status || null,
      continuationAnchor: null,
      mountedTurnKey: null,
      mountedTurnOrder: null,
      sentAt: null,
      resumedAt: null,
      cancelReason: null,
    };
    session.transport.interruptionPromise = promise;
    session.transport.pauseReason = 'User interruption requested; waiting for durable safe point';
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    scheduleProcess(40);
    renderPanel();
    return cloneSemanticValue(promise);
  }

  function cancelUserInterruption(reason = 'cancelled by user before delivery') {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return false;
    const promise = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
    if (!promise || !['armed', 'waiting-safe-point'].includes(promise.status)) return false;
    session.transport.interruptionPromise = {
      ...promise,
      status: 'cancelled',
      cancelledAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      cancelReason: String(reason || ''),
    };
    session.transport.pauseReason = '';
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    scheduleProcess(40);
    renderPanel();
    return true;
  }

  function semanticPendingDispatchIsInFlight(sessionInput, turns = getTailTurns()) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (!pending) return false;
    const mounted = findMountedSemanticDispatchTurn(pending, turns);
    const status = String(pending.status || 'ready');
    if (mounted) return true;
    return ['submitting', 'submitted', 'generating', 'submit-unconfirmed'].includes(status);
  }

  function findMountedUserTextAfterBoundary(message, boundary, turns = getTailTurns()) {
    const normalized = normalizeText(message);
    return turns.find(turn => {
      if (turn.role !== 'user') return false;
      if (!semanticTurnAfterBoundary(turn, boundary, turns)) return false;
      return normalizeText(turn.readableText) === normalized;
    }) || null;
  }

  async function waitForMountedUserTextAfterBoundary(
    message,
    boundary,
    timeoutMs = CONFIG.sendMountConfirmMs
  ) {
    const deadline = now() + Math.max(0, Number(timeoutMs || 0));
    let mounted = findMountedUserTextAfterBoundary(message, boundary);
    while (!mounted && now() < deadline) {
      await sleep(280);
      mounted = findMountedUserTextAfterBoundary(message, boundary);
    }
    return mounted;
  }

  async function deliverUserInterruptionAtSafePoint(turnsInput = getTailTurns()) {
    if (await enforceModelContinuityGuardV622('user-interruption-preflight', { allowArm: true })) return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'model continuity guard paused transport' };
    if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate('user-interruption-preflight')) {
      return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'platform pressure paused transport' };
    }

    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const promise = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
    if (!session || !promise || !['armed', 'waiting-safe-point'].includes(promise.status)) {
      return { handled: false };
    }
    if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) {
      if (promise.status !== 'waiting-safe-point') {
        saveUserInterruptionPromise({ status: 'waiting-safe-point' });
      }
      return {
        handled: true,
        delivered: false,
        reason: 'Вмешательство поставлено в очередь; жду завершения текущего assistant turn и принятого VIBE_STATE',
      };
    }

    const turns = turnsInput || getTailTurns();
    if (semanticPendingDispatchIsInFlight(session, turns)) {
      if (promise.status !== 'waiting-safe-point') {
        saveUserInterruptionPromise({ status: 'waiting-safe-point' });
      }
      // Do not short-circuit the normal exchange inspector here. It still needs
      // to observe the in-flight assistant turn, accept/repair its VIBE_STATE,
      // and only then may the interruption become deliverable.
      return {
        handled: false,
        waitingSafePoint: true,
        reason: 'Вмешательство ждёт durable state от уже отправленного semantic dispatch',
      };
    }

    if (pendingSend?.protocolName === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name) {
      const owner = ProtocolRuntime.getByName(pendingSend.protocolName);
      owner?.markDispatchCancelled?.(
        pendingSend.dispatch,
        'user interruption reached safe point before physical semantic send'
      );
      clearPendingSend();
    }

    session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (pending && !findMountedSemanticDispatchTurn(pending, turns)) {
      session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    }
    const anchor = semanticContinuationAnchor(session);
    session.transport.interruptionPromise = {
      ...currentUserInterruptionPromise(session),
      status: 'sending',
      continuationAnchor: anchor,
      safePointAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    session.transport.pausedByUser = true;
    session.transport.pauseReason = 'Sending queued user interruption at durable semantic safe point';
    session.transport.pausedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    const deliveryBoundaryTurn = turns.at(-1) || null;
    const deliveryBoundary = deliveryBoundaryTurn
      ? {
          turnKey: deliveryBoundaryTurn.key || null,
          turnOrder: Number.isFinite(deliveryBoundaryTurn.order) ? deliveryBoundaryTurn.order : null,
        }
      : { turnKey: anchor?.turnKey || null, turnOrder: anchor?.turnOrder ?? null };

    const composer = findComposer();
    if (!composer) {
      saveUserInterruptionPromise({
        status: 'waiting-safe-point',
        lastError: 'Composer not found while delivering user interruption',
      });
      return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'Composer не найден; interruption остаётся в очереди' };
    }
    setComposerText(composer, promise.message);
    const sendButton = await waitForEnabledSendButton();
    if (!sendButton) {
      if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate('user-interruption-send-button-wait')) {
        return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'platform pressure paused transport' };
      }
      saveUserInterruptionPromise({
        status: 'waiting-safe-point',
        lastError: 'Send button unavailable while delivering user interruption',
      });
      return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'Send button недоступен; interruption остаётся в очереди' };
    }

    if (await enforceModelContinuityGuardV622('user-interruption-before-click', { allowArm: true })) return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'model continuity guard paused transport' };
    if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate('user-interruption-before-click')) {
      return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'platform pressure paused transport' };
    }
    const usageInterruptionV625 = usageGovernorDecisionV625('user-interruption:preflight');
    if (!usageInterruptionV625.allowed) {
      saveUserInterruptionPromise({
        status: 'waiting-safe-point',
        lastError: `Usage governor delayed interruption: ${usageInterruptionV625.reason}`,
      });
      setPhase('delay', `usage governor задержал interruption · ${usageInterruptionV625.reason}`);
      scheduleProcess(Math.max(1000, Number(usageInterruptionV625.waitMs || 0)));
      return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'usage governor delayed user interruption' };
    }

    if (!(await verifySemanticRuntimeLeaseV616())) {
      return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'durable semantic writer lease lost before user-interruption send' };
    }
    if (!clickSendButtonWithPermitV616(sendButton, 'user-interruption', promise.message)) {
      return { handled: true, delivered: false, reason: 'physical send gate denied user interruption' };
    }
    const mounted = await waitForMountedUserTextAfterBoundary(
      promise.message,
      deliveryBoundary,
      CONFIG.sendMountConfirmMs
    );
    if (!mounted) {
      session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      const uncertainPromise = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
      session.transport.interruptionPromise = {
        ...uncertainPromise,
        status: 'paused',
        deliveryConfirmed: false,
        deliveryAttemptedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        deliveryBoundary: cloneSemanticValue(deliveryBoundary),
        lastError: 'Physical click did not produce mounted interruption user turn; automatic resend suppressed',
      };
      session.transport.pausedByUser = true;
      session.transport.pauseReason = 'Interruption send is unconfirmed; automatic resend suppressed to avoid duplicate user message';
      session.transport.pausedAt = session.transport.pausedAt || semanticIsoNow();
      session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      return {
        handled: true,
        delivered: true,
        reason: 'Interruption click не подтверждён mounted user turn; автоповтор запрещён, VIBE поставлен на безопасную паузу',
      };
    }

    session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const latestPromise = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
    session.transport.interruptionPromise = {
      ...latestPromise,
      status: 'paused',
      mountedTurnKey: mounted.key || null,
      mountedTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(mounted.order) ? mounted.order : null,
      sentAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      deliveryConfirmed: true,
      deliveryBoundary: cloneSemanticValue(deliveryBoundary),
      lastError: null,
    };
    session.transport.pausedByUser = true;
    session.transport.pauseReason = 'User interruption delivered; VIBE automation paused until explicit resume';
    session.transport.pausedAt = session.transport.pausedAt || semanticIsoNow();
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    renderPanel();
    return {
      handled: true,
      delivered: true,
      reason: 'Пользовательское вмешательство отправлено; continuation anchor сохранён, VIBE на паузе',
      mountedTurn: mounted,
      continuationAnchor: anchor,
    };
  }

  async function resumeUserInterruption() {
    const readiness = await ensureSemanticSessionReady({
      reason: 'resume user interruption',
      recoverFromTail: true,
    });
    const session = readiness.session;
    const promise = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
    if (!promise || promise.status !== 'paused') {
      throw new Error('Нет доставленного user interruption, ожидающего resume');
    }
    if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) {
      throw new Error('Нельзя продолжить VIBE, пока assistant отвечает на пользовательское вмешательство');
    }

    session.transport.interruptionPromise = {
      ...promise,
      status: 'resuming',
      resumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    const result = await reanchorSemanticTransport({
      reason: `resume after user interruption ${promise.id}; preserve semantic continuation anchor r${promise.continuationAnchor?.semanticRevision ?? session.revision}`,
      forceFullProtocolRefeed: false,
    });
    const resumed = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (resumed) {
      resumed.transport.interruptionPromise = {
        ...(currentUserInterruptionPromise(resumed) || promise),
        status: 'resumed',
        resumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        resumeBoundary: cloneSemanticValue(result.boundary || null),
      };
      resumed.transport.pausedByUser = false;
      resumed.transport.pauseReason = '';
      resumed.transport.pausedAt = null;
      resumed.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(resumed);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }
    scheduleProcess(80);
    renderPanel();
    return result;
  }

  async function reanchorSemanticTransport(options = {}) {
    const readiness = await ensureSemanticSessionReady({
      reason: String(options.reason || 'semantic transport re-anchor'),
      recoverFromTail: options.recoverFromTail !== false,
      requireRecoverySuccess: options.requireRecoverySuccess === true,
    });
    const session = readiness.session;
    if (isGenerating()) {
      throw new Error('Cannot re-anchor semantic transport while assistant is generating');
    }

    if (pendingSend) {
      const owner = ProtocolRuntime.getByName(pendingSend.protocolName);
      owner?.markDispatchCancelled?.(
        pendingSend.dispatch,
        'semantic transport re-anchor replaced pending timer'
      );
    }
    clearPendingSend();

    const turns = getTailTurns();
    const tail = turns.at(-1) || null;
    if (!tail) throw new Error('Cannot re-anchor semantic transport without a mounted tail turn');

    const previousPending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const previousControl = semanticTransportControlBoundary(session);
    const boundary = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-semantic-transport-reanchor/v1',
      id: semanticId('semantic-reanchor'),
      revision: Number(session.revision),
      turnKey: tail.key || null,
      turnOrder: Number.isFinite(tail.order) ? tail.order : null,
      capturedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      reason: String(options.reason || 'abandon unaccepted semantic attempt and issue a fresh causal dispatch'),
      forceFullProtocolRefeed: options.forceFullProtocolRefeed === true,
      previousPendingDispatchId: previousPending?.id || null,
      previousControlId: previousControl?.id || null,
    };

    session.transport = {
      ...session.transport,
      reanchorBoundary: boundary,
      pendingDispatch: null,
      pausedByUser: false,
      pauseReason: '',
      pausedAt: null,
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);

    state.tailWatchKey = null;
    state.tailWatchSince = 0;

    const pending = ensureSemanticPendingDispatch(SemanticSessionStore.load());
    scheduleProcess(100);
    log('Semantic transport re-anchored without semantic/source revision change', {
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: session.revision,
      boundary,
      pendingDispatchId: pending.id,
      workingRevision: session.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
    });
    return {
      reanchored: true,
      semanticRevision: session.revision,
      workingRevision: session.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      boundary: cloneSemanticValue(boundary),
      pendingDispatch: cloneSemanticValue(pending),
    };
  }

  function findMountedSemanticDispatchTurn(dispatch, turns = getTailTurns()) {
    if (!dispatch?.id) return null;
    const markerPrefix = `[[VIBE_DISPATCH id=${dispatch.id} `;
    return turns.find(turn =>
      turn.role === 'user' &&
      String(turn.readableText || turn.markerText || '').includes(markerPrefix)
    ) || null;
  }

  async function waitForMountedSemanticDispatchTurn(
    dispatch,
    timeoutMs = CONFIG.sendMountConfirmMs
  ) {
    const deadline = now() + Math.max(0, Number(timeoutMs || 0));
    let mounted = findMountedSemanticDispatchTurn(dispatch);
    while (!mounted && now() < deadline) {
      await sleep(320);
      mounted = findMountedSemanticDispatchTurn(dispatch);
    }
    return mounted;
  }

  function inspectSemanticExchange(control, turns, dispatch) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) {
      return { action: 'idle', reason: 'Semantic session is not initialized' };
    }
    const tail = semanticTailAfterControl(turns, control);
    if (!tail) {
      const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
      const pendingStatus = String(pending?.status || '');
      const detachedProvenUnsent = Boolean(
        Array.isArray(turns) &&
        turns.length === 0 &&
        pending &&
        (pendingStatus === 'ready' || pendingStatus === 'queued') &&
        String(pending.id || '') === String(dispatch?.id || '') &&
        String(pending.controlId || '') === String(dispatch?.controlId || '') &&
        Number(pending.baseRevision) === Number(dispatch?.baseRevision)
      );

      // a20: ready/queued are durable proof that no physical click has happened.
      // Runtime timers disappear on package reload and the mounted conversation tail
      // may transiently be empty. In that narrow state it is safe to recreate the
      // send timer for the exact persisted causal envelope. Never extend this rule to
      // submitting/submitted/generating/submit-unconfirmed: those states may already
      // have crossed the physical-send boundary and remain fail-closed. Also require
      // turns.length === 0; if some newer DOM tail exists while the accepted control
      // is detached, unseen user intervention cannot be excluded.
      if (detachedProvenUnsent) {
        state.tailWatchKey = null;
        state.tailWatchSince = 0;
        setSemanticUserPause(false);
        return {
          action: 'send',
          kind: 'normal',
          reason: `durable semantic dispatch ${dispatch.id} остаётся proven-unsent (${pendingStatus}); восстанавливаю send timer при пустом mounted tail`,
        };
      }

      if (control?.synthetic && Array.isArray(turns) && turns.length === 0) {
        state.tailWatchKey = null;
        state.tailWatchSince = 0;
        setSemanticUserPause(false);
        return {
          action: 'send',
          kind: 'normal',
          reason: 'semantic rollover/bootstrap готов к первому dispatch в пустом чате',
        };
      }
      return {
        action: 'idle',
        reason: 'Semantic control boundary больше не смонтирован; историю назад не сканирую',
      };
    }
    if (!tail.length) {
      state.tailWatchKey = null;
      state.tailWatchSince = 0;

      // Restart/reload invariant: absence of a mounted tail is not evidence that a
      // previously submitted dispatch was never sent. `pendingDispatch` is durable
      // authority and survives page/runtime restarts, while ChatGPT's conversation
      // DOM may hydrate later. Never turn that temporary DOM absence into a second
      // model-facing send for the same causal envelope.
      const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
      const pendingStatus = String(pending?.status || 'ready');
      const pendingMatchesDispatch = Boolean(
        pending &&
        String(pending.id || '') === String(dispatch?.id || '') &&
        Number(pending.baseRevision) === Number(dispatch?.baseRevision)
      );
      const detachedInflightStatuses = new Set([
        'submitting',
        'submitted',
        'generating',
        'submit-unconfirmed',
      ]);
      if (pendingMatchesDispatch && detachedInflightStatuses.has(pendingStatus)) {
        const submittedAt = Date.parse(
          pending.submittedAt ||
          pending.sentAt ||
          pending.submitStartedAt ||
          pending.queuedAt ||
          ''
        );
        const elapsed = Number.isFinite(submittedAt)
          ? Math.max(0, now() - submittedAt)
          : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

        if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) {
          setSemanticUserPause(false);
          return {
            action: 'wait',
            retryAfterMs: CONFIG.assistantTailPollMs,
            reason:
              `Persisted semantic dispatch ${dispatch.id} остаётся in-flight (${pendingStatus}); ` +
              'assistant activity видна, повторная отправка запрещена',
          };
        }

        // `submit-unconfirmed` is already the durable result of a physical click
        // that lacked both mounted-turn and assistant-activity confirmation. On a
        // restart it must require explicit operator recovery rather than another
        // click. Other in-flight states get a bounded DOM rehydration window.
        if (
          pendingStatus !== 'submit-unconfirmed' &&
          elapsed < CONFIG.semanticDetachedInflightGraceMs
        ) {
          return {
            action: 'wait',
            retryAfterMs: Math.min(2500, Math.max(500, CONFIG.semanticDetachedInflightGraceMs - elapsed)),
            reason:
              `Persisted semantic dispatch ${dispatch.id} уже отправлялся (${pendingStatus}); ` +
              `жду rehydrate mounted tail без resend (${Math.ceil((CONFIG.semanticDetachedInflightGraceMs - elapsed) / 1000)}с)`,
          };
        }

        const reason =
          `Persisted semantic dispatch ${dispatch.id} имеет in-flight status ${pendingStatus}, ` +
          'но matching mounted tail сейчас отсутствует. Reload/virtualization не доказывает, что send не состоялся; ' +
          'automatic resend запрещён, pending causal envelope сохранён для supervised recovery.';
        setSemanticUserPause(true, reason);
        return { action: 'pause', reason };
      }

      setSemanticUserPause(false);
      return {
        action: 'send',
        kind: 'normal',
        reason: control.synthetic
          ? 'semantic bootstrap готов к первому dispatch'
          : `semantic state r${session.revision} принят; продолжаю Distance`,
      };
    }

    const first = tail[0];
    if (first.role === 'user') {
      const parsedFirst = parseSemanticDispatchTurn(first);
      if (
        !parsedFirst ||
        parsedFirst.invalid ||
        parsedFirst.id !== dispatch.id ||
        parsedFirst.sessionId !== session.id ||
        Number(parsedFirst.revision) !== Number(dispatch.baseRevision)
      ) {
        const reason = parsedFirst?.invalid
          ? parsedFirst.reason
          : `Native operator turn after semantic control: "${first.readableText.slice(0, 120)}"`;
        enterOperatorControlV626(reason, {
          source: 'mounted-user-fallback',
          turnKey: first.key || null,
          turnOrder: Number.isFinite(first.order) ? first.order : null,
        });
        return { action: 'operator', reason };
      }

      const firstAssistantIndex = tail.findIndex(turn => turn.role === 'assistant');
      const usersBeforeAssistant = firstAssistantIndex < 0
        ? tail
        : tail.slice(0, firstAssistantIndex);
      const invalidDispatch = usersBeforeAssistant.find(turn => {
        if (turn.role !== 'user') return true;
        const parsed = parseSemanticDispatchTurn(turn);
        return !parsed || parsed.invalid || parsed.id !== dispatch.id;
      });
      if (invalidDispatch) {
        const reason = 'До assistant turn обнаружено сообщение, не принадлежащее ожидаемому semantic dispatch';
        setSemanticUserPause(true, reason);
        return { action: 'pause', reason };
      }

      if (firstAssistantIndex < 0) {
        state.tailWatchKey = null;
        state.tailWatchSince = 0;
        if (isGenerating()) {
          return {
            action: 'wait',
            reason: `Semantic dispatch r${dispatch.baseRevision}: assistant генерирует`,
          };
        }

        const pending = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
        const submittedAt = Date.parse(
          pending?.submittedAt ||
          pending?.sentAt ||
          pending?.submitStartedAt ||
          pending?.queuedAt ||
          ''
        );
        const elapsed = Number.isFinite(submittedAt) ? Math.max(0, now() - submittedAt) : 0;
        if (elapsed < CONFIG.assistantStartGraceMs) {
          return {
            action: 'wait',
            retryAfterMs: Math.min(2500, Math.max(500, CONFIG.assistantStartGraceMs - elapsed)),
            reason:
              `Semantic dispatch ${dispatch.id} смонтирован; ` +
              'ожидаю фактический старт assistant без повторной отправки',
          };
        }

        const reason =
          `Semantic dispatch ${dispatch.id} смонтирован как user turn, ` +
          `но assistant не стартовал за ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)}с; ` +
          'автоповтор отключён, потому что повтор создаст дубликат dispatch. ' +
          'Вероятен сбой conversation transport/resume.';
        setSemanticUserPause(true, reason);
        return { action: 'pause', reason };
      }

      const afterAssistant = tail.slice(firstAssistantIndex + 1);
      const additionalUser = afterAssistant.find(turn => turn.role === 'user');
      if (additionalUser) {
        const reason = 'Native operator turn appeared before the expected semantic result';
        enterOperatorControlV626(reason, {
          source: 'mounted-user-fallback',
          turnKey: additionalUser.key || null,
          turnOrder: Number.isFinite(additionalUser.order) ? additionalUser.order : null,
        });
        return { action: 'operator', reason };
      }

      if (isGenerating()) {
        state.tailWatchKey = null;
        state.tailWatchSince = 0;
        return {
          action: 'wait',
          reason: `Semantic dispatch r${dispatch.baseRevision}: assistant генерирует`,
        };
      }

      const lastAssistant = tail.filter(turn => turn.role === 'assistant').at(-1);
      const watchKey = lastAssistant
        ? `${session.id}:${dispatch.id}:${lastAssistant.key}:${hashText(lastAssistant.readableText)}:${lastAssistant.readableText.length}`
        : `${session.id}:${dispatch.id}:assistant-tail:${tail.length}`;
      if (state.tailWatchKey !== watchKey) {
        state.tailWatchKey = watchKey;
        state.tailWatchSince = now();
      }
      const quietFor = now() - state.tailWatchSince;
      if (quietFor < CONFIG.assistantTailQuietMs) {
        const secondsLeft = Math.max(
          1,
          Math.ceil((CONFIG.assistantTailQuietMs - quietFor) / 1000)
        );
        return {
          action: 'wait',
          retryAfterMs: CONFIG.assistantTailPollMs,
          reason: `Ответ ожидает VG_RESULT; quiet tail ${secondsLeft}с`,
        };
      }
      const reason = 'Assistant response завершён без accepted semantic result; semantic session сохранена, автоитерация приостановлена';
      return { action: 'pause', reason };
    }

    if (first.role === 'assistant') {
      if (isGenerating()) {
        return {
          action: 'wait',
          reason: 'Assistant генерирует после semantic control без распознанного dispatch',
        };
      }
      const lastAssistant = tail.filter(turn => turn.role === 'assistant').at(-1);
      const watchKey = lastAssistant
        ? `${session.id}:direct-assistant:${lastAssistant.key}:${hashText(lastAssistant.readableText)}`
        : `${session.id}:direct-assistant:${tail.length}`;
      if (state.tailWatchKey !== watchKey) {
        state.tailWatchKey = watchKey;
        state.tailWatchSince = now();
      }
      const quietFor = now() - state.tailWatchSince;
      if (quietFor < CONFIG.assistantTailQuietMs) {
        return {
          action: 'wait',
          retryAfterMs: CONFIG.assistantTailPollMs,
          reason: 'Assistant turn после semantic control; наблюдаю появление VG_RESULT',
        };
      }
      return {
        action: 'pause',
        reason: 'Assistant turn появился без ожидаемого semantic dispatch и завершился без semantic result',
      };
    }

    return { action: 'pause', reason: 'Неизвестное semantic tail-состояние' };
  }

  const SemanticDistanceProtocol = Object.freeze({
    name: 'semantic-distance-runtime-v1',
    mode: 'semantic',

    createSession(options = {}) {
      return SemanticSessionStore.create(options);
    },

    loadSession() {
      return SemanticSessionStore.load();
    },

    clearSession() {
      SemanticSessionStore.clear();
    },

    parseTurn(turn) {
      return parseSemanticTurn(turn);
    },

    parseDispatchTurn(turn) {
      return parseSemanticDispatchTurn(turn);
    },

    async prepare() {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
      if (!session) return null;
      try {
        return await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Source Workspace restore failed', error);
        return null;
      }
    },

    async reconcile(turns, sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
      const session = sessionInput ? cloneSemanticValue(sessionInput) : null;
      if (!session) return { status: 'NO_SESSION', markersSeen: 0 };
      const acceptanceBoundary = semanticStateAcceptanceBoundary(session);
      const markers = turns
        .map(parseSemanticTurn)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter(marker =>
          semanticTurnAfterBoundary(marker.turn, acceptanceBoundary, turns)
        );
      // Semantic attempts are append-only in the mounted tail. An older broken
      // attempt must not poison the session forever once a newer correction
      // exists. Only the latest mounted VIBE_STATE attempt is authoritative
      // for the still-pending revision.
      const latest = markers.at(-1) || null;
      if (latest?.incomplete) {
        // a18 secondary guard: a stable truncated projection is repairable only
        // while a causal dispatch is actually pending. If the accepted state has
        // already cleared pendingDispatch and there is no newer mounted dispatch
        // after the acceptance boundary, this is a remounted/orphan DOM projection
        // of historical transport evidence. Do not convert UI degradation into an
        // integrity HOLD. Conversely, a newer mounted dispatch with no durable
        // pending authority remains a real causal-integrity failure.
        const pendingDispatch = session.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
        if (!pendingDispatch) {
          const postBoundaryDispatch = turns
            .filter(turn => turn?.role === 'user' && semanticTurnAfterBoundary(turn, acceptanceBoundary, turns))
            .map(parseSemanticDispatchTurn)
            .filter(Boolean)
            .at(-1) || null;
          if (!postBoundaryDispatch) {
            const raw = String(latest.raw || latest.turn?.markerText || '');
            warn('Ignoring orphan incomplete VIBE_STATE projection after accepted boundary', {
              turnKey: latest.turn?.key || null,
              turnOrder: Number.isFinite(latest.turn?.order) ? latest.turn.order : null,
              observedChars: raw.length,
              tailHash: hashText(raw.slice(-256)),
              acceptanceBoundary,
            });
            state.incompleteSemanticStateKey = null;
            state.incompleteSemanticStateSince = 0;
            return {
              status: session.status === 'sealed'
                ? 'MISSION_SEALED'
                : session.status === 'hold'
                  ? 'HOLD'
                  : 'CONTROL_READY',
              session,
              control: semanticControlFromSession(session),
              marker: latest,
              markersSeen: markers.length,
              ignoredOrphanIncompleteProjection: true,
            };
          }
        }

        const raw = String(latest.raw || latest.turn?.markerText || '');
        const incompleteKey = `${latest.turn?.key || 'assistant'}:${hashText(raw)}:${raw.length}`;
        if (state.incompleteSemanticStateKey !== incompleteKey) {
          state.incompleteSemanticStateKey = incompleteKey;
          state.incompleteSemanticStateSince = now();
        }
        const stableFor = Math.max(0, now() - Number(state.incompleteSemanticStateSince || 0));
        if (stableFor < CONFIG.semanticIncompleteStateGraceMs) {
          return {
            status: 'INCOMPLETE_STATE',
            reason: `Semantic result ещё не замкнут; жду стабилизацию fenced transport (${Math.ceil((CONFIG.semanticIncompleteStateGraceMs - stableFor) / 1000)}с максимум)`,
            marker: latest,
            markersSeen: markers.length,
            retryAfterMs: Math.min(
              CONFIG.semanticIncompleteStatePollMs,
              Math.max(80, CONFIG.semanticIncompleteStateGraceMs - stableFor)
            ),
            session,
          };
        }
        warn('Stable incomplete semantic-result transport projection', {
          turnKey: latest.turn?.key || null,
          observedChars: raw.length,
          tailHash: hashText(raw.slice(-256)),
          dispatchId: session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        });
        state.incompleteSemanticStateKey = null;
        state.incompleteSemanticStateSince = 0;
        return {
          status: 'INVALID_STATE',
          reason: latest.reason || 'Unclosed semantic result',
          marker: latest,
          markersSeen: markers.length,
          staleInvalidMarkers: markers.slice(0, -1).filter(marker => marker.invalid).length,
          session,
          recoverable: true,
        };
      }
      state.incompleteSemanticStateKey = null;
      state.incompleteSemanticStateSince = 0;
      if (latest?.invalid) {
        return {
          status: 'INVALID_STATE',
          reason: latest.reason,
          marker: latest,
          markersSeen: markers.length,
          staleInvalidMarkers: markers.slice(0, -1).filter(marker => marker.invalid).length,
          session,
          recoverable: true,
        };
      }
      if (!latest) {
        return {
          status: session.status === 'sealed'
            ? 'MISSION_SEALED'
            : session.status === 'hold'
              ? 'HOLD'
              : 'CONTROL_READY',
          session,
          control: semanticControlFromSession(session),
          markersSeen: 0,
        };
      }
      if (session.transport.lastControl?.id === latest.id) {
        return {
          status: session.status === 'sealed'
            ? 'MISSION_SEALED'
            : session.status === 'hold'
              ? 'HOLD'
              : 'CONTROL_READY',
          session,
          control: semanticControlFromSession(session),
          marker: latest,
          markersSeen: markers.length,
        };
      }
      try {
        const envelope = hydrateAutomaticSemanticEnvelope(session, latest, turns);
        const expectedCommitPendingV615 = session.transport?.pendingDispatch
          ? {
              id: String(session.transport.pendingDispatch.id || ''),
              baseRevision: Number(session.transport.pendingDispatch.baseRevision),
            }
          : null;
        const next = await applySemanticStateWithWorking(session, envelope.payload, {
          id: latest.id,
          turnKey: latest.turn.key,
          turnOrder: latest.turn.order,
          markerHash: hashText(latest.raw),
          protocol: latest.protocol || 'unknown',
          machineChars: String(latest.raw || '').length,
          automatic: true,
          inferredEnvelope: envelope.inferred,
        });
        const commitAuthorityV615 = SemanticSessionStore.load();
        const commitPendingV615 = commitAuthorityV615?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
        if (
          !expectedCommitPendingV615 ||
          !commitAuthorityV615 ||
          Number(commitAuthorityV615.revision) !== Number(session.revision) ||
          !commitPendingV615 ||
          String(commitPendingV615.id || '') !== expectedCommitPendingV615.id ||
          Number(commitPendingV615.baseRevision) !== expectedCommitPendingV615.baseRevision
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            'VIBE_STATE_CAUSAL_COMMIT_DRIFT: pending dispatch authority changed while applying the accepted state; ' +
            `expected ${expectedCommitPendingV615?.id || 'none'}@r${expectedCommitPendingV615?.baseRevision ?? 'n/a'}, ` +
            `current ${commitPendingV615?.id || 'none'}@r${commitPendingV615?.baseRevision ?? 'n/a'}`
          );
        }
        const savedNextV615 = SemanticSessionStore.save(next);
        markCrossChatHandoffConsumed(savedNextV615);
        recordModelContinuityProtocolSuccessV622({
          revision: next.revision,
          dispatchId: envelope.payload.dispatchId || null,
          markerId: latest.id || null,
          protocol: latest.protocol || 'unknown',
          machineChars: String(latest.raw || '').length,
        });
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
        const routedSourceOps = splitSemanticSourceOps(envelope.payload.sourceOps);
        if (routedSourceOps.intelligenceOps.length) {
          await applyAndRecordSemanticSourceIntelligenceOps(routedSourceOps.intelligenceOps, next.revision, next.transport?.acceptanceSequence);
        }
        if (Array.isArray(envelope.payload.projectOps) && envelope.payload.projectOps.length) {
          await applyAndRecordProjectDataOpsV670(envelope.payload.projectOps, next.revision, next.transport?.acceptanceSequence);
        }
        if (Array.isArray(envelope.payload.workbenchOps) && envelope.payload.workbenchOps.length) {
          await applyAndRecordWorkbenchOpsM05P3(
            envelope.payload.workbenchOps,
            next.revision,
            next.transport?.acceptanceSequence,
            { controlId: latest.id || null, dispatchId: envelope.payload.dispatchId || null }
          );
        }
        if (Array.isArray(envelope.payload.hostOps) && envelope.payload.hostOps.length) {
          await applyAndRecordResortHostOpsV1(
            envelope.payload.hostOps,
            next.revision,
            next.transport?.acceptanceSequence,
            { controlId: latest.id || null, dispatchId: envelope.payload.dispatchId || null }
          );
        }
        if (envelope.inferred.length) {
          log('Recovered omitted semantic-result causal metadata from durable/mounted authority', {
            inferred: envelope.inferred,
            dispatchId: envelope.payload.dispatchId,
            baseRevision: envelope.payload.baseRevision,
          });
        }
        if (envelope.detachedDispatchFallback) {
          log('Accepted explicit semantic-result envelope against persisted pending dispatch after DOM detachment', {
            dispatchId: envelope.payload.dispatchId,
            baseRevision: envelope.payload.baseRevision,
            pendingStatus: session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status || null,
            persistedMountedTurnKey: session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.mountedTurnKey || null,
            persistedMountedTurnOrder: session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.mountedTurnOrder ?? null,
          });
        }
        if (envelope.correctionRetry) {
          log('Accepted corrected VIBE_STATE after failed attempt and explicit user-requested retry', {
            dispatchId: envelope.payload.dispatchId,
            baseRevision: envelope.payload.baseRevision,
            markerId: latest.id,
          });
        }
        const effective = SemanticSessionStore.load() || savedNextV615 || next;
        return {
          status: effective.status === 'sealed'
            ? 'MISSION_SEALED'
            : effective.status === 'hold'
              ? 'HOLD'
              : 'CONTROL_READY',
          session: effective,
          control: semanticControlFromSession(effective),
          marker: latest,
          acceptedState: envelope.payload,
          inferredEnvelope: envelope.inferred,
          correctionRetry: Boolean(envelope.correctionRetry),
          acceptedProtocol: latest.protocol || 'unknown',
          machineChars: String(latest.raw || '').length,
          markersSeen: markers.length,
        };
      } catch (error) {
        return {
          status: 'INVALID_STATE',
          reason: error.message,
          marker: latest,
          markersSeen: markers.length,
          session,
          recoverable: true,
        };
      }
    },

    classifyReconciliation(reconciliation) {
      if (reconciliation.status === 'INCOMPLETE_STATE') {
        return {
          kind: 'settling',
          reason: reconciliation.reason || 'Semantic-result transport ещё стабилизируется',
          retryAfterMs: Number(reconciliation.retryAfterMs || CONFIG.semanticIncompleteStatePollMs),
          marker: reconciliation.marker || null,
        };
      }
      if (reconciliation.status === 'INVALID_STATE') {
        return {
          kind: 'invalid',
          reason: reconciliation.reason,
          recoverable: reconciliation.recoverable !== false,
          marker: reconciliation.marker || null,
        };
      }
      if (reconciliation.status === 'HOLD') {
        return {
          kind: 'hold',
          reason: reconciliation.session?.hold?.reason || 'Semantic HOLD',
        };
      }
      if (reconciliation.status === 'MISSION_SEALED') {
        return { kind: 'complete' };
      }
      return { kind: 'continue' };
    },

    resolveControl(reconciliation) {
      return reconciliation.control || null;
    },

    async applyState(payload, sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
      if (!sessionInput) throw new Error('Semantic session is not initialized');
      const next = await applySemanticStateWithWorking(sessionInput, payload, {
        id: `manual-state:${hashText(JSON.stringify(payload))}:${now()}`,
        markerHash: hashText(JSON.stringify(payload)),
        automatic: false,
      });
      SemanticSessionStore.save(next);
      const routedSourceOps = splitSemanticSourceOps(payload?.sourceOps);
      if (routedSourceOps.intelligenceOps.length) {
        await applyAndRecordSemanticSourceIntelligenceOps(routedSourceOps.intelligenceOps, next.revision, next.transport?.acceptanceSequence);
      }
      if (Array.isArray(payload?.projectOps) && payload.projectOps.length) {
        await applyAndRecordProjectDataOpsV670(payload.projectOps, next.revision, next.transport?.acceptanceSequence);
      }
      if (Array.isArray(payload?.workbenchOps) && payload.workbenchOps.length) {
        await applyAndRecordWorkbenchOpsM05P3(
          payload.workbenchOps,
          next.revision,
          next.transport?.acceptanceSequence,
          { controlId: next.transport?.lastControl?.id || null, dispatchId: payload.dispatchId || null }
        );
      }
      if (Array.isArray(payload?.hostOps) && payload.hostOps.length) {
        await applyAndRecordResortHostOpsV1(
          payload.hostOps,
          next.revision,
          next.transport?.acceptanceSequence,
          { controlId: next.transport?.lastControl?.id || null, dispatchId: payload.dispatchId || null }
        );
      }
      return SemanticSessionStore.load() || next;
    },

    buildDispatch(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
      return ensureSemanticPendingDispatch(sessionInput);
    },

    getControlId(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
      if (!sessionInput) return null;
      return semanticControlFromSession(sessionInput).id;
    },

    inspectExchange(control, turns, dispatch) {
      return inspectSemanticExchange(control, turns, dispatch);
    },

    markGenerating() {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch;
      if (pending) {
        updateSemanticPendingDispatch(pending, {
          status: 'generating',
          generatingAt: pending.generatingAt || semanticIsoNow(),
        });
      }
    },

    markDispatchQueued(dispatch) {
      updateSemanticPendingDispatch(dispatch, {
        status: 'queued',
        queuedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
    },

    markDispatchStarted(dispatch) {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch;
      return updateSemanticPendingDispatch(dispatch, {
        status: 'submitting',
        submitStartedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        retries: Number(pending?.retries || 0),
      });
    },

    markDispatchMounted(dispatch, turn = null) {
      updateSemanticPendingDispatch(dispatch, {
        status: 'submitted',
        submittedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        sentAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        mountedTurnKey: turn?.key || null,
        mountedTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(turn?.order) ? turn.order : null,
        submitError: null,
      });
      recordStageHSubmissionWitnessV654(dispatch, 'mounted-user-turn', turn);
      recordStageISubmissionWitnessV655(dispatch, 'mounted-user-turn', turn);
    },

    markDispatchUnconfirmed(dispatch, reason = '') {
      updateSemanticPendingDispatch(dispatch, {
        status: 'submit-unconfirmed',
        submitFailedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        submitError: String(reason || 'semantic dispatch did not mount after physical click'),
      });
    },

    markDispatchCancelled(dispatch, reason = '') {
      updateSemanticPendingDispatch(dispatch, {
        status: 'ready',
        cancelReason: String(reason || ''),
      });
    },

    describeGenerating() {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      return session
        ? `${session.route.activity} · r${session.revision}: assistant генерирует`
        : 'assistant сейчас генерирует';
    },

    describeQueued(dispatch, kind, seconds) {
      const label = kind === 'retry'
        ? dispatch.display.queuedRetry
        : dispatch.display.queuedNormal;
      return `${label} через ${seconds}с`;
    },

    describeSent(dispatch, kind) {
      return kind === 'retry'
        ? dispatch.display.sentRetry
        : dispatch.display.sentNormal;
    },

    describeNoControl(reconciliation) {
      if (reconciliation.status === 'NO_SESSION') {
        return 'semantic session не создана; вызови VibeGo.activateSemantic(...)';
      }
      return 'semantic control boundary не удалось восстановить';
    },

    getPanelProjection(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
      if (!sessionInput) {
        return {
          mode: 'semantic',
          current: 'NO SESSION',
          activity: '—',
          distance: '—',
          depth: 0,
          notes: 0,
          status: 'missing',
        };
      }
      const active = semanticActiveDistance(sessionInput);
      return {
        mode: 'semantic',
        current: `r${sessionInput.revision}`,
        activity: sessionInput.route.activity,
        distance: active?.objective || 'No active Distance',
        depth: sessionInput.route.deepeningStack.length,
        notes: sessionInput.notes.filter(note => note.status !== 'resolved').length,
        status: sessionInput.status,
        pausedByUser: Boolean(sessionInput.transport.pausedByUser),
        pendingStatus: sessionInput.transport.pendingDispatch?.status || 'none',
        interruption: currentUserInterruptionPromise(sessionInput)
          ? cloneSemanticValue(currentUserInterruptionPromise(sessionInput))
          : null,
        operatorControl: currentOperatorControlV626(sessionInput)
          ? cloneSemanticValue(currentOperatorControlV626(sessionInput))
          : null,
        sourceCursorDiagnostics: sourceCursorDiagnosticsV626(sessionInput),
        source: SourceWorkspace.status(),
      };
    },

    syncPanelProjection() {},

    getLogContext(tail, mountedTurns) {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      return {
        protocol: this.name,
        sessionId: session?.id || null,
        revision: session?.revision ?? null,
        activity: session?.route?.activity || null,
        activeDistanceId: session?.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
        dispatchId: session?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        action: tail.action,
        reason: tail.reason,
        mountedTurns,
      };
    },

    async complete() {
      await completeSemanticMission();
    },

    selfTest() {
      let session = createSemanticSession({
        sessionId: 'semantic-self-test',
        objective: 'Root Distance',
        closureContract: 'Root closure',
        bootstrapBoundary: {
          turnKey: 'boundary',
          turnOrder: 1,
          capturedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        },
      });
      session = applySemanticState(session, {
        action: 'DEEPEN',
        activity: 'RECON',
        objective: 'Child Distance',
        reason: 'Linked unknown',
        notes: [{ kind: 'risk', text: 'Do not lose this finding' }],
      });
      const childId = session.route.activeDistanceId;
      session = applySemanticState(session, {
        action: 'RETURN',
        activity: 'ANALYSIS',
        summary: 'Return without false closure',
        promise: { kind: 'post-distance', text: 'Resume child later' },
      });
      session = applySemanticState(session, {
        action: 'REDIRECT',
        activity: 'CHANGE',
        objective: 'Updated root route',
        decisions: [{ text: 'Redirect remains model-owned' }],
      });
      const dispatch = buildSemanticDispatch(session);
      return {
        ok:
          session.route.activity === 'CHANGE' &&
          session.route.deepeningStack.length === 0 &&
          session.distances[childId]?.status === 'suspended' &&
          session.notes.length === 2 &&
          session.decisions.length === 1 &&
          dispatch.text.includes('[[VIBE_DISPATCH'),
        revision: session.revision,
        childDistancePreserved: Boolean(session.distances[childId]),
        notes: session.notes.length,
        decisions: session.decisions.length,
      };
    },
  });

  const protocol = SemanticDistanceProtocol;


  function semanticCursorBaselineSha(cursorInput) {
    const cursor = cursorInput && typeof cursorInput === 'object' ? cursorInput : {};
    const values = [];
    if (cursor.baselineId != null) values.push(cursor.baselineId);
    if (cursor.baseline != null) {
      if (typeof cursor.baseline === 'string') values.push(cursor.baseline);
      else if (typeof cursor.baseline === 'object') {
        if (cursor.baseline.id != null) values.push(cursor.baseline.id);
        if (cursor.baseline.sha256 != null) values.push(cursor.baseline.sha256);
      }
    }
    for (const value of values) {
      const raw = String(value || '').trim();
      const match = raw.match(/^(?:sha256:|baseline:)?([a-f0-9]{64})$/i);
      if (match) return match[1].toLowerCase();
    }
    return null;
  }

  function latestMountedSemanticMarker(turns = getTailTurns()) {
    const markers = turns.map(parseSemanticTurn).filter(Boolean);
    return markers.at(-1) || null;
  }

  function classifyMountedSemanticOrigin(turns, marker) {
    if (!marker || marker.invalid) return { kind: 'unknown', dispatch: null };
    const payload = marker.payload || {};
    const markerIndex = semanticTurnIndex(turns, marker.turn);
    let nearestDispatch = null;
    if (markerIndex >= 0) {
      for (let index = markerIndex - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
        const turn = turns[index];
        if (turn.role !== 'user') continue;
        const parsed = parseSemanticDispatchTurn(turn);
        if (parsed && !parsed.invalid) {
          nearestDispatch = parsed;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (nearestDispatch) {
      return { kind: 'runner-dispatch', dispatch: nearestDispatch };
    }
    if (payload.dispatchId != null || payload.baseRevision != null) {
      return { kind: 'detached-causal-claim', dispatch: null };
    }
    return { kind: 'initiative-state', dispatch: null };
  }

  async function findRecoverableSourceAuthority(cursorInput) {
    const desiredSha = semanticCursorBaselineSha(cursorInput);
    const workspaces = await sourceDbGetAll('workspaces');
    const candidates = [];
    for (const workspace of workspaces) {
      if (!workspace || workspace.schema !== SOURCE_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA || !workspace.baselineId) continue;
      const baseline = await sourceDbGet('baselines', workspace.baselineId);
      if (!baseline || baseline.schema !== SOURCE_BASELINE_SCHEMA) continue;
      if (desiredSha && String(baseline.sha256).toLowerCase() !== desiredSha) continue;
      candidates.push({ workspace, baseline });
    }
    if (candidates.length === 1) {
      return { status: 'unique', desiredSha, ...candidates[0] };
    }
    return {
      status: candidates.length ? 'ambiguous' : 'missing',
      desiredSha,
      candidates: candidates.map(item => ({
        sessionId: item.workspace.sessionId,
        baselineId: item.baseline.id,
        sha256: item.baseline.sha256,
        updatedAt: item.workspace.updatedAt || null,
      })),
    };
  }

  function semanticRecoverySessionOptions(marker, sessionId) {
    const payload = marker?.payload || {};
    const distance = payload.activeDistance || payload.distance || {
      id: semanticId('distance-recovered'),
      objective: payload.objective || 'Продолжить восстановленную semantic Distance.',
      closureContract: payload.closureContract || '',
    };
    return {
      sessionId,
      direction: payload.direction || SEMANTIC_DEFAULT_DIRECTION,
      reminder: payload.reminder || SEMANTIC_DEFAULT_REMINDER,
      activity: payload.activity || 'RECON',
      activeDistance: distance,
      nextFocus: payload.nextFocus || '',
      sourceCursor: payload.sourceCursor || payload.cursor || {},
      bootstrapBoundary: {
        turnKey: marker?.turn?.key || null,
        turnOrder: Number.isFinite(marker?.turn?.order) ? marker.turn.order : null,
        capturedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      },
    };
  }

  function stripRecoveryTransportEnvelope(payloadInput, sessionId) {
    const payload = cloneSemanticValue(payloadInput || {});
    payload.sessionId = sessionId;
    delete payload.dispatchId;
    delete payload.baseRevision;
    return payload;
  }

  async function recoverSemanticAuthorityFromTail(options = {}) {
    const existing = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const turns = getTailTurns();
    const marker = latestMountedSemanticMarker(turns);
    if (!marker) return { recovered: false, reason: 'NO_VIBE_STATE' };
    if (marker.invalid) {
      throw new Error(`Mounted VIBE_STATE is invalid: ${marker.reason}`);
    }

    if (existing) {
      if (ProtocolRuntime.getMode() !== 'semantic') {
        await ProtocolRuntime.activateSemantic({ resume: true });
      }
      return {
        recovered: true,
        reusedSession: true,
        session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
        markerId: marker.id,
      };
    }

    const payload = cloneSemanticValue(marker.payload || {});
    const origin = classifyMountedSemanticOrigin(turns, marker);
    const sourceAuthority = await findRecoverableSourceAuthority(payload.sourceCursor || payload.cursor || {});
    if (sourceAuthority.status === 'ambiguous') {
      throw new Error(
        'Semantic recovery found multiple Source Workspaces for the mounted VIBE_STATE baseline; refusing to guess authority'
      );
    }

    const explicitSessionId = payload.sessionId ? String(payload.sessionId) : null;
    if (
      explicitSessionId &&
      sourceAuthority.status === 'unique' &&
      explicitSessionId !== String(sourceAuthority.workspace.sessionId)
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'Mounted VIBE_STATE sessionId conflicts with the only recoverable Source Workspace'
      );
    }

    const sessionId = explicitSessionId ||
      (sourceAuthority.status === 'unique' ? String(sourceAuthority.workspace.sessionId) : semanticId('semantic-session-recovered'));

    let session = SemanticSessionStore.create(
      semanticRecoverySessionOptions(marker, sessionId)
    );

    if (sourceAuthority.status !== 'unique' && origin.kind === 'initiative-state') {
      session.status = 'hold';
      session.hold = {
        kind: 'initiative-source-bootstrap',
        reason:
