          'Initiative VIBE_STATE adopted as semantic bootstrap. Attach the authoritative monolith once; VIBE-GO will verify its SHA, reconstruct Source Workspace from the staged cursor, accept the state, then own the next causal dispatch.',
        at: semanticIsoNow(),
        revision: session.revision,
      };
      session.transport.initiativeBootstrap = {
        schema: 'vibe-go-initiative-bootstrap/v1',
        status: 'awaiting-source',
        markerId: marker.id,
        turnKey: marker.turn?.key || null,
        turnOrder: Number.isFinite(marker.turn?.order) ? marker.turn.order : null,
        markerHash: hashText(marker.raw),
        desiredBaselineSha256: sourceAuthority.desiredSha || null,
        stagedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        payload: cloneSemanticValue(payload),
      };
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      state.tailWatchKey = null;
      state.tailWatchSince = 0;
      log('Initiative VIBE_STATE staged; source attachment required before first runner-owned dispatch', {
        sessionId: session.id,
        markerId: marker.id,
        baselineSha256: sourceAuthority.desiredSha || null,
      });
      return {
        recovered: true,
        initiativeBootstrap: true,
        detached: true,
        held: true,
        markerId: marker.id,
        session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
        sourceAuthority,
        origin,
      };
    }

    if (sourceAuthority.status === 'unique') {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
      session = SemanticSessionStore.load() || session;
    }

    const hasWorkingOps = Array.isArray(payload.workingOps) && payload.workingOps.length > 0;
    const hasWorkspaceOps = Array.isArray(payload.workspaceOps) && payload.workspaceOps.length > 0;
    if ((hasWorkingOps || hasWorkspaceOps) && sourceAuthority.status !== 'unique') {
      const held = cloneSemanticValue(session);
      held.status = 'hold';
      held.hold = {
        reason: 'Recovered VIBE_STATE contains source operations, but its Source Workspace is not available; reattach the authoritative baseline before replay.',
        at: semanticIsoNow(),
        revision: held.revision,
      };
      SemanticSessionStore.save(held);
      return {
        recovered: true,
        detached: true,
        held: true,
        markerId: marker.id,
        session: held,
        sourceAuthority,
      };
    }

    const recoveryPayload = stripRecoveryTransportEnvelope(payload, session.id);
    if (sourceAuthority.status !== 'unique') {
      // Preserve the declarative cursor in the recovered session, but do not
      // pretend that a physical Source Workspace exists.
      delete recoveryPayload.sourceCursor;
      delete recoveryPayload.cursor;
      delete recoveryPayload.workingOps;
      delete recoveryPayload.workspaceOps;
    }

    session = await applySemanticStateWithWorking(session, recoveryPayload, {
      id: marker.id,
      turnKey: marker.turn?.key || null,
      turnOrder: Number.isFinite(marker.turn?.order) ? marker.turn.order : null,
      markerHash: hashText(marker.raw),
      automatic: false,
      recoveredAuthority: true,
    });

    if (sourceAuthority.status !== 'unique') {
      session.status = 'hold';
      session.hold = {
        reason:
          'Semantic state recovered from mounted VIBE_STATE, but the authoritative Source Workspace is absent. Reattach the monolith with VibeGoAlpha.launch({fresh:false}) before continuing.',
        at: semanticIsoNow(),
        revision: session.revision,
      };
    }
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    state.tailWatchKey = null;
    state.tailWatchSince = 0;

    if (sourceAuthority.status === 'unique' && session.status !== 'hold' && session.status !== 'sealed') {
      ensureSemanticPendingDispatch(session);
    }

    log('Semantic authority recovered from mounted VIBE_STATE', {
      sessionId: session.id,
      revision: session.revision,
      markerId: marker.id,
      sourceAuthority: sourceAuthority.status,
      baselineSha256: sourceAuthority.status === 'unique' ? sourceAuthority.baseline.sha256 : sourceAuthority.desiredSha,
    });

    return {
      recovered: true,
      reusedSession: false,
      detached: sourceAuthority.status !== 'unique',
      held: session.status === 'hold',
      markerId: marker.id,
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
      sourceAuthority,
      origin,
    };
  }

  async function finalizeInitiativeSemanticBootstrap(options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('No semantic session exists for initiative bootstrap');
    const bootstrap = session.transport?.initiativeBootstrap;
    if (!bootstrap || bootstrap.status !== 'awaiting-source') {
      return { finalized: false, reason: 'NO_PENDING_INITIATIVE_BOOTSTRAP', session };
    }
    const source = SourceWorkspace.status();
    if (!source?.ready || !source?.baseline?.sha256 || !sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) {
      throw new Error('Initiative bootstrap requires the authoritative Source Workspace before finalization');
    }
    const expectedSha = String(bootstrap.desiredBaselineSha256 || '').toLowerCase();
    const actualSha = String(source.baseline.sha256 || '').toLowerCase();
    if (expectedSha && actualSha !== expectedSha) {
      throw new Error(
        `Initiative baseline SHA-256 mismatch: expected ${expectedSha}, attached ${actualSha}`
      );
    }

    const base = cloneSemanticValue(session);
    base.status = 'active';
    base.hold = null;
    const payload = stripRecoveryTransportEnvelope(bootstrap.payload || {}, base.id);
    let next = await applySemanticStateWithWorking(base, payload, {
      id: bootstrap.markerId,
      turnKey: bootstrap.turnKey || null,
      turnOrder: Number.isFinite(bootstrap.turnOrder) ? bootstrap.turnOrder : null,
      markerHash: bootstrap.markerHash || hashText(JSON.stringify(payload)),
      automatic: false,
      initiativeBootstrap: true,
    });
    next.transport.initiativeBootstrap = {
      ...cloneSemanticValue(bootstrap),
      status: 'adopted',
      adoptedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      acceptedRevision: next.revision,
      payload: undefined,
    };
    delete next.transport.initiativeBootstrap.payload;
    SemanticSessionStore.save(next);
    const routedBootstrapSourceOps = splitSemanticSourceOps(payload.sourceOps);
    if (routedBootstrapSourceOps.intelligenceOps.length) {
      await applyAndRecordSemanticSourceIntelligenceOps(routedBootstrapSourceOps.intelligenceOps, next.revision, next.transport?.acceptanceSequence);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(payload?.projectOps) && payload.projectOps.length) {
      await applyAndRecordProjectDataOpsV670(payload.projectOps, next.revision, next.transport?.acceptanceSequence);
    }
    next = SemanticSessionStore.load() || next;
    if (next.status !== 'hold' && next.status !== 'sealed') {
      ensureSemanticPendingDispatch(next);
    }
    log('Initiative semantic bootstrap finalized; runner now owns causal dispatch', {
      sessionId: next.id,
      revision: next.revision,
      baselineSha256: actualSha,
      markerId: bootstrap.markerId,
      pendingDispatchId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
    });
    return {
      finalized: true,
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
      baselineSha256: actualSha,
      markerId: bootstrap.markerId,
    };
  }

  async function maybeRecoverSemanticAuthority(options = {}) {
    if (SemanticSessionStore.load()) return null;
    const marker = latestMountedSemanticMarker(getTailTurns());
    if (!marker) return null;
    return recoverSemanticAuthorityFromTail(options);
  }

  const ProtocolRuntime = Object.freeze({
    getActive() {
      return SemanticDistanceProtocol;
    },

    getMode() {
      return 'semantic';
    },

    getByName(name) {
      return name === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name ? SemanticDistanceProtocol : null;
    },

    initialize() {
      return SemanticDistanceProtocol;
    },

    async activateSemantic(options = {}) {
      if (isGenerating()) {
        throw new Error('Нельзя переинициализировать semantic protocol во время генерации assistant');
      }
      if (pendingSend) {
        SemanticDistanceProtocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(
          pendingSend.dispatch,
          'semantic activation replaced pending timer'
        );
      }
      clearPendingSend();
      const resume = options.resume === true;
      let session = null;
      if (resume) {
        const readiness = await ensureSemanticSessionReady({
          reason: 'activate semantic resume',
          recoverFromTail: true,
          required: false,
        });
        session = readiness.session;
      }
      if (!session) {
        session = SemanticSessionStore.create({
          ...options,
          bootstrapBoundary: captureSemanticBoundary(getTailTurns()),
        });
      }
      try {
        await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Semantic activation continues without restored Source Workspace', error);
      }
      state.tailWatchKey = null;
      state.tailWatchSince = 0;
      if (!state.running) {
        state.running = true;
        installObserver();
      }
      setPhase('active', `Semantic Distance Mode · r${session.revision}`);
      await processTail();
      return SemanticSessionStore.load();
    },

    status() {
      return {
        mode: 'semantic',
        name: SemanticDistanceProtocol.name,
        semanticSession: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
        pendingSend: pendingSend ? cloneSemanticValue(pendingSend) : null,
      };
    },
  });

  function findComposer() {
    const candidates = [
      document.querySelector('#prompt-textarea'),
      document.querySelector(
        '[contenteditable="true"][data-testid]'
      ),
      document.querySelector('textarea[data-testid]'),
      document.querySelector('main [contenteditable="true"]'),
      document.querySelector('textarea'),
    ].filter(Boolean);

    return candidates.find(isVisible) || null;
  }

  function setComposerText(element, text) {
    if (element instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) {
      const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(
        HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,
        'value'
      )?.set;

      if (!setter) {
        throw new Error('Native textarea setter not found');
      }

      setter.call(element, text);

      element.dispatchEvent(
        new InputEvent('input', {
          bubbles: true,
          inputType: 'insertText',
          data: text,
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    if (!element.isContentEditable) {
      throw new Error('Unknown composer element type');
    }

    element.focus();
    element.replaceChildren();

    const paragraph = document.createElement('p');
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    element.appendChild(paragraph);

    element.dispatchEvent(
      new InputEvent('input', {
        bubbles: true,
        inputType: 'insertText',
        data: text,
      })
    );
  }

  function composerPayloadMatchesV616(expectedText) {
    return assessComposerPayloadV617(expectedText).matches;
  }

  function findSendButton() {
    const selectors = [
      'button[data-testid="send-button"]',
      'button[data-testid="composer-submit-button"]',
      '[data-testid="send-button"]',
      '[data-testid="composer-submit-button"]',
    ];

    for (const selector of selectors) {
      const button = document.querySelector(selector);
      if (button && isVisible(button)) return button;
    }

    return [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button => {
      if (!isVisible(button)) return false;

      const label = normalizeText(
        button.getAttribute('aria-label') || button.textContent
      );

      return (
        label === 'send' ||
        label.includes('send message') ||
        label === 'отправить' ||
        label.includes('отправить сообщение')
      );
    }) || null;
  }

  async function waitForEnabledSendButton() {
    const startedAt = now();
    let nextPressureProbeAt = startedAt;

    while (now() - startedAt < CONFIG.sendButtonWaitMs) {
      if (now() >= nextPressureProbeAt) {
        if (detectPlatformPressureSignal()) return null;
        nextPressureProbeAt = now() + Math.max(250, Number(CONFIG.platformPressureProbeIntervalMs || 750));
      }
      const button = findSendButton();

      if (
        button &&
        !button.disabled &&
        button.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true'
      ) {
        return button;
      }

      await sleep(150);
    }

    return null;
  }

  function leaseBlocksSend(eventKey) {
    const cache = loadCache();

    return (
      cache.lastSendEventKey === eventKey &&
      Number.isFinite(cache.lastSendAt) &&
      now() - cache.lastSendAt < CONFIG.sendLeaseMs
    );
  }

  function getRetryCounts() {
    const value = loadCache().retryCounts;

    return value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? value
      : {};
  }

  function getRetryCount(eventKey) {
    return Number(getRetryCounts()[eventKey] || 0);
  }

  function incrementRetryCount(eventKey) {
    const retryCounts = getRetryCounts();

    retryCounts[eventKey] =
      Number(retryCounts[eventKey] || 0) + 1;

    saveCache({ retryCounts });

    return retryCounts[eventKey];
  }

  function clearSemanticRepairQueue() {
    clearTimeout(semanticRepairTimer);
    semanticRepairTimer = null;
    semanticRepairQueuedSignature = null;
  }

  function semanticRepairDisposition(reasonInput, sessionInput = null) {
    const reason = String(reasonInput || 'Unknown semantic-result error');
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore?.load?.() || null;
    const expected = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (!expected) {
      return {
        mode: 'integrity-hold',
        category: 'integrity',
        reason: 'No pending semantic dispatch exists, so a causal repair envelope cannot be constructed safely.',
      };
    }

    // These failures describe source authority/commit integrity, not a malformed
    // model note. Asking the model to rewrite JSON cannot make them safe.
    if (/CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_HEAD_FORK|SOURCE_OP_(?:AUTHORITY_STALE|AUTHORITY_FLOOR_FORK|AUTHORITY_(?:LOCAL|FOREIGN|REGISTRY)_FORK|AUTHORITY_REGISTRY_REPAIR_FAILED|AUTHORITY_FLOOR_REPAIR(?:_VERIFY_FAILED)?|EQUIVALENT_FLOOR(?:_(?:STALE|FORK))?|STALE_HEAD|COMMIT_VERIFY_FAILED|AUTHORITY:)|SOURCE_AUTHORITY_(?:LOCAL|FOREIGN)_PROMOTE_RACE|SPEC_OPS_(?:AUTHORITY|EQUIVALENT_HEAD_REQUIRED|AUTHORITY_TARGET_MISMATCH|PARENT_MISMATCH|BASELINE_MISMATCH)|baseline mismatch|SHA-256 mismatch|Working Source head revision is missing|Source baseline is missing or damaged/i.test(reason)) {
      return { mode: 'integrity-hold', category: 'integrity', reason };
    }

    // A real user turn is not a serialization defect. Promise-based interruption
    // owns planned user turns; unexpected manual user turns still pause transport
    // instead of being rewritten as a model repair problem.
    if (/User intervention detected/i.test(reason)) {
      return { mode: 'wait-user', category: 'user', reason };
    }

    // a09.14: the runner rejected an attempt to park on a recoverable tool failure.
    // This is a model/tool correction loop, not semantic authority damage.
    if (/RECOVERABLE_TOOL_FAILURE_PARK_FORBIDDEN/i.test(reason)) {
      return { mode: 'tool-correction', category: 'tool-recovery', reason };
    }

    // Exact/source-target resolution failures are causally different from JSON or
    // field-shape mistakes. The engineering decision may be valid, but the edit was
    // not committed because its current source address/anchor did not resolve.
    if (/source operation \d+\/\d+ .*?(?:expectedText .*?not found|expectedText is ambiguous|anchor .*?not found|anchor is ambiguous|matchIndex is out of range|Unknown Working Source span|Unknown surfaced range|Working Source target .*?has no valid range|Unable to normalize working edit)|expectedText was not found in target|anchor was not found in target/i.test(reason)) {
      return { mode: 'source-correction', category: 'source-resolution', reason };
    }

    return { mode: 'repair-impulse', category: 'transport', reason };
  }

  const FAILURE_DOMAIN_SCHEMA_V695 = 'vibe-go-failure-domain/v1';

  function semanticFailureDomainV695(reasonInput, dispositionInput = null) {
    const reason = String(reasonInput || '');
    const disposition = dispositionInput || null;
    if (disposition?.mode === 'integrity-hold') return 'SEMANTIC_FAILURE';
    if (disposition?.mode === 'wait-user') return 'OPERATOR_INTERVENTION';
    if (disposition?.mode === 'tool-correction') return 'TOOL_REQUEST_FAILURE';
    if (disposition?.mode === 'source-correction') return 'SOURCE_RESOLUTION_FAILURE';
    if (disposition?.mode === 'repair-impulse') return 'TRANSPORT_FAILURE';
    if (/MALFORMED_(?:VG_RESULT|VG_PATCH|VIBE_STATE)_PAYLOAD|Expected (?:one|at most one) VG_(?:RESULT|PATCH)|VG_PATCH .*mismatch|VG_RESULT must not contain patch fields|closing sentinel|JSON is not complete|marker has no JSON payload/i.test(reason)) {
      return 'TRANSPORT_FAILURE';
    }
    return 'SEMANTIC_FAILURE';
  }

  function semanticRepairEscalationPolicyV695(dispositionInput, failureDomainInput) {
    const disposition = dispositionInput || {};
    const failureDomain = String(failureDomainInput || semanticFailureDomainV695('', disposition));
    return {
      schema: FAILURE_DOMAIN_SCHEMA_V695,
      failureDomain,
      // FM-01: parser/serialization mistakes are engineering transport evidence,
      // never evidence of hidden model/routing drift. Only an explicitly classified
      // semantic failure may feed the behavioral model-continuity sentinel.
      allowModelContinuityBehavioralFailure: Boolean(
        failureDomain === 'SEMANTIC_FAILURE' && disposition.mode === 'repair-impulse'
      ),
      allowSemanticHold: disposition.mode === 'integrity-hold',
    };
  }

  function recordSemanticFailureObservationV695(reasonInput, marker, dispositionInput, failureDomainInput) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (!session || !pending) return null;
    const reason = String(reasonInput || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 900);
    const failureDomain = String(failureDomainInput || semanticFailureDomainV695(reason, dispositionInput));
    const attemptIdentity = String(
      marker?.id || marker?.turn?.key || marker?.turn?.domId ||
      `raw:${hashText(String(marker?.raw || ''))}:${String(marker?.raw || '').length}`
    );
    const key = [String(pending.id || ''), String(pending.baseRevision ?? ''), failureDomain, attemptIdentity, hashText(reason)].join('::');
    const previous = session.transport?.lastFailureObservationV695 || null;
    if (previous?.key === key) return previous;
    const observation = {
      schema: FAILURE_DOMAIN_SCHEMA_V695,
      key,
      kind: failureDomain,
      surface: failureDomain === 'TRANSPORT_FAILURE'
        ? 'SEMANTIC_MACHINE_BLOCK'
        : failureDomain.startsWith('TOOL_')
          ? 'PROJECT_DATA_TOOL_FEEDBACK'
          : 'SEMANTIC_RUNTIME',
      operation: dispositionInput?.mode || null,
      error_code: failureDomain.startsWith('TOOL_') ? 'RECOVERABLE_TOOL_FAILURE_PARK_FORBIDDEN' : undefined,
      message: reason,
      recoverable: failureDomain !== 'SEMANTIC_FAILURE',
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      dispatchId: pending.id || null,
      baseRevision: pending.baseRevision ?? null,
      markerId: marker?.id || null,
      observedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    session.transport ||= {};
    session.transport.lastFailureObservationV695 = observation;
    session.transport.failureHistoryV704 = [
      ...(Array.isArray(session.transport.failureHistoryV704) ? session.transport.failureHistoryV704 : [])
        .filter(item => String(item?.key || '') !== String(observation.key || '')),
      cloneSemanticValue(observation),
    ].slice(-24);
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    return observation;
  }

  function recordTransportRepairExhaustedV695(reasonInput, pendingInput, countsInput = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const pending = pendingInput || session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (!session || !pending) return null;
    const state = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-transport-repair-exhausted/v1',
      kind: 'TRANSPORT_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED',
      recoverable: true,
      dispatchId: pending.id || null,
      baseRevision: pending.baseRevision ?? null,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      attempts: Number(countsInput.total || 0),
      failureAttempts: Number(countsInput.failure || 0),
      reason: String(reasonInput || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 900),
      at: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    session.transport ||= {};
    session.transport.transportRepairExhaustedV695 = state;
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    return state;
  }

  function semanticRepairSignature(session, reason, category = 'transport', marker = null) {
    const expected = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || {};
    // Deduplicate one concrete failed assistant attempt, not the textual reason for
    // the whole dispatch. A newly generated correction can legitimately fail with
    // the same parser message and must receive its own bounded repair handoff. The
    // dispatch-wide attempt cap remains the guard against an endless repair loop.
    const attemptIdentity = String(
      marker?.id ||
      marker?.turn?.key ||
      marker?.turn?.domId ||
      `raw:${hashText(String(marker?.raw || ''))}:${String(marker?.raw || '').length}`
    );
    return [
      String(expected.id || 'no-dispatch'),
      String(expected.baseRevision ?? 'no-revision'),
      String(category || 'transport'),
      attemptIdentity,
      hashText(String(reason || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()),
    ].join('::');
  }

  function semanticRepairDispatchAttemptLimitV6914() {
    const configured = Number(CONFIG.semanticRepairMaxAttemptsPerDispatch);
    return Number.isFinite(configured) && configured > 0 ? Math.floor(configured) : Infinity;
  }

  function semanticRepairAttemptLabelV6914(attemptInput) {
    const attempt = Math.max(1, Number(attemptInput || 1));
    const limit = semanticRepairDispatchAttemptLimitV6914();
    return Number.isFinite(limit) ? `${attempt}/${limit}` : `${attempt} (continuous)`;
  }

  function semanticRepairAttemptCounts(expected, failureKey) {
    const sameEpoch = String(expected?.repairEpoch || '') === String(CONFIG.semanticRepairEpoch || '');
    const persistedByFailure = sameEpoch && expected?.repairFailureAttempts && typeof expected.repairFailureAttempts === 'object'
      ? expected.repairFailureAttempts
      : {};
    return {
      total: Math.max(
        Number(semanticRepairAttempts.get(expected?.id) || 0),
        sameEpoch ? Number(expected?.repairAttempts || 0) : 0
      ),
      failure: Math.max(
        Number(semanticRepairFailureAttempts.get(failureKey) || 0),
        Number(persistedByFailure[failureKey] || 0)
      ),
    };
  }

  function clearSemanticRepairAttemptState(dispatchId) {
    const prefix = `${String(dispatchId || '')}::`;
    semanticRepairAttempts.delete(String(dispatchId || ''));
    for (const key of [...semanticRepairFailureAttempts.keys()]) {
      if (String(key).startsWith(prefix)) semanticRepairFailureAttempts.delete(key);
    }
    semanticRepairSentSignature = null;
  }

  function buildSemanticRepairImpulse(reasonInput, marker = null, dispositionInput = null) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const expected = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (!session || !expected) return null;
    const disposition = dispositionInput || semanticRepairDisposition(reasonInput, session);
    const reason = String(reasonInput || 'semantic result could not be read').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 700);
    const category = String(disposition?.category || 'transport');
    const signature = semanticRepairSignature(session, reason, category, marker);
    const sourceCorrection = disposition?.mode === 'source-correction';
    const toolCorrection = disposition?.mode === 'tool-correction';
    const truncatedCarrier = !sourceCorrection && !toolCorrection
      && /transport sentinel is not mounted yet|closing sentinel is not mounted yet|marker has no JSON payload yet|JSON is not complete|Unclosed (?:VIBE_STATE JSON|semantic result)/i.test(reason);
    const inlineAnalyzerSource = !sourceCorrection && !toolCorrection && /INLINE_ANALYZER_SOURCE_FORBIDDEN/i.test(reason);
    const instruction = toolCorrection
      ? 'Твой предыдущий HOLD/WAIT_OPERATOR не принят: свежая tool error является recoverable debugging evidence, а не причиной остановки VIBE-GO. Используй error_code/message/traceback из причины ниже, сам исправь request/args/id/op доступными VIBE tools или выбери другой инженерный маршрут и верни CONTINUE. WAIT_OPERATOR допустим только для реально внешнего действия, которое невозможно выполнить никаким доступным VIBE tool.'
      : sourceCorrection
        ? 'Инженерное решение не откатывай и не повторяй уже выполненную работу. Source mutation не была committed: исправь только её адресацию/anchor/target или замени её безопасным source/workspace operation, если это требуется фактическим source authority. Можно убрать неразрешимую mutation и сначала запросить точный SURFACE/QUERY в том же causal envelope.'
      : inlineAnalyzerSource
        ? 'Не повторяй analyzer source внутри VG_PATCH. Инженерное решение сохрани, но inline SAVE_ANALYZER mutation отбрось: analyzer implementation должен быть зарегистрирован из локального/file artifact, а semantic transport после этого переносит только компактный analyzer identity/args. Не создавай новый dispatch.'
      : truncatedCarrier
        ? 'Не повторяй инженерную работу и не меняй принятое инженерное решение. Transport artifact стабильно обрезан до конца JSON. Сохрани смысл необходимых sourceOps/workspaceOps, но НЕ повторяй большой предыдущий marker дословно: пересериализуй ту же mutation компактно. Предпочитай несколько коротких REPLACE_EXACT/INSERT_BEFORE/INSERT_AFTER с минимальными уникальными expectedText/anchor вместо одного full-function REPLACE_EXACT. Не удаляй необходимую mutation ради уменьшения размера и не создавай новый dispatch.'
        : 'Не повторяй инженерную работу и не меняй уже принятое инженерное решение. Исправь только transport/serialization формы предыдущего результата.';
    const opening = toolCorrection
      ? 'Предыдущий semantic result попытался остановить процесс на recoverable tool error и поэтому не был принят.'
      : sourceCorrection
        ? 'Предыдущий semantic result причинно распознан, но его source mutation не была применена.'
        : 'Предыдущий semantic result не принят только на техническом уровне.';
    const text = [
      'VIBE-GO · REPAIR IMPULSE',
      '',
      opening,
      `Причина: ${reason}`,
      '',
      instruction,
      `Верни исправленный fenced [[VG_RESULT d=${expected.id} r=${expected.baseRevision}]] ... [[/VG_RESULT]]. Если mutation/tool request нужен, добавь fenced [[VG_PATCH d=${expected.id} r=${expected.baseRevision}]] ... [[/VG_PATCH]]. Вне machine blocks допускается только очень короткое пояснение, но repair не должен повторять инженерную работу.`,
      'Если action в предыдущем ответе не был определён — используй CONTINUE. summary может быть одной короткой строкой.',
      '',
      'Точная causal envelope уже зафиксирована в marker header:',
      `dispatchId = ${expected.id}`,
      `baseRevision = ${expected.baseRevision}`,
      '',
      toolCorrection
        ? 'Не создавай новый VIBE_DISPATCH. Семантическая ревизия не продвинулась; исправь tool route в том же causal envelope. Не повторяй заведомо тот же failed request без изменения.'
        : sourceCorrection
          ? 'Не создавай новый VIBE_DISPATCH. Считай исходную source mutation неприменённой; опирайся на фактический source/target, а не на предположение, что предыдущий edit состоялся.'
        : truncatedCarrier
          ? 'Если предыдущий ответ содержал необходимые sourceOps/workspaceOps, сохрани их инженерный смысл, но разрешается эквивалентно разбить/сократить exact mutation envelope ради надёжного transport. Не создавай новый VIBE_DISPATCH.'
          : 'Если предыдущий ответ содержал необходимые sourceOps/workspaceOps, сохрани их смысл, исправив только техническую форму. Не создавай новый VIBE_DISPATCH.',
    ].join('\n');
    const failureDomain = semanticFailureDomainV695(reason, disposition);
    return {
      id: `semantic-repair:${hashText(signature)}`,
      signature,
      failureKey: signature,
      category,
      failureDomain,
      dispatchId: expected.id,
      baseRevision: expected.baseRevision,
      sessionId: session.id,
      text,
    };
  }

  async function executeSemanticRepairImpulse(repair) {
    semanticRepairTimer = null;
    semanticRepairQueuedSignature = null;
    if (!state.running || !repair || !isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;

    if (await enforceModelContinuityGuardV622('semantic-repair-preflight', { allowArm: true })) return;
    if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate('semantic-repair-preflight')) return;
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const usageRepairV625 = usageGovernorDecisionV625(`semantic-repair:${repair.dispatchId}:preflight`);
    if (!usageRepairV625.allowed) {
      semanticRepairQueuedSignature = repair.signature;
      semanticRepairTimer = setTimeout(
        () => void executeSemanticRepairImpulse(repair),
        Math.max(CONFIG.semanticRepairRetryMs, Number(usageRepairV625.waitMs || 0))
      );
      setPhase('delay', `usage governor задержал repair · ${usageRepairV625.reason} · ${Math.ceil(Number(usageRepairV625.waitMs || 0) / 1000)}с`);
      return;
    }

    if (isGenerating()) {
      semanticRepairQueuedSignature = repair.signature;
      semanticRepairTimer = setTimeout(
        () => void executeSemanticRepairImpulse(repair),
        CONFIG.semanticRepairRetryMs
      );
      return;
    }

    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const expected = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (
      !session || !expected ||
      String(expected.id) !== String(repair.dispatchId) ||
      Number(expected.baseRevision) !== Number(repair.baseRevision)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const counts = semanticRepairAttemptCounts(expected, repair.failureKey || repair.signature);
    const dispatchRepairLimitV6914 = semanticRepairDispatchAttemptLimitV6914();
    if (Number.isFinite(dispatchRepairLimitV6914) && counts.total >= dispatchRepairLimitV6914) {
      // Non-default administrative override only. The production a09.14 profile uses
      // Infinity so model/serialization mistakes never terminate the causal loop.
      recordTransportRepairExhaustedV695(
        'Semantic result exceeded an explicitly configured finite transport-repair limit',
        expected,
        counts
      );
      setPhase('correction', `Configured repair limit reached (${counts.total}); increase semanticRepairMaxAttemptsPerDispatch or set 0 for continuous repair`);
      return;
    }
    if (counts.failure >= CONFIG.semanticRepairMaxAttemptsPerFailure) {
      setPhase(
        'correction',
        `Этот конкретный failed assistant attempt уже получил auto-repair; дубликат observer-события не отправляется: ${repair.category || 'technical'}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const composer = findComposer();
    if (!composer) {
      semanticRepairQueuedSignature = repair.signature;
      semanticRepairTimer = setTimeout(() => void executeSemanticRepairImpulse(repair), Math.max(1000, CONFIG.semanticRepairRetryMs));
      setPhase('correction', 'Repair composer temporarily unavailable; retrying without stopping runner');
      return;
    }
    setComposerText(composer, repair.text);
    const sendButton = await waitForEnabledSendButton();
    if (!sendButton) {
      if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate('semantic-repair-send-button-wait')) return;
      semanticRepairQueuedSignature = repair.signature;
      semanticRepairTimer = setTimeout(() => void executeSemanticRepairImpulse(repair), Math.max(1000, CONFIG.semanticRepairRetryMs));
      setPhase('correction', 'Repair send button temporarily unavailable; retrying without stopping runner');
      return;
    }
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;

    if (await enforceModelContinuityGuardV622('semantic-repair-before-click', { allowArm: true })) return;
    if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate('semantic-repair-before-click')) return;
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;

    // Repair has the same causal envelope as the failed dispatch. Recheck it after
    // every awaited UI boundary so a superseded repair can never be physically sent.
    const repairPreClickSessionV614 = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const repairPreClickPendingV614 = repairPreClickSessionV614?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (
      !repairPreClickPendingV614 ||
      String(repairPreClickPendingV614.id || '') !== String(repair.dispatchId || '') ||
      Number(repairPreClickPendingV614.baseRevision) !== Number(repair.baseRevision)
    ) return;

    const leaseKey = `repair:${repair.signature}`;
    if (leaseBlocksSend(leaseKey)) return;
    saveCache({ lastSendEventKey: leaseKey, lastSendAt: now() });
    semanticRepairAttempts.set(expected.id, counts.total + 1);
    semanticRepairFailureAttempts.set(repair.failureKey || repair.signature, counts.failure + 1);
    semanticRepairSentSignature = repair.signature;
    // Persist both the dispatch-wide safety cap and per-failure identity without
    // advancing semantic revision. Reloading cannot resurrect an already-tried
    // identical repair, while a genuinely different technical failure still has
    // room to receive its own bounded correction.
    const repairSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (repairSession?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id === expected.id) {
      const pendingRepair = repairSession.transport.pendingDispatch;
      pendingRepair.repairEpoch = CONFIG.semanticRepairEpoch;
      pendingRepair.repairAttempts = counts.total + 1;
      pendingRepair.repairFailureAttempts = {
        ...(pendingRepair.repairFailureAttempts && typeof pendingRepair.repairFailureAttempts === 'object'
          ? pendingRepair.repairFailureAttempts
          : {}),
        [repair.failureKey || repair.signature]: counts.failure + 1,
      };
      pendingRepair.lastRepairSignature = repair.signature;
      pendingRepair.lastRepairCategory = repair.category || 'transport';
      pendingRepair.lastRepairFailureDomainV695 = repair.failureDomain || 'TRANSPORT_FAILURE';
      pendingRepair.lastRepairAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(repairSession);
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const repairDurablePendingV614 = SemanticSessionStore.load()?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    if (
      !repairDurablePendingV614 ||
      String(repairDurablePendingV614.id || '') !== String(repair.dispatchId || '') ||
      Number(repairDurablePendingV614.baseRevision) !== Number(repair.baseRevision)
    ) return;
    if (!(await verifySemanticRuntimeLeaseV616())) return;
    if (!clickSendButtonWithPermitV616(sendButton, `semantic-repair:${repair.dispatchId}`, repair.text)) return;

    setPhase(
      'correction',
      `Auto repair impulse ${semanticRepairAttemptLabelV6914(counts.total + 1)} отправлен (${repair.category || 'technical'}); ожидаю исправленный semantic result для того же dispatch`
    );
    showBanner('↻ VIBE-GO отправил короткий repair impulse', '#92400e', 7000);
    log('Semantic repair impulse sent', {
      dispatchId: expected.id,
      baseRevision: expected.baseRevision,
      attempt: counts.total + 1,
      failureAttempt: counts.failure + 1,
      category: repair.category || 'transport',
      markerSignature: repair.signature,
    });
    generationDirty = true;
    scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe(700);
  }

  function queueSemanticRepairImpulse(reason, marker = null) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const disposition = semanticRepairDisposition(reason, session);
    if (!['repair-impulse', 'source-correction', 'tool-correction'].includes(disposition.mode)) return disposition;

    const failureDomain = semanticFailureDomainV695(reason, disposition);
    const escalationPolicy = semanticRepairEscalationPolicyV695(disposition, failureDomain);
    const failureObservation = recordSemanticFailureObservationV695(
      reason, marker, disposition, failureDomain
    );

    // a09.5 / FM-01: ordinary thin-result parser/serialization failures are not
    // model-continuity evidence. Keep the historical behavioral sentinel only for
    // failures explicitly classified as SEMANTIC_FAILURE.
    if (escalationPolicy.allowModelContinuityBehavioralFailure) {
      const behavioral = recordModelContinuityBehavioralFailureV622(reason, marker);
      if (behavioral.alarm) {
        return {
          mode: 'model-continuity-hold',
          category: 'model-continuity',
          failureDomain,
          failureObservation,
          reason: behavioral.state?.paused?.reason ||
            'Repeated semantic-behavior failures triggered the model continuity guard',
          behavioral,
        };
      }
    }

    if (CONFIG.semanticAutoRepairEnabled !== true) {
      return {
        mode: 'manual-correction',
        category: disposition.category || 'transport',
        failureDomain,
        failureObservation,
        reason: String(disposition.reason || reason || 'semantic-result correction requires supervised resumption'),
      };
    }
    const repair = buildSemanticRepairImpulse(reason, marker, disposition);
    if (!repair) return { mode: 'integrity-hold', failureDomain: 'SEMANTIC_FAILURE', reason: 'Unable to construct semantic repair impulse' };

    const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const counts = semanticRepairAttemptCounts(pending, repair.failureKey || repair.signature);
    const dispatchRepairLimitV6914 = semanticRepairDispatchAttemptLimitV6914();
    if (Number.isFinite(dispatchRepairLimitV6914) && counts.total >= dispatchRepairLimitV6914) {
      const exhausted = recordTransportRepairExhaustedV695(reason, pending, counts);
      return {
        mode: 'transport-repair-exhausted',
        category: disposition.category || 'transport',
        failureDomain,
        failureObservation,
        attempts: counts.total,
        failureAttempts: counts.failure,
        exhausted,
        repair,
      };
    }
    if (counts.failure >= CONFIG.semanticRepairMaxAttemptsPerFailure) {
      return { mode: 'failure-limit', failureDomain, failureObservation, attempts: counts.total, failureAttempts: counts.failure, repair };
    }
    if (
      semanticRepairQueuedSignature === repair.signature ||
      semanticRepairSentSignature === repair.signature
    ) {
      return { mode: 'already-repairing', failureDomain, failureObservation, attempts: counts.total, failureAttempts: counts.failure, repair };
    }

    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    semanticRepairQueuedSignature = repair.signature;
    semanticRepairTimer = setTimeout(
      () => void executeSemanticRepairImpulse(repair),
      CONFIG.semanticRepairDelayMs
    );
    return { mode: 'repair-queued', failureDomain, failureObservation, attempts: counts.total, failureAttempts: counts.failure, repair };
  }

  function clearPendingSend() {
    clearTimeout(pendingSendTimer);
    clearInterval(pendingCountdownTimer);

    pendingSendTimer = null;
    pendingCountdownTimer = null;
    pendingSend = null;
  }

  function queueSend(dispatch, kind, reason) {
    if (!state.running || !isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    if (!dispatch?.id || !dispatch?.controlId) {
      throw new Error('Protocol dispatch identity is missing');
    }

    if (
      pendingSend?.dispatch?.id === dispatch.id &&
      pendingSend?.kind === kind
    ) {
      return;
    }

    clearPendingSend();

    const pacingProfile = getPacingProfile();
    const baseDelayMs = randomInt(
      pacingProfile.sendDelayMinMs,
      pacingProfile.sendDelayMaxMs
    );
    const cache = loadCache();
    const nowMs = now();

    const lastSendAt = Number(cache.lastSendAt || 0);
    const sinceLastSendMs = lastSendAt > 0
      ? Math.max(0, nowMs - lastSendAt)
      : Infinity;
    const sendFloorRemainingMs = Number.isFinite(sinceLastSendMs)
      ? Math.max(0, Number(pacingProfile.semanticMinInterDispatchMs || 0) - sinceLastSendMs)
      : 0;

    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const acceptedAtMs = Date.parse(
      String(session?.transport?.lastControl?.acceptedAt || '')
    );
    const sinceAcceptedMs = Number.isFinite(acceptedAtMs)
      ? Math.max(0, nowMs - acceptedAtMs)
      : Infinity;
    const postAcceptanceRemainingMs = Number.isFinite(sinceAcceptedMs)
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          Number(pacingProfile.semanticPostAcceptanceQuietMs || 0) - sinceAcceptedMs
        )
      : 0;
    const usageGovernorV625 = usageGovernorDecisionV625(`semantic-dispatch:${dispatch.id}`, nowMs);
    const usageGovernorRemainingMs = usageGovernorV625.allowed
      ? 0
      : Math.max(0, Number(usageGovernorV625.waitMs || 0));

    // Pacing is a lower bound only. Engineering need/tail state is what called
    // queueSend(); the timer merely prevents immediate request pressure.
    const delayMs = Math.max(
      baseDelayMs,
      sendFloorRemainingMs,
      postAcceptanceRemainingMs,
      usageGovernorRemainingMs
    );

    protocol.markDispatchQueued?.(dispatch);
    const queuedCasV615 = semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(dispatch, ['queued']);
    if (!queuedCasV615.matches) {
      log('a18 refused to queue superseded semantic dispatch timer', {
        dispatchId: dispatch.id,
        currentDispatchId: queuedCasV615.pending?.id || null,
        currentStatus: queuedCasV615.pending?.status || null,
        baseRevision: dispatch.baseRevision,
      });
      scheduleProcess(80);
      return;
    }

    pendingSend = {
      protocolName: protocol.name,
      dispatch: { ...dispatch, display: { ...dispatch.display } },
      kind,
      dueAt: nowMs + delayMs,
      reason,
      pacing: {
        baseDelayMs,
        sendFloorRemainingMs,
        postAcceptanceRemainingMs,
        profileId: pacingProfile.id,
        profileLabel: pacingProfile.label,
        profileRange: pacingProfile.shortLabel,
        minInterDispatchMs: Number(pacingProfile.semanticMinInterDispatchMs || 0),
        postAcceptanceQuietMs: Number(pacingProfile.semanticPostAcceptanceQuietMs || 0),
        usageGovernorRemainingMs,
        usageGovernor: cloneSemanticValue(usageGovernorV625),
        acceptedAt: Number.isFinite(acceptedAtMs)
          ? new Date(acceptedAtMs).toISOString()
          : null,
      },
    };

    const updateCountdown = () => {
      if (!pendingSend) return;

      const seconds = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.ceil((pendingSend.dueAt - now()) / 1000)
      );

      setPhase(
        'delay',
        protocol.describeQueued(
          pendingSend.dispatch,
          pendingSend.kind,
          seconds
        )
      );
    };

    updateCountdown();

    pendingCountdownTimer = setInterval(
      updateCountdown,
      500
    );

    pendingSendTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
      const task = pendingSend;

      clearPendingSend();

      if (!task || !state.running) return;

      await executeQueuedSend(task);
    }, delayMs);

    log('GO queued through continuous protocol façade', {
      protocol: protocol.name,
      kind,
      delayMs,
      dispatchId: dispatch.id,
      controlId: dispatch.controlId,
      reason,
      pacing: pendingSend?.pacing || null,
    });
  }

  async function executeQueuedSend(task) {
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;

    const globalTransportGateV697 = await ensureOriginGlobalTransportAuthorityV697(
      'physical-send-preflight',
      { pause: true }
    );
    if (!globalTransportGateV697.allowed) return;

    const semanticDispatchGateV696 = enforceSemanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696('physical-send-preflight');
    if (!semanticDispatchGateV696.allowed) {
      ProtocolRuntime.getByName(task?.protocolName)?.markDispatchCancelled?.(
        task?.dispatch,
        'semantic quiescent: no runnable Distance after open-Mission continuity repair at physical-send preflight'
      );
      setPhase(
        'idle',
        'semantic quiescent · queued dispatch cancelled because no runnable Distance remains after open-Mission continuity repair'
      );
      renderPanel();
      return;
    }

    if (await enforceModelContinuityGuardV622('semantic-dispatch-preflight', { allowArm: true })) return;
    if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate('semantic-dispatch-preflight')) return;
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const usagePreflightV625 = usageGovernorDecisionV625(`semantic-dispatch:${task.dispatch?.id || 'unknown'}:preflight`);
    if (!usagePreflightV625.allowed) {
      setPhase('delay', `usage governor · ${usagePreflightV625.reason} · ${Math.ceil(Number(usagePreflightV625.waitMs || 0) / 1000)}с`);
      queueSend(task.dispatch, task.kind, `a25 usage governor: ${usagePreflightV625.reason}`);
      return;
    }

    if (task.protocolName !== protocol.name) {
      ProtocolRuntime.getByName(task.protocolName)?.markDispatchCancelled?.(
        task.dispatch,
        'protocol switched'
      );
      log('Queued dispatch cancelled: protocol switched', {
        queued: task.protocolName,
        active: protocol.name,
      });
      return;
    }

    if (isGenerating()) {
      setPhase(
        'waiting',
        'перед отправкой обнаружена активная генерация'
      );
      scheduleProcess(2500);
      return;
    }

    const turns = getTailTurns();
    const reconciliation = await protocol.reconcile(turns);
    const disposition = protocol.classifyReconciliation(reconciliation);

    if (disposition.kind === 'settling') {
      // Force a fresh <pre> read on every bounded settling poll. The main
      // conversation observer intentionally ignores characterData, so relying on
      // mutation invalidation alone can preserve a transient truncated cache.
      markLatestAssistantTailDirty();
      setPhase('waiting', disposition.reason);
      scheduleProcess(disposition.retryAfterMs || CONFIG.semanticIncompleteStatePollMs);
      return;
    }

    if (disposition.kind === 'invalid') {
      if (task.protocolName === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name && disposition.recoverable !== false) {
        enterSemanticCorrectionWait(disposition.reason, disposition.marker);
      } else {
        enterHold(disposition.reason);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (disposition.kind === 'hold') {
      enterHold(disposition.reason);
      return;
    }

    if (disposition.kind === 'complete') {
      await protocol.complete();
      return;
    }

    const control = protocol.resolveControl(reconciliation);

    if (!control) {
      setPhase(
        'idle',
        'control marker/boundary не смонтирован; GO отменён'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (protocol.getControlId() !== task.dispatch.controlId) {
      protocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(task.dispatch, 'control advanced');
      log('Queued GO cancelled: control advanced', {
        queued: task.dispatch.controlId,
        actual: protocol.getControlId(),
      });

      scheduleProcess(250);
      return;
    }

    const preInspectCasV614 = semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(task.dispatch, ['ready', 'queued']);
    if (!preInspectCasV614.matches) {
      abandonSupersededQueuedDispatchV614(task, 'pre-inspect', preInspectCasV614);
      return;
    }

    const tail = protocol.inspectExchange(control, turns, task.dispatch);

    if (task.kind === 'normal' && tail.action !== 'send') {
      protocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(task.dispatch, tail.reason || tail.action);
      log('Queued normal GO cancelled by tail recheck', tail);
      scheduleProcess(250);
      return;
    }

    if (task.kind === 'retry' && tail.action !== 'orphan-go') {
      protocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(task.dispatch, tail.reason || tail.action);
      log('Queued retry GO cancelled by tail recheck', tail);
      scheduleProcess(250);
      return;
    }

    if (leaseBlocksSend(task.dispatch.id)) {
      setPhase(
        'waiting',
        'anti-double-send lease ещё активен'
      );
      scheduleProcess(2500);
      return;
    }

    // A physical send may never outrun its durable semantic/runtime authority.
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    const dispatchSize = task.dispatch.size || semanticDispatchSize(task.dispatch.text);
    if (dispatchSize.chars > CONFIG.semanticDispatchHardMaxChars) {
      const reason =
        `Semantic dispatch payload refused before send: ${dispatchSize.chars} chars / ` +
        `${dispatchSize.bytes} bytes (~${dispatchSize.approxTokens} tokens) exceeds hard budget ` +
        `${CONFIG.semanticDispatchHardMaxChars} chars. Compact Source Workspace context instead of sending persisted history through chat.`;
      protocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(task.dispatch, reason);
      warn(reason, { dispatchId: task.dispatch.id, ...dispatchSize });
      enterHold(reason);
      return;
    }

    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const preComposerCasV614 = semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(task.dispatch, ['ready', 'queued']);
    if (!preComposerCasV614.matches) {
      abandonSupersededQueuedDispatchV614(task, 'pre-composer', preComposerCasV614);
      return;
    }

    const composer = findComposer();

    if (!composer) {
      enterHold('Composer not found');
      return;
    }

    log('Semantic dispatch payload accepted for physical send', {
      dispatchId: task.dispatch.id,
      ...dispatchSize,
      softMaxChars: CONFIG.semanticDispatchSoftMaxChars,
      hardMaxChars: CONFIG.semanticDispatchHardMaxChars,
    });

    setComposerText(composer, task.dispatch.text);

    const sendButton = await waitForEnabledSendButton();

    if (!sendButton) {
      if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate(`semantic-dispatch-send-button-wait:${task.kind || 'unknown'}`)) return;
      enterHold(
        'Send button not found or stayed disabled'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (await enforceModelContinuityGuardV622(`semantic-dispatch-before-click:${task.kind || 'unknown'}`, { allowArm: true })) return;
    if (await enforcePlatformPressureGate(`semantic-dispatch-before-click:${task.kind || 'unknown'}`)) return;
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;

    const preStartCasV614 = semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(task.dispatch, ['ready', 'queued']);
    if (!preStartCasV614.matches) {
      abandonSupersededQueuedDispatchV614(task, 'pre-submit-start', preStartCasV614);
      return;
    }

    if (task.kind === 'retry') {
      const retryNumber = incrementRetryCount(task.dispatch.id);

      log(`Orphan GO retry #${retryNumber}`);
    }

    const sendCacheBeforeCommit = loadCache();
    saveCache({
      lastSendEventKey: task.dispatch.id,
      lastSendAt: now(),
    });

    protocol.markDispatchStarted(task.dispatch);
    const startedCasV614 = semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(task.dispatch, ['submitting']);
    if (!startedCasV614.matches) {
      abandonSupersededQueuedDispatchV614(task, 'mark-dispatch-started-cas', startedCasV614);
      return;
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const durableSubmitCasV614 = semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(task.dispatch, ['submitting']);
    if (!durableSubmitCasV614.matches) {
      abandonSupersededQueuedDispatchV614(task, 'post-submit-flush-cas', durableSubmitCasV614);
      return;
    }

    const pressureAfterDurableSubmit = detectPlatformPressureSignal();
    if (pressureAfterDurableSubmit) {
      // No physical click happened. Revert the pending envelope to proven-unsent
      // authority before latching platform pressure, so restart recovery cannot
      // mistake this suppressed send for an in-flight dispatch.
      protocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(
        task.dispatch,
        'platform reliability/cooldown detected after durable submit precommit and before physical click'
      );
      saveCache({
        lastSendEventKey: sendCacheBeforeCommit.lastSendEventKey || null,
        lastSendAt: Number(sendCacheBeforeCommit.lastSendAt || 0),
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      await pauseForPlatformPressure(
        pressureAfterDurableSubmit,
        `semantic-dispatch-after-durable-precommit:${task.kind || 'unknown'}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const submitBoundary = task.protocolName === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name
      ? captureSemanticBoundary()
      : null;
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    const clickCasV614 = semanticPendingDispatchCasV614(task.dispatch, ['submitting']);
    if (!clickCasV614.matches) {
      abandonSupersededQueuedDispatchV614(task, 'physical-click-cas', clickCasV614);
      return;
    }
    if (!(await verifySemanticRuntimeLeaseV616())) {
      protocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(task.dispatch, 'durable semantic writer lease lost before physical click');
      enterHold('Durable semantic writer lease lost before physical semantic send');
      return;
    }
    if (!clickSendButtonWithPermitV616(sendButton, `semantic-dispatch:${task.dispatch.id}`, task.dispatch.text)) {
      protocol.markDispatchCancelled?.(task.dispatch, 'physical send gate denied current runner click');
      enterHold('Physical send gate denied semantic dispatch click');
      return;
    }

    let mountedDispatchTurn = null;
    let semanticSubmissionWitness = null;
    if (task.protocolName === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name) {
      mountedDispatchTurn = await waitForMountedSemanticDispatchTurn(
        task.dispatch,
        CONFIG.sendMountConfirmMs
      );
      if (!mountedDispatchTurn) {
        const turnsAfterSubmit = getTailTurns();
        const assistantAdvanced = Boolean(
          submitBoundary && turnsAfterSubmit.some(turn =>
            turn.role === 'assistant' && semanticTurnAfterBoundary(turn, submitBoundary, turnsAfterSubmit)
          )
        );
        const generationObserved = isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating();

        // Live acceptance on 2026-08-13 proved that ChatGPT can accept a large
        // semantic user turn while its mounted user DOM lags beyond 8 seconds.
        // A concurrently observed assistant generation/new assistant turn is a
        // positive submission witness. Preserve the pending dispatch as in-flight
        // instead of entering a false HOLD; duplicate resend remains suppressed.
        if (generationObserved || assistantAdvanced) {
          ProtocolRuntime.getByName(task.protocolName)?.markGenerating?.();
          semanticSubmissionWitness = generationObserved
            ? 'assistant-generation'
            : 'assistant-turn-advanced';
          recordStageHSubmissionWitnessV654(task.dispatch, semanticSubmissionWitness, null);
          recordStageISubmissionWitnessV655(task.dispatch, semanticSubmissionWitness, null);
          await flushRuntimePersistence();
          log('Semantic dispatch accepted by assistant activity despite delayed user-turn mount', {
            dispatchId: task.dispatch.id,
            controlId: task.dispatch.controlId,
            kind: task.kind,
            witness: semanticSubmissionWitness,
            mountConfirmMs: CONFIG.sendMountConfirmMs,
          });
        } else {
          const reason =
            `Physical click did not produce mounted semantic dispatch ${task.dispatch.id} ` +
            `within ${CONFIG.sendMountConfirmMs}ms and no assistant activity witnessed; automatic resend suppressed.`;
          ProtocolRuntime.getByName(task.protocolName)?.markDispatchUnconfirmed?.(
            task.dispatch,
            reason
          );
          warn('Semantic dispatch submission was not confirmed by mounted tail or assistant activity', {
            dispatchId: task.dispatch.id,
            controlId: task.dispatch.controlId,
            kind: task.kind,
          });
          enterHold(reason);
          return;
        }
      } else {
        ProtocolRuntime.getByName(task.protocolName)?.markDispatchMounted?.(
          task.dispatch,
          mountedDispatchTurn
        );
        semanticSubmissionWitness = 'mounted-user-turn';
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
      }
    }

    showBanner(
      protocol.describeSent(task.dispatch, task.kind),
      task.kind === 'retry'
        ? '#92400e'
        : '#166534'
    );

    log(
      task.protocolName === SemanticDistanceProtocol.name
        ? (mountedDispatchTurn
            ? 'Semantic dispatch mounted; physical submission confirmed'
            : 'Semantic dispatch submission confirmed by assistant activity witness')
        : 'GO sent through protocol façade',
      {
        protocol: protocol.name,
        dispatchId: task.dispatch.id,
        controlId: task.dispatch.controlId,
        kind: task.kind,
        semanticSubmissionWitness,
        mountedTurnKey: mountedDispatchTurn?.key || null,
        mountedTurnOrder: Number.isFinite(mountedDispatchTurn?.order)
          ? mountedDispatchTurn.order
          : null,
      }
    );

    generationDirty = true;
    scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe(700);
  }

  async function ensureAudioContext() {
    try {
      audioContext ||= new AudioContext();

      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') {
        await audioContext.resume();
      }

      return audioContext;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function playCompletionSignal() {
    const context = await ensureAudioContext();

    if (!context) return false;

    const pattern = [
      [880, 0.00],
      [1100, 0.18],
      [1320, 0.36],
      [1760, 0.56],
      [1320, 0.92],
      [1760, 1.12],
      [2200, 1.36],
    ];

    for (const [frequency, offset] of pattern) {
      const oscillator = context.createOscillator();
      const gain = context.createGain();
      const start = context.currentTime + offset;

      oscillator.type = 'square';
      oscillator.frequency.value = frequency;

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.22, start);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(
        0.001,
        start + 0.14
      );

      oscillator.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(context.destination);

      oscillator.start(start);
      oscillator.stop(start + 0.15);
    }

    return true;
  }

  async function playHoldSignal() {
    const context = await ensureAudioContext();

    if (!context) return false;

    const pattern = [
      [740, 0.00, 0.12],
      [520, 0.16, 0.16],
      [330, 0.36, 0.24],
      [740, 0.78, 0.12],
      [520, 0.94, 0.16],
      [330, 1.14, 0.32],
    ];

    for (const [frequency, offset, duration] of pattern) {
      const oscillator = context.createOscillator();
      const gain = context.createGain();
      const start = context.currentTime + offset;

      oscillator.type = 'sawtooth';
      oscillator.frequency.value = frequency;

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, start);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(
        0.001,
        start + duration
      );

      oscillator.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(context.destination);

      oscillator.start(start);
      oscillator.stop(start + duration + 0.01);
    }

    return true;
  }

  async function signalHold(reason) {
    const semanticSession = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    const holdSignalKey =
      semanticSession?.transport?.lastControl?.id ||
      semanticSession?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id ||
      `${semanticSession?.id || 'semantic-tail'}:${semanticSession?.revision ?? '?'}:${hashText(reason)}`;

    const cache = loadCache();

    if (cache.lastHoldSignalKey === holdSignalKey) {
      return false;
    }

    saveCache({
      lastHoldSignalKey: holdSignalKey,
    });

    return playHoldSignal();
  }

  async function completeSemanticMission() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();
    setPhase(
      'complete',
      session
        ? `Semantic mission sealed · r${session.revision}`
        : 'Semantic mission sealed'
    );
    document.title = '✅ VIBE SEMANTIC MISSION SEALED';
    showBanner('✅ SEMANTIC MISSION SEALED', '#166534', 15000);
    await playCompletionSignal();
  }

  document.addEventListener(
    'pointerdown',
    () => ensureAudioContext(),
    {
      once: true,
      capture: true,
    }
  );

  function showBanner(
    text,
    background = '#1e3a8a',
    duration = 5000
  ) {
    let banner = document.querySelector(
      '#vibe-go-banner-v5'
    );

    if (!banner) {
      banner = document.createElement('div');
      banner.id = 'vibe-go-banner-v5';

      Object.assign(banner.style, {
        position: 'fixed',
        top: '12px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        zIndex: '2147483647',
        padding: '9px 15px',
        borderRadius: '999px',
        color: '#fff',
        font: '800 12px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif',
        boxShadow: '0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.42)',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      });

      document.body.appendChild(banner);
    }

    banner.textContent = text;
    banner.style.background = background;

    clearTimeout(banner._vibeHideTimer);

    banner._vibeHideTimer = setTimeout(
      () => banner.remove(),
      duration
    );
  }

  function statusColor() {
    switch (state.phase) {
      case 'active':
        return '#166534';
      case 'waiting':
        return '#92400e';
      case 'delay':
        return '#7c3aed';
      case 'complete':
        return '#6b21a8';
      case 'paused':
        return '#92400e';
      case 'hold':
        return '#991b1b';
      default:
        return '#374151';
    }
  }

  function resolveProjectAnchor() {
    const candidates = [
      ...document.querySelectorAll(
        CONFIG.projectAnchorSelector
      ),
    ].filter(element => {
      if (!isVisible(element)) return false;

      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();

      return (
        rect.top >= 0 &&
        rect.top < Math.min(window.innerHeight, 260) &&
        rect.width >= 28 &&
        rect.width <= 620 &&
        rect.height >= 20 &&
        rect.height <= 120
      );
    });

    if (!candidates.length) return null;

    candidates.sort((a, b) => {
      const aRect = a.getBoundingClientRect();
      const bRect = b.getBoundingClientRect();

      const aTopBias = aRect.top;
      const bTopBias = bRect.top;

      if (Math.abs(aTopBias - bTopBias) > 2) {
        return aTopBias - bTopBias;
      }

      return aRect.left - bRect.left;
    });

    return candidates[0];
  }

  /*
   * Ledger Console + Persistence v1
   *
   * The console is a projection of already-authoritative semantic/source state.
   * It never invents future checkpoints or gates engineering decisions.
   * Persistence export/import is explicit and developer-owned.
   */
  const PERSISTENCE_BUNDLE_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-persistence-bundle/v2';
  const PERSISTENCE_LEGACY_BUNDLE_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-persistence-bundle/v1';
  const PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES = Object.freeze([
    'baselines',
    'workspaces',
    'intelligenceQueries',
    'workingSpans',
    'workingRevisions',
  ]);
  let persistenceUiMessage = '';

  function persistenceStoreKey(storeName, value) {
    if (storeName === 'workspaces') return String(value?.sessionId || '');
    return String(value?.id || '');
  }

  function persistenceNormalizeStores(storesInput = {}) {
    const stores = {};
    for (const storeName of PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES) {
      const source = Array.isArray(storesInput?.[storeName]) ? storesInput[storeName] : [];
      const seen = new Set();
      stores[storeName] = source.map(item => cloneSemanticValue(item)).filter(item => {
        const key = persistenceStoreKey(storeName, item);
        if (!key) throw new Error(`Persistence bundle ${storeName} contains a record without identity`);
        if (seen.has(key)) throw new Error(`Persistence bundle ${storeName} duplicates key ${key}`);
        seen.add(key);
        return true;
      });
    }
    return stores;
  }

  function persistenceValidateReferentialIntegrity(stores) {
    const baselineIds = new Set(stores.baselines.map(item => item.id));
    const spanIds = new Set(stores.workingSpans.map(item => item.id));
    const revisionIds = new Set(stores.workingRevisions.map(item => item.id));
    for (const workspace of stores.workspaces) {
      if (!baselineIds.has(workspace.baselineId)) {
        throw new Error(`Workspace ${workspace.sessionId} references missing baseline ${workspace.baselineId}`);
      }
      const working = workspace.working || {};
      for (const spanId of Array.isArray(working.activeSpanIds) ? working.activeSpanIds : []) {
        if (!spanIds.has(spanId)) {
          throw new Error(`Workspace ${workspace.sessionId} references missing working span ${spanId}`);
        }
      }
      if (working.headRevisionId && !revisionIds.has(working.headRevisionId)) {
        throw new Error(`Workspace ${workspace.sessionId} references missing working revision ${working.headRevisionId}`);
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  function runtimePersistenceStoreKey(storeName, value) {
    if (storeName === RUNTIME_STATE_STORE || storeName === 'legacyMigrationInbox') {
      return String(value?.key || '');
    }
    if (storeName === 'semanticSessions') return String(value?.id || '');
    if (['semanticTransport', 'semanticCursors', 'semanticPendingDispatch'].includes(storeName)) {
      return String(value?.sessionId || '');
    }
    return String(value?.key || value?.id || '');
  }

  function persistenceNormalizeRuntimeStores(storesInput = {}) {
    const stores = {};
    for (const storeName of RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES) {
      const source = Array.isArray(storesInput?.[storeName]) ? storesInput[storeName] : [];
      const seen = new Set();
      stores[storeName] = source.map(item => persistenceClone(item)).filter(item => {
        const key = runtimePersistenceStoreKey(storeName, item);
        if (!key) throw new Error(`Runtime persistence ${storeName} contains a record without identity`);
        if (seen.has(key)) throw new Error(`Runtime persistence ${storeName} duplicates key ${key}`);
        seen.add(key);
        return true;
      });
    }
    return stores;
  }

  function emptyRuntimePersistenceStores() {
    return Object.fromEntries(RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES.map(name => [name, []]));
  }

  function legacyLocalStateToRuntimeStores(localState = {}) {
    const stores = emptyRuntimePersistenceStores();
    const pushState = (key, value) => {
      if (value != null) stores.runtimeState.push({ key, value: persistenceClone(value), updatedAt: semanticIsoNow() });
    };
    pushState('runnerCache', localState.runnerCache);
    pushState('manifestBootstrap', localState.manifestBootstrap);
    pushState('alphaLaunch', localState.alphaLaunch);
    const session = localState.semanticCache?.session || null;
    if (session) {
      validateSemanticSession(session);
      pushState('semanticActiveSessionId', String(session.id));
      const records = semanticSessionToPersistenceRecords(session);
      for (const name of RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_STORE_NAMES) stores[name].push(...records[name]);
    }
    return stores;
  }

  function runtimeSessionFromStores(stores, authoritySessionId = null) {
    const activeState = (stores.runtimeState || []).find(item => item.key === 'semanticActiveSessionId');
    const sessionId = activeState?.value || authoritySessionId || stores.semanticSessions?.[0]?.id || null;
    return sessionId ? reconstructSemanticSessionFromRecords(stores, sessionId) : null;
  }

  const CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-cross-chat-handoff/v1';
  const CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY = 'crossChatHandoff';

  function buildCrossChatHandoff(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load(), options = {}) {
    const session = sessionInput ? persistenceClone(sessionInput) : null;
    if (!session) return null;
    validateSemanticSession(session);
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    const cursor = session.sourceCursor || {};
    const sourceStatus = SourceWorkspace.status();
    const workingStatus = WorkingSource.status();
    const compactNote = note => ({
      id: note.id,
      kind: note.kind,
      text: note.text,
      status: note.status,
      distanceId: note.distanceId || null,
      revision: note.revision ?? null,
    });
    const compactDecision = decision => ({
      id: decision.id,
      text: decision.text,
      reason: decision.reason || '',
      distanceId: decision.distanceId || null,
      revision: decision.revision ?? null,
    });
    const compactWorklog = item => ({
      revision: item.revision,
      action: item.action,
      activity: item.activity,
      distanceId: item.distanceId || null,
      summary: item.summary || '',
      nextFocus: item.nextFocus || '',
      workingIdentity: item.workingIdentity || null,
      workingRevisionId: item.workingRevisionId || null,
    });
    const sourcePath = {
      origin: location.origin,
      pathname: location.pathname,
    };
    const timestamp = semanticIsoNow();
    return {
      schema: CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_SCHEMA,
      id: `handoff:${session.id}`,
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision),
      status: 'ready',
      reason: String(options.reason || 'portable cross-chat continuation'),
      sourceContext: sourcePath,
      createdAt: options.createdAt || timestamp,
      updatedAt: timestamp,
      mission: {
        direction: session.mission?.direction || '',
        reminder: session.mission?.reminder || '',
      },
      route: {
        activity: session.route?.activity || null,
        activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
        nextFocus: session.route?.nextFocus || '',
        returnPoint: persistenceClone(session.route?.returnPoint || null),
        deepeningStack: (session.route?.deepeningStack || []).map(frame => ({
          distanceId: frame.distanceId || null,
          childDistanceId: frame.childDistanceId || null,
          returnPoint: persistenceClone(frame.returnPoint || null),
        })),
      },
      activeDistance: active ? {
        id: active.id,
        parentId: active.parentId || null,
        status: active.status,
        objective: active.objective,
        closureContract: active.closureContract || '',
        summary: active.summary || '',
      } : null,
      source: {
        baselineId: cursor.baselineId || sourceStatus?.baseline?.id || null,
        baselineSha256:
          sourceStatus?.baseline?.sha256 ||
          semanticCursorBaselineSha(cursor) ||
          null,
        baselineName: cursor.baseline?.name || sourceStatus?.baseline?.name || null,
        nextOffset: cursor.nextOffset ?? null,
        activeRange: persistenceClone(cursor.activeRange || null),
        coveredThrough: cursor.coveredThrough ?? null,
        coveredRangeCount: Array.isArray(cursor.coveredRanges) ? cursor.coveredRanges.length : 0,
        relatedRangeCount: Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges) ? cursor.relatedRanges.length : 0,
        workspaceRevision: cursor.workspaceRevision ?? null,
      },
      working: {
        identity: cursor.workingRevision || workingStatus?.identity || null,
        sequence: workingStatus?.sequence ?? null,
        headRevisionId: workingStatus?.headRevisionId || null,
        activeSpanCount: workingStatus?.activeSpanCount ?? null,
        structureDirty: Boolean(workingStatus?.structureDirty),
      },
      transport: {
        lastControl: session.transport?.lastControl ? {
          id: session.transport.lastControl.id,
          turnKey: session.transport.lastControl.turnKey || null,
          turnOrder: session.transport.lastControl.turnOrder ?? null,
          revision: session.transport.lastControl.revision ?? null,
        } : null,
        pendingDispatch: session.transport?.pendingDispatch ? {
          id: session.transport.pendingDispatch.id,
          baseRevision: session.transport.pendingDispatch.baseRevision,
          status: session.transport.pendingDispatch.status || null,
        } : null,
        reanchorBoundary: persistenceClone(session.transport?.reanchorBoundary || null),
      },
      continuity: {
        openNotes: (session.notes || [])
          .filter(note => note.status !== 'resolved')
          .slice(-16)
          .map(compactNote),
        recentDecisions: (session.decisions || []).slice(-12).map(compactDecision),
        recentWorklog: (session.worklog || []).slice(-8).map(compactWorklog),
        totals: {
          distances: Object.keys(session.distances || {}).length,
          notes: (session.notes || []).length,
          decisions: (session.decisions || []).length,
          worklog: (session.worklog || []).length,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  function loadCrossChatHandoff() {
    const value = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY, null);
    if (!value || value.schema !== CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_SCHEMA) return null;
    return persistenceClone(value);
  }

  async function saveCrossChatHandoff(options = {}) {
    const previous = loadCrossChatHandoff();
    const record = buildCrossChatHandoff(SemanticSessionStore.load(), {
      ...options,
      createdAt:
        previous?.sessionId === SemanticSessionStore.load()?.id
          ? previous.createdAt
          : undefined,
    });
    if (!record) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY, null);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      return null;
    }
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY, record);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return loadCrossChatHandoff();
  }

  function crossChatHandoffDispatchContext(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const handoff = loadCrossChatHandoff();
    if (!session || !handoff || String(handoff.sessionId) !== String(session.id)) {
      return '(none)';
    }
    const crossPath =
      String(handoff.sourceContext?.origin || '') !== String(location.origin) ||
      String(handoff.sourceContext?.pathname || '') !== String(location.pathname);
    const importedHere =
      handoff.importedInto?.origin === location.origin &&
      handoff.importedInto?.pathname === location.pathname;
    if ((!crossPath && !importedHere) || handoff.consumedAt) return '(none)';
    const continuity = handoff.continuity || {};
    const compactContinuity = {
      openNotes: (Array.isArray(continuity.openNotes) ? continuity.openNotes : [])
        .slice(-4)
        .map(item => ({
          kind: item?.kind || 'note',
          text: semanticClipText(item?.text || '', 600),
          revision: item?.revision ?? null,
          distanceId: item?.distanceId || null,
        })),
      recentDecisions: (Array.isArray(continuity.recentDecisions) ? continuity.recentDecisions : [])
        .slice(-4)
        .map(item => ({
          text: semanticClipText(item?.text || '', 600),
          revision: item?.revision ?? null,
          distanceId: item?.distanceId || null,
        })),
      recentWorklog: (Array.isArray(continuity.recentWorklog) ? continuity.recentWorklog : [])
        .slice(-4)
        .map(item => ({
          revision: item?.revision ?? null,
          action: item?.action || null,
          activity: item?.activity || null,
          distanceId: item?.distanceId || null,
          summary: semanticClipText(item?.summary || '', 800),
          nextFocus: semanticClipText(item?.nextFocus || '', 700),
          workingIdentity: item?.workingIdentity || null,
          workingRevisionId: item?.workingRevisionId || null,
        })),
      totals: continuity.totals || {
        notes: Array.isArray(continuity.openNotes) ? continuity.openNotes.length : 0,
        decisions: Array.isArray(continuity.recentDecisions) ? continuity.recentDecisions.length : 0,
        worklog: Array.isArray(continuity.recentWorklog) ? continuity.recentWorklog.length : 0,
      },
      authority: 'Full cross-chat continuity remains persisted in VIBE-GO runtime IndexedDB; dispatch carries only a bounded causal summary.',
    };
    return JSON.stringify({
      schema: handoff.schema,
      sessionId: handoff.sessionId,
      semanticRevision: handoff.semanticRevision,
      sourceContext: handoff.sourceContext,
      importedInto: handoff.importedInto || null,
      mission: handoff.mission,
      route: handoff.route ? {
        activity: handoff.route.activity || null,
        activeDistanceId: handoff.route.activeDistanceId || null,
        nextFocus: semanticClipText(handoff.route.nextFocus || '', 1000),
        returnPoint: handoff.route.returnPoint || null,
        deepeningStack: Array.isArray(handoff.route.deepeningStack)
          ? handoff.route.deepeningStack.slice(-4)
          : [],
      } : null,
      activeDistance: handoff.activeDistance,
      source: handoff.source,
      working: handoff.working,
      continuity: compactContinuity,
    }, null, 2);
  }

  function markCrossChatHandoffConsumed(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.load()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const handoff = loadCrossChatHandoff();
    if (!session || !handoff || String(handoff.sessionId) !== String(session.id)) return false;
    const importedHere =
      handoff.importedInto?.origin === location.origin &&
      handoff.importedInto?.pathname === location.pathname;
    const crossPath =
      String(handoff.sourceContext?.origin || '') !== String(location.origin) ||
      String(handoff.sourceContext?.pathname || '') !== String(location.pathname);
    if (!importedHere && !crossPath) return false;
    if (handoff.consumedAt) return true;
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY, {
      ...handoff,
      status: 'consumed',
      consumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      consumedIn: {
        origin: location.origin,
        pathname: location.pathname,
        semanticRevision: Number(session.revision),
      },
    });
    return true;
  }


  /*
   * Seamless Cross-Chat Recovery v1
   *
   * IndexedDB databases are origin-scoped even though v6.x deliberately uses
   * pathname-derived database names.  v6.3 therefore keeps a tiny origin-wide
   * registry and can also discover legacy v6.2.x databases with
   * indexedDB.databases().  A new chat can clone the latest authoritative
   * Runtime + Source pair into its own pathname namespace, restore Working
   * Source, and then re-anchor only the mounted transport envelope.
   *
   * No chat-history archaeology and no source reconstruction from prose.
   */
  const CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-cross-chat-registry/v1';
  const CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_DB_NAME =
    'vibe-go-resort-web-cross-chat-registry:' + hashText(location.origin);
  const CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_DB_VERSION = 1;
  const CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE = 'registry';
  const CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY = 'crossChatAutoRecovery';
  function crossChatLatestRegistryKeyV6918(laneId = currentSemanticLaneIdV6918()) {
    return `latest:${normalizeSemanticLaneIdV6918(laneId)}`;
  }
  function resolveCrossChatRegistryKeyV6918(key) {
    const raw = String(key == null ? 'latest' : key);
