    return raw === 'latest' ? crossChatLatestRegistryKeyV6918() : raw;
  }
  let crossChatRegistryPromise = null;
  let crossChatPublishTimer = null;
  let crossChatRecoveryPromise = null;

  function openCrossChatRegistry() {
    if (crossChatRegistryPromise) return crossChatRegistryPromise;
    crossChatRegistryPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(
        CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_DB_NAME,
        CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_DB_VERSION
      );
      request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        const database = request.result;
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE)) {
          database.createObjectStore(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE, { keyPath: 'key' });
        }
      };
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(
        request.error || new Error('Unable to open VIBE cross-chat registry')
      );
    });
    return crossChatRegistryPromise;
  }

  async function crossChatRegistryGet(key = 'latest') {
    const database = await openCrossChatRegistry();
    const transaction = database.transaction(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE, 'readonly');
    return runtimeRequest(transaction.objectStore(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE).get(resolveCrossChatRegistryKeyV6918(key)));
  }

  async function crossChatRegistryPut(value) {
    const database = await openCrossChatRegistry();
    const transaction = database.transaction(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE, 'readwrite');
    transaction.objectStore(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE).put(value);
    await runtimeTransactionDone(transaction);
    return value;
  }


  const ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_LEASE_SCHEMA_V697 =
    'vibe-go-origin-global-semantic-transport-lease/v1';

  function originGlobalTransportLeaseKeyV697(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session?.id) return null;
    return `transport-owner:${semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session)}:${String(session.id)}`;
  }

  function originGlobalTransportOwnerMatchesCurrentV697(lease, sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!lease || !session) return false;
    return Boolean(
      lease.schema === ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_LEASE_SCHEMA_V697 &&
      String(lease.sessionId || '') === String(session.id || '') &&
      String(lease.semanticLaneId || '') === String(semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session)) &&
      String(lease.pathname || '') === String(location.pathname || '') &&
      String(lease.runtimeDatabaseName || '') === String(RUNTIME_DB_NAME || '')
    );
  }

  async function getOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const key = originGlobalTransportLeaseKeyV697(session);
    if (!key) return null;
    const database = await openCrossChatRegistry();
    const transaction = database.transaction(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE, 'readonly');
    return runtimeRequest(transaction.objectStore(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE).get(key));
  }

  async function claimOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek(), options = {}) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session?.id) return { claimed: false, reason: 'NO_SESSION', lease: null, latest: null };

    const laneId = semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session);
    const key = originGlobalTransportLeaseKeyV697(session);
    const latestKey = crossChatLatestRegistryKeyV6918(laneId);
    const pathname = String(location.pathname || '');
    const expectedPreviousPathname = String(options.expectedPreviousPathname || '').trim() || null;
    const expectedPreviousLeaseId = String(options.expectedPreviousLeaseId || '').trim() || null;
    const expectedPreviousGeneration = Number.isFinite(Number(options.expectedPreviousGeneration))
      ? Number(options.expectedPreviousGeneration)
      : null;
    const expectedPreviousSemanticRevision = Number.isFinite(Number(options.expectedPreviousSemanticRevision))
      ? Number(options.expectedPreviousSemanticRevision)
      : null;
    const expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence = Number.isFinite(Number(options.expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence))
      ? Number(options.expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence)
      : null;
    const expectedRolloverId = String(options.rolloverId || '').trim() || null;
    const expectedTransferToken = String(options.transferToken || '').trim() || null;
    const transfer = options.transfer === true;

    const previousLeaseMatchesExpectationV2 = lease => Boolean(
      lease &&
      (!expectedPreviousLeaseId || String(lease.leaseId || '') === expectedPreviousLeaseId) &&
      (expectedPreviousGeneration == null || Number(lease.generation || 0) === expectedPreviousGeneration) &&
      (expectedPreviousSemanticRevision == null || Number(lease.semanticRevision || 0) === expectedPreviousSemanticRevision) &&
      (expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence == null ||
        Number(lease.acceptanceSequence || 0) === expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence) &&
      (!expectedRolloverId || !lease.rolloverId || String(lease.rolloverId || '') === expectedRolloverId) &&
      (!expectedTransferToken || !lease.transferToken || String(lease.transferToken || '') === expectedTransferToken)
    );

    const database = await openCrossChatRegistry();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = database.transaction(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE, 'readwrite');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE);
      const leaseRequest = store.get(key);
      const latestRequest = store.get(latestKey);
      let leaseDone = false;
      let latestDone = false;
      let current = null;
      let latest = null;
      let decision = null;
      let settledError = null;

      const abort = error => {
        settledError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error || 'origin-global transport lease failure'));
        try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
      };

      const maybeDecide = () => {
        if (!leaseDone || !latestDone || decision || settledError) return;
        try {
          const sameOwner = originGlobalTransportOwnerMatchesCurrentV697(current, session);
          let allowed = false;
          let mode = '';

          if (!current) {
            const latestSameSession = Boolean(
              latest?.schema === CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA &&
              String(latest.sessionId || '') === String(session.id) &&
              String(latest.semanticLaneId || laneId) === String(laneId)
            );
            const latestPath = latestSameSession ? String(latest.pathname || '') : '';
            if (!latestSameSession || !latestPath || latestPath === pathname) {
              allowed = true;
              mode = latestSameSession ? 'bootstrap-from-current-global-latest' : 'bootstrap-no-existing-owner';
            } else if (transfer && expectedPreviousPathname && latestPath === expectedPreviousPathname) {
              allowed = true;
              mode = 'explicit-cross-chat-transfer-from-global-latest';
            } else {
              decision = {
                claimed: false,
                reason: 'GLOBAL_OWNER_MISSING_BUT_LATEST_POINTS_OTHER_PATH',
                lease: null,
                latest: persistenceClone(latest),
              };
              return;
            }
          } else if (sameOwner) {
            allowed = true;
            mode = 'renew-current-owner';
          } else if (
            current?.schema === ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_LEASE_SCHEMA_V697 &&
            String(current.sessionId || '') === String(session.id) &&
            String(current.semanticLaneId || '') === String(laneId) &&
            transfer &&
            expectedPreviousPathname &&
            String(current.pathname || '') === expectedPreviousPathname &&
            previousLeaseMatchesExpectationV2(current)
          ) {
            allowed = true;
            mode = 'explicit-cross-chat-transfer';
          } else {
            decision = {
              claimed: false,
              reason: 'OWNED_BY_DIFFERENT_PATH',
              lease: persistenceClone(current),
              latest: persistenceClone(latest),
            };
            return;
          }

          if (!allowed) return;

          const next = {
            schema: ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_LEASE_SCHEMA_V697,
            key,
            sessionId: String(session.id),
            semanticLaneId: laneId,
            leaseId: `origin-transport-lease-v697:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`,
            generation: Math.max(0, Number(current?.generation || 0)) + 1,
            origin: String(location.origin || ''),
            pathname,
            runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
            sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
            ownerRunnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id,
            semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
            acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
            rolloverId: expectedRolloverId || current?.rolloverId || null,
            transferToken: expectedTransferToken || current?.transferToken || null,
            reason: String(options.reason || mode || 'origin-global-transport-claim'),
            mode,
            previousOwner: current ? {
              pathname: current.pathname || null,
              runtimeDatabaseName: current.runtimeDatabaseName || null,
              generation: Number(current.generation || 0),
              leaseId: current.leaseId || null,
            } : null,
            acquiredAt: semanticIsoNow(),
          };
          store.put(next);
          decision = {
            claimed: true,
            reason: mode,
            lease: persistenceClone(next),
            latest: persistenceClone(latest),
          };
        } catch (error) {
          abort(error);
        }
      };

      leaseRequest.onerror = () => abort(leaseRequest.error || new Error('Unable to read origin-global transport lease'));
      latestRequest.onerror = () => abort(latestRequest.error || new Error('Unable to read origin-global latest pointer'));
      leaseRequest.onsuccess = () => {
        current = leaseRequest.result || null;
        leaseDone = true;
        maybeDecide();
      };
      latestRequest.onsuccess = () => {
        latest = latestRequest.result || null;
        latestDone = true;
        maybeDecide();
      };

      transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(decision || {
        claimed: false,
        reason: 'NO_DECISION',
        lease: persistenceClone(current),
        latest: persistenceClone(latest),
      });
      transaction.onabort = () => reject(
        settledError || transaction.error || new Error('Origin-global transport lease transaction aborted')
      );
      transaction.onerror = () => {
        if (!settledError) settledError = transaction.error || new Error('Origin-global transport lease transaction failed');
      };
    });
  }

  async function originGlobalTransportAuthorityStatusV697(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session?.id) {
      return {
        schema: 'vibe-go-origin-global-transport-authority-status/v1',
        allowed: true,
        reason: 'NO_SESSION',
        currentPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
        lease: null,
        latest: null,
      };
    }
    const [lease, latest] = await Promise.all([
      getOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(session).catch(() => null),
      crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null),
    ]);
    const allowed = originGlobalTransportOwnerMatchesCurrentV697(lease, session);
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-origin-global-transport-authority-status/v1',
      allowed,
      reason: allowed
        ? 'CURRENT_PATH_OWNS_ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT'
        : lease
          ? 'ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_OWNED_BY_OTHER_PATH'
          : 'ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_UNCLAIMED',
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticLaneId: semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session),
      currentPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
      runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      lease: persistenceClone(lease),
      latest: persistenceClone(latest),
    };
  }

  function pauseForOriginGlobalTransportFenceV697(statusInput, context = '') {
    const statusValue = statusInput || {};
    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    clearTimeout(observerSettleTimer);
    observerSettleTimer = null;
    clearTimeout(generationProbeTimer);
    generationProbeTimer = null;
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();
    const owner = statusValue?.lease?.pathname || statusValue?.latest?.pathname || 'unknown-owner';
    replaceRuntimeStateValue('originGlobalTransportFenceV697', {
      schema: 'vibe-go-origin-global-transport-fence/v1',
      blocked: true,
      context: String(context || 'runtime'),
      currentPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
      ownerPathname: owner,
      lease: persistenceClone(statusValue?.lease || null),
      latest: persistenceClone(statusValue?.latest || null),
      observedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
    setPhase('paused', `origin-global transport fence · authority owned by ${owner}`);
    renderPanel();
    warn('Origin-global semantic transport fence blocked stale endpoint', {
      context,
      currentPathname: location.pathname,
      ownerPathname: owner,
      lease: statusValue?.lease || null,
    });
    return true;
  }

  async function ensureOriginGlobalTransportAuthorityV697(context = 'runtime', options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session?.id) {
      return {
        schema: 'vibe-go-origin-global-transport-authority-status/v1',
        allowed: true,
        reason: 'NO_SESSION',
        currentPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
        lease: null,
        latest: null,
      };
    }

    let statusValue = await originGlobalTransportAuthorityStatusV697(session);
    if (statusValue.allowed) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue('originGlobalTransportFenceV697', null);
      return statusValue;
    }

    if (!statusValue.lease) {
      const claim = await claimOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(session, {
        reason: `bootstrap:${String(context || 'runtime')}`,
      });
      statusValue = await originGlobalTransportAuthorityStatusV697(session);
      if (claim.claimed && statusValue.allowed) {
        replaceRuntimeStateValue('originGlobalTransportFenceV697', null);
        return { ...statusValue, claim };
      }
    }

    if (options.pause !== false) pauseForOriginGlobalTransportFenceV697(statusValue, context);
    return statusValue;
  }


  // Resort Web Stage 2E — project-neutral chat rollover custody.
  // Rollover remains disabled by default through CONFIG.rolloverAutoEnabled=false.
  // No project/session identity is embedded in firmware; current route/session evidence
  // must supply them at runtime.
  const CHAT_ROLLOVER_VERSION_RESORT_V01 = 'resort-web-rollover-1';

  function currentRolloverProjectIdentityV01() {
    return stableProjectRouteIdentityV621(location.pathname) || null;
  }

  function chatRolloverCanonical(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(chatRolloverCanonical);
    if (value && typeof value === 'object') return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(value).sort().map(key => [key, chatRolloverCanonical(value[key])])
    );
    return value;
  }

  function chatRolloverSemanticWitness(session) {
    const copy = cloneSemanticValue(session);
    // Transport reanchoring changes these fields; semantic state must stay exact.
    delete copy.transport;
    delete copy.updatedAt;
    return JSON.stringify(chatRolloverCanonical(copy));
  }

  function chatRolloverVerifyClone(before, after) {
    if (chatRolloverSemanticWitness(before) !== chatRolloverSemanticWitness(after) ||
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(before) !== semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(after)) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SEMANTIC_CUSTODY_MISMATCH: exact semantic state/acceptance sequence was not preserved');
    }
    return true;
  }

  function chatRolloverBootstrapLines(session) {
    if (!session.transport?.rollover?.id || session.transport?.lastControl) return [];
    return [
      'RESORT WEB · EXACT SESSION CONTINUATION · NOT A NEW MISSION',
      `Resume SemanticSession ${session.id} at r${session.revision}, acceptance ${semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session)}.`,
      'Read the attached VIBE_GO_ROLLOVER_STATE.json. It contains the exact saved semantic/persistence authority needed for continuation without summary substitution.',
      'The attached state is a recovery snapshot, not permission to reset semantic state or replay UNKNOWN external effects.',
      'Continue from factual source/runtime/test evidence. Do not infer completion from narrative memory and do not replay failed/unknown mutations blindly.',
      'Transport ownership belongs to the destination chat; the previous chat is not a continuing execution authority.',
      ''
    ];
  }

  function queueManualChatRolloverRequest(options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_NO_SESSION: semantic session is unavailable');
    const request = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-manual-request/v1',

    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_MANUAL_REQUEST_STATE_KEY, request);
    persistenceUiMessage = `Manual rollover queued · ${request.projectName} · waiting for semantic safe point`;

  function chatRolloverDefaultPolicy() {

      enabled: CONFIG.rolloverAutoEnabled !== false,
      projectName: String(CONFIG.rolloverProjectName || 'Resort Empire Web'),

      softMountedTurns: Math.max(40, Number(CONFIG.rolloverSoftMountedTurns || 260)),
      softTailChars: Math.max(200000, Number(CONFIG.rolloverSoftTailChars || 2400000)),
      navigationTimeoutMs: Math.max(4000, Number(CONFIG.rolloverNavigationTimeoutMs || 20000)),
      failureCooldownMs: Math.max(10000, Number(CONFIG.rolloverFailureCooldownMs || 180000)),
      bootstrapAttachments: CONFIG.rolloverBootstrapAttachments !== false,
      attachmentTimeoutMs: Math.max(10000, Number(CONFIG.rolloverAttachmentTimeoutMs || 60000)),
      runnerFilename: String(CONFIG.rolloverRunnerFilename || 'VIBE_GO_RESORT_WEB_v0.1_STAGE4B_ACTIVE_MISSION_V2.txt'),
    };
  }

  function rolloverLeaseMatchesBoundSourceV2(lease, session, pathname, runtimeDatabaseName) {
    if (!lease || !session) return false;
    return Boolean(
      lease.schema === ORIGIN_GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_LEASE_SCHEMA_V697 &&
      String(lease.sessionId || '') === String(session.id || '') &&
      String(lease.semanticLaneId || '') === String(semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session)) &&
      String(lease.pathname || '') === String(pathname || '') &&
      String(lease.runtimeDatabaseName || '') === String(runtimeDatabaseName || '') &&
      Number(lease.semanticRevision || 0) === Number(session.revision || 0) &&
      Number(lease.acceptanceSequence || 0) === semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session)
    );
  }

  async function captureBoundPersistenceBundleV2(options = {}) {
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    const sourceStores = {};
    for (const storeName of PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES) {
      sourceStores[storeName] = await sourceDbGetAll(storeName);
    }
    const runtimeStores = {};
    for (const storeName of RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES) {
      runtimeStores[storeName] = await runtimeDbGetAll(storeName);
    }
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    return {
      schema: PERSISTENCE_BUNDLE_SCHEMA,
      exportedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      package: 'VIBE-GO Resort Web v0.1 · Mission Neutral',
      versions: {
        exporterVersion: 'forensic-persistence-bundle/v3',
        runnerVersion: 'v6.7.0-resort-web-v0.1',
        transportProfileVersion: String(CONFIG.semanticTransportProfile || ''),
        sourceIntelligenceVersion: Number(SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION || 0),
        sourceWorkspaceSchema: String(SOURCE_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA || ''),
        sourceBaselineSchema: String(SOURCE_BASELINE_SCHEMA || ''),
        sourceDatabaseVersion: Number(SOURCE_DB_VERSION || 0),
        runtimeDatabaseSchema: String(RUNTIME_DB_SCHEMA || ''),
        runtimeDatabaseVersion: Number(RUNTIME_DB_VERSION || 0),
      },
      context: {
        origin: location.origin,
        pathname: String(options.sourcePathname || persistenceBoundPathname || location.pathname || ''),
        sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
        sourceDatabaseVersion: SOURCE_DB_VERSION,
        runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        runtimeDatabaseVersion: RUNTIME_DB_VERSION,
      },
      authority: {
        sessionId: session?.id || null,
        semanticRevision: session?.revision ?? null,
        acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session || {}),
        baselineId: session?.sourceCursor?.baselineId || sourceRuntime.baseline?.id || null,
        baselineSha256:
          sourceRuntime.baseline?.sha256 || semanticCursorBaselineSha(session?.sourceCursor || {}) || null,
        workingRevision: session?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      },
      sourceDatabase: { stores: sourceStores },
      runtimeDatabase: { stores: runtimeStores },
    };
  }

  function chatRolloverCapsuleHashMaterialV2(capsuleInput) {
    const capsule = cloneSemanticValue(capsuleInput || {});
    delete capsule.capsuleSha256;
    return JSON.stringify(chatRolloverCanonical(capsule));
  }

  async function sealChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rolloverState, options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session?.id) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_NO_SESSION');
    const rolloverId = String(rolloverState?.id || options.rolloverId || '').trim();
    if (!rolloverId) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_ID_REQUIRED');
    const phase = String(options.phase || 'source');
    const sourcePathname = String(
      options.sourcePathname || persistenceBoundPathname || location.pathname || ''
    );
    const sourceRuntimeDatabaseName = String(RUNTIME_DB_NAME || '');
    const sourceSourceDatabaseName = String(SOURCE_DB_NAME || '');
    const lease = await getOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(session).catch(() => null);
    if (!rolloverLeaseMatchesBoundSourceV2(
      lease,
      session,
      sourcePathname,
      sourceRuntimeDatabaseName
    )) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_TRANSPORT_OWNER_MISMATCH: bound=${sourcePathname} owner=${lease?.pathname || 'none'}`
      );
    }

    const persistenceBundle = await captureBoundPersistenceBundleV2({ sourcePathname });
    const semanticSha256 = await sourceSha256(
      new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverSemanticWitness(session))
    );
    const key = chatRolloverCapsuleKeyV2(rolloverId, phase);
    const transferToken = String(options.transferToken ||
      `rollover-transfer:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 12)}`);
    if (phase !== 'source' && (
      String(lease.rolloverId || '') !== rolloverId ||
      String(lease.transferToken || '') !== transferToken
    )) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_TRANSFER_CHAIN_MISMATCH');
    }
    const capsule = {
      schema: CHAT_ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_SCHEMA_V2,
      key,
      capsuleId: `${rolloverId}:${phase}`,
      rolloverId,
      phase,
      immutable: true,
      transferToken,
      projectName: String(rolloverState?.projectName || options.projectName || ''),
      projectIdentity: currentRolloverProjectIdentityV01(),
      semanticLaneId: semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session),
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      semanticSha256,
      source: {
        origin: String(location.origin || ''),
        pathname: sourcePathname,
        runtimeDatabaseName: sourceRuntimeDatabaseName,
        sourceDatabaseName: sourceSourceDatabaseName,
        lease: cloneSemanticValue(lease),
      },
      handoff: cloneSemanticValue(loadCrossChatHandoff() || null),
      session: cloneSemanticValue(session),
      persistenceBundle,
      support: {
        runnerFilename: 'VIBE_GO_RESORT_WEB_v0.1_STAGE4B_ACTIVE_MISSION_V2.txt',
      },
      sealedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    capsule.capsuleSha256 = await sourceSha256(
      new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverCapsuleHashMaterialV2(capsule))
    );
    await crossChatRegistryPut(capsule);
    return cloneSemanticValue(capsule);
  }

  async function getChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rolloverState, phase = null) {
    const key = phase
      ? chatRolloverCapsuleKeyV2(rolloverState?.id, phase)
      : String(rolloverState?.routeCapsuleKey || rolloverState?.capsuleKey || '').trim();
    if (!key) return null;
    const capsule = await crossChatRegistryGet(key).catch(() => null);
    if (!capsule || capsule.schema !== CHAT_ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_SCHEMA_V2) return null;
    return cloneSemanticValue(capsule);
  }

  async function verifyChatRolloverCapsuleV2(capsuleInput, rolloverState = null) {
    const capsule = cloneSemanticValue(capsuleInput || null);
    if (!capsule || capsule.schema !== CHAT_ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_SCHEMA_V2) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_SCHEMA_INVALID');
    }
    if (rolloverState?.id && String(capsule.rolloverId || '') !== String(rolloverState.id)) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_ROLLOVER_ID_MISMATCH');
    }
    if (rolloverState?.sessionId && String(capsule.sessionId || '') !== String(rolloverState.sessionId)) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_SESSION_MISMATCH');
    }
    const hash = await sourceSha256(
      new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverCapsuleHashMaterialV2(capsule))
    );
    if (!capsule.capsuleSha256 || hash !== capsule.capsuleSha256) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_HASH_MISMATCH');
    }
    const bundledSession = runtimeSessionFromStores(
      persistenceNormalizeRuntimeStores(capsule.persistenceBundle?.runtimeDatabase?.stores || {}),
      capsule.sessionId
    );
    if (!bundledSession || String(bundledSession.id || '') !== String(capsule.sessionId || '')) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_BUNDLE_SESSION_MISSING');
    }
    const semanticHash = await sourceSha256(
      new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverSemanticWitness(bundledSession))
    );
    if (
      Number(bundledSession.revision || 0) !== Number(capsule.semanticRevision || 0) ||
      semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(bundledSession) !== Number(capsule.acceptanceSequence || 0) ||
      semanticHash !== capsule.semanticSha256
    ) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_SEMANTIC_WITNESS_MISMATCH');
    }
    return capsule;
  }

  async function restoreChatRolloverCapsuleIntoBoundPathV2(capsuleInput, rolloverState, options = {}) {
    const capsule = await verifyChatRolloverCapsuleV2(capsuleInput, rolloverState);
    const bundle = capsule.persistenceBundle;
    const sourceStores = persistenceNormalizeStores(bundle?.sourceDatabase?.stores || {});
    const runtimeStores = persistenceNormalizeRuntimeStores(bundle?.runtimeDatabase?.stores || {});

    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    await commitPersistenceStores(sourceStores, 'replace');
    await commitRuntimePersistenceStores(runtimeStores, 'replace');
    await hydrateRuntimePersistence({ force: true });
    await claimSemanticRuntimeLeaseV616('rollover-capsule-restore');

    sourceRuntime.sessionId = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = null;
    sourceRuntime.baseline = null;
    sourceRuntime.restorePromise = null;
    workingRuntime.sessionId = null;
    workingRuntime.spans = new Map();
    workingRuntime.headRevision = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLens = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.queries.clear();
    intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
    intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;

    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || String(session.id || '') !== String(capsule.sessionId || '')) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_RESTORE_SESSION_VERIFY_FAILED');
    }
    const actualSemanticHash = await sourceSha256(
      new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverSemanticWitness(session))
    );
    if (
      Number(session.revision || 0) !== Number(capsule.semanticRevision || 0) ||
      semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session) !== Number(capsule.acceptanceSequence || 0) ||
      actualSemanticHash !== capsule.semanticSha256
    ) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_RESTORE_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH');
    }

    const importedHandoff = loadCrossChatHandoff() || capsule.handoff || null;
    if (importedHandoff && String(importedHandoff.sessionId || '') === String(session.id)) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY, {
        ...cloneSemanticValue(importedHandoff),
        status: 'imported',
        consumedAt: null,
        consumedIn: null,
        importedInto: {
          origin: location.origin,
          pathname: location.pathname,
          importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
          automatic: true,
          rolloverId: rolloverState?.id || capsule.rolloverId,
        },
      });
    }

    let previousLease = capsule.source?.lease || null;
    let expectedPreviousPathname = String(
      options.expectedPreviousPathname || capsule.source?.pathname || ''
    );
    const liveLease = await getOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(session).catch(() => null);
    const liveLeaseBelongsToSameRollover = Boolean(
      liveLease &&
      String(liveLease.sessionId || '') === String(session.id || '') &&
      String(liveLease.semanticLaneId || '') === String(semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session)) &&
      Number(liveLease.semanticRevision || 0) === Number(capsule.semanticRevision || 0) &&
      Number(liveLease.acceptanceSequence || 0) === Number(capsule.acceptanceSequence || 0) &&
      String(liveLease.rolloverId || '') === String(capsule.rolloverId || '') &&
      String(liveLease.transferToken || '') === String(capsule.transferToken || '')
    );
    if (
      liveLeaseBelongsToSameRollover &&
      String(liveLease.pathname || '') !== String(location.pathname || '')
    ) {
      previousLease = liveLease;
      expectedPreviousPathname = String(liveLease.pathname || expectedPreviousPathname);
    }
    const transportTransfer = await claimOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(session, {
      transfer: true,
      expectedPreviousPathname,
      expectedPreviousLeaseId: previousLease?.leaseId || null,
      expectedPreviousGeneration: previousLease?.generation ?? null,
      expectedPreviousSemanticRevision: capsule.semanticRevision,
      expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence: capsule.acceptanceSequence,
      rolloverId: capsule.rolloverId,
      transferToken: capsule.transferToken,
      reason: String(options.reason || `rollover-capsule-transfer:${capsule.phase}`),
    });
    if (!transportTransfer?.claimed) {
      throw new Error(
        'ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_TRANSPORT_TRANSFER_FAILED: ' +
        `${expectedPreviousPathname || 'unknown'} -> ${location.pathname}; ` +
        `owner=${transportTransfer?.lease?.pathname || transportTransfer?.latest?.pathname || 'unknown'}`
      );
    }

    replaceRuntimeStateValue('originGlobalTransportFenceV697', null);
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
      schema: 'vibe-go-cross-chat-auto-recovery/v1',
      status: 'pending-reanchor',
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      fromRuntimeDatabase: capsule.source?.runtimeDatabaseName || null,
      fromSourceDatabase: capsule.source?.sourceDatabaseName || null,
      fromPathname: capsule.source?.pathname || null,
      rolloverId: rolloverState?.id || capsule.rolloverId,
      capsuleKey: capsule.key,
      capsuleSha256: capsule.capsuleSha256,
      importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
    saveCache({ lastSendEventKey: null, lastSendAt: 0, retryCounts: {} });

    if (sourceStores.workspaces?.some(item => String(item?.sessionId || '') === String(session.id))) {
      try { await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id); } catch (error) {
        warn('Rollover capsule restored semantic authority but Source Workspace restore failed', error);
      }
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(session).catch(() => null);

    return {
      recovered: true,
      capsule: {
        key: capsule.key,
        capsuleId: capsule.capsuleId,
        phase: capsule.phase,
        sha256: capsule.capsuleSha256,
      },
      transportTransfer: cloneSemanticValue(transportTransfer),
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
    };
  }

  function ensureChatRolloverEpoch(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session) return null;
    const current = getRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_EPOCH_STATE_KEY, null);
    if (
      current?.sessionId === session.id &&
      current?.pathname === location.pathname &&
      Number.isFinite(Number(current.startSemanticRevision))
    ) {
      return current;
    }
    const epoch = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-epoch/v1',
      sessionId: session.id,
      pathname: location.pathname,
      startSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      startAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      startedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_EPOCH_STATE_KEY, epoch);
    return epoch;
  }

  function chatRolloverPressureSnapshot(turnsInput = null, sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const turns = Array.isArray(turnsInput) ? turnsInput : getTailTurns();
    const policy = getChatRolloverPolicy();
    const epoch = ensureChatRolloverEpoch(session);
    const semanticSpan = session && epoch
      ? Math.max(0, Number(session.revision || 0) - Number(epoch.startSemanticRevision || 0))
      : 0;
    const mountedTurns = chatgptMountedConversationUnitCountV730();
    const tailChars = turns.reduce(
      (sum, turn) => sum + String(turn?.readableText || '').length,
      0
    );
    const currentAcceptance = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session || {});
    if (epoch && !Number.isFinite(epoch.startAcceptanceSequence)) {
      // An old epoch has no trustworthy turn baseline. Roll at the next safe point
      // instead of declaring a long, virtualized chat fresh.
      epoch.legacyUnmeasured = projectRolloverInScope(session);
      epoch.startAcceptanceSequence = currentAcceptance;
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_EPOCH_STATE_KEY, epoch);
    }
    const acceptedTurns = epoch ? Math.max(0, currentAcceptance - epoch.startAcceptanceSequence) : 0;
    const ratios = {
      accepted: acceptedTurns / Math.max(1, Number(policy.softAcceptedTurns || 80)),
      semantic: semanticSpan / Math.max(1, Number(policy.softSemanticRevisions || 1)),
      turns: mountedTurns / Math.max(1, Number(policy.softMountedTurns || 1)),
      tailChars: tailChars / Math.max(1, Number(policy.softTailChars || 1)),
    };
    const pressure = Math.max(ratios.accepted, ratios.semantic, ratios.turns, ratios.tailChars);
    let reason = null;
    if (ratios.semantic >= 1) reason = `semantic revisions in this chat ${semanticSpan}/${policy.softSemanticRevisions}`;
    else if (ratios.turns >= 1) reason = `mounted turns ${mountedTurns}/${policy.softMountedTurns}`;
    else if (ratios.tailChars >= 1) reason = `mounted tail chars ${tailChars}/${policy.softTailChars}`;
    else if (ratios.accepted >= 1) reason = `accepted turns ${acceptedTurns}/${policy.softAcceptedTurns || 80}`;
    else if (epoch?.legacyUnmeasured) reason = 'legacy chat has no reliable acceptance baseline';
    return {
      acceptedTurns,
      pressure,
      reason,
      semanticSpan,
      mountedTurns,
      tailChars,
      ratios,
      policy,
      epoch,
    };
  }

  function visibleTextForRolloverAction(element) {
    return normalizeText(
      element?.getAttribute?.('aria-label') ||
      element?.getAttribute?.('title') ||
      element?.textContent || ''
    );
  }

  function projectNameMatchesElement(element, projectName) {
    const wanted = normalizeText(projectName);
    if (!wanted || !(element instanceof Element)) return false;
    const own = visibleTextForRolloverAction(element);
    if (own === wanted || own.includes(wanted)) return true;
    // Do not use the whole sidebar/nav as project evidence: it contains every
    // project plus global Chat controls and caused v6.5.9 to accept global Chat.
    const local = element.closest?.(
      '[data-testid*="project" i],[class*="project" i],[role="menuitem"],li'
    );
    return local ? normalizeText(local.textContent || '').includes(wanted) : false;
  }

  function projectBasePathFromPathname(pathnameInput) {
    const pathname = String(pathnameInput || '');
    const match = pathname.match(/^\/g\/(g-p-[^/]+)/i);
    return match ? `/g/${match[1]}` : null;
  }

  function projectBasePathFromElement(element) {
    if (!(element instanceof Element)) return null;
    const anchor = element.matches?.('a[href]') ? element : element.closest?.('a[href]');
    const href = anchor?.getAttribute?.('href') || anchor?.href || null;
    if (!href) return null;
    try {
      return projectBasePathFromPathname(new URL(href, location.href).pathname);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function stableProjectRouteIdentityV621(pathnameInput) {
    const pathname = String(pathnameInput || '');
    // ChatGPT can expose the same project through both a slugless sidebar href
    //   /g/g-p-<stable-id>
    // and a slugged mounted route
    //   /g/g-p-<stable-id>-<project-slug>/...
    // The stable g-p id is the project authority; the human-readable slug is not.
    // Current project ids are 32 hex chars. Keep a conservative fallback for any
    // future non-hex id shape without allowing arbitrary prefix matches.
    const stable = pathname.match(/^\/g\/(g-p-[0-9a-f]{32})(?=[\/-]|$)/i);
    if (stable) return stable[1].toLowerCase();
    const segment = pathname.match(/^\/g\/(g-p-[^/]+)/i)?.[1] || '';
    return segment ? segment.toLowerCase() : null;
  }

  function projectBasePathsShareIdentityV621(leftInput, rightInput) {
    const left = stableProjectRouteIdentityV621(leftInput);
    const right = stableProjectRouteIdentityV621(rightInput);
    return !!left && !!right && left === right;
  }

  function isRecoverableSameProjectScopeFailureV621(rolloverInput) {
    const rollover = rolloverInput && typeof rolloverInput === 'object' ? rolloverInput : null;
    if (!rollover || String(rollover.status || '') !== 'failed') return false;
    const error = String(rollover.error || '');
    if (!error.includes('ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SCOPE_VIOLATION')) return false;
    const match = error.match(/escaped\s+(\/g\/g-p-[^\s]+)\s+->\s+(\/g\/g-p-[^;\s]+)/i);
    if (!match) return false;
    return projectBasePathsShareIdentityV621(match[1], match[2]);
  }

  function pathnameBelongsToProject(pathnameInput, projectBasePathInput) {
    const pathname = String(pathnameInput || '');
    const base = String(projectBasePathInput || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    if (!base) return false;
    if (pathname === base || pathname.startsWith(`${base}/`)) return true;
    // a21: route slugs are presentation. A slugged mounted route and slugless
    // project href belong to the same project only when their stable g-p ids match.
    return projectBasePathsShareIdentityV621(pathname, base);
  }
  function projectRolloverInScope(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session || session.status !== 'active' || !session.id) return false;

    const projectBasePath = projectBasePathFromPathname(location.pathname);
    if (!projectBasePath) return false;

    return pathnameBelongsToProject(location.pathname, projectBasePath);
  }

  function findNamedProjectEntry(projectName) {
    const wanted = normalizeText(projectName);
    const candidates = [
      ...document.querySelectorAll('a[href],button,[role="button"],[role="menuitem"]'),
    ].filter(element =>
      isVisible(element) &&
      !element.closest?.('#vibe-go-panel-v5,#vibe-go-panel-v628')
    );
    return candidates
      .map(element => ({
        element,
        label: visibleTextForRolloverAction(element),
        basePath: projectBasePathFromElement(element),
      }))
      .filter(item => item.label === wanted || item.label.includes(wanted))
      // Prefer a real project href because it certifies project identity.
      .sort((a, b) => Number(Boolean(b.basePath)) - Number(Boolean(a.basePath)) || a.label.length - b.label.length)[0]?.element || null;
  }

  function resolveCanonicalProjectBasePath(projectName, projectEntry = null) {
    const current = projectBasePathFromPathname(location.pathname);
    if (current) return current;
    const entry = projectEntry || findNamedProjectEntry(projectName);
    const fromEntry = projectBasePathFromElement(entry);
    if (fromEntry) return fromEntry;
    throw new Error(
      `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED: project "${projectName}" has no certifiable /g/g-p-* route`
    );
  }

  function projectChatActionScope(element, projectName, projectBasePath) {
    if (!(element instanceof Element)) return false;
    const hrefBase = projectBasePathFromElement(element);
    if (hrefBase && (hrefBase === projectBasePath || projectBasePathsShareIdentityV621(hrefBase, projectBasePath))) return true;
    if (!pathnameBelongsToProject(location.pathname, projectBasePath)) return false;
    // Once mounted on the certified project route, accept only project-content
    // actions. Global sidebar controls are outside main and therefore rejected.
    if (element.closest?.('main')) return true;
    return projectNameMatchesElement(element, projectName);
  }

  function findProjectChatActions(projectName, projectBasePath) {
    const candidates = [
      ...document.querySelectorAll('a[href],button,[role="button"],[role="menuitem"]'),
    ].filter(element =>
      isVisible(element) &&
      !element.closest?.('#vibe-go-panel-v5,#vibe-go-panel-v628')
    );
    const labels = new Set(['chat', 'new chat', 'новый чат', 'чат']);
    const scored = [];
    for (const element of candidates) {
      const label = visibleTextForRolloverAction(element);
      if (!labels.has(label)) continue;
      const projectScoped = projectChatActionScope(element, projectName, projectBasePath);
      if (!projectScoped) continue;
      let score = 0;
      if (label === 'chat' || label === 'чат') score += 50;
      if (label === 'new chat' || label === 'новый чат') score += 35;
      if (element.closest?.('main')) score += 40;
      const hrefBase = projectBasePathFromElement(element);
      if (hrefBase && (hrefBase === projectBasePath || projectBasePathsShareIdentityV621(hrefBase, projectBasePath))) score += 50;
      if (element.matches?.('a[href]')) score += 5;
      scored.push({ element, score, label, projectScoped: true });
    }
    scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    return scored;
  }

  function findProjectChatAction(projectName, projectBasePath) {
    return findProjectChatActions(projectName, projectBasePath)[0] || null;
  }

  async function waitForRolloverCondition(predicate, timeoutMs, pollMs = 180) {
    const deadline = now() + Math.max(0, Number(timeoutMs || 0));
    let value = predicate();
    while (!value && now() < deadline) {
      await sleep(pollMs);
      value = predicate();
    }
    return value || null;
  }

  function blankProjectDestination(projectBasePath, sourcePathname) {
    const composer = findComposer();
    const pathname = location.pathname;
    const turns = getTailTurns();
    if (!composer) return null;
    if (!pathnameBelongsToProject(pathname, projectBasePath)) return null;
    if (pathname === sourcePathname) return null;
    if (/\/c\//.test(pathname) || turns.length !== 0) return null;
    if (String(composer.value ?? composer.innerText ?? composer.textContent ?? '').trim()) return null;
    return {
      pathname,
      href: location.href,
      turns: turns.length,
      projectBasePath,
    };
  }

  function probeProjectLandingForRollover(projectName, projectBasePath, sourcePathname) {
    const destination = blankProjectDestination(projectBasePath, sourcePathname);
    if (destination) return { kind: 'destination', destination };
    const action = findProjectChatAction(projectName, projectBasePath);
    if (action) return { kind: 'action', action };
    return null;
  }

  async function navigateToNewProjectChat(projectName, options = {}) {
    const sourcePathname = location.pathname;
    const timeoutMs = Math.max(4000, Number(options.timeoutMs || CONFIG.rolloverNavigationTimeoutMs));
    let projectEntry = resolveProjectAnchor();
    if (!projectEntry || !projectNameMatchesElement(projectEntry, projectName)) {
      projectEntry = findNamedProjectEntry(projectName);
    }
    if (!projectEntry) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLOVER_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: project "${projectName}" is not mounted`);
    }

    const projectBasePath = resolveCanonicalProjectBasePath(projectName, projectEntry);
    const entryBase = projectBasePathFromElement(projectEntry);
    if (!entryBase || !projectBasePathsShareIdentityV621(entryBase, projectBasePath)) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_PROJECT_ENTRY_MISMATCH: project link does not match current project identity');
    }

    projectEntry.click();

    // Live acceptance on 2026-08-13 showed that the current ChatGPT project UI
    // can spend several seconds mounting the project conversation list before the
    // blank composer becomes available, and may never expose a separate scoped
    // "Chat" action at all. Poll BOTH valid outcomes for the whole landing phase:
    // a certified blank project composer OR a certified project-scoped Chat action.
    // v6.5.10 checked the direct composer only once after ~700 ms and then waited
    // exclusively for an action, producing a false ROLLOVER_CHAT_ACTION_NOT_FOUND.
    let landing = await waitForRolloverCondition(
      () => probeProjectLandingForRollover(projectName, projectBasePath, sourcePathname),
      Math.min(8000, timeoutMs),
      180
    );

    if (landing?.kind === 'destination') {
      return {
        sourcePathname,
        projectName,
        projectBasePath,
        action: 'project-entry-async-destination',
        ...landing.destination,
      };
    }

    let action = landing?.kind === 'action' ? landing.action : null;
    if (!action) {
      // A remounted project entry can appear after the loading shell swaps. One
      // retry is allowed, but its wait still accepts either a blank destination or
      // an explicit scoped action; there is no action-only failure path anymore.
      const fallbackProject = findNamedProjectEntry(projectName);
      if (fallbackProject && fallbackProject !== projectEntry) {
        fallbackProject.click();
        landing = await waitForRolloverCondition(
          () => probeProjectLandingForRollover(projectName, projectBasePath, sourcePathname),
          Math.min(8000, timeoutMs),
          180
        );
        if (landing?.kind === 'destination') {
          return {
            sourcePathname,
            projectName,
            projectBasePath,
            action: 'project-entry-remount-async-destination',
            ...landing.destination,
          };
        }
        action = landing?.kind === 'action' ? landing.action : null;
      }
    }

    if (!action) {
      const actual = location.pathname;
      if (!pathnameBelongsToProject(actual, projectBasePath)) {
        throw new Error(
          `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SCOPE_VIOLATION: project landing escaped ${projectBasePath} -> ${actual}; bootstrap was not sent`
        );
      }
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_DESTINATION_NOT_READY: certified project "${projectName}" opened, but neither a blank project composer nor a scoped Chat action mounted before timeout`
      );
    }

    action.element.click();
    const destination = await waitForRolloverCondition(
      () => blankProjectDestination(projectBasePath, sourcePathname),
      timeoutMs,
      220
    );
    if (!destination) {
      const actual = location.pathname;
      if (!pathnameBelongsToProject(actual, projectBasePath)) {
        throw new Error(
          `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SCOPE_VIOLATION: navigation escaped project ${projectBasePath} -> ${actual}; bootstrap was not sent`
        );
      }
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_NAVIGATION_UNCONFIRMED: no blank certified project chat route/composer appeared');
    }
    return {
      sourcePathname,
      projectName,
      projectBasePath,
      action: action.label,
      ...destination,
    };
  }

  const ROLLOVER_SELF_SOURCE_PART_KEYS = Object.freeze([
    '00-runner',
    '10-manifest',
    '20-alpha',
    '30-observability',
  ]);

  function selfSourceRegistry() {
    const current = globalThis.__VIBE_GO_SELF_SOURCE_PARTS__;
    if (current && typeof current === 'object') return current;
    const next = {};
    Object.defineProperty(globalThis, '__VIBE_GO_SELF_SOURCE_PARTS__', {
      value: next,
      configurable: true,
      writable: true,
      enumerable: false,
    });
    return next;
  }

  function registerVibeGoSelfSourcePart(key, text) {
    const registry = selfSourceRegistry();
    registry[String(key)] = String(text || '');
    return registry[String(key)];
  }

  function buildInstalledVibeGoSelfSource() {
    const registry = selfSourceRegistry();
    const missing = ROLLOVER_SELF_SOURCE_PART_KEYS.filter(key => !String(registry[key] || '').trim());
    if (missing.length) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLOVER_RUNNER_SELF_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE: missing ${missing.join(', ')}`);
    }
    return ROLLOVER_SELF_SOURCE_PART_KEYS.map(key => registry[key]).join('\n\n');
  }

  function findRolloverFileInput() {
    const composer = findComposer();
    const composerForm = composer?.closest?.('form') || null;
    const inputs = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[type="file"]')]
      .filter(input => !input.closest?.('#vibe-go-panel-v5,#vibe-go-panel-v628'));
    inputs.sort((a, b) => {
      const aScore = (composerForm?.contains(a) ? 100 : 0) + (a.multiple ? 10 : 0);
      const bScore = (composerForm?.contains(b) ? 100 : 0) + (b.multiple ? 10 : 0);
      return bScore - aScore;
    });
    return inputs[0] || null;
  }

  function rolloverAttachmentButtonCandidates() {
    const composer = findComposer();
    const composerForm = composer?.closest?.('form') || null;
    const tokens = [
      'attach', 'add photos', 'add files', 'upload file', 'upload files',
      'прикреп', 'добавить файл', 'добавить фото', 'загрузить файл',
    ];
    return [...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role="button"],[role="menuitem"]')]
      .filter(element => isVisible(element) && !element.closest?.('#vibe-go-panel-v5,#vibe-go-panel-v628'))
      .map(element => {
        const label = normalizeText(
          `${element.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || ''} ${element.getAttribute?.('title') || ''} ${element.textContent || ''}`
        );
        let score = tokens.some(token => label.includes(token)) ? 50 : 0;
        if (composerForm?.contains(element)) score += 70;
        if (/plus|composer/i.test(String(element.getAttribute?.('data-testid') || ''))) score += 15;
        return { element, label, score };
      })
      .filter(item => item.score >= 50)
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  }

  async function ensureRolloverFileInput(timeoutMs = 5000) {
    let input = findRolloverFileInput();
    if (input) return input;

    const primary = rolloverAttachmentButtonCandidates()[0] || null;
    if (primary) {
      primary.element.click();
      input = await waitForRolloverCondition(() => findRolloverFileInput(), Math.min(timeoutMs, 2500), 120);
      if (input) return input;

      // A plus/menu button may only expose a second-level Upload files action.
      const secondary = rolloverAttachmentButtonCandidates().find(item => item.element !== primary.element) || null;
      if (secondary) {
        secondary.element.click();
        input = await waitForRolloverCondition(() => findRolloverFileInput(), Math.min(timeoutMs, 2500), 120);
        if (input) return input;
      }
    }
    throw new Error('ROLLOVER_ATTACHMENT_INPUT_NOT_FOUND: ChatGPT file input could not be resolved');
  }

  function assignFilesToInput(input, files) {
    if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement) || input.type !== 'file') {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_ATTACHMENT_INPUT_INVALID: target is not a file input');
    }
    if (typeof DataTransfer !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_ATTACHMENT_DATATRANSFER_UNAVAILABLE');
    }
    const transfer = new DataTransfer();
    for (const file of files) transfer.items.add(file);
    const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'files')?.set;
    if (setter) setter.call(input, transfer.files);
    else input.files = transfer.files;
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
  }

  function rolloverAttachmentNamesMounted(names) {
    const text = String(document.body?.innerText || '');
    return names.every(name => text.includes(name));
  }

  async function attachRolloverBootstrapFiles(files, options = {}) {
    const list = Array.isArray(files) ? files.filter(Boolean) : [];
    if (!list.length) return { attached: false, files: [] };
    const timeoutMs = Math.max(10000, Number(options.timeoutMs || CONFIG.rolloverAttachmentTimeoutMs || 60000));
    const input = await ensureRolloverFileInput(Math.min(6000, timeoutMs));
    assignFilesToInput(input, list);
    const names = list.map(file => file.name);
    const mounted = await waitForRolloverCondition(
      () => rolloverAttachmentNamesMounted(names),
      timeoutMs,
      250
    );
    if (!mounted) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLOVER_ATTACHMENT_UNCONFIRMED: composer did not mount ${names.join(', ')}`);
    }
    // Give ChatGPT's attachment pipeline one short settle window after chips mount.
    await sleep(Math.max(250, Number(CONFIG.rolloverActionSettleMs || 700)));
    return {
      attached: true,
      files: list.map(file => ({ name: file.name, size: file.size, type: file.type })),
      confirmedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  function base64ToBytesRolloverV2(value) {
    const raw = atob(String(value || ''));
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i += 1) bytes[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
    return bytes;
  }

  async function buildRolloverBootstrapFiles(options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_NO_SESSION');
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline;
    if (session.sourceCursor?.baselineId && !baseline?.text) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE: attached source baseline is not restored');
    }
    const runnerSource = buildInstalledVibeGoSelfSource();
    const runnerName = 'VIBE_GO_RESORT_WEB_v0.1_STAGE4B_ACTIVE_MISSION_V2.txt';
    const rolloverState = options.rolloverState || await getGlobalChatRolloverState();
    const capsule = rolloverState ? await getChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rolloverState, 'source') : null;
    const verifiedCapsule = capsule ? await verifyChatRolloverCapsuleV2(capsule, rolloverState) : null;
    const fallbackBundle = verifiedCapsule
      ? null
      : await exportPersistenceBundle({ handoffReason: 'exact rollover recovery attachment fallback' });
    const bundle = verifiedCapsule?.persistenceBundle || fallbackBundle;
    const recoveryState = verifiedCapsule
      ? {
          schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-recovery/v2',
          rolloverId: rolloverState.id,
          capsuleKey: verifiedCapsule.key,
          capsuleSha256: verifiedCapsule.capsuleSha256,
          transferToken: verifiedCapsule.transferToken,
          authority: bundle.authority,
          session: verifiedCapsule.session,
          persistenceBundle: bundle,
          source: verifiedCapsule.source,
          supportFiles: [runnerName],
          note: 'Immutable exact rollover capsule export. Do not reconstruct Mission, invent a new Distance, or replay UNKNOWN effects.'
        }
      : {
          schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-recovery/v1',
          authority: bundle.authority,
          session: cloneSemanticValue(session),
          persistenceBundle: bundle,
          note: 'Fallback exact saved state; current dispatch header owns response causality. No effect replay is authorized by this snapshot.'
        };
    const files = [
      new File([runnerSource], runnerName, { type: 'text/plain' }),
      new File([JSON.stringify(recoveryState)], 'VIBE_GO_ROLLOVER_STATE.json', { type: 'application/json' }),
    ];
    if (baseline?.text) files.push(new File([baseline.text], baseline.name, { type: baseline.type || 'text/plain' }));
    return {
      baselineSha256: baseline?.sha256 || null,
      capsuleKey: verifiedCapsule?.key || null,
      capsuleSha256: verifiedCapsule?.capsuleSha256 || null,
      files,
    };
  }

  async function prepareRolloverBootstrapAttachments(rolloverState, options = {}) {
    const policy = getChatRolloverPolicy();
    if (options.attachments === false || policy.bootstrapAttachments === false) {
      if (projectRolloverInScope()) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_RECOVERY_ATTACHMENTS_REQUIRED');
      return { attached: false, skipped: true, reason: 'bootstrap attachments disabled' };
    }
    if (!pathnameBelongsToProject(location.pathname, rolloverState.projectBasePath)) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SCOPE_VIOLATION: refusing bootstrap attachments outside ${rolloverState.projectBasePath}`
      );
    }
    const built = await buildRolloverBootstrapFiles({ rolloverState });
    const result = await attachRolloverBootstrapFiles(built.files, {
      timeoutMs: policy.attachmentTimeoutMs,
    });
    return {
      ...result,
      baselineSha256: built.baselineSha256,
    };
  }

  async function cloneLatestCrossChatAuthorityIntoBoundPath(options = {}) {
    await hydrateRuntimePersistence({ force: true });
    const candidates = await discoverCrossChatCandidates({
      scanAll: true,
      hydrateLimit: 12,
    });
    const candidate = candidates[0] || null;
    if (!candidate) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_RECOVERY_FAILED: no authoritative cross-chat candidate found');
    }
    const result = await cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(candidate, {
      automatic: true,
      rollover: true,
      ...options,
    });
    return { result, candidate };
  }

  async function cloneExactRolloverAuthorityIntoBoundPath(options = {}) {
    const sessionId = String(options.sessionId || '').trim();
    const runtimeDatabaseName = String(options.runtimeDatabaseName || '').trim();
    if (!sessionId) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_EXACT_RECOVERY_SESSION_REQUIRED');
    if (!runtimeDatabaseName) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_EXACT_RECOVERY_RUNTIME_REQUIRED');
    if (runtimeDatabaseName === RUNTIME_DB_NAME) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLOVER_EXACT_RECOVERY_RUNTIME_IS_CURRENT:${runtimeDatabaseName}`);
    }

    const candidate = await findCrossChatSessionCandidateV678({
      sessionId,
      runtimeDatabaseName,
    });
    if (!candidate) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_EXACT_RECOVERY_NOT_FOUND: session=${sessionId} runtime=${runtimeDatabaseName}`
      );
    }

    const result = await cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(candidate, {
      automatic: true,
      rollover: true,
      allowSemanticOnly: true,
      ...options,
    });
    return { result, candidate };
  }

  function resetSemanticTransportForRolloverBootstrap(sessionInput, rolloverState) {
    const session = cloneSemanticValue(sessionInput);
    const previousOperatorControl = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    const operatorControlArchive = Array.isArray(session.transport?.operatorControlArchiveV626)
      ? cloneSemanticValue(session.transport.operatorControlArchiveV626)
      : [];
    if (previousOperatorControl) {
      operatorControlArchive.push({
        ...cloneSemanticValue(previousOperatorControl),
        archivedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        archiveReason: 'cross-chat destination bootstrap retired source-chat operator transport latch',
        archivePathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
        rolloverId: rolloverState?.id || null,
      });
      while (operatorControlArchive.length > 8) operatorControlArchive.shift();
    }

    session.transport = {
      ...session.transport,
      bootstrapBoundary: {
        turnKey: null,
        turnOrder: null,
        capturedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        kind: 'chat-rollover-bootstrap',
        rolloverId: rolloverState?.id || null,
      },
      lastControl: null,
      pendingDispatch: null,
      reanchorBoundary: null,
      pausedByUser: false,
      pauseReason: '',
      pausedAt: null,
      operatorControl: null,
      operatorControlArchiveV626: operatorControlArchive,
      rollover: {
        id: rolloverState?.id || null,
        sourcePathname: rolloverState?.sourcePathname || null,
        destinationPathname: location.pathname,
        preparedSemanticRevision: rolloverState?.sourceSemanticRevision ?? session.revision,
        bootstrapPreparedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      },
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    return session;
  }

  async function restoreRunnerAfterRolloverClone() {
    saveCache({
      lastSendEventKey: null,
      lastSendAt: 0,
      retryCounts: {},
    });
    state.running = true;
    installObserver();
    installDockTracking();
    renderPanel();
  }

  async function bindAndRecoverRolloverDestination(rolloverState, options = {}) {
    const sessionId = String(options.sessionId || rolloverState?.sessionId || '').trim();
    if (!sessionId) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SESSION_VERIFY_FAILED: prepared session identity is unavailable');

    const rebind = await rebindPathScopedPersistenceToCurrentLocation();
    const capsule = options.capsule || await getChatRolloverCapsuleV2(
      rolloverState,
      options.capsulePhase || null
    );

    let recovered;
    let candidate = null;
    if (capsule) {
      recovered = await restoreChatRolloverCapsuleIntoBoundPathV2(capsule, rolloverState, {
        expectedPreviousPathname: options.expectedPreviousPathname || capsule.source?.pathname || null,
        reason: String(options.reason || 'exact rollover capsule restore'),
      });
    } else {
      // Compatibility fallback for pre-v2 prepared rollovers. New v2 rollovers
      // never depend on candidate ranking/discovery for normal continuation.
      const recoveryRuntimeDatabaseName = String(
        options.recoveryRuntimeDatabaseName ||
        rolloverState?.targetRuntimeDatabaseName ||
        rolloverState?.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName ||
        ''
      ).trim();
      if (!recoveryRuntimeDatabaseName) {
        throw new Error('ROLLOVER_EXACT_RECOVERY_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE: prepared rollover has no donor runtime DB/capsule');
      }
      const exact = await cloneExactRolloverAuthorityIntoBoundPath({
        sessionId,
        runtimeDatabaseName: recoveryRuntimeDatabaseName,
        expectedPreviousTransportPathname: options.expectedPreviousPathname || rolloverState?.sourcePathname || null,
        rolloverId: rolloverState?.id || null,
        transferToken: rolloverState?.transferToken || null,
        reason: String(options.reason || 'legacy exact rollover authority clone'),
      });
      recovered = exact.result;
      candidate = exact.candidate;
    }

    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || String(session.id) !== sessionId) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SESSION_VERIFY_FAILED: recovered session identity differs from prepared handoff');
    }
    if (capsule) {
      const actual = await sourceSha256(new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverSemanticWitness(session)));
      if (
        actual !== capsule.semanticSha256 ||
        Number(session.revision || 0) !== Number(capsule.semanticRevision || 0) ||
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session) !== Number(capsule.acceptanceSequence || 0)
      ) {
        throw new Error('ROLLOVER_CAPSULE_POST_RESTORE_VERIFY_FAILED');
      }
    } else if (candidate) {
      chatRolloverVerifyClone(candidate.session, session);
      if (rolloverState.sourceSemanticSha256) {
        const actual = await sourceSha256(new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverSemanticWitness(session)));
        if (actual !== rolloverState.sourceSemanticSha256 ||
            semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session) !== rolloverState.sourceAcceptanceSequence) {
          throw new Error('ROLLOVER_PREPARED_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH');
        }
      }
    }

    if (options.resetTransport === true) {
      session = resetSemanticTransportForRolloverBootstrap(session, rolloverState);
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_EPOCH_STATE_KEY, {
        schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-epoch/v1',
        sessionId: session.id,
        pathname: location.pathname,
        startSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        startAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
        startedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }
    const ownership = await originGlobalTransportAuthorityStatusV697(session);
    if (!ownership.allowed) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_DESTINATION_TRANSPORT_NOT_OWNED');
    await restoreRunnerAfterRolloverClone();
    return {
      rebind,
      recovered,
      capsule: capsule ? {
        key: capsule.key,
        sha256: capsule.capsuleSha256,
        phase: capsule.phase,
      } : null,
      candidate: candidate ? {
        runtimeDatabaseName: candidate.runtimeDatabaseName,
        sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
        semanticRevision: candidate.session?.revision ?? null,
      } : null,
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
      ownership,
    };
  }

  function replaceableTailRecoverySurrogateForRolloverV695(sessionInput, rolloverState) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session || !rolloverState?.sessionId) return false;
    if (!String(session.id || '').startsWith('semantic-session-recovered:')) return false;
    if (String(session.id || '') === String(rolloverState.sessionId || '')) return false;
    if (Number(session.revision || 0) > 1) return false;
    if (semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session) > 1) return false;
    if (session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id) return false;
    return true;
  }

  async function recoverFailedRolloverFinalRouteExact(options = {}) {
    const rollover = await getGlobalChatRolloverState();
    if (!rollover?.sessionId) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_FINAL_RESCUE_STATE_MISSING');

    const existing = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (existing && String(existing.id || '') === String(rollover.sessionId || '')) {
      return {
        recovered: true,
        alreadyExact: true,
        session: existing,
        rollover: cloneSemanticValue(rollover),
        auto: getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null),
      };
    }

    const replaceableSurrogate = replaceableTailRecoverySurrogateForRolloverV695(existing, rollover);
    if (existing && !replaceableSurrogate) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_FINAL_RESCUE_REFUSED_NON_SURROGATE_SESSION:${existing.id || 'unknown'}:r${existing.revision ?? 'unknown'}`
      );
    }

    const displacedSurrogate = replaceableSurrogate ? {
      sessionId: existing.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(existing.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(existing),
      activeDistanceId: existing.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
      observedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    } : null;

    const donorRuntimeDatabaseName = String(
      options.runtimeDatabaseName ||
      rollover.targetRuntimeDatabaseName ||
      rollover.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName ||
      ''
    ).trim();
    const recoveryCapsule = await getChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rollover).catch(() => null) ||
      await getChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rollover, 'source').catch(() => null);
    if (!recoveryCapsule && !donorRuntimeDatabaseName) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_FINAL_RESCUE_DONOR_RUNTIME_OR_CAPSULE_MISSING');
    }
    if (!recoveryCapsule && donorRuntimeDatabaseName === RUNTIME_DB_NAME) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLOVER_FINAL_RESCUE_DONOR_IS_CURRENT:${donorRuntimeDatabaseName}`);
    }

    const here = String(location.pathname || '');
    if (rollover.projectBasePath && !pathnameBelongsToProject(here, rollover.projectBasePath)) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SCOPE_VIOLATION: final rescue escaped ${rollover.projectBasePath} -> ${here}`
      );
    }

    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();

    let result;
    let candidate = null;
    if (recoveryCapsule) {
      const restored = await restoreChatRolloverCapsuleIntoBoundPathV2(
        recoveryCapsule,
        rollover,
        {
          expectedPreviousPathname: recoveryCapsule.source?.pathname || rollover.sourcePathname || null,
          reason: 'exact final-route rescue from immutable rollover capsule',
        }
      );
      result = restored;
    } else {
      const exact = await cloneExactRolloverAuthorityIntoBoundPath({
        sessionId: rollover.sessionId,
        runtimeDatabaseName: donorRuntimeDatabaseName,
        expectedPreviousTransportPathname: rollover.sourcePathname || null,
        reason: 'legacy exact final-route rescue after provisional->conversation rebind failure',
      });
      result = exact.result;
      candidate = exact.candidate;
    }

    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || String(session.id) !== String(rollover.sessionId)) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_FINAL_RESCUE_SESSION_VERIFY_FAILED');
    }

    const importedAuto = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null);
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
      ...(importedAuto || {}),
      schema: 'vibe-go-cross-chat-auto-recovery/v1',
      status: 'ready',
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      fromRuntimeDatabase: donorRuntimeDatabaseName,
      finalRouteRecoveredWithoutReanchor: true,
      finalRoutePathname: here,
      finalRouteRecoveredAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      pendingDispatchId: session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
    });

    const repairedRollover = {
      ...rollover,
      status: 'bootstrap-sent',
      targetPathname: here,
      targetRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      targetSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
      finalRouteBoundAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      exactFinalRouteRecovery: {
        donorRuntimeDatabaseName,
        donorSemanticRevision: Number(recoveryCapsule?.semanticRevision ?? candidate?.session?.revision ?? 0),
        donorPendingDispatchId: recoveryCapsule?.session?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || candidate?.session?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        recoveredWithoutReanchor: true,
        displacedTailRecoverySurrogate: displacedSurrogate,
      },
    };
    await putGlobalChatRolloverState(repairedRollover);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    return {
      recovered: true,
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
      candidate: {
        runtimeDatabaseName: recoveryCapsule?.source?.runtimeDatabaseName || candidate?.runtimeDatabaseName || null,
        sourceDatabaseName: recoveryCapsule?.source?.sourceDatabaseName || candidate?.sourceDatabaseName || null,
        semanticRevision: Number(recoveryCapsule?.semanticRevision ?? candidate?.session?.revision ?? 0),
        acceptanceSequence: Number(recoveryCapsule?.acceptanceSequence ?? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(candidate?.session || {})),
        pendingDispatch: cloneSemanticValue(recoveryCapsule?.session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || candidate?.session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null),
      },
      rollover: cloneSemanticValue(repairedRollover),
      auto: getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null),
      displacedTailRecoverySurrogate: displacedSurrogate,
      result,
    };
  }

  async function maybeRecoverExactRolloverBeforeTailRecoveryV695(options = {}) {
    const rollover = await getGlobalChatRolloverState().catch(() => null);
    if (!rollover?.sessionId) return null;

    const here = String(location.pathname || '');
    if (!/\/c\//.test(here)) return null;
    if (rollover.projectBasePath && !pathnameBelongsToProject(here, rollover.projectBasePath)) return null;
    if (![
      'destination-mounted',
      'attaching-bootstrap',
      'bootstrap-ready',
      'bootstrap-sent',
      'failed',
    ].includes(String(rollover.status || ''))) return null;

    const current = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (current && String(current.id || '') === String(rollover.sessionId || '')) {
      return { recovered: false, alreadyExact: true, session: current, rollover };
    }
    if (current && !replaceableTailRecoverySurrogateForRolloverV695(current, rollover)) {
      return {
        recovered: false,
        refused: true,
        reason: 'current session is not a replaceable mounted-tail recovery surrogate',
        session: current,
        rollover,
      };
    }

    const donorRuntimeDatabaseName = String(
      rollover.targetRuntimeDatabaseName ||
      rollover.sourceRuntimeDatabaseName ||
      ''
    ).trim();
    const capsuleAvailable = Boolean(
      await getChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rollover).catch(() => null) ||
      await getChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rollover, 'source').catch(() => null)
    );
    if (!capsuleAvailable && (!donorRuntimeDatabaseName || donorRuntimeDatabaseName === RUNTIME_DB_NAME)) return null;

    const recovered = await recoverFailedRolloverFinalRouteExact({
      runtimeDatabaseName: donorRuntimeDatabaseName || null,
      reason: String(options.reason || 'startup exact rollover recovery before mounted-tail fallback'),
    });
    log('Exact rollover authority restored before mounted-tail recovery', {
      sessionId: recovered.session?.id || null,
      semanticRevision: recovered.session?.revision ?? null,
      donorRuntimeDatabaseName,
      pathname: here,
      displacedTailRecoverySurrogate: recovered.displacedTailRecoverySurrogate || null,
    });
    return recovered;
  }

  async function executeChatRollover(reason = 'manual', metrics = null, options = {}) {
    if (chatRolloverPromise) return chatRolloverPromise;
    chatRolloverPromise = (async () => {
      const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (!session) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_NO_SESSION: semantic session is unavailable');
      if (!projectRolloverInScope(session)) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SESSION_SCOPE_REQUIRED');
      const owner = await ensureOriginGlobalTransportAuthorityV697('rollover-preflight');
      if (!owner.allowed) return { handled: false, deferred: true, reason: 'source does not own transport' };
      if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) {
        return { handled: false, deferred: true, reason: 'assistant is generating' };
      }
      if (pendingSend) {
        return { handled: false, deferred: true, reason: 'semantic dispatch timer is already queued' };
      }
      if (composerDraftTextV626()) return { handled: false, deferred: true, reason: 'composer contains unsent text' };
      const interruption = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
      if (interruption && !['resumed', 'cancelled'].includes(interruption.status)) {
        return { handled: false, deferred: true, reason: 'user interruption promise has priority' };
      }
      if (session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status && !['ready'].includes(session.transport.pendingDispatch.status)) {
        return { handled: false, deferred: true, reason: 'semantic dispatch is already in flight' };
      }

      if (session.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status === 'ready') {
        session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
        session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
        SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      }

      configureChatRolloverPolicy({});
      const rolloverId = semanticId('chat-rollover');
      await saveCrossChatHandoff({ reason: `automatic project chat rollover: ${reason}` });
      await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(SemanticSessionStore.load()).catch(() => null);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();

      const authority = localSemanticSourceAuthority(SemanticSessionStore.load());
      let rollover = {
        schema: CHAT_ROLLOVER_SCHEMA,
        key: CHAT_ROLLOVER_REGISTRY_KEY,
        id: rolloverId,
        status: 'prepared',
        version: CHAT_ROLLOVER_VERSION_RESORT_V01,
        projectName: String(options.projectName || getChatRolloverPolicy().projectName || 'Resort Empire Web'),
        sessionId: session.id,
        sourcePathname: String(persistenceBoundPathname || location.pathname || ''),
        sourceRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        sourceSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
        sourceSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        sourceAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
        sourceSemanticSha256: await sourceSha256(new TextEncoder().encode(chatRolloverSemanticWitness(session))),
        sourceWorkingSequence: Number(authority.workingSequence || 0),
        sourceHeadRevisionId: authority.headRevisionId || null,
        reason: String(reason || 'chat pressure'),
        pressure: metrics ? cloneSemanticValue(metrics) : null,
        preparedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };

      const sourceCapsule = await sealChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rollover, {
        phase: 'source',
        sourcePathname: rollover.sourcePathname,
      });
      rollover = {
        ...rollover,
        capsuleKey: sourceCapsule.key,
        capsuleId: sourceCapsule.capsuleId,
        capsuleSha256: sourceCapsule.capsuleSha256,
        transferToken: sourceCapsule.transferToken,
        sourceTransportLease: cloneSemanticValue(sourceCapsule.source?.lease || null),
        transferPreparedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      await putGlobalChatRolloverState(rollover);

      // TRANSFER_PREPARED is the point of no return for the source endpoint.
      // All authority required for destination recovery is now origin-global.
      // The old chat is no longer allowed to emit model-facing transport.
      state.running = false;
      clearPendingSend();
      clearSemanticRepairQueue();
      clearTimeout(settleTimer);
      clearTimeout(observerSettleTimer);
      observerSettleTimer = null;
      clearTimeout(generationProbeTimer);
      generationProbeTimer = null;
      observer?.disconnect();
      observer = null;
      uninstallDockTracking();
      setPhase('paused', `rollover transfer prepared · ${rollover.id}`);
