      persistenceUiMessage = `Chat rollover sealed · ${rollover.projectName} · semantic r${rollover.sourceSemanticRevision}`;
      renderPanel();

      try {
        rollover = {
          ...rollover,
          status: 'navigating',
          navigationStartedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        await putGlobalChatRolloverState(rollover);
        const navigation = await navigateToNewProjectChat(rollover.projectName, {
          timeoutMs: getChatRolloverPolicy().navigationTimeoutMs,
        });
        rollover = {
          ...rollover,
          status: 'destination-mounted',
          targetPathname: navigation.pathname,
          targetHref: navigation.href,
          navigation,
          projectBasePath: navigation.projectBasePath,
          destinationMountedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        await putGlobalChatRolloverState(rollover);

        const recovered = await bindAndRecoverRolloverDestination(rollover, {
          resetTransport: true,
          capsule: sourceCapsule,
          expectedPreviousPathname: rollover.sourcePathname,
          reason: 'source-capsule -> project-destination exact transfer',
        });
        rollover = {
          ...rollover,
          status: 'attaching-bootstrap',
          targetPathname: location.pathname,
          targetRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
          targetSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
          destinationTransportLease: cloneSemanticValue(recovered.ownership?.lease || null),
          recoveredSemanticRevision: recovered.session?.revision ?? null,
          recoveredWorkingRevision: recovered.session?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
          attachmentStartedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        await putGlobalChatRolloverState(rollover);
        persistenceUiMessage = `Chat rollover · attaching exact capsule + governing/support sources in ${rollover.projectName}…`;
        renderPanel();

        const attachments = await prepareRolloverBootstrapAttachments(rollover, {
          attachments: options.bootstrapAttachments !== false,
        });
        rollover = {
          ...rollover,
          status: 'bootstrap-ready',
          targetPathname: location.pathname,
          bootstrapAttachments: cloneSemanticValue(attachments),
          bootstrapReadyAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        await putGlobalChatRolloverState(rollover);
        persistenceUiMessage = `Chat rollover bootstrap ready · ${rollover.targetPathname} · r${rollover.recoveredSemanticRevision} · ${attachments.attached ? `${attachments.files.length} files attached` : 'attachments skipped'}`;
        renderPanel();
        scheduleProcess(80);
        return { handled: true, rollover, navigation, recovered, attachments, sourceCapsule: {
          key: sourceCapsule.key,
          sha256: sourceCapsule.capsuleSha256,
        } };
      } catch (error) {
        state.running = false;
        clearPendingSend();
        clearSemanticRepairQueue();
        observer?.disconnect();
        observer = null;
        setPhase('paused', 'rollover recovery required');
        const failed = {
          ...rollover,
          status: 'failed',
          error: error?.message || String(error),
          failedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
        await putGlobalChatRolloverState(failed).catch(() => undefined);
        persistenceUiMessage = `Chat rollover FAILED · ${failed.error}`;
        renderPanel();
        throw error;
      }
    })();
    try {
      return await chatRolloverPromise;
    } finally {
      chatRolloverPromise = null;
    }
  }

  async function maybeRebindActiveRolloverRoute() {
    const rollover = await getGlobalChatRolloverState();
    if (!rollover || String(rollover.sessionId || '') !== String(SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.id || '')) return null;
    if (!['destination-mounted', 'attaching-bootstrap', 'bootstrap-ready', 'bootstrap-sent', 'final-route-rebinding'].includes(rollover.status)) return null;
    if (rollover.projectBasePath && !pathnameBelongsToProject(location.pathname, rollover.projectBasePath)) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SCOPE_VIOLATION: final conversation route escaped ${rollover.projectBasePath} -> ${location.pathname}`
      );
    }
    if (persistenceBoundPathname === location.pathname) return null;

    // The native first send assigns the final /c/<id> while persistence is still
    // bound to the provisional blank-project namespace. Seal THAT exact bound
    // authority before rebinding. Never rewrite sourceContext using the already-new
    // location.pathname; that was the candidate-1 ownership bug.
    const provisionalPathname = String(persistenceBoundPathname || rollover.targetPathname || '');
    const provisionalRuntimeDatabaseName = RUNTIME_DB_NAME;
    const provisionalSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const provisionalWitness = provisionalSession ? {
      sessionId: provisionalSession.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(provisionalSession.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(provisionalSession),
      pendingDispatchId: provisionalSession.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      pendingDispatchStatus: provisionalSession.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status || null,
      authorityEpoch: semanticTransportAuthorityEpochV615(provisionalSession),
    } : null;
    if (!provisionalSession || String(provisionalSession.id || '') !== String(rollover.sessionId || '')) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_FINAL_ROUTE_SOURCE_SESSION_MISSING');
    }

    const routeCapsule = await sealChatRolloverCapsuleV2(rollover, {
      phase: `route-${hashText(provisionalPathname)}`,
      sourcePathname: provisionalPathname,
      transferToken: rollover.transferToken,
    });
    let rebinding = {
      ...rollover,
      status: 'final-route-rebinding',
      routeCapsuleKey: routeCapsule.key,
      routeCapsuleSha256: routeCapsule.capsuleSha256,
      provisionalPathname,
      provisionalRuntimeDatabaseName,
      finalRouteObservedPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
      finalRouteRebindStartedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    await putGlobalChatRolloverState(rebinding);

    const recovered = await bindAndRecoverRolloverDestination(rebinding, {
      resetTransport: false,
      capsule: routeCapsule,
      expectedPreviousPathname: provisionalPathname,
      reason: 'provisional-route capsule -> final conversation route exact transfer',
    });

    const finalSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (
      provisionalWitness &&
      (
        String(finalSession?.id || '') !== String(provisionalWitness.sessionId || '') ||
        Number(finalSession?.revision || 0) !== Number(provisionalWitness.semanticRevision || 0) ||
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(finalSession) !== Number(provisionalWitness.acceptanceSequence || 0) ||
        String(finalSession?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || '') !== String(provisionalWitness.pendingDispatchId || '') ||
        semanticTransportAuthorityEpochV615(finalSession) < Number(provisionalWitness.authorityEpoch || 0)
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'ROLLOVER_FINAL_ROUTE_CAUSAL_MISMATCH: exact provisional authority was not preserved across final-route rebind'
      );
    }

    const finalOwnership = await originGlobalTransportAuthorityStatusV697(finalSession);
    if (!finalOwnership.allowed || String(finalOwnership.lease?.pathname || '') !== String(location.pathname || '')) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_FINAL_ROUTE_TRANSPORT_NOT_OWNED');
    }

    const importedAuto = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null);
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
      ...(importedAuto || {}),
      schema: 'vibe-go-cross-chat-auto-recovery/v1',
      status: 'ready',
      sessionId: finalSession.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(finalSession.revision || 0),
      fromRuntimeDatabase: provisionalRuntimeDatabaseName,
      fromPathname: provisionalPathname,
      rolloverId: rebinding.id,
      capsuleKey: routeCapsule.key,
      finalRouteRecoveredWithoutReanchor: true,
      finalRoutePathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
      finalRouteRecoveredAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      pendingDispatchId: finalSession.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
    });

    const next = {
      ...rebinding,
      status: 'bootstrap-sent',
      targetPathname: location.pathname,
      targetRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      targetSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
      destinationTransportLease: cloneSemanticValue(finalOwnership.lease || null),
      finalRouteBoundAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      exactFinalRouteRecovery: {
        donorKind: 'origin-global-route-capsule',
        donorCapsuleKey: routeCapsule.key,
        donorCapsuleSha256: routeCapsule.capsuleSha256,
        donorRuntimeDatabaseName: provisionalRuntimeDatabaseName,
        donorSemanticRevision: Number(provisionalWitness?.semanticRevision || 0),
        donorPendingDispatchId: provisionalWitness?.pendingDispatchId || null,
        recoveredWithoutReanchor: true,
      },
    };
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    await putGlobalChatRolloverState(next);
    return { rebound: true, recovered, rollover: next, ownership: finalOwnership };
  }

  async function maybeAutoChatRolloverAtSafePoint(turns, reconciliation = null) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return { handled: false };
    if (!projectRolloverInScope(session)) return { handled: false, reason: 'outside authorized project semantic session' };
    const policy = getChatRolloverPolicy();

    const active = await getGlobalChatRolloverState();
    if (
      active &&
      String(active.sessionId || '') === String(session.id) &&
      ['prepared', 'navigating', 'destination-mounted', 'attaching-bootstrap'].includes(active.status)
    ) {
      return { handled: true, reason: `chat rollover ${active.status}`, rollover: active };
    }
    if (
      active &&
      String(active.sessionId || '') === String(session.id) &&
      ['bootstrap-ready', 'bootstrap-sent'].includes(active.status)
    ) {
      // Destination bootstrap is itself the continuation. Do not start another
      // rollover and do not block the first semantic dispatch in the new chat.
      return { handled: false, rolloverActive: true, rollover: active };
    }

    const manualRequest = getManualChatRolloverRequest();
    const manualForSession = manualRequest &&
      String(manualRequest.sessionId || '') === String(session.id)
      ? manualRequest
      : null;

    const recoverableSameProjectScopeFailureV621 =
      active?.status === 'failed' && !manualForSession && isRecoverableSameProjectScopeFailureV621(active);
    if (active?.status === 'failed' && !manualForSession) {
      const failedAt = Date.parse(active.failedAt || '') || 0;
      if (recoverableSameProjectScopeFailureV621) {
        log('a23 recognized proven same-project rollover scope failure as resumable intent', {
          rolloverId: active.id || null,
          error: active.error || '',
        });
      } else {
        // A failed handoff is a transport recovery boundary, never permission
        // to continue with incomplete bootstrap or quietly create another chat.
        state.running = false;
        setPhase('paused', `rollover recovery required: ${active.error || active.status}`);
        return { handled: true, recoveryRequired: true, rollover: active };
      }
    }

    const interruption = currentUserInterruptionPromise(session);
    if (interruption && !['resumed', 'cancelled'].includes(interruption.status)) {
      return { handled: false, manualQueued: Boolean(manualForSession) };
    }
    if (session.transport?.pendingDispatch) {
      return { handled: false, manualQueued: Boolean(manualForSession) };
    }
    if (pendingSend || isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) {
      return { handled: false, manualQueued: Boolean(manualForSession) };
    }

    if (recoverableSameProjectScopeFailureV621) {
      const retryState = getRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_SCOPE_RETRY_STATE_KEY_V623, null);
      const currentRevision = Number(session.revision || 0);
      const alreadyAttempted = retryState &&
        String(retryState.sessionId || '') === String(session.id) &&
        Number(retryState.semanticRevision || -1) === currentRevision &&
        Number(retryState.attempts || 0) >= 1;
      if (alreadyAttempted) {
        warn('a23 same-project rollover retry already consumed for this semantic revision; leaving failure fail-closed', {
          rolloverId: active.id || null,
          semanticRevision: currentRevision,
          retryState,
        });
        return { handled: false, cooldown: true, rollover: active, retryConsumed: true };
      }

      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_SCOPE_RETRY_STATE_KEY_V623, {
        schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-scope-retry/v1',
        sessionId: session.id,
        semanticRevision: currentRevision,
        failedRolloverId: active.id || null,
        attempts: 1,
        armedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      log('a23 resuming proven same-project rollover failure at semantic safe point', {
        failedRolloverId: active.id || null,
        semanticRevision: currentRevision,
        currentPathname: location.pathname,
      });
      const metrics = chatRolloverPressureSnapshot(turns, session);
      const result = await executeChatRollover(
        'resume proven same-project route mismatch',
        metrics,
        {
          projectName: active.projectName || policy.projectName,
          automatic: true,
          bootstrapAttachments: true,
        }
      );
      return {
        handled: Boolean(result?.handled),
        result,
        metrics,
        recoveredFailedRollover: true,
      };
    }

    if (manualForSession) {
      // Consume only once the exact semantic safe point has been reached. If the
      // rollover itself fails, the persisted rollover failure is authoritative and
      // the user may arm a new request explicitly instead of entering a retry loop.
      clearManualChatRolloverRequest();
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      const metrics = chatRolloverPressureSnapshot(turns, session);
      const result = await executeChatRollover(
        manualForSession.reason || 'manual project chat rollover',
        metrics,
        {
          projectName: manualForSession.projectName || policy.projectName,
          automatic: false,
          bootstrapAttachments: manualForSession.bootstrapAttachments !== false,
        }
      );
      return {
        handled: Boolean(result?.handled),
        result,
        metrics,
        manual: true,
      };
    }

    if (policy.enabled === false) return { handled: false };

    const metrics = chatRolloverPressureSnapshot(turns, session);
    if (!metrics.reason) return { handled: false, metrics };
    const result = await executeChatRollover(metrics.reason, metrics, {
      projectName: policy.projectName,
      automatic: true,
      bootstrapAttachments: true,
    });
    return { handled: Boolean(result?.handled), result, metrics };
  }

  async function finalizeChatRolloverAfterAcceptedState(reconciliation = null) {
    if (!reconciliation?.acceptedState) return null;
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const rollover = await getGlobalChatRolloverState();
    if (!session || !rollover) return null;
    if (String(rollover.sessionId || '') !== String(session.id)) return null;
    if (!['bootstrap-ready', 'bootstrap-sent', 'destination-mounted'].includes(rollover.status)) return null;
    if (rollover.projectBasePath && !pathnameBelongsToProject(location.pathname, rollover.projectBasePath)) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_PROJECT_SCOPE_VIOLATION: refusing rollover completion outside ${rollover.projectBasePath}; current=${location.pathname}`
      );
    }
    if (!/\/c\//.test(String(location.pathname || ''))) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_COMPLETE_REQUIRES_FINAL_CONVERSATION_PATH');
    }
    if (rollover.bootstrapAttachments?.attached !== true) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_COMPLETE_REQUIRES_BOOTSTRAP_ATTACHMENTS');
    }
    const transportOwnership = await originGlobalTransportAuthorityStatusV697(session);
    if (!transportOwnership.allowed || String(transportOwnership.lease?.pathname || '') !== String(location.pathname || '')) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_COMPLETE_REQUIRES_DESTINATION_TRANSPORT_OWNERSHIP');
    }

    const authority = localSemanticSourceAuthority(session);
    const completed = {
      ...rollover,
      status: 'complete',
      targetPathname: location.pathname,
      targetRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      targetSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
      acceptedSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptedWorkingSequence: Number(authority.workingSequence || 0),
      acceptedHeadRevisionId: authority.headRevisionId || null,
      completedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      completionProof: {
        finalPathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
        transportLease: cloneSemanticValue(transportOwnership.lease || null),
        bootstrapAttachments: cloneSemanticValue(rollover.bootstrapAttachments || null),
        sourceEndpointFencedByLeaseTransfer: String(transportOwnership.lease?.pathname || '') !== String(rollover.sourcePathname || ''),
      },
    };
    markCrossChatHandoffConsumed(session);
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_EPOCH_STATE_KEY, {
      schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-epoch/v1',
      sessionId: session.id,
      pathname: location.pathname,
      startSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      startAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      startedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(session).catch(() => null);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    await putGlobalChatRolloverState(completed);
    persistenceUiMessage = `Chat rollover complete · ${rollover.sourcePathname} → ${location.pathname} · semantic r${session.revision}`;
    renderPanel();
    return completed;
  }

  function workingSequenceFromIdentity(value) {
    const match = String(value || '').match(/:r(\d+)(?::|$)/i);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
  }

  function semanticSourceAuthority(sessionInput = null, sourceStores = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const sessionId = String(session?.id || '');
    const workspaces = Array.isArray(sourceStores?.workspaces) ? sourceStores.workspaces : [];
    const workspace = workspaces.find(item => String(item?.sessionId || '') === sessionId) || null;
    const working = workspace?.working || null;
    const cursor = session?.sourceCursor || {};
    const identity = working?.identity || cursor.workingRevision || null;
    const baselineId = workspace?.baselineId || cursor.baselineId || cursor.baseline?.id || null;
    const baselineSha256 = String(
      cursor.baseline?.sha256 ||
      (baselineId && String(baselineId).startsWith('baseline:') ? String(baselineId).slice('baseline:'.length) : '') ||
      ''
    ).toLowerCase() || null;
    return {
      sessionId: sessionId || null,
      baselineId,
      baselineSha256,
      workingIdentity: identity,
      workingSequence: Number.isFinite(Number(working?.sequence))
        ? Number(working.sequence)
        : workingSequenceFromIdentity(identity),
      headRevisionId: working?.headRevisionId || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number.isFinite(Number(workspace?.revision))
        ? Number(workspace.revision)
        : Number.isFinite(Number(cursor.workspaceRevision)) ? Number(cursor.workspaceRevision) : 0,
      nextOffset: Number.isFinite(Number(workspace?.cursor?.nextOffset))
        ? Number(workspace.cursor.nextOffset)
        : Number.isFinite(Number(cursor.nextOffset)) ? Number(cursor.nextOffset) : 0,
      semanticRevision: Number.isFinite(Number(session?.revision)) ? Number(session.revision) : 0,
      updatedAt: workspace?.updatedAt || session?.updatedAt || null,
    };
  }

  function localSemanticSourceAuthority(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    const workspace = sourceRuntime.workspace && String(sourceRuntime.workspace.sessionId) === String(session?.id)
      ? sourceRuntime.workspace
      : null;
    if (!workspace) return semanticSourceAuthority(session, null);
    return {
      ...semanticSourceAuthority(session, null),
      baselineId: workspace.baselineId || session?.sourceCursor?.baselineId || null,
      baselineSha256: String(
        sourceRuntime.baseline?.sha256 ||
        session?.sourceCursor?.baseline?.sha256 ||
        semanticCursorBaselineSha(session?.sourceCursor || {}) ||
        ''
      ).toLowerCase() || null,
      workingIdentity: workspace.working?.identity || session?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      workingSequence: Number(workspace.working?.sequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(session?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision)),
      headRevisionId: workspace.working?.headRevisionId || null,
      workspaceRevision: Number(workspace.revision || session?.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision || 0),
      nextOffset: Number(workspace.cursor?.nextOffset || session?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset || 0),
      updatedAt: workspace.updatedAt || session?.updatedAt || null,
    };
  }

  // v657: cross-chat authority is not a scalar `(working, workspace, semantic)` tuple.
  // `workspaceRevision` is namespace-local cursor/evidence state and may legitimately be
  // larger on an older semantic branch.  Across different Source DBs it MUST NOT outrank
  // the semantic head when the actual Working content head is identical.
  //
  // Global ordering therefore means:
  //   1. actual Working sequence;
  //   2. semantic revision when the Working head is the same;
  //   3. workspace revision only inside the SAME Source DB lineage;
  //   4. timestamp as a diagnostic tie-breaker.
  // Same-sequence conflicting Working heads are handled separately by the fork fence.
  function compareSemanticSourceAuthority(aInput, bInput) {
    const a = aInput || {};
    const b = bInput || {};
    const workingDelta = Number(a.workingSequence || 0) - Number(b.workingSequence || 0);
    if (workingDelta) return workingDelta;

    const aHead = String(a.headRevisionId || '');
    const bHead = String(b.headRevisionId || '');
    const sameHead = Boolean(aHead && bHead && aHead === bHead);
    if (sameHead || !aHead || !bHead) {
      const semanticDelta = Number(a.semanticRevision || 0) - Number(b.semanticRevision || 0);
      if (semanticDelta) return semanticDelta;

      const aSourceDb = String(a.sourceDatabaseName || '');
      const bSourceDb = String(b.sourceDatabaseName || '');
      if (aSourceDb && bSourceDb && aSourceDb === bSourceDb) {
        const workspaceDelta = Number(a.workspaceRevision || 0) - Number(b.workspaceRevision || 0);
        if (workspaceDelta) return workspaceDelta;
      }
    }

    const aTime = Date.parse(a.updatedAt || '') || 0;
    const bTime = Date.parse(b.updatedAt || '') || 0;
    return aTime - bTime;
  }

  const crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657 = {
    signature: '',
    at: 0,
    suppressed: 0,
  };

  function logCrossChatRegistryRejectV657(currentAuthority, rejectedAuthority) {
    const signature = [
      currentAuthority?.sessionId || '',
      currentAuthority?.workingSequence || 0,
      currentAuthority?.headRevisionId || '',
      currentAuthority?.semanticRevision || 0,
      currentAuthority?.workspaceRevision || 0,
      rejectedAuthority?.workingSequence || 0,
      rejectedAuthority?.headRevisionId || '',
      rejectedAuthority?.semanticRevision || 0,
      rejectedAuthority?.workspaceRevision || 0,
    ].join('|');
    const at = Date.now();
    if (crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657.signature === signature && at - crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657.at < 30000) {
      crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657.suppressed += 1;
      return false;
    }
    const suppressed = Number(crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657.suppressed || 0);
    crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657.signature = signature;
    crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657.at = at;
    crossChatRegistryRejectLogV657.suppressed = 0;
    log('Cross-chat registry refused stale authority candidate', {
      current: currentAuthority,
      rejected: rejectedAuthority,
      workspaceRevisionIsLocalV657: true,
      suppressedEquivalentRejectsSinceLastLog: suppressed,
    });
    return true;
  }

  function sourceAuthorityCompatible(aInput, bInput) {
    const a = aInput || {};
    const b = bInput || {};
    if (a.sessionId && b.sessionId && String(a.sessionId) !== String(b.sessionId)) return false;
    if (a.baselineSha256 && b.baselineSha256 && String(a.baselineSha256) !== String(b.baselineSha256)) return false;
    if (a.baselineId && b.baselineId && String(a.baselineId) !== String(b.baselineId)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  async function crossChatRegistryPutLatestMonotonic(pointer) {
    if (!pointer) return null;
    const database = await openCrossChatRegistry();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = database.transaction(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE, 'readwrite');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_STORE);
      const registryKey = String(pointer.key || crossChatLatestRegistryKeyV6918(pointer.semanticLaneId || currentSemanticLaneIdV6918()));
      const request = store.get(registryKey);
      let accepted = pointer;
      let settledError = null;

      request.onerror = () => {
        settledError = request.error || new Error('Unable to read current cross-chat registry authority');
        try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
      };
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        try {
          const current = request.result || null;
          if (
            current?.schema === CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA &&
            String(current.sessionId || '') === String(pointer?.sessionId || '') &&
            (!current.baselineSha256 || !pointer?.baselineSha256 || String(current.baselineSha256) === String(pointer.baselineSha256))
          ) {
            const currentAuthority = {
              sessionId: current.sessionId || null,
              baselineSha256: current.baselineSha256 || null,
              workingSequence: Number.isFinite(Number(current.workingSequence))
                ? Number(current.workingSequence)
                : workingSequenceFromIdentity(current.workingRevision),
              workspaceRevision: Number(current.workspaceRevision || 0),
              headRevisionId: current.headRevisionId || null,
              semanticRevision: Number(current.semanticRevision || 0),
              sourceDatabaseName: current.sourceDatabaseName || null,
              updatedAt: current.updatedAt || current.publishedAt || null,
            };
            const nextAuthority = {
              sessionId: pointer.sessionId || null,
              baselineSha256: pointer.baselineSha256 || null,
              workingSequence: Number(pointer.workingSequence || workingSequenceFromIdentity(pointer.workingRevision)),
              workspaceRevision: Number(pointer.workspaceRevision || 0),
              headRevisionId: pointer.headRevisionId || null,
              semanticRevision: Number(pointer.semanticRevision || 0),
              sourceDatabaseName: pointer.sourceDatabaseName || null,
              updatedAt: pointer.updatedAt || pointer.publishedAt || null,
            };

            const sameSequence = Number(nextAuthority.workingSequence || 0) === Number(currentAuthority.workingSequence || 0);
            const differentHeads = sameSequence &&
              String(nextAuthority.headRevisionId || '') &&
              String(currentAuthority.headRevisionId || '') &&
              String(nextAuthority.headRevisionId) !== String(currentAuthority.headRevisionId);
            if (differentHeads) {
              const equivalentForward = String(pointer.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '') === String(currentAuthority.headRevisionId || '');
              const currentAlreadySupersedesNext = String(current.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || '') === String(nextAuthority.headRevisionId || '');
              if (currentAlreadySupersedesNext) {
                accepted = current;
              } else if (!equivalentForward) {
                throw new Error(
                  'CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_HEAD_FORK: same Working sequence has conflicting non-equivalent heads; ' +
                  `current r${currentAuthority.workingSequence}/${currentAuthority.headRevisionId}, ` +
                  `next r${nextAuthority.workingSequence}/${nextAuthority.headRevisionId}`
                );
              }
            }

            if (accepted === pointer && compareSemanticSourceAuthority(nextAuthority, currentAuthority) < 0) {
              logCrossChatRegistryRejectV657(currentAuthority, nextAuthority);
              accepted = current;
            }
          }

          if (accepted === pointer) store.put(pointer);
        } catch (error) {
          settledError = error;
          try { transaction.abort(); } catch {}
        }
      };
      transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(accepted);
      transaction.onabort = () => reject(
        settledError || transaction.error || new Error('Cross-chat registry monotonic transaction aborted')
      );
      transaction.onerror = () => {
        if (!settledError) settledError = transaction.error || new Error('Cross-chat registry monotonic transaction failed');
      };
    });
  }


  function buildGlobalCrossChatPointer(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || null;
    if (!session) return null;
    const authority = localSemanticSourceAuthority(session);
    return {
      schema: CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA,
      key: crossChatLatestRegistryKeyV6918(semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session)),
      semanticLaneId: semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session),
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      sessionStatus: session.status,
      origin: location.origin,
      pathname: location.pathname,
      runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
      sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
      baselineSha256: authority.baselineSha256,
      workingRevision: authority.workingIdentity,
      workingSequence: authority.workingSequence,
      headRevisionId: authority.headRevisionId,
      equivalentToHeadRevisionId:
        workingRuntime?.headRevision &&
        String(workingRuntime.headRevision.id || '') === String(authority.headRevisionId || '')
          ? (workingRuntime.headRevision.recovery?.equivalentToHeadRevisionId || null)
          : null,
      workspaceRevision: authority.workspaceRevision,
      nextOffset: authority.nextOffset,
      activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
      updatedAt: authority.updatedAt || session.updatedAt || semanticIsoNow(),
      publishedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  async function publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.peek();

    // v697: a path that no longer owns origin-global transport authority is read-only
    // for cross-chat publication. This prevents an equal-r/a stale source from
    // reclaiming `latest` merely because its local save timer fired later.
    if (session?.id) {
      const globalTransportLeaseV697 = await getOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(session).catch(() => null);
      if (globalTransportLeaseV697 &&
          !originGlobalTransportOwnerMatchesCurrentV697(globalTransportLeaseV697, session)) {
        const currentLatestV697 = await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
        return {
          ...(currentLatestV697 ? cloneSemanticValue(currentLatestV697) : {}),
          transportPublishFencedV697: true,
          transportOwnerPathnameV697: globalTransportLeaseV697.pathname || null,
          rejectedPublisherPathnameV697: String(location.pathname || ''),
        };
      }
    }
    // v657 Stage-I quarantine: while an exact acceptance lease has already been
    // imported into THIS destination pathname, the generic `latest` pointer is not
    // allowed to compete with that exact recovery experiment. The generic registry
    // remains untouched and recoverable; Stage I owns its dedicated lease until
    // consumed. This also prevents a save/publish loop from spamming stale-regression
    // diagnostics during the two acceptance turns.
    const stageILeaseV657 = await getStageIAcceptanceLeaseV656().catch(() => null);
    if (
      session &&
      stageILeaseV657?.status === 'imported' &&
      String(stageILeaseV657.sessionId || '') === String(session.id || '') &&
      String(stageILeaseV657.destinationPathname || '') === String(location.pathname || '')
    ) {
      const current = await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
      return current ? {
        ...cloneSemanticValue(current),
        stageIGenericPublishQuarantinedV657: true,
        stageIRunIdV657: stageILeaseV657.runId || null,
      } : {
        schema: CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA,
        key: crossChatLatestRegistryKeyV6918(semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session)),
        semanticLaneId: semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session),
        stageIGenericPublishQuarantinedV657: true,
        stageIRunIdV657: stageILeaseV657.runId || null,
      };
    }
    const pointer = buildGlobalCrossChatPointer(session);
    if (!pointer) return null;
    return crossChatRegistryPutLatestMonotonic(pointer);
  }

  function scheduleGlobalCrossChatPublish(sessionInput = SemanticSessionStore.peek()) {
    const scheduledSessionId = sessionInput?.id || null;
    clearTimeout(crossChatPublishTimer);
    crossChatPublishTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      crossChatPublishTimer = null;
      const liveSession = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
      if (!liveSession || (scheduledSessionId && String(liveSession.id) !== String(scheduledSessionId))) return;
      // Build at execution time so SPA pathname rebinds cannot publish a pointer
      // captured from a provisional/previous conversation route.
      void publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(liveSession).catch(error => {
        warn('Cross-chat registry publish failed', error);
      });
    }, 250);
  }


  function foreignRequest(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Foreign IndexedDB request failed'));
    });
  }

  function openForeignDatabase(name) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(String(name));
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error(`Unable to open foreign IndexedDB ${name}`));
    });
  }

  async function foreignDbGetAll(database, storeName) {
    if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(storeName)) return [];
    const transaction = database.transaction(storeName, 'readonly');
    const store = transaction.objectStore(storeName);
    if (typeof store.getAll === 'function') return foreignRequest(store.getAll());
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const rows = [];
      const request = store.openCursor();
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Foreign IndexedDB cursor failed'));
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const cursor = request.result;
        if (!cursor) return resolve(rows);
        rows.push(cursor.value);
        cursor.continue();
      };
    });
  }

  async function readForeignRuntimeStores(runtimeDatabaseName) {
    const database = await openForeignDatabase(runtimeDatabaseName);
    try {
      const stores = {};
      for (const name of RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES) {
        stores[name] = await foreignDbGetAll(database, name);
      }
      return stores;
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
  }

  async function readForeignSourceStores(sourceDatabaseName) {
    const database = await openForeignDatabase(sourceDatabaseName);
    try {
      const stores = {};
      for (const name of PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES) {
        stores[name] = await foreignDbGetAll(database, name);
      }
      return stores;
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
  }

  async function readForeignSourceWorkspace(sourceDatabaseName, sessionId) {
    const database = await openForeignDatabase(sourceDatabaseName);
    try {
      if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains('workspaces')) return null;
      const transaction = database.transaction('workspaces', 'readonly');
      return await foreignRequest(
        transaction.objectStore('workspaces').get(String(sessionId || ''))
      );
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
  }

  async function discoverDirectSourceAuthorityCandidates(sessionInput, currentAuthorityInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return [];
    const currentAuthority = currentAuthorityInput || localSemanticSourceAuthority(session);
    const databaseNames = await listCrossChatDatabaseNames();
    const sourceNames = databaseNames.filter(name =>
      isVibeSourceDatabaseNameV616(name) && name !== SOURCE_DB_NAME
    );
    const metadata = [];

    // Physical Source authority must be discovered from Source DBs themselves.
    // Runtime/session metadata is intentionally not part of this scan: a stale
    // runtime clone may already report r46 even while another Source DB still
    // contains the causally newer r53 head.
    for (const sourceDatabaseName of sourceNames) {
      try {
        const workspace = await readForeignSourceWorkspace(sourceDatabaseName, session.id);
        if (!workspace) continue;
        const sourceAuthority = semanticSourceAuthority(session, { workspaces: [workspace] });
        if (!sourceAuthorityCompatible(sourceAuthority, currentAuthority)) continue;
        metadata.push({
          sourceDatabaseName,
          workspace,
          sourceAuthority,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Unable to inspect direct foreign Source authority', sourceDatabaseName, error);
      }
    }

    metadata.sort((a, b) =>
      compareSemanticSourceAuthority(b.sourceAuthority, a.sourceAuthority)
    );
    return metadata;
  }

  async function hydrateDirectSourceAuthorityCandidate(candidate, sessionInput) {
    if (!candidate?.sourceDatabaseName) return null;
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const sourceStores = await readForeignSourceStores(candidate.sourceDatabaseName);
    persistenceValidateReferentialIntegrity(sourceStores);
    const workspace = (sourceStores.workspaces || []).find(
      item => String(item?.sessionId || '') === String(session?.id || '')
    );
    if (!workspace) return null;
    const sourceAuthority = semanticSourceAuthority(session, sourceStores);
    return {
      sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
      sourceStores,
      workspace,
      sourceAuthority,
    };
  }

  function crossChatCandidateTimestamp(session, handoff = null) {
    const values = [
      session?.updatedAt,
      session?.createdAt,
      handoff?.updatedAt,
      handoff?.createdAt,
      session?.worklog?.at(-1)?.at,
    ].filter(Boolean).map(value => Date.parse(value)).filter(Number.isFinite);
    return values.length ? Math.max(...values) : 0;
  }

  async function buildCrossChatCandidate(runtimeDatabaseName, sourceDatabaseName, options = {}) {
    if (!runtimeDatabaseName || runtimeDatabaseName === RUNTIME_DB_NAME) return null;
    let runtimeStores;
    try {
      runtimeStores = await readForeignRuntimeStores(runtimeDatabaseName);
    } catch (error) {
      if (options.quiet !== true) warn('Unable to inspect foreign VIBE runtime DB', runtimeDatabaseName, error);
      return null;
    }
    const session = runtimeSessionFromStores(runtimeStores, options.sessionId || null);
    if (!session) return null;
    try {
      validateSemanticSession(session);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
    const stateRows = runtimeStores.runtimeState || [];
    const handoffRow = stateRows.find(item => item.key === CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY);
    const handoff = handoffRow?.value?.schema === CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_SCHEMA
      ? persistenceClone(handoffRow.value)
      : null;

    let sourceStores = null;
    let sourceAttached = false;
    if (sourceDatabaseName && options.loadSource !== false) {
      try {
        sourceStores = await readForeignSourceStores(sourceDatabaseName);
        persistenceValidateReferentialIntegrity(sourceStores);
        sourceAttached = (sourceStores.workspaces || []).some(
          item => String(item.sessionId) === String(session.id)
        );
      } catch (error) {
        if (options.quiet !== true) warn('Unable to inspect paired foreign VIBE source DB', sourceDatabaseName, error);
        sourceStores = null;
      }
    }

    const manifestMatch = String(session.mission?.reminder || '').includes(
      '0414d0131143450d10eb5b075f5c7b832e9b408502858a5f830d4d674db556b8'
    );
    const score =
      (handoff ? 100 : 0) +
      (sourceAttached ? 80 : 0) +
      (session.status === 'active' ? 40 : session.status === 'hold' ? 20 : 0) +
      (manifestMatch ? 20 : 0) +
      Math.min(19, Math.max(0, Number(session.revision || 0) / 100));

    const sourceAuthority = semanticSourceAuthority(session, sourceStores);
    const missionProfileId = semanticMissionProfileIdV678(session);
    const configuredProfileId = configuredMissionProfileV670().id;
    const missionCompatible = missionProfileId === configuredProfileId;
    return {
      runtimeDatabaseName,
      sourceDatabaseName,
      runtimeStores,
      sourceStores,
      session,
      handoff,
      sourceAttached,
      manifestMatch,
      sourceAuthority,
      missionProfileId,
      configuredProfileId,
      missionCompatible,
      semanticLaneId: semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session),
      score,
      timestamp: crossChatCandidateTimestamp(session, handoff),
    };
  }

  async function listCrossChatDatabaseNames() {
    if (typeof indexedDB.databases !== 'function') return [];
    try {
      return (await indexedDB.databases())
        .map(item => item?.name)
        .filter(Boolean);
    } catch (error) {
      warn('indexedDB.databases() is unavailable for cross-chat discovery', error);
      return [];
    }
  }

  function compareCrossChatCandidates(a, b) {
    const configuredProfileId = configuredMissionProfileV670().id;
    const aProfile = a?.missionProfileId || semanticMissionProfileIdV678(a?.session);
    const bProfile = b?.missionProfileId || semanticMissionProfileIdV678(b?.session);
    const bothConfigured = aProfile === configuredProfileId && bProfile === configuredProfileId;

    const authorityDelta = compareSemanticSourceAuthority(
      b?.sourceAuthority,
      a?.sourceAuthority
    );
    if (authorityDelta) return authorityDelta;
    return (
      Number(b?.score || 0) - Number(a?.score || 0) ||
      Number(b?.timestamp || 0) - Number(a?.timestamp || 0) ||
      Number(b?.session?.revision || 0) - Number(a?.session?.revision || 0)
    );
  }

  async function discoverCrossChatCandidates(options = {}) {
    const registry = await crossChatRegistryGet('latest').catch(() => null);
    const candidatesByRuntime = new Map();
    const configuredProfileId = configuredMissionProfileV670().id;
    const missionScoped = options.missionScope !== false;
    const includeIncompatible = options.includeIncompatible === true;
    const includeOtherLanes = options.includeOtherLanes === true;
    const desiredLaneId = currentSemanticLaneIdV6918();

    const missionEligible = candidate => Boolean(
      candidate &&
      (includeOtherLanes || semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(candidate.session) === desiredLaneId) && (
        !missionScoped ||
        candidate.missionProfileId === configuredProfileId ||
        includeIncompatible
      )
    );

    if (
      registry?.schema === CROSS_CHAT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA &&
      registry.runtimeDatabaseName &&
      registry.runtimeDatabaseName !== RUNTIME_DB_NAME
    ) {
      const candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(
        registry.runtimeDatabaseName,
        registry.sourceDatabaseName,
        { quiet: true, sessionId: registry.sessionId, loadSource: true }
      );
      if (candidate && missionEligible(candidate)) candidatesByRuntime.set(candidate.runtimeDatabaseName, candidate);
    }

    const databaseNames = await listCrossChatDatabaseNames();
    const sourceNames = new Set(
      databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeSourceDatabaseNameV616(name))
    );
    const metadata = [];
    for (const runtimeName of databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeRuntimeDatabaseNameV616(name))) {
      if (runtimeName === RUNTIME_DB_NAME || candidatesByRuntime.has(runtimeName)) continue;
      const sourceName = pairedSourceDatabaseNamesV616(runtimeName).find(name => sourceNames.has(name)) || null;
      const candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(
        runtimeName,
        sourceName,
        { quiet: true, loadSource: false }
      );
      if (candidate && missionEligible(candidate)) metadata.push(candidate);
    }
    metadata.sort(compareCrossChatCandidates);

    const hydrated = [...candidatesByRuntime.values()];
    const hydrateLimit = Math.max(1, Math.min(24, Number(options.hydrateLimit || 12)));
    for (const item of metadata.slice(0, hydrateLimit)) {
      if (item.sourceDatabaseName) {
        const candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(
          item.runtimeDatabaseName,
          item.sourceDatabaseName,
          { quiet: true, sessionId: item.session.id, loadSource: true }
        );
        if (candidate && missionEligible(candidate)) hydrated.push(candidate);
      }
    }

    const unique = new Map();
    for (const candidate of hydrated) {
      if (!candidate) continue;
      const sourceUsable = candidate.sourceAttached;
      if (!sourceUsable) continue;
      const key = `${candidate.runtimeDatabaseName}\n${candidate.sourceDatabaseName || ''}`;
      const previous = unique.get(key);
      if (!previous || compareCrossChatCandidates(candidate, previous) < 0) {
        unique.set(key, candidate);
      }
    }
    return [...unique.values()].sort(compareCrossChatCandidates);
  }

  async function cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(candidate, options = {}) {
    if (!candidate?.session) throw new Error('Cross-chat recovery candidate is missing');
    const missionCompatibility = configuredMissionCompatibilityV678(candidate.session, { allowUnknown: false });
    const semanticOnlyAllowed = options.allowSemanticOnly === true;
    if ((!candidate.sourceStores || !candidate.sourceAttached) && !semanticOnlyAllowed) {
      throw new Error('Cross-chat candidate has semantic authority but no paired Source Workspace');
    }
    if (!missionCompatibility.compatible && options.forceMission !== true) {
      throw new Error(`CROSS_CHAT_MISSION_MISMATCH: expected ${missionCompatibility.desired}, got ${missionCompatibility.actual}`);
    }
    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    if (candidate.sourceStores && candidate.sourceAttached) {
      await commitPersistenceStores(candidate.sourceStores, 'replace');
    } else {
      await commitPersistenceStores(persistenceNormalizeStores({}), 'replace');
    }
    await commitRuntimePersistenceStores(candidate.runtimeStores, 'replace');
    await hydrateRuntimePersistence({ force: true });
    await claimSemanticRuntimeLeaseV616('cross-chat-clone');

    sourceRuntime.sessionId = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = null;
    sourceRuntime.baseline = null;
    sourceRuntime.restorePromise = null;
    workingRuntime.sessionId = null;
    workingRuntime.spans = new Map();
    workingRuntime.headRevision = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLens = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.queries.clear();
    intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
    intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;

    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || String(session.id) !== String(candidate.session.id)) {
      throw new Error('Cross-chat clone did not restore the expected SemanticSession');
    }

    const importedHandoff = loadCrossChatHandoff() || buildCrossChatHandoff(session, {
      reason: 'seamless cross-chat database discovery',
    });
    if (importedHandoff) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY, {
        ...importedHandoff,
        status: 'imported',
        consumedAt: null,
        consumedIn: null,
        importedInto: {
          origin: location.origin,
          pathname: location.pathname,
          importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
          automatic: true,
        },
      });
    }

    const expectedPreviousTransportPathV697 =
      options.expectedPreviousTransportPathname ||
      candidate?.handoff?.sourceContext?.pathname ||
      importedHandoff?.sourceContext?.pathname ||
      null;
    const transportTransferV697 = await claimOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(session, {
      transfer: true,
      expectedPreviousPathname: expectedPreviousTransportPathV697,
      expectedPreviousLeaseId: options.expectedPreviousLeaseId || null,
      expectedPreviousGeneration: options.expectedPreviousGeneration ?? null,
      expectedPreviousSemanticRevision: options.expectedPreviousSemanticRevision ?? null,
      expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence: options.expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence ?? null,
      rolloverId: options.rolloverId || null,
      transferToken: options.transferToken || null,
      reason: String(options.transportTransferReason || 'exact-cross-chat-clone-transfer'),
    });
    if (!transportTransferV697?.claimed) {
      throw new Error(
        'CROSS_CHAT_TRANSPORT_AUTHORITY_TRANSFER_FAILED: exact semantic clone restored, ' +
        `but origin-global transport lease remains owned by ${transportTransferV697?.lease?.pathname || transportTransferV697?.latest?.pathname || 'unknown'}`
      );
    }

    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
      schema: 'vibe-go-cross-chat-auto-recovery/v1',
      status: 'pending-reanchor',
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: session.revision,
      fromRuntimeDatabase: candidate.runtimeDatabaseName,
      fromSourceDatabase: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
      fromPathname: candidate.handoff?.sourceContext?.pathname || null,
      importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
    saveCache({
      lastSendEventKey: null,
      lastSendAt: 0,
      retryCounts: {},
    });
    if (candidate.sourceStores && candidate.sourceAttached) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    scheduleGlobalCrossChatPublish(session);
    persistenceUiMessage =
      `Recovered cross-chat · r${session.revision} · Working ${session.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || '—'} · transport re-anchor pending`;
    return {
      recovered: true,
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
      source: SourceWorkspace.status(),
      candidate: {
        runtimeDatabaseName: candidate.runtimeDatabaseName,
        sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
        semanticRevision: candidate.session.revision,
        sourceAttached: candidate.sourceAttached,
      },
    };
  }

  async function findCrossChatSessionCandidateV678(options = {}) {
    const sessionId = String(options.sessionId || '').trim();
    if (!sessionId) throw new Error('EXACT_SESSION_RECOVERY: sessionId is required');
    const requestedRuntime = String(options.runtimeDatabaseName || '').trim();
    const databaseNames = await listCrossChatDatabaseNames();
    const runtimeNames = databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeRuntimeDatabaseNameV616(name));
    const sourceNames = new Set(databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeSourceDatabaseNameV616(name)));
    const matches = [];
    for (const runtimeName of runtimeNames) {
      if (runtimeName === RUNTIME_DB_NAME) continue;
      if (requestedRuntime && runtimeName !== requestedRuntime) continue;
      const sourceName = pairedSourceDatabaseNamesV616(runtimeName).find(name => sourceNames.has(name)) || null;
      const candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(runtimeName, sourceName, {
        quiet: true,
        sessionId,
        loadSource: Boolean(sourceName),
      });
      if (!candidate || String(candidate.session?.id || '') !== sessionId) continue;
      matches.push(candidate);
    }
    matches.sort(compareCrossChatCandidates);
    return matches[0] || null;
  }

  async function recoverExactSessionWithoutSourceChatV2(options = {}) {
    const sessionId = String(options.sessionId || SemanticSessionStore.load()?.id || '').trim();
    const runtimeDatabaseName = String(options.runtimeDatabaseName || '').trim();
    if (!sessionId) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SOURCELESS_RECOVERY_SESSION_REQUIRED');
    if (!runtimeDatabaseName) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SOURCELESS_RECOVERY_RUNTIME_REQUIRED');

    state.running = false;
    clearPendingSend();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    // Critical for a SPA route that changed while the old runner remained bound to
    // the previous chat DB: move the live runtime namespace first, leaving the named
    // donor DB untouched and discoverable without opening the old chat.
    await rebindPathScopedPersistenceToCurrentLocation();
    const candidate = await findCrossChatSessionCandidateV678({
      sessionId,
      runtimeDatabaseName,
    });
    if (!candidate) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLOVER_SOURCELESS_RECOVERY_NOT_FOUND:${sessionId}:${runtimeDatabaseName}`);
    }

    const lease = await getOriginGlobalTransportLeaseV697(candidate.session).catch(() => null);
    if (!lease) throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SOURCELESS_RECOVERY_LEASE_MISSING');
    const sameSemanticHead = Boolean(
      String(lease.sessionId || '') === String(candidate.session.id || '') &&
      String(lease.semanticLaneId || '') === String(semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(candidate.session)) &&
      Number(lease.semanticRevision || 0) === Number(candidate.session.revision || 0) &&
      Number(lease.acceptanceSequence || 0) === semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(candidate.session)
    );
    if (!sameSemanticHead) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SOURCELESS_RECOVERY_LEASE_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH');
    }
    const currentProject = projectBasePathFromPathname(location.pathname);
    const ownerProject = projectBasePathFromPathname(lease.pathname);
    if (!currentProject || !ownerProject || !projectBasePathsShareIdentityV621(currentProject, ownerProject)) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLOVER_SOURCELESS_RECOVERY_PROJECT_MISMATCH:${lease.pathname || 'unknown'}->${location.pathname}`
      );
    }

    const result = await cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(candidate, {
      allowSemanticOnly: options.allowSemanticOnly !== false,
      forceMission: options.forceMission === true,
      expectedPreviousTransportPathname: lease.pathname,
      expectedPreviousLeaseId: lease.leaseId,
      expectedPreviousGeneration: lease.generation,
      expectedPreviousSemanticRevision: lease.semanticRevision,
      expectedPreviousAcceptanceSequence: lease.acceptanceSequence,
      transportTransferReason: 'explicit sourceless exact-session takeover',
    });

    const reanchored = await finalizeCrossChatTransportReanchor({
      reason: String(options.reason || 'sourceless exact-session recovery into current chat'),
      projectName: options.projectName || 'BI',
    });
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const ownership = await originGlobalTransportAuthorityStatusV697(session);
    if (!session || String(session.id || '') !== sessionId || !ownership.allowed) {
      throw new Error('ROLLOVER_SOURCELESS_RECOVERY_FINAL_VERIFY_FAILED');
    }
    return {
      recovered: true,
      exact: true,
      oldChatRequired: false,
      operatorResumeRequired: true,
      session,
      ownership,
      reanchored,
      candidate: {
        runtimeDatabaseName: candidate.runtimeDatabaseName,
        sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName || null,
        semanticRevision: Number(candidate.session?.revision || 0),
        acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(candidate.session),
      },
      previousLease: cloneSemanticValue(lease),
      result,
    };
  }

  async function adoptExactCrossChatSessionV678(options = {}) {
    const candidate = await findCrossChatSessionCandidateV678(options);
    if (!candidate) throw new Error(`EXACT_SESSION_RECOVERY_NOT_FOUND: ${String(options.sessionId || '')}`);
    const missionCompatibility = configuredMissionCompatibilityV678(candidate.session, { allowUnknown: false });
    if (!missionCompatibility.compatible && options.forceMission !== true) {
      throw new Error(`EXACT_SESSION_MISSION_MISMATCH: expected ${missionCompatibility.desired}, got ${missionCompatibility.actual}`);
    }
    const result = await cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(candidate, {
      ...options,
      allowSemanticOnly: options.allowSemanticOnly !== false,
    });
    const missionMigration = await applyConfiguredMissionProfileV670().catch(error => ({
      migrated: false,
      error: error?.message || String(error),
    }));
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (session) {
      ensureSemanticSchedulerV677(session);
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }
    persistenceUiMessage = `Exact semantic authority adopted · ${session?.id || '—'} · r${session?.revision ?? '—'} · operator resume required`;
    renderPanel();
    return {
      ...result,
      exact: true,
      missionCompatibility,
      missionMigration,
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
      operatorResumeRequired: true,
    };
  }

  async function missionScopedCrossChatAuditV678(options = {}) {
    const databaseNames = await listCrossChatDatabaseNames();
    const sourceNames = new Set(databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeSourceDatabaseNameV616(name)));
    const rows = [];
    for (const runtimeName of databaseNames.filter(name => isVibeRuntimeDatabaseNameV616(name))) {
      let candidate = null;
      try {
        const sourceName = pairedSourceDatabaseNamesV616(runtimeName).find(name => sourceNames.has(name)) || null;
        candidate = await buildCrossChatCandidate(runtimeName, sourceName, { quiet: true, loadSource: false });
      } catch {}
      if (!candidate?.session) continue;
      rows.push({
        runtimeDatabaseName: runtimeName,
        sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName || null,
        sessionId: candidate.session.id,
        revision: Number(candidate.session.revision || 0),
        updatedAt: candidate.session.updatedAt || null,
        status: candidate.session.status || null,
        missionProfileId: candidate.missionProfileId,
        missionCompatible: candidate.missionCompatible,
        activeDistanceId: candidate.session.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
        activeObjective: candidate.session.distances?.[candidate.session.route?.activeDistanceId]?.objective || null,
        timestamp: candidate.timestamp || 0,
      });
    }
    rows.sort((a, b) => Number(b.timestamp || 0) - Number(a.timestamp || 0));
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-mission-scoped-recovery-audit/v1',
      configuredProfileId: configuredMissionProfileV670().id,
      currentSessionId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.id || null,
      currentMissionProfileId: semanticMissionProfileIdV678(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
      rows,
    };
  }

  const AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_STATE_KEY = 'authorityReconciliationV637';

  async function reconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority(options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return { recovered: false, reason: 'no current semantic session' };
    if (isGenerating()) {
      return { recovered: false, deferred: true, reason: 'assistant is generating' };
    }

    try {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
    } catch {
      // A detached/stale local Source DB is still a valid reconciliation input.
    }

    const currentAuthority = localSemanticSourceAuthority(session);

    // v6.3.8: recover Working head from physical Source DB authority directly.
    // Do not rely on paired Runtime DB metadata or a hydration shortlist.
    const directMetadata = await discoverDirectSourceAuthorityCandidates(
      session,
      currentAuthority
    );
    const directStrongerHeads = directMetadata.filter(item =>
      Number(item?.sourceAuthority?.workingSequence || 0) >
      Number(currentAuthority.workingSequence || 0)
    );

    let candidate = null;
    for (const item of directStrongerHeads) {
      try {
        const hydrated = await hydrateDirectSourceAuthorityCandidate(item, session);
        if (!hydrated) continue;
        if (!sourceAuthorityCompatible(hydrated.sourceAuthority, currentAuthority)) continue;
        if (
          Number(hydrated.sourceAuthority.workingSequence || 0) <=
          Number(currentAuthority.workingSequence || 0)
        ) continue;
        candidate = hydrated;
        break;
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Direct Source authority candidate hydration failed', item.sourceDatabaseName, error);
      }
    }

    // Compatibility fallback for environments without indexedDB.databases().
    // It is allowed only when it physically advances Working sequence; a higher
    // workspaceRevision with the same r46 head is not a head reconciliation.
    let runtimeFallbackCandidates = [];
    if (!candidate) {
      runtimeFallbackCandidates = await discoverCrossChatCandidates({
        ...options,
        scanAll: true,
        hydrateLimit: options.hydrateLimit || 12,
      });
      const eligible = runtimeFallbackCandidates.filter(item =>
        item?.sourceAttached &&
        String(item?.session?.id || '') === String(session.id) &&
        sourceAuthorityCompatible(item.sourceAuthority, currentAuthority) &&
        Number(item?.sourceAuthority?.workingSequence || 0) >
          Number(currentAuthority.workingSequence || 0)
      );
      if (eligible[0]) {
        candidate = {
          sourceDatabaseName: eligible[0].sourceDatabaseName,
          sourceStores: eligible[0].sourceStores,
          sourceAuthority: eligible[0].sourceAuthority,
          runtimeDatabaseName: eligible[0].runtimeDatabaseName,
          fallbackSessionRevision: eligible[0].session?.revision ?? null,
        };
      }
    }

    if (!candidate) {
      const result = {
        recovered: false,
        reason: directMetadata.length
          ? 'no foreign Source DB with a strictly newer Working head found'
          : 'no compatible foreign Source authority found',
        currentAuthority,
        directCandidates: directMetadata.map(item => ({
          sourceDatabaseName: item.sourceDatabaseName,
          sourceAuthority: item.sourceAuthority,
        })),
        runtimeFallbackCandidates: runtimeFallbackCandidates.map(item => ({
          runtimeDatabaseName: item.runtimeDatabaseName,
          sourceDatabaseName: item.sourceDatabaseName,
          sourceAuthority: item.sourceAuthority,
        })),
      };
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_STATE_KEY, {
        schema: 'vibe-go-authority-reconciliation/v1',
        status: 'checked',
        sessionId: session.id,
        currentAuthority,
        checkedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      return result;
    }

    clearPendingSend();
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    const candidateAuthority = candidate.sourceAuthority;
    const candidateSequence = Number(candidateAuthority?.workingSequence || 0);
    if (candidateSequence <= Number(currentAuthority.workingSequence || 0)) {
      throw new Error(
        `Refusing non-advancing Source authority candidate r${candidateSequence} over r${currentAuthority.workingSequence}`
      );
    }

    // Import only physical Source/Working authority. SemanticSession, Distance,
    // decisions and worklog remain on the current monotonic semantic head.
    await commitPersistenceStores(candidate.sourceStores, 'replace');

    // Verify the persistent record before touching any in-memory Source runtime.
    // This makes an IndexedDB write/race failure distinguishable from a restore
    // cache failure and prevents a misleading r46 -> r46 reconciliation loop.
    const persistedWorkspace = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', session.id);
    const persistedAuthority = semanticSourceAuthority(
      session,
      persistedWorkspace ? { workspaces: [persistedWorkspace] } : null
    );
    if (
      Number(persistedAuthority.workingSequence || 0) < candidateSequence ||
      String(persistedAuthority.headRevisionId || '') !==
        String(candidateAuthority.headRevisionId || '')
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Source DB import verification failed: candidate r${candidateSequence}/${candidateAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'} ` +
        `persisted as r${persistedAuthority.workingSequence}/${persistedAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'} ` +
        `from ${candidate.sourceDatabaseName}`
      );
    }

    sourceRuntime.sessionId = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = null;
    sourceRuntime.baseline = null;
    sourceRuntime.restorePromise = null;
    workingRuntime.sessionId = null;
    workingRuntime.spans = new Map();
    workingRuntime.headRevision = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLens = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.queries.clear();
    intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
    intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;

    const source = await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
    const afterSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const afterAuthority = localSemanticSourceAuthority(afterSession);
    if (
      Number(afterAuthority.workingSequence || 0) < candidateSequence ||
      String(afterAuthority.headRevisionId || '') !==
        String(candidateAuthority.headRevisionId || '')
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Source authority restore verification failed: expected r${candidateSequence}/${candidateAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'} ` +
        `but restored r${afterAuthority.workingSequence}/${afterAuthority.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }
    if (compareSemanticSourceAuthority(afterAuthority, currentAuthority) <= 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `Source authority reconciliation did not advance Working head: ${currentAuthority.workingSequence} -> ${afterAuthority.workingSequence}`
      );
    }

    replaceRuntimeStateValue(AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_STATE_KEY, {
      schema: 'vibe-go-authority-reconciliation/v1',
      status: 'reconciled',
      sessionId: session.id,
      before: currentAuthority,
      after: afterAuthority,
      candidate: candidateAuthority,
      fromRuntimeDatabase: candidate.runtimeDatabaseName || null,
      fromSourceDatabase: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
      reconciledAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });

    let reanchored = null;
    if (options.reanchor !== false && getTailTurns().length && !isGenerating()) {
      try {
        reanchored = await reanchorSemanticTransport({
          reason: 'Direct Source authority reconciliation: preserve semantic head, restore newer physical Working Source',
          forceFullProtocolRefeed: true,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Authority reconciliation restored Source but transport re-anchor was deferred', error);
      }
    }

    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(afterSession).catch(() => null);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    persistenceUiMessage =
      `Authority reconciled · Working r${currentAuthority.workingSequence} → r${afterAuthority.workingSequence} · semantic r${afterSession?.revision ?? '?'}`;
    renderPanel();
    return {
      recovered: true,
      mode: 'direct-source-authority-reconciliation',
      session: afterSession,
      source,
      before: currentAuthority,
      after: afterAuthority,
      candidate: {
        runtimeDatabaseName: candidate.runtimeDatabaseName || null,
        sourceDatabaseName: candidate.sourceDatabaseName,
        semanticRevision: candidate.fallbackSessionRevision ?? null,
        sourceAuthority: candidateAuthority,
      },
      reanchored,
    };
  }

  async function maybeAutoReconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || isGenerating()) return null;
    const previous = getRuntimeStateValue(AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_STATE_KEY, null);
    const current = localSemanticSourceAuthority(session);
    if (
      previous?.schema === 'vibe-go-authority-reconciliation/v1' &&
      String(previous.sessionId || '') === String(session.id) &&
      String(previous.packageVersion || '') === '6.3.12' &&
      Number(previous.observedWorkingSequence || -1) === Number(current.workingSequence || 0)
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    const result = await reconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority({ automatic: true, reanchor: false });
    const observed = localSemanticSourceAuthority(SemanticSessionStore.load());
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_STATE_KEY, {
      ...(getRuntimeStateValue(AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_STATE_KEY, null) || {}),
      schema: 'vibe-go-authority-reconciliation/v1',
      packageVersion: '6.3.12',
      sessionId: session.id,
      observedWorkingSequence: Number(observed.workingSequence || 0),
      autoCheckedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    });
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return result;
  }

  async function recoverCrossChatAuthority(options = {}) {
    if (crossChatRecoveryPromise && options.force !== true) return crossChatRecoveryPromise;
    crossChatRecoveryPromise = (async () => {
      const existing = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (existing) {
        const missionCompatibility = configuredMissionCompatibilityV678(existing, { allowUnknown: false });
        if (
          !missionCompatibility.compatible &&
          missionCompatibility.actual !== 'unknown' &&
          options.reconcileSource !== true
        ) {
          const candidates = await discoverCrossChatCandidates({ ...options, missionScope: true });
          const candidate = candidates[0] || null;
          if (!candidate) {
            return {
              recovered: false,
              reason: 'current semantic session belongs to another configured mission and no compatible foreign authority was found',
              session: existing,
              missionCompatibility,
            };
          }
          return cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(candidate, { ...options, allowSemanticOnly: true });
        }
        if (options.force === true || options.reconcileSource === true) {
          return reconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority(options);
        }
        return { recovered: false, reason: 'current semantic session already exists', session: existing, missionCompatibility };
      }
      const candidates = await discoverCrossChatCandidates(options);
      const candidate = candidates[0] || null;
      if (!candidate) {
        return { recovered: false, reason: 'no foreign semantic authority found', candidates: 0 };
      }
      return cloneCrossChatCandidateIntoCurrent(candidate, { ...options, allowSemanticOnly: true });
    })();
    try {
      return await crossChatRecoveryPromise;
    } finally {
      crossChatRecoveryPromise = null;
    }
  }

  async function maybeAutoRecoverCrossChatAuthority() {
    const existing = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (existing) {
      const missionCompatibility = configuredMissionCompatibilityV678(existing, { allowUnknown: false });
      if (missionCompatibility.compatible || missionCompatibility.actual === 'unknown') return null;
      try {
        return await recoverCrossChatAuthority({ automatic: true, missionScope: true });
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Automatic mission-scoped cross-chat authority recovery failed', error);
        return { recovered: false, error: error?.message || String(error), missionCompatibility };
      }
    }
    const disabled = getRuntimeStateValue('crossChatAutoRecoveryDisabled', false);
    if (disabled) return null;
    try {
      return await recoverCrossChatAuthority({ automatic: true });
    } catch (error) {
      warn('Automatic cross-chat authority recovery failed', error);
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
        schema: 'vibe-go-cross-chat-auto-recovery/v1',
        status: 'failed',
        error: error?.message || String(error),
        failedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
      return { recovered: false, error: error?.message || String(error) };
    }
  }

  function retireCrossChatSourceOperatorControlV626(sessionInput, options = {}) {
    const session = cloneSemanticValue(sessionInput);
    const control = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    if (!control || control.status !== 'active') {
      return { session, retired: false, previous: control ? cloneSemanticValue(control) : null };
    }
    session.transport ||= {};
    const archive = Array.isArray(session.transport.operatorControlArchiveV626)
      ? cloneSemanticValue(session.transport.operatorControlArchiveV626)
      : [];
    archive.push({
      ...cloneSemanticValue(control),
      archivedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      archiveReason: String(
        options.reason ||
        'cross-chat destination bootstrap retired source-chat operator transport latch'
      ),
      archivePathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
      rolloverId: options.rolloverId || session.transport?.rollover?.id || null,
    });
    while (archive.length > 8) archive.shift();
    session.transport.operatorControlArchiveV626 = archive;
    session.transport.operatorControl = null;
    session.transport.pausedByUser = false;
    session.transport.pauseReason = '';
    session.transport.pausedAt = null;
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    return { session, retired: true, previous: cloneSemanticValue(control) };
  }


  async function finalizeCrossChatTransportReanchor(options = {}) {
    const stateValue = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null);
    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session || !['pending-reanchor', 'ready'].includes(String(stateValue?.status || ''))) return null;
    if (String(stateValue.sessionId || '') !== String(session.id)) return null;

    const turns = getTailTurns();

    // Idempotent repair for an exact-session destination that was already converted
    // to an empty synthetic bootstrap by an earlier cut, but remained blocked by a
    // source-chat operatorControl latch. This is transport-only: revision,
    // acceptanceSequence, Mission and Distance are unchanged.
    if (
      stateValue?.status === 'ready' &&
      stateValue?.emptyDestinationBootstrap === true &&
      !turns.length
    ) {
      const retired = retireCrossChatSourceOperatorControlV626(session, {
        reason: 'P6.5 empty-destination idempotent transport repair',
        rolloverId: stateValue.rolloverId || session.transport?.rollover?.id || null,
      });
      if (retired.retired) {
        session = retired.session;
        SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
      }

      const pending = ensureSemanticPendingDispatch(SemanticSessionStore.load() || session);
      const live = SemanticSessionStore.load() || session;
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
        ...stateValue,
        status: 'ready',
        semanticRevision: Number(live.revision || 0),
        workingRevision: live.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
        pendingDispatchId: pending?.id || null,
        staleSourceOperatorControlRetired: retired.retired === true,
        staleSourceOperatorControlRetiredAt: retired.retired ? semanticIsoNow() : stateValue.staleSourceOperatorControlRetiredAt || null,
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      scheduleProcess(100);
      renderPanel();
      return {
        reanchored: true,
        alreadyReady: true,
        emptyDestinationBootstrap: true,
        staleSourceOperatorControlRetired: retired.retired === true,
        previousOperatorControl: retired.previous,
        semanticRevision: Number(live.revision || 0),
        acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(live),
        boundary: cloneSemanticValue(live.transport?.bootstrapBoundary || null),
        pendingDispatch: cloneSemanticValue(pending),
        rollover: cloneSemanticValue(await getGlobalChatRolloverState().catch(() => null)),
      };
    }

    if (stateValue?.status !== 'pending-reanchor') return null;

    // P6.5 / cross-chat empty-destination hardening:
    // exact-session adoption can legitimately happen on a blank project composer
    // before ChatGPT has allocated the final /c/... conversation pathname.
    // A normal re-anchor requires a mounted tail turn, so reuse the already-proven
    // rollover bootstrap transport: make the control boundary synthetic, register
    // the provisional route as an active rollover destination, then let
    // maybeRebindActiveRolloverRoute() migrate authority to the final /c/... path
    // before any assistant result is parsed/accepted.
    if (!turns.length) {
      const projectBasePath = projectBasePathFromPathname(location.pathname);
      if (!projectBasePath) {
        throw new Error(
          `CROSS_CHAT_EMPTY_DESTINATION_PROJECT_UNRESOLVED: ${location.pathname}`
        );
      }

      const existingRollover = await getGlobalChatRolloverState();
      if (
        existingRollover &&
        String(existingRollover.sessionId || '') !== String(session.id) &&
        !['complete', 'failed'].includes(String(existingRollover.status || ''))
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          `CROSS_CHAT_EMPTY_DESTINATION_ROLLOVER_BUSY: ${existingRollover.sessionId || 'unknown'}`
        );
      }

      const handoff = loadCrossChatHandoff() || null;
      const authority = localSemanticSourceAuthority(session);
      const timestamp = semanticIsoNow();
      const rollover = {
        schema: CHAT_ROLLOVER_SCHEMA,
        key: CHAT_ROLLOVER_REGISTRY_KEY,
        id: semanticId('chat-rollover'),
        status: 'bootstrap-ready',
        projectName: String(options.projectName || 'current-project'),
        sessionId: session.id,
        sourcePathname:
          stateValue.fromPathname ||
          handoff?.sourceContext?.pathname ||
          null,
        sourceRuntimeDatabaseName: stateValue.fromRuntimeDatabase || null,
        sourceSourceDatabaseName: stateValue.fromSourceDatabase || null,
        sourceSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        sourceWorkingSequence: Number(authority?.workingSequence || 0),
        sourceHeadRevisionId: authority?.headRevisionId || null,
        reason: String(
          options.reason ||
          'cross-chat exact-session adoption into empty project destination'
        ),
        pressure: null,
        preparedAt: timestamp,
        automatic: true,
        crossChatEmptyDestination: true,
        projectBasePath,
        targetPathname: location.pathname,
