        targetHref: location.href,
        targetRuntimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        targetSourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
        recoveredSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        recoveredWorkingRevision: session.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
        destinationMountedAt: timestamp,
        bootstrapReadyAt: timestamp,
        bootstrapAttachments: {
          attached: false,
          skipped: true,
          reason: 'cross-chat destination already has the installed runtime',
        },
      };

      session = resetSemanticTransportForRolloverBootstrap(session, rollover);
      SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CHAT_ROLLOVER_EPOCH_STATE_KEY, {
        schema: 'vibe-go-chat-rollover-epoch/v1',
        sessionId: session.id,
        pathname: location.pathname,
        startSemanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
        startAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
        startedAt: timestamp,
        source: 'cross-chat-empty-destination',
      });
      await putGlobalChatRolloverState(rollover);

      const pending = ensureSemanticPendingDispatch(SemanticSessionStore.load());
      const live = SemanticSessionStore.load() || session;
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
        ...stateValue,
        status: 'ready',
        reanchoredAt: timestamp,
        semanticRevision: Number(live.revision || 0),
        workingRevision: live.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
        pendingDispatchId: pending?.id || null,
        emptyDestinationBootstrap: true,
        rolloverId: rollover.id,
        provisionalPathname: location.pathname,
      });

      await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(live).catch(() => null);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      persistenceUiMessage =
        `Cross-chat ready · r${live.revision} · empty destination bootstrap armed`;
      scheduleProcess(100);
      renderPanel();

      return {
        reanchored: true,
        emptyDestinationBootstrap: true,
        semanticRevision: Number(live.revision || 0),
        workingRevision: live.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
        boundary: cloneSemanticValue(live.transport?.bootstrapBoundary || null),
        pendingDispatch: cloneSemanticValue(pending),
        rollover: cloneSemanticValue(rollover),
      };
    }

    const reanchored = await reanchorSemanticTransport({
      reason:
        options.reason ||
        'automatic cross-chat continuation: preserve semantic/Working authority and replace unmounted transport envelope',
      forceFullProtocolRefeed: true,
    });
    replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
      ...stateValue,
      status: 'ready',
      reanchoredAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      semanticRevision: reanchored.semanticRevision,
      workingRevision: reanchored.workingRevision,
      pendingDispatchId: reanchored.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      emptyDestinationBootstrap: false,
    });
    markCrossChatHandoffConsumed(session);
    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(session).catch(() => null);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    persistenceUiMessage =
      `Cross-chat ready · r${reanchored.semanticRevision} · transport re-anchored`;
    return reanchored;
  }

  async function exportPersistenceBundle(options = {}) {
    await saveCrossChatHandoff({ reason: options.handoffReason || 'portable-db-export' });
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    const sourceStores = {};
    for (const storeName of PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES) {
      sourceStores[storeName] = await sourceDbGetAll(storeName);
    }
    const runtimeStores = {};
    for (const storeName of RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES) {
      runtimeStores[storeName] = await runtimeDbGetAll(storeName);
    }
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const bundle = {
      schema: PERSISTENCE_BUNDLE_SCHEMA,
      exportedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      package: 'VIBE-GO Resort Web v0.1 · Mission Neutral',
      versions: {
        exporterVersion: 'forensic-persistence-bundle/v3',
        runnerVersion: 'v6.7.0-resort-web-v0.1',
        transportProfileVersion: String(CONFIG.semanticTransportProfile || ''),
        sourceIntelligenceVersion: Number(SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_VERSION || 0),
        sourceWorkspaceSchema: String(SOURCE_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA || ''),
        sourceBaselineSchema: String(SOURCE_BASELINE_SCHEMA || ''),
        sourceDatabaseVersion: Number(SOURCE_DB_VERSION || 0),
        runtimeDatabaseSchema: String(RUNTIME_DB_SCHEMA || ''),
        runtimeDatabaseVersion: Number(RUNTIME_DB_VERSION || 0),
      },
      context: {
        origin: location.origin,
        pathname: location.pathname,
        sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
        sourceDatabaseVersion: SOURCE_DB_VERSION,
        runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
        runtimeDatabaseVersion: RUNTIME_DB_VERSION,
      },
      authority: {
        sessionId: session?.id || null,
        semanticRevision: session?.revision ?? null,
        baselineId: session?.sourceCursor?.baselineId || sourceRuntime.baseline?.id || null,
        baselineSha256:
          sourceRuntime.baseline?.sha256 || semanticCursorBaselineSha(session?.sourceCursor || {}) || null,
        workingRevision: session?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      },
      sourceDatabase: { stores: sourceStores },
      runtimeDatabase: { stores: runtimeStores },
    };
    if (options.includeObservability && window.VibePerf?.snapshot) {
      try {
        bundle.observability = window.VibePerf.snapshot();
      } catch {
        bundle.observability = null;
      }
    }
    return bundle;
  }

  function persistenceDownloadJson(value, filename) {
    const json = JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');
    anchor.href = url;
    anchor.download = filename;
    anchor.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(anchor);
    anchor.click();
    anchor.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 0);
    return { filename, bytes: blob.size };
  }

  async function downloadPersistenceBundle(options = {}) {
    const bundle = await exportPersistenceBundle(options);
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const sessionId = String(bundle.authority.sessionId || 'no-session').replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/gi, '_');
    return {
      bundle,
      download: persistenceDownloadJson(bundle, `vibe-go-db-${sessionId}-${stamp}.json`),
    };
  }

  async function persistenceReadInput(input) {
    if (input && typeof input === 'object' && [PERSISTENCE_BUNDLE_SCHEMA, PERSISTENCE_LEGACY_BUNDLE_SCHEMA].includes(input.schema)) {
      return persistenceClone(input);
    }
    if (typeof input === 'string') return JSON.parse(input);
    if (input && typeof input.text === 'function') return JSON.parse(await input.text());
    throw new Error('Persistence import expects a VIBE-GO bundle object, JSON string, or File');
  }

  function mergePersistenceStoreArrays(storeNames, current, incoming, keyFn) {
    const effective = {};
    for (const storeName of storeNames) {
      const map = new Map();
      for (const item of current[storeName] || []) map.set(keyFn(storeName, item), item);
      for (const item of incoming[storeName] || []) map.set(keyFn(storeName, item), item);
      effective[storeName] = [...map.values()];
    }
    return effective;
  }

  async function previewPersistenceImport(input, options = {}) {
    const bundle = await persistenceReadInput(input);
    if (!bundle || ![PERSISTENCE_BUNDLE_SCHEMA, PERSISTENCE_LEGACY_BUNDLE_SCHEMA].includes(bundle.schema)) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported persistence bundle schema: ${bundle?.schema || '(missing)'}`);
    }
    const incomingSource = persistenceNormalizeStores(bundle.sourceDatabase?.stores || {});
    const incomingRuntime = bundle.schema === PERSISTENCE_LEGACY_BUNDLE_SCHEMA
      ? legacyLocalStateToRuntimeStores(bundle.localState || {})
      : persistenceNormalizeRuntimeStores(bundle.runtimeDatabase?.stores || {});
    const mode = String(options.mode || 'replace').toLowerCase();
    if (!['replace', 'merge'].includes(mode)) throw new Error(`Unknown import mode: ${mode}`);

    let effectiveSource = incomingSource;
    let effectiveRuntime = incomingRuntime;
    if (mode === 'merge') {
      const currentSource = {};
      for (const name of PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES) currentSource[name] = await sourceDbGetAll(name);
      effectiveSource = mergePersistenceStoreArrays(
        PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES, currentSource, incomingSource, persistenceStoreKey
      );
      const currentRuntime = {};
      for (const name of RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES) currentRuntime[name] = await runtimeDbGetAll(name);
      effectiveRuntime = mergePersistenceStoreArrays(
        RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES, currentRuntime, incomingRuntime, runtimePersistenceStoreKey
      );
    }
    persistenceValidateReferentialIntegrity(effectiveSource);
    const session = runtimeSessionFromStores(effectiveRuntime, bundle.authority?.sessionId || null);
    if (session) validateSemanticSession(session);
    const workspaceIds = new Set(effectiveSource.workspaces.map(item => String(item.sessionId)));
    const sourceAttached = session ? workspaceIds.has(String(session.id)) : false;
    return {
      bundle,
      mode,
      migratedLegacyBundle: bundle.schema === PERSISTENCE_LEGACY_BUNDLE_SCHEMA,
      sourceContextChanged:
        bundle.context?.origin !== location.origin || bundle.context?.pathname !== location.pathname,
      sessionId: session?.id || bundle.authority?.sessionId || null,
      semanticRevision: session?.revision ?? bundle.authority?.semanticRevision ?? null,
      sourceAttached,
      counts: Object.fromEntries(
        PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES.map(name => [name, incomingSource[name].length])
      ),
      runtimeCounts: Object.fromEntries(
        RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES.map(name => [name, incomingRuntime[name].length])
      ),
      effectiveCounts: Object.fromEntries(
        PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES.map(name => [name, effectiveSource[name].length])
      ),
      effectiveRuntimeCounts: Object.fromEntries(
        RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES.map(name => [name, effectiveRuntime[name].length])
      ),
      baselineSha256: bundle.authority?.baselineSha256 || null,
      workingRevision: bundle.authority?.workingRevision || null,
    };
  }

  async function commitPersistenceStores(stores, mode) {
    if (window.__VIBE_TEST_MODE && typeof window.__VIBE_TEST_DB?.get === 'function') {
      for (const storeName of PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES) {
        if (!window.__VIBE_TEST_DB.has(storeName)) window.__VIBE_TEST_DB.set(storeName, new Map());
        const target = window.__VIBE_TEST_DB.get(storeName);
        if (mode === 'replace') target.clear();
        for (const item of stores[storeName]) {
          target.set(persistenceStoreKey(storeName, item), persistenceClone(item));
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    const database = await openSourceDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction([...PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES], 'readwrite');
    for (const storeName of PERSISTENCE_STORE_NAMES) {
      const store = transaction.objectStore(storeName);
      if (mode === 'replace') store.clear();
      for (const item of stores[storeName]) store.put(item);
    }
    await sourceTransactionDone(transaction);
  }

  async function commitRuntimePersistenceStores(stores, mode) {
    const database = await openRuntimeDatabase();
    const transaction = database.transaction([...RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES], 'readwrite');
    for (const storeName of RUNTIME_EXPORT_STORE_NAMES) {
      const store = transaction.objectStore(storeName);
      if (mode === 'replace') store.clear();
      for (const item of stores[storeName] || []) store.put(persistenceClone(item));
    }
    await runtimeTransactionDone(transaction);
  }

  async function importPersistenceBundle(input, options = {}) {
    const preview = await previewPersistenceImport(input, options);
    const bundle = preview.bundle;
    const sourceStores = persistenceNormalizeStores(bundle.sourceDatabase?.stores || {});
    const runtimeStores = bundle.schema === PERSISTENCE_LEGACY_BUNDLE_SCHEMA
      ? legacyLocalStateToRuntimeStores(bundle.localState || {})
      : persistenceNormalizeRuntimeStores(bundle.runtimeDatabase?.stores || {});
    stop({ reason: 'persistence bundle import', source: 'persistence-import' });
    clearPendingSend();
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    await commitPersistenceStores(sourceStores, preview.mode);
    await commitRuntimePersistenceStores(runtimeStores, preview.mode);
    await hydrateRuntimePersistence({ force: true });
    await claimSemanticRuntimeLeaseV616('persistence-import');

    sourceRuntime.sessionId = null;
    sourceRuntime.workspace = null;
    sourceRuntime.baseline = null;
    sourceRuntime.restorePromise = null;
    workingRuntime.sessionId = null;
    workingRuntime.spans = new Map();
    workingRuntime.headRevision = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentMap = null;
    workingRuntime.workingSegmentIdentity = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLensKey = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.localLens = null;
    intelligenceRuntime.queries.clear();
    intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
    intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;

    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (session) {
      const importedHandoff = loadCrossChatHandoff();
      if (importedHandoff && String(importedHandoff.sessionId) === String(session.id)) {
        replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_HANDOFF_STATE_KEY, {
          ...importedHandoff,
          status: 'imported',
          consumedAt: null,
          consumedIn: null,
          importedInto: {
            origin: location.origin,
            pathname: location.pathname,
            importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
          },
        });
      }
      saveCache({
        lastSendEventKey: null,
        lastSendAt: 0,
        retryCounts: {},
      });
      try {
        await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
      } catch (error) {
        warn('Persistence import restored SemanticSession but Source Workspace restore failed', error);
      }
    } else {
      ProtocolRuntime.initialize();
    }
    if (session && preview.sourceContextChanged) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, {
        schema: 'vibe-go-cross-chat-auto-recovery/v1',
        status: 'pending-reanchor',
        sessionId: session.id,
        semanticRevision: session.revision,
        importedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        manualImport: true,
      });
    }
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    persistenceUiMessage =
      `Imported ${preview.mode}${preview.migratedLegacyBundle ? ' · v1→v2' : ''} · session ${session?.id || 'none'}${preview.sourceContextChanged ? ' · re-anchor pending' : ''}`;
    setPhase('idle', persistenceUiMessage);
    renderPanel();
    if (session && options.resume !== false) {
      await start();
    }
    return {
      imported: true,
      mode: preview.mode,
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
      source: SourceWorkspace.status(),
      preview: { ...preview, bundle: undefined },
    };
  }

  function choosePersistenceFile() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'file';
      input.accept = '.json,application/json';
      input.style.display = 'none';
      input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const file = input.files?.[0] || null;
        input.remove();
        if (file) resolve(file);
        else reject(new Error('Persistence import cancelled'));
      }, { once: true });
      document.body.appendChild(input);
      input.click();
    });
  }

  async function importPersistenceFromPicker(options = {}) {
    const file = await choosePersistenceFile();
    const preview = await previewPersistenceImport(file, options);
    const counts = Object.entries(preview.counts)
      .map(([name, count]) => `${name}: ${count}`)
      .join('\n');
    const warning = preview.sourceContextChanged
      ? '\n\nBundle was exported from another chat/path. Records are portable, but mounted chat turns are not part of the DB.'
      : '';
    const ok = typeof confirm !== 'function' || confirm(
      `Import VIBE-GO DB (${preview.mode})?\n\n` +
      `session: ${preview.sessionId || 'none'}\nrevision: ${preview.semanticRevision ?? 'n/a'}\n` +
      `${counts}${warning}\n\nSemantic authority will be restored; cross-chat transport is re-anchored automatically and the runner resumes.`
    );
    if (!ok) return { imported: false, cancelled: true, preview: { ...preview, bundle: undefined } };
    return importPersistenceBundle(file, { ...options, mode: preview.mode });
  }

  function ledgerTruncate(value, limit = 320) {
    const text = String(value ?? '').trim();
    if (text.length <= limit) return text;
    return text.slice(0, Math.max(0, limit - 1)) + '…';
  }

  function ledgerFormatRange(range) {
    if (!range) return '—';
    const start = Number(range.start);
    const end = Number(range.end);
    if (!Number.isFinite(start) || !Number.isFinite(end)) return '—';
    return `${start}…${end}${range.label ? ` · ${range.label}` : ''}`;
  }

  function ledgerCoverageStats(session, sourceStatus) {
    const size = Number(sourceStatus?.baseline?.sizeChars || 0);
    const ranges = Array.isArray(session?.sourceCursor?.coveredRanges)
      ? mergeSourceRanges(session.sourceCursor.coveredRanges, size || Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
      : [];
    const chars = ranges.reduce((sum, range) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(range.end) - Number(range.start)), 0);
    return {
      chars,
      size,
      percent: size > 0 ? Math.min(100, (chars / size) * 100) : null,
    };
  }

  function ensureLedgerSection(root, key, title, open = false) {
    let details = root.querySelector(`[data-vibe-ledger-section="${key}"]`);
    if (details) return details;
    details = document.createElement('details');
    details.dataset.vibeLedgerSection = key;
    details.open = open;
    Object.assign(details.style, {
      border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)',
      borderRadius: '8px',
      background: 'rgba(3,7,18,.34)',
      overflow: 'hidden',
    });
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    summary.dataset.role = 'summary';
    summary.textContent = title;
    Object.assign(summary.style, {
      padding: '7px 8px',
      cursor: 'pointer',
      font: '800 10px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif',
      color: '#dbeafe',
      userSelect: 'none',
    });
    const body = document.createElement('pre');
    body.dataset.role = 'body';
    Object.assign(body.style, {
      margin: '0',
      padding: '0 8px 8px',
      whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
      overflowWrap: 'anywhere',
      color: '#d1d5db',
      font: '600 10px/1.35 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace',
    });
    details.append(summary, body);
    root.appendChild(details);
    return details;
  }

  function setLedgerSection(root, key, title, content, open = false) {
    const details = ensureLedgerSection(root, key, title, open);
    const summary = details.querySelector('[data-role="summary"]');
    const body = details.querySelector('[data-role="body"]');
    if (summary && summary.textContent !== title) summary.textContent = title;
    if (body && body.textContent !== content) body.textContent = content;
  }

  function formatLedgerRoute(session) {
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(session);
    const lines = [
      `Activity  ${session.route.activity}    Revision r${session.revision}    Session ${session.status}`,
      '',
      `ACTIVE  ${active?.id || '—'} [${active?.status || '—'}]`,
      `  objective: ${ledgerTruncate(active?.objective || '—', 700)}`,
      `  closure:   ${ledgerTruncate(active?.closureContract || '—', 700)}`,
    ];
    if (session.route.deepeningStack.length) {
      lines.push('', 'DEEPENING STACK');
      session.route.deepeningStack.forEach((frame, index) => {
        const parent = frame.distanceId ? session.distances[frame.distanceId] : null;
        const child = frame.childDistanceId ? session.distances[frame.childDistanceId] : null;
        lines.push(
          `${'  '.repeat(index)}↳ ${parent?.id || frame.distanceId || 'root'} → ${child?.id || frame.childDistanceId || 'child'}`
        );
      });
    }
    lines.push('', `RETURN  ${session.route.returnPoint ? ledgerTruncate(JSON.stringify(session.route.returnPoint), 900) : '—'}`);
    lines.push(`NEXT    ${session.route.nextFocus || '—'}`);
    const other = Object.values(session.distances || {})
      .filter(item => item.id !== session.route.activeDistanceId)
      .sort((a, b) => String(a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(String(b.createdAt || '')))
      .slice(-12);
    if (other.length) {
      lines.push('', 'DISTANCE LEDGER');
      for (const item of other) {
        const icon = item.status === 'sealed' ? '✓' : item.status === 'suspended' ? '‖' : item.status === 'resumable' ? '↻' : item.status === 'ready' ? '→' : item.status === 'waiting_on_promise' ? '⏳' : item.status === 'waiting_on_human' ? '?' : item.status === 'waiting_on_transport' ? '⌁' : '·';
        lines.push(`  ${icon} ${item.id} [${item.status}]`);
        lines.push(`    ${ledgerTruncate(item.objective, 260)}`);
      }
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  function semanticDistanceMapProjection(session) {
    const distances = Object.values(session?.distances || {}).filter(Boolean);
    const byId = new Map(distances.map(item => [String(item.id), item]));
    const children = new Map();
    const roots = [];
    for (const item of distances) {
      const id = String(item.id || '');
      const parentId = item.parentId == null ? null : String(item.parentId);
      if (parentId && byId.has(parentId) && parentId !== id) {
        if (!children.has(parentId)) children.set(parentId, []);
        children.get(parentId).push(item);
      } else {
        roots.push(item);
      }
    }
    const sortNodes = values => values.sort((a, b) => {
      const created = String(a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(String(b.createdAt || ''));
      return created || String(a.id || '').localeCompare(String(b.id || ''));
    });
    sortNodes(roots);
    for (const values of children.values()) sortNodes(values);

    const activeId = session?.route?.activeDistanceId ? String(session.route.activeDistanceId) : null;
    const activePath = [];
    const activePathIds = new Set();
    let cursor = activeId && byId.get(activeId) ? byId.get(activeId) : null;
    const pathGuard = new Set();
    while (cursor && !pathGuard.has(String(cursor.id))) {
      const id = String(cursor.id);
      pathGuard.add(id);
      activePath.unshift(cursor);
      activePathIds.add(id);
      cursor = cursor.parentId && byId.has(String(cursor.parentId))
        ? byId.get(String(cursor.parentId))
        : null;
    }

    const associationCounts = new Map();
    const bump = (distanceId, key) => {
      if (!distanceId) return;
      const id = String(distanceId);
      if (!associationCounts.has(id)) associationCounts.set(id, { notes: 0, decisions: 0, worklog: 0 });
      associationCounts.get(id)[key] += 1;
    };
    for (const item of session?.notes || []) bump(item?.distanceId, 'notes');
    for (const item of session?.decisions || []) bump(item?.distanceId, 'decisions');
    for (const item of session?.worklog || []) bump(item?.distanceId, 'worklog');

    const counts = {};
    for (const item of distances) {
      const status = String(item.status || 'unknown');
      counts[status] = Number(counts[status] || 0) + 1;
    }
    return { distances, byId, children, roots, activeId, activePath, activePathIds, associationCounts, counts };
  }

  function formatSemanticDistanceMap(session) {
    const map = semanticDistanceMapProjection(session);
    const lines = [];
    const statusSummary = Object.entries(map.counts)
      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .map(([status, count]) => `${status}=${count}`)
      .join(' · ') || 'none';
    lines.push(`NODES ${map.distances.length} · ${statusSummary}`);
    lines.push(`ACTIVE ${map.activeId || '—'}`);
    lines.push(`PATH   ${map.activePath.length ? map.activePath.map(item => item.id).join(' → ') : '—'}`);
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('LEGEND  ★ current · ◆ active path ancestor · → ready · ↻ resumable · ⏳ waiting promise · ? waiting human · ⌁ waiting transport · ✓ sealed · ‖ suspended · · other');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('MAP');

    const visited = new Set();
    const iconFor = item => {
      const id = String(item.id || '');
      if (id === map.activeId) return '★';
      if (map.activePathIds.has(id)) return '◆';
      if (item.status === 'sealed') return '✓';
      if (item.status === 'suspended') return '‖';
      if (item.status === 'ready') return '→';
      if (item.status === 'resumable') return '↻';
      if (item.status === 'waiting_on_promise') return '⏳';
      if (item.status === 'waiting_on_human') return '?';
      if (item.status === 'waiting_on_transport') return '⌁';
      return '·';
    };
    const renderNode = (item, prefix = '', isLast = true, root = false) => {
      if (!item) return;
      const id = String(item.id || '(missing-id)');
      const cyclic = visited.has(id);
      const branch = root ? '' : (isLast ? '└─ ' : '├─ ');
      lines.push(`${prefix}${branch}${iconFor(item)} ${id} [${item.status || 'unknown'}]${cyclic ? ' · CYCLE' : ''}`);
      const childPrefix = root ? '' : `${prefix}${isLast ? '   ' : '│  '}`;
      lines.push(`${childPrefix}   objective: ${ledgerTruncate(item.objective || '—', 360)}`);
      if (item.closureContract) lines.push(`${childPrefix}   closure:   ${ledgerTruncate(item.closureContract, 320)}`);
      if (item.reason) lines.push(`${childPrefix}   reason:    ${ledgerTruncate(item.reason, 260)}`);
      if (item.waitingOn) {
        const p = (item.waitingOn.promiseIds || []).join(', ') || '—';
        const h = (item.waitingOn.humanRequestIds || []).join(', ') || '—';
        lines.push(`${childPrefix}   waiting:   promises ${ledgerTruncate(p, 220)} · humans ${ledgerTruncate(h, 220)} · priority ${item.resumePriority || 'NORMAL'}`);
        if (item.waitingOn.resumeContract) lines.push(`${childPrefix}   resume:    ${ledgerTruncate(item.waitingOn.resumeContract, 320)}`);
      }
      if (item.summary) lines.push(`${childPrefix}   summary:   ${ledgerTruncate(item.summary, 320)}`);
      if (item.sourceTarget) lines.push(`${childPrefix}   target:    ${ledgerTruncate(JSON.stringify(item.sourceTarget), 320)}`);
      const assoc = map.associationCounts.get(id);
      if (assoc && (assoc.notes || assoc.decisions || assoc.worklog)) {
        lines.push(`${childPrefix}   ledger:    notes ${assoc.notes} · decisions ${assoc.decisions} · worklog ${assoc.worklog}`);
      }
      const lifecycle = [
        item.createdAt ? `created ${item.createdAt}` : null,
        item.updatedAt ? `updated ${item.updatedAt}` : null,
        item.sealedAt ? `sealed ${item.sealedAt}` : null,
        item.suspendedAt ? `suspended ${item.suspendedAt}` : null,
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      if (lifecycle) lines.push(`${childPrefix}   time:      ${lifecycle}`);
      if (cyclic) return;
      visited.add(id);
      const childItems = map.children.get(id) || [];
      childItems.forEach((child, index) => renderNode(child, childPrefix, index === childItems.length - 1, false));
    };

    map.roots.forEach((root, index) => {
      if (index) lines.push('');
      renderNode(root, '', index === map.roots.length - 1, true);
    });

    const unvisited = map.distances.filter(item => !visited.has(String(item.id || '')));
    if (unvisited.length) {
      lines.push('', 'UNATTACHED / CYCLIC');
      unvisited.forEach((item, index) => renderNode(item, '', index === unvisited.length - 1, false));
    }

    if (Array.isArray(session?.route?.deepeningStack) && session.route.deepeningStack.length) {
      lines.push('', 'LIVE DEEPENING STACK');
      session.route.deepeningStack.forEach((frame, index) => {
        lines.push(`  ${index + 1}. ${frame.distanceId || '—'} → ${frame.childDistanceId || '—'}${frame.openedAt ? ` · ${frame.openedAt}` : ''}`);
      });
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  function renderSemanticLedgerPanel(panel, projection) {
    const root = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-ledger-v6');
    if (!root) return;
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    root.style.display = 'grid';
    if (!session) {
      const recovery = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null);
      root.replaceChildren();
      const empty = document.createElement('div');
      Object.assign(empty.style, {
        padding: '9px',
        border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.20)',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        background: 'rgba(2,132,199,.08)',
        color: '#cbd5e1',
        font: '700 10px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif',
      });
      empty.textContent = recovery?.status === 'failed'
        ? `Semantic authority not mounted. Auto-recovery failed: ${recovery.error || 'unknown error'}. Use ↻ Recover or ↑ Import DB.`
        : 'Semantic authority not mounted yet. VIBE-GO searches previous chats on this origin automatically; ↻ Recover forces a rescan, ↑ Import DB remains the portable fallback.';
      root.appendChild(empty);
      const dbStatus = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-db-status-v6');
      if (dbStatus) {
        const nextDbStatus = persistenceUiMessage || 'Semantic-first UI · seamless cross-chat recovery enabled';
        if (dbStatus.textContent !== nextDbStatus) dbStatus.textContent = nextDbStatus;
      }
      return;
    }
    const sourceStatus = SourceWorkspace.status();
    const coverage = ledgerCoverageStats(session, sourceStatus);
    const direction = [
      session.mission.direction || '—',
      '',
      `Status: ${session.status} · Activity: ${session.route.activity} · Revision: r${session.revision}`,
      session.hold ? `HOLD: ${session.hold.reason || session.hold.kind || 'active'}` : 'HOLD: —',
    ].join('\n');
    setLedgerSection(root, 'direction', 'DIRECTION / SESSION', direction, true);
    setLedgerSection(root, 'route', `ROUTE / DISTANCE · depth ${session.route.deepeningStack.length}`, formatLedgerRoute(session), true);
    const distanceMap = semanticDistanceMapProjection(session);
    setLedgerSection(root, 'distance-map', `DISTANCE MAP · ${distanceMap.distances.length} nodes · path ${distanceMap.activePath.length}`, formatSemanticDistanceMap(session), false);

    const cursor = session.sourceCursor || {};
    const sourceLines = [
      `Baseline    ${sourceStatus.baseline?.name || cursor.baselineId || cursor.baseline || 'not loaded'}`,
      `SHA         ${sourceStatus.baseline?.sha256 || semanticCursorBaselineSha(cursor) || '—'}`,
      `Working     ${cursor.workingRevision || sourceStatus.working?.identity || '—'}`,
      `Active      ${ledgerFormatRange(cursor.activeRange)}`,
      `nextOffset  ${cursor.nextOffset ?? '—'} / ${sourceStatus.baseline?.sizeChars ?? '—'}`,
      `physical    ${coverage.chars}${coverage.size ? ` / ${coverage.size}` : ''}${coverage.percent == null ? '' : ` (${coverage.percent.toFixed(2)}%)`} · traversal only · NOT task progress`,
      `surfaces    ${Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges) ? cursor.relatedRanges.length : 0}`,
      `workspace   r${cursor.workspaceRevision ?? sourceStatus.workspace?.revision ?? 0}`,
      '',
      ...(Array.isArray(cursor.relatedRanges) && cursor.relatedRanges.length
        ? ['RELATED', ...cursor.relatedRanges.slice(-8).map(item => `  · ${ledgerFormatRange(item)}`)]
        : ['RELATED  —']),
    ];
    setLedgerSection(root, 'source', 'SOURCE CURSOR / PHYSICAL COVERAGE', sourceLines.join('\n'), true);


    const workingAuthority = workingAuthorityProjectionSync();
    const workingLines = workingAuthority.ready
      ? [
          `baseline     ${workingAuthority.baselineName || '—'}`,
          `baseline sha ${workingAuthority.baselineSha256 || '—'}`,
          `working      ${workingAuthority.workingIdentity || '—'}`,
          `revision     r${workingAuthority.workingSequence} · workspace r${workingAuthority.workspaceRevision}`,
          `head         ${workingAuthority.headRevisionId || '—'}`,
          `working sha  ${workingAuthority.workingSha256 || 'pending fresh audit/export'}`,
          `size         ${workingAuthority.workingSizeChars} chars · baseline ${workingAuthority.baselineSizeChars}`,
          `net delta    ${workingAuthority.netDeltaChars >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${workingAuthority.netDeltaChars} chars`,
          `active spans ${workingAuthority.activeSpanCount} · delete ${workingAuthority.deletions} · replace ${workingAuthority.replacements} · insert ${workingAuthority.insertions}`,
          `structure    ${workingAuthority.structureDirty ? 'DIRTY / rebuild needed' : 'clean'}`,
          `audit sha    ${workingAuthority.auditFresh ? 'fresh for this Working head' : 'stale/pending'}`,
          '',
          'Exports are exact artifacts of the mounted Working authority.',
          'Physical coverage is traversal bookkeeping only; it is never a completion percentage.',
        ]
      : ['Working Source is not attached.'];
    setLedgerSection(
      root,
      'working-authority',
      `WORKING / AUTHORITY · ${workingAuthority.ready ? `r${workingAuthority.workingSequence}` : 'DETACHED'}`,
      workingLines.join('\n'),
      true
    );


    const auditReport = currentWorkingRefactorAudit();
    const auditStale = Boolean(
      auditReport?.working?.identity &&
      sourceStatus.working?.identity &&
      String(auditReport.working.identity) !== String(sourceStatus.working.identity)
    );
    const auditLines = auditReport
      ? [
          `verdict     ${auditStale ? 'STALE · ' : ''}${auditReport.verdict}`,
          `working     ${auditReport.working?.identity || '—'}`,
          `sha256      ${auditReport.working?.sha256 || '—'}`,
          `delta       ${auditReport.working?.netDeltaChars ?? '—'} chars`,
          `spans       ${auditReport.working?.activeSpanCount ?? '—'} active`,
          `history     ${auditReport.history?.headLineageRevisionCount ?? '—'} head-lineage revisions / ${auditReport.history?.revisionCount ?? '—'} stored`,
          `findings    critical ${auditReport.counts?.critical || 0} · high ${auditReport.counts?.high || 0} · medium ${auditReport.counts?.medium || 0} · low ${auditReport.counts?.low || 0}`,
          `zones       ${auditReport.suspiciousZones?.length || 0} review zones`,
          '',
          ...(auditReport.findings || []).filter(item => ['critical', 'high', 'medium'].includes(item.severity)).slice(0, 8).map(item =>
            `[${item.severity}]${item.revisionSequence ? ` r${item.revisionSequence}` : ''} ${item.code}\n  ${ledgerTruncate(item.message || item.summary || '', 360)}`
          ),
        ]
      : ['Audit has not run for the mounted Working head yet.'];
    setLedgerSection(
      root,
      'audit',
      `REFACTOR AUDIT · ${auditReport ? (auditStale ? 'STALE' : String(auditReport.verdict || 'unknown').toUpperCase()) : 'PENDING'}`,
      auditLines.join('\n'),
      Boolean(auditReport?.counts?.critical)
    );

    renderOperatorAsyncInboxSectionV676(root, session);

    const openNotes = session.notes.filter(note => note.status !== 'resolved');
    const noteText = openNotes.length
      ? openNotes.slice(-20).map(note =>
          `[${note.kind}] ${note.text}${note.sourceRange ? ` @ ${ledgerFormatRange(note.sourceRange)}` : ''}`
        ).join('\n\n')
      : '—';
    setLedgerSection(root, 'notes', `NOTES / PROMISES · ${openNotes.length} open · deduped`, noteText, false);

    const decisionText = session.decisions.length
      ? session.decisions.slice(-16).map(item =>
          `${item.text}${item.reason ? `\n  reason: ${item.reason}` : ''}`
        ).join('\n\n')
      : '—';
    setLedgerSection(root, 'decisions', `DECISIONS · ${session.decisions.length} durable`, decisionText, false);

    const worklogText = session.worklog.length
      ? session.worklog.slice(-18).map(item =>
          `r${item.revision} · ${item.activity} · ${item.action}${item.repeatCount > 1 ? ` · ×${item.repeatCount}` : ''}${item.summary ? `\n  ${item.summary}` : ''}`
        ).join('\n\n')
      : '—';
    setLedgerSection(root, 'worklog', `WORKLOG · ${session.worklog.length} factual events`, worklogText, false);

    const dbStatus = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-db-status-v6');
    if (dbStatus) {
      const nextDbStatus = persistenceUiMessage ||
        `DB ${SOURCE_DB_VERSION} · ${sourceStatus.ready ? 'source attached' : 'source detached'} · export includes full baseline text`;
      if (dbStatus.textContent !== nextDbStatus) dbStatus.textContent = nextDbStatus;
    }
  }

  function setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, property, value) {
    if (panel.style[property] !== value) panel.style[property] = value;
  }

  function schedulePanelPosition() {
    if (panelPositionRaf || typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'function') {
      if (!panelPositionRaf && typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'function') positionPanel();
      return;
    }
    panelPositionRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      panelPositionRaf = 0;
      positionPanel();
    });
  }

  function positionPanel() {
    const panel = document.querySelector(
      '#vibe-go-panel-v628'
    );

    if (!panel) return;

    const panelModeV626 = getOperatorUiSettingsV626().panelMode;
    if (panelModeV626 === 'rail') {
      const main = document.querySelector('main');
      const rect = main?.getBoundingClientRect?.() || null;
      const left = rect && Number.isFinite(rect.left) ? Math.max(6, Math.round(rect.left + 6)) : 8;
      setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'left', `${left}px`);
      setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'top', '50%');
      setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'transform', 'translateY(-50%)');
      if (panel.dataset.dock !== 'chat-left-rail') panel.dataset.dock = 'chat-left-rail';
      return;
    }
    setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'transform', '');

    const anchor = resolveProjectAnchor();

    if (anchor !== observedAnchor) {
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      resizeObserver = null;
      observedAnchor = anchor;

      if (anchor && typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
        resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(schedulePanelPosition);
        resizeObserver.observe(anchor);
      }
    }

    if (!anchor) {
      setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'top', '12px');
      setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'left', '12px');
      if (panel.dataset.dock !== 'fallback-top') panel.dataset.dock = 'fallback-top';
      return;
    }

    const rect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    const panelRect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();

    const maxLeft = Math.max(
      8,
      window.innerWidth - panelRect.width - 8
    );

    const left = Math.min(
      maxLeft,
      Math.max(8, rect.left)
    );

    const top = Math.min(
      Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - panelRect.height - 8),
      rect.bottom + 6
    );

    setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'left', `${Math.round(left)}px`);
    setPanelStyleIfChanged(panel, 'top', `${Math.round(top)}px`);
    if (panel.dataset.dock !== 'project-button') panel.dataset.dock = 'project-button';
  }

    Object.assign(modeBar.style, {
      display: 'flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'space-between',
