  function renderPanel() {
    cpuHotPathStats.panelRenders += 1;
    const panel = createPanel();
    const status = panel.querySelector(
      '#vibe-go-status-v5'
    );

    protocol.syncPanelProjection();
    const projection = protocol.getPanelProjection();
    applyPanelModeV626(panel);
    renderOperatorCountdownOverlayV626();

    const railStateV626 = narrativeRailIconStateV626(projection);
    const railLifecycleV626 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rail-lifecycle-v626');
    const railActivityV626 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rail-activity-v626');
    const railSourceV626 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rail-source-v626');
    const railWorkingV626 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rail-working-v626');
    const railTransportV626 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rail-transport-v626');
    const railInboxV676 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rail-inbox-v676');
    const railAutoV626 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rail-auto-v626');
    if (railLifecycleV626) {
      railLifecycleV626.textContent = railStateV626.lifecycle;
      railLifecycleV626.title = currentOperatorControlV626()?.status === 'active'
        ? 'Operator control · click to resume/replan'
        : state.running ? `Runner ${state.phase} · click to stop` : 'Runner stopped · click to start';
    }
    if (railActivityV626) {
      railActivityV626.textContent = railStateV626.activity;
      railActivityV626.title = `Engineering activity: ${projection.activity || '—'} · ${String(projection.distance || '').slice(0, 160)}`;
    }
    if (railSourceV626) {
      railSourceV626.textContent = railStateV626.source;
      const d = railStateV626.diagnostics;
      railSourceV626.title = d.ready
        ? `Source · stagnant ${d.stagnantTurns} turns · union ${d.coveredPercent.toFixed(1)}% · contiguous ${d.contiguousPercent.toFixed(1)}% · surfaces ${d.activeSurfaces}`
        : 'Source detached';
      railSourceV626.style.borderColor = d.warning ? 'rgba(248,113,113,.72)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.11)';
    }
    if (railWorkingV626) {
      railWorkingV626.textContent = railStateV626.working;
      railWorkingV626.title = projection.source?.ready ? 'Working Source attached' : 'Working Source detached';
    }
    if (railTransportV626) {
      railTransportV626.textContent = railStateV626.transport;
      railTransportV626.title = railStateV626.usage.allowed
        ? `Transport ${state.phase} · usage guard allowed`
        : `Usage guard: ${railStateV626.usage.reason}`;
    }
    if (railInboxV676) {
      const inboxV676 = operatorAsyncInboxSnapshotV676();
      const pendingV676 = inboxV676.promises.waiting.length + inboxV676.promises.fulfilled.length + inboxV676.humans.open.length + inboxV676.humans.deferred.length + inboxV676.humans.answered.length;
      railInboxV676.textContent = pendingV676 > 9 ? '9+' : String(pendingV676);
      railInboxV676.title = `Async Inbox · machine ${inboxV676.promises.waiting.length} waiting / ${inboxV676.promises.fulfilled.length} ready · human ${inboxV676.humans.open.length} open / ${inboxV676.humans.deferred.length} deferred / ${inboxV676.humans.answered.length} answered`;
      railInboxV676.style.borderColor = pendingV676 ? 'rgba(96,165,250,.72)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.11)';
      railInboxV676.style.color = pendingV676 ? '#dbeafe' : '#94a3b8';
    }
    if (railAutoV626) {
      railAutoV626.textContent = railStateV626.auto;
      railAutoV626.title = `Auto-continue ${getOperatorUiSettingsV626().autoContinue ? 'ON' : 'OFF'} · click to toggle`;
    }
    const autoToggleV626 = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-auto-toggle-v626');
    if (autoToggleV626) {
      const auto = getOperatorUiSettingsV626().autoContinue;
      autoToggleV626.textContent = auto ? '⟳ Auto ON' : '○ Auto OFF';
      autoToggleV626.style.background = auto ? 'rgba(6,78,59,.72)' : 'rgba(30,41,59,.72)';
      autoToggleV626.style.borderColor = auto ? 'rgba(52,211,153,.72)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)';
    }

    const heads = {
      active: 'VIBE ▶',
      waiting: 'VIBE ◌',
      delay: 'VIBE ⏱',
      complete: 'VIBE ✓',
      paused: 'VIBE ‖ PAUSED',
      hold: 'VIBE ‼ HOLD',
      idle: state.running
        ? 'VIBE · ARMED'
        : 'VIBE ■ OFF',
    };

    status.style.background = statusColor();

    const modeBadge = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-modebadge-v63');
    const pacingProfile = getPacingProfile();
    panel.querySelectorAll('#vibe-go-pacing-v611 button[data-vibe-go-pacing]').forEach(button => {
      const active = button.dataset.vibeGoPacing === pacingProfile.id;
      button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
      button.style.background = active ? 'rgba(6,78,59,.72)' : 'rgba(30,41,59,.72)';
      button.style.borderColor = active ? 'rgba(52,211,153,.72)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)';
      button.style.color = active ? '#d1fae5' : '#cbd5e1';
    });
    if (projection.mode === 'semantic') {
      if (modeBadge) {
        const autoRecovery = getRuntimeStateValue(CROSS_CHAT_AUTO_STATE_KEY, null);
        modeBadge.textContent = projection.current === 'NO SESSION'
          ? (autoRecovery?.status === 'failed' ? 'RECOVERY ERROR' : 'SEMANTIC · RECOVER')
          : `SEMANTIC · ${projection.current}`;
      }
      const distance = String(projection.distance || '').slice(0, 150);
      const nextStatusText =
        `${heads[state.phase] || heads.idle} · SEMANTIC ${projection.current} · ${projection.activity}
` +
        `Distance: ${distance}
` +
        `Depth ${projection.depth} · Notes ${projection.notes} · Dispatch ${projection.pendingStatus}
` +
        `Pacing ${pacingProfile.label} · ${pacingProfile.shortLabel}
` +
        `Source ${projection.source?.ready ? `${projection.source.workspace?.cursor?.nextOffset ?? 0}/${projection.source.baseline?.sizeChars ?? '?'}` : 'not loaded'}
` +
        `${state.detail || ''}`;
      if (status.textContent !== nextStatusText) status.textContent = nextStatusText;
      const ledger = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-ledger-v6');
      const dbToolbar = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-db-toolbar-v6');
      const workingToolbar = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-working-toolbar-v651');
      const workingToolbarStatus = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-working-toolbar-status-v651');
      const rolloverToolbar = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rollover-toolbar-v6510');
      const rolloverUiStatus = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-rollover-ui-status-v6510');
      const interruptionBox = panel.querySelector('#vibe-go-interruption-v642');
      if (ledger) ledger.style.display = 'grid';
      if (dbToolbar) dbToolbar.style.display = 'grid';
      if (rolloverToolbar) rolloverToolbar.style.display = 'grid';
      if (rolloverUiStatus) {
        const policy = getChatRolloverPolicy();
        const manualRequest = getManualChatRolloverRequest();
        const nextRolloverText = manualRequest
          ? `Queued → ${manualRequest.projectName} · execute at next safe point`
          : `Target: ${policy.projectName} · certified project route + 2-file bootstrap`;
        if (rolloverUiStatus.textContent !== nextRolloverText) rolloverUiStatus.textContent = nextRolloverText;
      }
      if (workingToolbar) workingToolbar.style.display = projection.source?.ready ? 'grid' : 'none';
      if (workingToolbarStatus && projection.source?.ready) {
        const authority = workingAuthorityProjectionSync();
        const nextWorkingStatus = authority.ready
          ? `Working r${authority.workingSequence} · ${authority.activeSpanCount} spans · delta ${authority.netDeltaChars >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${authority.netDeltaChars} · ${authority.workingSha256 ? `sha ${authority.workingSha256.slice(0, 12)}…` : 'sha pending audit/export'}`
          : 'Working Source detached';
        if (workingToolbarStatus.textContent !== nextWorkingStatus) workingToolbarStatus.textContent = nextWorkingStatus;
      }
      if (interruptionBox) {
        interruptionBox.style.display = 'grid';
        const promise = projection.interruption || null;
        const input = interruptionBox.querySelector('#vibe-go-interruption-input-v642');
        const button = interruptionBox.querySelector('#vibe-go-interruption-send-v642');
        const resume = interruptionBox.querySelector('#vibe-go-interruption-resume-v642');
        const info = interruptionBox.querySelector('#vibe-go-interruption-status-v642');
        const waiting = promise && ['armed', 'waiting-safe-point', 'sending'].includes(promise.status);
        const paused = promise?.status === 'paused';
        if (input) {
          input.disabled = Boolean(waiting || paused);
          if ((waiting || paused) && !input.value) input.value = String(promise.message || '');
          if (!waiting && !paused && promise?.status === 'resumed') input.value = '';
        }
        if (button) {
          button.style.display = paused ? 'none' : '';
          button.textContent = waiting ? 'Отменить' : 'Вмешаться';
          button.disabled = promise?.status === 'sending';
        }
        if (resume) resume.style.display = paused ? '' : 'none';
        if (info) {
          info.textContent = !promise
            ? 'Interruption promise: сообщение будет отправлено только в durable safe point.'
            : `Interruption ${promise.status}${promise.continuationAnchor ? ` · anchor r${promise.continuationAnchor.semanticRevision}` : ''}`;
        }
      }
      renderSemanticLedgerPanel(panel, projection);
      panel.style.borderColor = projection.pausedByUser
        ? 'rgba(245,158,11,.82)'
        : 'rgba(52,211,153,.62)';
      schedulePanelPosition();
      return;
    }

  }

  function setPhase(phase, detail = '') {
    const nextPhase = String(phase || 'idle');
    const nextDetail = String(detail || '');
    const changed = state.phase !== nextPhase || state.detail !== nextDetail;
    state.phase = nextPhase;
    state.detail = nextDetail;
    if (changed) renderPanel();
  }

  function enterSemanticCorrectionWait(reason, marker = null) {
    // Non-integrity VIBE_STATE failures keep the current pending dispatch.
    // Transport/schema mistakes and source-resolution failures receive different
    // bounded causal repair instructions; authority/commit failures never do.
    clearPendingSend();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);

    const repair = queueSemanticRepairImpulse(reason, marker);
    if (repair.mode === 'integrity-hold' || repair.mode === 'model-continuity-hold') {
      enterHold(repair.reason || reason);
      return { recoverable: false, mode: repair.mode, reason: repair.reason || reason };
    }

    const detail = repair.mode === 'repair-queued'
      ? `VIBE_STATE технически не принят; auto-repair impulse подготовлен: ${reason}`
      : repair.mode === 'manual-correction'
        ? `VIBE_STATE технически не принят; manual-first policy запрещает автоматическую повторную отправку. Pending causal envelope сохранён: ${reason}`
      : repair.mode === 'wait-user'
        ? `Обнаружено пользовательское вмешательство; session сохранена и ожидает управляемого продолжения: ${reason}`
        : repair.mode === 'transport-repair-exhausted'
          ? `Configured TRANSPORT_REPAIR limit reached; semantic session preserved. Production default is continuous repair: ${reason}`
          : repair.mode === 'failure-limit'
            ? `Этот конкретный failed assistant attempt уже автоматически передан модели; повтор для того же turn не отправляется: ${reason}`
            : `Исправление VIBE_STATE ожидается: ${reason}`;
    setPhase('correction', detail);

    const signature = `${marker?.id || '(no-marker)'}::${String(reason || '')}`;
    const repeated = state.lastCorrectionSignature === signature;
    state.lastCorrectionSignature = signature;
    state.lastCorrectionWarnAt = Date.now();
    if (!repeated) {
      warn('RECOVERABLE SEMANTIC TRANSPORT ERROR:', reason, {
        repairMode: repair.mode,
        failureDomain: repair.failureDomain || null,
      });
      showBanner(
        repair.mode === 'repair-queued'
          ? '↻ VIBE STATE ERROR — runner сам запросит короткую коррекцию'
          : repair.mode === 'manual-correction'
            ? '⏸ VIBE STATE ERROR — manual-first: автокоррекция отключена, pending causal envelope сохранён'
            : '↻ VIBE STATE ERROR — session сохранена; новый dispatch не отправляется',
        '#92400e',
        10000
      );
    }
    return {
      recoverable: true,
      repeated,
      mode: repair.mode,
      reason: String(reason || ''),
      markerId: marker?.id || null,
    };
  }

  function enterHold(reason) {
    state.running = false;

    clearPendingSend();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    clearTimeout(observerSettleTimer);
    observerSettleTimer = null;
    clearTimeout(generationProbeTimer);
    generationProbeTimer = null;

    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();

    setPhase('hold', reason);

    warn('HOLD:', reason);

    showBanner(
      `⏸ VIBE HOLD — ${reason}`,
      '#991b1b',
      12000
    );

    void signalHold(reason);
  }

  async function processTail() {
    if (!state.running || state.busy || !isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
    cpuHotPathStats.processTailCalls += 1;

    // Streaming is a quarantine boundary. Do not touch IndexedDB/source restore,
    // tail projection, marker parsing or panel reconciliation while ChatGPT is
    // actively mutating the assistant turn.
    if (isGeneratingFast()) {
      cpuHotPathStats.processTailGeneratingSkips += 1;
      generationDirty = true;
      protocol.markGenerating();
      setPhase('waiting', protocol.describeGenerating());
      scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe();
      return;
    }

    state.busy = true;

    try {
      if (isGenerating()) {
        cpuHotPathStats.processTailGeneratingSkips += 1;
        generationDirty = true;
        protocol.markGenerating();
        setPhase('waiting', protocol.describeGenerating());
        scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe();
        return;
      }

      try {
        await maybeRebindActiveRolloverRoute();
      } catch (error) {
        enterHold(`Chat rollover route rebind failed: ${error?.message || error}`);
        return;
      }

      await protocol.prepare?.();

      if (isGeneratingFast()) {
        cpuHotPathStats.processTailGeneratingSkips += 1;
        generationDirty = true;
        protocol.markGenerating();
        setPhase('waiting', protocol.describeGenerating());
        scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe();
        return;
      }

      const turns = getTailTurns();

      if (!turns.length) {
        const semanticSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
        const synthetic = semanticSession ? semanticControlFromSession(semanticSession) : null;
        const pending = semanticSession?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
        const boundary = semanticSession ? semanticTransportControlBoundary(semanticSession) : null;
        const pendingStatus = String(pending?.status || '');
        const detachedProvenUnsent = Boolean(
          pending &&
          (pendingStatus === 'ready' || pendingStatus === 'queued') &&
          String(pending.controlId || '') === String(boundary?.id || '') &&
          Number(pending.baseRevision) === Number(semanticSession?.revision) &&
          pending.id &&
          pending.text
        );
        if (!synthetic?.synthetic && !detachedProvenUnsent) {
          setPhase('idle', 'semantic tail пуст и нет synthetic bootstrap/proven-unsent pending dispatch');
          return;
        }
        if (detachedProvenUnsent) {
          log('a20 resuming proven-unsent semantic dispatch with temporarily empty mounted tail', {
            dispatchId: pending.id,
            baseRevision: pending.baseRevision,
            status: pendingStatus,
            controlId: pending.controlId,
          });
        }
      }

      // v704 live continuity boundary: mounted historical assistant markers remain
      // observational residue, but an OPEN Mission with no schedulable Distance is
      // repaired into a bounded continuity Distance before reconciliation. True idle
      // remains valid only for sealed/non-active Mission authority or an explicit wait.
      const preReconcileEligibilityV697 = semanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696(SemanticSessionStore.peek());
      if (!preReconcileEligibilityV697.eligible) {
        const earlyIdleGateV697 = enforceSemanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696('pre-reconciliation-idle-boundary');
        if (!earlyIdleGateV697.allowed) {
          const idleSessionV697 = SemanticSessionStore.load();
          setPhase(
            'idle',
            `semantic quiescent · r${idleSessionV697?.revision ?? '?'} · no runnable Distance after open-Mission continuity repair; Mission is sealed/non-active or explicitly blocked`
          );
          renderPanel();
          return;
        }
      }

      const globalTransportGateV697 = await ensureOriginGlobalTransportAuthorityV697(
        'process-tail-pre-reconciliation',
        { pause: true }
      );
      if (!globalTransportGateV697.allowed) return;

      const reconciliation = await protocol.reconcile(turns);
      const disposition = protocol.classifyReconciliation(reconciliation);

      if (disposition.kind === 'settling') {
        // Re-read the final fenced transport even when its last bytes arrived as
        // characterData after the stop button vanished; no model-facing action is
        // allowed during this bounded settling window.
        markLatestAssistantTailDirty();
        setPhase('waiting', disposition.reason);
        scheduleProcess(disposition.retryAfterMs || CONFIG.semanticIncompleteStatePollMs);
        return;
      }

      if (disposition.kind === 'invalid') {
        if (disposition.recoverable !== false) {
          enterSemanticCorrectionWait(disposition.reason, disposition.marker);
        } else {
          enterHold(disposition.reason);
        }
        return;
      }

      state.lastCorrectionSignature = null;
      clearSemanticRepairQueue();
      if (reconciliation?.acceptedState?.dispatchId) {
        clearSemanticRepairAttemptState(String(reconciliation.acceptedState.dispatchId));
      }
      if (reconciliation?.acceptedState) {
        try {
          await finalizeChatRolloverAfterAcceptedState(reconciliation);
        } catch (error) {
          enterHold(`Chat rollover completion verification failed: ${error?.message || error}`);
          return;
        }
      }

      if (disposition.kind === 'hold') {
        enterHold(disposition.reason);
        return;
      }

      const operatorPrerequisiteCycle = operatorPrerequisiteCycleV6912();
      if (operatorPrerequisiteCycle.handled) {
        setPhase(operatorPrerequisiteCycle.phase || 'paused', operatorPrerequisiteCycle.reason || 'Operator prerequisite');
        renderPanel();
        return;
      }

      const stageHGateV653 = await stageHLiveGateAfterReconciliationV653();
      if (stageHGateV653.handled) {
        setPhase(stageHGateV653.phase || 'paused', stageHGateV653.reason || 'Stage H live integration acceptance');
        return;
      }

      const stageIGateV655 = await stageILiveGateAfterReconciliationV655();
      if (stageIGateV655.handled) {
        setPhase(stageIGateV655.phase || 'paused', stageIGateV655.reason || 'Stage I cross-chat recovery acceptance');
        return;
      }

      if (disposition.kind === 'complete') {
        await protocol.complete();
        return;
      }

      const control = protocol.resolveControl(reconciliation);

      if (!control) {
        // Infrastructure continuation is allowed without a mounted semantic control
        // only for an explicit manual rollover or for the one proven same-project
        // route-mismatch failure that a23 knows how to resume. Normal engineering
        // dispatch still requires a mounted/synthetic control boundary.
        const activeRolloverWithoutControlV623 = await getGlobalChatRolloverState().catch(() => null);
        const resumableScopeFailureWithoutControlV623 =
          activeRolloverWithoutControlV623 &&
          String(activeRolloverWithoutControlV623.sessionId || '') === String(SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.id || '') &&
          isRecoverableSameProjectScopeFailureV621(activeRolloverWithoutControlV623);
        if (getManualChatRolloverRequest() || resumableScopeFailureWithoutControlV623) {
          try {
            const rollover = await maybeAutoChatRolloverAtSafePoint(turns, reconciliation);
            if (rollover?.handled) {
              setPhase(
                'waiting',
                resumableScopeFailureWithoutControlV623
                  ? 'resuming proven same-project chat rollover failure'
                  : 'manual project chat rollover'
              );
              return;
            }
            setPhase(
              'waiting',
              resumableScopeFailureWithoutControlV623
                ? 'Recoverable chat rollover is queued; waiting for a safe transport boundary'
                : 'Manual rollover queued; waiting for a safe transport boundary'
            );
            scheduleProcess(900);
            return;
          } catch (error) {
            state.running = false;
            setPhase('paused', `Chat rollover recovery required: ${error?.message || error}`);
            return;
          }
        }
        setPhase(
          'idle',
          protocol.describeNoControl(reconciliation)
        );

        return;
      }

      {
        const operatorCycleV626 = handleOperatorControlCycleV626(turns);
        if (operatorCycleV626.handled) {
          setPhase(operatorCycleV626.phase || 'paused', operatorCycleV626.reason || 'Operator control');
          if (operatorCycleV626.retryAfterMs) scheduleProcess(operatorCycleV626.retryAfterMs);
          return;
        }

        const interruption = await deliverUserInterruptionAtSafePoint(turns);
        if (interruption.handled) {
          setPhase(
            interruption.delivered ? 'paused' : 'waiting',
            interruption.reason
          );
          if (!interruption.delivered) scheduleProcess(900);
          return;
        }
        const activeInterruption = currentUserInterruptionPromise();
        if (activeInterruption?.status === 'paused') {
          setPhase('paused', 'User interruption active; нажми «Продолжить» после пользовательского диалога');
          return;
        }
        try {
          const rollover = await maybeAutoChatRolloverAtSafePoint(turns, reconciliation);
          if (rollover?.handled) {
            setPhase('waiting', rollover.reason || 'automatic project chat rollover');
            return;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          state.running = false;
          setPhase('paused', `Automatic chat rollover recovery required: ${error?.message || error}`);
          return;
        }
      }

      const transportDormancyV6915 = projectDataTransportDormancyDispositionV6915(SemanticSessionStore.peek());
      if (transportDormancyV6915.waitingDistanceIds.length) {
        scheduleProjectDataTransportWakeProbeV6915(null, 'process-tail-observed-transport-wait');
      }
      if (transportDormancyV6915.dormant) {
        setPhase(
          'waiting',
          `Project Data relay dormant watch · ${transportDormancyV6915.waitingDistanceIds.join(', ')} · model dispatch suppressed until factual wake`
        );
        renderPanel();
        return;
      }

      // v704: advisory nextFocus/tacticalFocus is still not work authority.
      // But an OPEN Mission may not become idle merely because a local Distance
      // sealed without a successor. The eligibility watchdog creates a bounded
      // structural continuity Distance whose only job is to reconcile the Mission
      // frontier and establish explicit successor authority.
      const semanticDispatchGateV696 = enforceSemanticModelDispatchEligibilityV696('process-tail-pre-dispatch');
      if (!semanticDispatchGateV696.allowed) {
        const idleSessionV696 = SemanticSessionStore.load();
        setPhase(
          'idle',
          `semantic quiescent · r${idleSessionV696?.revision ?? '?'} · no runnable Distance after open-Mission continuity repair`
        );
        renderPanel();
        return;
      }

      const dispatch = protocol.buildDispatch();
      const tail = protocol.inspectExchange(control, turns, dispatch);

      log(
        'Mounted tail state through protocol façade',
        protocol.getLogContext(tail, turns.length)
      );

      if (tail.action === 'hold') {
        enterHold(tail.reason);
        return;
      }

      if (tail.action === 'idle') {
        setPhase('idle', tail.reason);
        return;
      }

      if (tail.action === 'operator') {
        setPhase('paused', tail.reason || 'Operator control');
        scheduleProcess(250);
        return;
      }

      if (tail.action === 'pause') {
        setPhase('paused', tail.reason);

        if (tail.retryAfterMs) {
          scheduleProcess(tail.retryAfterMs);
        }

        return;
      }

      if (tail.action === 'wait') {
        setPhase('waiting', tail.reason);

        if (tail.retryAfterMs) {
          scheduleProcess(tail.retryAfterMs);
        }

        return;
      }

      if (tail.action === 'send') {
        setPhase('active', tail.reason);

        queueSend(
          dispatch,
          'normal',
          tail.reason
        );

        return;
      }

      if (tail.action === 'orphan-go') {
        const cache = loadCache();
        const retryCount = getRetryCount(dispatch.id);

        const recentLease =
          cache.lastSendEventKey === dispatch.id &&
          Number.isFinite(cache.lastSendAt) &&
          now() - cache.lastSendAt <
            CONFIG.orphanRetryAfterMs;

        if (recentLease) {
          const left = Math.ceil(
            (
              CONFIG.orphanRetryAfterMs -
              (now() - cache.lastSendAt)
            ) / 1000
          );

          setPhase(
            'waiting',
            `GO уже отправлен; assistant ещё ${Math.max(0, left)}с`
          );

          scheduleProcess(2500);

          return;
        }

        if (
          retryCount >=
          CONFIG.maxOrphanRetriesPerDispatch
        ) {
          enterHold(
            `GO остался без assistant turn; повторов ` +
            `${retryCount}/` +
            `${CONFIG.maxOrphanRetriesPerDispatch}`
          );

          return;
        }

        queueSend(
          dispatch,
          'retry',
          `${tail.reason}; retry ${retryCount + 1}/` +
          `${CONFIG.maxOrphanRetriesPerDispatch}`
        );

        return;
      }

      enterHold(
        `Unknown tail action: ${tail.action}`
      );
    } catch (error) {
      fail('Fatal tail processing error', error);
      enterHold(error?.message || String(error));
    } finally {
      state.busy = false;
    }
  }

  function scheduleProcess(delay = CONFIG.settleMs) {
    if (!state.running) return;

    clearTimeout(settleTimer);

    settleTimer = setTimeout(
      () => processTail(),
      delay
    );
  }

  function scheduleObserverProcess() {
    observerLastRelevantAt = now();
    if (observerSettleTimer) return;

    const run = () => {
      observerSettleTimer = null;
      if (!state.running) return;
      if (isGeneratingFast()) {
        cpuHotPathStats.observerDeferredRuns += 1;
        generationDirty = true;
        scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe();
        return;
      }
      const quietFor = now() - observerLastRelevantAt;
      if (quietFor < CONFIG.settleMs) {
        observerSettleTimer = setTimeout(run, Math.max(40, CONFIG.settleMs - quietFor));
        return;
      }
      processTail();
    };

    observerSettleTimer = setTimeout(run, CONFIG.settleMs);
  }

  function installObserver() {
    observer?.disconnect();

    const target =
      document.querySelector('main') ||
      document.body;

    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      cpuHotPathStats.observerBatches += 1;
      cpuHotPathStats.observerMutationRecords += mutations.length;

      // The assistant stream can generate hundreds/thousands of DOM commits.
      // While the native stop button exists, do zero subtree searching and do
      // not churn debounce timers. One low-frequency completion probe owns the
      // transition back to semantic processing.
      if (isGeneratingFast()) {
        cpuHotPathStats.observerBatchesDuringGeneration += 1;
        generationDirty = true;
        scheduleGenerationCompletionProbe();
        return;
      }

      let relevant = false;
      for (const mutation of mutations) {
        const element = mutation.target instanceof Element
          ? mutation.target
          : mutation.target?.parentElement;
        if (element?.closest?.('#vibe-go-panel-v5,#vibe-go-panel-v628,#vibe-go-banner-v5')) {
          continue;
        }
        markTailRoleDirtyFromMutation(mutation);
        if (mutationTouchesConversationTransport(mutation)) relevant = true;
      }
      if (relevant) {
        cpuHotPathStats.observerRelevantBatches += 1;
        scheduleObserverProcess();
      }
    });

    // characterData is intentionally not observed. During streaming it is pure
    // token noise. Normally the final assistant role is invalidated once after
    // generation; the only targeted exception is a lexically incomplete fenced
    // VIBE_STATE, whose bounded settling loop explicitly dirties/re-reads that
    // final role without installing a high-frequency characterData observer.
    observer.observe(target, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });
  }

  function dockMutationTouchesAnchor(mutations) {
    const selector = CONFIG.projectAnchorSelector;
    const current = observedAnchor;
    for (const mutation of mutations) {
      if (mutation.type !== 'childList') continue;
      const nodes = [...mutation.addedNodes, ...mutation.removedNodes];
      for (const node of nodes) {
        if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;
        if (current && (node === current || node.contains(current))) return true;
        if (node.matches?.(selector) || node.querySelector?.(selector)) return true;
      }
    }
    return !current || !current.isConnected;
  }

  function installDockTracking() {
    dockObserver?.disconnect();

    // Do NOT observe style/class attributes here. positionPanel() itself writes
    // panel style, so an attribute observer over document.body can self-trigger
    // forever. Child-list observation is only for anchor mount/unmount; layout
    // motion is covered by ResizeObserver + scroll/resize events.
    dockObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      if (dockMutationTouchesAnchor(mutations)) schedulePanelPosition();
    });

    dockObserver.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });

    if (!dockListenersInstalled) {
      window.addEventListener('resize', schedulePanelPosition, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('scroll', schedulePanelPosition, {
        passive: true,
        capture: true,
      });
      dockListenersInstalled = true;
    }

    schedulePanelPosition();
  }

  function uninstallDockTracking() {
    dockObserver?.disconnect();
    dockObserver = null;

    resizeObserver?.disconnect();
    resizeObserver = null;
    observedAnchor = null;

    if (panelPositionRaf) {
      cancelAnimationFrame?.(panelPositionRaf);
      panelPositionRaf = 0;
    }

    if (dockListenersInstalled) {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', schedulePanelPosition);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', schedulePanelPosition, true);
      dockListenersInstalled = false;
    }
  }

  async function start(options = {}) {
    if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return { staleInstance: true, runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id };
    const explicitResume = options.explicit !== false;

    createPanel();

    // P6.5: an assigned final /c/... route may mount the already-sent dispatch/answer
    // before pathname-scoped persistence has recovered the exact provisional authority.
    // Exact durable rollover lineage outranks DOM reconstruction. Otherwise a generic
    // mounted-tail fallback can manufacture a surrogate semantic-session-recovered:* r1
    // and mask the real session. Replace only a narrowly proven surrogate; never replace
    // an unrelated real semantic session.
    try {
      await maybeRecoverExactRolloverBeforeTailRecoveryV695({
        reason: explicitResume
          ? 'explicit-start exact rollover preflight'
          : 'package-bootstrap exact rollover preflight',
      });
    } catch (error) {
      warn('Exact rollover preflight recovery failed', error);
      enterHold(`Exact rollover preflight recovery failed: ${error?.message || error}`);
      return status();
    }

    // A real platform-pressure pause is sticky across reload/package bootstrap.
    // Automatic bootstrap may not silently resume it; an explicit operator start
    // is required after the platform UI no longer reports pressure.
    const livePressure = detectPlatformPressureSignal();
    if (livePressure) {
      await pauseForPlatformPressure(
        livePressure,
        explicitResume ? 'explicit-start-preflight' : 'package-bootstrap-preflight'
      );
      return status();
    }

    let pressureSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const persistedPressure = pressureSession?.transport?.platformPressure || null;
    if (
      !explicitResume &&
      persistedPressure?.status === 'paused'
    ) {
      state.running = false;
      setPhase(
        'paused',
        'previous platform reliability/cooldown pause is still latched; explicit VibeGo.start() required after platform permits'
      );
      log('Automatic bootstrap preserved platform-pressure pause', persistedPressure);
      return status();
    }

    if (explicitResume && persistedPressure?.status === 'paused') {
      pressureSession.transport.platformPressure = {
        ...persistedPressure,
        status: 'cleared',
        resumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        resumeAuthority: 'explicit-operator-start',
      };
      pressureSession.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      SemanticSessionStore.save(pressureSession);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }

    const legacyGuardMigrationV6910 = migrateLegacyTransportBehavioralGuardV6910(explicitResume ? 'explicit-start-preflight' : 'package-bootstrap-preflight');
    if (legacyGuardMigrationV6910?.migrated) await flushRuntimePersistence();

    const modelContinuityStartSignalV622 = await enforceModelContinuityGuardV622(
      explicitResume ? 'explicit-start-preflight' : 'package-bootstrap-preflight',
      { allowArm: true }
    );
    if (modelContinuityStartSignalV622) return status();

    // A09.13: preserve A09.12 legacy HOLD migration before normal lifecycle
    // handling. Missing local analyzer registration is an operator/tooling
    // prerequisite, not semantic meaning, so migrate that narrow legacy HOLD into
    // a transport-only waiting gate while preserving the semantic revision.
    const operatorPrerequisiteMigrationV6912 = migrateLegacyOperatorPrerequisiteHoldV6912(
      explicitResume ? 'explicit-start-preflight' : 'package-bootstrap-preflight'
    );
    if (operatorPrerequisiteMigrationV6912?.migrated) await flushRuntimePersistence();

    // A09.11: a real external-transport HOLD is sticky until an explicit resume
    // proves the exact Project Data operation route healthy. Semantic/authority
    // HOLDs remain untouched. Recovery + re-anchor happen before runner start, so
    // stale pre-HOLD focus cannot be physically dispatched after the blocker clears.
    if (explicitResume) {
      const holdRecoveryV6911 = await recoverExternalTransportHoldV6911({
        authority: String(options.reason || 'explicit-start'),
      });
      if (holdRecoveryV6911?.attempted && holdRecoveryV6911?.recovered !== true) {
        return status();
      }
    }

    const originGlobalStartGateV697 = await ensureOriginGlobalTransportAuthorityV697(
      explicitResume ? 'explicit-start-preflight' : 'package-bootstrap-preflight',
      { pause: true }
    );
    if (!originGlobalStartGateV697.allowed) return status();

    state.running = true;

    installObserver();
    installDockTracking();

    setPhase(
      'idle',
      'читаю только последние mounted turns'
    );

    log('Runner started', {
      explicitResume,
      mode: 'continuous',
    });
    log(
      `Tail-only mode: max ${CONFIG.tailTurnLimit} mounted turns, no history scrolling`
    );

    try {
      await maybeRecoverSemanticAuthority({ reason: 'startup-mounted-vibe-state' });
    } catch (error) {
      warn('Automatic semantic authority recovery failed', error);
      enterHold(error?.message || String(error));
      return;
    }


    if (ProtocolRuntime.getMode() === 'semantic') {
      const semanticSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      if (semanticSession) {
        try {
          await SourceWorkspace.restore(semanticSession.id);
        } catch (error) {
          warn(
            'Semantic startup continues without restored Source Workspace',
            error
          );
        }
        try {
          const authorityReconciliation = await maybeAutoReconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority();
          if (authorityReconciliation?.recovered) {
            log('Stronger cross-chat Working authority restored without semantic rollback', authorityReconciliation);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          warn('Automatic Working authority reconciliation deferred', error);
        }
        try {
          await finalizeCrossChatTransportReanchor();
        } catch (error) {
          warn('Cross-chat transport re-anchor deferred', error);
          persistenceUiMessage = `Recovered semantic authority; transport re-anchor deferred: ${error?.message || error}`;
        }
      }
    }

    await processTail();
  }

  function stop(options = {}) {
    const stopReasonV637 = String(options?.reason || 'explicit stop() API call');
    const stopSourceV637 = String(options?.source || (options?.retire === true ? 'runner-retirement' : 'public-api-or-unattributed'));
    const stopStackV637 = (() => {
      try {
        return String(new Error('VIBE-GO stop attribution').stack || '')
          .split('\n')
          .slice(1, 5)
          .map(line => line.trim());
      } catch (_) {
        return [];
      }
    })();
    state.lastStopV637 = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-stop-attribution/v1',
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reason: stopReasonV637,
      source: stopSourceV637,
      retire: options?.retire === true,
      runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id,
      stack: stopStackV637,
    };
    state.running = false;
    if (options?.retire === true) retireRunnerInstanceV614();

    clearPendingSend();
    clearOperatorAutoContinueTimerV626();
    document.querySelector('#vibe-go-auto-continue-overlay-v626')?.remove();
    clearSemanticRepairQueue();
    clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    clearTimeout(observerSettleTimer);
    observerSettleTimer = null;
    clearTimeout(generationProbeTimer);
    generationProbeTimer = null;

    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    uninstallDockTracking();

    setPhase(
      'idle',
      stopSourceV637 === 'ui-stop-button'
        ? 'остановлен явной кнопкой ■ Stop; клик по lifecycle — запустить'
        : `runner stopped · ${stopSourceV637} · ${stopReasonV637}`
    );

    showBanner(
      '■ VIBE-GO остановлен',
      '#7f1d1d'
    );

    log('Runner stopped');
  }

  async function recover(options = {}) {
    if (!state.running) {
      state.running = true;
      createPanel();
      installObserver();
      installDockTracking();
    }

    let semanticRecovery = null;
    try {
      semanticRecovery = await maybeRecoverSemanticAuthority(options);
    } catch (error) {
      warn('Semantic authority recovery failed', error);
      enterHold(error?.message || String(error));
      return { recovered: false, error: error?.message || String(error) };
    }


    await processTail();
    return semanticRecovery || {
      recovered: Boolean(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
      reusedSession: Boolean(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
      session: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
    };
  }

          return gate ? {

            usageGovernorBlocks: gate.usageGovernorBlocks || 0,
            lastUsageGovernorBlock: cloneSemanticValue(gate.lastUsageGovernorBlock || null),
            lastBlocked: cloneSemanticValue(gate.lastBlocked || null),
            lastAllowed: cloneSemanticValue(gate.lastAllowed || null),
            lastPayloadMismatch: cloneSemanticValue(gate.lastPayloadMismatch || null),
            lastCanonicalizedPayloadAccept: cloneSemanticValue(gate.lastCanonicalizedPayloadAccept || null),
          } : null;
        })(),
      },
      platformPressure: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.transport?.platformPressure || loadCache().lastPlatformPressure || null,
      usageGovernorV625: {
        state: getUsageGovernorStateV625(),

      modelContinuityGuardV622: {
        state: getModelContinuityGuardStateV622(),
        observation: observeModelContinuityV622(),
      },
      mountedTurns: getTailTurns().length,
      pendingSend: pendingSend
        ? { ...pendingSend }
        : null,
      cache: loadCache(),
    };
  }

  function buildLostR53SpecSeed(options = {}) {
    const operations = lostR46R53RecoverySteps().flatMap(step => step.operations.map(operation => cloneSemanticValue(operation)));
    return {

      parent: {

        headRevisionId: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.parentHeadRevisionId,

      targetSequence: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence,

        ],
        ...(options.expectedWorkingSha256 ? { workingSha256: String(options.expectedWorkingSha256).toLowerCase() } : {}),
      },
      workingChange: {
        intent: 'spec-determinization',
        summary: 'Deterministically materialize the certified lost r53-equivalent source state from r46 in one content-addressed recovery revision.',
        rationale: 'The original r47…r53 revision store is unavailable; preserve the certified source delta without fabricating lost revision IDs.',
      },
    };
  }

  function simulateSourceRecoveryRecipe(steps) {
    const { baseline } = requireSourceRuntime();
    let stagedSpans = new Map(workingSortedSpans(workingRuntime.spans).map(span => [span.id, span]));
    const report = [];
    for (const step of steps) {
      const beforeCount = stagedSpans.size;
      for (let index = 0; index < step.operations.length; index += 1) {
        const operation = step.operations[index];
        try {
          const edit = resolveExactWorkingOperation(stagedSpans, operation);
          stagedSpans = stageWorkingEdit(stagedSpans, edit).spans;
        } catch (error) {
          throw new Error(
            `SOURCE_RECOVERY_DRY_RUN_FAILED at target r${step.recoveryOfSequence}, ` +
            `op ${index + 1}/${step.operations.length} ${operation.op}: ${error?.message || error}`
          );
        }
      }
      validateWorkingSpanSet(stagedSpans, baseline.text.length);
      report.push({
        recoveryOfSequence: step.recoveryOfSequence,
        operationCount: step.operations.length,
        beforeActiveSpanCount: beforeCount,
        afterActiveSpanCount: stagedSpans.size,
      });
    }
    return { ok: true, report, finalSpans: stagedSpans };
  }

  async function validateLostR46R53RecoveryResult() {
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync().text;
    const current = workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    const forbidden = [
      `#modsBoard.mod-grid-flat.mod-grid-single,\n.mods-separator-grid.mod-grid-flat.mod-grid-single {\n  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;\n}`,
      `  --mod-canonical-dot-active: 1;`,
      `.mod-decoration-flyout .mod-decoration-grid-title {\n  grid-column: 1 / -1;\n  color: #93c5fd;\n  font-size: 11px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  letter-spacing: .04em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  margin: 2px 0 -4px;\n}`,
    ];
    const required = [
      `/* === v309: wide responsive decoration flyouts === */`,
      `min-height: 0 !important;`,
      `margin-top: calc(((var(--classic-mod-card-height, 30px) - 10px) / 2) - 3px + var(--mod-pocket-pull-up, 0px)) !important;`,
      `.mod-card.has-mod-visual-radius {`,
      `.mod-card.has-mod-visual-shadow {`,
    ];
    const forbiddenPresent = forbidden.filter(text => materialized.includes(text));
    const requiredMissing = required.filter(text => !materialized.includes(text));
    return {
      ok: Number(current.workingSequence || 0) === LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence &&
        forbiddenPresent.length === 0 && requiredMissing.length === 0,
      current,
      forbiddenPresent,
      requiredMissing,
      v309Present: materialized.includes(`/* === v309: wide responsive decoration flyouts === */`),
      nextOffset: sourceRuntime.workspace?.cursor?.nextOffset ?? null,
    };
  }

  async function recoverLostR46ToR53Equivalent(options = {}) {
    const semanticSession = await ensureSemanticSessionReady({
      operation: 'sourceOps.recoverLostR46ToR53Equivalent',
      recoverFromTail: true,
    });
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) await SourceWorkspace.restore(semanticSession.id);
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const baseline = sourceRuntime.baseline;
    const before = workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace);
    if (String(baseline?.sha256 || '') !== LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.baselineSha256) {
      throw new Error(`SOURCE_RECOVERY_BASELINE_MISMATCH: expected ${LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.baselineSha256}, got ${baseline?.sha256 || 'none'}`);
    }
    const beforeSequence = Number(before.workingSequence || 0);
    const headRecovery = workingRuntime.headRevision?.recovery || null;
    const onCertifiedParent = beforeSequence === LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.parentSequence &&
      String(before.headRevisionId || '') === LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.parentHeadRevisionId;
    const onRecipeReplay = beforeSequence > LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.parentSequence &&
      beforeSequence <= LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence &&
      String(headRecovery?.recipeId || '') === LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.id &&
      Number(headRecovery?.recoveryOfSequence || 0) === beforeSequence;
    if (!onCertifiedParent && !onRecipeReplay) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_RECOVERY_PARENT_MISMATCH: recipe is only valid on the certified lost parent or its own resumable replay chain; ' +
        `expected r${LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.parentSequence}/${LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.parentHeadRevisionId} ` +
        `or recipe-owned r47…r53, got r${before.workingSequence}/${before.headRevisionId || 'no-head'}`
      );
    }

    if (beforeSequence === LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence && onRecipeReplay) {
      const validation = await validateLostR46R53RecoveryResult();
      if (!validation.ok) throw new Error('SOURCE_RECOVERY_VERIFY_FAILED: existing replay head r53 is not equivalent');
      replaceSourceAuthorityFloorWithEquivalentHead({
        sessionId: semanticSession.id,
        baselineId: baseline.id,
        workingSequence: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence,
        headRevisionId: validation.current.headRevisionId,
        reason: `recovered-equivalent:${LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.id}`,
      }, LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.lostTargetHeadRevisionId, { semanticSession });
      return {
        recovered: true,
        alreadyRecovered: true,
        equivalentToLostSequence: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence,
        lostHeadRevisionId: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.lostTargetHeadRevisionId,
        newHeadRevisionId: validation.current.headRevisionId,
        before,
        current: validation.current,
        revisions: [],
        validation,
        cursorPreserved: true,
        nextOffset: validation.nextOffset,
        authorityFloor: resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(semanticSession),
      };
    }

    const allSteps = lostR46R53RecoverySteps();
    const steps = allSteps.filter(step => Number(step.recoveryOfSequence) > beforeSequence);
    const dryRun = simulateSourceRecoveryRecipe(steps);
    if (options.dryRun === true) {
      return {
        recovered: false,
        dryRun: true,
        recipe: cloneSemanticValue(LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY),
        before,
        validation: dryRun.report,
        authorityFloor: resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(semanticSession),
      };
    }

    // COMMIT-only authority mutation: a dry run must never persist a causal floor.
    // Once replay starts, install the certified lost target so ordinary sourceOps
    // remain fail-closed if recovery is interrupted midway.
    setSourceAuthorityFloor({
      sessionId: semanticSession.id,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      workingSequence: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence,
      headRevisionId: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.lostTargetHeadRevisionId,
      reason: `certified-lost-authority:${LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.id}`,
    }, { semanticSession });
    await flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);

    const revisions = [];
    for (const step of steps) {
      const current = workingAuthorityToken(sourceRuntime.workspace);
      if (Number(current.workingSequence || 0) + 1 !== Number(step.recoveryOfSequence)) {
        throw new Error(
          `SOURCE_RECOVERY_SEQUENCE_DRIFT: expected parent r${step.recoveryOfSequence - 1}, ` +
          `got r${current.workingSequence}`
        );
      }
      const revision = await applyWorkingChangeSet({
        operations: step.operations,
        intent: 'recovery-replay',
        summary: step.summary,
        rationale: 'Deterministically re-materialize the certified lost r46→r53 source mutations after Source revision-store loss; preserve observable behavior and do not fabricate lost revision IDs.',
      }, {
        skipAuthorityPreflight: true,
        kind: 'recovery-replay',
        syncSession: true,
        schedule: false,
        recovery: {
          schema: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.schema,
          recipeId: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.id,
          recoveryOfSequence: step.recoveryOfSequence,
          lostTargetHeadRevisionId: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.lostTargetHeadRevisionId,
          originalDistanceId: step.distanceId,
        },
      });
      revisions.push(revision);
    }
    const validation = await validateLostR46R53RecoveryResult();
    if (!validation.ok) {
      throw new Error(
        'SOURCE_RECOVERY_VERIFY_FAILED: replay reached a non-equivalent materialization; ' +
        JSON.stringify(validation)
      );
    }
    replaceSourceAuthorityFloorWithEquivalentHead({
      sessionId: semanticSession.id,
      baselineId: baseline.id,
      workingSequence: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence,
      headRevisionId: validation.current.headRevisionId,
      reason: `recovered-equivalent:${LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.id}`,
    }, LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.lostTargetHeadRevisionId, { semanticSession });
    await flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);
    await publishGlobalCrossChatPointer(SemanticSessionStore.load()).catch(() => null);
    renderPanel();
    scheduleProcess(100);
    return {
      recovered: true,
      equivalentToLostSequence: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.targetSequence,
      lostHeadRevisionId: LOST_R46_R53_RECOVERY.lostTargetHeadRevisionId,
      newHeadRevisionId: validation.current.headRevisionId,
      before,
      current: validation.current,
      revisions: revisions.map(revision => ({
        sequence: revision.sequence,
        revisionId: revision.id,
        sourceOpsDigest: revision.sourceOpsDigest,
        recovery: revision.recovery,
      })),
      validation,
      cursorPreserved: true,
      nextOffset: validation.nextOffset,
      authorityFloor: resolveSourceAuthorityFloor(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
    };
  }


  /*
   * Working Refactor Audit v1
   *
   * Read-only audit over the durable Working Source lineage. It does not mutate
   * source, create Working revisions, or turn heuristic review findings into HOLD.
   * Hard integrity invariants are reported separately from historical risk signals.
   */
  const REFACTOR_AUDIT_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-working-refactor-audit/v1';
  const REFACTOR_AUDIT_MAX_FINDINGS = 240;
  const REFACTOR_AUDIT_MAX_ZONES = 96;

  function refactorAuditRuntimeKey(sessionId) {
    return `workingRefactorAudit:${String(sessionId || 'unknown')}`;
  }

  function refactorAuditSetEqual(aInput, bInput) {
    const a = [...new Set(Array.isArray(aInput) ? aInput.map(String) : [])].sort();
    const b = [...new Set(Array.isArray(bInput) ? bInput.map(String) : [])].sort();
    return a.length === b.length && a.every((value, index) => value === b[index]);
  }

  function refactorAuditRevisionText(revision) {
    return [
      revision?.kind,
      revision?.intent,
      revision?.recovery?.kind,
      revision?.recovery?.reason,
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
  }

  function refactorAuditIsRollbackArtifact(revision) {
    const controlText = refactorAuditRevisionText(revision);
    if (/\b(?:restore|rollback|revert|recover|recovery|repair|corrective)\b/i.test(controlText)) return true;
    const summary = String(revision?.summary || '').trim();
    return /^(?:rollback|restore|revert|recover|repair|откат|восстанов|исправ)/i.test(summary);
  }

  function refactorAuditSourceOpName(operation) {
    return String(operation?.op || operation?.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  function refactorAuditExpectedIds(operation) {
    const target = operation?.target && typeof operation.target === 'object'
      ? operation.target
      : {};
    const ids = operation?.expectedSpanIds ?? operation?.spanIds ?? target.expectedSpanIds ?? target.spanIds;
    return Array.isArray(ids) ? [...new Set(ids.map(String).filter(Boolean))].sort() : null;
  }

  function refactorAuditOwnershipProof(revision) {
    const removed = [...new Set((revision?.removedSpanIds || []).map(String))].sort();
    if (!removed.length) return { proved: true, mode: 'no-removed-spans' };
    const operations = Array.isArray(revision?.sourceOps) ? revision.sourceOps : [];
    if (!operations.length) return { proved: false, mode: 'legacy-no-sourceops' };

    const owned = new Set();
    for (const operation of operations) {
      const op = refactorAuditSourceOpName(operation);
      if (op === 'RESTORE_CHANGE_SPAN') {
        const spanId = String(operation?.target?.spanId || operation?.target?.id || operation?.spanId || '');
        if (spanId) owned.add(spanId);
        continue;
      }
      if (op === 'RESTORE_BASELINE_RANGE' || op === 'DELETE_BASELINE_RANGE') {
        const ids = refactorAuditExpectedIds(operation);
        if (!ids) return { proved: false, mode: `${op.toLowerCase()}-without-ownership` };
        ids.forEach(id => owned.add(id));
        continue;
      }
      // Exact/working-coordinate mutations in pre-v6.4.5 history could normalize
      // across an overlapping span. Presence of exactText alone is not ownership proof.
      return { proved: false, mode: `generic-${op.toLowerCase() || 'unknown'}` };
    }
    const proved = refactorAuditSetEqual([...owned], removed);
    return {
      proved,
      mode: proved ? 'span-owned-sourceops' : 'sourceops-ownership-mismatch',
      ownedSpanIds: [...owned].sort(),
    };
  }

  function refactorAuditFindInverseRevisions(revisions) {
    const result = new Map();
    for (let index = 0; index < revisions.length; index += 1) {
      const revision = revisions[index];
      const before = revision?.beforeActiveSpanIds || [];
      const after = revision?.afterActiveSpanIds || [];
      for (let laterIndex = index + 1; laterIndex < revisions.length; laterIndex += 1) {
        const later = revisions[laterIndex];
        if (
          refactorAuditSetEqual(later?.beforeActiveSpanIds || [], after) &&
          refactorAuditSetEqual(later?.afterActiveSpanIds || [], before)
        ) {
          result.set(revision.id, later);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  function refactorAuditRangeLength(range) {
    return Math.max(0, Number(range?.end || 0) - Number(range?.start || 0));
  }

  function refactorAuditMergeZones(findings, baselineLength) {
    const raw = [];
    for (const finding of findings) {
      for (const range of finding.ranges || []) {
        const normalized = sourceNormalizeRange(range, baselineLength);
        if (!normalized) continue;
        raw.push({
          ...normalized,
          severity: finding.severity,
          codes: [finding.code],
          revisions: finding.revisionSequence ? [finding.revisionSequence] : [],
        });
      }
    }
    raw.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.end - b.end);
    const zones = [];
    const severityRank = { info: 0, low: 1, medium: 2, high: 3, critical: 4 };
    for (const item of raw) {
      const current = zones.at(-1);
      if (!current || item.start > current.end + 96) {
        zones.push({ ...item });
        continue;
      }
      current.end = Math.max(current.end, item.end);
      current.codes = [...new Set([...current.codes, ...item.codes])];
      current.revisions = [...new Set([...current.revisions, ...item.revisions])].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      if ((severityRank[item.severity] || 0) > (severityRank[current.severity] || 0)) {
        current.severity = item.severity;
      }
    }
    return zones.slice(0, REFACTOR_AUDIT_MAX_ZONES);
  }

  function refactorAuditLineage(revisions, workspace) {
    const revisionMap = new Map(revisions.map(item => [String(item.id), item]));
    const issues = [];
    const lineage = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    let currentId = String(workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || '');
    const expectedHeadSequence = Number(workspace?.working?.sequence || 0);

    if (expectedHeadSequence > 0 && !currentId) {
      issues.push({ severity: 'critical', code: 'head-revision-missing', message: 'Working sequence is non-zero but headRevisionId is empty.' });
      return { lineage, lineageIds: new Set(), issues };
    }
    while (currentId) {
      if (seen.has(currentId)) {
        issues.push({ severity: 'critical', code: 'revision-lineage-cycle', message: `Working revision lineage contains a cycle at ${currentId}.` });
        break;
      }
      seen.add(currentId);
      const revision = revisionMap.get(currentId);
      if (!revision) {
        issues.push({ severity: 'critical', code: 'head-lineage-record-missing', message: `Working revision ${currentId} is referenced by the head lineage but missing from IndexedDB.` });
        break;
      }
      lineage.push(revision);
      currentId = String(revision.parentRevisionId || '');
    }
    lineage.reverse();
    if (lineage.length) {
      const head = lineage.at(-1);
      if (Number(head.sequence || 0) !== expectedHeadSequence) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'critical',
          code: 'head-sequence-mismatch',
          message: `Workspace head says r${expectedHeadSequence}, lineage head is r${Number(head.sequence || 0)}.`,
        });
      }
      for (let index = 1; index < lineage.length; index += 1) {
        const previous = lineage[index - 1];
        const revision = lineage[index];
        if (String(revision.parentRevisionId || '') !== String(previous.id || '')) {
          issues.push({ severity: 'critical', code: 'revision-parent-mismatch', revisionSequence: Number(revision.sequence || 0), message: `r${revision.sequence} parent does not match previous lineage revision.` });
        }
        const expected = Number(previous.sequence || 0) + 1;
        const actual = Number(revision.sequence || 0);
        const deterministicJump = revision?.kind === 'spec-determinization' &&
          revision?.recovery?.schema === SPEC_DETERMINIZATION_SCHEMA &&
          Number(revision?.recovery?.fromSequence || 0) === Number(previous.sequence || 0) &&
          Number(revision?.recovery?.targetSequence || 0) === actual && actual >= expected;
        if (actual !== expected && !deterministicJump) {
          issues.push({ severity: 'critical', code: 'revision-sequence-gap', revisionSequence: actual, message: `Revision sequence jumps from r${previous.sequence} to r${actual} without deterministic recovery metadata.` });
        }
      }
    }
    return { lineage, lineageIds: new Set(lineage.map(item => String(item.id))), issues };
  }

  function refactorAuditRevisionConsistency(revision, spanMap) {
    const issues = [];
    const before = new Set((revision.beforeActiveSpanIds || []).map(String));
    const after = new Set((revision.afterActiveSpanIds || []).map(String));
    const added = new Set((revision.addedSpanIds || []).map(String));
    const removed = new Set((revision.removedSpanIds || []).map(String));
    const expectedAfter = new Set([...before].filter(id => !removed.has(id)));
    added.forEach(id => expectedAfter.add(id));
    if (!refactorAuditSetEqual([...expectedAfter], [...after])) {
      issues.push({
        severity: 'critical',
        code: 'revision-span-set-inconsistent',
        revisionSequence: Number(revision.sequence || 0),
        ranges: cloneSemanticValue(revision.affectedBaselineRanges || []),
        message: `r${revision.sequence} afterActiveSpanIds does not equal before - removed + added.`,
      });
    }
    for (const id of new Set([...before, ...after, ...added, ...removed])) {
      if (!spanMap.has(id)) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'critical',
          code: 'revision-span-record-missing',
          revisionSequence: Number(revision.sequence || 0),
          ranges: cloneSemanticValue(revision.affectedBaselineRanges || []),
          message: `r${revision.sequence} references missing span ${id}.`,
        });
      }
    }
    return issues;
  }

  function refactorAuditRevisionFinding(revision, context) {
    const removed = (revision.removedSpanIds || []).map(String);
    const added = (revision.addedSpanIds || []).map(String);
    const ownership = refactorAuditOwnershipProof(revision);
    const inverse = context.inverseMap.get(revision.id) || null;
    const directlyActive = added.some(id => context.activeSpanIds.has(id));
    const onHeadLineage = context.lineageIds.has(String(revision.id));
    const rollbackArtifact = refactorAuditIsRollbackArtifact(revision);
    const ranges = cloneSemanticValue(revision.affectedBaselineRanges || []);
    const rangeChars = ranges.reduce((sum, range) => sum + refactorAuditRangeLength(range), 0);

    if (!removed.length && !rollbackArtifact && !revision.recovery) return null;

    let severity = 'info';
    const codes = [];
    if (rollbackArtifact || revision.recovery) codes.push('rollback-recovery-artifact');
    if (removed.length && !ownership.proved) {
      codes.push('unproved-span-ownership');
      severity = directlyActive ? 'high' : (onHeadLineage ? 'medium' : 'low');
    }
    if (removed.length > 1 && !ownership.proved) {
      codes.push('multi-span-normalization');
      if (severity === 'medium') severity = 'high';
    }
    if (removed.length && added.length === 1 && !ownership.proved) {
      codes.push('envelope-collapse-signature');
      if (severity === 'low' || severity === 'info') severity = 'medium';
    }
    if (rollbackArtifact && removed.length && !ownership.proved && onHeadLineage) {
      codes.push('legacy-rollback-without-ownership-proof');
      if (ownership.mode.includes('without-ownership') || directlyActive || added.length) {
        severity = 'high';
      } else if (severity !== 'critical') {
        // A legacy removal-only rollback may be exactly the repair we wanted. It
        // still deserves review because old revisions lack ownership provenance,
        // but it is not equivalent to an active envelope-collapse signature.
        severity = 'medium';
      }
    }
    if (rollbackArtifact && removed.length && !added.length && !directlyActive && ownership.mode === 'legacy-no-sourceops' && !inverse) {
      severity = 'medium';
    }
    if (inverse) {
      codes.push('exactly-neutralized-later');
      if (!directlyActive) severity = 'info';
    }
    if (!codes.length) return null;

    const headRelevance = inverse
      ? `neutralized-by-r${Number(inverse.sequence || 0)}`
      : directlyActive
        ? 'direct-active-span'
        : onHeadLineage
          ? 'lineage-only'
          : 'off-head-lineage';
    return {
      severity,
      code: codes.join('+'),
      revisionId: revision.id,
      revisionSequence: Number(revision.sequence || 0),
      kind: revision.kind || 'change',
      intent: revision.intent || '',
      summary: ledgerTruncate(revision.summary || '', 360),
      ranges,
      affectedChars: rangeChars,
      addedSpanIds: added,
      removedSpanIds: removed,
      ownershipProof: ownership,
      headRelevance,
      message:
        `r${revision.sequence}: ${removed.length} removed / ${added.length} added span(s); ` +
        `ownership=${ownership.mode}; relevance=${headRelevance}.`,
    };
  }

  async function runWorkingRefactorAudit(options = {}) {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session?.id) throw new Error('REFACTOR_AUDIT: semantic session is unavailable');
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline || sourceRuntime.workspace.sessionId !== session.id) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
    }
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const { workspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime(session);
    const revisions = (await sourceDbGetAll('workingRevisions'))
      .filter(item => String(item?.baselineId || '') === String(baseline.id || ''))
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a.sequence || 0) - Number(b.sequence || 0));
    const spanRows = (await sourceDbGetAll('workingSpans'))
      .filter(item => String(item?.baselineId || '') === String(baseline.id || ''));
    const spanMap = new Map(spanRows.map(item => [String(item.id), item]));
    const activeSpanIds = new Set((workspace.working?.activeSpanIds || []).map(String));
    const findings = [];

    // Hard integrity: current active spans and lineage must be reconstructable.
    const missingActive = [...activeSpanIds].filter(id => !spanMap.has(id));
    for (const id of missingActive) {
      findings.push({ severity: 'critical', code: 'active-span-record-missing', message: `Current Working head references missing active span ${id}.`, ranges: [] });
    }
    try {
      const activeSpans = new Map([...activeSpanIds].filter(id => spanMap.has(id)).map(id => [id, spanMap.get(id)]));
      validateWorkingSpanSet(activeSpans, baseline.text.length);
    } catch (error) {
      findings.push({ severity: 'critical', code: 'active-span-set-invalid', message: error?.message || String(error), ranges: [] });
    }

    const lineageInfo = refactorAuditLineage(revisions, workspace);
    findings.push(...lineageInfo.issues);
    for (const revision of lineageInfo.lineage) {
      findings.push(...refactorAuditRevisionConsistency(revision, spanMap));
    }
    const inverseMap = refactorAuditFindInverseRevisions(revisions);
    const context = {
      activeSpanIds,
      lineageIds: lineageInfo.lineageIds,
      inverseMap,
    };
    for (const revision of revisions) {
      const finding = refactorAuditRevisionFinding(revision, context);
      if (finding) findings.push(finding);
    }

    // Active-span provenance: current source should not contain unattributed spans.
    const creatorBySpan = new Map();
    for (const revision of revisions) {
      for (const id of revision.addedSpanIds || []) creatorBySpan.set(String(id), revision);
    }
    const activeStats = { deletions: 0, replacements: 0, insertions: 0, baselineChars: 0, replacementChars: 0 };
    for (const id of activeSpanIds) {
      const span = spanMap.get(id);
      if (!span) continue;
      const baselineChars = Math.max(0, Number(span.baselineEnd || 0) - Number(span.baselineStart || 0));
      const replacementChars = String(span.replacementText || '').length;
      activeStats.baselineChars += baselineChars;
      activeStats.replacementChars += replacementChars;
      if (baselineChars === 0) activeStats.insertions += 1;
      else if (!replacementChars) activeStats.deletions += 1;
      else activeStats.replacements += 1;
      const creator = creatorBySpan.get(id);
      if (!creator) {
        findings.push({
          severity: 'high',
          code: 'active-span-unattributed',
          message: `Active span ${id} has no creating Working revision in durable lineage storage.`,
          ranges: [{ start: Number(span.baselineStart), end: Number(span.baselineEnd) }],
        });
      }
    }

    // Materialized structural comparison is one targeted audit question, not a test cascade.
    const materialized = materializeWorkingSourceSync();
    const workingBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(materialized.text);
    const workingSha256 = await sourceSha256(workingBytes.buffer);
    const baselineSegments = Array.isArray(workspace.segmentMap) && workspace.segmentMap.length
      ? workspace.segmentMap
      : buildSourceSegmentMap(baseline.text);
    const workingSegments = buildSourceSegmentMap(materialized.text);
    const segmentSignature = rows => rows.map(item => item.mode).join('|');
    if (segmentSignature(baselineSegments) !== segmentSignature(workingSegments)) {
      findings.push({
        severity: 'critical',
        code: 'script-style-segment-structure-changed',
        message: `Materialized Working Source changes the HTML/script/style segment signature (${baselineSegments.length} → ${workingSegments.length}).`,
        ranges: [],
      });
    }

    const severityRank = { info: 0, low: 1, medium: 2, high: 3, critical: 4 };
    findings.sort((a, b) =>
      (severityRank[b.severity] || 0) - (severityRank[a.severity] || 0) ||
      Number(a.revisionSequence || 0) - Number(b.revisionSequence || 0)
    );
    const counts = Object.fromEntries(['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low', 'info'].map(level => [
      level,
      findings.filter(item => item.severity === level).length,
    ]));
    const verdict = counts.critical ? 'critical-integrity' : counts.high || counts.medium ? 'review' : 'clean';
    const orphanRevisionCount = revisions.filter(item => !lineageInfo.lineageIds.has(String(item.id))).length;
    const report = {
      schema: REFACTOR_AUDIT_SCHEMA,
      generatedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      verdict,
      baseline: {
        id: baseline.id,
        sha256: baseline.sha256,
        name: baseline.name,
        sizeChars: baseline.text.length,
        segmentCount: baselineSegments.length,
      },
      working: {
        identity: workspace.working?.identity || null,
        sequence: Number(workspace.working?.sequence || 0),
        headRevisionId: workspace.working?.headRevisionId || null,
        sha256: workingSha256,
        sizeChars: materialized.text.length,
        netDeltaChars: materialized.text.length - baseline.text.length,
        activeSpanCount: activeSpanIds.size,
        activeStats,
        segmentCount: workingSegments.length,
      },
      history: {
        revisionCount: revisions.length,
        headLineageRevisionCount: lineageInfo.lineage.length,
        orphanRevisionCount,
        storedSpanCount: spanRows.length,
        rollbackRecoveryRevisionCount: revisions.filter(refactorAuditIsRollbackArtifact).length,
        revisionsWithRemovedSpans: revisions.filter(item => (item.removedSpanIds || []).length).length,
        revisionsWithoutSourceOps: revisions.filter(item => !Array.isArray(item.sourceOps) || !item.sourceOps.length).length,
      },
      counts,
      findings: findings.slice(0, REFACTOR_AUDIT_MAX_FINDINGS),
      suspiciousZones: refactorAuditMergeZones(
        findings.filter(item => ['critical', 'high', 'medium'].includes(item.severity)),
        baseline.text.length
      ),
      recommendations: [
        'Treat critical findings as source-authority/integrity failures; do not mutate until resolved.',
        'High/medium historical findings are review targets, not automatic regressions.',
        'Prefer reviewing suspiciousZones and revisions that remain directly active before broad runtime testing.',
        'Do not auto-repair from this report; repairs must be driven by factual source evidence.',
      ],
    };

    if (options.persist !== false) {
      replaceRuntimeStateValue(refactorAuditRuntimeKey(session.id), report);
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
    }
    renderPanel();
    if (options.download === true) downloadWorkingRefactorAudit(report);
    log('Working Refactor Audit complete', {
      verdict: report.verdict,
      working: report.working.identity,
      counts: report.counts,
      suspiciousZones: report.suspiciousZones.length,
    });
    return cloneSemanticValue(report);
  }

  function currentWorkingRefactorAudit() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    if (!session?.id) return null;
    return getRuntimeStateValue(refactorAuditRuntimeKey(session.id), null);
  }

  function downloadWorkingRefactorAudit(reportInput = null) {
    const report = reportInput || currentWorkingRefactorAudit();
    if (!report) throw new Error('REFACTOR_AUDIT: no report is available');
    if (typeof Blob !== 'function' || !globalThis.URL?.createObjectURL) return cloneSemanticValue(report);
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');
    anchor.href = url;
    anchor.download = `vibe-go-working-audit-r${Number(report?.working?.sequence || 0)}-${Date.now()}.json`;
    anchor.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(anchor);
    anchor.click();
    anchor.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    return cloneSemanticValue(report);
  }

  async function maybeAutoRunWorkingRefactorAudit() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.peek();
    if (!session?.id) return null;
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline || sourceRuntime.workspace.sessionId !== session.id) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
    }
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline) return null;
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const identity = sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null;
    const previous = currentWorkingRefactorAudit();
    if (previous?.working?.identity && previous.working.identity === identity) return previous;
    return runWorkingRefactorAudit({ persist: true, download: false, reason: 'bootstrap-head-change' });
  }


  // a41: non-mutating recovery/full-refeed classifier acceptance.
  // Exercises the production buildSemanticDispatch() decision against cloned
  // SemanticSession variants only. No session/workspace/Working mutation occurs.
  function recoveryEnvelopeAcceptanceV641() {
    const liveSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!liveSession) throw new Error('V641_RECOVERY_ACCEPTANCE_NO_SESSION');

    const authoritySnapshot = () => ({
      sessionRevision: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.revision ?? -1),
      workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision ?? -1),
      workingIdentity:
        SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision ||
        sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      pendingDispatchId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? -1),
    });

    const before = authoritySnapshot();

    const buildCase = (name, mutate, expectedFull) => {
      const session = cloneSemanticValue(liveSession);
      session.transport = cloneSemanticValue(session.transport || {});
      mutate(session);
      const built = buildSemanticDispatch(session);
      const metrics = built.transportMetrics || {};
      const full = metrics.fullProtocolRefeed === true;
      const envelope = String(metrics.dispatchEnvelopeV630 || '');
      const hasFullSemantics = String(built.text || '').includes('MODEL-OPERATING SEMANTICS · MANIFEST AUTHORITY');
      const hasThinSemantics = String(built.text || '').includes('VIBE · NORMAL CONTINUATION · LOCAL AUTHORITY');
      const expectedEnvelope = expectedFull ? 'bootstrap-recovery/full' : 'normal/thin-relevance-v1';
      const ok =
        full === expectedFull &&
        envelope === expectedEnvelope &&
        metrics.relevanceProjectionV630 === !expectedFull &&
        (expectedFull ? hasFullSemantics && !hasThinSemantics : hasThinSemantics && !hasFullSemantics);
      return {
        name,
        ok,
        expectedFull,
        fullProtocolRefeed: full,
        envelope,
        relevanceProjection: metrics.relevanceProjectionV630,
        cursorHistoryMode: metrics.cursorHistoryMode || null,
        ledgerMode: metrics.ledgerMode || null,
        chars: Number(built.size?.chars || 0),
        hasFullSemantics,
        hasThinSemantics,
      };
    };

    const cases = [
      buildCase('normal-current-authority', session => {
        session.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
        if (session.transport.reanchorBoundary) {
          session.transport.reanchorBoundary.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
        }
      }, false),
      buildCase('manual-operator-reanchor', session => {
        session.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
        session.transport.reanchorBoundary = {
          schema: 'vibe-go-semantic-transport-reanchor/v1',
          id: 'v641-manual-reanchor',
          revision: Number(session.revision),
          reason: 'v641 manual operator resume classifier acceptance',
          forceFullProtocolRefeed: false,
        };
      }, false),
      buildCase('recovery-reanchor', session => {
        session.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
        session.transport.reanchorBoundary = {
          schema: 'vibe-go-semantic-transport-reanchor/v1',
          id: 'v641-recovery-reanchor',
          revision: Number(session.revision),
          reason: 'v641 recovery classifier acceptance',
          forceFullProtocolRefeed: true,
        };
      }, true),
      buildCase('explicit-transport-force', session => {
        session.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = true;
        if (session.transport.reanchorBoundary) {
          session.transport.reanchorBoundary.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
        }
      }, true),
      buildCase('bootstrap-no-last-control', session => {
        session.transport.lastControl = null;
        session.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
        session.transport.reanchorBoundary = null;
      }, true),
    ];

    const after = authoritySnapshot();
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(after);
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-recovery-envelope-acceptance/v1',
      ok: authorityNonMutating && cases.every(item => item.ok),
      authorityNonMutating,
      cases,
      before,
      after,
    };
  }

  // a44 + forensic repair: semantic-revision churn audit.
  // Runs applySemanticState() against cloned sessions and proves that tactical/control
  // continuity does not advance semantic authority while actual admitted meaning does.
  function semanticMeaningProjectionV644(sessionInput) {
    const value = cloneSemanticValue(sessionInput || {});
    const distances = Object.values(value.distances || {})
      .map(item => ({
        id: item?.id || null,
        parentId: item?.parentId || null,
