        objective: item?.objective || '',
        closureContract: item?.closureContract || '',
        reason: item?.reason || '',
        sourceTarget: cloneSemanticValue(item?.sourceTarget || null),
        status: item?.status || null,
        summary: item?.summary || '',
        suspendedAt: item?.suspendedAt || null,
        sealedAt: item?.sealedAt || null,
        readyAt: item?.readyAt || null,
        resumableAt: item?.resumableAt || null,
        resumedAt: item?.resumedAt || null,
        resumePriority: item?.resumePriority || null,
        dependencyBlocking: Boolean(item?.dependencyBlocking),
        waitingOn: cloneSemanticValue(item?.waitingOn || null),
        schedulerReturn: cloneSemanticValue(item?.schedulerReturn || null),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)));
    const notes = (Array.isArray(value.notes) ? value.notes : [])
      .map(item => ({
        kind: item?.kind || null,
        text: item?.text || item?.summary || '',
        status: item?.status || null,
        distanceId: item?.distanceId || null,
      }));
    const decisions = (Array.isArray(value.decisions) ? value.decisions : [])
      .map(item => ({
        text: item?.text || item?.summary || '',
        status: item?.status || null,
        distanceId: item?.distanceId || null,
      }));
    return {
      status: value.status || null,
      mission: {
        direction: value.mission?.direction || '',
        reminder: value.mission?.reminder || '',
        contract: cloneSemanticValue(value.mission?.contract || null),
      },
      route: {
        // activity/nextFocus/tacticalFocus are control continuity only. They are
        // intentionally excluded from semantic meaning/revision authority.
        activeDistanceId: value.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
        deepeningStack: cloneSemanticValue(value.route?.deepeningStack || []),
        returnPoint: cloneSemanticValue(value.route?.returnPoint || null),
        scheduler: cloneSemanticValue(value.route?.scheduler || null),
      },
      strategicFrontier: cloneSemanticValue(value.strategicFrontier || null),
      distances,
      notes,
      decisions,
      hold: cloneSemanticValue(value.hold || null),
      completedAt: value.completedAt || null,
      // Source cursor/workspace state is durable control/navigation authority in the
      // Source Workspace domain, not SemanticSession meaning. Working source changes
      // are accounted separately as declared source mutations.
    };
  }

  function semanticRevisionChurnAuditV644() {
    const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!live) throw new Error('V644_SEMANTIC_REVISION_AUDIT_NO_SESSION');

    const authoritySnapshot = () => ({
      revision: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.revision ?? -1),
      workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision ?? -1),
      workingIdentity:
        SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision ||
        sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      pendingDispatchId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      worklogLength: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.worklog?.length || 0),
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? -1),
    });

    const beforeAuthority = authoritySnapshot();
    const baselineMeaning = semanticMeaningProjectionV644(live);

    const runCase = (name, payloadPatch, expectedMeaningChanged) => {
      const seed = cloneSemanticValue(live);
      const payload = {
        sessionId: seed.id,
        baseRevision: Number(seed.revision),
        action: 'CONTINUE',
        ...cloneSemanticValue(payloadPatch || {}),
      };
      const beforeMeaning = semanticMeaningProjectionV644(seed);
      const beforeRevision = Number(seed.revision || 0);
      const beforeWorklog = Number(seed.worklog?.length || 0);
      const next = applySemanticState(seed, payload, {
        protocol: 'v644-semantic-revision-audit',
      });
      const afterMeaning = semanticMeaningProjectionV644(next);
      const meaningChanged = JSON.stringify(beforeMeaning) !== JSON.stringify(afterMeaning);
      const revisionDelta = Number(next.revision || 0) - beforeRevision;
      const worklogDelta = Number(next.worklog?.length || 0) - beforeWorklog;
      return {
        name,
        ok:
          meaningChanged === expectedMeaningChanged &&
          revisionDelta === (expectedMeaningChanged ? 1 : 0) &&
          worklogDelta === (expectedMeaningChanged ? 1 : 0),
        expectedMeaningChanged,
        meaningChanged,
        revisionDelta,
        worklogDelta,
        action: payload.action,
        activityBefore: seed.route?.activity || null,
        activityAfter: next.route?.activity || null,
        nextFocusBefore: seed.route?.nextFocus || '',
        nextFocusAfter: next.route?.nextFocus || '',
      };
    };

    const currentActivity = String(live.route?.activity || 'RECON');
    const currentFocus = String(live.route?.nextFocus || '');
    const active = semanticActiveDistance(live);

    const cases = [
      runCase('empty-continue', {}, false),
      runCase('idempotent-current-values', {
        activity: currentActivity,
        nextFocus: currentFocus,
      }, false),
      runCase('control-next-focus', {
        nextFocus: `${currentFocus || 'current focus'} · v644-audit-change`,
      }, false),
      runCase('meaningful-note', {
        action: 'NOTE_ADDED',
        notes: ['v644 semantic revision audit note'],
      }, true),
      runCase('meaningful-decision', {
        decisions: ['v644 semantic revision audit decision'],
      }, true),
      ...(active ? [runCase('meaningful-distance-objective', {
        action: 'REDIRECT',
        activeDistance: {
          id: active.id,
          objective: `${active.objective || ''} · v644-audit-change`,
        },
      }, true)] : []),
    ];

    const artificialCases = cases.filter(item => item.expectedMeaningChanged === false);
    const meaningfulCases = cases.filter(item => item.expectedMeaningChanged === true);
    const artificialChurnPrevented =
      artificialCases.length > 0 &&
      artificialCases.every(item => item.meaningChanged === false && item.revisionDelta === 0 && item.worklogDelta === 0);
    const meaningfulTransitionsRevisioned =
      meaningfulCases.length > 0 &&
      meaningfulCases.every(item => item.meaningChanged === true && item.revisionDelta === 1 && item.worklogDelta === 1);

    const afterAuthority = authoritySnapshot();
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(beforeAuthority) === JSON.stringify(afterAuthority);
    const liveMeaningUnchanged =
      JSON.stringify(baselineMeaning) === JSON.stringify(semanticMeaningProjectionV644(SemanticSessionStore.load()));

    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-semantic-revision-churn-audit/v1',
      ok:
        authorityNonMutating &&
        liveMeaningUnchanged &&
        cases.every(item => item.ok) &&
        artificialChurnPrevented &&
        meaningfulTransitionsRevisioned,
      authorityNonMutating,
      liveMeaningUnchanged,
      artificialChurnPrevented,
      meaningfulTransitionsRevisioned,
      separationNeeded: !artificialChurnPrevented,
      finding: artificialChurnPrevented
        ? 'Control-only activity/focus/no-op turns do not advance semantic revision or append semantic worklog.'
        : 'Artificial semantic revision churn remains in at least one audited control-only case.',
      cases,
      before: beforeAuthority,
      after: afterAuthority,
    };
  }

  function workingRefactorAuditSelfTest() {
    const safe = {
      removedSpanIds: ['a'],
      sourceOps: [{ op: 'RESTORE_CHANGE_SPAN', target: { spanId: 'a' } }],
    };
    const unsafe = {
      removedSpanIds: ['a'],
      sourceOps: [{ op: 'RESTORE_BASELINE_RANGE', target: { start: 10, end: 20 } }],
    };
    const owned = {
      removedSpanIds: ['a', 'b'],
      sourceOps: [{ op: 'RESTORE_BASELINE_RANGE', target: { start: 10, end: 30 }, expectedSpanIds: ['b', 'a'] }],
    };
    const r1 = { id: 'r1', sequence: 1, beforeActiveSpanIds: [], afterActiveSpanIds: ['a'] };
    const r2 = { id: 'r2', sequence: 2, beforeActiveSpanIds: ['a'], afterActiveSpanIds: [] };
    const inverses = refactorAuditFindInverseRevisions([r1, r2]);
    return {
      ok:
        refactorAuditOwnershipProof(safe).proved === true &&
        refactorAuditOwnershipProof(unsafe).proved === false &&
        refactorAuditOwnershipProof(owned).proved === true &&
        inverses.get('r1')?.id === 'r2',
      safe: refactorAuditOwnershipProof(safe),
      unsafe: refactorAuditOwnershipProof(unsafe),
      owned: refactorAuditOwnershipProof(owned),
      inverse: inverses.get('r1')?.id || null,
    };
  }


  // a47: causal-marker shape hotfix — acceptance reads base revision from the actual serialized VG_RESULT marker.
  // buildSemanticDispatch intentionally does not expose a top-level baseRevision property.
  // a46: scope hotfix — keep the a45 acceptance helper in the VibeGoRunner lexical scope.
  // a45: acceptance for semantic-revision / transport-sequence separation.
  // All cases run on clones. The live SemanticSession, Working/source workspace,
  // cursor and pending dispatch remain untouched.
  function semanticRevisionTransportSequenceAcceptanceV645() {
    const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!live) throw new Error('V645_SEMANTIC_REVISION_ACCEPTANCE_NO_SESSION');

    const snapshot = () => {
      const current = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      return {
        revision: Number(current?.revision ?? -1),
        acceptanceSequence: current ? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(current) : null,
        workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision ?? -1),
        workingIdentity: current?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
        pendingDispatchId: current?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        worklogLength: Number(current?.worklog?.length || 0),
        activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(current?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
        nextOffset: Number(current?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? -1),
      };
    };

    const before = snapshot();
    const seedSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(live);

    const runCase = (name, payloadPatch, expectedRevisionDelta, expectedWorklogDelta) => {
      const seed = cloneSemanticValue(live);
      seed.transport ||= {};
      delete seed.transport.pendingDispatch;
      const beforeRevision = Number(seed.revision || 0);
      const beforeSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(seed);
      const beforeWorklog = Number(seed.worklog?.length || 0);
      const payload = {
        sessionId: seed.id,
        baseRevision: beforeRevision,
        action: 'CONTINUE',
        ...cloneSemanticValue(payloadPatch || {}),
      };
      const next = applySemanticState(seed, payload, {
        id: `v645-${name}:${semanticId('control')}`,
        protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
        markerHash: hashText(name),
        machineChars: 1,
      });
      const revisionDelta = Number(next.revision || 0) - beforeRevision;
      const sequenceDelta = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(next) - beforeSequence;
      const worklogDelta = Number(next.worklog?.length || 0) - beforeWorklog;
      return {
        name,
        ok: revisionDelta === expectedRevisionDelta && sequenceDelta === 1 && worklogDelta === expectedWorklogDelta,
        revisionDelta,
        sequenceDelta,
        worklogDelta,
        semanticChanged: next.transport?.lastControl?.semanticChanged === true,
        resultingRevision: Number(next.revision || 0),
        resultingAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(next),
      };
    };

    const cases = [
      runCase('empty-continue', {}, 0, 0),
      runCase('idempotent-current-values', {
        activity: live.route?.activity,
        nextFocus: live.route?.nextFocus,
      }, 0, 0),
      runCase('control-next-focus', {
        nextFocus: `${String(live.route?.nextFocus || '').trim()} · v645-control-change`,
      }, 0, 0),
      runCase('meaningful-note', {
        action: 'NOTE_ADDED',
        notes: [{ text: 'v645 acceptance note' }],
      }, 1, 1),
      runCase('meaningful-decision', {
        decisions: [{ text: 'v645 acceptance decision', reason: 'semantic revision acceptance' }],
      }, 1, 1),
      runCase('declared-working-effect', {
        // This operation is never executed here; applySemanticState only proves
        // that a declared transactional Working mutation reserves one semantic
        // revision so downstream staging/receipt logic keeps base+1 semantics.
        workingOps: [{ op: 'REPLACE_EXACT', expectedText: 'v645-a', replacementText: 'v645-b' }],
      }, 1, 1),
    ];

    // Two accepted no-op turns may legitimately share one semantic revision, but
    // they must have distinct acceptance sequence/control ids/dispatch ids.
    const chain0 = cloneSemanticValue(live);
    chain0.transport ||= {};
    chain0.transport.acceptanceSequence = seedSequence;
    delete chain0.transport.pendingDispatch;
    const chain1 = applySemanticState(chain0, {
      sessionId: chain0.id,
      baseRevision: chain0.revision,
      action: 'CONTINUE',
    }, {
      id: `v645-chain-control-1:${semanticId('control')}`,
      protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
      markerHash: 'v645-chain-1',
    });
    const dispatch1 = buildSemanticDispatch(chain1);
    const chain2 = applySemanticState(chain1, {
      sessionId: chain1.id,
      baseRevision: chain1.revision,
      action: 'CONTINUE',
    }, {
      id: `v645-chain-control-2:${semanticId('control')}`,
      protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
      markerHash: 'v645-chain-2',
    });
    const dispatch2 = buildSemanticDispatch(chain2);
    const serializedBaseRevisionV647 = built => {
      const match = String(built?.text || '').match(/\[\[VG_RESULT\s+d=[^\s\]]+\s+r=(\d+)\]\]/);
      return match ? Number(match[1]) : NaN;
    };
    const baseRevision1V647 = serializedBaseRevisionV647(dispatch1);
    const baseRevision2V647 = serializedBaseRevisionV647(dispatch2);
    const causalSameRevision = {
      ok:
        Number(chain1.revision) === Number(chain0.revision) &&
        Number(chain2.revision) === Number(chain0.revision) &&
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain1) === seedSequence + 1 &&
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain2) === seedSequence + 2 &&
        dispatch1.id !== dispatch2.id &&
        Number.isFinite(baseRevision1V647) &&
        Number.isFinite(baseRevision2V647) &&
        baseRevision1V647 === Number(chain1.revision) &&
        baseRevision2V647 === Number(chain2.revision) &&
        baseRevision1V647 === baseRevision2V647,
      semanticRevision: Number(chain2.revision),
      acceptanceSequence1: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain1),
      acceptanceSequence2: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain2),
      dispatchId1: dispatch1.id,
      dispatchId2: dispatch2.id,
      baseRevision1: baseRevision1V647,
      baseRevision2: baseRevision2V647,
      baseRevisionSource: 'serialized VG_RESULT marker',
    };

    // Fresh evidence is scoped to the acceptance that produced it, not merely to
    // semantic revision. A same-r later no-op acceptance must suppress the old batch.
    const evidenceSession = cloneSemanticValue(chain1);
    evidenceSession.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-local-evidence-batch/v1',
      revision: Number(evidenceSession.revision),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(evidenceSession),
      recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requested: 1,
      succeeded: 1,
      failed: 0,
      queryCount: 1,
      surfacedCount: 0,
      results: [{ op: 'QUERY', ok: true, resultId: 'v645-query', candidateCount: 1 }],
    };
    const evidenceCurrent = Boolean(sourceIntelligenceBatchForDispatch(evidenceSession));
    const evidenceNext = applySemanticState(evidenceSession, {
      sessionId: evidenceSession.id,
      baseRevision: evidenceSession.revision,
      action: 'CONTINUE',
    }, {
      id: `v645-evidence-next:${semanticId('control')}`,
      protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
      markerHash: 'v645-evidence-next',
    });
    const evidenceStaleAfterSameRevisionTurn = Boolean(sourceIntelligenceBatchForDispatch(evidenceNext));
    const evidenceSequenceScope = {
      ok: evidenceCurrent === true && evidenceStaleAfterSameRevisionTurn === false,
      currentAccepted: evidenceCurrent,
      staleAfterSameRevisionTurn: evidenceStaleAfterSameRevisionTurn,
      revisionBefore: Number(evidenceSession.revision),
      revisionAfter: Number(evidenceNext.revision),
      sequenceBefore: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(evidenceSession),
      sequenceAfter: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(evidenceNext),
    };

    const after = snapshot();
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(after);
    const ok = authorityNonMutating && cases.every(item => item.ok) && causalSameRevision.ok && evidenceSequenceScope.ok;
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-semantic-revision-transport-sequence-acceptance/v1',
      ok,
      authorityNonMutating,
      cases,
      causalSameRevision,
      evidenceSequenceScope,
      before,
      after,
      contract: {
        semanticRevision: 'meaningful durable semantic/source commit only',
        transportAcceptanceSequence: 'every accepted model control',
        causalIdentity: 'dispatchId + baseRevision + current durable pending/control boundary',
      },
    };
  }


  // a48: Stage E bundled acceptance. This intentionally exercises the complete
  // semantic-revision / transport-sequence contract on clones so one live run can
  // close a coherent architecture block instead of one checkbox at a time.
  function semanticStageEBundleAcceptanceV648() {
    const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!live) throw new Error('V648_STAGE_E_ACCEPTANCE_NO_SESSION');

    const markerBaseRevision = built => {
      const match = String(built?.text || '').match(/\[\[VG_RESULT\s+d=[^\s\]]+\s+r=(\d+)\]\]/);
      return match ? Number(match[1]) : NaN;
    };
    const liveSnapshot = () => {
      const current = SemanticSessionStore.load();
      return {
        revision: Number(current?.revision ?? -1),
        acceptanceSequence: current ? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(current) : null,
        workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision ?? -1),
        workingIdentity: current?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
        pendingDispatchId: current?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
        pendingStatus: current?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.status || null,
        worklogLength: Number(current?.worklog?.length || 0),
        activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(current?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
        nextOffset: Number(current?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? -1),
      };
    };
    const normalizedClone = input => {
      const s = cloneSemanticValue(input);
      s.transport ||= {};
      s.transport.acceptanceSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(s);
      delete s.transport.pendingDispatch;
      s.transport.reanchorBoundary = null;
      s.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
      return s;
    };
    const acceptThroughExactPending = (sessionInput, payloadPatch = {}, label = 'turn') => {
      const seed = normalizedClone(sessionInput);
      const beforeRevision = Number(seed.revision || 0);
      const beforeSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(seed);
      const built = buildSemanticDispatch(seed);
      const baseRevision = markerBaseRevision(built);
      seed.transport.pendingDispatch = {
        ...cloneSemanticValue(built),
        baseRevision: beforeRevision,
        status: 'submitted',
        createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
      const payload = {
        sessionId: seed.id,
        dispatchId: built.id,
        baseRevision: beforeRevision,
        action: 'CONTINUE',
        ...cloneSemanticValue(payloadPatch || {}),
      };
      const next = applySemanticState(seed, payload, {
        id: `v648-${label}:${semanticId('control')}`,
        protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
        markerHash: hashText(`v648-${label}`),
        machineChars: 1,
        automatic: true,
      });
      return {
        before: seed,
        next,
        built,
        baseRevision,
        beforeRevision,
        afterRevision: Number(next.revision || 0),
        beforeSequence,
        afterSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(next),
      };
    };

    const before = liveSnapshot();
    const core = semanticRevisionTransportSequenceAcceptanceV645();

    // Persistence round-trip with all Stage E authority axes populated.
    const persistenceSeed = normalizedClone(live);
    const persistenceBuilt = buildSemanticDispatch(persistenceSeed);
    persistenceSeed.transport.pendingDispatch = {
      ...cloneSemanticValue(persistenceBuilt),
      baseRevision: Number(persistenceSeed.revision || 0),
      status: 'submitted',
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    persistenceSeed.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-local-evidence-batch/v1',
      revision: Number(persistenceSeed.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(persistenceSeed),
      recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requested: 1,
      succeeded: 1,
      failed: 0,
      queryCount: 1,
      surfacedCount: 0,
      results: [{ op: 'QUERY', ok: true, resultId: 'v648-persist-query', candidateCount: 1 }],
    };
    const persistenceRecords = semanticSessionToPersistenceRecords(persistenceSeed);
    const persistenceRestored = reconstructSemanticSessionFromRecords(persistenceRecords, persistenceSeed.id);
    const persistenceRoundTrip = {
      ok: Boolean(
        persistenceRestored &&
        Number(persistenceRestored.revision) === Number(persistenceSeed.revision) &&
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(persistenceRestored) === semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(persistenceSeed) &&
        Number(persistenceRestored.transport?.acceptanceSequence) === semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(persistenceSeed) &&
        String(persistenceRestored.transport?.lastControl?.id || '') === String(persistenceSeed.transport?.lastControl?.id || '') &&
        String(persistenceRestored.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || '') === String(persistenceSeed.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || '') &&
        Number(persistenceRestored.transport?.pendingDispatch?.baseRevision) === Number(persistenceSeed.transport?.pendingDispatch?.baseRevision) &&
        Number(persistenceRestored.transport?.lastSourceIntelligenceOps?.acceptanceSequence) === Number(persistenceSeed.transport?.lastSourceIntelligenceOps?.acceptanceSequence) &&
        JSON.stringify(persistenceRestored.sourceCursor) === JSON.stringify(persistenceSeed.sourceCursor) &&
        Number(persistenceRestored.worklog?.length || 0) === Number(persistenceSeed.worklog?.length || 0)
      ),
      revision: Number(persistenceRestored?.revision ?? -1),
      acceptanceSequence: persistenceRestored ? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(persistenceRestored) : null,
      explicitSequencePersisted: Number(persistenceRecords.semanticTransport?.[0]?.value?.acceptanceSequence) === semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(persistenceSeed),
      pendingDispatchId: persistenceRestored?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      pendingBaseRevision: persistenceRestored?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.baseRevision ?? null,
      evidenceAcceptanceSequence: persistenceRestored?.transport?.lastSourceIntelligenceOps?.acceptanceSequence ?? null,
    };

    // Pre-a45 persistence must migrate deterministically from semantic revision.
    const legacySeed = normalizedClone(live);
    delete legacySeed.transport.acceptanceSequence;
    if (legacySeed.transport.lastControl) delete legacySeed.transport.lastControl.acceptanceSequence;
    const legacyRecords = semanticSessionToPersistenceRecords(legacySeed);
    const legacyRestored = reconstructSemanticSessionFromRecords(legacyRecords, legacySeed.id);
    const legacyBaseSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(legacyRestored);
    const legacyAccepted = applySemanticState(legacyRestored, {
      sessionId: legacyRestored.id,
      baseRevision: legacyRestored.revision,
      action: 'CONTINUE',
    }, {
      id: `v648-legacy:${semanticId('control')}`,
      protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
      markerHash: 'v648-legacy',
    });
    const legacyDefaulting = {
      ok:
        Number(legacyRestored.transport?.acceptanceSequence) === Number(legacyRestored.revision) &&
        legacyBaseSequence === Number(legacyRestored.revision) &&
        Number(legacyAccepted.revision) === Number(legacyRestored.revision) &&
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(legacyAccepted) === legacyBaseSequence + 1,
      restoredRevision: Number(legacyRestored.revision),
      restoredAcceptanceSequence: Number(legacyRestored.transport?.acceptanceSequence),
      acceptedRevision: Number(legacyAccepted.revision),
      acceptedAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(legacyAccepted),
    };

    // Exact pending authority on a same-r no-op: current pending is accepted once,
    // a newer same-r dispatch is distinct, and the stale earlier result fails closed.
    const pending0 = normalizedClone(live);
    const first = acceptThroughExactPending(pending0, {}, 'pending-first');
    const secondBuilt = buildSemanticDispatch(first.next);
    let staleLateRejected = false;
    let staleLateError = null;
    try {
      applySemanticState(first.next, {
        sessionId: first.next.id,
        dispatchId: first.built.id,
        baseRevision: first.beforeRevision,
        action: 'CONTINUE',
      }, {
        id: `v648-stale-late:${semanticId('control')}`,
        protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
        markerHash: 'v648-stale-late',
        automatic: true,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      staleLateRejected = true;
      staleLateError = String(error?.message || error);
    }
    const secondSeed = normalizedClone(first.next);
    secondSeed.transport.pendingDispatch = {
      ...cloneSemanticValue(secondBuilt),
      baseRevision: Number(first.next.revision),
      status: 'submitted',
      createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    const secondAccepted = applySemanticState(secondSeed, {
      sessionId: secondSeed.id,
      dispatchId: secondBuilt.id,
      baseRevision: secondSeed.revision,
      action: 'CONTINUE',
    }, {
      id: `v648-pending-second:${semanticId('control')}`,
      protocol: 'thin-result/v1',
      markerHash: 'v648-pending-second',
      automatic: true,
    });
    const pendingCausalAuthority = {
      ok: Boolean(
        first.afterRevision === first.beforeRevision &&
        first.afterSequence === first.beforeSequence + 1 &&
        first.next.transport?.pendingDispatch == null &&
        first.built.id !== secondBuilt.id &&
        first.baseRevision === first.beforeRevision &&
        markerBaseRevision(secondBuilt) === Number(first.next.revision) &&
        staleLateRejected &&
        Number(secondAccepted.revision) === Number(first.next.revision) &&
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(secondAccepted) === semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(first.next) + 1 &&
        secondAccepted.transport?.pendingDispatch == null
      ),
      semanticRevision: Number(secondAccepted.revision),
      firstAcceptanceSequence: first.afterSequence,
      secondAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(secondAccepted),
      dispatchId1: first.built.id,
      dispatchId2: secondBuilt.id,
      baseRevision1: first.baseRevision,
      baseRevision2: markerBaseRevision(secondBuilt),
      staleLateRejected,
      staleLateError,
    };

    // Five consecutive model controls: no-op, idempotent no-op, meaningful note,
    // no-op, control-only nextFocus. This proves control continuity can advance independently.
    let chain = normalizedClone(live);
    const chainBaseRevision = Number(chain.revision || 0);
    const chainBaseSequence = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain);
    const chainRows = [];
    const runMixed = (name, patch) => {
      const accepted = acceptThroughExactPending(chain, patch, `mixed-${name}`);
      chainRows.push({
        name,
        dispatchId: accepted.built.id,
        baseRevision: accepted.baseRevision,
        revisionBefore: accepted.beforeRevision,
        revisionAfter: accepted.afterRevision,
        sequenceBefore: accepted.beforeSequence,
        sequenceAfter: accepted.afterSequence,
        revisionDelta: accepted.afterRevision - accepted.beforeRevision,
        sequenceDelta: accepted.afterSequence - accepted.beforeSequence,
        semanticChanged: accepted.next.transport?.lastControl?.semanticChanged === true,
      });
      chain = accepted.next;
      return accepted;
    };
    runMixed('noop-1', {});
    runMixed('noop-2', { activity: chain.route?.activity, nextFocus: chain.route?.nextFocus });

    // Fresh evidence attached to the second no-op boundary should be visible in
    // exactly the next dispatch, then stale once that control is accepted.
    chain.transport.lastSourceIntelligenceOps = {
      schema: 'vibe-go-local-evidence-batch/v1',
      revision: Number(chain.revision),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain),
      recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requested: 1,
      succeeded: 1,
      failed: 0,
      queryCount: 1,
      surfacedCount: 0,
      results: [{ op: 'QUERY', ok: true, resultId: 'v648-one-shot-query', candidateCount: 1 }],
    };
    const evidenceDispatch = buildSemanticDispatch(chain);
    const evidenceFreshBeforeAcceptance = Boolean(evidenceDispatch.transportMetrics?.localEvidenceBatch);
    const noteTurn = runMixed('meaningful-note', {
      action: 'NOTE_ADDED',
      notes: [{ text: 'v648 mixed-chain semantic note' }],
      summary: 'v648 mixed-chain note commit',
    });
    const dispatchAfterMeaningful = buildSemanticDispatch(chain);
    const evidenceStaleAfterAcceptance = !Boolean(dispatchAfterMeaningful.transportMetrics?.localEvidenceBatch);
    const ledgerVisibleAfterMeaningful = Number(dispatchAfterMeaningful.transportMetrics?.ledgerItems?.worklog || 0) >= 1;
    runMixed('noop-after-note', {});
    const dispatchAfterNoop = buildSemanticDispatch(chain);
    const ledgerSuppressedAfterSameRNoop = Number(dispatchAfterNoop.transportMetrics?.ledgerItems?.worklog || 0) === 0;
    runMixed('control-focus', {
      nextFocus: `${String(chain.route?.nextFocus || '').trim()} · v648-mixed-focus`,
    });

    const expectedRevisionDeltas = [0, 0, 1, 0, 0];
    const uniqueDispatchIds = new Set(chainRows.map(row => row.dispatchId)).size;
    const mixedConsecutiveTurns = {
      ok: Boolean(
        chainRows.length === expectedRevisionDeltas.length &&
        chainRows.every((row, index) => row.revisionDelta === expectedRevisionDeltas[index] && row.sequenceDelta === 1) &&
        uniqueDispatchIds === chainRows.length &&
        Number(chain.revision) === chainBaseRevision + 1 &&
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain) === chainBaseSequence + 5 &&
        evidenceFreshBeforeAcceptance &&
        evidenceStaleAfterAcceptance &&
        ledgerVisibleAfterMeaningful &&
        ledgerSuppressedAfterSameRNoop
      ),
      baseRevision: chainBaseRevision,
      finalRevision: Number(chain.revision),
      baseAcceptanceSequence: chainBaseSequence,
      finalAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain),
      uniqueDispatchIds,
      rows: chainRows,
      evidenceOneShot: {
        freshBeforeAcceptance: evidenceFreshBeforeAcceptance,
        staleAfterAcceptance: evidenceStaleAfterAcceptance,
      },
      ledgerDelta: {
        visibleAfterMeaningful: ledgerVisibleAfterMeaningful,
        suppressedAfterSameRNoop: ledgerSuppressedAfterSameRNoop,
        meaningfulDispatchWorklogItems: Number(dispatchAfterMeaningful.transportMetrics?.ledgerItems?.worklog || 0),
        postNoopDispatchWorklogItems: Number(dispatchAfterNoop.transportMetrics?.ledgerItems?.worklog || 0),
      },
      noteTurnRevision: noteTurn.afterRevision,
    };

    // Persist the resulting mixed chain too; this catches sequence drift after
    // several same-r / r+1 transitions rather than only a single seed object.
    const mixedRecords = semanticSessionToPersistenceRecords(chain);
    const mixedRestored = reconstructSemanticSessionFromRecords(mixedRecords, chain.id);
    const mixedPersistence = {
      ok: Boolean(
        mixedRestored &&
        Number(mixedRestored.revision) === Number(chain.revision) &&
        semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(mixedRestored) === semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(chain) &&
        String(mixedRestored.transport?.lastControl?.id || '') === String(chain.transport?.lastControl?.id || '') &&
        Number(mixedRestored.worklog?.length || 0) === Number(chain.worklog?.length || 0)
      ),
      revision: Number(mixedRestored?.revision ?? -1),
      acceptanceSequence: mixedRestored ? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(mixedRestored) : null,
      worklogLength: Number(mixedRestored?.worklog?.length || 0),
    };

    const after = liveSnapshot();
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(after);
    const sections = {
      coreSeparation: Boolean(core?.ok),
      persistenceRoundTrip: persistenceRoundTrip.ok,
      legacyDefaulting: legacyDefaulting.ok,
      pendingCausalAuthority: pendingCausalAuthority.ok,
      mixedConsecutiveTurns: mixedConsecutiveTurns.ok,
      mixedPersistence: mixedPersistence.ok,
    };
    const ok = authorityNonMutating && Object.values(sections).every(Boolean);
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-stage-e-bundle-acceptance/v1',
      ok,
      authorityNonMutating,
      sections,
      core,
      persistenceRoundTrip,
      legacyDefaulting,
      pendingCausalAuthority,
      mixedConsecutiveTurns,
      mixedPersistence,
      before,
      after,
      contract: {
        semanticRevision: 'meaningful durable semantic/source commit only',
        transportAcceptanceSequence: 'every accepted model control',
        persistence: 'explicit sequence survives round-trip; legacy sessions normalize from semantic head',
        pendingAuthority: 'exact dispatchId + baseRevision; stale late same-r result fails closed',
        freshness: 'ledger and Source Intelligence are acceptance-boundary aware across same-r turns',
      },
    };
  }

  // a49: bundled Stage F protocol-cargo acceptance.
  // Proves that new model-facing output has one authority (VG_RESULT/VG_PATCH),
  // historical VIBE_STATE remains parser-only recovery compatibility, dead cargo
  // is absent from the installed self-source, and persistence normalization strips
  // stale write-only telemetry. Live authority is not mutated.
  function semanticStageFProtocolCargoAcceptanceV649() {
    const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!live) throw new Error('V649_STAGE_F_NO_SESSION');

    const authoritySnapshot = () => ({
      revision: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.revision ?? -1),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
      workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision ?? -1),
      workingIdentity: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || sourceRuntime.workspace?.working?.identity || null,
      pendingDispatchId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.transport?.pendingDispatch?.id || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? -1),
    });
    const before = authoritySnapshot();

    const normalSeed = cloneSemanticValue(live);
    normalSeed.transport ||= {};
    normalSeed.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
    if (normalSeed.transport.reanchorBoundary) normalSeed.transport.reanchorBoundary.forceFullProtocolRefeed = false;
    normalSeed.transport.lastControl ||= {
      id: 'v649-normal-control',
      type: 'assistant',
      revision: Number(normalSeed.revision),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(normalSeed),
      semanticChanged: false,
      acceptedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
    const normalBuilt = buildSemanticDispatch(normalSeed);
    const normalText = String(normalBuilt?.text || '');
    const normalOutputAuthority = {
      ok: normalText.includes('[[VG_RESULT') && !normalText.includes('Full [[VIBE_STATE') && !normalText.includes('в новых ответах его НЕ возвращай'),
      envelope: normalBuilt?.transportMetrics?.dispatchEnvelopeV630 || null,
      hasVgResult: normalText.includes('[[VG_RESULT'),
      hasLegacyOutputInstruction: normalText.includes('Full [[VIBE_STATE'),
    };

    const recoverySeed = cloneSemanticValue(normalSeed);
    recoverySeed.transport.forceFullProtocolRefeed = true;
    const recoveryBuilt = buildSemanticDispatch(recoverySeed);
    const recoveryText = String(recoveryBuilt?.text || '');
    const recoveryOutputAuthority = {
      ok: Boolean(
        recoveryBuilt?.transportMetrics?.fullProtocolRefeed === true &&
        recoveryText.includes('[[VG_RESULT') &&
        recoveryText.includes('в новых ответах его НЕ возвращай') &&
        !recoveryText.includes('Full [[VIBE_STATE ...]] — только backward-compatible recovery/bootstrap fallback.')
      ),
      envelope: recoveryBuilt?.transportMetrics?.dispatchEnvelopeV630 || null,
      hasVgResult: recoveryText.includes('[[VG_RESULT'),
      legacyParserOnlyInstruction: recoveryText.includes('в новых ответах его НЕ возвращай'),
    };

    const thinSynthetic = `[[VG_RESULT d=v649-thin r=${Number(live.revision)}]]\n{"action":"CONTINUE","summary":"v649"}\n[[/VG_RESULT]]`;
    const thinParsed = extractThinSemanticTurnPayloadV627(thinSynthetic);
    const thinParser = {
      ok: Boolean(thinParsed?.payload && !thinParsed?.error && Number(thinParsed.baseRevision) === Number(live.revision)),
      protocol: thinParsed?.protocol || null,
      baseRevision: thinParsed?.baseRevision ?? null,
    };

    // Historical canonical framing is a single opener + terminal `]]`, not an
    // XML-style closing marker. This fixture deliberately matches pre-a27 output.
    const legacySynthetic = `[[VIBE_STATE\n{"schema":"vibe-go-semantic-state/v1","sessionId":"${String(live.id)}","dispatchId":"v650-historical","baseRevision":${Number(live.revision)},"action":"CONTINUE"}\n]]`;
    const legacyPayloads = extractSemanticStatePayloads(legacySynthetic);
    const legacyPayload = legacyPayloads[0]?.payload || null;
    const legacyRecoveryParser = {
      ok: Boolean(
        legacyPayloads.length === 1 &&
        legacyPayload &&
        !legacyPayloads[0]?.error &&
        legacyPayload.schema === 'vibe-go-semantic-state/v1' &&
        legacyPayload.sessionId === String(live.id) &&
        Number(legacyPayload.baseRevision) === Number(live.revision) &&
        legacyPayload.action === 'CONTINUE'
      ),
      payloads: legacyPayloads.length,
      schema: legacyPayload?.schema || null,
      sessionIdMatches: legacyPayload?.sessionId === String(live.id),
      baseRevision: legacyPayload?.baseRevision ?? null,
      action: legacyPayload?.action || null,
      canonicalHistoricalFraming: '[[VIBE_STATE\n{json}\n]]',
      parserRetainedForHistoricalRecovery: true,
    };

    const staleCargoSeed = cloneSemanticValue(live);
    staleCargoSeed.transport ||= {};
    staleCargoSeed.transport.operatorControl = {
      ...(staleCargoSeed.transport.operatorControl || {}),
      supersededDispatch: { id: 'obsolete-v649', status: 'historical-only' },
      inFlightDispatch: staleCargoSeed.transport.operatorControl?.inFlightDispatch || null,
    };
    const normalized = normalizeProtocolCargoV649(staleCargoSeed);
    const staleCargoNormalization = {
      ok: !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(normalized.transport?.operatorControl || {}, 'supersededDispatch'),
      inFlightPreserved: JSON.stringify(normalized.transport?.operatorControl?.inFlightDispatch || null) === JSON.stringify(staleCargoSeed.transport?.operatorControl?.inFlightDispatch || null),
    };

    let selfSource = '';
    let selfSourceError = null;
    try { selfSource = buildInstalledVibeGoSelfSource(); } catch (error) { selfSourceError = error?.message || String(error); }
    const deadHelperNeedleV649 = ['function saveSemantic', 'TransportPatch('].join('');
    const supersededWriterNeedleV649 = ['superseded', 'Dispatch: provenUnsent'].join('');
    const deadCargo = {
      ok: Boolean(
        selfSource &&
        !selfSource.includes(deadHelperNeedleV649) &&
        !selfSource.includes(supersededWriterNeedleV649)
      ),
      selfSourceAvailable: Boolean(selfSource),
      selfSourceError,
      saveSemanticTransportPatchPresent: selfSource.includes(deadHelperNeedleV649),
      supersededDispatchWriterPresent: selfSource.includes(supersededWriterNeedleV649),
    };

    const legacyParserNeedleV649 = ['function extractSemanticState', 'Payloads('].join('');
    const recoveryOwnerNeedleV649 = ['async function recoverSemanticAuthority', 'FromTail('].join('');
    const fullRecoveryNeedleV649 = ['bootstrap-recovery', '/full'].join('');
    const interruptionNeedleV649 = ['USER_INTERRUPTION', '_PROMISE_SCHEMA'].join('');
    const protectedCompatibility = {
      ok: Boolean(
        selfSource.includes(legacyParserNeedleV649) &&
        selfSource.includes(recoveryOwnerNeedleV649) &&
        selfSource.includes(fullRecoveryNeedleV649)
      ),
      legacyParserRetained: selfSource.includes(legacyParserNeedleV649),
      recoveryOwnerRetained: selfSource.includes(recoveryOwnerNeedleV649),
      fullRecoveryEnvelopeRetained: selfSource.includes(fullRecoveryNeedleV649),
      interruptionPromiseRetained: selfSource.includes(interruptionNeedleV649),
    };

    const after = authoritySnapshot();
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(after);
    const sections = {
      normalOutputAuthority: normalOutputAuthority.ok,
      recoveryOutputAuthority: recoveryOutputAuthority.ok,
      thinParser: thinParser.ok,
      legacyRecoveryParser: legacyRecoveryParser.ok,
      staleCargoNormalization: staleCargoNormalization.ok && staleCargoNormalization.inFlightPreserved,
      deadCargo: deadCargo.ok,
      protectedCompatibility: protectedCompatibility.ok,
    };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-stage-f-protocol-cargo-acceptance/v1',
      ok: authorityNonMutating && Object.values(sections).every(Boolean),
      authorityNonMutating,
      sections,
      normalOutputAuthority,
      recoveryOutputAuthority,
      thinParser,
      legacyRecoveryParser,
      staleCargoNormalization,
      deadCargo,
      protectedCompatibility,
      before,
      after,
      inventory: {
        removed: [
          'dead helper saveSemanticTransportPatch',
          'write-only operatorControl.supersededDispatch telemetry',
          'current-model permission to emit full VIBE_STATE during recovery',
          'generic repair/status wording that treated VIBE_STATE as current result authority',
        ],
        retained: [
          'historical VIBE_STATE parser for mounted recovery artifacts',
          'recoverSemanticAuthorityFromTail recovery owner',
          'bootstrap-recovery/full input envelope',
          'operator interruptionPromise subsystem pending its separately deferred acceptance/cutover',
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  // a51: bundled Stage G durability/source-lifecycle acceptance.
  // Uses clones for lifecycle/ledger/mapping stress and a temporary isolated Source
  // Workspace record for physical persistence. The live SemanticSession, live workspace
  // record and Working authority are restored/untouched before return.
  async function semanticStageGDurabilityAcceptanceV651() {
    const live = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!live) throw new Error('V651_STAGE_G_NO_SESSION');
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline || sourceRuntime.workspace.sessionId !== live.id) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(live.id);
    }
    const { workspace: liveWorkspace, baseline } = requireSourceRuntime(live);
    const authoritySnapshot = () => ({
      revision: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.revision ?? -1),
      acceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
      workspaceRevision: Number(sourceRuntime.workspace?.sessionId === live.id ? sourceRuntime.workspace?.revision : liveWorkspace.revision),
      workspaceSessionId: sourceRuntime.workspace?.sessionId || null,
      workingIdentity: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || liveWorkspace.working?.identity || null,
      activeRange: cloneSemanticValue(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.activeRange || null),
      nextOffset: Number(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.nextOffset ?? -1),
      coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.sourceCursor?.coveredRanges || []),
    });
    const before = authoritySnapshot();

    // 1) Surface lifecycle stress: old active evidence is bounded, old ephemeral
    // evidence expires at an acceptance boundary, and evicted rows become compact summaries.
    const stress = cloneSemanticValue(liveWorkspace);
    stress.settings = { ...SOURCE_DEFAULTS, ...(stress.settings || {}) };
    stress.cursor ||= {};
    stress.cursor.surfacedRanges = [];
    stress.cursor.surfaceArchive = [];
    const seq = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(live);
    for (let i = 0; i < 2200; i += 1) {
      const start = (i * 97) % Math.max(1, baseline.text.length - 200);
      stress.cursor.surfacedRanges.push({
        id: `v651-active-${i}`,
        start,
        end: Math.min(baseline.text.length, start + 120),
        space: 'baseline', baselineStart: start, baselineEnd: Math.min(baseline.text.length, start + 120),
        label: `stress active ${i}`,
        reason: 'long-run retained evidence stress',
        distanceId: `distance-${i % 73}`,
        status: 'active', lifecycle: i % 97 === 0 ? 'pinned' : 'retained',
        createdAcceptanceSequence: seq,
        createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - (2200 - i) * 1000).toISOString(),
      });
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 240; i += 1) {
      stress.cursor.surfacedRanges.push({
        id: `v651-resolved-${i}`,
        start: i * 3, end: i * 3 + 2, space: 'baseline',
        label: `resolved ${i}`, reason: 'resolved stress', distanceId: `resolved-distance-${i % 81}`,
        status: 'resolved', lifecycle: 'retained', createdAcceptanceSequence: seq - 3,
        createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - (5000 + i) * 1000).toISOString(), resolvedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i += 1) {
      stress.cursor.surfacedRanges.push({
        id: `v651-ephemeral-${i}`,
        start: 50000 + i * 4, end: 50002 + i * 4, space: 'baseline',
        label: `ephemeral ${i}`, reason: 'turn-local stress', distanceId: 'ephemeral-distance',
        status: 'active', lifecycle: 'ephemeral', createdAcceptanceSequence: i < 60 ? seq - 1 : seq,
        createdAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      });
    }
    // One exact duplicate should collapse without consuming a retained slot.
    stress.cursor.surfacedRanges.push({ ...cloneSemanticValue(stress.cursor.surfacedRanges[100]), id: 'v651-duplicate-id' });
    const surfaceGc = compactSourceSurfaceLedgerV651(stress, live);
    const activeAfter = stress.cursor.surfacedRanges.filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved');
    const resolvedAfter = stress.cursor.surfacedRanges.filter(item => item.status === 'resolved');
    const archivedTotal = (stress.cursor.surfaceArchive || []).reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item?.count || 0), 0);
    const currentEphemeral = activeAfter.filter(item => item.lifecycle === 'ephemeral' && Number(item.createdAcceptanceSequence) === seq);
    const staleEphemeral = activeAfter.filter(item => item.lifecycle === 'ephemeral' && Number(item.createdAcceptanceSequence) < seq);
    const surfaceLifecycle = {
      ok: Boolean(
        surfaceGc.changed &&
        activeAfter.length <= Number(stress.settings.surfacedActiveRetention) &&
        resolvedAfter.length <= Number(stress.settings.surfacedResolvedRetention) &&
        (stress.cursor.surfaceArchive || []).length <= Number(stress.settings.surfacedArchiveBucketLimit) &&
        archivedTotal > 1500 &&
        currentEphemeral.length > 0 && staleEphemeral.length === 0
      ),
      before: 2200 + 240 + 80 + 1,
      after: stress.cursor.surfacedRanges.length,
      activeAfter: activeAfter.length,
      resolvedAfter: resolvedAfter.length,
      currentEphemeral: currentEphemeral.length,
      staleEphemeral: staleEphemeral.length,
      archiveBuckets: stress.cursor.surfaceArchive.length,
      archivedTotal,
      gc: surfaceGc.stats,
    };

    // 2) Existing semantic ledgers are themselves bounded under stress. Exercise note
    // distributions explicitly because open-note priority has a zero-room boundary.
    const buildLedgerStressV652 = (name, noteRows) => {
      const seed = cloneSemanticValue(live);
      seed.notes = noteRows.map((row, i) => ({
        id: `v652-${name}-note-${i}`,
        kind: 'finding',
        text: `unique ${name} note ${i}`,
        status: row.status,
        revision: i + 1,
        createdAt: new Date(i * 1000).toISOString(),
      }));
      seed.decisions = [];
      seed.worklog = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.decisions + 120; i += 1) seed.decisions.push({
        id: `v652-${name}-decision-${i}`, text: `unique ${name} decision ${i}`, revision: i + 1, createdAt: new Date(i * 1000).toISOString(),
      });
      for (let i = 0; i < SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.worklog + 120; i += 1) seed.worklog.push({
        id: `v652-${name}-work-${i}`, action: 'REDIRECT', activity: 'ANALYSIS', summary: `unique ${name} work ${i}`, revision: i + 1, at: new Date(i * 1000).toISOString(),
      });
      compactSemanticLedger(seed);
      const open = seed.notes.filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved').length;
      const resolved = seed.notes.filter(item => item.status === 'resolved').length;
      return {
        name,
        ok: Boolean(
          seed.notes.length <= SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.notes &&
          seed.decisions.length <= SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.decisions &&
          seed.worklog.length <= SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.worklog
        ),
        notes: seed.notes.length,
        open,
        resolved,
        decisions: seed.decisions.length,
        worklog: seed.worklog.length,
      };
    };
    const noteBudgetV652 = SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS.notes;
    const ledgerCasesV652 = [
      buildLedgerStressV652('mixed-open-overflow', Array.from({ length: noteBudgetV652 + 160 }, (_, i) => ({ status: i % 5 ? 'open' : 'resolved' }))),
      buildLedgerStressV652('resolved-room', [
        ...Array.from({ length: Math.floor(noteBudgetV652 / 2) }, () => ({ status: 'open' })),
        ...Array.from({ length: noteBudgetV652 + 80 }, () => ({ status: 'resolved' })),
      ]),
      buildLedgerStressV652('all-open', Array.from({ length: noteBudgetV652 + 160 }, () => ({ status: 'open' }))),
      buildLedgerStressV652('all-resolved', Array.from({ length: noteBudgetV652 + 160 }, () => ({ status: 'resolved' }))),
    ];
    const mixedLedgerV652 = ledgerCasesV652[0];
    const resolvedRoomV652 = ledgerCasesV652[1];
    const semanticLedgerBounded = {
      ok: Boolean(
        ledgerCasesV652.every(item => item.ok) &&
        mixedLedgerV652.notes === noteBudgetV652 &&
        mixedLedgerV652.open === noteBudgetV652 &&
        mixedLedgerV652.resolved === 0 &&
        resolvedRoomV652.notes === noteBudgetV652 &&
        resolvedRoomV652.open === Math.floor(noteBudgetV652 / 2) &&
        resolvedRoomV652.resolved === noteBudgetV652 - Math.floor(noteBudgetV652 / 2)
      ),
      notes: mixedLedgerV652.notes,
      decisions: mixedLedgerV652.decisions,
      worklog: mixedLedgerV652.worklog,
      limits: cloneSemanticValue(SEMANTIC_LEDGER_LIMITS),
      cases: ledgerCasesV652,
      zeroRoomGuard: mixedLedgerV652.resolved === 0,
      resolvedRoomGuard: resolvedRoomV652.resolved === noteBudgetV652 - Math.floor(noteBudgetV652 / 2),
    };

    // 3) Runtime Source Intelligence cache obeys its byte budget. Snapshot and restore
    // the cache exactly; no persistent query records are created by this stress test.
    const intelligenceBefore = {
      queries: new Map([...intelligenceRuntime.queries.entries()].map(([id, value]) => [id, cloneSemanticValue(value)])),
      queryBytes: intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes,
      lastQueryId: intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId,
    };
    let intelligenceRuntimeBounded;
    try {
      intelligenceRuntime.queries = new Map();
      intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = 0;
      intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = null;
      const budget = intelligenceBudgets(baseline).runtimeBytes;
      for (let i = 0; i < 180; i += 1) {
        const payload = 'x'.repeat(24000 + (i % 5) * 1000);
        intelligenceRememberQuery({
          schema: SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_SCHEMA,
          id: `query:v651-${i}`,
          baselineId: baseline.id,
          workingIdentity: liveWorkspace.working?.identity || 'baseline',
          anchor: `v651-${i}`,
          relations: ['definitions'], status: 'ready', candidates: [],
          createdAt: semanticIsoNow(), lastUsedAt: semanticIsoNow(), payload,
        }, baseline);
      }
      intelligenceRuntimeBounded = {
        ok: Boolean(intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes <= budget && intelligenceRuntime.queries.size < 180),
        cachedQueries: intelligenceRuntime.queries.size,
        cachedBytes: intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes,
        runtimeBudgetBytes: budget,
      };
    } finally {
      intelligenceRuntime.queries = intelligenceBefore.queries;
      intelligenceRuntime.queryBytes = intelligenceBefore.queryBytes;
      intelligenceRuntime.lastQueryId = intelligenceBefore.lastQueryId;
    }

    // 4) Baseline↔Working mapping with one insertion before the current focus,
    // one replacement inside it, and one deletion after it. This exercises the
    // production coordinate functions without touching Working authority.
    const focus = sourceNormalizeRange(liveWorkspace.cursor?.activeRange || { start: 10000, end: 12000 }, baseline.text.length) || { start: 10000, end: 12000 };
    const insertAt = Math.max(16, Math.min(focus.start - 200, Math.floor(focus.start / 2)));
    const replaceStart = Math.max(focus.start + 10, Math.min(focus.end - 40, focus.start + Math.floor((focus.end - focus.start) / 3)));
    const replaceEnd = Math.min(focus.end - 5, replaceStart + 12);
    const deleteStart = Math.min(baseline.text.length - 40, Math.max(focus.end + 200, focus.end + 20));
    const deleteEnd = Math.min(baseline.text.length - 1, deleteStart + 24);
    const spans = new Map([
      ['v651-insert', { schema: WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA, id: 'v651-insert', baselineStart: insertAt, baselineEnd: insertAt, replacementText: 'INSERT-V651' }],
      ['v651-replace', { schema: WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA, id: 'v651-replace', baselineStart: replaceStart, baselineEnd: replaceEnd, replacementText: 'REPLACEMENT-V651-LONGER' }],
      ['v651-delete', { schema: WORKING_SPAN_SCHEMA, id: 'v651-delete', baselineStart: deleteStart, baselineEnd: deleteEnd, replacementText: '' }],
    ]);
    validateWorkingSpanSet(spans, baseline.text.length);
    const projectedFocus = projectBaselineRangeSync(focus.start, focus.end, spans);
    const focusWorkingStartExpected = baselineToWorkingOffset(focus.start, 'before', spans);
    const focusWorkingEndExpected = baselineToWorkingOffset(focus.end, 'after', spans);
    const roundStart = workingBoundaryToBaseline(projectedFocus.workingRange.start, 'before', spans);
    const roundEnd = workingBoundaryToBaseline(projectedFocus.workingRange.end, 'after', spans);
    const afterDeleteBaseline = Math.min(baseline.text.length, deleteEnd + 100);
    const afterDeleteWorking = baselineToWorkingOffset(afterDeleteBaseline, 'before', spans);
    const expectedNetDelta =
      'INSERT-V651'.length +
      ('REPLACEMENT-V651-LONGER'.length - (replaceEnd - replaceStart)) -
      (deleteEnd - deleteStart);
    const coordinateMapping = {
      ok: Boolean(
        projectedFocus.workingRange.start === focusWorkingStartExpected &&
        projectedFocus.workingRange.end === focusWorkingEndExpected &&
        roundStart === focus.start && roundEnd === focus.end &&
        afterDeleteWorking === afterDeleteBaseline + expectedNetDelta
      ),
      focusBaseline: focus,
      focusWorking: projectedFocus.workingRange,
      touchingSpanIds: projectedFocus.touchingSpanIds,
      roundTripBaseline: { start: roundStart, end: roundEnd },
      afterDelete: { baseline: afterDeleteBaseline, working: afterDeleteWorking, expectedNetDelta },
    };

    // 5) Physical sequential persistence in an isolated workspace row. This is not
    // a clone-only test: saveSourceWorkspace() writes the temporary workspace to IDB.
    const originalRuntime = {
      sessionId: sourceRuntime.sessionId,
      workspace: sourceRuntime.workspace,
      baseline: sourceRuntime.baseline,
    };
    const tempSessionId = `v651-temp:${semanticId('workspace')}`;
    let physicalSequential;
    let nonlinearCoverage;
    try {
      const temp = cloneSemanticValue(liveWorkspace);
      temp.sessionId = tempSessionId;
      temp.revision = 0;
      temp.createdAt = semanticIsoNow();
      temp.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
      temp.cursor = {
        nextOffset: 0,
        activeRange: proposeSourceChunk(baseline.text, 0, { ...temp.settings, segmentMap: temp.segmentMap }),
        coveredRanges: [], surfacedRanges: [], surfaceArchive: [],
      };
      await saveSourceWorkspace(temp, { syncSession: false });
      const rows = [];
      let persisted = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', tempSessionId);
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {
        const beforeOffset = Number(persisted.cursor.nextOffset);
        const staged = stageWorkspaceOperations(persisted, [{ op: 'NEXT_CHUNK', label: `v651 sequential ${i + 1}` }], baseline, live);
        await saveSourceWorkspace(staged.workspace, { syncSession: false });
        persisted = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', tempSessionId);
        rows.push({
          step: i + 1,
          beforeOffset,
          afterOffset: Number(persisted.cursor.nextOffset),
          activeStart: persisted.cursor.activeRange ? Number(persisted.cursor.activeRange.start) : null,
          coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(persisted.cursor.coveredRanges),
          workspaceRevision: Number(persisted.revision),
        });
      }
      const monotonic = rows.every((row, index) =>
        row.afterOffset > row.beforeOffset &&
        (index === 0 || row.afterOffset > rows[index - 1].afterOffset) &&
        row.coveredThrough === row.afterOffset
      );
      physicalSequential = {
        ok: Boolean(monotonic && rows.length === 5 && rows.at(-1).workspaceRevision >= 6),
        rows,
        persisted: true,
        finalCoveredRanges: persisted.cursor.coveredRanges.length,
      };

      const beforeJump = {
        nextOffset: Number(persisted.cursor.nextOffset),
        coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(persisted.cursor.coveredRanges),
        coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(persisted.cursor.coveredRanges),
      };
      const jumpStart = Math.min(baseline.text.length - 64, Math.max(beforeJump.nextOffset + 50000, Math.floor(baseline.text.length * 0.7)));
      const jumpEnd = Math.min(baseline.text.length, jumpStart + 512);
      const jump = stageWorkspaceOperations(persisted, [{
        op: 'SURFACE_RANGE', id: 'v651-nonlinear-jump', start: jumpStart, end: jumpEnd,
        label: 'v651 nonlinear evidence', reason: 'must not advance sequential coverage', lifecycle: 'ephemeral',
      }], baseline, live);
      await saveSourceWorkspace(jump.workspace, { syncSession: false });
      const afterJumpRow = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', tempSessionId);
      const afterJump = {
        nextOffset: Number(afterJumpRow.cursor.nextOffset),
        coveredRanges: cloneSemanticValue(afterJumpRow.cursor.coveredRanges),
        coveredThrough: sourceCoveredThrough(afterJumpRow.cursor.coveredRanges),
        surfaced: afterJumpRow.cursor.surfacedRanges.some(item => item.id === 'v651-nonlinear-jump'),
      };
      nonlinearCoverage = {
        ok: Boolean(
          beforeJump.nextOffset === afterJump.nextOffset &&
          beforeJump.coveredThrough === afterJump.coveredThrough &&
          JSON.stringify(beforeJump.coveredRanges) === JSON.stringify(afterJump.coveredRanges) &&
          afterJump.surfaced
        ),
        before: beforeJump,
        after: afterJump,
      };
    } finally {
      await sourceDbDelete('workspaces', tempSessionId).catch(() => undefined);
      sourceRuntime.sessionId = originalRuntime.sessionId;
      sourceRuntime.workspace = originalRuntime.workspace;
      sourceRuntime.baseline = originalRuntime.baseline;
      renderPanel();
    }

    const after = authoritySnapshot();
    const authorityNonMutating = JSON.stringify(before) === JSON.stringify(after);
    const sections = {
      surfaceLifecycle: surfaceLifecycle.ok,
      semanticLedgerBounded: semanticLedgerBounded.ok,
      intelligenceRuntimeBounded: intelligenceRuntimeBounded.ok,
      coordinateMapping: coordinateMapping.ok,
      physicalSequentialPersistence: physicalSequential?.ok === true,
      nonlinearCoverage: nonlinearCoverage?.ok === true,
    };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-stage-g-durability-source-lifecycle-acceptance/v1',
      ok: authorityNonMutating && Object.values(sections).every(Boolean),
      authorityNonMutating,
      sections,
      surfaceLifecycle,
      semanticLedgerBounded,
      intelligenceRuntimeBounded,
      coordinateMapping,
      physicalSequentialPersistence: physicalSequential,
      nonlinearCoverage,
      before,
      after,
      contract: {
        surfaces: 'bounded evidence cache with ephemeral/retained/pinned lifecycle; evicted rows summarized, not treated as semantic memory',
        traversal: 'NEXT_CHUNK physically advances persisted sequential coverage; SURFACE_RANGE never implies coverage',
        coordinateMapping: 'baseline↔Working projection remains explicit under insert/replace/delete spans',
        longRun: 'Semantic ledger and Source Intelligence runtime cache remain bounded independently of model-facing payload',
      },
    };
  }

  async function stageHWorkingPersistenceRoundTripV653() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('V653_STAGE_H_NO_SESSION');
    if (!sourceRuntime.workspace || !sourceRuntime.baseline || sourceRuntime.workspace.sessionId !== session.id) {
      await SourceWorkspace.restore(session.id);
    }
    await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
    const { baseline, workspace } = requireSourceRuntime(session);
    const active = sourceNormalizeRange(workspace.cursor.activeRange, baseline.text.length);
    if (!active || active.end <= active.start) throw new Error('V653_STAGE_H_NO_ACTIVE_CURSOR_RANGE');
    const original = materializeWorkingSourceSync();
    const originalHash = hashText(original.text);
    const originalSequence = Number(workspace.working?.sequence || 0);
    const semanticRevisionBefore = Number(session.revision || 0);
    const acceptanceSequenceBefore = semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session);
    const runToken = semanticId('v653-working').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9:_-]/g, '');
    const baselinePoints = [
      { placement: 'before', baseline: Math.max(0, active.start - 384) },
      { placement: 'inside', baseline: Math.min(active.end - 1, active.start + Math.max(1, Math.floor((active.end - active.start) / 2))) },
      { placement: 'after', baseline: Math.min(baseline.text.length, active.end + 384) },
    ];
    const points = baselinePoints.map((item, index) => ({
      ...item,
      working: baselineToWorkingOffset(item.baseline, 'before'),
      marker: `/* VIBE_STAGE_H_V653_${runToken}_${index}_${item.placement} */`,
    })).sort((a, b) => b.working - a.working);
    const operations = points.map(item => ({
      op: 'APPLY_EDIT',
      workingStart: item.working,
      workingEnd: item.working,
      replacementText: item.marker,
    }));

    // Pre-stage before touching durable Working authority.
    stageWorkingChangeSet({
      operations,
      intent: 'stage-h-live-acceptance',
      summary: 'Stage H reversible Working persistence preflight',
    }, { semanticSession: session, semanticRevision: session.revision });

    let mutationRevision = null;
    let revertRevision = null;
    let mutationReadback = null;
    let restoredReadback = null;
    let restoredHash = null;
    let markersAfterMutation = [];
    let markersAfterRestore = [];
    let mutationCommitted = false;
    try {
      mutationRevision = await applyWorkingChangeSet({
        operations,
        intent: 'stage-h-live-acceptance',
        summary: 'Stage H reversible Working persistence: before/inside/after cursor',
        rationale: 'Acceptance-only reversible current-session persistence proof; no monolith engineering decision.',
      }, {
        semanticSession: SemanticSessionStore.load(),
        semanticRevision: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.revision,
        skipAuthorityPreflight: true,
        schedule: false,
      });
      mutationCommitted = true;
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      mutationReadback = {
        workspace: await sourceDbGet('workspaces', session.id),
        revision: await sourceDbGet('workingRevisions', mutationRevision.id),
      };
      await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
      const mutatedText = materializeWorkingSourceSync().text;
      markersAfterMutation = points.map(item => ({ placement: item.placement, present: mutatedText.includes(item.marker) }));

      revertRevision = await revertWorkingHead({
        summary: 'Stage H acceptance revert: restore byte-identical Working content',
        rationale: 'Acceptance cleanup after one reversible persistence transaction.',
      });
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      restoredReadback = {
        workspace: await sourceDbGet('workspaces', session.id),
        revision: revertRevision ? await sourceDbGet('workingRevisions', revertRevision.id) : null,
      };
      await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
      const restoredText = materializeWorkingSourceSync().text;
      restoredHash = hashText(restoredText);
      markersAfterRestore = points.map(item => ({ placement: item.placement, present: restoredText.includes(item.marker) }));
    } catch (error) {
      if (mutationCommitted) {
        try {
          await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
          const currentText = materializeWorkingSourceSync().text;
          if (points.some(item => currentText.includes(item.marker))) {
            await revertWorkingHead({
              summary: 'Stage H emergency acceptance cleanup',
              rationale: 'Restore content after interrupted acceptance round-trip.',
            });
            await flushRuntimePersistence();
            await restoreWorkingSourceForWorkspace();
          }
        } catch (cleanupError) {
          throw new Error(`V653_STAGE_H_WORKING_CLEANUP_FAILED: ${error?.message || error}; cleanup: ${cleanupError?.message || cleanupError}`);
        }
      }
      throw error;
    }

    const finalSession = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const finalWorkspace = await sourceDbGet('workspaces', session.id);
    const finalWorking = materializeWorkingSourceSync();
    const placementsOk = markersAfterMutation.length === 3 && markersAfterMutation.every(item => item.present) && markersAfterRestore.every(item => !item.present);
    const persistedMutation = Boolean(
      mutationReadback?.revision &&
      String(mutationReadback.workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || '') === String(mutationRevision?.id || '')
    );
    const persistedRevert = Boolean(
      restoredReadback?.revision &&
      String(restoredReadback.workspace?.working?.headRevisionId || '') === String(revertRevision?.id || '')
    );
    const ok = Boolean(
      persistedMutation && persistedRevert && placementsOk &&
      restoredHash === originalHash && hashText(finalWorking.text) === originalHash &&
      Number(finalWorkspace?.working?.sequence || 0) === originalSequence + 2 &&
      Number(finalSession?.revision || 0) === semanticRevisionBefore &&
      semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(finalSession) === acceptanceSequenceBefore
    );
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-stage-h-working-persistence/v1',
      ok,
      contentRestoredByteIdentical: restoredHash === originalHash,
      semanticRevisionUnchanged: Number(finalSession?.revision || 0) === semanticRevisionBefore,
      acceptanceSequenceUnchanged: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(finalSession) === acceptanceSequenceBefore,
      original: { sequence: originalSequence, identity: workspace.working?.identity || null, hash: originalHash },
      mutation: {
        sequence: Number(mutationRevision?.sequence || 0),
        revisionId: mutationRevision?.id || null,
        persisted: persistedMutation,
        markers: markersAfterMutation,
      },
      revert: {
        sequence: Number(revertRevision?.sequence || 0),
        revisionId: revertRevision?.id || null,
        persisted: persistedRevert,
        markers: markersAfterRestore,
        hash: restoredHash,
      },
      final: {
        sequence: Number(finalWorkspace?.working?.sequence || 0),
        identity: finalWorkspace?.working?.identity || null,
        workspaceRevision: Number(finalWorkspace?.revision || 0),
      },
      placements: points.map(item => ({ placement: item.placement, baseline: item.baseline, working: item.working })),
    };
  }

  async function semanticStageHLiveIntegrationAcceptanceV653(options = {}) {
    let session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('V653_STAGE_H_NO_SESSION');
    const existing = stageHLiveStateV653(session);
    if (existing && options.restart !== true) return stageHLiveReportV653(session);
    if (isGeneratingFast() || isGenerating()) throw new Error('V653_STAGE_H_GENERATING: wait for the current assistant turn to finish before arming');

    // Stop only the runner machinery; durable semantic/source authority remains.
    if (state.running) stop({ reason: 'Stage H live integration acceptance arm', source: 'stage-h-v653' });
    clearPendingSend();

    const workingRoundTrip = await stageHWorkingPersistenceRoundTripV653();
    if (!workingRoundTrip.ok) {
      throw new Error(`V653_STAGE_H_WORKING_ROUNDTRIP_FAILED: ${JSON.stringify(workingRoundTrip)}`);
    }

    session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    session.transport ||= {};
    const currentOperator = currentOperatorControlV626(session);
    if (currentOperator?.status === 'active') {
      session.transport.operatorControl = {
        ...currentOperator,
        status: 'resumed',
        resumeMode: 'stage-h-v653-explicit-operator',
        resumedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
        countdownStartedAt: null,
        countdownDeadlineAt: null,
      };
    }
    session.transport.pendingDispatch = null;
    session.transport.pausedByUser = false;
    session.transport.pauseReason = '';
    session.transport.pausedAt = null;
    const runId = semanticId('stage-h-v653');
    session.transport.stageHLiveV653 = {
      schema: STAGE_H_LIVE_SCHEMA_V653,
      runId,
      status: 'armed',
      armedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      startRevision: Number(session.revision || 0),
      startAcceptanceSequence: semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session),
      startWorkingIdentity: session.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
      startWorkspaceRevision: Number(session.sourceCursor?.workspaceRevision || 0),
      noteText: `Stage H live transport acceptance ${runId}`,
      workingRoundTrip: cloneSemanticValue(workingRoundTrip),
      dispatchObservations: [],
      submissionWitnesses: [],
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();

    // Fresh operator-supervised causal boundary after the ordinary user conversation.
    const reanchored = await reanchorSemanticTransport({
      reason: `Stage H live integration ${runId}: fresh supervised native transport boundary`,
      forceFullProtocolRefeed: false,
      recoverFromTail: true,
    });

      justArmed: true,
      reanchor: {
        semanticRevision: reanchored?.semanticRevision ?? null,
        workingRevision: reanchored?.workingRevision || null,

  // Native durable human-promise backlog.
  // This deliberately reuses the extensible semantic note ledger instead of
  // introducing a closed task/request enum. `human_promise` is a convention,
  // not a kernel-wide finite vocabulary.
  function semanticHumanPromiseItemsV700(sessionInput = null, options = {}) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const notes = Array.isArray(session?.notes) ? session.notes : [];
    const includeResolved = options.includeResolved === true;
    return notes
      .filter(item => String(item?.kind || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'human_promise')
      .filter(item => includeResolved || String(item?.status || 'open').toLowerCase() !== 'resolved')
      .map(item => cloneSemanticValue(item))
      .sort(semanticLedgerChronology);
  }

  function semanticHumanPromiseProjectionV700(sessionInput = null) {
    const open = semanticHumanPromiseItemsV700(sessionInput, { includeResolved: false });
    const all = semanticHumanPromiseItemsV700(sessionInput, { includeResolved: true });
    return {
      open,
      resolved: all.filter(item => String(item?.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'resolved'),
      counts: {
        open: open.length,
        total: all.length,
      },
    };
  }

  function resolveSemanticHumanPromiseV700(id, resolution = '') {
    const promiseId = String(id || '').trim();
    if (!promiseId) throw new Error('HUMAN_PROMISE_ID_REQUIRED');
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) throw new Error('HUMAN_PROMISE_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE');
    const item = (Array.isArray(session.notes) ? session.notes : []).find(note =>
      String(note?.id || '') === promiseId &&
      String(note?.kind || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'human_promise'
    );
    if (!item) throw new Error(`HUMAN_PROMISE_NOT_FOUND: ${promiseId}`);
    item.status = 'resolved';
    item.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    item.meta = {
      ...(item.meta && typeof item.meta === 'object' ? cloneSemanticValue(item.meta) : {}),
      resolution: semanticMemoryText(resolution, 1800),
      resolvedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      resolutionAuthority: 'operator',
    };
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    flushRuntimePersistence().catch(() => undefined);
    return cloneSemanticValue(item);
  }
