  // Resort Stage 5A — native Windows host execution adapter.
  // Authority boundary:
  // - factual execution evidence only;
  // - no Mission/Distance/semantic authority;
  // - every mutation is exact-environment gated in the browser AND revalidated by the host bridge;
  // - localhost traffic crosses a dedicated Chrome-extension relay because page-context fetch is blocked by ChatGPT CSP;
  // - mutation request_id is durable identity; UNKNOWN outcomes must be reconciled, never blindly replayed.
  const RESORT_HOST_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_V1 = 'resort-vibe-host-adapter/v1';
  const RESORT_HOST_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_V1 = 'resort-vibe-host-evidence/v1';
  const RESORT_HOST_RELAY_REQUEST_SCHEMA_V1 = 'resort-host-relay-request/v1';
  const RESORT_HOST_RELAY_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_V1 = 'resort-host-relay-response/v1';
  const RESORT_HOST_RELAY_READY_SCHEMA_V1 = 'resort-host-relay-ready/v1';
  const RESORT_HOST_RELAY_CHANNEL_V1 = 'resort-host-bridge';
  const RESORT_HOST_BATCH_SCHEMA_V1 = 'resort-vibe-host-batch/v1';
  const RESORT_HOST_DISPATCH_SCHEMA_V1 = 'resort-vibe-host-dispatch-context/v1';
  const RESORT_HOST_BATCH_MAX_RESULTS_V1 = 24;

  const RESORT_HOST_ALLOWED_OPS_V1 = new Set([
    'capabilities.list',
    'bridge.environment',
    'fs.stat',
    'fs.list',
    'fs.read',
    'fs.sha256',
    'fs.mkdir',
    'fs.writeExact',
    'git.status',
    'request.get',
    'process.run',
    'process.start',
    'process.status',
    'process.stop',
  ]);
  const RESORT_HOST_MUTATING_OPS_V1 = new Set([
    'fs.mkdir',
    'fs.writeExact',
    'process.run',
    'process.start',
    'process.stop',
  ]);

  const resortHostRelayPendingV1 = new Map();
  let resortHostRelayListenerInstalledV1 = false;
  const resortHostRuntimeV1 = {
    readySeenAt: null,
    readyVersion: null,
    lastRequestAt: null,
    lastResponseAt: null,
    lastErrorAt: null,
    lastError: null,
    lastUnknown: null,
  };

  function resortHostClientRequestIdV1(prefix = 'host') {
    return `${String(prefix || 'host')}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
  }

  function resortHostExternalTransportErrorV1(code, message, extra = {}) {
    const error = new Error(String(message || code || 'RESORT_HOST_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE'));
    error.code = String(code || 'RESORT_HOST_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE');
    error.failureDomain = 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE';
    Object.assign(error, extra || {});
    return error;
  }

  function ensureResortHostRelayListenerV1() {
    if (resortHostRelayListenerInstalledV1) return;
    resortHostRelayListenerInstalledV1 = true;
    window.addEventListener('message', event => {
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
      if (event.source !== window || event.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
      const data = event.data;
      if (!data || data.channel !== RESORT_HOST_RELAY_CHANNEL_V1) return;
      if (data.schema === RESORT_HOST_RELAY_READY_SCHEMA_V1) {
        resortHostRuntimeV1.readySeenAt = semanticIsoNow();
        resortHostRuntimeV1.readyVersion = data.version ? String(data.version) : null;
        return;
      }
      if (data.schema !== RESORT_HOST_RELAY_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_V1) return;
      const clientRequestId = String(data.client_request_id || '');
      const pending = resortHostRelayPendingV1.get(clientRequestId);
      if (!pending) return;
      resortHostRelayPendingV1.delete(clientRequestId);
      clearTimeout(pending.timeout);
      resortHostRuntimeV1.lastResponseAt = semanticIsoNow();
      pending.resolve(data.response || { ok: false, error: { code: 'EMPTY_RESORT_HOST_RELAY_RESPONSE' } });
    });
  }

  function resortHostRelayRequestV1(kind, bridgeRequest = null, options = {}) {
    if (CONFIG.resortHostBridgeEnabled !== true) {
      throw resortHostExternalTransportErrorV1(
        'RESORT_HOST_DISABLED',
        'RESORT_HOST_DISABLED: Resort-native host bridge is not enabled in this firmware build'
      );
    }
    ensureResortHostRelayListenerV1();
    const timeoutMs = Math.max(1000, Math.min(125000, Number(options.timeoutMs || CONFIG.resortHostBridgeTimeoutMs || 45000)));
    const clientRequestId = resortHostClientRequestIdV1(options.clientRequestPrefix || 'host');
    resortHostRuntimeV1.lastRequestAt = semanticIsoNow();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        resortHostRelayPendingV1.delete(clientRequestId);
        const error = resortHostExternalTransportErrorV1(
          'RESORT_HOST_EXTENSION_RELAY_TIMEOUT',
          `RESORT_HOST_EXTENSION_RELAY_TIMEOUT: no extension response within ${timeoutMs} ms`,
          { clientRequestId }
        );
        resortHostRuntimeV1.lastErrorAt = semanticIsoNow();
        resortHostRuntimeV1.lastError = { code: error.code, message: error.message };
        reject(error);
      }, timeoutMs);
      resortHostRelayPendingV1.set(clientRequestId, { resolve, reject, timeout });
      window.postMessage({
        schema: RESORT_HOST_RELAY_REQUEST_SCHEMA_V1,
        channel: RESORT_HOST_RELAY_CHANNEL_V1,
        client_request_id: clientRequestId,
        kind,
        bridge_request: bridgeRequest,
      }, window.location.origin);
    });
  }

  function resortHostFixedContextV1() {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const browser = resortBrowserProjectObservationV01();
    return {
      project_id: CONFIG.resortProjectId,
      environment_id: CONFIG.resortExpectedEnvironmentId,
      host_name: CONFIG.resortExpectedHostName,
      repo_root: CONFIG.resortExpectedRepoRoot,
      chatgpt_origin: window.location.origin,
      chatgpt_project_id: browser.observedChatGptProjectId,
      semantic_session_id: session?.id || null,
      semantic_revision: Number(session?.revision || 0),
      distance_id: session?.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
    };
  }

  function resortHostMutationPreflightV1() {
    return assertResortEnvironmentForMutationV01({
      environmentId: CONFIG.resortExpectedEnvironmentId,
      hostName: CONFIG.resortExpectedHostName,
      repoRoot: CONFIG.resortExpectedRepoRoot,
      platform: CONFIG.resortRequiredPlatform,
      shell: CONFIG.resortRequiredShell,
    });
  }

  function normalizeResortHostOpNameV1(opInput) {
    return String(opInput || '').trim();
  }

  function normalizeResortHostRequestV1(rawInput, index = 0, context = {}) {
    const raw = rawInput && typeof rawInput === 'object' ? cloneSemanticValue(rawInput) : {};
    const op = normalizeResortHostOpNameV1(raw.op);
    if (!op) throw new Error(`RESORT_HOST_OP_INVALID: hostOps[${index}].op is required`);
    if (!RESORT_HOST_ALLOWED_OPS_V1.has(op)) throw new Error(`RESORT_HOST_OP_UNSUPPORTED: ${op}`);
    const args = raw.args && typeof raw.args === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw.args) ? raw.args : {};
    const mutation = RESORT_HOST_MUTATING_OPS_V1.has(op);
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const acceptanceSequence = Number(context.acceptanceSequence ?? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session || {}));
    const stablePayload = JSON.stringify({ op, args, mutation });
    const stableHash = String(hashText(stablePayload)).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '').slice(0, 16) || 'op';
    const sid = String(session?.id || 'no-session').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._:-]+/g, '-').slice(0, 40);
    const requestId = String(raw.request_id || '').trim() ||
      `rrh:${sid}:a${acceptanceSequence}:${index}:${stableHash}`;
    return {
      schema: 'resort-host-request/v1',
      request_id: requestId,
      op,
      args,
      mutation,
      context: resortHostFixedContextV1(),
    };
  }

  function resortHostEvidenceV1(responseInput, requestInput = null, clientKind = 'bridge.request') {
    const response = cloneSemanticValue(responseInput || {});
    const bridge = response?.bridge_response || null;
    const httpStatus = Number(response?.http_status || 0) || null;
    const relayOk = response?.ok === true;
    const status = String(bridge?.status || '');
    const ok = clientKind === 'health'
      ? relayOk && httpStatus === 200 && bridge?.ok === true
      : relayOk && httpStatus === 200 && status === 'SUCCEEDED';
    const failureDomain = response?.error
      ? 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE'
      : (bridge?.failure_domain || null);
    return {
      schema: RESORT_HOST_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_V1,
      ok,
      client_kind: clientKind,
      request: requestInput ? cloneSemanticValue(requestInput) : null,
      relay_version: response?.relay_version || null,
      http_status: httpStatus,
      bridge: cloneSemanticValue(bridge),
      failure_domain: failureDomain,
      error: cloneSemanticValue(response?.error || bridge?.error || null),
      observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  async function resortHostHealthV1(options = {}) {
    try {
      const response = await resortHostRelayRequestV1('health', null, options || {});
      const evidence = resortHostEvidenceV1(response, null, 'health');
      resortHostRuntimeV1.lastError = evidence.ok ? null : cloneSemanticValue(evidence.error || null);
      if (!evidence.ok) resortHostRuntimeV1.lastErrorAt = semanticIsoNow();
      return evidence;
    } catch (error) {
      resortHostRuntimeV1.lastErrorAt = semanticIsoNow();
      resortHostRuntimeV1.lastError = { code: error?.code || 'RESORT_HOST_TRANSPORT_FAILURE', message: String(error?.message || error) };
      return {
        schema: RESORT_HOST_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_V1,
        ok: false,
        client_kind: 'health',
        request: null,
        relay_version: null,
        http_status: null,
        bridge: null,
        failure_domain: error?.failureDomain || 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE',
        error: cloneSemanticValue(resortHostRuntimeV1.lastError),
        observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
  }

  async function resortHostRequestV1(requestInput, options = {}) {
    const normalized = normalizeResortHostRequestV1(requestInput, Number(options.index || 0), {
      acceptanceSequence: options.acceptanceSequence,
    });
    if (normalized.mutation) resortHostMutationPreflightV1();
    try {
      const response = await resortHostRelayRequestV1('bridge.request', normalized, options || {});
      const evidence = resortHostEvidenceV1(response, normalized, 'bridge.request');
      const bridgeStatus = String(evidence?.bridge?.status || '');
      if (normalized.mutation && (bridgeStatus === 'UNKNOWN' || evidence.failure_domain === 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE')) {
        resortHostRuntimeV1.lastUnknown = {
          schema: 'resort-host-mutation-outcome-unknown/v1',
          request_id: normalized.request_id,
          op: normalized.op,
          at: semanticIsoNow(),
          contract: 'DO_NOT_BLIND_REPLAY; query request.get and/or factual repository state before any new mutation request.',
        };
      } else if (evidence.ok && resortHostRuntimeV1.lastUnknown?.request_id === normalized.request_id) {
        resortHostRuntimeV1.lastUnknown = null;
      }
      resortHostRuntimeV1.lastError = evidence.ok ? null : cloneSemanticValue(evidence.error || null);
      if (!evidence.ok) resortHostRuntimeV1.lastErrorAt = semanticIsoNow();
      return evidence;
    } catch (error) {
      if (normalized.mutation) {
        resortHostRuntimeV1.lastUnknown = {
          schema: 'resort-host-mutation-outcome-unknown/v1',
          request_id: normalized.request_id,
          op: normalized.op,
          at: semanticIsoNow(),
          cause: String(error?.message || error),
          contract: 'DO_NOT_BLIND_REPLAY; query request.get and/or factual repository state before any new mutation request.',
        };
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  function boundedResortHostEvidenceV1(evidenceInput) {
    const evidence = cloneSemanticValue(evidenceInput || {});
    let raw = '';
    try { raw = JSON.stringify(evidence); } catch {}
    const limit = Math.max(2000, Number(CONFIG.resortHostResultMaxChars || 14000));
    if (raw.length <= limit) return evidence;
    const bridge = evidence?.bridge || null;
    return {
      schema: evidence?.schema || RESORT_HOST_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_V1,
      ok: evidence?.ok === true,
      client_kind: evidence?.client_kind || 'bridge.request',
      request: cloneSemanticValue(evidence?.request || null),
      relay_version: evidence?.relay_version || null,
      http_status: evidence?.http_status || null,
      bridge: bridge ? {
        request_id: bridge.request_id || null,
        status: bridge.status || null,
        failure_domain: bridge.failure_domain || null,
        started_at: bridge.started_at || null,
        finished_at: bridge.finished_at || null,
        duration_ms: bridge.duration_ms ?? null,
        result_preview: semanticMemoryText(JSON.stringify(bridge.result ?? null), 6000),
        error: cloneSemanticValue(bridge.error || null),
      } : null,
      failure_domain: evidence?.failure_domain || null,
      error: cloneSemanticValue(evidence?.error || null),
      observed_at: evidence?.observed_at || semanticIsoNow(),
      truncated: true,
      original_chars: raw.length,
    };
  }

  async function applyAndRecordResortHostOpsV1(opsInput, semanticRevision, acceptanceSequenceInput = null, causal = {}) {
    const requestedRaw = Array.isArray(opsInput) ? opsInput.slice(0, RESORT_HOST_BATCH_MAX_RESULTS_V1) : [];
    const sessionBefore = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!sessionBefore) throw new Error('RESORT_HOST_CAUSAL_SESSION_MISSING');
    const acceptanceSequence = Number.isInteger(Number(acceptanceSequenceInput))
      ? Number(acceptanceSequenceInput)
      : semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(sessionBefore);
    const distanceId = sessionBefore.route?.activeDistanceId || null;
    const controlId = String(causal.controlId || sessionBefore.transport?.lastControl?.id || '') || null;
    const dispatchId = String(causal.dispatchId || '') || null;
    const requested = requestedRaw.map((item, index) =>
      normalizeResortHostRequestV1(item, index, { acceptanceSequence })
    );
    const results = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < requested.length; index += 1) {
      const request = requested[index];
      let evidence;
      try {
        evidence = await resortHostRequestV1(request, { index, acceptanceSequence });
      } catch (error) {
        evidence = {
          schema: RESORT_HOST_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_V1,
          ok: false,
          client_kind: 'bridge.request',
          request: cloneSemanticValue(request),
          relay_version: null,
          http_status: null,
          bridge: null,
          failure_domain: error?.failureDomain || 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE',
          error: { code: error?.code || 'RESORT_HOST_EXECUTION_THROW', message: String(error?.message || error) },
          observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
      }
      results.push(boundedResortHostEvidenceV1(evidence));
    }
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return results;
    session.transport ||= {};
    const batch = {
      schema: RESORT_HOST_BATCH_SCHEMA_V1,
      revision: Number.isFinite(Number(semanticRevision)) ? Number(semanticRevision) : Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence,
      distanceId,
      controlId,
      dispatchId,
      recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requested: requested.length,
      succeeded: results.filter(item => item?.ok === true).length,
      failed: results.filter(item => item?.ok !== true).length,
      requests: requested.map(item => ({ request_id: item.request_id, op: item.op, mutation: item.mutation === true })),
      results,
    };
    session.transport.lastResortHostOpsV1 = batch;
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return results;
  }

  function resortHostBatchForDispatchV1(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const batch = session?.transport?.lastResortHostOpsV1 || null;
    if (!batch) return null;
    if (Number(batch.revision) !== Number(session?.revision || 0)) return null;
    if (Number(batch.acceptanceSequence) !== Number(semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session || {}))) return null;
    const lastControlId = String(session?.transport?.lastControl?.id || '');
    if (batch.controlId && lastControlId && String(batch.controlId) !== lastControlId) return null;
    return batch;
  }

  function buildResortHostDispatchContextV1(sessionInput = null, options = {}) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const batch = resortHostBatchForDispatchV1(session);
    const status = {
      schema: RESORT_HOST_DISPATCH_SCHEMA_V1,
      adapter: RESORT_HOST_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_V1,
      enabled: CONFIG.resortHostBridgeEnabled === true,
      semanticAuthority: false,
      transport: 'chromium-extension-relay-to-loopback',
      channel: RESORT_HOST_RELAY_CHANNEL_V1,
      readySeenAt: resortHostRuntimeV1.readySeenAt,
      readyVersion: resortHostRuntimeV1.readyVersion,
      fresh: Boolean(batch),
      allowedOps: [...RESORT_HOST_ALLOWED_OPS_V1],
      mutatingOps: [...RESORT_HOST_MUTATING_OPS_V1],
      lastUnknown: cloneSemanticValue(resortHostRuntimeV1.lastUnknown),
    };
    const lines = [batch ? 'RESORT HOST · FRESH EXECUTION EVIDENCE' : 'RESORT HOST · AVAILABLE', JSON.stringify(status)];
    if (!batch) {
      lines.push(
        'Use VG_PATCH.hostOps only when factual Windows/repository evidence or mutation is required. ' +
        'Host results are evidence only and never Mission/Distance authority. ' +
        'For mutation UNKNOWN, do not replay: reconcile request_id first.'
      );
      return lines.join('\n');
    }
    lines.push(
      `causal revision r${batch.revision} · acceptance a${batch.acceptanceSequence} · distance ${batch.distanceId || '(none)'} · control ${batch.controlId || '(none)'}`,
      `requests ${batch.requested} · ok ${batch.succeeded} · failed ${batch.failed}`,
      'These are factual host-execution observations only.'
    );
    let used = lines.join('\n').length;
    const limit = Math.max(4000, Number(CONFIG.resortHostDispatchMaxChars || 18000));
    for (const result of Array.isArray(batch.results) ? batch.results : []) {
      const block = JSON.stringify(result, null, options.thinNormal ? 0 : 2);
      if (used + block.length > limit) {
        lines.push(`(remaining Resort Host evidence omitted by ${limit}-char dispatch budget)`);
        break;
      }
      lines.push(block);
      used += block.length + 1;
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  const ResortHostV1 = Object.freeze({
    schema: RESORT_HOST_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_V1,
    status: () => ({
      schema: RESORT_HOST_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_V1,
      enabled: CONFIG.resortHostBridgeEnabled === true,
      semanticAuthority: false,
      transport: 'chromium-extension-relay-to-loopback',
      channel: RESORT_HOST_RELAY_CHANNEL_V1,
      readySeenAt: resortHostRuntimeV1.readySeenAt,
      readyVersion: resortHostRuntimeV1.readyVersion,
      lastRequestAt: resortHostRuntimeV1.lastRequestAt,
      lastResponseAt: resortHostRuntimeV1.lastResponseAt,
      lastErrorAt: resortHostRuntimeV1.lastErrorAt,
      lastError: cloneSemanticValue(resortHostRuntimeV1.lastError),
      lastUnknown: cloneSemanticValue(resortHostRuntimeV1.lastUnknown),
      pending: resortHostRelayPendingV1.size,
      allowedOps: [...RESORT_HOST_ALLOWED_OPS_V1],
      mutatingOps: [...RESORT_HOST_MUTATING_OPS_V1],
    }),
    health: options => resortHostHealthV1(options || {}),
    request: (request, options) => resortHostRequestV1(request, options || {}),
    capabilities: options => resortHostRequestV1({ op: 'capabilities.list', args: {} }, options || {}),
    environment: options => resortHostRequestV1({ op: 'bridge.environment', args: {} }, options || {}),
    requestGet: (requestId, options = {}) => resortHostRequestV1({
      op: 'request.get',
      args: { target_request_id: String(requestId || '') },
    }, options || {}),
    gitStatus: options => resortHostRequestV1({ op: 'git.status', args: {} }, options || {}),
    processRun: (tool, args = [], options = {}) => resortHostRequestV1({
      op: 'process.run',
      args: {
        tool: String(tool || ''),
        args: Array.isArray(args) ? args.map(value => String(value)) : [],
        cwd: options.cwd == null ? '.' : String(options.cwd),
        timeout_ms: options.timeoutMs == null ? 30000 : Number(options.timeoutMs),
      },
    }, options || {}),
    processStart: (tool, args = [], options = {}) => resortHostRequestV1({
      op: 'process.start',
      args: {
        tool: String(tool || ''),
        args: Array.isArray(args) ? args.map(value => String(value)) : [],
        cwd: options.cwd == null ? '.' : String(options.cwd),
      },
    }, options || {}),
    processStatus: (jobId, options = {}) => resortHostRequestV1({
      op: 'process.status',
      args: { job_id: String(jobId || '') },
    }, options || {}),
    processStop: (jobId, options = {}) => resortHostRequestV1({
      op: 'process.stop',
      args: { job_id: String(jobId || '') },
    }, options || {}),
    freshBatch: () => cloneSemanticValue(resortHostBatchForDispatchV1(SemanticSessionStore.load())),
    buildDispatchContext: options => buildResortHostDispatchContextV1(SemanticSessionStore.load(), options || {}),
  });


  // M0.5 P2 — generic Workbench adapter.
  // Constitutional boundary: this adapter carries factual execution evidence only.
  // It does not mutate Mission, Distance, scheduler authority, semantic revision,
  // Source Workspace, or Working. ProjectData remains a compatibility donor only.
  const WORKBENCH_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_M05P2 = 'vibe-go-workbench-adapter/v1';
  const WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2 = 'vibe-go-workbench-evidence/v1';
  const WORKBENCH_RELAY_REQUEST_SCHEMA_M05P2 = 'vibe-go-legacy-workbench-request/v1';
  const WORKBENCH_RELAY_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_M05P2 = 'vibe-go-legacy-workbench-response/v1';
  const WORKBENCH_RELAY_READY_SCHEMA_M05P2 = 'vibe-go-legacy-workbench-relay-ready/v1';
  const WORKBENCH_RELAY_CHANNEL_M05P2 = 'vibe-go-legacy-workbench';
  const workbenchRelayPendingM05P2 = new Map();
  let workbenchRelayListenerInstalledM05P2 = false;
  const workbenchRuntimeM05P2 = {
    readySeenAt: null,
    readyVersion: null,
    lastRequestAt: null,
    lastResponseAt: null,
    lastErrorAt: null,
    lastError: null,
  };

  function workbenchClientRequestIdM05P2(prefix = 'wb') {
    return `${String(prefix || 'wb')}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
  }

  function workbenchBridgeRequestIdM05P2(prefix = 'vibe') {
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const sid = String(session?.id || 'no-session').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._:-]+/g, '-').slice(0, 48);
    return `${String(prefix || 'vibe')}:${sid}:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  }

  function workbenchExternalTransportErrorM05P2(code, message, extra = {}) {
    const error = new Error(String(message || code || 'WORKBENCH_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE'));
    error.code = String(code || 'WORKBENCH_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE');
    error.failureDomain = 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE';
    Object.assign(error, extra || {});
    return error;
  }

  function ensureWorkbenchRelayListenerM05P2() {
    if (workbenchRelayListenerInstalledM05P2) return;
    workbenchRelayListenerInstalledM05P2 = true;
    window.addEventListener('message', event => {
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return;
      if (event.source !== window || event.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
      const data = event.data;
      if (!data || data.channel !== WORKBENCH_RELAY_CHANNEL_M05P2) return;
      if (data.schema === WORKBENCH_RELAY_READY_SCHEMA_M05P2) {
        workbenchRuntimeM05P2.readySeenAt = new Date().toISOString();
        workbenchRuntimeM05P2.readyVersion = data.version ? String(data.version) : null;
        return;
      }
      if (data.schema !== WORKBENCH_RELAY_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_M05P2) return;
      const clientRequestId = String(data.client_request_id || '');
      const pending = workbenchRelayPendingM05P2.get(clientRequestId);
      if (!pending) return;
      workbenchRelayPendingM05P2.delete(clientRequestId);
      clearTimeout(pending.timeout);
      workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastResponseAt = new Date().toISOString();
      pending.resolve(data.response || { ok: false, error: { code: 'EMPTY_RELAY_RESPONSE' } });
    });
  }

  function workbenchRelayRequestM05P2(kind, bridgeRequest = null, options = {}) {
    ensureWorkbenchRelayListenerM05P2();
    const timeoutMs = Math.max(1000, Math.min(125000, Number(options.timeoutMs || 45000)));
    const clientRequestId = workbenchClientRequestIdM05P2(options.clientRequestPrefix || 'wb');
    workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastRequestAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        workbenchRelayPendingM05P2.delete(clientRequestId);
        const error = workbenchExternalTransportErrorM05P2(
          'WORKBENCH_EXTENSION_RELAY_TIMEOUT',
          `WORKBENCH_EXTENSION_RELAY_TIMEOUT: no extension response within ${timeoutMs} ms`,
          { clientRequestId }
        );
        workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
        workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastError = { code: error.code, message: error.message };
        reject(error);
      }, timeoutMs);
      workbenchRelayPendingM05P2.set(clientRequestId, { resolve, reject, timeout });
      window.postMessage({
        schema: WORKBENCH_RELAY_REQUEST_SCHEMA_M05P2,
        channel: WORKBENCH_RELAY_CHANNEL_M05P2,
        client_request_id: clientRequestId,
        kind,
        bridge_request: bridgeRequest,
      }, window.location.origin);
    });
  }

  function workbenchEvidenceM05P2(responseInput, requestInput = null, clientKind = 'bridge.request') {
    const response = cloneSemanticValue(responseInput || {});
    const bridge = response?.bridge_response || null;
    const httpStatus = Number(response?.http_status || 0) || null;
    const extensionOk = response?.ok === true;
    const bridgeStatus = String(bridge?.status || '');
    const bridgeOk = bridgeStatus === 'SUCCEEDED';
    const ok = clientKind === 'health'
      ? extensionOk && httpStatus === 200 && response?.relay_health?.ok === true
      : extensionOk && httpStatus === 200 && Boolean(bridge) && bridgeOk;
    const extensionError = response?.error || null;
    const bridgeError = bridge?.error || null;
    return {
      schema: WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
      ok,
      client_kind: clientKind,
      request: requestInput ? cloneSemanticValue(requestInput) : null,
      relay_version: response?.relay_version || response?.relay_health?.version || null,
      http_status: httpStatus,
      bridge: cloneSemanticValue(bridge),
      relay_health: clientKind === 'health' ? cloneSemanticValue(response?.relay_health || null) : null,
      failure_domain: extensionError
        ? 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE'
        : (bridge?.failure_domain || null),
      error: cloneSemanticValue(extensionError || bridgeError || null),
      observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
    };
  }

  async function workbenchHealthM05P2(options = {}) {
    if (CONFIG.legacyWorkbenchEnabled !== true) {
      return {
        schema: WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
        ok: false,
        client_kind: 'health',
        request: null,
        relay_version: null,
        http_status: null,
        bridge: null,
        relay_health: null,
        failure_domain: 'CAPABILITY_DISABLED',
        error: {
          code: 'RESORT_LEGACY_WORKBENCH_DISABLED',
          message: 'Historical CC Workbench relay is quarantined; no local execution capability is active yet.',
        },
        observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
    try {
      const response = await workbenchRelayRequestM05P2('health', null, options || {});
      workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastError = response?.ok === false ? cloneSemanticValue(response.error || null) : null;
      if (response?.ok === false) workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      return workbenchEvidenceM05P2(response, null, 'health');
    } catch (error) {
      workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastError = { code: error?.code || 'WORKBENCH_TRANSPORT_FAILURE', message: String(error?.message || error) };
      return {
        schema: WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
        ok: false,
        client_kind: 'health',
        request: null,
        relay_version: null,
        http_status: null,
        bridge: null,
        relay_health: null,
        failure_domain: error?.failureDomain || 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE',
        error: cloneSemanticValue(workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastError),
        observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
  }

  async function workbenchRequestM05P2(requestInput, options = {}) {
    if (CONFIG.legacyWorkbenchEnabled !== true) {
      const request = cloneSemanticValue(requestInput || {});
      return {
        schema: WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
        ok: false,
        client_kind: 'bridge.request',
        request,
        relay_version: null,
        http_status: null,
        bridge: null,
        relay_health: null,
        failure_domain: 'CAPABILITY_DISABLED',
        error: {
          code: 'RESORT_LEGACY_WORKBENCH_DISABLED',
          message: 'Historical CC Workbench relay is quarantined; Resort PowerShell bridge has not been installed.',
        },
        observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
    const request = cloneSemanticValue(requestInput || {});
    if (!request || typeof request !== 'object') throw new Error('Workbench request must be an object');
    if (!String(request.request_id || '').trim()) request.request_id = workbenchBridgeRequestIdM05P2('vibe');
    if (!String(request.op || '').trim()) throw new Error('Workbench request.op is required');
    if (!request.args || typeof request.args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(request.args)) request.args = {};
    request.mutation = request.mutation === true;
    try {
      const response = await workbenchRelayRequestM05P2('bridge.request', request, options || {});
      workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastError = response?.ok === false ? cloneSemanticValue(response.error || null) : null;
      if (response?.ok === false) workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      return workbenchEvidenceM05P2(response, request, 'bridge.request');
    } catch (error) {
      workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastError = { code: error?.code || 'WORKBENCH_TRANSPORT_FAILURE', message: String(error?.message || error) };
      return {
        schema: WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
        ok: false,
        client_kind: 'bridge.request',
        request,
        relay_version: null,
        http_status: null,
        bridge: null,
        relay_health: null,
        failure_domain: error?.failureDomain || 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE',
        error: cloneSemanticValue(workbenchRuntimeM05P2.lastError),
        observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
      };
    }
  }

  function workbenchCapabilitiesM05P2(options = {}) {
    return workbenchRequestM05P2({
      request_id: String(options.requestId || workbenchBridgeRequestIdM05P2('caps')),
      op: 'capabilities.list',
      args: {},
      mutation: false,
    }, options || {});
  }

  function workbenchRequestGetM05P2(targetRequestId, options = {}) {
    const target = String(targetRequestId || '').trim();
    if (!target) throw new Error('request.get target request_id is required');
    return workbenchRequestM05P2({
      request_id: String(options.requestId || workbenchBridgeRequestIdM05P2('request-get')),
      op: 'request.get',
      args: { request_id: target },
      mutation: false,
    }, options || {});
  }



  // M0.5 P3 — causal Workbench evidence loop.
  // workbenchOps are execution requests, not semantic mutations. An accepted
  // control advances acceptanceSequence normally; the runner then executes the
  // requested Bridge operations and records one bounded factual batch keyed to
  // that exact acceptanceSequence/control/Distance. The next dispatch may see
  // the batch; any later accepted control makes it stale automatically.
  const WORKBENCH_BATCH_SCHEMA_M05P3 = 'vibe-go-workbench-batch/v1';
  const WORKBENCH_DISPATCH_SCHEMA_M05P3 = 'vibe-go-workbench-dispatch-context/v1';
  const WORKBENCH_BATCH_MAX_RESULTS_M05P3 = 24;
  const WORKBENCH_RESULT_MAX_CHARS_M05P3 = 9000;
  const WORKBENCH_DISPATCH_MAX_CHARS_M05P3 = 18000;

  function normalizeWorkbenchRequestM05P3(rawInput, index = 0, context = {}) {
    const raw = rawInput && typeof rawInput === 'object' ? cloneSemanticValue(rawInput) : {};
    const op = String(raw.op || '').trim();
    if (!op) throw new Error(`WORKBENCH_OP_INVALID: workbenchOps[${index}].op is required`);
    const args = raw.args && typeof raw.args === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw.args) ? raw.args : {};
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const acceptanceSequence = Number(context.acceptanceSequence ?? semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session || {}));
    const requestId = String(raw.request_id || '').trim() ||
      `wb:${String(session?.id || 'no-session').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._:-]+/g, '-').slice(0, 36)}:a${acceptanceSequence}:${index}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    return {
      request_id: requestId,
      op,
      args,
      mutation: raw.mutation === true,
    };
  }

  function boundedWorkbenchEvidenceM05P3(evidenceInput) {
    const evidence = cloneSemanticValue(evidenceInput || {});
    const raw = (() => { try { return JSON.stringify(evidence); } catch { return ''; } })();
    if (raw.length <= WORKBENCH_RESULT_MAX_CHARS_M05P3) return evidence;
    const bridge = evidence?.bridge || null;
    return {
      schema: evidence?.schema || WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
      ok: evidence?.ok === true,
      client_kind: evidence?.client_kind || 'bridge.request',
      request: cloneSemanticValue(evidence?.request || null),
      relay_version: evidence?.relay_version || null,
      http_status: evidence?.http_status || null,
      bridge: bridge ? {
        request_id: bridge.request_id || null,
        status: bridge.status || null,
        failure_domain: bridge.failure_domain || null,
        started_at: bridge.started_at || null,
        finished_at: bridge.finished_at || null,
        duration_ms: bridge.duration_ms ?? null,
        result_preview: semanticMemoryText(JSON.stringify(bridge.result ?? null), 4200),
        error: cloneSemanticValue(bridge.error || null),
      } : null,
      failure_domain: evidence?.failure_domain || null,
      error: cloneSemanticValue(evidence?.error || null),
      observed_at: evidence?.observed_at || semanticIsoNow(),
      truncated: true,
      original_chars: raw.length,
    };
  }

  async function applyAndRecordWorkbenchOpsM05P3(opsInput, semanticRevision, acceptanceSequenceInput = null, causal = {}) {
    const requestedRaw = Array.isArray(opsInput) ? opsInput.slice(0, WORKBENCH_BATCH_MAX_RESULTS_M05P3) : [];
    const sessionBefore = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!sessionBefore) throw new Error('WORKBENCH_CAUSAL_SESSION_MISSING');
    const acceptanceSequence = Number.isInteger(Number(acceptanceSequenceInput))
      ? Number(acceptanceSequenceInput)
      : semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(sessionBefore);
    const distanceId = sessionBefore.route?.activeDistanceId || null;
    const controlId = String(causal.controlId || sessionBefore.transport?.lastControl?.id || '') || null;
    const dispatchId = String(causal.dispatchId || '') || null;
    const requested = requestedRaw.map((item, index) => normalizeWorkbenchRequestM05P3(item, index, { acceptanceSequence }));
    const results = [];
    for (const request of requested) {
      let evidence;
      try {
        evidence = await workbenchRequestM05P2(request);
      } catch (error) {
        evidence = {
          schema: WORKBENCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
          ok: false,
          client_kind: 'bridge.request',
          request: cloneSemanticValue(request),
          relay_version: null,
          http_status: null,
          bridge: null,
          relay_health: null,
          failure_domain: error?.failureDomain || 'EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE',
          error: { code: error?.code || 'WORKBENCH_EXECUTION_THROW', message: String(error?.message || error) },
          observed_at: semanticIsoNow(),
        };
      }
      results.push(boundedWorkbenchEvidenceM05P3(evidence));
    }
    const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
    if (!session) return results;
    session.transport ||= {};
    const batch = {
      schema: WORKBENCH_BATCH_SCHEMA_M05P3,
      revision: Number.isFinite(Number(semanticRevision)) ? Number(semanticRevision) : Number(session.revision || 0),
      acceptanceSequence,
      distanceId,
      controlId,
      dispatchId,
      recordedAt: semanticIsoNow(),
      requested: requested.length,
      succeeded: results.filter(item => item?.ok === true).length,
      failed: results.filter(item => item?.ok !== true).length,
      requests: requested.map(item => ({ request_id: item.request_id, op: item.op, mutation: item.mutation === true })),
      results,
    };
    session.transport.lastWorkbenchOpsM05P3 = batch;
    session.updatedAt = semanticIsoNow();
    SemanticSessionStore.save(session);
    await flushRuntimePersistence();
    return results;
  }

  function workbenchBatchForDispatchM05P3(sessionInput = null) {
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const batch = session?.transport?.lastWorkbenchOpsM05P3 || null;
    if (!batch) return null;
    if (Number(batch.revision) !== Number(session?.revision || 0)) return null;
    if (Number(batch.acceptanceSequence) !== Number(semanticTransportAcceptanceSequenceV645(session || {}))) return null;
    const lastControlId = String(session?.transport?.lastControl?.id || '');
    if (batch.controlId && lastControlId && String(batch.controlId) !== lastControlId) return null;
    return batch;
  }

  function buildWorkbenchDispatchContextM05P3(sessionInput = null, options = {}) {
    if (CONFIG.legacyWorkbenchEnabled !== true) {
      return 'WORKBENCH · disabled in Resort firmware construction; no PowerShell/local execution capability is active';
    }
    const session = sessionInput || SemanticSessionStore.load();
    const batch = workbenchBatchForDispatchM05P3(session);
    const status = {
      schema: WORKBENCH_DISPATCH_SCHEMA_M05P3,
      adapter: WORKBENCH_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_M05P2,
      semanticAuthority: false,
      transport: 'armed-extension-relay',
      fresh: Boolean(batch),
    };
    const lines = [batch ? 'WORKBENCH · FRESH EXECUTION EVIDENCE' : 'WORKBENCH · AVAILABLE', JSON.stringify(status)];
    if (!batch) {
      lines.push('No fresh Workbench batch for this accepted control. Legacy Workbench must not be used unless explicitly re-enabled by a later Resort-native bridge stage.');
      return lines.join('\n');
    }
    lines.push(
      `causal revision r${batch.revision} · acceptance a${batch.acceptanceSequence} · distance ${batch.distanceId || '(none)'} · control ${batch.controlId || '(none)'}`,
      `requests ${batch.requested} · ok ${batch.succeeded} · failed ${batch.failed}`,
      'These results are factual execution evidence only. They do not alter Mission/Distance/decisions by themselves.'
    );
    let used = lines.join('\n').length;
    for (const result of Array.isArray(batch.results) ? batch.results : []) {
      const block = JSON.stringify(result, null, options.thinNormal ? 0 : 2);
      if (used + block.length > WORKBENCH_DISPATCH_MAX_CHARS_M05P3) {
        lines.push(`(remaining Workbench evidence omitted by ${WORKBENCH_DISPATCH_MAX_CHARS_M05P3}-char dispatch budget)`);
        break;
      }
      lines.push(block);
      used += block.length + 1;
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  function workbenchCausalContractAcceptanceM05P3() {
    const parserPayload = validateThinPatchPayloadV627({ workbenchOps: [{ op: 'capabilities.list', args: {}, mutation: false }] });
    const sections = {
      patchFieldAccepted: Array.isArray(parserPayload.workbenchOps) && parserPayload.workbenchOps.length === 1,
      toolOnlyDoesNotDeclareSemanticEffect: semanticPayloadDeclaresDurableEffectsV645({ workbenchOps: [{ op: 'capabilities.list', args: {}, mutation: false }] }) === false,
      adapterHasNoSemanticAuthority: WorkbenchM05P2.status().semanticAuthority === false,
      projectDataCompatibilityPathFalse: WorkbenchM05P2.status().projectDataCompatibilityPath === false,
    };
    return {
      schema: 'vibe-go-legacy-workbench-causal-contract-acceptance/v1',
      ok: Object.values(sections).every(Boolean),
      sections,
    };
  }

  const WorkbenchM05P2 = Object.freeze({
    schema: WORKBENCH_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_M05P2,
    status: () => ({
      schema: WORKBENCH_ADAPTER_SCHEMA_M05P2,
      enabled: CONFIG.legacyWorkbenchEnabled === true,
      quarantined: CONFIG.legacyWorkbenchEnabled !== true,
      transport: CONFIG.legacyWorkbenchEnabled === true ? 'armed-extension-relay' : 'disabled-legacy-donor',
      relayRequestSchema: WORKBENCH_RELAY_REQUEST_SCHEMA_M05P2,
      relayResponseSchema: WORKBENCH_RELAY_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_M05P2,
      channel: WORKBENCH_RELAY_CHANNEL_M05P2,
      semanticAuthority: false,
      projectDataCompatibilityPath: false,
      causalPatchField: 'workbenchOps',
      causalEvidenceSchema: WORKBENCH_BATCH_SCHEMA_M05P3,
      readySeenAt: workbenchRuntimeM05P2.readySeenAt,

        const dispatchId = String(options.dispatchId || '').trim();
        const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(24, Number(options.limit || 12)));
        const turns = getTailTurns();
        const matches = [];
        for (const turn of turns) {
          if (turn?.role !== 'assistant') continue;
          const markerText = String(turn.markerText || '');
          const readableText = String(turn.readableText || '');
          const haystack = `${markerText}\n${readableText}`;
          if (token && !haystack.includes(token)) continue;
          if (dispatchId && !haystack.includes(dispatchId)) continue;
          const parsed = parseSemanticTurn(turn);
          matches.push({
            key: turn.key || null,
            order: Number.isFinite(turn.order) ? turn.order : null,
            markerChars: markerText.length,
            readableChars: readableText.length,
            markerHasVGResult: markerText.includes('[[VG_RESULT'),
            markerHasVGPatch: markerText.includes('[[VG_PATCH'),
            markerHasWorkbenchOps: markerText.includes('workbenchOps'),
            readableHasVGResult: readableText.includes('[[VG_RESULT'),
            readableHasVGPatch: readableText.includes('[[VG_PATCH'),
            readableHasWorkbenchOps: readableText.includes('workbenchOps'),
            parsed: parsed ? {
              id: parsed.id || null,
              protocol: parsed.protocol || null,
              invalid: parsed.invalid === true,
              incomplete: parsed.incomplete === true,
              reason: parsed.reason || null,
              payloadKeys: parsed.payload && typeof parsed.payload === 'object'
                ? Object.keys(parsed.payload)
                : [],
              dispatchId: parsed.payload?.dispatchId || null,
              baseRevision: parsed.payload?.baseRevision ?? null,
              action: parsed.payload?.action || null,
              workbenchOps: cloneSemanticValue(parsed.payload?.workbenchOps || null),
              rawChars: String(parsed.raw || '').length,
            } : null,
            markerPreview: semanticMemoryText(markerText, 6000),
            readablePreview: semanticMemoryText(readableText, 6000),
          });
          if (matches.length >= limit) break;
        }
        return {
          schema: 'vibe-go-legacy-workbench-native-tail-snapshot/v1',
          token: token || null,
          dispatchId: dispatchId || null,
          turnCount: turns.length,
          matches,
        };
      },
      sessionSnapshot: () => {
        const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
        const batch = session?.transport?.lastWorkbenchOpsM05P3 || null;
        const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
        return {
          schema: 'cc-m0-5-p3-native-session-snapshot/v1',

          revision: session ? Number(session.revision || 0) : null,

          status: session?.status || null,

            status: pending.status || null,
            controlId: pending.controlId || null,
          } : null,

  const RESORT_ENVIRONMENT_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_V01 = 'resort-vibe-environment-contract/v1';

  function normalizeResortPathV01(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .trim()
      .replace(/\//g, '\\')
      .replace(/\\+$/, '')
      .toLowerCase();
  }

  function resortEnvironmentContractV01() {
    return Object.freeze({
      schema: RESORT_ENVIRONMENT_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_V01,
      projectId: String(CONFIG.resortProjectId || 'resort-empire-web'),
      bindingState: String(CONFIG.resortEnvironmentBindingState || 'UNBOUND'),
      expected: Object.freeze({
        environmentId: CONFIG.resortExpectedEnvironmentId || null,
        hostName: CONFIG.resortExpectedHostName || null,
        repoRoot: CONFIG.resortExpectedRepoRoot || null,
        chatGptProjectId: CONFIG.resortExpectedChatGptProjectId || null,
        platform: String(CONFIG.resortRequiredPlatform || 'windows'),
        shell: String(CONFIG.resortRequiredShell || 'powershell'),
      }),
      failClosedCode: 'ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH',
      fallbackToOtherHostAllowed: false,
    });
  }

  function resortBrowserProjectObservationV01() {
    const observedProjectId = stableProjectRouteIdentityV621(location.pathname);
    return {
      schema: 'resort-vibe-browser-project-observation/v1',
      pathname: String(location.pathname || ''),
      observedChatGptProjectId: observedProjectId || null,
    };
  }

  function resortEnvironmentPreflightV01(evidenceInput = {}) {
    const contract = resortEnvironmentContractV01();
    const evidence = evidenceInput && typeof evidenceInput === 'object'
      ? cloneSemanticValue(evidenceInput)
      : {};
    const expected = contract.expected;
    const browser = resortBrowserProjectObservationV01();

    const failures = [];
    if (contract.bindingState !== 'BOUND') {
      failures.push({
        code: 'ENVIRONMENT_BINDING_UNBOUND',
        message: 'Exact environment binding is complete only when supplied runtime evidence matches the bound Windows host, repository root, platform, shell, environment id, and current ChatGPT project id.',
      });
    }

    if (expected.chatGptProjectId) {
      if (!browser.observedChatGptProjectId ||
          String(browser.observedChatGptProjectId).toLowerCase() !== String(expected.chatGptProjectId).toLowerCase()) {
        failures.push({
          code: 'CHATGPT_PROJECT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH',
          expected: expected.chatGptProjectId,
          observed: browser.observedChatGptProjectId,
        });
      }
    }

    if (expected.environmentId &&
        String(evidence.environmentId || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== String(expected.environmentId).trim().toLowerCase()) {
      failures.push({
        code: 'ENVIRONMENT_ID_MISMATCH',
        expected: expected.environmentId,
        observed: evidence.environmentId || null,
      });
    }

    if (expected.hostName &&
        String(evidence.hostName || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== String(expected.hostName).trim().toLowerCase()) {
      failures.push({
        code: 'HOST_IDENTITY_MISMATCH',
        expected: expected.hostName,
        observed: evidence.hostName || null,
      });
    }

    if (expected.repoRoot &&
        normalizeResortPathV01(evidence.repoRoot) !== normalizeResortPathV01(expected.repoRoot)) {
      failures.push({
        code: 'REPOSITORY_ROOT_MISMATCH',
        expected: expected.repoRoot,
        observed: evidence.repoRoot || null,
      });
    }

    if (expected.platform &&
        String(evidence.platform || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== String(expected.platform).trim().toLowerCase()) {
      failures.push({
        code: 'PLATFORM_MISMATCH',
        expected: expected.platform,
        observed: evidence.platform || null,
      });
    }

    if (expected.shell &&
        String(evidence.shell || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== String(expected.shell).trim().toLowerCase()) {
      failures.push({
        code: 'SHELL_MISMATCH',
        expected: expected.shell,
        observed: evidence.shell || null,
      });
    }

    const readyForMutation = failures.length === 0;
    return {
      schema: 'resort-vibe-environment-preflight/v1',
      projectId: contract.projectId,
      bindingState: contract.bindingState,
      browser,
      evidence,
      failures,
      readyForMutation,
      decision: readyForMutation ? 'ALLOW_PROJECT_MUTATION' : 'ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH',
    };
  }

  function assertResortEnvironmentForMutationV01(evidenceInput = {}) {
    const result = resortEnvironmentPreflightV01(evidenceInput);
    if (!result.readyForMutation) {
      const error = new Error(
        `ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: ${result.failures.map(item => item.code).join(', ') || 'unknown mismatch'}`
      );
      error.code = 'ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH';
      error.preflight = result;
      throw error;
    }
    return result;
  }
