      configureBridge: baseUrl => {
        const value = String(baseUrl || '').trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
        if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) throw new Error('Project Data bridge URL must be http(s)');
        projectDataRuntimeV670.baseUrl = value;
        return ProjectDataV670.status();
      },
    }),

    dispatchPlanner: Object.freeze({
      intents: [...DispatchPlannerV642.intents],
      profiles: cloneSemanticValue(DispatchPlannerV642.profiles),
      plan: (session, options) => DispatchPlannerV642.plan(session || SemanticSessionStore.load(), options || {}),
      acceptanceV642: () => DispatchPlannerV642.acceptance(),
      envelopeAcceptanceV643: () => adaptiveIntentEnvelopeAcceptanceV643(),
    }),

    semantic: {
      ready: options => ensureSemanticSessionReady({ required: false, ...(options || {}) }),
      lane: Object.freeze({
        schema: SEMANTIC_LANE_SCHEMA_V6918,
        current: () => ({ laneId: currentSemanticLaneIdV6918(), sessionId: SemanticSessionStore.load()?.id || null }),
        ofSession: session => semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(session || SemanticSessionStore.load()),
        set: (laneId, options = {}) => setSemanticLaneV6918(laneId, options || {}),
        available: () => [...new Set([SEMANTIC_LANE_DEFAULT_V6918, persistedSemanticLaneIdV6918(), currentSemanticLaneIdV6918()])],
      }),
      missionContract: Object.freeze({
        schema: configuredMissionProfileV670().schema,
        revision: configuredMissionProfileV670().revision,
        direction: configuredMissionProfileV670().direction,
        reminder: configuredMissionProfileV670().reminder,
        profile: () => cloneSemanticValue(configuredMissionProfileV670()),
        migrate: options => applyConfiguredMissionProfileV670(options || {}),
        status: () => cloneSemanticValue(SemanticSessionStore.load()?.mission?.contract || null),
        authority: () => {
          const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
          return session ? {
            sessionId: session.id,
            profile: semanticMissionProfileIdV678(session),
            direction: session.mission?.direction || '',
            contract: cloneSemanticValue(session.mission?.contract || null),
            automaticMigrationEnabled: configuredMissionProfileV670().id !== 'mission-neutral',
          } : null;
        },
      }),
      createSession: options => SemanticDistanceProtocol.createSession(options),
      loadSession: () => SemanticDistanceProtocol.loadSession(),
      clearSession: () => SemanticDistanceProtocol.clearSession(),
      humanPromises: Object.freeze({
        convention: 'human_promise',
        list: options => semanticHumanPromiseItemsV700(
          SemanticSessionStore.load(),
          options || {}
        ),
        projection: () => semanticHumanPromiseProjectionV700(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
        resolve: (id, resolution = '') => resolveSemanticHumanPromiseV700(id, resolution),
      }),
      reconcileTail: () =>
        SemanticDistanceProtocol.reconcile(
          getTailTurns(),
          SemanticDistanceProtocol.loadSession()
        ),
      recoverFromTail: options => recoverSemanticAuthorityFromTail(options),
      reanchorTransport: options => reanchorSemanticTransport(options),
      reconcileAuthority: options => reconcileCrossChatSourceAuthority({ force: true, ...(options || {}) }),
      authorityStatus: () => ({
        current: localSemanticSourceAuthority(SemanticSessionStore.load()),
        semanticLaneId: currentSemanticLaneIdV6918(),
        reconciliation: getRuntimeStateValue(AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_STATE_KEY, null),
      }),
      finalizeInitiativeBootstrap: options => finalizeInitiativeSemanticBootstrap(options),
      applyState: payload => SemanticDistanceProtocol.applyState(payload),
      buildDispatch: () => SemanticDistanceProtocol.buildDispatch(),
      parseDispatchTurn: turn => SemanticDistanceProtocol.parseDispatchTurn(turn),
      interruption: Object.freeze({
        arm: message => armUserInterruption(message),
        cancel: reason => cancelUserInterruption(reason),
        resume: () => resumeUserInterruption(),
        status: () => cloneSemanticValue(currentUserInterruptionPromise() || null),
      }),
      activate: options => ProtocolRuntime.activateSemantic(options),
      status: () => ({
        session: SemanticDistanceProtocol.loadSession(),
        panel: SemanticDistanceProtocol.getPanelProjection(),
        source: SourceWorkspace.status(),
        working: WorkingSource.status(),
        intelligence: SourceIntelligence.status(),
        projectData: ProjectDataV670.status(),
        semanticLane: { laneId: currentSemanticLaneIdV6918(), sessionLaneId: semanticSessionLaneIdV6918(SemanticSessionStore.load()) },
      }),
      exportSession: () => SemanticSessionStore.export(),
      selfTest: () => SemanticDistanceProtocol.selfTest(),
      idleBoundaryAcceptanceV696: () => semanticIdleBoundaryAcceptanceV696(),
      openMissionContinuityAcceptanceV704: () => openMissionContinuityAcceptanceV704(),
      agency: Object.freeze({
        schema: SEMANTIC_AGENCY_SCHEMA_V690,
        projection: () => {
          const session = SemanticSessionStore.load();
          if (!session) return null;
          ensureSemanticAgencyV690(session);
          return {
            tacticalFocus: session.route?.tacticalFocus || session.route?.nextFocus || '',
            frontier: cloneSemanticValue(session.strategicFrontier),
            antiTunnel: cloneSemanticValue(detectSemanticAntiTunnelV690(session)),
          };
        },
        acceptanceV690: () => semanticAgencyAcceptanceV690(),
        acceptanceBranchV691: () => semanticStrategicBranchAcceptanceV691(),
      }),
      scheduler: Object.freeze({
        projection: () => cloneSemanticValue(semanticSchedulerProjectionV677(SemanticSessionStore.load())),
        reconcileFromCurrentInbox: async () => {
          const snapshot = await refreshOperatorAsyncInboxV676();
          return { snapshot, scheduler: cloneSemanticValue(semanticSchedulerProjectionV677(SemanticSessionStore.load())) };
        },
        selfTest: () => semanticSchedulerSelfTestV677(),
        openMissionContinuityAcceptanceV704: () => openMissionContinuityAcceptanceV704(),
      }),
    },
  };

  registerVibeGoSelfSourcePart(
    '00-runner',
    `(${VibeGoRunner.toString()})();`
  );

  vibeBootstrapPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return { staleInstance: true, runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id };
      let persistence = await hydrateRuntimePersistence();
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return { staleInstance: true, runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id };
      const crossChatRecovery = CONFIG.automaticCrossChatRecoveryEnabled === true
        ? await maybeAutoRecoverCrossChatAuthority()
        : {
            recovered: false,
            skipped: true,
            reason: 'MISSION_NEUTRAL_SUPERVISED_RECOVERY_ONLY: automatic cross-chat adoption is disabled; use explicit recovery/adoption authority.',
          };
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return { staleInstance: true, runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id };
      if (crossChatRecovery?.recovered) {
        persistence = await hydrateRuntimePersistence({ force: true });
      }
      await claimSemanticRuntimeLeaseV616('operator-package-bootstrap');
      persistDeferredSemanticCompactionAfterLeaseV619();
      await flushRuntimePersistence();

      // Resort Stage 2C: runtime owns no built-in project Mission.
      // Preserve explicit external Mission authority, but fail closed if an isolated
      // Resort namespace somehow contains a known donor Mission schema.
      const missionAuthorityCheckV01 = await applyConfiguredMissionProfileV670().catch(error => {
        warn('external mission-authority check could not complete', error);
        return { migrated: false, error: error?.message || String(error) };
      });
      if (missionAuthorityCheckV01?.rejected) {
        throw new Error(
          `RESORT_LEGACY_MISSION_AUTHORITY_REJECTED: ${missionAuthorityCheckV01.missionSchema || missionAuthorityCheckV01.detectedProfile || 'unknown'}`
        );
      }

      ProtocolRuntime.initialize();
      createPanel();
      const refactorAudit = await maybeAutoRunWorkingRefactorAudit().catch(error => {
        warn('Automatic Working Refactor Audit could not complete', error);
        return { error: error?.message || String(error) };
      });
      // Installing/injecting this runner package is itself an explicit supervised
      // operator action. A historical platform-pressure latch may therefore be
      // cleared here when the pressure UI is no longer actually present. Live
      // pressure is still checked synchronously inside start() and always wins.
      // This prevents yesterday's cooldown metadata from making a freshly
      // installed continuous runner look like the old manual-first brick.
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return { staleInstance: true, runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id };
      if (crossChatRecovery?.recovered) {
        // First migration into the isolated a16 authority namespace is deliberately
        // operator-supervised. Recovery may have selected the strongest legacy DB;
        // do not emit a model-facing dispatch until the recovered revision/Working
        // identity and durable lease are visible to the operator once.
        state.running = false;
        setPhase('idle', 'authority namespace migration recovered; verify status, then run await VibeGo.start()');
        showBanner('authority recovered · verify once, then start', '#0f766e', 12000);
        await flushRuntimePersistence();
        log('isolated authority migration ready for supervised start', {
          semanticRevision: SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.revision ?? null,
          workingRevision: SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.sourceCursor?.workingRevision || null,
          runtimeDatabaseName: RUNTIME_DB_NAME,
          sourceDatabaseName: SOURCE_DB_NAME,
          lease: semanticRuntimeLeaseV616,
        });
        return status();
      }
      if (globalThis.__VIBE_GO_SUPERVISED_INSTALL_NO_AUTOSTART_V697__ === true) {
        state.running = false;
        setPhase('idle', 'supervised package install · auto-start suppressed by V697 operator flag');
        log('Supervised package install loaded without auto-start', {
          sessionId: SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.id || null,
          revision: SemanticSessionStore.peek()?.revision ?? null,
          pathname: location.pathname,
        });
      } else {
        await start({ explicit: true, reason: 'operator-package-bootstrap' });
      }
      if (!isCurrentRunnerInstanceV614()) return { staleInstance: true, runnerInstanceId: runnerInstanceTokenV614.id };
      await flushRuntimePersistence();
      log('Full IndexedDB persistence ready', {
        persistence,
        crossChatRecovery,
        missionAuthorityCheckV01,
        refactorAudit: refactorAudit
          ? { verdict: refactorAudit.verdict || null, working: refactorAudit.working?.identity || null }
          : null,
      });
      return status();
    } catch (error) {
      fail('Full IndexedDB bootstrap failed', error);
      state.running = false;
      setPhase('hold', `IDB bootstrap failed: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
      throw error;
    }
  })();
})();

;(function VibeGoManifestBootstrap() {
  'use strict';

  // Mission-neutral compatibility launcher. It never owns project Mission authority.
  // Project work must provide explicit external direction/reminder/contract.
  const MANIFEST_BOOTSTRAP = Object.freeze({
    package: 'VIBE-GO Resort Web v0.1 · Mission Neutral',
    manifest: Object.freeze({
      id: 'MODEL-OPERATING-MANIFEST:EXPLICIT-MISSION-BOOTSTRAP',
      title: 'EXPLICIT MISSION BOOTSTRAP',
      sha256: '0fce37bb8f154edbe527d3c3415d26915025162365078292824f421d5e259936',
    }),
    session: Object.freeze({
      direction:
        window.VibeGo?.semantic?.missionContract?.direction ||
        'No project Mission is configured by this launcher. Supply explicit Mission authority before project work.',
      reminder:
        window.VibeGo?.semantic?.missionContract?.reminder ||
        'Mission authority is external. This launcher contains no built-in project goal and must not invent one.',
      activity: 'RECON',
      activeDistance: Object.freeze({
        id: 'distance-explicit-mission-bootstrap',
        objective: 'Await explicit Mission authority; perform no project work under this placeholder Distance.',
        closureContract: 'An explicit externally supplied Mission/Distance replaces this placeholder before project work begins.',
      }),
      nextFocus: 'Do not infer a project goal from the runtime package. Await explicit session bootstrap authority.',
      sourceCursor: Object.freeze({
        baseline: null,
        baselineId: null,
        activeRange: null,
        coveredThrough: null,
        workingRevision: null,
      }),
    }),
  });

  function readBootstrapState() {
    return window.VibeGo?.persistence?.getRuntimeState?.('manifestBootstrap', {}) || {};
  }

  function writeBootstrapState(patch) {
    if (!window.VibeGo?.persistence?.patchRuntimeState) {
      throw new Error('VIBE full-IDB persistence is not initialized');
    }
    return window.VibeGo.persistence.patchRuntimeState('manifestBootstrap', patch || {});
  }

  function sessionBelongsToManifest(session) {
    if (!session || typeof session !== 'object') return false;
    return String(session.mission?.contract?.schema || '') === 'vibe-go-explicit-mission-bootstrap/v1';
  }

  async function activate({ fresh = false, session: explicitSession = null } = {}) {
    await window.VibeGo?.persistence?.ready?.();
    if (!window.VibeGo?.activateSemantic) {
      throw new Error('VibeGo semantic runtime is not initialized');
    }

    const existing = window.VibeGo.semantic.loadSession();
    const resume = !fresh && !explicitSession && sessionBelongsToManifest(existing);

    if (fresh && existing) window.VibeGo.semantic.clearSession();

    const requested = explicitSession && typeof explicitSession === 'object'
      ? explicitSession
      : MANIFEST_BOOTSTRAP.session;
    const session = await window.VibeGo.activateSemantic(
      resume
        ? { resume: true }
        : {
            ...requested,
            sourceCursor: { ...(requested.sourceCursor || {}) },
            activeDistance: { ...(requested.activeDistance || {}) },
          }
    );

    writeBootstrapState({
      activatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      mode: resume ? 'resume-placeholder' : (explicitSession ? 'explicit-session' : 'fresh-placeholder'),
      sessionId: session?.id || null,
      revision: session?.revision ?? null,
      manifestSha256: MANIFEST_BOOTSTRAP.manifest.sha256,
      missionSchema: session?.mission?.contract?.schema || null,
    });
    await window.VibeGo.persistence.flush();
    return session;
  }

  async function restartFresh(options = {}) {
    window.VibeGo?.stop?.();
    window.VibeGo?.semantic?.clearSession?.();
    writeBootstrapState({ restartedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
    return activate({ fresh: true, session: options.session || null });
  }

  window.VibeGoManifest = Object.freeze({
    config: MANIFEST_BOOTSTRAP,
    activate,
    resume: () => activate({ fresh: false }),
    restartFresh,
    status: () => ({
      bootstrap: readBootstrapState(),
      protocol: window.VibeGo?.protocolStatus?.() || null,
      semantic: window.VibeGo?.semantic?.status?.() || null,
    }),
  });

  (globalThis.__VIBE_GO_SELF_SOURCE_PARTS__ ||= {})['10-manifest'] =
    `;(${VibeGoManifestBootstrap.toString()})();`;

  console.log(
    '%c[VIBE-GO RESORT WEB MANIFEST]',
    'color:#a78bfa;font-weight:900',
    'Mission-neutral compatibility launcher loaded. It will not choose a project Mission automatically.'
  );
})();

;(function VibeGoAlphaInstaller() {
  'use strict';

  /*
   * VIBE-GO v6.0 · ALPHA LAUNCH PATH
   *
   * This is deliberately not another workflow subsystem.  It is a compact
   * launch/recovery projection over the already existing SemanticSession,
   * SourceWorkspace, WorkingSource and ProtocolRuntime APIs.
   */
  const ALPHA_SCHEMA = 'vibe-go-alpha-launch/v1';
  const MANIFEST_SHA256 =
    '0fce37bb8f154edbe527d3c3415d26915025162365078292824f421d5e259936';

  function alphaNow() {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  }

  function alphaRead() {
    const value = window.VibeGo?.persistence?.getRuntimeState?.('alphaLaunch', {}) || {};
    return value && typeof value === 'object' ? value : {};
  }

  function alphaWrite(patch) {
    if (!window.VibeGo?.persistence?.replaceRuntimeState) {
      throw new Error('VIBE full-IDB persistence is not initialized');
    }
    const next = {
      ...alphaRead(),
      ...patch,
      schema: ALPHA_SCHEMA,
      updatedAt: alphaNow(),
    };
    window.VibeGo.persistence.replaceRuntimeState('alphaLaunch', next);
    return next;
  }

  function alphaSessionOptions(overrides = {}) {
    const base = {
      direction:
        window.VibeGo?.semantic?.missionContract?.direction ||
        'No project Mission is configured by the runtime. Supply explicit Mission authority before project work.',
      reminder:
        window.VibeGo?.semantic?.missionContract?.reminder ||
        'Mission authority is external; alpha launch must not infer a project goal.',
      activity: 'RECON',
      missionContract: {
        schema: 'vibe-go-explicit-mission-bootstrap/v1',
        revision: '2026-09-16-mission-neutral-bootstrap-v1',
        mode: 'explicit-external-mission-authority',
      },
      activeDistance: {
        id: 'distance-explicit-mission-bootstrap',
        objective: 'Await explicit Mission authority; perform no project work under this placeholder Distance.',
        closureContract: 'Explicit Mission/Distance authority is supplied before project work begins.',
      },
      nextFocus: 'Await explicit session bootstrap authority.',
    };
    return {
      ...base,
      ...overrides,
      missionContract: {
        ...base.missionContract,
        ...(overrides.missionContract || {}),
      },
      activeDistance: {
        ...base.activeDistance,
        ...(overrides.activeDistance || {}),
      },
    };
  }

  function alphaSnapshot() {
    const protocol = window.VibeGo?.protocolStatus?.() || null;
    const semantic = window.VibeGo?.semantic?.status?.() || null;
    const session = semantic?.session || null;
    const source = semantic?.source || null;
    const working = semantic?.working || null;
    const launch = alphaRead();
    const activeRange =
      source?.workspace?.cursor?.activeRange ||
      session?.sourceCursor?.activeRange ||
      null;
    const coveredThrough =
      source?.workspace?.cursor?.coveredThrough ??
      session?.sourceCursor?.coveredThrough ??
      null;
    const pending = session?.transport?.pendingDispatch || null;
    const initial = launch.initial || null;
    const reloadExpectation = launch.reloadExpectation || null;
    const reloadVerified = Boolean(
      reloadExpectation &&
      session?.id === reloadExpectation.sessionId &&
      source?.baseline?.sha256 === reloadExpectation.baselineSha256 &&
      working?.identity === reloadExpectation.workingIdentity &&
      Number(session?.revision) >= Number(reloadExpectation.semanticRevision)
    );
    return {
      package: 'VIBE-GO Resort Web v0.1 · Mission Neutral',
      manifestSha256: MANIFEST_SHA256,
      launch,
      protocol,
      session: session
        ? {
            id: session.id,
            revision: session.revision,
            status: session.status,
            activity: session.route?.activity || null,
            activeDistanceId: session.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
            deepeningDepth: session.route?.deepeningStack?.length || 0,
            notes: session.notes?.filter(item => item.status !== 'resolved').length || 0,
            pendingDispatch: pending
              ? {
                  id: pending.id,
                  baseRevision: pending.baseRevision,
                  status: pending.status,
                  retries: pending.retries || 0,
                }
              : null,
          }
        : null,
      source: source
        ? {
            ready: Boolean(source.ready),
            baseline: source.baseline || null,
            activeRange,
            coveredThrough,
            workspaceRevision: source.workspace?.revision ?? null,
          }
        : null,
      working: working
        ? {
            ready: Boolean(working.ready),
            identity: working.identity || null,
            sequence: working.sequence ?? null,
            activeSpanCount: working.activeSpanCount ?? null,
          }
        : null,
      acceptance: {
        semanticActive: protocol?.mode === 'semantic',
        manifestSession: Boolean(
          String(session?.mission?.contract?.schema || '') === 'vibe-go-explicit-mission-bootstrap/v1'
        ),
        realBaselineLoaded: Boolean(source?.ready && source?.baseline?.sha256),
        activeChunkAvailable: Boolean(activeRange),
        dispatchKnown: Boolean(pending?.id || session?.transport?.lastControl?.id),
        stateAcceptedAfterLaunch: Boolean(
          initial && Number(session?.revision) > Number(initial.semanticRevision)
        ),
        cursorMovedAfterLaunch: Boolean(
          initial &&
          Number(session?.revision) > Number(initial.semanticRevision) &&
          (
            Number(coveredThrough ?? -1) > Number(initial.coveredThrough ?? -1) ||
            Number(activeRange?.start ?? -1) !== Number(initial.activeStart ?? -1)
          )
        ),
        workingChangedAfterLaunch: Boolean(
          initial &&
          Number(session?.revision) > Number(initial.semanticRevision) &&
          working?.identity &&
          working.identity !== initial.workingIdentity
        ),
        reloadVerified,
      },
    };
  }

  async function alphaLaunch(options = {}) {
    await window.VibeGo?.persistence?.ready?.();
    if (!window.VibeGo?.semantic || !window.VibeGo?.source) {
      throw new Error('VIBE-GO Resort Web v0.1 runtime is not initialized');
    }
    const existing = window.VibeGo.semantic.loadSession();
    const pendingInitiative = existing?.transport?.initiativeBootstrap?.status === 'awaiting-source';
    if (pendingInitiative && options.fresh !== true) {
      return alphaAdoptInitiative(options);
    }
    const fresh = options.fresh === true
      ? true
      : options.fresh === false
        ? false
        : !existing;

    window.VibeGo.stop();

    if (fresh) {
      if (existing) {
        try {
          await window.VibeGo.source.clear({
            deleteBaseline: options.deletePreviousBaseline === true,
            deleteWorking: true,
            deleteIntelligence: true,
          });
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn('[VIBE-GO ALPHA] Previous workspace cleanup skipped', error);
        }
      }
      window.VibeGo.semantic.clearSession();
      window.VibeGo.semantic.createSession(
        alphaSessionOptions(options.session || {})
      );
    } else if (!existing) {
      throw new Error('No semantic session exists to resume');
    }

    const session = window.VibeGo.semantic.loadSession();
    if (!session) throw new Error('Semantic session was not created');

    let sourceStatus = await window.VibeGo.source.restore(session.id);
    if (!sourceStatus?.ready || options.file) {
      sourceStatus = await window.VibeGo.source.openFile(
        options.file || null,
        {
          ...(options.metadata || {}),
          name: options.metadata?.name || options.file?.name,
        }
      );
    }

    const working = window.VibeGo.working.status();
    const activeRange =
      sourceStatus?.workspace?.cursor?.activeRange ||
      window.VibeGo.source.getActiveChunk() ||
      null;
    const initial = {
      sessionId: session.id,
      semanticRevision: session.revision,
      baselineSha256: sourceStatus?.baseline?.sha256 || null,
      workingIdentity: working?.identity || null,
      coveredThrough:
        sourceStatus?.workspace?.cursor?.coveredThrough ??
        session.sourceCursor?.coveredThrough ??
        null,
      activeStart: activeRange?.start ?? null,
      launchedAt: alphaNow(),
    };
    alphaWrite({
      state: 'launching',
      initial,
      reloadExpectation: null,
      lastError: null,
    });

    // Materialize the first causal dispatch only after the real baseline and
    // active chunk are ready.  Protocol activation then owns physical sending.
    window.VibeGo.semantic.buildDispatch();

    const activated = await window.VibeGo.activateSemantic({ resume: true });
    alphaWrite({
      state: 'active',
      sessionId: activated?.id || session.id,
      activatedAt: alphaNow(),
    });

    await window.VibeGo.persistence.flush();
    const snapshot = alphaSnapshot();
    console.log(
      '%c[VIBE-GO v6.7.0-a09.18 ALPHA · COMPATIBILITY API]',
      'color:#34d399;font-weight:900',
      'Live alpha launched',
      snapshot
    );
    return snapshot;
  }

  async function alphaAdoptInitiative(options = {}) {
    await window.VibeGo?.persistence?.ready?.();
    if (!window.VibeGo?.semantic || !window.VibeGo?.source) {
      throw new Error('VIBE-GO Resort Web v0.1 runtime is not initialized');
    }
    window.VibeGo.stop();
    let session = window.VibeGo.semantic.loadSession();
    if (!session) {
      await window.VibeGo.recover({ reason: 'alpha-adopt-initiative' });
      session = window.VibeGo.semantic.loadSession();
    }
    const bootstrap = session?.transport?.initiativeBootstrap;
    if (!bootstrap || bootstrap.status !== 'awaiting-source') {
      throw new Error('No pending initiative VIBE_STATE bootstrap is waiting for source authority');
    }

    let sourceStatus = await window.VibeGo.source.restore(session.id);
    if (!sourceStatus?.ready || options.file) {
      sourceStatus = await window.VibeGo.source.openFile(
        options.file || null,
        {
          ...(options.metadata || {}),
          name: options.metadata?.name || options.file?.name,
          rehydrateSemanticCursor: true,
        }
      );
    }
    if (!sourceStatus?.ready) {
      throw new Error('Initiative bootstrap source attachment did not produce a ready Source Workspace');
    }

    const finalized = await window.VibeGo.semantic.finalizeInitiativeBootstrap();
    session = finalized?.session || window.VibeGo.semantic.loadSession();
    if (!session) throw new Error('Initiative bootstrap finalization lost SemanticSession');

    const working = window.VibeGo.working.status();
    const activeRange =
      sourceStatus?.workspace?.cursor?.activeRange ||
      window.VibeGo.source.getActiveChunk() ||
      null;
    alphaWrite({
      state: session.status === 'hold' ? 'hold' : 'launching',
      initial: {
        sessionId: session.id,
        semanticRevision: session.revision,
        baselineSha256: sourceStatus?.baseline?.sha256 || null,
        workingIdentity: working?.identity || null,
        coveredThrough:
          sourceStatus?.workspace?.cursor?.coveredThrough ??
          session.sourceCursor?.coveredThrough ??
          null,
        activeStart: activeRange?.start ?? null,
        launchedAt: alphaNow(),
        initiativeBootstrap: true,
      },
      reloadExpectation: null,
      lastError: null,
    });

    if (session.status !== 'hold' && session.status !== 'sealed') {
      window.VibeGo.semantic.buildDispatch();
      const activated = await window.VibeGo.activateSemantic({ resume: true });
      alphaWrite({
        state: 'active',
        sessionId: activated?.id || session.id,
        activatedAt: alphaNow(),
        initiativeAdoptedAt: alphaNow(),
      });
    }

    await window.VibeGo.persistence.flush();
    const snapshot = alphaSnapshot();
    console.log(
      '%c[VIBE-GO v6.7.0-a09.18 ALPHA · COMPATIBILITY API]',
      'color:#34d399;font-weight:900',
      'Initiative VIBE_STATE adopted; runner now owns causal dispatch',
      snapshot
    );
    return snapshot;
  }

  async function alphaResume() {
    await window.VibeGo?.persistence?.ready?.();
    if (!window.VibeGo?.semantic?.loadSession?.()) {
      throw new Error('No semantic alpha session to resume');
    }
    if (window.VibeGo.status?.().running) {
      window.VibeGo.stop({ reason: 'alpha resume lifecycle quiesce', source: 'alpha-resume' });
    }
    const session = window.VibeGo.semantic.loadSession();
    await window.VibeGo.source.restore(session.id);
    const activated = await window.VibeGo.activateSemantic({ resume: true });

    const operatorControl = window.VibeGo.operator?.status?.()?.control || null;
    let lifecycleResult;
    if (operatorControl?.status === 'active') {
      lifecycleResult = await window.VibeGo.operator.resume({ source: 'alpha-resume' });
    } else {
      lifecycleResult = await window.VibeGo.start({ explicit: true, reason: 'alpha resume canonical lifecycle' });
    }
    const lifecycleStatus = window.VibeGo.status?.() || {};
    if (lifecycleStatus.running !== true) {
      alphaWrite({ state: 'hold', sessionId: activated?.id || session.id, lastError: `Alpha resume lifecycle failed: ${lifecycleStatus.detail || lifecycleStatus.phase || 'runner-not-running'}` });
      await window.VibeGo.persistence.flush();
      throw new Error(`Alpha resume lifecycle failed: runner not running (${lifecycleStatus.phase || 'unknown'} · ${lifecycleStatus.detail || 'no detail'})`);
    }

    alphaWrite({
      state: 'active',
      sessionId: activated?.id || session.id,
      resumedAt: alphaNow(),
      lastError: null,
      lifecycle: {
        schema: 'vibe-go-alpha-resume-lifecycle/v1',
        running: true,
        phase: lifecycleStatus.phase || null,
        operatorStatus: window.VibeGo.operator?.status?.()?.control?.status || null,
        result: lifecycleResult ? { resumed: lifecycleResult.resumed === true, reason: lifecycleResult.reason || null, startedRunner: lifecycleResult.startedRunner === true, operatorControl: lifecycleResult.operatorControl ?? null, decision: lifecycleResult.decision || null } : null,
      },
    });
    await window.VibeGo.persistence.flush();
    return alphaSnapshot();
  }

  async function alphaPrepareReload() {
    const snapshot = alphaSnapshot();
    if (!snapshot.session || !snapshot.source?.baseline?.sha256) {
      throw new Error('Alpha session with loaded baseline is required');
    }
    const expectation = {
      sessionId: snapshot.session.id,
      semanticRevision: snapshot.session.revision,
      baselineSha256: snapshot.source.baseline.sha256,
      workingIdentity: snapshot.working?.identity || null,
      activeRange: snapshot.source.activeRange || null,
      coveredThrough: snapshot.source.coveredThrough ?? null,
      preparedAt: alphaNow(),
    };
    alphaWrite({ reloadExpectation: expectation });
    await window.VibeGo.persistence.flush();
    console.log(
      '%c[VIBE-GO v6.7.0-a09.18 ALPHA · COMPATIBILITY API]',
      'color:#fbbf24;font-weight:900',
      'Reload expectation durably saved in IDB. Reload the page, re-inject this package, then call VibeGoAlpha.verifyReload().',
      expectation
    );
    return expectation;
  }

  async function alphaVerifyReload() {
    const session = window.VibeGo?.semantic?.loadSession?.();
    if (!session) throw new Error('Semantic session not found after reload');
    await window.VibeGo.source.restore(session.id);
    if (window.VibeGo.protocols.active() !== 'semantic-distance-runtime-v1') {
      await window.VibeGo.activateSemantic({ resume: true });
    }
    const snapshot = alphaSnapshot();
    alphaWrite({
      reloadVerifiedAt: snapshot.acceptance.reloadVerified ? alphaNow() : null,
      lastReloadVerification: snapshot.acceptance.reloadVerified,
    });
    await window.VibeGo.persistence.flush();
    if (!snapshot.acceptance.reloadVerified) {
      throw new Error(
        'Reload recovery mismatch; inspect VibeGoAlpha.status() before continuing'
      );
    }
    console.log(
      '%c[VIBE-GO v6.7.0-a09.18 ALPHA · COMPATIBILITY API]',
      'color:#60a5fa;font-weight:900',
      'Reload recovery verified',
      snapshot
    );
    return snapshot;
  }

  async function alphaResetProjection() {
    window.VibeGo?.persistence?.clearRuntimeState?.('alphaLaunch');
    await window.VibeGo?.persistence?.flush?.();
    return true;
  }

  window.VibeGoAlpha = Object.freeze({
    schema: ALPHA_SCHEMA,
    launch: alphaLaunch,
    adoptInitiative: alphaAdoptInitiative,
    resume: alphaResume,
    status: alphaSnapshot,
    acceptance: () => alphaSnapshot().acceptance,
    prepareReload: alphaPrepareReload,
    verifyReload: alphaVerifyReload,
    resetProjection: alphaResetProjection,
  });

  (globalThis.__VIBE_GO_SELF_SOURCE_PARTS__ ||= {})['20-alpha'] =
    `;(${VibeGoAlphaInstaller.toString()})();`;

  console.log(
    '%c[VIBE-GO v6.7.0-a09.18 ALPHA · COMPATIBILITY API]',
    'color:#34d399;font-weight:900',
    'Package loaded. Ledger Console + DB import/export active. Start/resume with: await VibeGoAlpha.launch() / await VibeGoAlpha.adoptInitiative() / await VibeGoAlpha.resume()'
  );
})();

;(function VibePerfInstaller(global) {
  'use strict';

  const VERSION = '1.0.0';
  const GLOBAL_KEY = 'VibePerf';

  try {
    global[GLOBAL_KEY]?.destroy?.();
  } catch {
    // Previous observability instance may not exist.
  }

  const DEFAULTS = {
    maxEvents: 5000,
    maxEventBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
    maxIncidents: 12,
    incidentPreMs: 15000,
    incidentPostMs: 5000,
    incidentCooldownMs: 10000,

    eventLoopIntervalMs: 100,
    eventLoopRecordLagMs: 50,
    eventLoopIncidentLagMs: 250,
    frameRecordGapMs: 50,
    frameIncidentGapMs: 250,
    longTaskIncidentMs: 250,
    longFrameIncidentMs: 250,
    eventDurationThresholdMs: 40,
    eventIncidentMs: 250,

    memorySampleMs: 1000,
    memoryHardFailureBytes: Math.round(2.0 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    memoryCrashZoneBytes: Math.round(2.5 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    memoryIncidentDeltaBytes: 128 * 1024 * 1024,

    pressureSampleMs: 1000,
    autoIncidents: true,
    consoleSink: false,
  };

  const KNOWN_CHANNELS = Object.freeze([
    'cpu-pressure',
    'main-thread',
    'frames',
    'events',
    'memory',
    'operations',
    'render',
    'workers',
    'queues',
    'dom',
  ]);

  const PRESETS = Object.freeze({
    minimal: ['main-thread', 'frames', 'memory'],
    ui: ['main-thread', 'frames', 'events', 'render', 'dom', 'memory'],
    analysis: ['main-thread', 'frames', 'memory', 'operations', 'workers', 'queues'],
    full: [...KNOWN_CHANNELS],
  });

  const config = { ...DEFAULTS };
  const enabled = new Set();
  const events = [];
  const incidents = [];
  const activeOperations = new Map();
  const operationStack = [];
  const activeTraces = new Map();
  const queueDepths = new Map();
  const workerTasks = new Map();
  const monitors = new Map();

  let totalEventBytes = 0;
  let running = false;
  let sequence = 0;
  let incidentSequence = 0;
  let traceSequence = 0;
  let lastIncidentAt = -Infinity;
  let contextCache = { at: -Infinity, value: null };
  let lastMemorySample = null;
  let lastPressureState = null;
  let maxLongTaskMs = 0;
  let maxFrameGapMs = 0;
  let maxEventLoopLagMs = 0;
  let maxEventDurationMs = 0;

  const perf = global.performance || {
    now: () => Date.now(),
  };

  function monoNow() {
    try {
      return Number(perf.now()) || 0;
    } catch {
      return Date.now();
    }
  }

  function wallNow() {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  }

  function makeId(prefix) {
    sequence += 1;
    return `${prefix}:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${sequence.toString(36)}`;
  }

  function safeValue(value, depth = 0, seen = new WeakSet()) {
    if (value == null) return value;
    const type = typeof value;
    if (type === 'string') {
      return value.length > 1200 ? value.slice(0, 1200) + '…' : value;
    }
    if (type === 'number' || type === 'boolean') return value;
    if (type === 'bigint') return String(value);
    if (type === 'function') return `[Function ${value.name || 'anonymous'}]`;
    if (type !== 'object') return String(value);
    if (depth >= 4) return '[MaxDepth]';
    if (seen.has(value)) return '[Circular]';
    seen.add(value);

    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      return value.slice(0, 30).map(item => safeValue(item, depth + 1, seen));
    }

    const output = {};
    for (const key of Object.keys(value).slice(0, 60)) {
      try {
        output[key] = safeValue(value[key], depth + 1, seen);
      } catch (error) {
        output[key] = `[Unreadable: ${error?.message || error}]`;
      }
    }
    return output;
  }

  function estimateBytes(value) {
    try {
      return Math.max(64, JSON.stringify(value).length * 2);
    } catch {
      return 256;
    }
  }

  function currentVibeContext() {
    const at = monoNow();
    if (at - contextCache.at < 250) return contextCache.value;

    let value = null;
    try {
      const session = global.VibeGo?.semantic?.loadSession?.() || null;
      const source = global.VibeGo?.source?.status?.() || null;
      const working = global.VibeGo?.working?.status?.() || null;
      if (session || source || working) {
        value = {
          sessionId: session?.id || null,
          semanticRevision: session?.revision ?? null,
          distanceId: session?.route?.activeDistanceId || null,
          activity: session?.route?.activity || null,
          baselineSha256: source?.baseline?.sha256 || null,
          workingIdentity: working?.identity || null,
        };
      }
    } catch {
      value = null;
    }
    contextCache = { at, value };
    return value;
  }

  function trimEvents() {
    while (
      events.length > config.maxEvents ||
      totalEventBytes > config.maxEventBytes
    ) {
      const removed = events.shift();
      totalEventBytes -= Number(removed?._bytes || 0);
    }
  }

  function maybeConsole(event) {
    if (!config.consoleSink) return;
    const method = event.severity === 'critical' || event.severity === 'error'
      ? 'error'
      : event.severity === 'warn'
        ? 'warn'
        : 'log';
    console[method]?.('[VIBE-PERF]', event.channel, event.type, event.payload || '');
  }

  function emit(channel, type, payload = {}, options = {}) {
    if (!enabled.has(channel) && !options.force) return null;
    const event = {
      id: makeId('evt'),
      ts: monoNow(),
      wall: wallNow(),
      channel,
      type,
      severity: options.severity || 'info',
      operationId: options.operationId || null,
      parentOperationId: options.parentOperationId || null,
      context: currentVibeContext(),
      payload: safeValue(payload),
    };
    event._bytes = estimateBytes(event);
    events.push(event);
    totalEventBytes += event._bytes;
    trimEvents();
    maybeConsole(event);
    return event;
  }

  function recentEvents(sinceMs, channel = null) {
    const cutoff = monoNow() - Math.max(0, Number(sinceMs) || 0);
    return events
      .filter(event => event.ts >= cutoff && (!channel || event.channel === channel))
      .map(event => {
        const { _bytes, ...copy } = event;
        return copy;
      });
  }

  function finalizeIncident(id) {
    const incident = incidents.find(item => item.id === id);
    if (!incident || incident.status !== 'open') return incident || null;
    const endTs = incident.triggerTs + incident.postMs;
    incident.postEvents = events
      .filter(event => event.ts >= incident.triggerTs && event.ts <= endTs)
      .map(event => {
        const { _bytes, ...copy } = event;
        return copy;
      });
    incident.status = 'closed';
    incident.closedAt = wallNow();
    return incident;
  }

  function triggerIncident(reason, metadata = {}, options = {}) {
    if (!config.autoIncidents && !options.force) return null;
    const at = monoNow();
    if (!options.force && at - lastIncidentAt < config.incidentCooldownMs) return null;
    lastIncidentAt = at;
    incidentSequence += 1;
    const preMs = Number(options.preMs ?? config.incidentPreMs);
    const postMs = Number(options.postMs ?? config.incidentPostMs);
    const incident = {
      id: `incident:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${incidentSequence.toString(36)}`,
      reason: String(reason || 'runtime-pressure'),
      severity: options.severity || 'warn',
      triggerTs: at,
      triggeredAt: wallNow(),
      preMs,
      postMs,
      metadata: safeValue(metadata),
      context: currentVibeContext(),
      preEvents: events
        .filter(event => event.ts >= at - preMs && event.ts <= at)
        .map(event => {
          const { _bytes, ...copy } = event;
          return copy;
        }),
      postEvents: [],
      status: 'open',
    };
    incidents.push(incident);
    while (incidents.length > config.maxIncidents) incidents.shift();
    emit('operations', 'incident-trigger', {
      incidentId: incident.id,
      reason: incident.reason,
      severity: incident.severity,
    }, { force: true, severity: incident.severity });
    setTimeout(() => finalizeIncident(incident.id), Math.max(0, postMs));
    return safeValue(incident);
  }

  function observePerformanceType(type, callback, options = {}) {
    const PO = global.PerformanceObserver;
    if (typeof PO !== 'function') return null;
    const supported = Array.isArray(PO.supportedEntryTypes)
      ? PO.supportedEntryTypes
      : [];
    if (supported.length && !supported.includes(type)) return null;
    try {
      const observer = new PO(list => callback(list.getEntries()));
      const observeOptions = { type, buffered: true };
      if (options.durationThreshold != null) {
        observeOptions.durationThreshold = options.durationThreshold;
      }
      observer.observe(observeOptions);
      return observer;
    } catch {
      try {
        const observer = new PO(list => callback(list.getEntries()));
        observer.observe({ entryTypes: [type] });
        return observer;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  function startLongTaskMonitor() {
    const observer = observePerformanceType('longtask', entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const duration = Number(entry.duration || 0);
        maxLongTaskMs = Math.max(maxLongTaskMs, duration);
        const attribution = Array.from(entry.attribution || []).slice(0, 8).map(item => ({
          name: item.name || null,
          entryType: item.entryType || null,
          containerType: item.containerType || null,
          containerName: item.containerName || null,
          containerSrc: item.containerSrc || null,
        }));
        emit('main-thread', 'long-task', {
          startTime: entry.startTime,
          duration,
          name: entry.name || null,
          attribution,
        }, { severity: duration >= config.longTaskIncidentMs ? 'warn' : 'info' });
        if (duration >= config.longTaskIncidentMs) {
          triggerIncident('long-task', { duration, startTime: entry.startTime }, { severity: 'warn' });
        }
      }
    });
    return () => observer?.disconnect?.();
  }

  function startLongAnimationFrameMonitor() {
    const observer = observePerformanceType('long-animation-frame', entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const duration = Number(entry.duration || 0);
        const blockingDuration = Number(entry.blockingDuration || 0);
        maxFrameGapMs = Math.max(maxFrameGapMs, duration);
        const scripts = Array.from(entry.scripts || [])
          .sort((a, b) => Number(b.duration || 0) - Number(a.duration || 0))
          .slice(0, 8)
          .map(script => ({
            sourceURL: script.sourceURL || null,
            sourceFunctionName: script.sourceFunctionName || null,
            duration: Number(script.duration || 0),
            executionStart: Number(script.executionStart || 0),
            forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration: Number(script.forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration || 0),
          }));
        emit('frames', 'long-animation-frame', {
          startTime: entry.startTime,
          duration,
          blockingDuration,
          renderStart: Number(entry.renderStart || 0),
          styleAndLayoutStart: Number(entry.styleAndLayoutStart || 0),
          scripts,
        }, { severity: duration >= config.longFrameIncidentMs ? 'warn' : 'info' });
        if (duration >= config.longFrameIncidentMs) {
          triggerIncident('long-animation-frame', { duration, blockingDuration }, { severity: 'warn' });
        }
      }
    });
    return () => observer?.disconnect?.();
  }

  function startEventTimingMonitor() {
    const observer = observePerformanceType('event', entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const duration = Number(entry.duration || 0);
        maxEventDurationMs = Math.max(maxEventDurationMs, duration);
        const inputDelay = Math.max(0, Number(entry.processingStart || 0) - Number(entry.startTime || 0));
        const processing = Math.max(0, Number(entry.processingEnd || 0) - Number(entry.processingStart || 0));
        emit('events', 'event-timing', {
          name: entry.name || null,
          startTime: entry.startTime,
          duration,
          inputDelay,
          processing,
          interactionId: entry.interactionId || 0,
          cancelable: Boolean(entry.cancelable),
        }, { severity: duration >= config.eventIncidentMs ? 'warn' : 'info' });
        if (duration >= config.eventIncidentMs) {
          triggerIncident('slow-interaction', { name: entry.name, duration, inputDelay }, { severity: 'warn' });
        }
      }
    }, { durationThreshold: config.eventDurationThresholdMs });
    return () => observer?.disconnect?.();
  }

  function startEventLoopMonitor() {
    let expected = monoNow() + config.eventLoopIntervalMs;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const actual = monoNow();
      const lag = Math.max(0, actual - expected);
      expected = actual + config.eventLoopIntervalMs;
      maxEventLoopLagMs = Math.max(maxEventLoopLagMs, lag);
      if (lag >= config.eventLoopRecordLagMs) {
        emit('main-thread', 'event-loop-lag', { lag, intervalMs: config.eventLoopIntervalMs }, {
          severity: lag >= config.eventLoopIncidentLagMs ? 'warn' : 'info',
        });
      }
      if (lag >= config.eventLoopIncidentLagMs) {
        triggerIncident('event-loop-lag', { lag }, { severity: 'warn' });
      }
    }, config.eventLoopIntervalMs);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }

  function startRafMonitor() {
    if (typeof global.requestAnimationFrame !== 'function') return () => {};
    let active = true;
    let last = null;
    let rafId = null;
    const tick = timestamp => {
      if (!active) return;
      if (last != null) {
        const gap = Math.max(0, Number(timestamp) - last);
        maxFrameGapMs = Math.max(maxFrameGapMs, gap);
        if (gap >= config.frameRecordGapMs) {
          emit('frames', 'frame-gap', {
            gap,
            hidden: Boolean(global.document?.hidden),
          }, { severity: gap >= config.frameIncidentGapMs ? 'warn' : 'info' });
          if (!global.document?.hidden && gap >= config.frameIncidentGapMs) {
            triggerIncident('frame-gap', { gap }, { severity: 'warn' });
          }
        }
      }
      last = Number(timestamp);
      rafId = global.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rafId = global.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => {
      active = false;
      if (rafId != null && typeof global.cancelAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        global.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      }
    };
  }

  function lightMemorySnapshot() {
    const memory = perf.memory;
    if (!memory) return null;
    return {
      usedJSHeapSize: Number(memory.usedJSHeapSize || 0),
      totalJSHeapSize: Number(memory.totalJSHeapSize || 0),
      jsHeapSizeLimit: Number(memory.jsHeapSizeLimit || 0),
    };
  }

  function recordMemorySample(sample, source = 'performance.memory') {
    if (!sample) return null;
    const at = monoNow();
    const delta = lastMemorySample
      ? Number(sample.usedJSHeapSize || 0) - Number(lastMemorySample.sample.usedJSHeapSize || 0)
      : 0;
    const elapsedMs = lastMemorySample ? Math.max(1, at - lastMemorySample.at) : 0;
    const slopeBytesPerSec = elapsedMs ? (delta / elapsedMs) * 1000 : 0;
    const used = Number(sample.usedJSHeapSize || sample.bytes || 0);
    const severity = used >= config.memoryCrashZoneBytes
      ? 'critical'
      : used >= config.memoryHardFailureBytes
        ? 'error'
        : Math.abs(delta) >= config.memoryIncidentDeltaBytes
          ? 'warn'
          : 'info';
    const event = emit('memory', 'memory-sample', {
      source,
      ...sample,
      deltaBytes: delta,
      slopeBytesPerSec,
    }, { severity });
    if (used >= config.memoryCrashZoneBytes) {
      triggerIncident('memory-crash-zone', { usedJSHeapSize: used, ...sample }, { severity: 'critical' });
    } else if (used >= config.memoryHardFailureBytes) {
      triggerIncident('memory-hard-failure-zone', { usedJSHeapSize: used, ...sample }, { severity: 'error' });
    } else if (Math.abs(delta) >= config.memoryIncidentDeltaBytes) {
      triggerIncident('memory-spike', { usedJSHeapSize: used, deltaBytes: delta }, { severity: 'warn' });
    }
    lastMemorySample = { at, sample: { ...sample } };
    return event;
  }

  function startMemoryMonitor() {
    const sample = () => recordMemorySample(lightMemorySnapshot());
    sample();
    const timer = setInterval(sample, config.memorySampleMs);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }

  async function deepMemorySnapshot() {
    if (typeof perf.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory !== 'function') return null;
    const result = await perf.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory();
    return {
      bytes: Number(result?.bytes || 0),
      breakdown: safeValue(result?.breakdown || []),
    };
  }

  function startCpuPressureMonitor() {
    const PO = global.PressureObserver;
    if (typeof PO !== 'function') return () => {};
    let observer;
    try {
      observer = new PO(records => {
        for (const record of records || []) {
          const state = record.state || null;
          lastPressureState = state;
          const severity = state === 'critical' ? 'critical' : state === 'serious' ? 'warn' : 'info';
          emit('cpu-pressure', 'pressure', {
            source: record.source || 'cpu',
            state,
            time: record.time ?? null,
            ownContributionEstimate: record.ownContributionEstimate ?? null,
          }, { severity });
          if (state === 'critical' || state === 'serious') {
            triggerIncident(`cpu-pressure-${state}`, { state }, { severity });
          }
        }
      });
      const result = observer.observe('cpu', { sampleInterval: config.pressureSampleMs });
      Promise.resolve(result).catch(() => {});
    } catch {
      return () => {};
    }
    return () => {
      try { observer.unobserve?.('cpu'); } catch {}
      try { observer.disconnect?.(); } catch {}
    };
  }

  function startDomMonitor() {
    if (typeof global.MutationObserver !== 'function' || !global.document) return () => {};
    const observer = new global.MutationObserver(records => {
      let added = 0;
      let removed = 0;
      let attributes = 0;
      let characterData = 0;
      for (const record of records) {
        added += record.addedNodes?.length || 0;
        removed += record.removedNodes?.length || 0;
        if (record.type === 'attributes') attributes += 1;
        if (record.type === 'characterData') characterData += 1;
      }
      emit('dom', 'mutation-batch', {
        records: records.length,
        added,
        removed,
        attributes,
        characterData,
      });
    });
    observer.observe(global.document.documentElement || global.document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      attributes: true,
      characterData: true,
    });
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }

  function monitorKey(channel, suffix = 'default') {
    return `${channel}:${suffix}`;
  }

  function ensureMonitor(channel) {
    if (!running || !enabled.has(channel)) return;

    const startOne = (key, starter) => {
      if (monitors.has(key)) return;
      const stop = starter() || (() => {});
      monitors.set(key, stop);
    };

    if (channel === 'main-thread') {
      startOne(monitorKey(channel, 'longtask'), startLongTaskMonitor);
      startOne(monitorKey(channel, 'event-loop'), startEventLoopMonitor);
    } else if (channel === 'frames') {
      startOne(monitorKey(channel, 'loaf'), startLongAnimationFrameMonitor);
      startOne(monitorKey(channel, 'raf'), startRafMonitor);
    } else if (channel === 'events') {
      startOne(monitorKey(channel), startEventTimingMonitor);
    } else if (channel === 'memory') {
      startOne(monitorKey(channel), startMemoryMonitor);
    } else if (channel === 'cpu-pressure') {
      startOne(monitorKey(channel), startCpuPressureMonitor);
    } else if (channel === 'dom') {
      startOne(monitorKey(channel), startDomMonitor);
    }
  }

  function stopChannelMonitors(channel) {
    for (const [key, stop] of [...monitors.entries()]) {
      if (!key.startsWith(`${channel}:`)) continue;
      try { stop(); } catch {}
      monitors.delete(key);
    }
  }

  function start() {
    running = true;
    for (const channel of enabled) ensureMonitor(channel);
    return status();
  }

  function stop() {
    running = false;
    for (const stop of monitors.values()) {
      try { stop(); } catch {}
    }
    monitors.clear();
    return status();
  }

  function enable(channel) {
    if (channel === 'all') return enableAll();
    if (!KNOWN_CHANNELS.includes(channel)) throw new Error(`Unknown VibePerf channel: ${channel}`);
    enabled.add(channel);
    if (!running) running = true;
    ensureMonitor(channel);
    return status();
  }

  function disable(channel) {
    if (channel === 'all') return disableAll();
    enabled.delete(channel);
    stopChannelMonitors(channel);
    return status();
  }

  function enablePreset(name) {
    const channels = PRESETS[name];
    if (!channels) throw new Error(`Unknown VibePerf preset: ${name}`);
    for (const channel of channels) enabled.add(channel);
    if (!running) running = true;
    for (const channel of channels) ensureMonitor(channel);
    return status();
  }

  function enableAll() {
    for (const channel of KNOWN_CHANNELS) enabled.add(channel);
    if (!running) running = true;
    for (const channel of KNOWN_CHANNELS) ensureMonitor(channel);
    return status();
  }

  function disableAll() {
    for (const channel of [...enabled]) stopChannelMonitors(channel);
    enabled.clear();
    return status();
  }

  function configure(patch = {}) {
    const numericKeys = Object.keys(DEFAULTS).filter(key => typeof DEFAULTS[key] === 'number');
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
      if (!(key in DEFAULTS)) throw new Error(`Unknown VibePerf config key: ${key}`);
      if (numericKeys.includes(key)) {
        const number = Number(value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(number) || number < 0) throw new Error(`Invalid numeric config: ${key}`);
        config[key] = number;
      } else {
        config[key] = Boolean(value);
      }
    }
    trimEvents();
    return status();
  }

  function removeOperationFromStack(id) {
    const index = operationStack.lastIndexOf(id);
    if (index >= 0) operationStack.splice(index, 1);
  }

  function beginChannel(channel, name, metadata = {}) {
    const id = String(metadata.operationId || makeId(channel === 'render' ? 'render' : 'op'));
    const parentOperationId = metadata.parentOperationId || operationStack.at(-1) || null;
    const startTs = monoNow();
    const operation = {
      id,
      channel,
      name: String(name || 'operation'),
      parentOperationId,
      startTs,
      startedAt: wallNow(),
      metadata: safeValue(metadata),
    };
    activeOperations.set(id, operation);
    operationStack.push(id);
    emit(channel, `${channel === 'render' ? 'render' : 'operation'}-start`, {
      name: operation.name,
      metadata: operation.metadata,
    }, { operationId: id, parentOperationId });

    let ended = false;
    const end = (outcome = {}) => {
      if (ended) return null;
      ended = true;
      const endTs = monoNow();
      const duration = Math.max(0, endTs - startTs);
      activeOperations.delete(id);
      removeOperationFromStack(id);
      return emit(channel, `${channel === 'render' ? 'render' : 'operation'}-end`, {
        name: operation.name,
        duration,
        outcome: safeValue(outcome),
      }, {
        operationId: id,
        parentOperationId,
        severity: outcome?.error ? 'error' : 'info',
      });
    };

    return {
      id,
      parentOperationId,
      startTs,
      end,
      fail(error, outcome = {}) {
        return end({
          ...outcome,
          error: error?.message || String(error),
          stack: error?.stack || null,
        });
      },
    };
  }

  function begin(name, metadata = {}) {
    return beginChannel('operations', name, metadata);
  }

  function beginRender(name, metadata = {}) {
    return beginChannel('render', name, metadata);
  }

  async function measure(name, fn, metadata = {}) {
    const scope = begin(name, metadata);
    try {
      const value = fn();
      const result = value && typeof value.then === 'function' ? await value : value;
      scope.end({ ok: true });
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      scope.fail(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  function mark(name, payload = {}, channel = 'operations') {
    if (!KNOWN_CHANNELS.includes(channel)) channel = 'operations';
    return emit(channel, 'mark', { name, ...safeValue(payload) });
  }

  function renderEvent(payload = {}) {
    return emit('render', 'render-event', payload);
  }

  function queueEvent(queue, phase, payload = {}) {
    const key = String(queue || 'default');
    let depth = Number(queueDepths.get(key) || 0);
    if (Number.isFinite(Number(payload.depth))) {
      depth = Math.max(0, Number(payload.depth));
    } else if (phase === 'enqueue') {
      depth += 1;
    } else if (['start', 'drop', 'cancel'].includes(phase)) {
      depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
    }
    queueDepths.set(key, depth);
    return emit('queues', 'queue-event', {
      queue: key,
      phase,
      depth,
      ...safeValue(payload),
    });
  }

  function workerEvent(payload = {}) {
    const workerId = String(payload.workerId || 'worker');
    const taskId = payload.taskId == null ? null : String(payload.taskId);
    const phase = String(payload.phase || 'event');
    const key = taskId ? `${workerId}:${taskId}` : null;
    let duration = Number(payload.duration || 0);
    if (key && ['queued', 'start'].includes(phase)) {
      const current = workerTasks.get(key) || {};
      workerTasks.set(key, {
        ...current,
        workerId,
        taskId,
        queuedAt: phase === 'queued' ? monoNow() : current.queuedAt,
        startedAt: phase === 'start' ? monoNow() : current.startedAt,
      });
    }
    if (key && ['complete', 'cancel', 'error'].includes(phase)) {
      const current = workerTasks.get(key);
      if (!duration && current?.startedAt != null) {
        duration = Math.max(0, monoNow() - current.startedAt);
      }
      workerTasks.delete(key);
    }
    return emit('workers', 'worker-event', {
      ...safeValue(payload),
      workerId,
      taskId,
      phase,
      duration,
    }, { severity: phase === 'error' ? 'error' : 'info' });
  }

  function ingestWorkerMessage(event) {
    const payload = event?.data?.__vibePerf || event?.__vibePerf || null;
    if (!payload) return null;
    return workerEvent(payload);
  }

  function bindWorker(worker, options = {}) {
    if (!worker?.addEventListener) throw new Error('bindWorker requires a Worker-like EventTarget');
    const handler = event => {
      const payload = event?.data?.__vibePerf;
      if (!payload) return;
      workerEvent({ workerId: options.workerId || payload.workerId, ...payload });
    };
    worker.addEventListener('message', handler);
    return () => worker.removeEventListener?.('message', handler);
  }

  function startTrace(label, metadata = {}) {
    traceSequence += 1;
    const id = `trace:${Date.now().toString(36)}:${traceSequence.toString(36)}`;
    activeTraces.set(id, {
      id,
      label: String(label || 'trace'),
      metadata: safeValue(metadata),
      startTs: monoNow(),
      startedAt: wallNow(),
    });
    emit('operations', 'trace-start', { traceId: id, label, metadata }, { force: true });
    return id;
  }

  function stopTrace(id, metadata = {}) {
    const trace = activeTraces.get(id);
    if (!trace) throw new Error(`Unknown VibePerf trace: ${id}`);
    activeTraces.delete(id);
    const endTs = monoNow();
    const traceEvents = events
      .filter(event => event.ts >= trace.startTs && event.ts <= endTs)
      .map(event => {
        const { _bytes, ...copy } = event;
        return copy;
      });
    const result = {
      ...trace,
      endedAt: wallNow(),
      endTs,
      duration: Math.max(0, endTs - trace.startTs),
      endMetadata: safeValue(metadata),
      events: traceEvents,
    };
    emit('operations', 'trace-end', { traceId: id, duration: result.duration }, { force: true });
    return result;
  }

  async function sampleMemory(options = {}) {
    const light = lightMemorySnapshot();
    if (light) recordMemorySample(light, 'performance.memory');
    let deep = null;
    if (options.deep) {
      try {
        deep = await deepMemorySnapshot();
        if (deep) recordMemorySample(deep, 'measureUserAgentSpecificMemory');
      } catch (error) {
        emit('memory', 'deep-memory-error', { error: error?.message || String(error) }, {
          force: true,
          severity: 'warn',
        });
      }
    }
    return { light, deep };
  }

  function summaryWindow(windowMs = 60000) {
    const recent = recentEvents(windowMs);
    const counts = {};
    for (const event of recent) {
      counts[event.channel] = (counts[event.channel] || 0) + 1;
    }
    return {
      windowMs,
      eventCount: recent.length,
      counts,
      maxLongTaskMs,
      maxFrameGapMs,
      maxEventLoopLagMs,
      maxEventDurationMs,
      lastPressureState,
      memory: lastMemorySample?.sample || null,
      activeOperations: activeOperations.size,
      activeWorkerTasks: workerTasks.size,
      queues: Object.fromEntries(queueDepths.entries()),
    };
  }

  function status() {
    return {
      version: VERSION,
      running,
      enabled: [...enabled],
      presets: Object.keys(PRESETS),
      config: { ...config },
      support: {
        performanceObserver: typeof global.PerformanceObserver === 'function',
        longTask: Boolean(global.PerformanceObserver?.supportedEntryTypes?.includes?.('longtask')),
        longAnimationFrame: Boolean(global.PerformanceObserver?.supportedEntryTypes?.includes?.('long-animation-frame')),
        eventTiming: Boolean(global.PerformanceObserver?.supportedEntryTypes?.includes?.('event')),
        computePressure: typeof global.PressureObserver === 'function',
        performanceMemory: Boolean(perf.memory),
        userAgentSpecificMemory: typeof perf.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory === 'function',
        requestAnimationFrame: typeof global.requestAnimationFrame === 'function',
        mutationObserver: typeof global.MutationObserver === 'function',
      },
      buffer: {
        events: events.length,
        approximateBytes: totalEventBytes,
        incidents: incidents.length,
      },
      summary: summaryWindow(),
    };
  }

  function snapshot(options = {}) {
    const sinceMs = Number(options.sinceMs ?? 60000);
    return {
      createdAt: wallNow(),
      status: status(),
      context: currentVibeContext(),
      events: recentEvents(sinceMs, options.channel || null),
      incidents: incidents.map(item => safeValue(item)),
    };
  }

  function downloadJson(filename, value) {
    if (!global.document || typeof global.Blob !== 'function' || !global.URL?.createObjectURL) {
      return false;
    }
    const blob = new global.Blob([JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = global.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = global.document.createElement('a');
    anchor.href = url;
    anchor.download = filename;
    anchor.style.display = 'none';
    global.document.body?.appendChild(anchor);
    anchor.click();
    anchor.remove();
    setTimeout(() => global.URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    return true;
  }

  function exportSnapshot(options = {}) {
    const data = snapshot(options);
    if (options.download !== false) {
      downloadJson(options.filename || `vibe-perf-${Date.now()}.json`, data);
    }
    return data;
  }

  function exportIncident(id, options = {}) {
    const incident = incidents.find(item => item.id === id);
    if (!incident) throw new Error(`Unknown incident: ${id}`);
    const data = safeValue(incident);
    if (options.download !== false) {
      downloadJson(options.filename || `${id.replace(/[:]/g, '-')}.json`, data);
    }
    return data;
  }

  function clear(options = {}) {
    events.length = 0;
    totalEventBytes = 0;
    incidents.length = 0;
    lastMemorySample = null;
    if (options.metrics !== false) {
      maxLongTaskMs = 0;
      maxFrameGapMs = 0;
      maxEventLoopLagMs = 0;
      maxEventDurationMs = 0;
      lastPressureState = null;
    }
    return status();
  }

  function destroy() {
    stop();
    activeOperations.clear();
    activeTraces.clear();
    queueDepths.clear();
    workerTasks.clear();
    return true;
  }

  async function selfTest() {
    const previousSink = config.consoleSink;
    const previousEnabled = [...enabled];
    const previousRunning = running;
    try {
      config.consoleSink = false;
      enabled.add('operations');
      enabled.add('queues');
      enabled.add('workers');
      running = true;
      const before = events.length;
      const scope = begin('self-test-operation', { test: true });
      queueEvent('self-test', 'enqueue', { taskId: 'q1' });
      queueEvent('self-test', 'start', { taskId: 'q1' });
      workerEvent({ workerId: 'w1', taskId: 't1', phase: 'start' });
      workerEvent({ workerId: 'w1', taskId: 't1', phase: 'complete' });
      scope.end({ ok: true });
      const trace = startTrace('self-test-trace');
      mark('self-test-mark');
      const traceResult = stopTrace(trace);
      const incident = triggerIncident('self-test', { ok: true }, { force: true, postMs: 0 });
      finalizeIncident(incident.id);
      return {
        ok: events.length > before,
        operationEvents: events.filter(item => item.payload?.name === 'self-test-operation').length,
        queueDepth: queueDepths.get('self-test') || 0,
        traceEvents: traceResult.events.length,
        incidentClosed: incidents.find(item => item.id === incident.id)?.status === 'closed',
        bounded: events.length <= config.maxEvents && totalEventBytes <= config.maxEventBytes,
      };
    } finally {
      config.consoleSink = previousSink;
      disableAll();
      for (const channel of previousEnabled) enabled.add(channel);
      running = previousRunning;
      if (running) for (const channel of enabled) ensureMonitor(channel);
    }
  }


  const api = {
    version: VERSION,
    channels: [...KNOWN_CHANNELS],
    presets: { ...PRESETS },
    start,
    stop,
    enable,
    disable,
    enableAll,
    disableAll,
    enablePreset,
    configure,
    status,
    snapshot,
    events: (options = {}) => recentEvents(Number(options.sinceMs ?? 60000), options.channel || null),
    incidents: () => incidents.map(item => safeValue(item)),
    triggerIncident: (reason, metadata, options) => triggerIncident(reason, metadata, { ...options, force: true }),
    finalizeIncident,
    begin,
    beginRender,
    measure,
    mark,
    renderEvent,
    queueEvent,
    workerEvent,
    ingestWorkerMessage,
    bindWorker,
    startTrace,
    stopTrace,
    sampleMemory,
    exportSnapshot,
    exportIncident,
    clear,
    selfTest,
    destroy,
    setConsoleSink(value) {
      config.consoleSink = Boolean(value);
      return config.consoleSink;
    },
  };

  global[GLOBAL_KEY] = api;
  if (global.VibeGo && typeof global.VibeGo === 'object') {
    global.VibeGo.observability = api;
  }
  (globalThis.__VIBE_GO_SELF_SOURCE_PARTS__ ||= {})['30-observability'] =
    `;(${VibePerfInstaller.toString()})(globalThis);`;

  console.log(
    '%c[VIBE-PERF v1]',
    'color:#f59e0b;font-weight:900',
    'Observer-only runtime toolkit loaded; all monitors are OFF by default. Use VibePerf.enablePreset("analysis") or VibePerf.enable("main-thread").'
  );
})(globalThis);
